text_en: I n the beginning God created heaven and earth.
text_la: In principio creavit Deus cælum et terram.
text_pt: No princípio criou Deus o céu e a terra.
text_el: ἐν ἀρχῇ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And the earth was void and empty, and darkness was upon the face of the deep , and the spirit of God moved over the waters.
text_la: Terra autem erat inanis et vacua, et tenebræ erant super faciem abyssi : et spiritus Dei ferebatur super aquas.
text_pt: E a terra era sem forma e vazia; e havia trevas sobre a face do abismo; e o Espírito de Deus se movia sobre a face das águas.
text_el: ἡ δὲ γῆ ἦν ἀόρατος καὶ ἀκατασκεύαστος καὶ σκότος ἐπάνω τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἐπεφέρετο ἐπάνω τοῦ ὕδατος

text_en: And God said: Be light made. And light was made.
text_la: Dixitque Deus : Fiat lux. Et facta est lux.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Haja luz; e houve luz.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός γενηθήτω φῶς καὶ ἐγένετο φῶς

text_en: And God saw the light, that it was good , and he divided the light from the darkness.
text_la: Et vidit Deus lucem quod esset bona : et divisit lucem a tenebris.
text_pt: E viu Deus que era boa a luz; e fez Deus separação entre a luz e as trevas.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ φῶς ὅτι καλόν καὶ διεχώρισεν ὁ θεὸς ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σκότους

text_en: And he called the light Day, and the darkness Night; and there was evening and morning, one day .
text_la: Appellavitque lucem Diem, et tenebras Noctem : factumque est vespere et mane, dies unus.
text_pt: E Deus chamou à luz Dia; e às trevas chamou Noite. E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia primeiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ φῶς ἡμέραν καὶ τὸ σκότος ἐκάλεσεν νύκτα καὶ ἐγένετο ἑσπέρα καὶ ἐγένετο πρωί ἡμέρα μία

text_en: And God said: Let there be a firmament made amidst the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.
text_la: Dixit quoque Deus : Fiat firmamentum in medio aquarum : et dividat aquas ab aquis.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Haja uma expansão no meio das águas, e haja separação entre águas e águas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός γενηθήτω στερέωμα ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ ὕδατος καὶ ἔστω διαχωρίζον ἀνὰ μέσον ὕδατος καὶ ὕδατος καὶ ἐγένετο οὕτως

text_en: And God made a firmament , and divided the waters that were under the firmament from those that were above the firmament , and it was so.
text_la: Et fecit Deus firmamentum, divisitque aquas, quæ erant sub firmamento, ab his, quæ erant super firmamentum. Et factum est ita.
text_pt: E fez Deus a expansão, e fez separação entre as águas que estavam debaixo da expansão e as águas que estavam sobre a expansão; e assim foi.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ στερέωμα καὶ διεχώρισεν ὁ θεὸς ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ὕδατος ὃ ἦν ὑποκάτω τοῦ στερεώματος καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ ὕδατος τοῦ ἐπάνω τοῦ στερεώματος

text_en: And God called the firmament Heaven; and the evening and morning were the second day .
text_la: Vocavitque Deus firmamentum, Cælum : et factum est vespere et mane, dies secundus.
text_pt: E chamou Deus à expansão Céus, e foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia segundo.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ θεὸς τὸ στερέωμα οὐρανόν καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς ὅτι καλόν καὶ ἐγένετο ἑσπέρα καὶ ἐγένετο πρωί ἡμέρα δευτέρα

text_en: God also said: Let the waters that are under the heaven be gathered together into one place, and let the dry land appear. And it was so done.
text_la: Dixit vero Deus : Congregentur aquæ, quæ sub cælo sunt, in locum unum : et appareat arida. Et factum est ita.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Ajuntem-se as águas debaixo dos céus num lugar; e apareça a porção seca; e assim foi.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός συναχθήτω τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ὑποκάτω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ εἰς συναγωγὴν μίαν καὶ ὀφθήτω ἡ ξηρά καὶ ἐγένετο οὕτως καὶ συνήχθη τὸ ὕδωρ τὸ ὑποκάτω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ εἰς τὰς συναγωγὰς αὐτῶν καὶ ὤφθη ἡ ξηρά

text_en: And God called the dry land Earth; and the gathering together of the waters, he called Seas. And God saw that it was good .
text_la: Et vocavit Deus aridam Terram, congregationesque aquarum appellavit Maria. Et vidit Deus quod esset bonum.
text_pt: E chamou Deus à porção seca Terra; e ao ajuntamento das águas chamou Mares; e viu Deus que era bom.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ὁ θεὸς τὴν ξηρὰν γῆν καὶ τὰ συστήματα τῶν ὑδάτων ἐκάλεσεν θαλάσσας καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς ὅτι καλόν

text_en: And he said: Let the earth bring forth green herb , and such as may seed, and the fruit tree yielding fruit after its kind, which may have seed in itself upon the earth. And it was so done.
text_la: Et ait : Germinet terra herbam virentem, et facientem semen, et lignum pomiferum faciens fructum juxta genus suum, cujus semen in semetipso sit super terram. Et factum est ita.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Produza a terra erva verde, erva que dê semente, árvore frutífera que dê fruto segundo a sua espécie, cuja semente está nela sobre a terra; e assim foi.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός βλαστησάτω ἡ γῆ βοτάνην χόρτου σπεῖρον σπέρμα κατὰ γένος καὶ καθ' ὁμοιότητα καὶ ξύλον κάρπιμον ποιοῦν καρπόν οὗ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ κατὰ γένος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐγένετο οὕτως

text_en: And the earth brought forth the green herb , and such as yields seed according to its kind, and the tree that bears fruit, having seed each one according to its kind. And God saw that it was good .
text_la: Et protulit terra herbam virentem, et facientem semen juxta genus suum, lignumque faciens fructum, et habens unumquodque sementem secundum speciem suam. Et vidit Deus quod esset bonum.
text_pt: E a terra produziu erva, erva dando semente conforme a sua espécie, e a árvore frutífera, cuja semente está nela conforme a sua espécie; e viu Deus que era bom.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήνεγκεν ἡ γῆ βοτάνην χόρτου σπεῖρον σπέρμα κατὰ γένος καὶ καθ' ὁμοιότητα καὶ ξύλον κάρπιμον ποιοῦν καρπόν οὗ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ κατὰ γένος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς ὅτι καλόν

text_en: And the evening and the morning were the third day .
text_la: Et factum est vespere et mane, dies tertius.
text_pt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia terceiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἑσπέρα καὶ ἐγένετο πρωί ἡμέρα τρίτη

text_en: And God said: Let there be lights made in the firmament of heaven , to divide the day and the night, and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days and years,
text_la: Dixit autem Deus : Fiant luminaria in firmamento cæli, et dividant diem ac noctem, et sint in signa et tempora, et dies et annos,
text_pt: E disse Deus: Haja luminares na expansão dos céus, para haver separação entre o dia e a noite; e sejam eles para sinais e para tempos determinados e para dias e anos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός γενηθήτωσαν φωστῆρες ἐν τῷ στερεώματι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ εἰς φαῦσιν τῆς γῆς τοῦ διαχωρίζειν ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς νυκτὸς καὶ ἔστωσαν εἰς σημεῖα καὶ εἰς καιροὺς καὶ εἰς ἡμέρας καὶ εἰς ἐνιαυτοὺς

text_en: to shine in the firmament of heaven , and to give light upon the earth. And it was so done.
text_la: ut luceant in firmamento cæli, et illuminent terram. Et factum est ita.
text_pt: E sejam para luminares na expansão dos céus, para iluminar a terra; e assim foi.
text_el: καὶ ἔστωσαν εἰς φαῦσιν ἐν τῷ στερεώματι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὥστε φαίνειν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐγένετο οὕτως

text_en: And God made two great lights — a greater light to rule the day, and a lesser light to rule the night — and the stars.
text_la: Fecitque Deus duo luminaria magna : luminare majus, ut præesset diei : et luminare minus, ut præesset nocti : et stellas.
text_pt: E fez Deus os dois grandes luminares: o luminar maior para governar o dia, e o luminar menor para governar a noite; e fez as estrelas.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τοὺς δύο φωστῆρας τοὺς μεγάλους τὸν φωστῆρα τὸν μέγαν εἰς ἀρχὰς τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τὸν φωστῆρα τὸν ἐλάσσω εἰς ἀρχὰς τῆς νυκτός καὶ τοὺς ἀστέρας

text_en: And he set them in the firmament of heaven to shine upon the earth,
text_la: Et posuit eas in firmamento cæli, ut lucerent super terram,
text_pt: E Deus os pôs na expansão dos céus para iluminar a terra,
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο αὐτοὺς ὁ θεὸς ἐν τῷ στερεώματι τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὥστε φαίνειν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: and to rule the day and the night, and to divide the light and the darkness. And God saw that it was good .
text_la: et præessent diei ac nocti, et dividerent lucem ac tenebras. Et vidit Deus quod esset bonum.
text_pt: E para governar o dia e a noite, e para fazer separação entre a luz e as trevas; e viu Deus que era bom.
text_el: καὶ ἄρχειν τῆς ἡμέρας καὶ τῆς νυκτὸς καὶ διαχωρίζειν ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ φωτὸς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σκότους καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς ὅτι καλόν

text_en: And the evening and morning were the fourth day .
text_la: Et factum est vespere et mane, dies quartus.
text_pt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia quarto.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἑσπέρα καὶ ἐγένετο πρωί ἡμέρα τετάρτη

text_en: God also said: Let the waters bring forth the creeping creature having life , and the fowl that may fly over the earth under the firmament of heaven .
text_la: Dixit etiam Deus : Producant aquæ reptile animæ viventis, et volatile super terram sub firmamento cæli.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Produzam as águas abundantemente répteis de alma vivente; e voem as aves sobre a face da expansão dos céus.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός ἐξαγαγέτω τὰ ὕδατα ἑρπετὰ ψυχῶν ζωσῶν καὶ πετεινὰ πετόμενα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κατὰ τὸ στερέωμα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἐγένετο οὕτως

text_en: And God created the great whales, and every living and moving creature which the waters brought forth, according to their kinds, and every winged fowl according to its kind. And God saw that it was good .
text_la: Creavitque Deus cete grandia, et omnem animam viventem atque motabilem, quam produxerant aquæ in species suas, et omne volatile secundum genus suum. Et vidit Deus quod esset bonum.
text_pt: E Deus criou as grandes baleias, e todo o réptil de alma vivente que as águas abundantemente produziram conforme as suas espécies; e toda a ave de asas conforme a sua espécie; e viu Deus que era bom.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τὰ κήτη τὰ μεγάλα καὶ πᾶσαν ψυχὴν ζῴων ἑρπετῶν ἃ ἐξήγαγεν τὰ ὕδατα κατὰ γένη αὐτῶν καὶ πᾶν πετεινὸν πτερωτὸν κατὰ γένος καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς ὅτι καλά

text_en: And he blessed them, saying: Increase and multiply, and fill the waters of the sea, and let the birds be multiplied upon the earth.
text_la: Benedixitque eis, dicens : Crescite, et multiplicamini, et replete aquas maris : avesque multiplicentur super terram.
text_pt: E Deus os abençoou, dizendo: Frutificai e multiplicai-vos, e enchei as águas nos mares; e as aves se multipliquem na terra.
text_el: καὶ ηὐλόγησεν αὐτὰ ὁ θεὸς λέγων αὐξάνεσθε καὶ πληθύνεσθε καὶ πληρώσατε τὰ ὕδατα ἐν ταῖς θαλάσσαις καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ πληθυνέσθωσαν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the evening and morning were the fifth day .
text_la: Et factum est vespere et mane, dies quintus.
text_pt: E foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia quinto.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἑσπέρα καὶ ἐγένετο πρωί ἡμέρα πέμπτη

text_en: And God said: Let the earth bring forth the living creature in its kind, cattle and creeping things, and beasts of the earth, according to their kinds. And it was so done.
text_la: Dixit quoque Deus : Producat terra animam viventem in genere suo, jumenta, et reptilia, et bestias terræ secundum species suas. Factumque est ita.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Produza a terra alma vivente conforme a sua espécie; gado, e répteis e feras da terra conforme a sua espécie; e assim foi.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός ἐξαγαγέτω ἡ γῆ ψυχὴν ζῶσαν κατὰ γένος τετράποδα καὶ ἑρπετὰ καὶ θηρία τῆς γῆς κατὰ γένος καὶ ἐγένετο οὕτως

text_en: And God made the beasts of the earth according to their kinds, and cattle, and everything that creeps on the earth after its kind. And God saw that it was good .
text_la: Et fecit Deus bestias terræ juxta species suas, et jumenta, et omne reptile terræ in genere suo. Et vidit Deus quod esset bonum,
text_pt: E fez Deus as feras da terra conforme a sua espécie, e o gado conforme a sua espécie, e todo o réptil da terra conforme a sua espécie; e viu Deus que era bom.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τὰ θηρία τῆς γῆς κατὰ γένος καὶ τὰ κτήνη κατὰ γένος καὶ πάντα τὰ ἑρπετὰ τῆς γῆς κατὰ γένος αὐτῶν καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς ὅτι καλά

text_en: And he said: Let us make man to our image and likeness, and let him have dominion over the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the air, and the beasts, and the whole earth, and every creeping creature that moves upon the earth.
text_la: et ait : Faciamus hominem ad imaginem et similitudinem nostram : et præsit piscibus maris, et volatilibus cæli, et bestiis, universæque terræ, omnique reptili, quod movetur in terra.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Façamos o homem à nossa imagem, conforme a nossa semelhança; e domine sobre os peixes do mar, e sobre as aves dos céus, e sobre o gado, e sobre toda a terra, e sobre todo o réptil que se move sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός ποιήσωμεν ἄνθρωπον κατ' εἰκόνα ἡμετέραν καὶ καθ' ὁμοίωσιν καὶ ἀρχέτωσαν τῶν ἰχθύων τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ τῶν πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ πάσης τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντων τῶν ἑρπετῶν τῶν ἑρπόντων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And God created man to his own image; to the image of God he created him; male and female he created them.
text_la: Et creavit Deus hominem ad imaginem suam : ad imaginem Dei creavit illum, masculum et feminam creavit eos.
text_pt: E criou Deus o homem à sua imagem; à imagem de Deus o criou; homem e mulher os criou.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον κατ' εἰκόνα θεοῦ ἐποίησεν αὐτόν ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτούς

text_en: And God blessed them, saying: Increase and multiply, and fill the earth, and subdue it, and rule over the fishes of the sea, and the fowls of the air, and all living creatures that move upon the earth.
text_la: Benedixitque illis Deus, et ait : Crescite et multiplicamini, et replete terram, et subjicite eam, et dominamini piscibus maris, et volatilibus cæli, et universis animantibus, quæ moventur super terram.
text_pt: E Deus os abençoou, e Deus lhes disse: Frutificai e multiplicai-vos, e enchei a terra, e sujeitai-a; e dominai sobre os peixes do mar e sobre as aves dos céus, e sobre todo o animal que se move sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ηὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς ὁ θεὸς λέγων αὐξάνεσθε καὶ πληθύνεσθε καὶ πληρώσατε τὴν γῆν καὶ κατακυριεύσατε αὐτῆς καὶ ἄρχετε τῶν ἰχθύων τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ τῶν πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ πάσης τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντων τῶν ἑρπετῶν τῶν ἑρπόντων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And God said: Behold I have given you every herb bearing seed upon the earth, and all trees that have in themselves seed of their own kind, to be your food;
text_la: Dixitque Deus : Ecce dedi vobis omnem herbam afferentem semen super terram, et universa ligna quæ habent in semetipsis sementem generis sui, ut sint vobis in escam:
text_pt: E disse Deus: Eis que vos tenho dado toda a erva que dê semente, que está sobre a face de toda a terra; e toda a árvore, em que há fruto que dê semente, ser-vos-á para mantimento.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός ἰδοὺ δέδωκα ὑμῖν πᾶν χόρτον σπόριμον σπεῖρον σπέρμα ὅ ἐστιν ἐπάνω πάσης τῆς γῆς καὶ πᾶν ξύλον ὃ ἔχει ἐν ἑαυτῷ καρπὸν σπέρματος σπορίμου ὑμῖν ἔσται εἰς βρῶσιν

text_en: and to all beasts of the earth, and to every fowl of the air, and to all that move upon the earth, and wherein there is life , that they may have to feed upon. And it was so done.
text_la: et cunctis animantibus terræ, omnique volucri cæli, et universis quæ moventur in terra, et in quibus est anima vivens, ut habeant ad vescendum. Et factum est ita.
text_pt: E a todo o animal da terra, e a toda a ave dos céus, e a todo o réptil da terra, em que há alma vivente, toda a erva verde será para mantimento; e assim foi.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ παντὶ ἑρπετῷ τῷ ἕρποντι ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὃ ἔχει ἐν ἑαυτῷ ψυχὴν ζωῆς πάντα χόρτον χλωρὸν εἰς βρῶσιν καὶ ἐγένετο οὕτως

text_en: And God saw all the things that he had made , and they were very good . And the evening and morning were the sixth day .
text_la: Viditque Deus cuncta quæ fecerat, et erant valde bona. Et factum est vespere et mane, dies sextus.
text_pt: E viu Deus tudo quanto tinha feito, e eis que era muito bom; e foi a tarde e a manhã, o dia sexto.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς τὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησεν καὶ ἰδοὺ καλὰ λίαν καὶ ἐγένετο ἑσπέρα καὶ ἐγένετο πρωί ἡμέρα ἕκτη

text_en: So the heavens and the earth were finished, and all the furniture of them.
text_la: Igitur perfecti sunt cæli et terra, et omnis ornatus eorum.
text_pt: Assim os céus, a terra e todo o seu exército foram acabados.
text_el: καὶ συνετελέσθησαν ὁ οὐρανὸς καὶ ἡ γῆ καὶ πᾶς ὁ κόσμος αὐτῶν

text_en: And on the seventh day God ended his work which he had made: and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.
text_la: Complevitque Deus die septimo opus suum quod fecerat : et requievit die septimo ab universo opere quod patrarat.
text_pt: E havendo Deus acabado no dia sétimo a obra que fizera, descansou no sétimo dia de toda a sua obra, que tinha feito.
text_el: καὶ συνετέλεσεν ὁ θεὸς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἕκτῃ τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ ἃ ἐποίησεν καὶ κατέπαυσεν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ἑβδόμῃ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ὧν ἐποίησεν

text_en: And he blessed the seventh day , and sanctified it: because in it he had rested from all his work which God created and made.
text_la: Et benedixit diei septimo, et sanctificavit illum, quia in ipso cessaverat ab omni opere suo quod creavit Deus ut faceret.
text_pt: E abençoou Deus o dia sétimo, e o santificou; porque nele descansou de toda a sua obra que Deus criara e fizera.
text_el: καὶ ηὐλόγησεν ὁ θεὸς τὴν ἡμέραν τὴν ἑβδόμην καὶ ἡγίασεν αὐτήν ὅτι ἐν αὐτῇ κατέπαυσεν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἔργων αὐτοῦ ὧν ἤρξατο ὁ θεὸς ποιῆσαι

text_en: These are the generations of the heaven and the earth, when they were created , in the day that the Lord God made the heaven and the earth:
text_la: Istæ sunt generationes cæli et terræ, quando creata sunt, in die quo fecit Dominus Deus cælum et terram,
text_pt: Estas são as origens dos céus e da terra, quando foram criados; no dia em que o Senhor Deus fez a terra e os céus,
text_el: αὕτη ἡ βίβλος γενέσεως οὐρανοῦ καὶ γῆς ὅτε ἐγένετο ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And every plant of the field before it sprung up in the earth, and every herb of the ground before it grew: for the Lord God had not rained upon the earth; and there was not a man to till the earth.
text_la: et omne virgultum agri antequam oriretur in terra, omnemque herbam regionis priusquam germinaret : non enim pluerat Dominus Deus super terram, et homo non erat qui operaretur terram:
text_pt: E toda a planta do campo que ainda não estava na terra, e toda a erva do campo que ainda não brotava; porque ainda o Senhor Deus não tinha feito chover sobre a terra, e não havia homem para lavrar a terra.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν χλωρὸν ἀγροῦ πρὸ τοῦ γενέσθαι ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ πάντα χόρτον ἀγροῦ πρὸ τοῦ ἀνατεῖλαι οὐ γὰρ ἔβρεξεν ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἄνθρωπος οὐκ ἦν ἐργάζεσθαι τὴν γῆν

text_en: But a spring rose out of the earth, watering all the surface of the earth.
text_la: sed fons ascendebat e terra, irrigans universam superficiem terræ.
text_pt: Um vapor, porém, subia da terra, e regava toda a face da terra.
text_el: πηγὴ δὲ ἀνέβαινεν ἐκ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπότιζεν πᾶν τὸ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the Lord God formed man of the slime of the earth: and breathed into his face the breath of life , and man became a living soul .
text_la: Formavit igitur Dominus Deus hominem de limo terræ, et inspiravit in faciem ejus spiraculum vitæ, et factus est homo in animam viventem.
text_pt: E formou o Senhor Deus o homem do pó da terra, e soprou em suas narinas o fôlego da vida; e o homem foi feito alma vivente.
text_el: καὶ ἔπλασεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον χοῦν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐνεφύσησεν εἰς τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ πνοὴν ζωῆς καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἄνθρωπος εἰς ψυχὴν ζῶσαν

text_en: And the Lord God had planted a paradise of pleasure from the beginning: wherein he placed man whom he had formed.
text_la: Plantaverat autem Dominus Deus paradisum voluptatis a principio, in quo posuit hominem quem formaverat.
text_pt: E plantou o Senhor Deus um jardim no Éden, do lado oriental; e pôs ali o homem que tinha formado.
text_el: καὶ ἐφύτευσεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς παράδεισον ἐν Εδεμ κατὰ ἀνατολὰς καὶ ἔθετο ἐκεῖ τὸν ἄνθρωπον ὃν ἔπλασεν

text_en: And the Lord God brought forth of the ground all manner of trees, fair to behold, and pleasant to eat of: the tree of life also in the midst of paradise : and the tree of knowledge of good and evil .
text_la: Produxitque Dominus Deus de humo omne lignum pulchrum visu, et ad vescendum suave lignum etiam vitæ in medio paradisi, lignumque scientiæ boni et mali.
text_pt: E o Senhor Deus fez brotar da terra toda a árvore agradável à vista, e boa para comida; e a árvore da vida no meio do jardim, e a árvore do conhecimento do bem e do mal.
text_el: καὶ ἐξανέτειλεν ὁ θεὸς ἔτι ἐκ τῆς γῆς πᾶν ξύλον ὡραῖον εἰς ὅρασιν καὶ καλὸν εἰς βρῶσιν καὶ τὸ ξύλον τῆς ζωῆς ἐν μέσῳ τῷ παραδείσῳ καὶ τὸ ξύλον τοῦ εἰδέναι γνωστὸν καλοῦ καὶ πονηροῦ

text_en: And a river went out of the place of pleasure to water paradise, which from thence is divided into four heads.
text_la: Et fluvius egrediebatur de loco voluptatis ad irrigandum paradisum, qui inde dividitur in quatuor capita.
text_pt: E saía um rio do Éden para regar o jardim; e dali se dividia e se tornava em quatro braços.
text_el: ποταμὸς δὲ ἐκπορεύεται ἐξ Εδεμ ποτίζειν τὸν παράδεισον ἐκεῖθεν ἀφορίζεται εἰς τέσσαρας ἀρχάς

text_en: The name of the one is Phison: that is it which compasses all the land of Hevilath, where gold grows.
text_la: Nomen uni Phison : ipse est qui circuit omnem terram Hevilath, ubi nascitur aurum:
text_pt: O nome do primeiro é Pisom; este é o que rodeia toda a terra de Havilá, onde há ouro.
text_el: ὄνομα τῷ ἑνὶ Φισων οὗτος ὁ κυκλῶν πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Ευιλατ ἐκεῖ οὗ ἐστιν τὸ χρυσίον

text_en: And the gold of that land is very good : there is found bdellium, and the onyx stone.
text_la: et aurum terræ illius optimum est; ibi invenitur bdellium, et lapis onychinus.
text_pt: E o ouro dessa terra é bom; ali há o bdélio, e a pedra sardônica.
text_el: τὸ δὲ χρυσίον τῆς γῆς ἐκείνης καλόν καὶ ἐκεῖ ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθραξ καὶ ὁ λίθος ὁ πράσινος

text_en: And the name of the second river is Gehon: the same is it that compasses all the land of Ethiopia .
text_la: Et nomen fluvii secundi Gehon; ipse est qui circumit omnem terram Æthiopiæ.
text_pt: E o nome do segundo rio é Giom; este é o que rodeia toda a terra de Cuxe.
text_el: καὶ ὄνομα τῷ ποταμῷ τῷ δευτέρῳ Γηων οὗτος ὁ κυκλῶν πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Αἰθιοπίας

text_en: And the name of the third river is Tigris: the same passes along by the Assyrians . And the fourth river is Euphrates.
text_la: Nomen vero fluminis tertii, Tigris : ipse vadit contra Assyrios. Fluvius autem quartus, ipse est Euphrates.
text_pt: E o nome do terceiro rio é Tigre; este é o que vai para o lado oriental da Assíria; e o quarto rio é o Eufrates.
text_el: καὶ ὁ ποταμὸς ὁ τρίτος Τίγρις οὗτος ὁ πορευόμενος κατέναντι Ἀσσυρίων ὁ δὲ ποταμὸς ὁ τέταρτος οὗτος Εὐφράτης

text_en: And the Lord God took man , and put him into the paradise of pleasure , to dress it, and to keep it.
text_la: Tulit ergo Dominus Deus hominem, et posuit eum in paradiso voluptatis, ut operaretur, et custodiret illum:
text_pt: E tomou o Senhor Deus o homem, e o pôs no jardim do Éden para o lavrar e o guardar.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον ὃν ἔπλασεν καὶ ἔθετο αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ ἐργάζεσθαι αὐτὸν καὶ φυλάσσειν

text_en: And he commanded him, saying: Of every tree of paradise you shall eat:
text_la: præcepitque ei, dicens : Ex omni ligno paradisi comede;
text_pt: E ordenou o Senhor Deus ao homem, dizendo: De toda a árvore do jardim comerás livremente,
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αδαμ λέγων ἀπὸ παντὸς ξύλου τοῦ ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ βρώσει φάγῃ

text_en: But of the tree of knowledge of good and evil , you shall not eat. For in what day soever you shall eat of it, you shall die the death.
text_la: de ligno autem scientiæ boni et mali ne comedas : in quocumque enim die comederis ex eo, morte morieris.
text_pt: Mas da árvore do conhecimento do bem e do mal, dela não comerás; porque no dia em que dela comeres, certamente morrerás.
text_el: ἀπὸ δὲ τοῦ ξύλου τοῦ γινώσκειν καλὸν καὶ πονηρόν οὐ φάγεσθε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ᾗ δ' ἂν ἡμέρᾳ φάγητε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ θανάτῳ ἀποθανεῖσθε

text_en: And the Lord God said: It is not good for man to be alone: let us make him a help like unto himself.
text_la: Dixit quoque Dominus Deus : Non est bonum esse hominem solum : faciamus ei adjutorium simile sibi.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor Deus: Não é bom que o homem esteja só; far-lhe-ei uma ajudadora idônea para ele.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεός οὐ καλὸν εἶναι τὸν ἄνθρωπον μόνον ποιήσωμεν αὐτῷ βοηθὸν κατ' αὐτόν

text_en: And the Lord God having formed out of the ground all the beasts of the earth, and all the fowls of the air, brought them to Adam to see what he would call them: for whatsoever Adam called any living creature the same is its name .
text_la: Formatis igitur Dominus Deus de humo cunctis animantibus terræ, et universis volatilibus cæli, adduxit ea ad Adam, ut videret quid vocaret ea : omne enim quod vocavit Adam animæ viventis, ipsum est nomen ejus.
text_pt: Havendo, pois, o Senhor Deus formado da terra todo o animal do campo, e toda a ave dos céus, os trouxe a Adão, para este ver como lhes chamaria; e tudo o que Adão chamou a toda a alma vivente, isso foi o seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἔπλασεν ὁ θεὸς ἔτι ἐκ τῆς γῆς πάντα τὰ θηρία τοῦ ἀγροῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτὰ πρὸς τὸν Αδαμ ἰδεῖν τί καλέσει αὐτά καὶ πᾶν ὃ ἐὰν ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸ Αδαμ ψυχὴν ζῶσαν τοῦτο ὄνομα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Adam called all the beasts by their names , and all the fowls of the air, and all the cattle of the field: but for Adam there was not found a helper like himself.
text_la: Appellavitque Adam nominibus suis cuncta animantia, et universa volatilia cæli, et omnes bestias terræ : Adæ vero non inveniebatur adjutor similis ejus.
text_pt: E Adão pôs os nomes a todo o gado, e às aves dos céus, e a todo o animal do campo; mas para o homem não se achava ajudadora idônea.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Αδαμ ὀνόματα πᾶσιν τοῖς κτήνεσιν καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς πετεινοῖς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς θηρίοις τοῦ ἀγροῦ τῷ δὲ Αδαμ οὐχ εὑρέθη βοηθὸς ὅμοιος αὐτῷ

text_en: Then the Lord God cast a deep sleep upon Adam : and when he was fast asleep, he took one of his ribs, and filled up flesh for it.
text_la: Immisit ergo Dominus Deus soporem in Adam : cumque obdormisset, tulit unam de costis ejus, et replevit carnem pro ea.
text_pt: Então o Senhor Deus fez cair um sono pesado sobre Adão, e este adormeceu; e tomou uma das suas costelas, e cerrou a carne em seu lugar;
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβαλεν ὁ θεὸς ἔκστασιν ἐπὶ τὸν Αδαμ καὶ ὕπνωσεν καὶ ἔλαβεν μίαν τῶν πλευρῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνεπλήρωσεν σάρκα ἀντ' αὐτῆς

text_en: And the Lord God built the rib which he took from Adam into a woman : and brought her to Adam .
text_la: Et ædificavit Dominus Deus costam, quam tulerat de Adam, in mulierem : et adduxit eam ad Adam.
text_pt: E da costela que o Senhor Deus tomou do homem, formou uma mulher, e trouxe-a a Adão.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὴν πλευράν ἣν ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Αδαμ εἰς γυναῖκα καὶ ἤγαγεν αὐτὴν πρὸς τὸν Αδαμ

text_en: And Adam said: This now is bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh; she shall be called woman , because she was taken out of man.
text_la: Dixitque Adam : Hoc nunc os ex ossibus meis, et caro de carne mea : hæc vocabitur Virago, quoniam de viro sumpta est.
text_pt: E disse Adão: Esta é agora osso dos meus ossos, e carne da minha carne; esta será chamada mulher, porquanto do homem foi tomada.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αδαμ τοῦτο νῦν ὀστοῦν ἐκ τῶν ὀστέων μου καὶ σὰρξ ἐκ τῆς σαρκός μου αὕτη κληθήσεται γυνή ὅτι ἐκ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς ἐλήμφθη αὕτη

text_en: Wherefore a man shall leave father and mother , and shall cleave to his wife: and they shall be two in one flesh .
text_la: Quam ob rem relinquet homo patrem suum, et matrem, et adhærebit uxori suæ : et erunt duo in carne una.
text_pt: Portanto deixará o homem o seu pai e a sua mãe, e apegar-se-á à sua mulher, e serão ambos uma carne.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τούτου καταλείψει ἄνθρωπος τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ προσκολληθήσεται πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσονται οἱ δύο εἰς σάρκα μίαν

text_en: And they were both naked: to wit, Adam and his wife: and were not ashamed.
text_la: Erat autem uterque nudus, Adam scilicet et uxor ejus : et non erubescebant.
text_pt: E ambos estavam nus, o homem e a sua mulher; e não se envergonhavam.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν οἱ δύο γυμνοί ὅ τε Αδαμ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐκ ᾐσχύνοντο

text_en: Now the serpent was more subtle than any of the beasts of the earth which the Lord God had made. And he said to the woman : Why has God commanded you, that you should not eat of every tree of paradise ?
text_la: Sed et serpens erat callidior cunctis animantibus terræ quæ fecerat Dominus Deus. Qui dixit ad mulierem : Cur præcepit vobis Deus ut non comederetis de omni ligno paradisi?
text_pt: Ora, a serpente era mais astuta que todas as alimárias do campo que o SENHOR Deus tinha feito. E esta disse à mulher: É assim que Deus disse: Não comereis de toda a árvore do jardim?
text_el: ὁ δὲ ὄφις ἦν φρονιμώτατος πάντων τῶν θηρίων τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὧν ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεός καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ὄφις τῇ γυναικί τί ὅτι εἶπεν ὁ θεός οὐ μὴ φάγητε ἀπὸ παντὸς ξύλου τοῦ ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ

text_en: And the woman answered him, saying: Of the fruit of the trees that are in paradise we do eat:
text_la: Cui respondit mulier : De fructu lignorum, quæ sunt in paradiso, vescimur:
text_pt: E disse a mulher à serpente: Do fruto das árvores do jardim comeremos,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνὴ τῷ ὄφει ἀπὸ καρποῦ ξύλου τοῦ παραδείσου φαγόμεθα

text_en: But of the fruit of the tree which is in the midst of paradise , God has commanded us that we should not eat; and that we should not touch it, lest perhaps we die.
text_la: de fructu vero ligni quod est in medio paradisi, præcepit nobis Deus ne comederemus, et ne tangeremus illud, ne forte moriamur.
text_pt: Mas do fruto da árvore que está no meio do jardim, disse Deus: Não comereis dele, nem nele tocareis para que não morrais.
text_el: ἀπὸ δὲ καρποῦ τοῦ ξύλου ὅ ἐστιν ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ παραδείσου εἶπεν ὁ θεός οὐ φάγεσθε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ οὐδὲ μὴ ἅψησθε αὐτοῦ ἵνα μὴ ἀποθάνητε

text_en: And the serpent said to the woman : No, you shall not die the death.
text_la: Dixit autem serpens ad mulierem: Nequaquam morte moriemini.
text_pt: Então a serpente disse à mulher: Certamente não morrereis.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ ὄφις τῇ γυναικί οὐ θανάτῳ ἀποθανεῖσθε

text_en: For God knows that in what day soever you shall eat thereof, your eyes shall be opened: and you shall be as Gods, knowing good and evil .
text_la: Scit enim Deus quod in quocumque die comederitis ex eo, aperientur oculi vestri, et eritis sicut dii, scientes bonum et malum.
text_pt: Porque Deus sabe que no dia em que dele comerdes se abrirão os vossos olhos, e sereis como Deus, sabendo o bem e o mal.
text_el: ᾔδει γὰρ ὁ θεὸς ὅτι ἐν ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ φάγητε ἀπ' αὐτοῦ διανοιχθήσονται ὑμῶν οἱ ὀφθαλμοί καὶ ἔσεσθε ὡς θεοὶ γινώσκοντες καλὸν καὶ πονηρόν

text_en: And the woman saw that the tree was good to eat, and fair to the eyes, and delightful to behold: and she took of the fruit thereof, and ate, and gave to her husband , who ate.
text_la: Vidit igitur mulier quod bonum esset lignum ad vescendum, et pulchrum oculis, aspectuque delectabile : et tulit de fructu illius, et comedit : deditque viro suo, qui comedit.
text_pt: E viu a mulher que aquela árvore era boa para se comer, e agradável aos olhos, e árvore desejável para dar entendimento; tomou do seu fruto, e comeu, e deu também a seu marido, e ele comeu com ela.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ἡ γυνὴ ὅτι καλὸν τὸ ξύλον εἰς βρῶσιν καὶ ὅτι ἀρεστὸν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς ἰδεῖν καὶ ὡραῖόν ἐστιν τοῦ κατανοῆσαι καὶ λαβοῦσα τοῦ καρποῦ αὐτοῦ ἔφαγεν καὶ ἔδωκεν καὶ τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς μετ' αὐτῆς καὶ ἔφαγον

text_en: And the eyes of them both were opened: and when they perceived themselves to be naked, they sewed together fig leaves, and made themselves aprons.
text_la: Et aperti sunt oculi amborum; cumque cognovissent se esse nudos, consuerunt folia ficus, et fecerunt sibi perizomata.
text_pt: Então foram abertos os olhos de ambos, e conheceram que estavam nus; e coseram folhas de figueira, e fizeram para si aventais.
text_el: καὶ διηνοίχθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ τῶν δύο καὶ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι γυμνοὶ ἦσαν καὶ ἔρραψαν φύλλα συκῆς καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς περιζώματα

text_en: And when they heard the voice of the Lord God walking in paradise at the afternoon air, Adam and his wife hid themselves from the face of the Lord God , amidst the trees of paradise .
text_la: Et cum audissent vocem Domini Dei deambulantis in paradiso ad auram post meridiem, abscondit se Adam et uxor ejus a facie Domini Dei in medio ligni paradisi.
text_pt: E ouviram a voz do Senhor Deus, que passeava no jardim pela viração do dia; e esconderam-se Adão e sua mulher da presença do Senhor Deus, entre as árvores do jardim.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσαν τὴν φωνὴν κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ περιπατοῦντος ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ τὸ δειλινόν καὶ ἐκρύβησαν ὅ τε Αδαμ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ προσώπου κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ ξύλου τοῦ παραδείσου

text_en: And the Lord God called Adam , and said to him: Where are you?
text_la: Vocavitque Dominus Deus Adam, et dixit ei : Ubi es?
text_pt: E chamou o Senhor Deus a Adão, e disse-lhe: Onde estás?
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὸν Αδαμ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Αδαμ ποῦ εἶ

text_en: And he said: I heard your voice in paradise ; and I was afraid , because I was naked, and I hid myself.
text_la: Qui ait : Vocem tuam audivi in paradiso, et timui, eo quod nudus essem, et abscondi me.
text_pt: E ele disse: Ouvi a tua voz soar no jardim, e temi, porque estava nu, e escondi-me.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τὴν φωνήν σου ἤκουσα περιπατοῦντος ἐν τῷ παραδείσῳ καὶ ἐφοβήθην ὅτι γυμνός εἰμι καὶ ἐκρύβην

text_en: And he said to him: And who has told you that you were naked, but that you have eaten of the tree whereof I commanded you that you should not eat?
text_la: Cui dixit : Quis enim indicavit tibi quod nudus esses, nisi quod ex ligno de quo præceperam tibi ne comederes, comedisti?
text_pt: E Deus disse: Quem te mostrou que estavas nu? Comeste tu da árvore de que te ordenei que não comesses?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τίς ἀνήγγειλέν σοι ὅτι γυμνὸς εἶ μὴ ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου οὗ ἐνετειλάμην σοι τούτου μόνου μὴ φαγεῖν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἔφαγες

text_en: And Adam said: The woman , whom you gave me to be my companion, gave me of the tree, and I ate.
text_la: Dixitque Adam : Mulier, quam dedisti mihi sociam, dedit mihi de ligno, et comedi.
text_pt: Então disse Adão: A mulher que me deste por companheira, ela me deu da árvore, e comi.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Αδαμ ἡ γυνή ἣν ἔδωκας μετ' ἐμοῦ αὕτη μοι ἔδωκεν ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου καὶ ἔφαγον

text_en: And the Lord God said to the woman : Why have you done this? And she answered: The serpent deceived me, and I ate.
text_la: Et dixit Dominus Deus ad mulierem : Quare hoc fecisti? Quæ respondit : Serpens decepit me, et comedi.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor Deus à mulher: Por que fizeste isto? E disse a mulher: A serpente me enganou, e eu comi.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῇ γυναικί τί τοῦτο ἐποίησας καὶ εἶπεν ἡ γυνή ὁ ὄφις ἠπάτησέν με καὶ ἔφαγον

text_en: And the Lord God said to the serpent : Because you have done this thing, you are cursed among all cattle, and beasts of the earth: upon your breast shall you go, and earth shall you eat all the days of your life.
text_la: Et ait Dominus Deus ad serpentem : Quia fecisti hoc, maledictus es inter omnia animantia, et bestias terræ : super pectus tuum gradieris, et terram comedes cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ.
text_pt: Então o Senhor Deus disse à serpente: Porquanto fizeste isto, maldita serás mais que toda a fera, e mais que todos os animais do campo; sobre o teu ventre andarás, e pó comerás todos os dias da tua vida.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῷ ὄφει ὅτι ἐποίησας τοῦτο ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν θηρίων τῆς γῆς ἐπὶ τῷ στήθει σου καὶ τῇ κοιλίᾳ πορεύσῃ καὶ γῆν φάγῃ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου

text_en: I will put enmities between you and the woman , and your seed and her seed : she shall crush your head, and you shall lie in wait for her heel.
text_la: Inimicitias ponam inter te et mulierem, et semen tuum et semen illius : ipsa conteret caput tuum, et tu insidiaberis calcaneo ejus.
text_pt: E porei inimizade entre ti e a mulher, e entre a tua semente e a sua semente; esta te ferirá a cabeça, e tu lhe ferirás o calcanhar.
text_el: καὶ ἔχθραν θήσω ἀνὰ μέσον σου καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σπέρματός σου καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σπέρματος αὐτῆς αὐτός σου τηρήσει κεφαλήν καὶ σὺ τηρήσεις αὐτοῦ πτέρναν

text_en: To the woman also he said: I will multiply your sorrows, and your conceptions: in sorrow shall you bring forth children, and you shall be under your husband's power, and he shall have dominion over you.
text_la: Mulieri quoque dixit : Multiplicabo ærumnas tuas, et conceptus tuos : in dolore paries filios, et sub viri potestate eris, et ipse dominabitur tui.
text_pt: E à mulher disse: Multiplicarei grandemente a tua dor, e a tua conceição; com dor darás à luz filhos; e o teu desejo será para o teu marido, e ele te dominará.
text_el: καὶ τῇ γυναικὶ εἶπεν πληθύνων πληθυνῶ τὰς λύπας σου καὶ τὸν στεναγμόν σου ἐν λύπαις τέξῃ τέκνα καὶ πρὸς τὸν ἄνδρα σου ἡ ἀποστροφή σου καὶ αὐτός σου κυριεύσει

text_en: And to Adam he said: Because you have hearkened to the voice of your wife , and have eaten of the tree, whereof I commanded you, that you should not eat, cursed is the earth in your work: with labour and toil shall you eat thereof all the days of your life.
text_la: Adæ vero dixit : Quia audisti vocem uxoris tuæ, et comedisti de ligno, ex quo præceperam tibi ne comederes, maledicta terra in opere tuo : in laboribus comedes ex ea cunctis diebus vitæ tuæ.
text_pt: E a Adão disse: Porquanto deste ouvidos à voz de tua mulher, e comeste da árvore de que te ordenei, dizendo: Não comerás dela, maldita é a terra por causa de ti; com dor comerás dela todos os dias da tua vida.
text_el: τῷ δὲ Αδαμ εἶπεν ὅτι ἤκουσας τῆς φωνῆς τῆς γυναικός σου καὶ ἔφαγες ἀπὸ τοῦ ξύλου οὗ ἐνετειλάμην σοι τούτου μόνου μὴ φαγεῖν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἐπικατάρατος ἡ γῆ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις σου ἐν λύπαις φάγῃ αὐτὴν πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς ζωῆς σου

text_en: Thorns and thistles shall it bring forth to you, and you shall eat the herbs of the earth.
text_la: Spinas et tribulos germinabit tibi, et comedes herbam terræ.
text_pt: Espinhos, e cardos também, te produzirá; e comerás a erva do campo.
text_el: ἀκάνθας καὶ τριβόλους ἀνατελεῖ σοι καὶ φάγῃ τὸν χόρτον τοῦ ἀγροῦ

text_en: In the sweat of your face shall you eat bread till you return to the earth out of which you were taken: for dust you are, and into dust you shall return.
text_la: In sudore vultus tui vesceris pane, donec revertaris in terram de qua sumptus es : quia pulvis es et in pulverem reverteris.
text_pt: No suor do teu rosto comerás o teu pão, até que te tornes à terra; porque dela foste tomado; porquanto és pó e em pó te tornarás.
text_el: ἐν ἱδρῶτι τοῦ προσώπου σου φάγῃ τὸν ἄρτον σου ἕως τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι σε εἰς τὴν γῆν ἐξ ἧς ἐλήμφθης ὅτι γῆ εἶ καὶ εἰς γῆν ἀπελεύσῃ

text_en: And Adam called the name of his wife Eve : because she was the mother of all the living.
text_la: Et vocavit Adam nomen uxoris suæ, Heva : eo quod mater esset cunctorum viventium.
text_pt: E chamou Adão o nome de sua mulher Eva; porquanto era a mãe de todos os viventes.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Αδαμ τὸ ὄνομα τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ Ζωή ὅτι αὕτη μήτηρ πάντων τῶν ζώντων

text_en: And the Lord God made for Adam and his wife garments of skins, and clothed them.
text_la: Fecit quoque Dominus Deus Adæ et uxori ejus tunicas pelliceas, et induit eos:
text_pt: E fez o Senhor Deus a Adão e à sua mulher túnicas de peles, e os vestiu.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αδαμ καὶ τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ χιτῶνας δερματίνους καὶ ἐνέδυσεν αὐτούς

text_en: And he said: Behold Adam has become as one of us, knowing good and evil : now therefore lest perhaps he put forth his hand and take also of the tree of life , and eat, and live for ever .
text_la: et ait : Ecce Adam quasi unus ex nobis factus est, sciens bonum et malum : nunc ergo ne forte mittat manum suam, et sumat etiam de ligno vitæ, et comedat, et vivat in æternum.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor Deus: Eis que o homem é como um de nós, sabendo o bem e o mal; ora, para que não estenda a sua mão, e tome também da árvore da vida, e coma e viva eternamente,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός ἰδοὺ Αδαμ γέγονεν ὡς εἷς ἐξ ἡμῶν τοῦ γινώσκειν καλὸν καὶ πονηρόν καὶ νῦν μήποτε ἐκτείνῃ τὴν χεῖρα καὶ λάβῃ τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς καὶ φάγῃ καὶ ζήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα

text_en: And the Lord God sent him out of the paradise of pleasure , to till the earth from which he was taken.
text_la: Et emisit eum Dominus Deus de paradiso voluptatis, ut operaretur terram de qua sumptus est.
text_pt: O Senhor Deus, pois, o lançou fora do jardim do Éden, para lavrar a terra de que fora tomado.
text_el: καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτὸν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τοῦ παραδείσου τῆς τρυφῆς ἐργάζεσθαι τὴν γῆν ἐξ ἧς ἐλήμφθη

text_en: And he cast out Adam : and placed before the paradise of pleasure Cherubims , and a flaming sword, turning every way, to keep the way of the tree of life .
text_la: Ejecitque Adam : et collocavit ante paradisum voluptatis cherubim, et flammeum gladium, atque versatilem, ad custodiendam viam ligni vitæ.
text_pt: E havendo lançado fora o homem, pôs querubins ao oriente do jardim do Éden, e uma espada inflamada que andava ao redor, para guardar o caminho da árvore da vida.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέβαλεν τὸν Αδαμ καὶ κατῴκισεν αὐτὸν ἀπέναντι τοῦ παραδείσου τῆς τρυφῆς καὶ ἔταξεν τὰ χερουβιμ καὶ τὴν φλογίνην ῥομφαίαν τὴν στρεφομένην φυλάσσειν τὴν ὁδὸν τοῦ ξύλου τῆς ζωῆς

text_en: And Adam knew Eve his wife; who conceived and brought forth Cain , saying: I have gotten a man through God .
text_la: Adam vero cognovit uxorem suam Hevam, quæ concepit et peperit Cain, dicens : Possedi hominem per Deum.
text_pt: E conheceu Adão a Eva, sua mulher, e ela concebeu e deu à luz a Caim, e disse: Alcancei do SENHOR um homem.
text_el: Αδαμ δὲ ἔγνω Ευαν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν τὸν Καιν καὶ εἶπεν ἐκτησάμην ἄνθρωπον διὰ τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And again she brought forth his brother Abel . And Abel was a shepherd, and Cain a husbandman.
text_la: Rursumque peperit fratrem ejus Abel. Fuit autem Abel pastor ovium, et Cain agricola.
text_pt: E deu à luz mais a seu irmão Abel; e Abel foi pastor de ovelhas, e Caim foi lavrador da terra.
text_el: καὶ προσέθηκεν τεκεῖν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν Αβελ καὶ ἐγένετο Αβελ ποιμὴν προβάτων Καιν δὲ ἦν ἐργαζόμενος τὴν γῆν

text_en: And it came to pass after many days, that Cain offered , of the fruits of the earth, gifts to the Lord .
text_la: Factum est autem post multos dies ut offerret Cain de fructibus terræ munera Domino.
text_pt: E aconteceu ao cabo de dias que Caim trouxe do fruto da terra uma oferta ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μεθ' ἡμέρας ἤνεγκεν Καιν ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν τῆς γῆς θυσίαν τῷ κυρίῳ

text_en: Abel also offered of the firstlings of his flock, and of their fat: and the Lord had respect to Abel , and to his offerings .
text_la: Abel quoque obtulit de primogenitis gregis sui, et de adipibus eorum : et respexit Dominus ad Abel, et ad munera ejus.
text_pt: E Abel também trouxe dos primogênitos das suas ovelhas, e da sua gordura; e atentou o Senhor para Abel e para a sua oferta.
text_el: καὶ Αβελ ἤνεγκεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἀπὸ τῶν πρωτοτόκων τῶν προβάτων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν στεάτων αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπεῖδεν ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ Αβελ καὶ ἐπὶ τοῖς δώροις αὐτοῦ

text_en: But to Cain and his offerings he had no respect: and Cain was exceeding angry , and his countenance fell.
text_la: Ad Cain vero, et ad munera illius non respexit : iratusque est Cain vehementer, et concidit vultus ejus.
text_pt: Mas para Caim e para a sua oferta não atentou. E irou-se Caim fortemente, e descaiu-lhe o semblante.
text_el: ἐπὶ δὲ Καιν καὶ ἐπὶ ταῖς θυσίαις αὐτοῦ οὐ προσέσχεν καὶ ἐλύπησεν τὸν Καιν λίαν καὶ συνέπεσεν τῷ προσώπῳ

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Why are you angry ? And why is your countenance fallen?
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad eum : Quare iratus es? et cur concidit facies tua?
text_pt: E o Senhor disse a Caim: Por que te iraste? E por que descaiu o teu semblante?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῷ Καιν ἵνα τί περίλυπος ἐγένου καὶ ἵνα τί συνέπεσεν τὸ πρόσωπόν σου

text_en: If you do well, shall you not receive? But if ill, shall not sin forthwith be present at the door? But the lust thereof shall be under you, and you shall have dominion over it.
text_la: nonne si bene egeris, recipies : sin autem male, statim in foribus peccatum aderit? sed sub te erit appetitus ejus, et tu dominaberis illius.
text_pt: Se bem fizeres, não é certo que serás aceito? E se não fizeres bem, o pecado jaz à porta, e sobre ti será o seu desejo, mas sobre ele deves dominar.
text_el: οὐκ ἐὰν ὀρθῶς προσενέγκῃς ὀρθῶς δὲ μὴ διέλῃς ἥμαρτες ἡσύχασον πρὸς σὲ ἡ ἀποστροφὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ σὺ ἄρξεις αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Cain said to Abel his brother: Let us go forth abroad. And when they were in the field, Cain rose up against his brother Abel , and slew him.
text_la: Dixitque Cain ad Abel fratrem suum : Egrediamur foras. Cumque essent in agro, consurrexit Cain adversus fratrem suum Abel, et interfecit eum.
text_pt: E falou Caim com o seu irmão Abel; e sucedeu que, estando eles no campo, se levantou Caim contra o seu irmão Abel, e o matou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Καιν πρὸς Αβελ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ διέλθωμεν εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ εἶναι αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ καὶ ἀνέστη Καιν ἐπὶ Αβελ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτόν

text_en: And the Lord said to Cain : Where is your brother Abel ? And he answered: I know not: am I my brother's keeper?
text_la: Et ait Dominus ad Cain : Ubi est Abel frater tuus? Qui respondit : Nescio : num custos fratris mei sum ego?
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Caim: Onde está Abel, teu irmão? E ele disse: Não sei; sou eu guardador do meu irmão?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Καιν ποῦ ἐστιν Αβελ ὁ ἀδελφός σου ὁ δὲ εἶπεν οὐ γινώσκω μὴ φύλαξ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ μού εἰμι ἐγώ

text_en: And he said to him: What have you done? The voice of your brother's blood cries to me from the earth.
text_la: Dixitque ad eum : Quid fecisti? vox sanguinis fratris tui clamat ad me de terra.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Que fizeste? A voz do sangue do teu irmão clama a mim desde a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός τί ἐποίησας φωνὴ αἵματος τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου βοᾷ πρός με ἐκ τῆς γῆς

text_en: Now therefore cursed shall you be upon the earth, which has opened her mouth and received the blood of your brother at your hand.
text_la: Nunc igitur maledictus eris super terram, quæ aperuit os suum, et suscepit sanguinem fratris tui de manu tua.
text_pt: E agora maldito és tu desde a terra, que abriu a sua boca para receber da tua mão o sangue do teu irmão.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἐπικατάρατος σὺ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἣ ἔχανεν τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς δέξασθαι τὸ αἷμα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου ἐκ τῆς χειρός σου

text_en: When you shall till it, it shall not yield to you its fruit: a fugitive and a vagabond shall you be upon the earth.
text_la: Cum operatus fueris eam, non dabit tibi fructus suos : vagus et profugus eris super terram.
text_pt: Quando lavrares a terra, não te dará mais a sua força; fugitivo e vagabundo serás na terra.
text_el: ὅτι ἐργᾷ τὴν γῆν καὶ οὐ προσθήσει τὴν ἰσχὺν αὐτῆς δοῦναί σοι στένων καὶ τρέμων ἔσῃ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And Cain said to the Lord : My iniquity is greater than that I may deserve pardon.
text_la: Dixitque Cain ad Dominum : Major est iniquitas mea, quam ut veniam merear.
text_pt: Então disse Caim ao Senhor: É maior a minha maldade que a que possa ser perdoada.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Καιν πρὸς τὸν κύριον μείζων ἡ αἰτία μου τοῦ ἀφεθῆναί με

text_en: Behold you do cast me out this day from the face of the earth, and from your face I shall be hid, and I shall be a vagabond and a fugitive on the earth: every one therefore that finds me, shall kill me.
text_la: Ecce ejicis me hodie a facie terræ, et a facie tua abscondar, et ero vagus et profugus in terra : omnis igitur qui invenerit me, occidet me.
text_pt: Eis que hoje me lanças da face da terra, e da tua face me esconderei; e serei fugitivo e vagabundo na terra, e será que todo aquele que me achar, me matará.
text_el: εἰ ἐκβάλλεις με σήμερον ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ προσώπου σου κρυβήσομαι καὶ ἔσομαι στένων καὶ τρέμων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔσται πᾶς ὁ εὑρίσκων με ἀποκτενεῖ με

text_en: And the Lord said to him: No, it shall not so be: but whosoever shall kill Cain , shall be punished sevenfold. And the Lord set a mark upon Cain , that whosoever found him should not kill him.
text_la: Dixitque ei Dominus : Nequaquam ita fiet : sed omnis qui occiderit Cain, septuplum punietur. Posuitque Dominus Cain signum, ut non interficeret eum omnis qui invenisset eum.
text_pt: O Senhor, porém, disse-lhe: Portanto qualquer que matar a Caim, sete vezes será castigado. E pôs o Senhor um sinal em Caim, para que o não ferisse qualquer que o achasse.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ κύριος ὁ θεός οὐχ οὕτως πᾶς ὁ ἀποκτείνας Καιν ἑπτὰ ἐκδικούμενα παραλύσει καὶ ἔθετο κύριος ὁ θεὸς σημεῖον τῷ Καιν τοῦ μὴ ἀνελεῖν αὐτὸν πάντα τὸν εὑρίσκοντα αὐτόν

text_en: And Cain went out from the face of the Lord , and dwelt as a fugitive on the earth at the east side of Eden .
text_la: Egressusque Cain a facie Domini, habitavit profugus in terra ad orientalem plagam Eden.
text_pt: E saiu Caim de diante da face do Senhor, e habitou na terra de Node, do lado oriental do Éden.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Καιν ἀπὸ προσώπου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ᾤκησεν ἐν γῇ Ναιδ κατέναντι Εδεμ

text_en: And Cain knew his wife, and she conceived, and brought forth Henoch: and he built a city, and called the name thereof by the name of his son Henoch.
text_la: Cognovit autem Cain uxorem suam, quæ concepit, et peperit Henoch : et ædificavit civitatem, vocavitque nomen ejus ex nomine filii sui, Henoch.
text_pt: E conheceu Caim a sua mulher, e ela concebeu, e deu à luz a Enoque; e ele edificou uma cidade, e chamou o nome da cidade conforme o nome de seu filho Enoque;
text_el: καὶ ἔγνω Καιν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν τὸν Ενωχ καὶ ἦν οἰκοδομῶν πόλιν καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὴν πόλιν ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ενωχ

text_en: And Henoch begot Irad, and Irad begot Maviael, and Maviael begot Mathusael, and Mathusael begot Lamech,
text_la: Porro Henoch genuit Irad, et Irad genuit Maviaël, et Maviaël genuit Mathusaël, et Mathusaël genuit Lamech.
text_pt: E a Enoque nasceu Irade, e Irade gerou a Meujael, e Meujael gerou a Metusael e Metusael gerou a Lameque.
text_el: ἐγενήθη δὲ τῷ Ενωχ Γαιδαδ καὶ Γαιδαδ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαιηλ καὶ Μαιηλ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαθουσαλα καὶ Μαθουσαλα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Λαμεχ

text_en: who took two wives: the name of the one was Ada, and the name of the other Sella.
text_la: Qui accepit duas uxores, nomen uni Ada, et nomen alteri Sella.
text_pt: E tomou Lameque para si duas mulheres; o nome de uma era Ada, e o nome da outra, Zilá.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν ἑαυτῷ Λαμεχ δύο γυναῖκας ὄνομα τῇ μιᾷ Αδα καὶ ὄνομα τῇ δευτέρᾳ Σελλα

text_en: And Ada brought forth Jabel: who was the father of such as dwell in tents, and of herdsmen.
text_la: Genuitque Ada Jabel, qui fuit pater habitantium in tentoriis, atque pastorum.
text_pt: E Ada deu à luz a Jabal; este foi o pai dos que habitam em tendas e têm gado.
text_el: καὶ ἔτεκεν Αδα τὸν Ιωβελ οὗτος ἦν ὁ πατὴρ οἰκούντων ἐν σκηναῖς κτηνοτρόφων

text_en: And his brother's name was Jubal: he was the father of them that play upon the harp and the organs.
text_la: Et nomen fratris ejus Jubal : ipse fuit pater canentium cithara et organo.
text_pt: E o nome do seu irmão era Jubal; este foi o pai de todos os que tocam harpa e órgão.
text_el: καὶ ὄνομα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ Ιουβαλ οὗτος ἦν ὁ καταδείξας ψαλτήριον καὶ κιθάραν

text_en: Sella also brought forth Tubalcain, who was a hammerer and artificer in every work of brass and iron. And the sister of Tubalcain was Noema.
text_la: Sella quoque genuit Tubalcain, qui fuit malleator et faber in cuncta opera æris et ferri. Soror vero Tubalcain, Noëma.
text_pt: E Zilá também deu à luz a Tubalcaim, mestre de toda a obra de cobre e ferro; e a irmã de Tubalcaim foi Noema.
text_el: Σελλα δὲ ἔτεκεν καὶ αὐτὴ τὸν Θοβελ καὶ ἦν σφυροκόπος χαλκεὺς χαλκοῦ καὶ σιδήρου ἀδελφὴ δὲ Θοβελ Νοεμα

text_en: And Lamech said to his wives Ada and Sella: Hear my voice, you wives of Lamech, hearken to my speech: for I have slain a man to the wounding of myself, and a stripling to my own bruising.
text_la: Dixitque Lamech uxoribus suis Adæ et Sellæ : Audite vocem meam, uxores Lamech; auscultate sermonem meum : quoniam occidi virum in vulnus meum, et adolescentulum in livorem meum.
text_pt: E disse Lameque a suas mulheres Ada e Zilá: Ouvi a minha voz; vós, mulheres de Lameque, escutai as minhas palavras; porque eu matei um homem por me ferir, e um jovem por me pisar.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Λαμεχ ταῖς ἑαυτοῦ γυναιξίν Αδα καὶ Σελλα ἀκούσατέ μου τῆς φωνῆς γυναῖκες Λαμεχ ἐνωτίσασθέ μου τοὺς λόγους ὅτι ἄνδρα ἀπέκτεινα εἰς τραῦμα ἐμοὶ καὶ νεανίσκον εἰς μώλωπα ἐμοί

text_en: Sevenfold vengeance shall be taken for Cain : but for Lamech seventy times sevenfold.
text_la: Septuplum ultio dabitur de Cain : de Lamech vero septuagies septies.
text_pt: Porque sete vezes Caim será castigado; mas Lameque setenta vezes sete.
text_el: ὅτι ἑπτάκις ἐκδεδίκηται ἐκ Καιν ἐκ δὲ Λαμεχ ἑβδομηκοντάκις ἑπτά

text_en: Adam also knew his wife again: and she brought forth a son, and called his name Seth, saying: God has given me another seed for Abel , whom Cain slew .
text_la: Cognovit quoque adhuc Adam uxorem suam : et peperit filium, vocavitque nomen ejus Seth, dicens : Posuit mihi Deus semen aliud pro Abel, quem occidit Cain.
text_pt: E tornou Adão a conhecer a sua mulher; e ela deu à luz um filho, e chamou o seu nome Sete; porque, disse ela, Deus me deu outro filho em lugar de Abel; porquanto Caim o matou.
text_el: ἔγνω δὲ Αδαμ Ευαν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν υἱὸν καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Σηθ λέγουσα ἐξανέστησεν γάρ μοι ὁ θεὸς σπέρμα ἕτερον ἀντὶ Αβελ ὃν ἀπέκτεινεν Καιν

text_en: But to Seth also was born a son, whom he called Enos: this man began to call upon the name of the Lord .
text_la: Sed et Seth natus est filius, quem vocavit Enos : iste cœpit invocare nomen Domini.
text_pt: E a Sete também nasceu um filho; e chamou o seu nome Enos; então se começou a invocar o nome do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σηθ ἐγένετο υἱός ἐπωνόμασεν δὲ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ενως οὗτος ἤλπισεν ἐπικαλεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: This is the book of the generation of Adam . In the day that God created man , he made him to the likeness of God .
text_la: Hic est liber generationis Adam. In die qua creavit Deus hominem, ad similitudinem Dei fecit illum.
text_pt: Este é o livro das gerações de Adão. No dia em que Deus criou o homem, à semelhança de Deus o fez.
text_el: αὕτη ἡ βίβλος γενέσεως ἀνθρώπων ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν Αδαμ κατ' εἰκόνα θεοῦ ἐποίησεν αὐτόν

text_en: He created them male and female ; and blessed them: and called their name Adam , in the day when they were created .
text_la: Masculum et feminam creavit eos, et benedixit illis : et vocavit nomen eorum Adam, in die quo creati sunt.
text_pt: Homem e mulher os criou; e os abençoou e chamou o seu nome Adão, no dia em que foram criados.
text_el: ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἐποίησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῶν Αδαμ ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἐποίησεν αὐτούς

text_en: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begot a son to his own image and likeness, and called his name Seth.
text_la: Vixit autem Adam centum triginta annis : et genuit ad imaginem et similitudinem suam, vocavitque nomen ejus Seth.
text_pt: E Adão viveu cento e trinta anos, e gerou um filho à sua semelhança, conforme a sua imagem, e pôs-lhe o nome de Sete.
text_el: ἔζησεν δὲ Αδαμ διακόσια καὶ τριάκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν κατὰ τὴν ἰδέαν αὐτοῦ καὶ κατὰ τὴν εἰκόνα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Σηθ

text_en: And the days of Adam , after he begot Seth, were eight hundred years: and he begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Et facti sunt dies Adam, postquam genuit Seth, octingenti anni : genuitque filios et filias.
text_pt: E foram os dias de Adão, depois que gerou a Sete, oitocentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: ἐγένοντο δὲ αἱ ἡμέραι Αδαμ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Σηθ ἑπτακόσια ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the time that Adam lived, came to nine hundred and thirty years, and he died.
text_la: Et factum est omne tempus quod vixit Adam, anni nongenti triginta, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias que Adão viveu, novecentos e trinta anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Αδαμ ἃς ἔζησεν ἐννακόσια καὶ τριάκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: Seth also lived a hundred and five years, and begot Enos.
text_la: Vixit quoque Seth centum quinque annis, et genuit Enos.
text_pt: E viveu Sete cento e cinco anos, e gerou a Enos.
text_el: ἔζησεν δὲ Σηθ διακόσια καὶ πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ενως

text_en: And Seth lived after he begot Enos, eight hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixitque Seth, postquam genuit Enos, octingentis septem annis, genuitque filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Sete, depois que gerou a Enos, oitocentos e sete anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Σηθ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Ενως ἑπτακόσια καὶ ἑπτὰ ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.
text_la: Et facti sunt omnes dies Seth nongentorum duodecim annorum, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Sete novecentos e doze anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Σηθ ἐννακόσια καὶ δώδεκα ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Enos lived ninety years, and begot Cainan.
text_la: Vixit vero Enos nonaginta annis, et genuit Cainan.
text_pt: E viveu Enos noventa anos, e gerou a Cainã.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ενως ἑκατὸν ἐνενήκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Καιναν

text_en: After whose birth he lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Post cujus ortum vixit octingentis quindecim annis, et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Enos, depois que gerou a Cainã, oitocentos e quinze anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ενως μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Καιναν ἑπτακόσια καὶ δέκα πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years, and he died.
text_la: Factique sunt omnes dies Enos nongenti quinque anni, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Enos novecentos e cinco anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Ενως ἐννακόσια καὶ πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Malaleel.
text_la: Vixit quoque Cainan septuaginta annis, et genuit Malaleel.
text_pt: E viveu Cainã setenta anos, e gerou a Maalaleel.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Καιναν ἑκατὸν ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαλελεηλ

text_en: And Cainan lived after he begot Malaleel, eight hundred and forty years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Et vixit Cainan, postquam genuit Malaleel, octingentis quadraginta annis, genuitque filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Cainã, depois que gerou a Maalaleel, oitocentos e quarenta anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Καιναν μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Μαλελεηλ ἑπτακόσια καὶ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.
text_la: Et facti sunt omnes dies Cainan nongenti decem anni, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Cainã novecentos e dez anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Καιναν ἐννακόσια καὶ δέκα ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Malaleel lived sixty-five years and begot Jared.
text_la: Vixit autem Malaleel sexaginta quinque annis, et genuit Jared.
text_pt: E viveu Maalaleel sessenta e cinco anos, e gerou a Jerede.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Μαλελεηλ ἑκατὸν καὶ ἑξήκοντα πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιαρεδ

text_en: And Malaleel lived after he begot Jared, eight hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Et vixit Malaleel, postquam genuit Jared, octingentis triginta annis, et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Maalaleel, depois que gerou a Jerede, oitocentos e trinta anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Μαλελεηλ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Ιαρεδ ἑπτακόσια καὶ τριάκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the days of Malaleel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.
text_la: Et facti sunt omnes dies Malaleel octingenti nonaginta quinque anni, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Maalaleel oitocentos e noventa e cinco anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Μαλελεηλ ὀκτακόσια καὶ ἐνενήκοντα πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Jared lived a hundred and sixty-two years, and begot Henoch .
text_la: Vixitque Jared centum sexaginta duobus annis, et genuit Henoch.
text_pt: E viveu Jerede cento e sessenta e dois anos, e gerou a Enoque.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ιαρεδ ἑκατὸν καὶ ἑξήκοντα δύο ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ενωχ

text_en: And Jared lived after he begot Henoch , eight hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Et vixit Jared, postquam genuit Henoch, octingentis annis, et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Jerede, depois que gerou a Enoque, oitocentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ιαρεδ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Ενωχ ὀκτακόσια ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.
text_la: Et facti sunt omnes dies Jared nongenti sexaginta duo anni, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Jerede novecentos e sessenta e dois anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Ιαρεδ ἐννακόσια καὶ ἑξήκοντα δύο ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Henoch lived sixty-five years, and begot Mathusala .
text_la: Porro Henoch vixit sexaginta quinque annis, et genuit Mathusalam.
text_pt: E viveu Enoque sessenta e cinco anos, e gerou a Matusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ενωχ ἑκατὸν καὶ ἑξήκοντα πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Μαθουσαλα

text_en: And Henoch walked with God : and lived after he begot Mathusala , three hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Et ambulavit Henoch cum Deo : et vixit, postquam genuit Mathusalam, trecentis annis, et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E andou Enoque com Deus, depois que gerou a Matusalém, trezentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: εὐηρέστησεν δὲ Ενωχ τῷ θεῷ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Μαθουσαλα διακόσια ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the days of Henoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.
text_la: Et facti sunt omnes dies Henoch trecenti sexaginta quinque anni.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Enoque trezentos e sessenta e cinco anos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Ενωχ τριακόσια ἑξήκοντα πέντε ἔτη

text_en: And he walked with God , and was seen no more: because God took him.
text_la: Ambulavitque cum Deo, et non apparuit : quia tulit eum Deus.
text_pt: E andou Enoque com Deus; e não apareceu mais, porquanto Deus para si o tomou.
text_el: καὶ εὐηρέστησεν Ενωχ τῷ θεῷ καὶ οὐχ ηὑρίσκετο ὅτι μετέθηκεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεός

text_en: And Mathusala lived a hundred and eighty-seven years, and begot Lamech.
text_la: Vixit quoque Mathusala centum octoginta septem annis, et genuit Lamech.
text_pt: E viveu Matusalém cento e oitenta e sete anos, e gerou a Lameque.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Μαθουσαλα ἑκατὸν καὶ ἑξήκοντα ἑπτὰ ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Λαμεχ

text_en: And Mathusala lived after he begot Lamech, seven hundred and eighty-two years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Et vixit Mathusala, postquam genuit Lamech, septingentis octoginta duobus annis, et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Matusalém, depois que gerou a Lameque, setecentos e oitenta e dois anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Μαθουσαλα μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Λαμεχ ὀκτακόσια δύο ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the days of Mathusala were nine hundred and sixty-nine years, and he died.
text_la: Et facti sunt omnes dies Mathusala nongenti sexaginta novem anni, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Matusalém novecentos e sessenta e nove anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Μαθουσαλα ἃς ἔζησεν ἐννακόσια καὶ ἑξήκοντα ἐννέα ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Lamech lived a hundred and eighty-two years, and begot a son.
text_la: Vixit autem Lamech centum octoginta duobus annis, et genuit filium:
text_pt: E viveu Lameque cento e oitenta e dois anos, e gerou um filho,
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Λαμεχ ἑκατὸν ὀγδοήκοντα ὀκτὼ ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱὸν

text_en: And he called his name Noe , saying: This same shall comfort us from the works and labours of our hands on the earth, which the Lord has cursed .
text_la: vocavitque nomen ejus Noë, dicens : Iste consolabitur nos ab operibus et laboribus manuum nostrarum in terra, cui maledixit Dominus.
text_pt: A quem chamou Noé, dizendo: Este nos consolará acerca de nossas obras e do trabalho de nossas mãos, por causa da terra que o Senhor amaldiçoou.
text_el: καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Νωε λέγων οὗτος διαναπαύσει ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῶν ἔργων ἡμῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν λυπῶν τῶν χειρῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἧς κατηράσατο κύριος ὁ θεός

text_en: And Lamech lived after he begot Noe , five hundred and ninety-five years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixitque Lamech, postquam genuit Noë, quingentis nonaginta quinque annis, et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Lameque, depois que gerou a Noé, quinhentos e noventa e cinco anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Λαμεχ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Νωε πεντακόσια καὶ ἑξήκοντα πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας

text_en: And all the days of Lamech came to seven hundred and seventy-seven years, and he died.
text_la: Et facti sunt omnes dies Lamech septingenti septuaginta septem anni, et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Lameque setecentos e setenta e sete anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Λαμεχ ἑπτακόσια καὶ πεντήκοντα τρία ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Noe , when he was five hundred years old, begot Sem , Cham , and Japheth.
text_la: Noë vero cum quingentorum esset annorum, genuit Sem, Cham et Japheth.
text_pt: E era Noé da idade de quinhentos anos, e gerou Noé a Sem, Cão e Jafé.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Νωε ἐτῶν πεντακοσίων καὶ ἐγέννησεν Νωε τρεῖς υἱούς τὸν Σημ τὸν Χαμ τὸν Ιαφεθ

text_en: And after that men began to be multiplied upon the earth, and daughters were born to them,
text_la: Cumque cœpissent homines multiplicari super terram, et filias procreassent,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, como os homens começaram a multiplicar-se sobre a face da terra, e lhes nasceram filhas,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἤρξαντο οἱ ἄνθρωποι πολλοὶ γίνεσθαι ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ θυγατέρες ἐγενήθησαν αὐτοῖς

text_en: the sons of God seeing the daughters of men , that they were fair, took to themselves wives of all which they chose.
text_la: videntes filii Dei filias hominum quod essent pulchræ, acceperunt sibi uxores ex omnibus, quas elegerant.
text_pt: Viram os filhos de Deus que as filhas dos homens eram formosas; e tomaram para si mulheres de todas as que escolheram.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ θεοῦ τὰς θυγατέρας τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὅτι καλαί εἰσιν ἔλαβον ἑαυτοῖς γυναῖκας ἀπὸ πασῶν ὧν ἐξελέξαντο

text_en: And God said: My spirit shall not remain in man for ever , because he is flesh, and his days shall be a hundred and twenty years.
text_la: Dixitque Deus : Non permanebit spiritus meus in homine in æternum, quia caro est : eruntque dies illius centum viginti annorum.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor: Não contenderá o meu Espírito para sempre com o homem; porque ele também é carne; porém os seus dias serão cento e vinte anos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεός οὐ μὴ καταμείνῃ τὸ πνεῦμά μου ἐν τοῖς ἀνθρώποις τούτοις εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα διὰ τὸ εἶναι αὐτοὺς σάρκας ἔσονται δὲ αἱ ἡμέραι αὐτῶν ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ἔτη

text_en: Now giants were upon the earth in those days. For after the sons of God went in to the daughters of men , and they brought forth children, these are the mighty men of old, men of renown.
text_la: Gigantes autem erant super terram in diebus illis : postquam enim ingressi sunt filii Dei ad filias hominum, illæque genuerunt, isti sunt potentes a sæculo viri famosi.
text_pt: Havia naqueles dias gigantes na terra; e também depois, quando os filhos de Deus entraram às filhas dos homens e delas geraram filhos; estes eram os valentes que houve na antiguidade, os homens de fama.
text_el: οἱ δὲ γίγαντες ἦσαν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις καὶ μετ' ἐκεῖνο ὡς ἂν εἰσεπορεύοντο οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ θεοῦ πρὸς τὰς θυγατέρας τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ ἐγεννῶσαν ἑαυτοῖς ἐκεῖνοι ἦσαν οἱ γίγαντες οἱ ἀπ' αἰῶνος οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ ὀνομαστοί

text_en: And God seeing that the wickedness of men was great on the earth, and that all the thought of their heart was bent upon evil at all times,
text_la: Videns autem Deus quod multa malitia hominum esset in terra, et cuncta cogitatio cordis intenta esset ad malum omni tempore,
text_pt: E viu o Senhor que a maldade do homem se multiplicara sobre a terra e que toda a imaginação dos pensamentos de seu coração era só má continuamente.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὅτι ἐπληθύνθησαν αἱ κακίαι τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ πᾶς τις διανοεῖται ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ ἐπιμελῶς ἐπὶ τὰ πονηρὰ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: it repented him that he had made man on the earth. And being touched inwardly with sorrow of heart,
text_la: pœnituit eum quod hominum fecisset in terra. Et tactus dolore cordis intrinsecus,
text_pt: Então arrependeu-se o Senhor de haver feito o homem sobre a terra e pesou-lhe em seu coração.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεθυμήθη ὁ θεὸς ὅτι ἐποίησεν τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ διενοήθη

text_en: he said: I will destroy man , whom I have created , from the face of the earth, from man even to beasts, from the creeping thing even to the fowls of the air, for it repents me that I have made them.
text_la: Delebo, inquit, hominem, quem creavi, a facie terræ, ab homine usque ad animantia, a reptili usque ad volucres cæli : pœnitet enim me fecisse eos.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Destruirei o homem que criei de sobre a face da terra, desde o homem até ao animal, até ao réptil, e até à ave dos céus; porque me arrependo de os haver feito.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός ἀπαλείψω τὸν ἄνθρωπον ὃν ἐποίησα ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους καὶ ἀπὸ ἑρπετῶν ἕως τῶν πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὅτι ἐθυμώθην ὅτι ἐποίησα αὐτούς

text_en: But Noe found grace before the Lord .
text_la: Noë vero invenit gratiam coram Domino.
text_pt: Noé, porém, achou graça aos olhos do Senhor.
text_el: Νωε δὲ εὗρεν χάριν ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: These are the generations of Noe : Noe was a just and perfect man in his generations , he walked with God .
text_la: Hæ sunt generationes Noë : Noë vir justus atque perfectus fuit in generationibus suis; cum Deo ambulavit.
text_pt: Estas são as gerações de Noé. Noé era homem justo e perfeito em suas gerações; Noé andava com Deus.
text_el: αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις Νωε Νωε ἄνθρωπος δίκαιος τέλειος ὢν ἐν τῇ γενεᾷ αὐτοῦ τῷ θεῷ εὐηρέστησεν Νωε

text_en: And he begot three sons, Sem , Cham , and Japheth.
text_la: Et genuit tres filios, Sem, Cham et Japheth.
text_pt: E gerou Noé três filhos: Sem, Cão e Jafé.
text_el: ἐγέννησεν δὲ Νωε τρεῖς υἱούς τὸν Σημ τὸν Χαμ τὸν Ιαφεθ

text_en: And the earth was corrupted before God , and was filled with iniquity .
text_la: Corrupta est autem terra coram Deo, et repleta est iniquitate.
text_pt: A terra, porém, estava corrompida diante da face de Deus; e encheu-se a terra de violência.
text_el: ἐφθάρη δὲ ἡ γῆ ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐπλήσθη ἡ γῆ ἀδικίας

text_en: And when God had seen that the earth was corrupted (for all flesh had corrupted its way upon the earth),
text_la: Cumque vidisset Deus terram esse corruptam (omnis quippe caro corruperat viam suam super terram),
text_pt: E viu Deus a terra, e eis que estava corrompida; porque toda a carne havia corrompido o seu caminho sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τὴν γῆν καὶ ἦν κατεφθαρμένη ὅτι κατέφθειρεν πᾶσα σὰρξ τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: he said to Noe : The end of all flesh has come before me, the earth is filled with iniquity through them, and I will destroy them with the earth.
text_la: dixit ad Noë : Finis universæ carnis venit coram me : repleta est terra iniquitate a facie eorum, et ego disperdam eos cum terra.
text_pt: Então disse Deus a Noé: O fim de toda a carne é vindo perante a minha face; porque a terra está cheia de violência; e eis que os desfarei com a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Νωε καιρὸς παντὸς ἀνθρώπου ἥκει ἐναντίον μου ὅτι ἐπλήσθη ἡ γῆ ἀδικίας ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ καταφθείρω αὐτοὺς καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: Make an ark of timber planks: you shall make little rooms in the ark , and you shall pitch it within and without.
text_la: Fac tibi arcam de lignis lævigatis; mansiunculas in arca facies, et bitumine linies intrinsecus et extrinsecus.
text_pt: Faze para ti uma arca da madeira de gofer; farás compartimentos na arca e a betumarás por dentro e por fora com betume.
text_el: ποίησον οὖν σεαυτῷ κιβωτὸν ἐκ ξύλων τετραγώνων νοσσιὰς ποιήσεις τὴν κιβωτὸν καὶ ἀσφαλτώσεις αὐτὴν ἔσωθεν καὶ ἔξωθεν τῇ ἀσφάλτῳ

text_en: And thus shall you make it. The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits: the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
text_la: Et sic facies eam : trecentorum cubitorum erit longitudo arcæ, quinquaginta cubitorum latitudo, et triginta cubitorum altitudo illius.
text_pt: E desta maneira a farás: De trezentos côvados o comprimento da arca, e de cinqüenta côvados a sua largura, e de trinta côvados a sua altura.
text_el: καὶ οὕτως ποιήσεις τὴν κιβωτόν τριακοσίων πήχεων τὸ μῆκος τῆς κιβωτοῦ καὶ πεντήκοντα πήχεων τὸ πλάτος καὶ τριάκοντα πήχεων τὸ ὕψος αὐτῆς

text_en: You shall make a window in the ark , and in a cubit shall you finish the top of it: and the door of the ark you shall set in the side: with lower, middle chambers, and third stories shall you make it.
text_la: Fenestram in arca facies, et in cubito consummabis summitatem ejus : ostium autem arcæ pones ex latere; deorsum, cœnacula et tristega facies in ea.
text_pt: Farás na arca uma janela, e de um côvado a acabarás em cima; e a porta da arca porás ao seu lado; far-lhe-ás andares, baixo, segundo e terceiro.
text_el: ἐπισυνάγων ποιήσεις τὴν κιβωτὸν καὶ εἰς πῆχυν συντελέσεις αὐτὴν ἄνωθεν τὴν δὲ θύραν τῆς κιβωτοῦ ποιήσεις ἐκ πλαγίων κατάγαια διώροφα καὶ τριώροφα ποιήσεις αὐτήν

text_en: Behold, I will bring the waters of a great flood upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein is the breath of life under heaven . All things that are in the earth shall be consumed.
text_la: Ecce ego adducam aquas diluvii super terram, ut interficiam omnem carnem, in qua spiritus vitæ est subter cælum : universa quæ in terra sunt, consumentur.
text_pt: Porque eis que eu trago um dilúvio de águas sobre a terra, para desfazer toda a carne em que há espírito de vida debaixo dos céus; tudo o que há na terra expirará.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἰδοὺ ἐπάγω τὸν κατακλυσμὸν ὕδωρ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καταφθεῖραι πᾶσαν σάρκα ἐν ᾗ ἐστιν πνεῦμα ζωῆς ὑποκάτω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὅσα ἐὰν ᾖ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τελευτήσει

text_en: And I will establish my covenant with you, and you shall enter into the ark , you and your sons, and your wife, and the wives of your sons with you.
text_la: Ponamque fœdus meum tecum : et ingredieris arcam tu et filii tui, uxor tua, et uxores filiorum tuorum tecum.
text_pt: Mas contigo estabelecerei a minha aliança; e entrarás na arca, tu e os teus filhos, tua mulher e as mulheres de teus filhos contigo.
text_el: καὶ στήσω τὴν διαθήκην μου πρὸς σέ εἰσελεύσῃ δὲ εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ ἡ γυνή σου καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες τῶν υἱῶν σου μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: And of every living creature of all flesh, you shall bring two of a sort into the ark , that they may live with you: of the male sex, and the female.
text_la: Et ex cunctis animantibus universæ carnis bina induces in arcam, ut vivant tecum : masculini sexus et feminini.
text_pt: E de tudo o que vive, de toda a carne, dois de cada espécie, farás entrar na arca, para os conservar vivos contigo; macho e fêmea serão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἑρπετῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν θηρίων καὶ ἀπὸ πάσης σαρκός δύο δύο ἀπὸ πάντων εἰσάξεις εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν ἵνα τρέφῃς μετὰ σεαυτοῦ ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἔσονται

text_en: Of fowls according to their kind, and of beasts in their kind, and of everything that creeps on the earth according to its kind: two of every sort shall go in with you, that they may live.
text_la: De volucribus juxta genus suum, et de jumentis in genere suo, et ex omni reptili terræ secundum genus suum : bina de omnibus ingredientur tecum, ut possint vivere.
text_pt: Das aves conforme a sua espécie, e dos animais conforme a sua espécie, de todo o réptil da terra conforme a sua espécie, dois de cada espécie virão a ti, para os conservar em vida.
text_el: ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ὀρνέων τῶν πετεινῶν κατὰ γένος καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν κατὰ γένος καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἑρπετῶν τῶν ἑρπόντων ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κατὰ γένος αὐτῶν δύο δύο ἀπὸ πάντων εἰσελεύσονται πρὸς σὲ τρέφεσθαι μετὰ σοῦ ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ

text_en: You shall take unto you of all food that may be eaten, and you shall lay it up with you: and it shall be food for you and them.
text_la: Tolles igitur tecum ex omnibus escis, quæ mandi possunt, et comportabis apud te : et erunt tam tibi, quam illis in cibum.
text_pt: E leva contigo de toda a comida que se come e ajunta-a para ti; e te será para mantimento, a ti e a eles.
text_el: σὺ δὲ λήμψῃ σεαυτῷ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν βρωμάτων ἃ ἔδεσθε καὶ συνάξεις πρὸς σεαυτόν καὶ ἔσται σοὶ καὶ ἐκείνοις φαγεῖν

text_en: And Noe did all things which God commanded him.
text_la: Fecit igitur Noë omnia quæ præceperat illi Deus.
text_pt: Assim fez Noé; conforme a tudo o que Deus lhe mandou, assim o fez.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Νωε πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ κύριος ὁ θεός οὕτως ἐποίησεν

text_en: And the Lord said to him: Go in, you and all your house , into the ark : for you I have seen just before me in this generation .
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad eum : Ingredere tu et omnis domus tua in arcam : te enim vidi justum coram me in generatione hac.
text_pt: Depois disse o SENHOR a Noé: Entra tu e toda a tua casa na arca, porque tenho visto que és justo diante de mim nesta geração.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Νωε εἴσελθε σὺ καὶ πᾶς ὁ οἶκός σου εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν ὅτι σὲ εἶδον δίκαιον ἐναντίον μου ἐν τῇ γενεᾷ ταύτῃ

text_en: Of all clean beasts take seven and seven, the male and the female.
text_la: Ex omnibus animantibus mundis tolle septena et septena, masculum et feminam : de animantibus vero immundis duo et duo, masculum et feminam.
text_pt: De todos os animais limpos tomarás para ti sete e sete, o macho e sua fêmea; mas dos animais que não são limpos, dois, o macho e sua fêmea.
text_el: ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν καθαρῶν εἰσάγαγε πρὸς σὲ ἑπτὰ ἑπτά ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν μὴ καθαρῶν δύο δύο ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ

text_en: But of the beasts that are unclean two and two, the male and the female. Of the fowls also of the air seven and seven, the male and the female: that seed may be saved upon the face of the whole earth.
text_la: Sed et de volatilibus cæli septena et septena, masculum et feminam : ut salvetur semen super faciem universæ terræ.
text_pt: Também das aves dos céus sete e sete, macho e fêmea, para conservar em vida sua espécie sobre a face de toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τῶν καθαρῶν ἑπτὰ ἑπτά ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πετεινῶν τῶν μὴ καθαρῶν δύο δύο ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ διαθρέψαι σπέρμα ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν
