text_en: For yet a while, and after seven days, I will rain upon the earth forty days and forty nights: and I will destroy every substance that I have made, from the face of the earth.
text_la: Adhuc enim, et post dies septem ego pluam super terram quadraginta diebus et quadraginta noctibus : et delebo omnem substantiam, quam feci, de superficie terræ.
text_pt: Porque, passados ainda sete dias, farei chover sobre a terra quarenta dias e quarenta noites; e desfarei de sobre a face da terra toda a substância que fiz.
text_el: ἔτι γὰρ ἡμερῶν ἑπτὰ ἐγὼ ἐπάγω ὑετὸν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας καὶ ἐξαλείψω πᾶσαν τὴν ἐξανάστασιν ἣν ἐποίησα ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: And Noe did all things which the Lord had commanded him.
text_la: Fecit ergo Noë omnia quæ mandaverat ei Dominus.
text_pt: E fez Noé conforme a tudo o que o Senhor lhe ordenara.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν Νωε πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ κύριος ὁ θεός

text_en: And he was six hundred years old, when the waters of the flood overflowed the earth.
text_la: Eratque sexcentorum annorum quando diluvii aquæ inundaverunt super terram.
text_pt: E era Noé da idade de seiscentos anos, quando o dilúvio das águas veio sobre a terra.
text_el: Νωε δὲ ἦν ἐτῶν ἑξακοσίων καὶ ὁ κατακλυσμὸς ἐγένετο ὕδατος ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And Noe went in and his sons, his wife and the wives of his sons with him into the ark , because of the waters of the flood .
text_la: Et ingressus est Noë et filii ejus, uxor ejus et uxores filiorum ejus cum eo in arcam propter aquas diluvii.
text_pt: Noé entrou na arca, e com ele seus filhos, sua mulher e as mulheres de seus filhos, por causa das águas do dilúvio.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Νωε καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν κιβωτὸν διὰ τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ κατακλυσμοῦ

text_en: And of beasts clean and unclean , and of fowls, and of everything that moves upon the earth,
text_la: De animantibus quoque mundis et immundis, et de volucribus, et ex omni quod movetur super terram,
text_pt: Dos animais limpos e dos animais que não são limpos, e das aves, e de todo o réptil sobre a terra,
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν πετεινῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν καθαρῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν μὴ καθαρῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἑρπετῶν τῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: two and two went in to Noe into the ark , male and female, as the Lord had commanded Noe .
text_la: duo et duo ingressa sunt ad Noë in arcam, masculus et femina, sicut præceperat Dominus Noë.
text_pt: Entraram de dois em dois para junto de Noé na arca, macho e fêmea, como Deus ordenara a Noé.
text_el: δύο δύο εἰσῆλθον πρὸς Νωε εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ καθὰ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ ὁ θεός

text_en: And after the seven days were passed, the waters of the flood overflowed the earth.
text_la: Cumque transissent septem dies, aquæ diluvii inundaverunt super terram.
text_pt: E aconteceu que passados sete dias, vieram sobre a terra as águas do dilúvio.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὰς ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας καὶ τὸ ὕδωρ τοῦ κατακλυσμοῦ ἐγένετο ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: In the six hundredth year of the life of Noe , in the second month, in the seventeenth day of the month, all the fountains of the great deep were broken up, and the floodgates of heaven were opened:
text_la: Anno sexcentesimo vitæ Noë, mense secundo, septimodecimo die mensis, rupti sunt omnes fontes abyssi magnæ, et cataractæ cæli apertæ sunt:
text_pt: No ano seiscentos da vida de Noé, no mês segundo, aos dezessete dias do mês, naquele mesmo dia se romperam todas as fontes do grande abismo, e as janelas dos céus se abriram,
text_el: ἐν τῷ ἑξακοσιοστῷ ἔτει ἐν τῇ ζωῇ τοῦ Νωε τοῦ δευτέρου μηνός ἑβδόμῃ καὶ εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνός τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ ἐρράγησαν πᾶσαι αἱ πηγαὶ τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ οἱ καταρράκται τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἠνεῴχθησαν

text_en: And the rain fell upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
text_la: et facta est pluvia super terram quadraginta diebus et quadraginta noctibus.
text_pt: E houve chuva sobre a terra quarenta dias e quarenta noites.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ὑετὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας

text_en: In the selfsame day Noe , and Sem , and Cham , and Japheth, his sons: his wife, and the three wives of his sons with them, went into the ark .
text_la: In articulo diei illius ingressus est Noë, et Sem, et Cham, et Japheth filii ejus; uxor illius, et tres uxores filiorum ejus cum eis in arcam:
text_pt: E no mesmo dia entraram na arca Noé, seus filhos Sem, Cão e Jafé, sua mulher e as mulheres de seus filhos.
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ταύτῃ εἰσῆλθεν Νωε Σημ Χαμ Ιαφεθ υἱοὶ Νωε καὶ ἡ γυνὴ Νωε καὶ αἱ τρεῖς γυναῖκες τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν

text_en: They and every beast according to its kind, and all the cattle in their kind, and everything that moves upon the earth, according to its kind, and every fowl according to its kind, all birds, and all that fly,
text_la: ipsi et omne animal secundum genus suum, universaque jumenta in genere suo, et omne quod movetur super terram in genere suo, cunctumque volatile secundum genus suum, universæ aves, omnesque volucres,
text_pt: Eles, e todo o animal conforme a sua espécie, e todo o gado conforme a sua espécie, e todo o réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra conforme a sua espécie, e toda a ave conforme a sua espécie, pássaros de toda qualidade.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ θηρία κατὰ γένος καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη κατὰ γένος καὶ πᾶν ἑρπετὸν κινούμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κατὰ γένος καὶ πᾶν πετεινὸν κατὰ γένος

text_en: went in to Noe into the ark , two and two of all flesh, wherein was the breath of life .
text_la: ingressæ sunt ad Noë in arcam, bina et bina ex omni carne, in qua erat spiritus vitæ.
text_pt: E de toda a carne, em que havia espírito de vida, entraram de dois em dois para junto de Noé na arca.
text_el: εἰσῆλθον πρὸς Νωε εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν δύο δύο ἀπὸ πάσης σαρκός ἐν ᾧ ἐστιν πνεῦμα ζωῆς

text_en: And they that went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God had commanded him: and the Lord shut him in on the outside.
text_la: Et quæ ingressa sunt, masculus et femina ex omni carne introierunt, sicut præceperat ei Deus : et inclusit eum Dominus deforis.
text_pt: E os que entraram eram macho e fêmea de toda a carne, como Deus lhe tinha ordenado; e o Senhor o fechou dentro.
text_el: καὶ τὰ εἰσπορευόμενα ἄρσεν καὶ θῆλυ ἀπὸ πάσης σαρκὸς εἰσῆλθεν καθὰ ἐνετείλατο ὁ θεὸς τῷ Νωε καὶ ἔκλεισεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἔξωθεν αὐτοῦ τὴν κιβωτόν

text_en: And the flood was forty days upon the earth: and the waters increased, and lifted up the ark on high from the earth.
text_la: Factumque est diluvium quadraginta diebus super terram : et multiplicatæ sunt aquæ, et elevaverunt arcam in sublime a terra.
text_pt: E durou o dilúvio quarenta dias sobre a terra, e cresceram as águas e levantaram a arca, e ela se elevou sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ κατακλυσμὸς τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας καὶ τεσσαράκοντα νύκτας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπληθύνθη τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ ἐπῆρεν τὴν κιβωτόν καὶ ὑψώθη ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: For they overflowed exceedingly: and filled all on the face of the earth: and the ark was carried upon the waters.
text_la: Vehementer enim inundaverunt, et omnia repleverunt in superficie terræ : porro arca ferebatur super aquas.
text_pt: E prevaleceram as águas e cresceram grandemente sobre a terra; e a arca andava sobre as águas.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεκράτει τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ ἐπληθύνετο σφόδρα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπεφέρετο ἡ κιβωτὸς ἐπάνω τοῦ ὕδατος

text_en: And the waters prevailed beyond measure upon the earth: and all the high mountains under the whole heaven were covered.
text_la: Et aquæ prævaluerunt nimis super terram : opertique sunt omnes montes excelsi sub universo cælo.
text_pt: E as águas prevaleceram excessivamente sobre a terra; e todos os altos montes que havia debaixo de todo o céu, foram cobertos.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ὕδωρ ἐπεκράτει σφόδρα σφοδρῶς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπεκάλυψεν πάντα τὰ ὄρη τὰ ὑψηλά ἃ ἦν ὑποκάτω τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: The water was fifteen cubits higher than the mountains which it covered.
text_la: Quindecim cubitis altior fuit aqua super montes, quos operuerat.
text_pt: Quinze côvados acima prevaleceram as águas; e os montes foram cobertos.
text_el: δέκα πέντε πήχεις ἐπάνω ὑψώθη τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ ἐπεκάλυψεν πάντα τὰ ὄρη τὰ ὑψηλά

text_en: And all flesh was destroyed that moved upon the earth, both of fowl and of cattle, and of beasts, and of all creeping things that creep upon the earth: and all men .
text_la: Consumptaque est omnis caro quæ movebatur super terram, volucrum, animantium, bestiarum, omniumque reptilium, quæ reptant super terram : universi homines,
text_pt: E expirou toda a carne que se movia sobre a terra, tanto de ave como de gado e de feras, e de todo o réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra, e todo o homem.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν πᾶσα σὰρξ κινουμένη ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς τῶν πετεινῶν καὶ τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ τῶν θηρίων καὶ πᾶν ἑρπετὸν κινούμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ πᾶς ἄνθρωπος

text_en: And all things wherein there is the breath of life on the earth, died.
text_la: et cuncta, in quibus spiraculum vitæ est in terra, mortua sunt.
text_pt: Tudo o que tinha fôlego de espírito de vida em suas narinas, tudo o que havia em terra seca, morreu.
text_el: καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἔχει πνοὴν ζωῆς καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἦν ἐπὶ τῆς ξηρᾶς ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And he destroyed all the substance that was upon the earth, from man even to beast, and the creeping things and fowls of the air: and they were destroyed from the earth: and Noe only remained, and they that were with him in the ark .
text_la: Et delevit omnem substantiam quæ erat super terram, ab homine usque ad pecus, tam reptile quam volucres cæli : et deleta sunt de terra. Remansit autem solus Noë, et qui cum eo erant in arca.
text_pt: Assim foi destruído todo o ser vivente que havia sobre a face da terra, desde o homem até ao animal, até ao réptil, e até à ave dos céus; e foram extintos da terra; e ficou somente Noé, e os que com ele estavam na arca.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήλειψεν πᾶν τὸ ἀνάστημα ὃ ἦν ἐπὶ προσώπου πάσης τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπου ἕως κτήνους καὶ ἑρπετῶν καὶ τῶν πετεινῶν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἐξηλείφθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ κατελείφθη μόνος Νωε καὶ οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ

text_en: And the waters prevailed upon the earth a hundred and fifty days.
text_la: Obtinueruntque aquæ terram centum quinquaginta diebus.
text_pt: E prevaleceram as águas sobre a terra cento e cinqüenta dias.
text_el: καὶ ὑψώθη τὸ ὕδωρ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἡμέρας ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα

text_en: And God remembered Noe , and all the living creatures, and all the cattle which were with him in the ark , and brought a wind upon the earth, and the waters were abated:
text_la: Recordatus autem Deus Noë, cunctorumque animantium, et omnium jumentorum, quæ erant cum eo in arca, adduxit spiritum super terram, et imminutæ sunt aquæ.
text_pt: E lembrou-se Deus de Noé, e de todos os seres viventes, e de todo o gado que estavam com ele na arca; e Deus fez passar um vento sobre a terra, e aquietaram-se as águas.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθη ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Νωε καὶ πάντων τῶν θηρίων καὶ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν καὶ πάντων τῶν πετεινῶν καὶ πάντων τῶν ἑρπετῶν ὅσα ἦν μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ κιβωτῷ καὶ ἐπήγαγεν ὁ θεὸς πνεῦμα ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἐκόπασεν τὸ ὕδωρ

text_en: The fountains also of the deep , and the floodgates of heaven , were shut up, and the rain from heaven was restrained.
text_la: Et clausi sunt fontes abyssi, et cataractæ cæli : et prohibitæ sunt pluviæ de cælo.
text_pt: Cerraram-se também as fontes do abismo e as janelas dos céus, e a chuva dos céus deteve-se.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεκαλύφθησαν αἱ πηγαὶ τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ οἱ καταρράκται τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ συνεσχέθη ὁ ὑετὸς ἀπὸ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: And the waters returned from off the earth going and coming: and they began to be abated after a hundred and fifty days.
text_la: Reversæque sunt aquæ de terra euntes et redeuntes : et cœperunt minui post centum quinquaginta dies.
text_pt: E as águas iam-se escoando continuamente de sobre a terra, e ao fim de cento e cinqüenta dias minguaram.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεδίδου τὸ ὕδωρ πορευόμενον ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἐνεδίδου καὶ ἠλαττονοῦτο τὸ ὕδωρ μετὰ πεντήκοντα καὶ ἑκατὸν ἡμέρας

text_en: And the ark rested in the seventh month, the seven and twentieth day of the month, upon the mountains of Armenia .
text_la: Requievitque arca mense septimo, vigesimo septimo die mensis, super montes Armeniæ.
text_pt: E a arca repousou no sétimo mês, no dia dezessete do mês, sobre os montes de Ararate.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἡ κιβωτὸς ἐν μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνός ἐπὶ τὰ ὄρη τὰ Αραρατ

text_en: And the waters were going and decreasing until the tenth month: for in the tenth month, the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains appeared.
text_la: At vero aquæ ibant et decrescebant usque ad decimum mensem : decimo enim mense, primo die mensis, apparuerunt cacumina montium.
text_pt: E foram as águas indo e minguando até ao décimo mês; no décimo mês, no primeiro dia do mês, apareceram os cumes dos montes.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ὕδωρ πορευόμενον ἠλαττονοῦτο ἕως τοῦ δεκάτου μηνός ἐν δὲ τῷ ἑνδεκάτῳ μηνί τῇ πρώτῃ τοῦ μηνός ὤφθησαν αἱ κεφαλαὶ τῶν ὀρέων

text_en: And after that forty days were passed, Noe opening the window of the ark , which he had made, sent forth a raven:
text_la: Cumque transissent quadraginta dies, aperiens Noë fenestram arcæ, quam fecerat, dimisit corvum,
text_pt: E aconteceu que ao cabo de quarenta dias, abriu Noé a janela da arca que tinha feito.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας ἠνέῳξεν Νωε τὴν θυρίδα τῆς κιβωτοῦ ἣν ἐποίησεν

text_en: Which went forth and did not return, till the waters were dried up upon the earth.
text_la: qui egrediebatur, et non revertebatur, donec siccarentur aquæ super terram.
text_pt: E soltou um corvo, que saiu, indo e voltando, até que as águas se secaram de sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὸν κόρακα τοῦ ἰδεῖν εἰ κεκόπακεν τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ ἐξελθὼν οὐχ ὑπέστρεψεν ἕως τοῦ ξηρανθῆναι τὸ ὕδωρ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: He sent forth also a dove after him, to see if the waters had now ceased upon the face of the earth.
text_la: Emisit quoque columbam post eum, ut videret si jam cessassent aquæ super faciem terræ.
text_pt: Depois soltou uma pomba, para ver se as águas tinham minguado de sobre a face da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν τὴν περιστερὰν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἰδεῖν εἰ κεκόπακεν τὸ ὕδωρ ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: But she not finding where her foot might rest, returned to him into the ark : for the waters were upon the whole earth: and he put forth his hand, and caught her, and brought her into the ark .
text_la: Quæ cum non invenisset ubi requiesceret pes ejus, reversa est ad eum in arcam : aquæ enim erant super universam terram : extenditque manum, et apprehensam intulit in arcam.
text_pt: A pomba, porém, não achou repouso para a planta do seu pé, e voltou a ele para a arca; porque as águas estavam sobre a face de toda a terra; e ele estendeu a sua mão, e tomou-a, e recolheu-a consigo na arca.
text_el: καὶ οὐχ εὑροῦσα ἡ περιστερὰ ἀνάπαυσιν τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτῆς ὑπέστρεψεν πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν ὅτι ὕδωρ ἦν ἐπὶ παντὶ προσώπῳ πάσης τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκτείνας τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὴν πρὸς ἑαυτὸν εἰς τὴν κιβωτόν

text_en: And having waited yet seven other days, he again sent forth the dove out of the ark .
text_la: Expectatis autem ultra septem diebus aliis, rursum dimisit columbam ex arca.
text_pt: E esperou ainda outros sete dias, e tornou a enviar a pomba fora da arca.
text_el: καὶ ἐπισχὼν ἔτι ἡμέρας ἑπτὰ ἑτέρας πάλιν ἐξαπέστειλεν τὴν περιστερὰν ἐκ τῆς κιβωτοῦ

text_en: And she came to him in the evening carrying a bough of an olive tree, with green leaves, in her mouth. Noe therefore understood that the waters were ceased upon the earth.
text_la: At illa venit ad eum ad vesperam, portans ramum olivæ virentibus foliis in ore suo : intellexit ergo Noë quod cessassent aquæ super terram.
text_pt: E a pomba voltou a ele à tarde; e eis, arrancada, uma folha de oliveira no seu bico; e conheceu Noé que as águas tinham minguado de sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν πρὸς αὐτὸν ἡ περιστερὰ τὸ πρὸς ἑσπέραν καὶ εἶχεν φύλλον ἐλαίας κάρφος ἐν τῷ στόματι αὐτῆς καὶ ἔγνω Νωε ὅτι κεκόπακεν τὸ ὕδωρ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And he stayed yet other seven days: and he sent forth the dove , which returned not any more unto him.
text_la: Expectavitque nihilominus septem alios dies : et emisit columbam, quæ non est reversa ultra ad eum.
text_pt: Então esperou ainda outros sete dias, e enviou fora a pomba; mas não tornou mais a ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐπισχὼν ἔτι ἡμέρας ἑπτὰ ἑτέρας πάλιν ἐξαπέστειλεν τὴν περιστεράν καὶ οὐ προσέθετο τοῦ ἐπιστρέψαι πρὸς αὐτὸν ἔτι

text_en: Therefore in the six hundredth and first year, the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were lessened upon the earth, and Noe opening the covering of the ark , looked, and saw that the face of the earth was dried.
text_la: Igitur sexcentesimo primo anno, primo mense, prima die mensis, imminutæ sunt aquæ super terram : et aperiens Noë tectum arcæ, aspexit, viditque quod exsiccata esset superficies terræ.
text_pt: E aconteceu que no ano seiscentos e um, no mês primeiro, no primeiro dia do mês, as águas se secaram de sobre a terra. Então Noé tirou a cobertura da arca, e olhou, e eis que a face da terra estava enxuta.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἑνὶ καὶ ἑξακοσιοστῷ ἔτει ἐν τῇ ζωῇ τοῦ Νωε τοῦ πρώτου μηνός μιᾷ τοῦ μηνός ἐξέλιπεν τὸ ὕδωρ ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀπεκάλυψεν Νωε τὴν στέγην τῆς κιβωτοῦ ἣν ἐποίησεν καὶ εἶδεν ὅτι ἐξέλιπεν τὸ ὕδωρ ἀπὸ προσώπου τῆς γῆς

text_en: In the second month, the seven and twentieth day of the month, the earth was dried.
text_la: Mense secundo, septimo et vigesimo die mensis arefacta est terra.
text_pt: E no segundo mês, aos vinte e sete dias do mês, a terra estava seca.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ μηνὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ ἑβδόμῃ καὶ εἰκάδι τοῦ μηνός ἐξηράνθη ἡ γῆ

text_en: And God spoke to Noe , saying:
text_la: Locutus est autem Deus ad Noë, dicens:
text_pt: Então falou Deus a Noé dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς τῷ Νωε λέγων

text_en: Go out of the ark , you and your wife, your sons and the wives of your sons with you.
text_la: Egredere de arca, tu et uxor tua, filii tui et uxores filiorum tuorum tecum.
text_pt: Sai da arca, tu com tua mulher, e teus filhos e as mulheres de teus filhos.
text_el: ἔξελθε ἐκ τῆς κιβωτοῦ σὺ καὶ ἡ γυνή σου καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες τῶν υἱῶν σου μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: All living things that are with you of all flesh, as well in fowls as in beasts, and all creeping things that creep upon the earth, bring out with you, and go upon the earth: increase and multiply upon it.
text_la: Cuncta animantia, quæ sunt apud te, ex omni carne, tam in volatilibus quam in bestiis et universis reptilibus, quæ reptant super terram, educ tecum, et ingredimini super terram : crescite et multiplicamini super eam.
text_pt: Todo o animal que está contigo, de toda a carne, de ave, e de gado, e de todo o réptil que se arrasta sobre a terra, traze fora contigo; e povoem abundantemente a terra e frutifiquem, e se multipliquem sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ θηρία ὅσα ἐστὶν μετὰ σοῦ καὶ πᾶσα σὰρξ ἀπὸ πετεινῶν ἕως κτηνῶν καὶ πᾶν ἑρπετὸν κινούμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἐξάγαγε μετὰ σεαυτοῦ καὶ αὐξάνεσθε καὶ πληθύνεσθε ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: So Noe went out, he and his sons: his wife, and the wives of his sons with him.
text_la: Egressus est ergo Noë, et filii ejus : uxor illius, et uxores filiorum ejus cum eo.
text_pt: Então saiu Noé, e seus filhos, e sua mulher, e as mulheres de seus filhos com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Νωε καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all living things, and cattle, and creeping things that creep upon the earth, according to their kinds went out of the ark .
text_la: Sed et omnia animantia, jumenta, et reptilia quæ reptant super terram, secundum genus suum, egressa sunt de arca.
text_pt: Todo o animal, todo o réptil, e toda a ave, e tudo o que se move sobre a terra, conforme as suas famílias, saiu para fora da arca.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ θηρία καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη καὶ πᾶν πετεινὸν καὶ πᾶν ἑρπετὸν κινούμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς κατὰ γένος αὐτῶν ἐξήλθοσαν ἐκ τῆς κιβωτοῦ

text_en: And Noe built an altar unto the Lord : and taking of all cattle and fowls that were clean , offered holocausts upon the altar .
text_la: Ædificavit autem Noë altare Domino : et tollens de cunctis pecoribus et volucribus mundis, obtulit holocausta super altare.
text_pt: E edificou Noé um altar ao Senhor; e tomou de todo o animal limpo e de toda a ave limpa, e ofereceu holocausto sobre o altar.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν Νωε θυσιαστήριον τῷ θεῷ καὶ ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν τῶν καθαρῶν καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν πετεινῶν τῶν καθαρῶν καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν ὁλοκαρπώσεις ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον

text_en: And the Lord smelled a sweet savour, and said: I will no more curse the earth for the sake of man : for the imagination and thought of man's heart are prone to evil from his youth: therefore I will no more destroy every living soul as I have done.
text_la: Odoratusque est Dominus odorem suavitatis, et ait : Nequaquam ultra maledicam terræ propter homines : sensus enim et cogitatio humani cordis in malum prona sunt ab adolescentia sua : non igitur ultra percutiam omnem animam viventem sicut feci.
text_pt: E o Senhor sentiu o suave cheiro, e o Senhor disse em seu coração: Não tornarei mais a amaldiçoar a terra por causa do homem; porque a imaginação do coração do homem é má desde a sua meninice, nem tornarei mais a ferir todo o vivente, como fiz.
text_el: καὶ ὠσφράνθη κύριος ὁ θεὸς ὀσμὴν εὐωδίας καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς διανοηθείς οὐ προσθήσω ἔτι τοῦ καταράσασθαι τὴν γῆν διὰ τὰ ἔργα τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὅτι ἔγκειται ἡ διάνοια τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἐπιμελῶς ἐπὶ τὰ πονηρὰ ἐκ νεότητος οὐ προσθήσω οὖν ἔτι πατάξαι πᾶσαν σάρκα ζῶσαν καθὼς ἐποίησα

text_en: All the days of the earth, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, night and day, shall not cease.
text_la: Cunctis diebus terræ, sementis et messis, frigus et æstus, æstas et hiems, nox et dies non requiescent.
text_pt: Enquanto a terra durar, sementeira e sega, e frio e calor, e verão e inverno, e dia e noite, não cessarão.
text_el: πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας τῆς γῆς σπέρμα καὶ θερισμός ψῦχος καὶ καῦμα θέρος καὶ ἔαρ ἡμέραν καὶ νύκτα οὐ καταπαύσουσιν

text_en: And God blessed Noe and his sons. And he said to them: Increase, and multiply, and fill the earth.
text_la: Benedixitque Deus Noë et filiis ejus. Et dixit ad eos : Crescite, et multiplicamini, et replete terram.
text_pt: E abençoou Deus a Noé e a seus filhos, e disse-lhes: Frutificai e multiplicai-vos e enchei a terra.
text_el: καὶ ηὐλόγησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν Νωε καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς αὐξάνεσθε καὶ πληθύνεσθε καὶ πληρώσατε τὴν γῆν καὶ κατακυριεύσατε αὐτῆς

text_en: And let the fear and dread of you be upon all the beasts of the earth, and upon all the fowls of the air, and all that move upon the earth: all the fishes of the sea are delivered into your hand.
text_la: Et terror vester ac tremor sit super cuncta animalia terræ, et super omnes volucres cæli, cum universis quæ moventur super terram : omnes pisces maris manui vestræ traditi sunt.
text_pt: E o temor de vós e o pavor de vós virão sobre todo o animal da terra, e sobre toda a ave dos céus; tudo o que se move sobre a terra, e todos os peixes do mar, nas vossas mãos são entregues.
text_el: καὶ ὁ τρόμος ὑμῶν καὶ ὁ φόβος ἔσται ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ ὄρνεα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα τὰ κινούμενα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ πάντας τοὺς ἰχθύας τῆς θαλάσσης ὑπὸ χεῖρας ὑμῖν δέδωκα

text_en: And everything that moves and lives shall be food for you: even as the green herbs have I delivered them all to you:
text_la: Et omne, quod movetur et vivit, erit vobis in cibum : quasi olera virentia tradidi vobis omnia.
text_pt: Tudo quanto se move, que é vivente, será para vosso mantimento; tudo vos tenho dado como a erva verde.
text_el: καὶ πᾶν ἑρπετόν ὅ ἐστιν ζῶν ὑμῖν ἔσται εἰς βρῶσιν ὡς λάχανα χόρτου δέδωκα ὑμῖν τὰ πάντα

text_en: Saving that flesh with blood you shall not eat .
text_la: Excepto, quod carnem cum sanguine non comedetis.
text_pt: A carne, porém, com sua vida, isto é, com seu sangue, não comereis.
text_el: πλὴν κρέας ἐν αἵματι ψυχῆς οὐ φάγεσθε

text_en: For I will require the blood of your lives at the hand of every beast, and at the hand of man , at the hand of every man , and of his brother, will I require the life of man .
text_la: Sanguinem enim animarum vestrarum requiram de manu cunctarum bestiarum : et de manu hominis, de manu viri, et fratris ejus requiram animam hominis.
text_pt: Certamente requererei o vosso sangue, o sangue das vossas vidas; da mão de todo o animal o requererei; como também da mão do homem, e da mão do irmão de cada um requererei a vida do homem.
text_el: καὶ γὰρ τὸ ὑμέτερον αἷμα τῶν ψυχῶν ὑμῶν ἐκζητήσω ἐκ χειρὸς πάντων τῶν θηρίων ἐκζητήσω αὐτὸ καὶ ἐκ χειρὸς ἀνθρώπου ἀδελφοῦ ἐκζητήσω τὴν ψυχὴν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου

text_en: Whosoever shall shed man's blood, his blood shall be shed: for man was made to the image of God .
text_la: Quicumque effuderit humanum sanguinem, fundetur sanguis illius : ad imaginem quippe Dei factus est homo.
text_pt: Quem derramar o sangue do homem, pelo homem o seu sangue será derramado; porque Deus fez o homem conforme a sua imagem.
text_el: ὁ ἐκχέων αἷμα ἀνθρώπου ἀντὶ τοῦ αἵματος αὐτοῦ ἐκχυθήσεται ὅτι ἐν εἰκόνι θεοῦ ἐποίησα τὸν ἄνθρωπον

text_en: But increase and multiply, and go upon the earth and fill it.
text_la: Vos autem crescite et multiplicamini, et ingredimini super terram, et implete eam.
text_pt: Mas vós frutificai e multiplicai-vos; povoai abundantemente a terra, e multiplicai-vos nela.
text_el: ὑμεῖς δὲ αὐξάνεσθε καὶ πληθύνεσθε καὶ πληρώσατε τὴν γῆν καὶ πληθύνεσθε ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: Thus also said God to Noe , and to his sons with him:
text_la: Hæc quoque dixit Deus ad Noë, et ad filios ejus cum eo:
text_pt: E falou Deus a Noé e a seus filhos com ele, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς τῷ Νωε καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ λέγων

text_en: Behold I will establish my covenant with you, and with your seed after you:
text_la: Ecce ego statuam pactum meum vobiscum, et cum semine vestro post vos:
text_pt: E eu, eis que estabeleço a minha aliança convosco e com a vossa descendência depois de vós.
text_el: ἐγὼ ἰδοὺ ἀνίστημι τὴν διαθήκην μου ὑμῖν καὶ τῷ σπέρματι ὑμῶν μεθ' ὑμᾶς

text_en: And with every living soul that is with you, as well in all birds, as in cattle and beasts of the earth, that have come forth out of the ark , and in all the beasts of the earth.
text_la: et ad omnem animam viventem, quæ est vobiscum, tam in volucribus quam in jumentis et pecudibus terræ cunctis, quæ egressa sunt de arca, et universis bestiis terræ.
text_pt: E com toda a alma vivente, que convosco está, de aves, de gado, e de todo o animal da terra convosco; com todos que saíram da arca, até todo o animal da terra.
text_el: καὶ πάσῃ ψυχῇ τῇ ζώσῃ μεθ' ὑμῶν ἀπὸ ὀρνέων καὶ ἀπὸ κτηνῶν καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς θηρίοις τῆς γῆς ὅσα μεθ' ὑμῶν ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἐξελθόντων ἐκ τῆς κιβωτοῦ

text_en: I will establish my covenant with you, and all flesh shall be no more destroyed with the waters of a flood , neither shall there be from henceforth a flood to waste the earth.
text_la: Statuam pactum meum vobiscum, et nequaquam ultra interficietur omnis caro aquis diluvii, neque erit deinceps diluvium dissipans terram.
text_pt: E eu convosco estabeleço a minha aliança, que não será mais destruída toda a carne pelas águas do dilúvio, e que não haverá mais dilúvio, para destruir a terra.
text_el: καὶ στήσω τὴν διαθήκην μου πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ οὐκ ἀποθανεῖται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἔτι ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕδατος τοῦ κατακλυσμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι κατακλυσμὸς ὕδατος τοῦ καταφθεῖραι πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: And God said: This is the sign of the covenant which I give between me and you, and to every living soul that is with you, for perpetual generations .
text_la: Dixitque Deus : Hoc signum fœderis quod do inter me et vos, et ad omnem animam viventem, quæ est vobiscum in generationes sempiternas:
text_pt: E disse Deus: Este é o sinal da aliança que ponho entre mim e vós, e entre toda a alma vivente, que está convosco, por gerações eternas.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Νωε τοῦτο τὸ σημεῖον τῆς διαθήκης ὃ ἐγὼ δίδωμι ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον πάσης ψυχῆς ζώσης ἥ ἐστιν μεθ' ὑμῶν εἰς γενεὰς αἰωνίους

text_en: I will set my bow in the clouds, and it shall be the sign of a covenant between me and between the earth.
text_la: arcum meum ponam in nubibus, et erit signum fœderis inter me et inter terram.
text_pt: O meu arco tenho posto nas nuvens; este será por sinal da aliança entre mim e a terra.
text_el: τὸ τόξον μου τίθημι ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ καὶ ἔσται εἰς σημεῖον διαθήκης ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And when I shall cover the sky with clouds, my bow shall appear in the clouds:
text_la: Cumque obduxero nubibus cælum, apparebit arcus meus in nubibus:
text_pt: E acontecerá que, quando eu trouxer nuvens sobre a terra, aparecerá o arco nas nuvens.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ συννεφεῖν με νεφέλας ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ὀφθήσεται τὸ τόξον μου ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ

text_en: And I will remember my covenant with you, and with every living soul that bears flesh: and there shall no more be waters of a flood to destroy all flesh.
text_la: et recordabor fœderis mei vobiscum, et cum omni anima vivente quæ carnem vegetat : et non erunt ultra aquæ diluvii ad delendum universam carnem.
text_pt: Então me lembrarei da minha aliança, que está entre mim e vós, e entre toda a alma vivente de toda a carne; e as águas não se tornarão mais em dilúvio para destruir toda a carne.
text_el: καὶ μνησθήσομαι τῆς διαθήκης μου ἥ ἐστιν ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον πάσης ψυχῆς ζώσης ἐν πάσῃ σαρκί καὶ οὐκ ἔσται ἔτι τὸ ὕδωρ εἰς κατακλυσμὸν ὥστε ἐξαλεῖψαι πᾶσαν σάρκα

text_en: And the bow shall be in the clouds, and I shall see it, and shall remember the everlasting covenant, that was made between God and every living soul of all flesh which is upon the earth.
text_la: Eritque arcus in nubibus, et videbo illum, et recordabor fœderis sempiterni quod pactum est inter Deum et omnem animam viventem universæ carnis quæ est super terram.
text_pt: E estará o arco nas nuvens, e eu o verei, para me lembrar da aliança eterna entre Deus e toda a alma vivente de toda a carne, que está sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ τόξον μου ἐν τῇ νεφέλῃ καὶ ὄψομαι τοῦ μνησθῆναι διαθήκην αἰώνιον ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον πάσης ψυχῆς ζώσης ἐν πάσῃ σαρκί ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And God said to Noe : This shall be the sign of the covenant, which I have established, between me and all flesh upon the earth.
text_la: Dixitque Deus ad Noë : Hoc erit signum fœderis, quod constitui inter me et omnem carnem super terram.
text_pt: E disse Deus a Noé: Este é o sinal da aliança que tenho estabelecido entre mim e entre toda a carne, que está sobre a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς τῷ Νωε τοῦτο τὸ σημεῖον τῆς διαθήκης ἧς διεθέμην ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον πάσης σαρκός ἥ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the sons of Noe , who came out of the ark , were Sem , Cham , and Japheth: and Cham is the father of Chanaan .
text_la: Erant ergo filii Noë, qui egressi sunt de arca, Sem, Cham et Japheth : porro Cham ipse est pater Chanaan.
text_pt: E os filhos de Noé, que da arca saíram, foram Sem, Cão e Jafé; e Cão é o pai de Canaã.
text_el: ἦσαν δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Νωε οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐκ τῆς κιβωτοῦ Σημ Χαμ Ιαφεθ Χαμ ἦν πατὴρ Χανααν

text_en: These three are the sons of Noe : and from these was all mankind spread over the whole earth.
text_la: Tres isti filii sunt Noë : et ab his disseminatum est omne genus hominum super universam terram.
text_pt: Estes três foram os filhos de Noé; e destes se povoou toda a terra.
text_el: τρεῖς οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Νωε ἀπὸ τούτων διεσπάρησαν ἐπὶ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν

text_en: And Noe a husbandman began to till the ground, and planted a vineyard.
text_la: Cœpitque Noë vir agricola exercere terram, et plantavit vineam.
text_pt: E começou Noé a ser lavrador da terra, e plantou uma vinha.
text_el: καὶ ἤρξατο Νωε ἄνθρωπος γεωργὸς γῆς καὶ ἐφύτευσεν ἀμπελῶνα

text_en: And drinking of the wine was made drunk , and was uncovered in his tent.
text_la: Bibensque vinum inebriatus est, et nudatus in tabernaculo suo.
text_pt: E bebeu do vinho, e embebedou-se; e descobriu-se no meio de sua tenda.
text_el: καὶ ἔπιεν ἐκ τοῦ οἴνου καὶ ἐμεθύσθη καὶ ἐγυμνώθη ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Which when Cham the father of Chanaan had seen, to wit, that his father's nakedness was uncovered, he told it to his two brethren without.
text_la: Quod cum vidisset Cham, pater Chanaan, verenda scilicet patris sui esse nudata, nuntiavit duobus fratribus suis foras.
text_pt: E viu Cão, o pai de Canaã, a nudez do seu pai, e fê-lo saber a ambos seus irmãos no lado de fora.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Χαμ ὁ πατὴρ Χανααν τὴν γύμνωσιν τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἀνήγγειλεν τοῖς δυσὶν ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ ἔξω

text_en: But Sem and Japheth put a cloak upon their shoulders, and going backward, covered the nakedness of their father: and their faces were turned away, and they saw not their father's nakedness.
text_la: At vero Sem et Japheth pallium imposuerunt humeris suis, et incedentes retrorsum, operuerunt verenda patris sui : faciesque eorum aversæ erant, et patris virilia non viderunt.
text_pt: Então tomaram Sem e Jafé uma capa, e puseram-na sobre ambos os seus ombros, e indo virados para trás, cobriram a nudez do seu pai, e os seus rostos estavam virados, de maneira que não viram a nudez do seu pai.
text_el: καὶ λαβόντες Σημ καὶ Ιαφεθ τὸ ἱμάτιον ἐπέθεντο ἐπὶ τὰ δύο νῶτα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν ὀπισθοφανῶς καὶ συνεκάλυψαν τὴν γύμνωσιν τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν καὶ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῶν ὀπισθοφανές καὶ τὴν γύμνωσιν τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν οὐκ εἶδον

text_en: And Noe awaking from the wine, when he had learned what his younger son had done to him,
text_la: Evigilans autem Noë ex vino, cum didicisset quæ fecerat ei filius suus minor,
text_pt: E despertou Noé do seu vinho, e soube o que seu filho menor lhe fizera.
text_el: ἐξένηψεν δὲ Νωε ἀπὸ τοῦ οἴνου καὶ ἔγνω ὅσα ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ὁ νεώτερος

text_en: he said: Cursed be Chanaan , a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
text_la: ait : Maledictus Chanaan, servus servorum erit fratribus suis.
text_pt: E disse: Maldito seja Canaã; servo dos servos seja aos seus irmãos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐπικατάρατος Χανααν παῖς οἰκέτης ἔσται τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said: Blessed be the Lord God of Sem , be Chanaan his servant.
text_la: Dixitque : Benedictus Dominus Deus Sem, sit Chanaan servus ejus.
text_pt: E disse: Bendito seja o Senhor Deus de Sem; e seja-lhe Canaã por servo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Σημ καὶ ἔσται Χανααν παῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: May God enlarge Japheth, and may he dwell in the tents of Sem , and Chanaan be his servant.
text_la: Dilatet Deus Japheth, et habitet in tabernaculis Sem, sitque Chanaan servus ejus.
text_pt: Alargue Deus a Jafé, e habite nas tendas de Sem; e seja-lhe Canaã por servo.
text_el: πλατύναι ὁ θεὸς τῷ Ιαφεθ καὶ κατοικησάτω ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις τοῦ Σημ καὶ γενηθήτω Χανααν παῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: And Noe lived after the flood three hundred and fifty years.
text_la: Vixit autem Noë post diluvium trecentis quinquaginta annis.
text_pt: E viveu Noé, depois do dilúvio, trezentos e cinqüenta anos.
text_el: ἔζησεν δὲ Νωε μετὰ τὸν κατακλυσμὸν τριακόσια πεντήκοντα ἔτη

text_en: And all his days were in the whole nine hundred and fifty years: and he died.
text_la: Et impleti sunt omnes dies ejus nongentorum quinquaginta annorum : et mortuus est.
text_pt: E foram todos os dias de Noé novecentos e cinqüenta anos, e morreu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο πᾶσαι αἱ ἡμέραι Νωε ἐννακόσια πεντήκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: These are the generations of the sons of Noe : Sem , Cham , and Japheth: and unto them sons were born after the flood .
text_la: Hæ sunt generationes filiorum Noë, Sem, Cham et Japheth : natique sunt eis filii post diluvium.
text_pt: Estas, pois, são as gerações dos filhos de Noé: Sem, Cão e Jafé; e nasceram-lhes filhos depois do dilúvio.
text_el: αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις τῶν υἱῶν Νωε Σημ Χαμ Ιαφεθ καὶ ἐγενήθησαν αὐτοῖς υἱοὶ μετὰ τὸν κατακλυσμόν

text_en: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, and Magog , and Madai , and Javan , and Thubal, and Mosoch, and Thiras.
text_la: Filii Japheth : Gomer, et Magog, et Madai, et Javan, et Thubal, et Mosoch, et Thiras.
text_pt: Os filhos de Jafé são: Gomer, Magogue, Madai, Javã, Tubal, Meseque e Tiras.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιαφεθ Γαμερ καὶ Μαγωγ καὶ Μαδαι καὶ Ιωυαν καὶ Ελισα καὶ Θοβελ καὶ Μοσοχ καὶ Θιρας

text_en: And the sons of Gomer: Ascenez and Riphath and Thogorma.
text_la: Porro filii Gomer : Ascenez et Riphath et Thogorma.
text_pt: E os filhos de Gomer são: Asquenaz, Rifate e Togarma.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Γαμερ Ασχαναζ καὶ Ριφαθ καὶ Θοργαμα

text_en: And the sons of Javan : Elisa and Tharsis, Cetthim and Dodanim .
text_la: Filii autem Javan : Elisa et Tharsis, Cetthim et Dodanim.
text_pt: E os filhos de Javã são: Elisá, Társis, Quitim e Dodanim.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Ιωυαν Ελισα καὶ Θαρσις Κίτιοι Ῥόδιοι

text_en: By these were divided the islands of the Gentiles in their lands, every one according to his tongue and their families in their nations.
text_la: Ab his divisæ sunt insulæ gentium in regionibus suis, unusquisque secundum linguam suam et familias suas in nationibus suis.
text_pt: Por estes foram repartidas as ilhas dos gentios nas suas terras, cada qual segundo a sua língua, segundo as suas famílias, entre as suas nações.
text_el: ἐκ τούτων ἀφωρίσθησαν νῆσοι τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν ἕκαστος κατὰ γλῶσσαν ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the Sons of Cham : Chus , and Mesram , and Phuth, and Chanaan .
text_la: Filii autem Cham : Chus, et Mesraim, et Phuth, et Chanaan.
text_pt: E os filhos de Cão são: Cuxe, Mizraim, Pute e Canaã.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Χαμ Χους καὶ Μεσραιμ Φουδ καὶ Χανααν

text_en: And the sons of Chus : Saba, and Hevila, and Sabatha, and Regma, and Sabatacha. The sons of Regma: Saba , and Dadan.
text_la: Filii Chus : Saba, et Hevila, et Sabatha, et Regma, et Sabatacha. Filii Regma : Saba et Dadan.
text_pt: E os filhos de Cuxe são: Sebá, Havilá, Sabtá, Raamá e Sabtecá; e os filhos de Raamá: Sebá e Dedã.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Χους Σαβα καὶ Ευιλα καὶ Σαβαθα καὶ Ρεγμα καὶ Σαβακαθα υἱοὶ δὲ Ρεγμα Σαβα καὶ Δαδαν

text_en: Now Chus begot Nemrod : he began to be mighty on the earth.
text_la: Porro Chus genuit Nemrod : ipse cœpit esse potens in terra,
text_pt: E Cuxe gerou a Ninrode; este começou a ser poderoso na terra. 9
text_el: Χους δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Νεβρωδ οὗτος ἤρξατο εἶναι γίγας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And he was a stout hunter before the Lord . Hence came a proverb: Even as Nemrod the stout hunter before the Lord .
text_la: et erat robustus venator coram Domino. Ob hoc exivit proverbium : Quasi Nemrod robustus venator coram Domino.
text_pt: E este foi poderoso caçador diante da face do Senhor; por isso se diz: Como Ninrode, poderoso caçador diante do Senhor.
text_el: οὗτος ἦν γίγας κυνηγὸς ἐναντίον κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ διὰ τοῦτο ἐροῦσιν ὡς Νεβρωδ γίγας κυνηγὸς ἐναντίον κυρίου

text_en: And the beginning of his kingdom was Babylon , and Arach, and Achad, and Chalanne in the land of Sennaar.
text_la: Fuit autem principium regni ejus Babylon, et Arach et Achad, et Chalanne, in terra Sennaar.
text_pt: E o princípio do seu reino foi Babel, Ereque, Acade e Calné, na terra de Sinar.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἀρχὴ τῆς βασιλείας αὐτοῦ Βαβυλὼν καὶ Ορεχ καὶ Αρχαδ καὶ Χαλαννη ἐν τῇ γῇ Σεννααρ

text_en: Out of that land came forth Assur , and built Ninive, and the streets of the city, and Chale.
text_la: De terra illa egressus est Assur, et ædificavit Niniven, et plateas civitatis, et Chale.
text_pt: Desta mesma terra saiu à Assíria e edificou a Nínive, Reobote-Ir, Calá,
text_el: ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἐκείνης ἐξῆλθεν Ασσουρ καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν τὴν Νινευη καὶ τὴν Ροωβωθ πόλιν καὶ τὴν Χαλαχ

text_en: Resen also between Ninive and Chale: this is the great city.
text_la: Resen quoque inter Niniven et Chale : hæc est civitas magna.
text_pt: E Resen, entre Nínive e Calá (esta é a grande cidade).
text_el: καὶ τὴν Δασεμ ἀνὰ μέσον Νινευη καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Χαλαχ αὕτη ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη

text_en: And Mesraim begot Ludim, and Anamim and Laabim, Nephthuim.
text_la: At vero Mesraim genuit Ludim, et Anamim et Laabim, Nephthuim,
text_pt: E Mizraim gerou a Ludim, a Anamim, a Leabim, a Naftuim,
text_el: καὶ Μεσραιμ ἐγέννησεν τοὺς Λουδιιμ καὶ τοὺς Ενεμετιιμ καὶ τοὺς Λαβιιμ καὶ τοὺς Νεφθαλιιμ

text_en: And Phetrusim, and Chasluim; of whom came forth the Philistines , and the Capthorim.
text_la: et Phetrusim, et Chasluim : de quibus egressi sunt Philisthiim et Caphtorim.
text_pt: A Patrusim e a Casluim (donde saíram os filisteus) e a Caftorim.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς Πατροσωνιιμ καὶ τοὺς Χασλωνιιμ ὅθεν ἐξῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν Φυλιστιιμ καὶ τοὺς Καφθοριιμ

text_en: And Chanaan begot Sidon his firstborn , the Hethite ,
text_la: Chanaan autem genuit Sidonem primogenitum suum. Hethæum,
text_pt: E Canaã gerou a Sidom, seu primogênito, e a Hete;
text_el: Χανααν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σιδῶνα πρωτότοκον καὶ τὸν Χετταῖον

text_en: and the Jebusite, and the Amorrhite , and the Gergesite.
text_la: et Jebusæum, et Amorrhæum, Gergesæum,
text_pt: E ao jebuseu, ao amorreu, ao girgaseu,
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ιεβουσαῖον καὶ τὸν Αμορραῖον καὶ τὸν Γεργεσαῖον

text_en: The Hevite and Aracite: the Sinite,
text_la: Hevæum, et Aracæum : Sinæum,
text_pt: E ao heveu, ao arqueu, ao sineu,
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ευαῖον καὶ τὸν Αρουκαῖον καὶ τὸν Ασενναῖον

text_en: and the Aradian, the Samarite, and the Hamathite : and afterwards the families of the Chanaanites were spread abroad.
text_la: et Aradium, Samaræum, et Amathæum : et post hæc disseminati sunt populi Chananæorum.
text_pt: E ao arvadeu, ao zemareu, e ao hamateu, e depois se espalharam as famílias dos cananeus.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Ἀράδιον καὶ τὸν Σαμαραῖον καὶ τὸν Αμαθι καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο διεσπάρησαν αἱ φυλαὶ τῶν Χαναναίων

text_en: And the limits of Chanaan were from Sidon as one comes to Gerara even to Gaza , until you enter Sodom and Gomorrha , and Adama, and Seboim even to Lesa.
text_la: Factique sunt termini Chanaan venientibus a Sidone Geraram usque Gazam, donec ingrediaris Sodomam et Gomorrham, et Adamam, et Seboim usque Lesa.
text_pt: E foi o termo dos cananeus desde Sidom, indo para Gerar, até Gaza; indo para Sodoma e Gomorra, Admá e Zeboim, até Lasa.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο τὰ ὅρια τῶν Χαναναίων ἀπὸ Σιδῶνος ἕως ἐλθεῖν εἰς Γεραρα καὶ Γάζαν ἕως ἐλθεῖν Σοδομων καὶ Γομορρας Αδαμα καὶ Σεβωιμ ἕως Λασα

text_en: These are the children of Cham in their kindreds and tongues, and generations , and lands, and nations.
text_la: Hi sunt filii Cham in cognationibus, et linguis, et generationibus, terrisque et gentibus suis.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Cão segundo as suas famílias, segundo as suas línguas, em suas terras, em suas nações.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Χαμ ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν κατὰ γλώσσας αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς χώραις αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: Of Sem also the father of all the children of Heber, the elder brother of Japheth, sons were born.
text_la: De Sem quoque nati sunt, patre omnium filiorum Heber, fratre Japheth majore.
text_pt: E a Sem nasceram filhos, e ele é o pai de todos os filhos de Éber, o irmão mais velho de Jafé.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Σημ ἐγενήθη καὶ αὐτῷ πατρὶ πάντων τῶν υἱῶν Εβερ ἀδελφῷ Ιαφεθ τοῦ μείζονος

text_en: The sons of Sem : Elam and Assur , and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram.
text_la: Filii Sem : Ælam, et Assur, et Arphaxad, et Lud, et Aram.
text_pt: Os filhos de Sem são: Elão, Assur, Arfaxade, Lude e Arã.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σημ Αιλαμ καὶ Ασσουρ καὶ Αρφαξαδ καὶ Λουδ καὶ Αραμ καὶ Καιναν

text_en: The sons of Aram: Us, and Hull, and Gether; and Mes.
text_la: Filii Aram : Us, et Hul, et Gether, et Mes.
text_pt: E os filhos de Arã são: Uz, Hul, Geter e Más.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Αραμ Ως καὶ Ουλ καὶ Γαθερ καὶ Μοσοχ

text_en: But Arphaxad begot Sale, of whom was born Heber.
text_la: At vero Arphaxad genuit Sale, de quo ortus est Heber.
text_pt: E Arfaxade gerou a Selá; e Selá gerou a Éber.
text_el: καὶ Αρφαξαδ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Καιναν καὶ Καιναν ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλα Σαλα δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Εβερ

text_en: And to Heber were born two sons: the name of the one was Phaleg, because in his days was the earth divided: and his brother's name Jectan.
text_la: Natique sunt Heber filii duo : nomen uni Phaleg, eo quod in diebus ejus divisa sit terra : et nomen fratris ejus Jectan.
text_pt: E a Éber nasceram dois filhos: o nome de um foi Pelegue, porquanto em seus dias se repartiu a terra, e o nome do seu irmão foi Joctã.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Εβερ ἐγενήθησαν δύο υἱοί ὄνομα τῷ ἑνὶ Φαλεκ ὅτι ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις αὐτοῦ διεμερίσθη ἡ γῆ καὶ ὄνομα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ Ιεκταν

text_en: Which Jectan begot Elmodad, and Saleph, and Asarmoth, Jare,
text_la: Qui Jectan genuit Elmodad, et Saleph, et Asarmoth, Jare,
text_pt: E Joctã gerou a Almodá, a Selefe, a Hazarmavé, a Jerá,
text_el: Ιεκταν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ελμωδαδ καὶ τὸν Σαλεφ καὶ Ασαρμωθ καὶ Ιαραχ

text_en: and Aduram, and Uzal, and Decla,
text_la: et Aduram, et Uzal, et Decla,
text_pt: A Hadorão, a Usal, a Dicla,
text_el: καὶ Οδορρα καὶ Αιζηλ καὶ Δεκλα

text_en: and Ebal, and Abimael, Saba ,
text_la: et Ebal, et Abimaël, Saba,
text_pt: A Obal, a Abimael, a Sebá,
text_el: καὶ Αβιμεηλ καὶ Σαβευ

text_en: and Ophir , and Hevila, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Jectan.
text_la: et Ophir, et Hevila, et Jobab : omnes isti, filii Jectan.
text_pt: A Ofir, a Havilá e a Jobabe; todos estes foram filhos de Joctã.
text_el: καὶ Ουφιρ καὶ Ευιλα καὶ Ιωβαβ πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ιεκταν

text_en: And their dwelling was from Messa as we go on as far as Sephar, a mountain in the east.
text_la: Et facta est habitatio eorum de Messa pergentibus usque Sephar montem orientalem.
text_pt: E foi a sua habitação desde Messa, indo para Sefar, montanha do oriente.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ κατοίκησις αὐτῶν ἀπὸ Μασση ἕως ἐλθεῖν εἰς Σωφηρα ὄρος ἀνατολῶν

text_en: These are the children of Sem according to their kindreds and tongues, and countries in their nations.
text_la: Isti filii Sem secundum cognationes, et linguas, et regiones in gentibus suis.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Sem segundo as suas famílias, segundo as suas línguas, nas suas terras, segundo as suas nações.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Σημ ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν κατὰ γλώσσας αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς χώραις αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: These are the families of Noe , according to their people and nations. By these were the nations divided on the earth after the flood .
text_la: Hæ familiæ Noë juxta populos et nationes suas. Ab his divisæ sunt gentes in terra post diluvium.
text_pt: Estas são as famílias dos filhos de Noé segundo as suas gerações, nas suas nações; e destes foram divididas as nações na terra depois do dilúvio.
text_el: αὗται αἱ φυλαὶ υἱῶν Νωε κατὰ γενέσεις αὐτῶν κατὰ τὰ ἔθνη αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τούτων διεσπάρησαν νῆσοι τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς μετὰ τὸν κατακλυσμόν

text_en: And the earth was of one tongue, and of the same speech.
text_la: Erat autem terra labii unius, et sermonum eorumdem.
text_pt: E era toda a terra de uma mesma língua e de uma mesma fala.
text_el: καὶ ἦν πᾶσα ἡ γῆ χεῖλος ἕν καὶ φωνὴ μία πᾶσιν

text_en: And when they removed from the east, they found a plain in the land of Sennaar, and dwelt in it.
text_la: Cumque proficiscerentur de oriente, invenerunt campum in terra Senaar, et habitaverunt in eo.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, partindo eles do oriente, acharam um vale na terra de Sinar; e habitaram ali.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ κινῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν εὗρον πεδίον ἐν γῇ Σεννααρ καὶ κατῴκησαν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And each one said to his neighbour: Come let us make brick, and bake them with fire. And they had brick instead of stones, and slime instead of mortar:
text_la: Dixitque alter ad proximum suum : Venite, faciamus lateres, et coquamus eos igni. Habueruntque lateres pro saxis, et bitumen pro cæmento:
text_pt: E disseram uns aos outros: Eia, façamos tijolos e queimemo-los bem. E foi-lhes o tijolo por pedra, e o betume por cal.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἄνθρωπος τῷ πλησίον δεῦτε πλινθεύσωμεν πλίνθους καὶ ὀπτήσωμεν αὐτὰς πυρί καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῖς ἡ πλίνθος εἰς λίθον καὶ ἄσφαλτος ἦν αὐτοῖς ὁ πηλός

text_en: And they said: Come, let us make a city and a tower , the top whereof may reach to heaven ; and let us make our name famous before we be scattered abroad into all lands.
text_la: et dixerunt : Venite, faciamus nobis civitatem et turrim, cujus culmen pertingat ad cælum : et celebremus nomen nostrum antequam dividamur in universas terras.
text_pt: E disseram: Eia, edifiquemos nós uma cidade e uma torre cujo cume toque nos céus, e façamo-nos um nome, para que não sejamos espalhados sobre a face de toda a terra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν δεῦτε οἰκοδομήσωμεν ἑαυτοῖς πόλιν καὶ πύργον οὗ ἡ κεφαλὴ ἔσται ἕως τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ποιήσωμεν ἑαυτοῖς ὄνομα πρὸ τοῦ διασπαρῆναι ἐπὶ προσώπου πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: And the Lord came down to see the city and the tower , which the children of Adam were building.
text_la: Descendit autem Dominus ut videret civitatem et turrim, quam ædificabant filii Adam,
text_pt: Então desceu o Senhor para ver a cidade e a torre que os filhos dos homens edificavam;
text_el: καὶ κατέβη κύριος ἰδεῖν τὴν πόλιν καὶ τὸν πύργον ὃν ᾠκοδόμησαν οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ἀνθρώπων

text_en: And he said: Behold, it is one people, and all have one tongue: and they have begun to do this, neither will they leave off from their designs, till they accomplish them in deed.
text_la: et dixit : Ecce, unus est populus, et unum labium omnibus : cœperuntque hoc facere, nec desistent a cogitationibus suis, donec eas opere compleant.
text_pt: E o Senhor disse: Eis que o povo é um, e todos têm uma mesma língua; e isto é o que começam a fazer; e agora, não haverá restrição para tudo o que eles intentarem fazer.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος ἰδοὺ γένος ἓν καὶ χεῖλος ἓν πάντων καὶ τοῦτο ἤρξαντο ποιῆσαι καὶ νῦν οὐκ ἐκλείψει ἐξ αὐτῶν πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐπιθῶνται ποιεῖν

text_en: Come, therefore, let us go down, and there confound their tongue, that they may not understand one another's speech.
text_la: Venite igitur, descendamus, et confundamus ibi linguam eorum, ut non audiat unusquisque vocem proximi sui.
text_pt: Eia, desçamos e confundamos ali a sua língua, para que não entenda um a língua do outro.
text_el: δεῦτε καὶ καταβάντες συγχέωμεν ἐκεῖ αὐτῶν τὴν γλῶσσαν ἵνα μὴ ἀκούσωσιν ἕκαστος τὴν φωνὴν τοῦ πλησίον

text_en: And so the Lord scattered them from that place into all lands, and they ceased to build the city .
text_la: Atque ita divisit eos Dominus ex illo loco in universas terras, et cessaverunt ædificare civitatem.
text_pt: Assim o Senhor os espalhou dali sobre a face de toda a terra; e cessaram de edificar a cidade.
text_el: καὶ διέσπειρεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ἐκεῖθεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπαύσαντο οἰκοδομοῦντες τὴν πόλιν καὶ τὸν πύργον

text_en: And therefore the name thereof was called Babel , because there the language of the whole earth was confounded: and from thence the Lord scattered them abroad upon the face of all countries.
text_la: Et idcirco vocatum est nomen ejus Babel, quia ibi confusum est labium universæ terræ : et inde dispersit eos Dominus super faciem cunctarum regionum.
text_pt: Por isso se chamou o seu nome Babel, porquanto ali confundiu o Senhor a língua de toda a terra, e dali os espalhou o Senhor sobre a face de toda a terra.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Σύγχυσις ὅτι ἐκεῖ συνέχεεν κύριος τὰ χείλη πάσης τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκεῖθεν διέσπειρεν αὐτοὺς κύριος ὁ θεὸς ἐπὶ πρόσωπον πάσης τῆς γῆς

text_en: These are the generations of Sem : Sem was a hundred years old when he begot Arphaxad, two years after the flood .
text_la: Hæ sunt generationes Sem : Sem erat centum annorum quando genuit Arphaxad, biennio post diluvium.
text_pt: Estas são as gerações de Sem: Sem era da idade de cem anos e gerou a Arfaxade, dois anos depois do dilúvio.
text_el: καὶ αὗται αἱ γενέσεις Σημ Σημ υἱὸς ἑκατὸν ἐτῶν ὅτε ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αρφαξαδ δευτέρου ἔτους μετὰ τὸν κατακλυσμόν

text_en: And Sem lived after he begot Arphaxad, five hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixitque Sem, postquam genuit Arphaxad, quingentis annis : et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Sem, depois que gerou a Arfaxade, quinhentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Σημ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Αρφαξαδ πεντακόσια ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Arphaxad lived thirty-five years, and begot Sale.
text_la: Porro Arphaxad vixit triginta quinque annis, et genuit Sale.
text_pt: E viveu Arfaxade trinta e cinco anos, e gerou a Selá.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Αρφαξαδ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Καιναν

text_en: And Arphaxad lived after he begot Sale, three hundred and three years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixitque Arphaxad, postquam genuit Sale, trecentis tribus annis : et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Arfaxade depois que gerou a Selá, quatrocentos e três anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Αρφαξαδ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Καιναν ἔτη τετρακόσια τριάκοντα καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν καὶ ἔζησεν Καιναν ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαλα καὶ ἔζησεν Καιναν μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Σαλα ἔτη τριακόσια τριάκοντα καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: Sale also lived thirty years, and begot Heber.
text_la: Sale quoque vixit triginta annis, et genuit Heber.
text_pt: E viveu Selá trinta anos, e gerou a Éber;
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Σαλα ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Εβερ

text_en: And Sale lived after he begot Heber, four hundred and three years: and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixitque Sale, postquam genuit Heber, quadringentis tribus annis : et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Selá, depois que gerou a Éber, quatrocentos e três anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Σαλα μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Εβερ τριακόσια τριάκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Heber lived thirty-four years, and begot Phaleg.
text_la: Vixit autem Heber triginta quatuor annis, et genuit Phaleg.
text_pt: E viveu Éber trinta e quatro anos, e gerou a Pelegue.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Εβερ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα τέσσαρα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Φαλεκ

text_en: And Heber lived after he begot Phaleg, four hundred and thirty years: and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Et vixit Heber postquam genuit Phaleg, quadringentis triginta annis : et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Éber, depois que gerou a Pelegue, quatrocentos e trinta anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Εβερ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Φαλεκ ἔτη τριακόσια ἑβδομήκοντα καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: Phaleg also lived thirty years, and begot Reu.
text_la: Vixit quoque Phaleg triginta annis, et genuit Reu.
text_pt: E viveu Pelegue trinta anos, e gerou a Reú.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Φαλεκ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ραγαυ

text_en: And Phaleg lived after he begot Reu, two hundred and nine years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixitque Phaleg, postquam genuit Reu, ducentis novem annis : et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Pelegue, depois que gerou a Reú, duzentos e nove anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Φαλεκ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Ραγαυ διακόσια ἐννέα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Reu lived thirty-two years, and begot Sarug.
text_la: Vixit autem Reu triginta duobus annis, et genuit Sarug.
text_pt: E viveu Reú trinta e dois anos, e gerou a Serugue.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ραγαυ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα δύο ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σερουχ

text_en: And Reu lived after he begot Sarug, two hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixit quoque Reu, postquam genuit Sarug, ducentis septem annis : et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Reú, depois que gerou a Serugue, duzentos e sete anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ραγαυ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Σερουχ διακόσια ἑπτὰ ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Sarug lived thirty years, and begot Nachor.
text_la: Vixit vero Sarug triginta annis, et genuit Nachor.
text_pt: E viveu Serugue trinta anos, e gerou a Naor.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Σερουχ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ναχωρ

text_en: And Sarug lived after he begot Nachor, two hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixitque Sarug, postquam genuit Nachor, ducentis annis : et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Serugue, depois que gerou a Naor, duzentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Σερουχ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Ναχωρ ἔτη διακόσια καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Nachor lived nine and twenty years, and begot Thare.
text_la: Vixit autem Nachor viginti novem annis, et genuit Thare.
text_pt: E viveu Naor vinte e nove anos, e gerou a Terá.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ναχωρ ἔτη ἑβδομήκοντα ἐννέα καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Θαρα

text_en: And Nachor lived after he begot Thare, a hundred and nineteen years, and begot sons and daughters.
text_la: Vixitque Nachor, postquam genuit Thare, centum decem et novem annis : et genuit filios et filias.
text_pt: E viveu Naor, depois que gerou a Terá, cento e dezenove anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Ναχωρ μετὰ τὸ γεννῆσαι αὐτὸν τὸν Θαρα ἔτη ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ἐννέα καὶ ἐγέννησεν υἱοὺς καὶ θυγατέρας καὶ ἀπέθανεν

text_en: And Thare lived seventy years, and begot Abram , and Nachor, and Aran.
text_la: Vixitque Thare septuaginta annis, et genuit Abram, et Nachor, et Aran.
text_pt: E viveu Terá setenta anos, e gerou a Abrão, a Naor, e a Harã.
text_el: καὶ ἔζησεν Θαρα ἑβδομήκοντα ἔτη καὶ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αβραμ καὶ τὸν Ναχωρ καὶ τὸν Αρραν

text_en: And these are the generations of Thare: Thare begot Abram , Nachor, and Aran. And Aran begot Lot .
text_la: Hæ sunt autem generationes Thare : Thare genuit Abram, Nachor et Aran. Porro Aran genuit Lot.
text_pt: E estas são as gerações de Terá: Terá gerou a Abrão, a Naor, e a Harã; e Harã gerou a Ló.
text_el: αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις Θαρα Θαρα ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αβραμ καὶ τὸν Ναχωρ καὶ τὸν Αρραν καὶ Αρραν ἐγέννησεν τὸν Λωτ

text_en: And Aran died before Thare his father, in the land of his nativity in Ur of the Chaldees.
text_la: Mortuusque est Aran ante Thare patrem suum, in terra nativitatis suæ, in Ur Chaldæorum.
text_pt: E morreu Harã estando seu pai Terá ainda vivo, na terra do seu nascimento, em Ur dos caldeus.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Αρραν ἐνώπιον Θαρα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ γῇ ᾗ ἐγενήθη ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ τῶν Χαλδαίων

text_en: And Abram and Nachor married wives: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai : and the name of Nachor's wife, Melcha, the daughter of Aran, father of Melcha and father of Jescha.
text_la: Duxerunt autem Abram et Nachor uxores : nomen uxoris Abram, Sarai : et nomen uxoris Nachor, Melcha filia Aran, patris Melchæ, et patris Jeschæ.
text_pt: E tomaram Abrão e Naor mulheres para si: o nome da mulher de Abrão era Sarai, e o nome da mulher de Naor era Milca, filha de Harã, pai de Milca e pai de Iscá.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβον Αβραμ καὶ Ναχωρ ἑαυτοῖς γυναῖκας ὄνομα τῇ γυναικὶ Αβραμ Σαρα καὶ ὄνομα τῇ γυναικὶ Ναχωρ Μελχα θυγάτηρ Αρραν πατὴρ Μελχα καὶ πατὴρ Ιεσχα

text_en: And Sarai was barren, and had no children.
text_la: Erat autem Sarai sterilis, nec habebat liberos.
text_pt: E Sarai foi estéril, não tinha filhos.
text_el: καὶ ἦν Σαρα στεῖρα καὶ οὐκ ἐτεκνοποίει

text_en: And Thare took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Aran, his son's son, and Sarai his daughter in law, the wife of Abram his son, and brought them out of Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Chanaan : and they came as far as Haran , and dwelt there.
text_la: Tulit itaque Thare Abram filium suum, et Lot filium Aran, filium filii sui, et Sarai nurum suam, uxorem Abram filii sui, et eduxit eos de Ur Chaldæorum, ut irent in terram Chanaan : veneruntque usque Haran, et habitaverunt ibi.
text_pt: E tomou Terá a Abrão seu filho, e a Ló, filho de Harã, filho de seu filho, e a Sarai sua nora, mulher de seu filho Abrão, e saiu com eles de Ur dos caldeus, para ir à terra de Canaã; e vieram até Harã, e habitaram ali.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Θαρα τὸν Αβραμ υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν Λωτ υἱὸν Αρραν υἱὸν τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν Σαραν τὴν νύμφην αὐτοῦ γυναῖκα Αβραμ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξήγαγεν αὐτοὺς ἐκ τῆς χώρας τῶν Χαλδαίων πορευθῆναι εἰς τὴν γῆν Χανααν καὶ ἦλθεν ἕως Χαρραν καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And the days of Thare were two hundred and five years, and he died in Haran .
text_la: Et facti sunt dies Thare ducentorum quinque annorum, et mortuus est in Haran.
text_pt: E foram os dias de Terá duzentos e cinco anos, e morreu Terá em Harã.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντο αἱ ἡμέραι Θαρα ἐν Χαρραν διακόσια πέντε ἔτη καὶ ἀπέθανεν Θαρα ἐν Χαρραν

text_en: And the Lord said to Abram : Go forth out of your country, and from your kindred, and out of your father's house, and come into the land which I shall show you.
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Abram : Egredere de terra tua, et de cognatione tua, et de domo patris tui, et veni in terram quam monstrabo tibi.
text_pt: Ora, o SENHOR disse a Abrão: Sai-te da tua terra, da tua parentela e da casa de teu pai, para a terra que eu te mostrarei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος τῷ Αβραμ ἔξελθε ἐκ τῆς γῆς σου καὶ ἐκ τῆς συγγενείας σου καὶ ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός σου εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ἄν σοι δείξω

text_en: And I will make of you a great nation, and I will bless you, and magnify your name , and you shall be blessed .
text_la: Faciamque te in gentem magnam, et benedicam tibi, et magnificabo nomen tuum, erisque benedictus.
text_pt: E far-te-ei uma grande nação, e abençoar-te-ei e engrandecerei o teu nome; e tu serás uma bênção.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσω σε εἰς ἔθνος μέγα καὶ εὐλογήσω σε καὶ μεγαλυνῶ τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ ἔσῃ εὐλογητός

text_en: I will bless them that bless you, and curse them that curse you, and IN THEE shall all the kindreds of the earth be blessed .
text_la: Benedicam benedicentibus tibi, et maledicam maledicentibus tibi, atque in te benedicentur universæ cognationes terræ.
text_pt: E abençoarei os que te abençoarem, e amaldiçoarei os que te amaldiçoarem; e em ti serão benditas todas as famílias da terra.
text_el: καὶ εὐλογήσω τοὺς εὐλογοῦντάς σε καὶ τοὺς καταρωμένους σε καταράσομαι καὶ ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: So Abram went out as the Lord had commanded him, and Lot went with him: Abram was seventy-five years old when he went forth from Haran .
text_la: Egressus est itaque Abram sicut præceperat ei Dominus, et ivit cum eo Lot : septuaginta quinque annorum erat Abram cum egrederetur de Haran.
text_pt: Assim partiu Abrão como o Senhor lhe tinha dito, e foi Ló com ele; e era Abrão da idade de setenta e cinco anos quando saiu de Harã.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Αβραμ καθάπερ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ κύριος καὶ ᾤχετο μετ' αὐτοῦ Λωτ Αβραμ δὲ ἦν ἐτῶν ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε ὅτε ἐξῆλθεν ἐκ Χαρραν

text_en: And he took Sarai his wife, and Lot his brother's son, and all the substance which they had gathered, and the souls which they had gotten in Haran : and they went out to go into the land of Chanaan . And when they had come into it,
text_la: Tulitque Sarai uxorem suam, et Lot filium fratris sui, universamque substantiam quam possederant, et animas quas fecerant in Haran : et egressi sunt ut irent in terram Chanaan. Cumque venissent in eam,
text_pt: E tomou Abrão a Sarai, sua mulher, e a Ló, filho de seu irmão, e todos os bens que haviam adquirido, e as almas que lhe acresceram em Harã; e saíram para irem à terra de Canaã; e chegaram à terra de Canaã.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Αβραμ τὴν Σαραν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν Λωτ υἱὸν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτῶν ὅσα ἐκτήσαντο καὶ πᾶσαν ψυχήν ἣν ἐκτήσαντο ἐν Χαρραν καὶ ἐξήλθοσαν πορευθῆναι εἰς γῆν Χανααν καὶ ἦλθον εἰς γῆν Χανααν

text_en: Abram passed through the country unto the place of Sichem , as far as the noble vale: now the Chanaanite was at that time in the land.
text_la: pertransivit Abram terram usque ad locum Sichem, usque ad convallem illustrem : Chananæus autem tunc erat in terra.
text_pt: E passou Abrão por aquela terra até ao lugar de Siquém, até ao carvalho de Moré; e estavam então os cananeus na terra.
text_el: καὶ διώδευσεν Αβραμ τὴν γῆν εἰς τὸ μῆκος αὐτῆς ἕως τοῦ τόπου Συχεμ ἐπὶ τὴν δρῦν τὴν ὑψηλήν οἱ δὲ Χαναναῖοι τότε κατῴκουν τὴν γῆν

text_en: And the Lord appeared to Abram , and said to him: To your seed will I give this land. And he built there an altar to the Lord , who had appeared to him.
text_la: Apparuit autem Dominus Abram, et dixit ei : Semini tuo dabo terram hanc. Qui ædificavit ibi altare Domino, qui apparuerat ei.
text_pt: E apareceu o Senhor a Abrão, e disse: À tua descendência darei esta terra. E edificou ali um altar ao Senhor, que lhe aparecera.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθη κύριος τῷ Αβραμ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τῷ σπέρματί σου δώσω τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ Αβραμ θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ τῷ ὀφθέντι αὐτῷ

text_en: And passing on from thence to a mountain, that was on the east side of Bethel , he there pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Hai on the east: he built there also an altar to the Lord , and called upon his name .
text_la: Et inde transgrediens ad montem, qui erat contra orientem Bethel, tetendit ibi tabernaculum suum, ab occidente habens Bethel, et ab oriente Hai : ædificavit quoque ibi altare Domino, et invocavit nomen ejus.
text_pt: E moveu-se dali para a montanha do lado oriental de Betel, e armou a sua tenda, tendo Betel ao ocidente, e Ai ao oriente; e edificou ali um altar ao Senhor, e invocou o nome do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστη ἐκεῖθεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος κατ' ἀνατολὰς Βαιθηλ καὶ ἔστησεν ἐκεῖ τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ Βαιθηλ κατὰ θάλασσαν καὶ Αγγαι κατ' ἀνατολάς καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι κυρίου

text_en: And Abram went forward, going and proceeding on to the south.
text_la: Perrexitque Abram vadens, et ultra progrediens ad meridiem.
text_pt: Depois caminhou Abrão dali, seguindo ainda para o lado do sul.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆρεν Αβραμ καὶ πορευθεὶς ἐστρατοπέδευσεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And there came a famine in the country: and Abram went down into Egypt , to sojourn there: for the famine was very grievous in the land.
text_la: Facta est autem fames in terra : descenditque Abram in Ægyptum, ut peregrinaretur ibi : prævaluerat enim fames in terra.
text_pt: E havia fome naquela terra; e desceu Abrão ao Egito, para peregrinar ali, porquanto a fome era grande na terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο λιμὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ κατέβη Αβραμ εἰς Αἴγυπτον παροικῆσαι ἐκεῖ ὅτι ἐνίσχυσεν ὁ λιμὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And when he was near to enter into Egypt , he said to Sarai his wife: I know that you are a beautiful woman :
text_la: Cumque prope esset ut ingrederetur Ægyptum, dixit Sarai uxori suæ : Novi quod pulchra sis mulier:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, chegando ele para entrar no Egito, disse a Sarai, sua mulher: Ora, bem sei que és mulher formosa à vista;
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἤγγισεν Αβραμ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς Αἴγυπτον εἶπεν Αβραμ Σαρα τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ γινώσκω ἐγὼ ὅτι γυνὴ εὐπρόσωπος εἶ

text_en: And that when the Egyptians shall see you, they will say: She is his wife: and they will kill me, and keep you.
text_la: et quod cum viderint te Ægyptii, dicturi sunt : Uxor ipsius est : et interficient me, et te reservabunt.
text_pt: E será que, quando os egípcios te virem, dirão: Esta é sua mulher. E matar-me-ão a mim, e a ti te guardarão em vida.
text_el: ἔσται οὖν ὡς ἂν ἴδωσίν σε οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι ἐροῦσιν ὅτι γυνὴ αὐτοῦ αὕτη καὶ ἀποκτενοῦσίν με σὲ δὲ περιποιήσονται

text_en: Say, therefore, I pray you, that you are my sister: that I may be well used for you, and that my soul may live for your sake.
text_la: Dic ergo, obsecro te, quod soror mea sis : ut bene sit mihi propter te, et vivat anima mea ob gratiam tui.
text_pt: Dize, peço-te, que és minha irmã, para que me vá bem por tua causa, e que viva a minha alma por amor de ti.
text_el: εἰπὸν οὖν ὅτι ἀδελφὴ αὐτοῦ εἰμι ὅπως ἂν εὖ μοι γένηται διὰ σέ καὶ ζήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου ἕνεκεν σοῦ

text_en: And when Abram had come into Egypt , the Egyptians saw the woman that she was very beautiful.
text_la: Cum itaque ingressus esset Abram Ægyptum, viderunt Ægyptii mulierem quod esset pulchra nimis.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, entrando Abrão no Egito, viram os egípcios a mulher, que era mui formosa.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα εἰσῆλθεν Αβραμ εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἰδόντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι τὴν γυναῖκα ὅτι καλὴ ἦν σφόδρα

text_en: And the princes told Pharao , and praised her before him: and the woman was taken into the house of Pharao .
text_la: Et nuntiaverunt principes Pharaoni, et laudaverunt eam apud illum : et sublata est mulier in domum Pharaonis.
text_pt: E viram-na os príncipes de Faraó, e gabaram-na diante de Faraó; e foi a mulher tomada para a casa de Faraó.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον αὐτὴν οἱ ἄρχοντες Φαραω καὶ ἐπῄνεσαν αὐτὴν πρὸς Φαραω καὶ εἰσήγαγον αὐτὴν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Φαραω

text_en: And they used Abram well for her sake. And he had sheep and oxen and he asses, and men servants, and maid servants, and she asses, and camels.
text_la: Abram vero bene usi sunt propter illam : fueruntque ei oves et boves et asini, et servi et famulæ, et asinæ et cameli.
text_pt: E fez bem a Abrão por amor dela; e ele teve ovelhas, vacas, jumentos, servos e servas, jumentas e camelos.
text_el: καὶ τῷ Αβραμ εὖ ἐχρήσαντο δι' αὐτήν καὶ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ πρόβατα καὶ μόσχοι καὶ ὄνοι παῖδες καὶ παιδίσκαι ἡμίονοι καὶ κάμηλοι

text_en: But the Lord scourged Pharao and his house with most grievous stripes for Sarai , Abram's wife.
text_la: Flagellavit autem Dominus Pharaonem plagis maximis, et domum ejus, propter Sarai uxorem Abram.
text_pt: Feriu, porém, o Senhor a Faraó e a sua casa, com grandes pragas, por causa de Sarai, mulher de Abrão.
text_el: καὶ ἤτασεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν Φαραω ἐτασμοῖς μεγάλοις καὶ πονηροῖς καὶ τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ περὶ Σαρας τῆς γυναικὸς Αβραμ

text_en: And Pharao called Abram , and said to him: What is this that you have done to me? Why did you not tell me that she was your wife?
text_la: Vocavitque Pharao Abram, et dixit ei : Quidnam est hoc quod fecisti mihi? quare non indicasti quod uxor tua esset?
text_pt: Então chamou Faraó a Abrão, e disse: Que é isto que me fizeste? Por que não me disseste que ela era tua mulher?
text_el: καλέσας δὲ Φαραω τὸν Αβραμ εἶπεν τί τοῦτο ἐποίησάς μοι ὅτι οὐκ ἀπήγγειλάς μοι ὅτι γυνή σού ἐστιν

text_en: For what cause did you say, she was your sister, that I might take her to my wife? Now therefore there is your wife, take her, and go your way.
text_la: quam ob causam dixisti esse sororem tuam, ut tollerem eam mihi in uxorem? Nunc igitur ecce conjux tua, accipe eam, et vade.
text_pt: Por que disseste: É minha irmã? Por isso a tomei por minha mulher; agora, pois, eis aqui tua mulher; toma-a e vai-te.
text_el: ἵνα τί εἶπας ὅτι ἀδελφή μού ἐστιν καὶ ἔλαβον αὐτὴν ἐμαυτῷ εἰς γυναῖκα καὶ νῦν ἰδοὺ ἡ γυνή σου ἐναντίον σου λαβὼν ἀπότρεχε

text_en: And Pharao gave his men orders concerning Abram : and they led him away and his wife, and all that he had.
text_la: Præcepitque Pharao super Abram viris : et deduxerunt eum, et uxorem illius, et omnia quæ habebat.
text_pt: E Faraó deu ordens aos seus homens a respeito dele; e acompanharam-no, a ele, e a sua mulher, e a tudo o que tinha.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Φαραω ἀνδράσιν περὶ Αβραμ συμπροπέμψαι αὐτὸν καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἦν αὐτῷ καὶ Λωτ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Abram went up out of Egypt , he and his wife, and all that he had, and Lot with him into the south.
text_la: Ascendit ergo Abram de Ægypto, ipse et uxor ejus, et omnia quæ habebat, et Lot cum eo, ad australem plagam.
text_pt: Subiu, pois, Abrão do Egito para o lado do sul, ele e sua mulher, e tudo o que tinha, e com ele Ló.
text_el: ἀνέβη δὲ Αβραμ ἐξ Αἰγύπτου αὐτὸς καὶ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ Λωτ μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν ἔρημον

text_en: And he was very rich in possession of gold and silver.
text_la: Erat autem dives valde in possessione auri et argenti.
text_pt: E era Abrão muito rico em gado, em prata e em ouro.
text_el: Αβραμ δὲ ἦν πλούσιος σφόδρα κτήνεσιν καὶ ἀργυρίῳ καὶ χρυσίῳ

text_en: And he returned by the way, that he came, from the south to Bethel , to the place where before he had pitched his tent between Bethel and Hai,
text_la: Reversusque est per iter, quo venerat, a meridie in Bethel, usque ad locum ubi prius fixerat tabernaculum inter Bethel et Hai,
text_pt: E fez as suas jornadas do sul até Betel, até ao lugar onde a princípio estivera a sua tenda, entre Betel e Ai;
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὅθεν ἦλθεν εἰς τὴν ἔρημον ἕως Βαιθηλ ἕως τοῦ τόπου οὗ ἦν ἡ σκηνὴ αὐτοῦ τὸ πρότερον ἀνὰ μέσον Βαιθηλ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Αγγαι

text_en: in the place of the altar which he had made before, and there he called upon the name of the Lord .
text_la: in loco altaris quod fecerat prius : et invocavit ibi nomen Domini.
text_pt: Até ao lugar do altar que outrora ali tinha feito; e Abrão invocou ali o nome do Senhor.
text_el: εἰς τὸν τόπον τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου οὗ ἐποίησεν ἐκεῖ τὴν ἀρχήν καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο ἐκεῖ Αβραμ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου

text_en: But Lot also, who was with Abram , had flocks of sheep, and herds of beasts, and tents.
text_la: Sed et Lot qui erat cum Abram, fuerunt greges ovium, et armenta, et tabernacula.
text_pt: E também Ló, que ia com Abrão, tinha rebanhos, gado e tendas.
text_el: καὶ Λωτ τῷ συμπορευομένῳ μετὰ Αβραμ ἦν πρόβατα καὶ βόες καὶ σκηναί

text_en: Neither was the land able to bear them, that they might dwell together: for their substance was great, and they could not dwell together.
text_la: Nec poterat eos capere terra, ut habitarent simul : erat quippe substantia eorum multa, et nequibant habitare communiter.
text_pt: E não tinha capacidade a terra para poderem habitar juntos; porque os seus bens eram muitos; de maneira que não podiam habitar juntos.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐχώρει αὐτοὺς ἡ γῆ κατοικεῖν ἅμα ὅτι ἦν τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτῶν πολλά καὶ οὐκ ἐδύναντο κατοικεῖν ἅμα

text_en: Whereupon also there arose a strife between the herdsmen of Abram and of Lot . And at that time the Chanaanite and the Pherezite dwelled in that country.
text_la: Unde et facta est rixa inter pastores gregum Abram et Lot. Eo autem tempore Chananæus et Pherezæus habitabant in terra illa.
text_pt: E houve contenda entre os pastores do gado de Abrão e os pastores do gado de Ló; e os cananeus e os perizeus habitavam então na terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μάχη ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ποιμένων τῶν κτηνῶν τοῦ Αβραμ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ποιμένων τῶν κτηνῶν τοῦ Λωτ οἱ δὲ Χαναναῖοι καὶ οἱ Φερεζαῖοι τότε κατῴκουν τὴν γῆν

text_en: Abram therefore said to Lot : Let there be no quarrel, I beseech you, between me and you, and between my herdsmen and your herdsmen: for we are brethren.
text_la: Dixit ergo Abram ad Lot : Ne quæso sit jurgium inter me et te, et inter pastores meos et pastores tuos : fratres enim sumus.
text_pt: E disse Abrão a Ló: Ora, não haja contenda entre mim e ti, e entre os meus pastores e os teus pastores, porque somos irmãos.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβραμ τῷ Λωτ μὴ ἔστω μάχη ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ποιμένων μου καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν ποιμένων σου ὅτι ἄνθρωποι ἀδελφοὶ ἡμεῖς ἐσμεν

text_en: Behold the whole land is before you: depart from me, I pray you: if you will go to the left hand, I will take the right: if you choose the right hand, I will pass to the left.
text_la: Ecce universa terra coram te est : recede a me, obsecro : si ad sinistram ieris, ego dexteram tenebo : si tu dexteram elegeris, ego ad sinistram pergam.
text_pt: Não está toda a terra diante de ti? Eia, pois, aparta-te de mim; e se escolheres a esquerda, irei para a direita; e se a direita escolheres, eu irei para a esquerda.
text_el: οὐκ ἰδοὺ πᾶσα ἡ γῆ ἐναντίον σού ἐστιν διαχωρίσθητι ἀπ' ἐμοῦ εἰ σὺ εἰς ἀριστερά ἐγὼ εἰς δεξιά εἰ δὲ σὺ εἰς δεξιά ἐγὼ εἰς ἀριστερά

text_en: And Lot lifting up his eyes, saw all the country about the Jordan, which was watered throughout, before the Lord destroyed Sodom and Gomorrha , as the paradise of the Lord , and like Egypt as one comes to Segor .
text_la: Elevatis itaque Lot oculis, vidit omnem circa regionem Jordanis, quæ universa irrigabatur antequam subverteret Dominus Sodomam et Gomorrham, sicut paradisus Domini, et sicut Ægyptus venientibus in Segor.
text_pt: E levantou Ló os seus olhos, e viu toda a campina do Jordão, que era toda bem regada, antes do Senhor ter destruído Sodoma e Gomorra, e era como o jardim do Senhor, como a terra do Egito, quando se entra em Zoar.
text_el: καὶ ἐπάρας Λωτ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτοῦ εἶδεν πᾶσαν τὴν περίχωρον τοῦ Ιορδάνου ὅτι πᾶσα ἦν ποτιζομένη πρὸ τοῦ καταστρέψαι τὸν θεὸν Σοδομα καὶ Γομορρα ὡς ὁ παράδεισος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ὡς ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου ἕως ἐλθεῖν εἰς Ζογορα

text_en: And Lot chose to himself the country about the Jordan, and he departed from the east: and they were separated one brother from the other.
text_la: Elegitque sibi Lot regionem circa Jordanem, et recessit ab oriente : divisique sunt alterutrum a fratre suo.
text_pt: Então Ló escolheu para si toda a campina do Jordão, e partiu Ló para o oriente, e apartaram-se um do outro.
text_el: καὶ ἐξελέξατο ἑαυτῷ Λωτ πᾶσαν τὴν περίχωρον τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἀπῆρεν Λωτ ἀπὸ ἀνατολῶν καὶ διεχωρίσθησαν ἕκαστος ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Abram dwelt in the land of Chanaan : and Lot abode in the towns, that were about the Jordan , and dwelt in Sodom .
text_la: Abram habitavit in terra Chanaan; Lot vero moratus est in oppidis, quæ erant circa Jordanem, et habitavit in Sodomis.
text_pt: Habitou Abrão na terra de Canaã e Ló habitou nas cidades da campina, e armou as suas tendas até Sodoma.
text_el: Αβραμ δὲ κατῴκησεν ἐν γῇ Χανααν Λωτ δὲ κατῴκησεν ἐν πόλει τῶν περιχώρων καὶ ἐσκήνωσεν ἐν Σοδομοις

text_en: And the men of Sodom were very wicked , and sinners before the face of the Lord beyond measure.
text_la: Homines autem Sodomitæ pessimi erant, et peccatores coram Domino nimis.
text_pt: Ora, eram maus os homens de Sodoma, e grandes pecadores contra o Senhor.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἄνθρωποι οἱ ἐν Σοδομοις πονηροὶ καὶ ἁμαρτωλοὶ ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ σφόδρα

text_en: And the Lord said to Abram , after Lot was separated from him: Lift up your eyes, and look from the place wherein you now are, to the north and to the south, to the east and to the west.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad Abram, postquam divisus est ab eo Lot : Leva oculos tuos et vide a loco, in quo nunc es, ad aquilonem et meridiem, ad orientem et occidentem.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Abrão, depois que Ló se apartou dele: Levanta agora os teus olhos, e olha desde o lugar onde estás, para o lado do norte, e do sul, e do oriente, e do ocidente;
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεὸς εἶπεν τῷ Αβραμ μετὰ τὸ διαχωρισθῆναι τὸν Λωτ ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἀναβλέψας τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου ἰδὲ ἀπὸ τοῦ τόπου οὗ νῦν σὺ εἶ πρὸς βορρᾶν καὶ λίβα καὶ ἀνατολὰς καὶ θάλασσαν

text_en: All the land which you see, I will give to you, and to your seed for ever .
text_la: Omnem terram, quam conspicis, tibi dabo, et semini tuo usque in sempiternum.
text_pt: Porque toda esta terra que vês, te hei de dar a ti, e à tua descendência, para sempre.
text_el: ὅτι πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ἣν σὺ ὁρᾷς σοὶ δώσω αὐτὴν καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος

text_en: And I will make your seed as the dust of the earth: if any man be able to number the dust of the earth, he shall be able to number your seed also.
text_la: Faciamque semen tuum sicut pulverem terræ : si quis potest hominum numerare pulverem terræ, semen quoque tuum numerare poterit.
text_pt: E farei a tua descendência como o pó da terra; de maneira que se alguém puder contar o pó da terra, também a tua descendência será contada.
text_el: καὶ ποιήσω τὸ σπέρμα σου ὡς τὴν ἄμμον τῆς γῆς εἰ δύναταί τις ἐξαριθμῆσαι τὴν ἄμμον τῆς γῆς καὶ τὸ σπέρμα σου ἐξαριθμηθήσεται

text_en: Arise and walk through the land in the length, and the breadth thereof: for I will give it to you.
text_la: Surge, et perambula terram in longitudine et in latitudine sua : quia tibi daturus sum eam.
text_pt: Levanta-te, percorre essa terra, no seu comprimento e na sua largura; porque a ti a darei.
