text_el: ἀναστὰς διόδευσον τὴν γῆν εἴς τε τὸ μῆκος αὐτῆς καὶ εἰς τὸ πλάτος ὅτι σοὶ δώσω αὐτήν

text_en: So Abram removing his tent, came, and dwelt by the vale of Mambre, which is in Hebron : and he built there an altar to the Lord .
text_la: Movens igitur tabernaculum suum Abram, venit, et habitavit juxta convallem Mambre, quæ est in Hebron : ædificavitque ibi altare Domino.
text_pt: E Abrão mudou as suas tendas, e foi, e habitou nos carvalhais de Manre, que estão junto a Hebrom; e edificou ali um altar ao Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀποσκηνώσας Αβραμ ἐλθὼν κατῴκησεν παρὰ τὴν δρῦν τὴν Μαμβρη ἣ ἦν ἐν Χεβρων καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον κυρίῳ

text_en: And it came to pass at that time, that Amraphel, king of Sennaar , and Arioch, king of Pontus , and Chodorlahomor, king of the Elamites, and Thadal, king of nations,
text_la: Factum est autem in illo tempore, ut Amraphel rex Senaar, et Arioch rex Ponti, et Chodorlahomor rex Elamitarum, et Thadal rex gentium
text_pt: E aconteceu nos dias de Anrafel, rei de Sinar, Arioque, rei de Elasar, Quedorlaomer, rei de Elão, e Tidal, rei de Goim,
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τῇ Αμαρφαλ βασιλέως Σεννααρ Αριωχ βασιλεὺς Ελλασαρ καὶ Χοδολλογομορ βασιλεὺς Αιλαμ καὶ Θαργαλ βασιλεὺς ἐθνῶν

text_en: made war against Bara, king of Sodom , and against Bersa, king of Gomorrha , and against Sennaab, king of Adama, and against Semeber, king of Seboim, and against the king of Bala , which is Segor .
text_la: inirent bellum contra Bara regem Sodomorum, et contra Bersa regem Gomorrhæ, et contra Sennaab regem Adamæ, et contra Semeber regem Seboim, contraque regem Balæ, ipsa est Segor.
text_pt: Que estes fizeram guerra a Bera, rei de Sodoma, a Birsa, rei de Gomorra, a Sinabe, rei de Admá, e a Semeber, rei de Zeboim, e ao rei de Belá (esta é Zoar).
text_el: ἐποίησαν πόλεμον μετὰ Βαλλα βασιλέως Σοδομων καὶ μετὰ Βαρσα βασιλέως Γομορρας καὶ Σεννααρ βασιλέως Αδαμα καὶ Συμοβορ βασιλέως Σεβωιμ καὶ βασιλέως Βαλακ αὕτη ἐστὶν Σηγωρ

text_en: All these came together into the woodland vale , which now is the salt sea .
text_la: Omnes hi convenerunt in vallem Silvestrem, quæ nunc est mare salis.
text_pt: Todos estes se ajuntaram no vale de Sidim (que é o Mar Salgado).
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι συνεφώνησαν ἐπὶ τὴν φάραγγα τὴν ἁλυκήν αὕτη ἡ θάλασσα τῶν ἁλῶν

text_en: For they had served Chodorlahomor twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they revolted from him.
text_la: Duodecim enim annis servierunt Chodorlahomor, et tertiodecimo anno recesserunt ab eo.
text_pt: Doze anos haviam servido a Quedorlaomer, mas ao décimo terceiro ano rebelaram-se.
text_el: δώδεκα ἔτη ἐδούλευον τῷ Χοδολλογομορ τῷ δὲ τρισκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει ἀπέστησαν

text_en: And in the fourteenth year came Chodorlahomor, and the kings that were with him: and they smote the Raphaim in Astarothcarnaim, and the Zuzim with them, and the Emim in Save of Cariathaim.
text_la: Igitur quartodecimo anno venit Chodorlahomor, et reges qui erant cum eo : percusseruntque Raphaim in Astarothcarnaim, et Zuzim cum eis, et Emim in Save Cariathaim,
text_pt: E ao décimo quarto ano veio Quedorlaomer, e os reis que estavam com ele, e feriram aos refains em Asterote-Carnaim, e aos zuzins em Hã, e aos emins em Savé-Quiriataim,
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ τεσσαρεσκαιδεκάτῳ ἔτει ἦλθεν Χοδολλογομορ καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ κατέκοψαν τοὺς γίγαντας τοὺς ἐν Ασταρωθ Καρναιν καὶ ἔθνη ἰσχυρὰ ἅμα αὐτοῖς καὶ τοὺς Ομμαίους τοὺς ἐν Σαυη τῇ πόλει

text_en: And the Chorreans in the mountains of Seir, even to the plains of Pharan, which is in the wilderness .
text_la: et Chorræos in montibus Seir, usque ad Campestria Pharan, quæ est in solitudine.
text_pt: E aos horeus no seu monte Seir, até El-Parã que está junto ao deserto.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς Χορραίους τοὺς ἐν τοῖς ὄρεσιν Σηιρ ἕως τῆς τερεμίνθου τῆς Φαραν ἥ ἐστιν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ

text_en: And they returned, and came to the fountain of Misphat, the same is Cades : and they smote all the country of the Amalecites , and the Amorrhean that dwelt in Asasonthamar .
text_la: Reversique sunt, et venerunt ad fontem Misphat, ipsa est Cades : et percusserunt omnem regionem Amalecitarum, et Amorrhæum, qui habitabat in Asasonthamar.
text_pt: Depois tornaram e vieram a En-Mispate (que é Cades), e feriram toda a terra dos amalequitas, e também aos amorreus, que habitavam em Hazazom-Tamar.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστρέψαντες ἤλθοσαν ἐπὶ τὴν πηγὴν τῆς κρίσεως αὕτη ἐστὶν Καδης καὶ κατέκοψαν πάντας τοὺς ἄρχοντας Αμαληκ καὶ τοὺς Αμορραίους τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν Ασασανθαμαρ

text_en: And the king of Sodom , and the king of Gomorrha , and the king of Adama, and the king of Seboim, and the king of Bala , which is Segor , went out: and they set themselves against them in battle array, in the woodland vale :
text_la: Et egressi sunt rex Sodomorum, et rex Gomorrhæ, rexque Adamæ, et rex Seboim, necnon et rex Balæ, quæ est Segor : et direxerunt aciem contra eos in valle Silvestri:
text_pt: Então saiu o rei de Sodoma, e o rei de Gomorra, e o rei de Admá, e o rei de Zeboim, e o rei de Belá (esta é Zoar), e ordenaram batalha contra eles no vale de Sidim,
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ βασιλεὺς Σοδομων καὶ βασιλεὺς Γομορρας καὶ βασιλεὺς Αδαμα καὶ βασιλεὺς Σεβωιμ καὶ βασιλεὺς Βαλακ αὕτη ἐστὶν Σηγωρ καὶ παρετάξαντο αὐτοῖς εἰς πόλεμον ἐν τῇ κοιλάδι τῇ ἁλυκῇ

text_en: To wit, against Chodorlahomor king of the Elamites, and Thadal king of nations, and Amraphel king of Sennaar , and Arioch king of Pontus : four kings against five.
text_la: scilicet adversus Chodorlahomor regem Elamitarum, et Thadal regem Gentium, et Amraphel regem Sennaar, et Arioch regem Ponti : quatuor reges adversus quinque.
text_pt: Contra Quedorlaomer, rei de Elão, e Tidal, rei de Goim, e Anrafel, rei de Sinar, e Arioque, rei de Elasar; quatro reis contra cinco.
text_el: πρὸς Χοδολλογομορ βασιλέα Αιλαμ καὶ Θαργαλ βασιλέα ἐθνῶν καὶ Αμαρφαλ βασιλέα Σεννααρ καὶ Αριωχ βασιλέα Ελλασαρ οἱ τέσσαρες βασιλεῖς πρὸς τοὺς πέντε

text_en: Now the woodland vale had many pits of slime. And the king of Sodom , and the king of Gomorrha turned their backs, and were overthrown there: and they that remained, fled to the mountain.
text_la: Vallis autem Silvestris habebat puteos multos bituminis. Itaque rex Sodomorum, et Gomorrhæ, terga verterunt, cecideruntque ibi : et qui remanserant, fugerunt ad montem.
text_pt: E o vale de Sidim estava cheio de poços de betume; e fugiram os reis de Sodoma e de Gomorra, e caíram ali; e os restantes fugiram para um monte.
text_el: ἡ δὲ κοιλὰς ἡ ἁλυκὴ φρέατα φρέατα ἀσφάλτου ἔφυγεν δὲ βασιλεὺς Σοδομων καὶ βασιλεὺς Γομορρας καὶ ἐνέπεσαν ἐκεῖ οἱ δὲ καταλειφθέντες εἰς τὴν ὀρεινὴν ἔφυγον

text_en: And they took all the substance of the Sodomites , and Gomorrhites , and all their victuals, and went their way:
text_la: Tulerunt autem omnem substantiam Sodomorum et Gomorrhæ, et universa quæ ad cibum pertinent, et abierunt:
text_pt: E tomaram todos os bens de Sodoma, e de Gomorra, e todo o seu mantimento e foram-se.
text_el: ἔλαβον δὲ τὴν ἵππον πᾶσαν τὴν Σοδομων καὶ Γομορρας καὶ πάντα τὰ βρώματα αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπῆλθον

text_en: And Lot also, the son of Abram's brother, who dwelt in Sodom , and his substance .
text_la: necnon et Lot, et substantiam ejus, filium fratris Abram, qui habitabat in Sodomis.
text_pt: Também tomaram a Ló, que habitava em Sodoma, filho do irmão de Abrão, e os seus bens, e foram-se.
text_el: ἔλαβον δὲ καὶ τὸν Λωτ υἱὸν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ Αβραμ καὶ τὴν ἀποσκευὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπῴχοντο ἦν γὰρ κατοικῶν ἐν Σοδομοις

text_en: And behold one, that had escaped, told Abram the Hebrew , who dwelt in the vale of Mambre the Amorrhite , the brother of Escol, and the brother of Aner: for these had made a league with Abram .
text_la: Et ecce unus, qui evaserat, nuntiavit Abram Hebræo, qui habitabat in convalle Mambre Amorrhæi, fratris Escol, et fratris Aner : hi enim pepigerant fœdus cum Abram.
text_pt: Então veio um, que escapara, e o contou a Abrão, o hebreu; ele habitava junto dos carvalhais de Manre, o amorreu, irmão de Escol, e irmão de Aner; eles eram confederados de Abrão.
text_el: παραγενόμενος δὲ τῶν ἀνασωθέντων τις ἀπήγγειλεν Αβραμ τῷ περάτῃ αὐτὸς δὲ κατῴκει πρὸς τῇ δρυὶ τῇ Μαμβρη ὁ Αμορις τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ Εσχωλ καὶ ἀδελφοῦ Αυναν οἳ ἦσαν συνωμόται τοῦ Αβραμ

text_en: Which when Abram had heard, to wit, that his brother Lot was taken, he numbered of the servants born in his house, three hundred and eighteen, well appointed: and pursued them to Dan .
text_la: Quod cum audisset Abram, captum videlicet Lot fratrem suum, numeravit expeditos vernaculos suos trecentos decem et octo : et persecutus est usque Dan.
text_pt: Ouvindo, pois, Abrão que o seu irmão estava preso, armou os seus criados, nascidos em sua casa, trezentos e dezoito, e os perseguiu até Dã.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ Αβραμ ὅτι ᾐχμαλώτευται Λωτ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἠρίθμησεν τοὺς ἰδίους οἰκογενεῖς αὐτοῦ τριακοσίους δέκα καὶ ὀκτώ καὶ κατεδίωξεν ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ἕως Δαν

text_en: And dividing his company, he rushed upon them in the night, and defeated them: and pursued them as far as Hoba, which is on the left hand of Damascus .
text_la: Et divisis sociis, irruit super eos nocte : percussitque eos, et persecutus est eos usque Hoba, quæ est ad lævam Damasci.
text_pt: E dividiu-se contra eles de noite, ele e os seus criados, e os feriu, e os perseguiu até Hobá, que fica à esquerda de Damasco.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέπεσεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς τὴν νύκτα αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ παῖδες αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπάταξεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐδίωξεν αὐτοὺς ἕως Χωβα ἥ ἐστιν ἐν ἀριστερᾷ Δαμασκοῦ

text_en: And he brought back all the substance , and Lot his brother, with his substance , the women also, and the people.
text_la: Reduxitque omnem substantiam, et Lot fratrem suum cum substantia illius, mulieres quoque et populum.
text_pt: E tornou a trazer todos os seus bens, e tornou a trazer também a Ló, seu irmão, e os seus bens, e também as mulheres, e o povo.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν πᾶσαν τὴν ἵππον Σοδομων καὶ Λωτ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπέστρεψεν καὶ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὸν λαόν

text_en: And the king of Sodom went out to meet him, after he returned from the slaughter of Chodorlahomor, and of the kings that were with him in the vale of Save, which is the king's vale.
text_la: Egressus est autem rex Sodomorum in occursum ejus postquam reversus est a cæde Chodorlahomor, et regum qui cum eo erant in valle Save, quæ est vallis regis.
text_pt: E o rei de Sodoma saiu-lhe ao encontro (depois que voltou de ferir a Quedorlaomer e aos reis que estavam com ele) até ao Vale de Savé, que é o vale do rei.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ βασιλεὺς Σοδομων εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ μετὰ τὸ ἀναστρέψαι αὐτὸν ἀπὸ τῆς κοπῆς τοῦ Χοδολλογομορ καὶ τῶν βασιλέων τῶν μετ' αὐτοῦ εἰς τὴν κοιλάδα τὴν Σαυη τοῦτο ἦν τὸ πεδίον βασιλέως

text_en: But Melchisedech , the king of Salem , bringing forth bread and wine, for he was the priest of the most high God ,
text_la: At vero Melchisedech rex Salem, proferens panem et vinum, erat enim sacerdos Dei altissimi,
text_pt: E Melquisedeque, rei de Salém, trouxe pão e vinho; e era este sacerdote do Deus Altíssimo.
text_el: καὶ Μελχισεδεκ βασιλεὺς Σαλημ ἐξήνεγκεν ἄρτους καὶ οἶνον ἦν δὲ ἱερεὺς τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ὑψίστου

text_en: blessed him, and said: Blessed be Abram by the most high God , who created heaven and earth.
text_la: benedixit ei, et ait : Benedictus Abram Deo excelso, qui creavit cælum et terram:
text_pt: E abençoou-o, e disse: Bendito seja Abrão pelo Deus Altíssimo, o Possuidor dos céus e da terra;
text_el: καὶ ηὐλόγησεν τὸν Αβραμ καὶ εἶπεν εὐλογημένος Αβραμ τῷ θεῷ τῷ ὑψίστῳ ὃς ἔκτισεν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And blessed be the most high God , by whose protection, the enemies are in your hands. And he gave him the tithes of all.
text_la: et benedictus Deus excelsus, quo protegente, hostes in manibus tuis sunt. Et dedit ei decimas ex omnibus.
text_pt: E bendito seja o Deus Altíssimo, que entregou os teus inimigos nas tuas mãos. E Abrão deu-lhe o dízimo de tudo.
text_el: καὶ εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς ὁ ὕψιστος ὃς παρέδωκεν τοὺς ἐχθρούς σου ὑποχειρίους σοι καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ δεκάτην ἀπὸ πάντων

text_en: And the king of Sodom said to Abram : Give me the persons , and the rest take to yourself.
text_la: Dixit autem rex Sodomorum ad Abram : Da mihi animas, cetera tolle tibi.
text_pt: E o rei de Sodoma disse a Abrão: Dá-me a mim as pessoas, e os bens toma para ti.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ βασιλεὺς Σοδομων πρὸς Αβραμ δός μοι τοὺς ἄνδρας τὴν δὲ ἵππον λαβὲ σεαυτῷ

text_en: And he answered him: I lift up my hand to the Lord God the most high , the possessor of heaven and earth,
text_la: Qui respondit ei: Levo manum meam ad Dominum Deum excelsum possessorem cæli et terræ,
text_pt: Abrão, porém, disse ao rei de Sodoma: Levantei minha mão ao Senhor, o Deus Altíssimo, o Possuidor dos céus e da terra,
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβραμ πρὸς βασιλέα Σοδομων ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τὸν ὕψιστον ὃς ἔκτισεν τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: that from the very woofthread unto the shoe latchet, I will not take of any things that are yours, lest you say: I have enriched Abram .
text_la: quod a filo subtegminis usque ad corigiam caligæ, non accipiam ex omnibus quæ tua sunt, ne dicas : Ego ditavi Abram:
text_pt: Jurando que desde um fio até à correia de um sapato, não tomarei coisa alguma de tudo o que é teu; para que não digas: Eu enriqueci a Abrão;
text_el: εἰ ἀπὸ σπαρτίου ἕως σφαιρωτῆρος ὑποδήματος λήμψομαι ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν σῶν ἵνα μὴ εἴπῃς ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐπλούτισα τὸν Αβραμ

text_en: Except such things as the young men have eaten, and the shares of the men that came with me, Aner, Escol, and Mambre: these shall take their shares.
text_la: exceptis his, quæ comederunt juvenes, et partibus virorum, qui venerunt mecum, Aner, Escol et Mambre : isti accipient partes suas.
text_pt: Salvo tão-somente o que os jovens comeram, e a parte que toca aos homens que comigo foram, Aner, Escol e Manre; estes que tomem a sua parte.
text_el: πλὴν ὧν ἔφαγον οἱ νεανίσκοι καὶ τῆς μερίδος τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν συμπορευθέντων μετ' ἐμοῦ Εσχωλ Αυναν Μαμβρη οὗτοι λήμψονται μερίδα

text_en: Now when these things were done, the word of the Lord came to Abram by a vision , saying: Fear not, Abram , I am your protector, and your reward exceeding great.
text_la: His itaque transactis, factus est sermo Domini ad Abram per visionem dicens : Noli timere, Abram : ego protector tuus sum, et merces tua magna nimis.
text_pt: Depois destas coisas veio a palavra do SENHOR a Abrão em visão, dizendo: Não temas, Abrão, eu sou o teu escudo, o teu grandíssimo galardão.
text_el: μετὰ δὲ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἐγενήθη ῥῆμα κυρίου πρὸς Αβραμ ἐν ὁράματι λέγων μὴ φοβοῦ Αβραμ ἐγὼ ὑπερασπίζω σου ὁ μισθός σου πολὺς ἔσται σφόδρα

text_en: And Abram said: Lord God , what will you give me? I shall go without children: and the son of the steward of my house is this Damascus Eliezer.
text_la: Dixitque Abram : Domine Deus, quid dabis mihi? ego vadam absque liberis, et filius procuratoris domus meæ iste Damascus Eliezer.
text_pt: Então disse Abrão: Senhor DEUS, que me hás de dar, pois ando sem filhos, e o mordomo da minha casa é o damasceno Eliézer?
text_el: λέγει δὲ Αβραμ δέσποτα τί μοι δώσεις ἐγὼ δὲ ἀπολύομαι ἄτεκνος ὁ δὲ υἱὸς Μασεκ τῆς οἰκογενοῦς μου οὗτος Δαμασκὸς Ελιεζερ

text_en: And Abram added: But to me you have not given seed: and lo my servant born in my house, shall be my heir.
text_la: Addiditque Abram : Mihi autem non dedisti semen, et ecce vernaculus meus, hæres meus erit.
text_pt: Disse mais Abrão: Eis que não me tens dado filhos, e eis que um nascido na minha casa será o meu herdeiro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβραμ ἐπειδὴ ἐμοὶ οὐκ ἔδωκας σπέρμα ὁ δὲ οἰκογενής μου κληρονομήσει με

text_en: And immediately the word of the Lord came to him, saying: He shall not be your heir: but he that shall come out of your bowels, him shall you have for your heir.
text_la: Statimque sermo Domini factus est ad eum, dicens : Non erit hic hæres tuus, sed qui egredietur de utero tuo, ipsum habebis hæredem.
text_pt: E eis que veio a palavra do Senhor a ele dizendo: Este não será o teu herdeiro; mas aquele que de tuas entranhas sair, este será o teu herdeiro.
text_el: καὶ εὐθὺς φωνὴ κυρίου ἐγένετο πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγων οὐ κληρονομήσει σε οὗτος ἀλλ' ὃς ἐξελεύσεται ἐκ σοῦ οὗτος κληρονομήσει σε

text_en: And he brought him forth abroad, and said to him: Look up to heaven and number the stars if you can. And he said to him: So shall your seed be.
text_la: Eduxitque eum foras, et ait illi : Suspice cælum, et numera stellas, si potes. Et dixit ei : Sic erit semen tuum.
text_pt: Então o levou fora, e disse: Olha agora para os céus, e conta as estrelas, se as podes contar. E disse-lhe: Assim será a tua descendência.
text_el: ἐξήγαγεν δὲ αὐτὸν ἔξω καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἀνάβλεψον δὴ εἰς τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ ἀρίθμησον τοὺς ἀστέρας εἰ δυνήσῃ ἐξαριθμῆσαι αὐτούς καὶ εἶπεν οὕτως ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα σου

text_en: Abram believed God , and it was reputed to him unto justice .
text_la: Credidit Abram Deo, et reputatum est illi ad justitiam.
text_pt: E creu ele no Senhor, e imputou-lhe isto por justiça.
text_el: καὶ ἐπίστευσεν Αβραμ τῷ θεῷ καὶ ἐλογίσθη αὐτῷ εἰς δικαιοσύνην

text_en: And he said to him: I am the Lord who brought you out from Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land, and that you might possess it.
text_la: Dixitque ad eum : Ego Dominus qui eduxi te de Ur Chaldæorum ut darem tibi terram istam, et possideres eam.
text_pt: Disse-lhe mais: Eu sou o Senhor, que te tirei de Ur dos caldeus, para dar-te a ti esta terra, para herdá-la.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτόν ἐγὼ ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἐξαγαγών σε ἐκ χώρας Χαλδαίων ὥστε δοῦναί σοι τὴν γῆν ταύτην κληρονομῆσαι

text_en: But he said: Lord God , whereby may I know that I shall possess it?
text_la: At ille ait : Domine Deus, unde scire possum quod possessurus sim eam?
text_pt: E disse ele: Senhor DEUS, como saberei que hei de herdá-la?
text_el: εἶπεν δέ δέσποτα κύριε κατὰ τί γνώσομαι ὅτι κληρονομήσω αὐτήν

text_en: And the Lord answered, and said: Take me a cow of three years old, and a she goat of three years and a ram of three years, a turtle also, and a pigeon.
text_la: Et respondens Dominus : Sume, inquit, mihi vaccam triennem, et capram trimam, et arietem annorum trium, turturem quoque et columbam.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Toma-me uma bezerra de três anos, e uma cabra de três anos, e um carneiro de três anos, uma rola e um pombinho.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ λαβέ μοι δάμαλιν τριετίζουσαν καὶ αἶγα τριετίζουσαν καὶ κριὸν τριετίζοντα καὶ τρυγόνα καὶ περιστεράν

text_en: And he took all these, and divided them in the midst, and laid the two pieces of each one against the other: but the birds he divided not.
text_la: Qui tollens universa hæc, divisit ea per medium, et utrasque partes contra se altrinsecus posuit; aves autem non divisit.
text_pt: E trouxe-lhe todos estes, e partiu-os pelo meio, e pôs cada parte deles em frente da outra; mas as aves não partiu.
text_el: ἔλαβεν δὲ αὐτῷ πάντα ταῦτα καὶ διεῖλεν αὐτὰ μέσα καὶ ἔθηκεν αὐτὰ ἀντιπρόσωπα ἀλλήλοις τὰ δὲ ὄρνεα οὐ διεῖλεν

text_en: And the fowls came down upon the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.
text_la: Descenderuntque volucres super cadavera, et abigebat eas Abram.
text_pt: E as aves desciam sobre os cadáveres; Abrão, porém, as enxotava.
text_el: κατέβη δὲ ὄρνεα ἐπὶ τὰ σώματα τὰ διχοτομήματα αὐτῶν καὶ συνεκάθισεν αὐτοῖς Αβραμ

text_en: And when the sun was setting, a deep sleep fell upon Abram , and a great and darksome horror seized upon him.
text_la: Cumque sol occumberet, sopor irruit super Abram, et horror magnus et tenebrosus invasit eum.
text_pt: E pondo-se o sol, um profundo sono caiu sobre Abrão; e eis que grande espanto e grande escuridão caiu sobre ele.
text_el: περὶ δὲ ἡλίου δυσμὰς ἔκστασις ἐπέπεσεν τῷ Αβραμ καὶ ἰδοὺ φόβος σκοτεινὸς μέγας ἐπιπίπτει αὐτῷ

text_en: And it was said unto him: Know beforehand that your seed shall be a stranger in a land not their own , and they shall bring them under bondage , and afflict them four hundred years.
text_la: Dictumque est ad eum : Scito prænoscens quod peregrinum futurum sit semen tuum in terra non sua, et subjicient eos servituti, et affligent quadringentis annis.
text_pt: Então disse a Abrão: Saibas, de certo, que peregrina será a tua descendência em terra alheia, e será reduzida à escravidão, e será afligida por quatrocentos anos,
text_el: καὶ ἐρρέθη πρὸς Αβραμ γινώσκων γνώσῃ ὅτι πάροικον ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα σου ἐν γῇ οὐκ ἰδίᾳ καὶ δουλώσουσιν αὐτοὺς καὶ κακώσουσιν αὐτοὺς καὶ ταπεινώσουσιν αὐτοὺς τετρακόσια ἔτη

text_en: But I will judge the nation which they shall serve, and after this they shall come out with great substance .
text_la: Verumtamen gentem, cui servituri sunt, ego judicabo : et post hæc egredientur cum magna substantia.
text_pt: Mas também eu julgarei a nação, à qual ela tem de servir, e depois sairá com grande riqueza.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ἔθνος ᾧ ἐὰν δουλεύσωσιν κρινῶ ἐγώ μετὰ δὲ ταῦτα ἐξελεύσονται ὧδε μετὰ ἀποσκευῆς πολλῆς

text_en: And you shall go to your fathers in peace, and be buried in a good old age.
text_la: Tu autem ibis ad patres tuos in pace, sepultus in senectute bona.
text_pt: E tu irás a teus pais em paz; em boa velhice serás sepultado.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ἀπελεύσῃ πρὸς τοὺς πατέρας σου μετ' εἰρήνης ταφεὶς ἐν γήρει καλῷ

text_en: But in the fourth generation they shall return hither: for as yet the iniquities of the Amorrhites are not at the full until this present time.
text_la: Generatione autem quarta revertentur huc : necdum enim completæ sunt iniquitates Amorrhæorum usque ad præsens tempus.
text_pt: E a quarta geração tornará para cá; porque a medida da injustiça dos amorreus não está ainda cheia.
text_el: τετάρτη δὲ γενεὰ ἀποστραφήσονται ὧδε οὔπω γὰρ ἀναπεπλήρωνται αἱ ἁμαρτίαι τῶν Αμορραίων ἕως τοῦ νῦν

text_en: And when the sun was set, there arose a dark mist, and there appeared a smoking furnace, and a lamp of fire passing between those divisions.
text_la: Cum ergo occubuisset sol, facta est caligo tenebrosa, et apparuit clibanus fumans, et lampas ignis transiens inter divisiones illas.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, posto o sol, houve escuridão, e eis um forno de fumaça, e uma tocha de fogo, que passou por aquelas metades.
text_el: ἐπεὶ δὲ ἐγίνετο ὁ ἥλιος πρὸς δυσμαῖς φλὸξ ἐγένετο καὶ ἰδοὺ κλίβανος καπνιζόμενος καὶ λαμπάδες πυρός αἳ διῆλθον ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν διχοτομημάτων τούτων

text_en: That day God made a covenant with Abram , saying: To your seed will I give this land, from the river of Egypt even to the great river Euphrates.
text_la: In illo die pepigit Dominus fœdus cum Abram, dicens : Semini tuo dabo terram hanc a fluvio Ægypti usque ad fluvium magnum Euphraten,
text_pt: Naquele mesmo dia fez o Senhor uma aliança com Abrão, dizendo: « tua descendência tenho dado esta terra, desde o rio do Egito até ao grande rio Eufrates;
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ διέθετο κύριος τῷ Αβραμ διαθήκην λέγων τῷ σπέρματί σου δώσω τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἀπὸ τοῦ ποταμοῦ Αἰγύπτου ἕως τοῦ ποταμοῦ τοῦ μεγάλου ποταμοῦ Εὐφράτου

text_en: The Cineans , and Cenezites, the Cedmonites,
text_la: Cinæos, et Cenezæos, Cedmonæos,
text_pt: E o queneu, e o quenezeu, e o cadmoneu,
text_el: τοὺς Καιναίους καὶ τοὺς Κενεζαίους καὶ τοὺς Κεδμωναίους

text_en: and the Hethites , and the Pherezites, the Raphaim also,
text_la: et Hethæos, et Pherezæos, Raphaim quoque,
text_pt: E o heteu, e o perizeu, e os refains,
text_el: καὶ τοὺς Χετταίους καὶ τοὺς Φερεζαίους καὶ τοὺς Ραφαϊν

text_en: and the Amorrhites , and the Chanaanites , and the Gergesites, and the Jebusites.
text_la: et Amorrhæos, et Chananæos, et Gergesæos, et Jebusæos.
text_pt: E o amorreu, e o cananeu, e o girgaseu, e o jebuseu.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς Αμορραίους καὶ τοὺς Χαναναίους καὶ τοὺς Ευαίους καὶ τοὺς Γεργεσαίους καὶ τοὺς Ιεβουσαίους

text_en: Now Sarai , the wife of Abram , had brought forth no children: but having a handmaid, an Egyptian , named Agar,
text_la: Igitur Sarai, uxor Abram, non genuerat liberos : sed habens ancillam ægyptiam nomine Agar,
text_pt: Ora Sarai, mulher de Abrão, não lhe dava filhos, e ele tinha uma serva egípcia, cujo nome era Agar.
text_el: Σαρα δὲ ἡ γυνὴ Αβραμ οὐκ ἔτικτεν αὐτῷ ἦν δὲ αὐτῇ παιδίσκη Αἰγυπτία ᾗ ὄνομα Αγαρ

text_en: she said to her husband: Behold, the Lord has restrained me from bearing: go in unto my handmaid, it may be I may have children of her at least. And when he agreed to her request,
text_la: dixit marito suo : Ecce, conclusit me Dominus, ne parerem. Ingredere ad ancillam meam, si forte saltem ex illa suscipiam filios. Cumque ille acquiesceret deprecanti,
text_pt: E disse Sarai a Abrão: Eis que o Senhor me tem impedido de dar à luz; toma, pois, a minha serva; porventura terei filhos dela. E ouviu Abrão a voz de Sarai.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Σαρα πρὸς Αβραμ ἰδοὺ συνέκλεισέν με κύριος τοῦ μὴ τίκτειν εἴσελθε οὖν πρὸς τὴν παιδίσκην μου ἵνα τεκνοποιήσῃς ἐξ αὐτῆς ὑπήκουσεν δὲ Αβραμ τῆς φωνῆς Σαρας

text_en: she took Agar the Egyptian her handmaid, ten years after they first dwelt in the land of Chanaan , and gave her to her husband to wife.
text_la: tulit Agar ægyptiam ancillam suam post annos decem quam habitare cœperant in terra Chanaan: et dedit eam viro suo uxorem.
text_pt: Assim tomou Sarai, mulher de Abrão, a Agar egípcia, sua serva, e deu-a por mulher a Abrão seu marido, ao fim de dez anos que Abrão habitara na terra de Canaã.
text_el: καὶ λαβοῦσα Σαρα ἡ γυνὴ Αβραμ Αγαρ τὴν Αἰγυπτίαν τὴν ἑαυτῆς παιδίσκην μετὰ δέκα ἔτη τοῦ οἰκῆσαι Αβραμ ἐν γῇ Χανααν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν Αβραμ τῷ ἀνδρὶ αὐτῆς αὐτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: And he went in to her. But she perceiving that she was with child, despised her mistress.
text_la: Qui ingressus est ad eam. At illa concepisse se videns, despexit dominam suam.
text_pt: E ele possuiu a Agar, e ela concebeu; e vendo ela que concebera, foi sua senhora desprezada aos seus olhos.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς Αγαρ καὶ συνέλαβεν καὶ εἶδεν ὅτι ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχει καὶ ἠτιμάσθη ἡ κυρία ἐναντίον αὐτῆς

text_en: And Sarai said to Abram : You do unjustly with me: I gave my handmaid into your bosom, and she perceiving herself to be with child, despises me. The Lord judge between me and you.
text_la: Dixitque Sarai ad Abram : Inique agis contra me : ego dedi ancillam meam in sinum tuum, quæ videns quod conceperit, despectui me habet : judicet Dominus inter me et te.
text_pt: Então disse Sarai a Abrão: Meu agravo seja sobre ti; minha serva pus eu em teu regaço; vendo ela agora que concebeu, sou menosprezada aos seus olhos; o Senhor julgue entre mim e ti.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Σαρα πρὸς Αβραμ ἀδικοῦμαι ἐκ σοῦ ἐγὼ δέδωκα τὴν παιδίσκην μου εἰς τὸν κόλπον σου ἰδοῦσα δὲ ὅτι ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχει ἠτιμάσθην ἐναντίον αὐτῆς κρίναι ὁ θεὸς ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ

text_en: And Abram made answer, and said to her: Behold your handmaid is in your own hand, use her as it pleases you. And when Sarai afflicted her, she ran away.
text_la: Cui respondens Abram : Ecce, ait, ancilla tua in manu tua est, utere ea ut libet. Affligente igitur eam Sarai, fugam iniit.
text_pt: E disse Abrão a Sarai: Eis que tua serva está na tua mão; faze-lhe o que bom é aos teus olhos. E afligiu-a Sarai, e ela fugiu de sua face.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβραμ πρὸς Σαραν ἰδοὺ ἡ παιδίσκη σου ἐν ταῖς χερσίν σου χρῶ αὐτῇ ὡς ἄν σοι ἀρεστὸν ᾖ καὶ ἐκάκωσεν αὐτὴν Σαρα καὶ ἀπέδρα ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῆς

text_en: And the angel of the Lord having found her, by a fountain of water in the wilderness , which is on the way to Sur in the desert ,
text_la: Cumque invenisset eam angelus Domini juxta fontem aquæ in solitudine, qui est in via Sur in deserto,
text_pt: E o anjo do Senhor a achou junto a uma fonte de água no deserto, junto à fonte no caminho de Sur.
text_el: εὗρεν δὲ αὐτὴν ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐπὶ τῆς πηγῆς τοῦ ὕδατος ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐπὶ τῆς πηγῆς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ Σουρ

text_en: he said to her: Agar, handmaid of Sarai , whence do you come? And where are you going? And she answered: I flee from the face of Sarai , my mistress.
text_la: dixit ad illam : Agar ancilla Sarai, unde venis? et quo vadis? Quæ respondit : A facie Sarai dominæ meæ ego fugio.
text_pt: E disse: Agar, serva de Sarai, donde vens, e para onde vais? E ela disse: Venho fugida da face de Sarai minha senhora.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου Αγαρ παιδίσκη Σαρας πόθεν ἔρχῃ καὶ ποῦ πορεύῃ καὶ εἶπεν ἀπὸ προσώπου Σαρας τῆς κυρίας μου ἐγὼ ἀποδιδράσκω

text_en: And the angel of the Lord said to her: Return to your mistress, and humble yourself under her hand.
text_la: Dixitque ei angelus Domini : Revertere ad dominam tuam, et humiliare sub manu illius.
text_pt: Então lhe disse o anjo do SENHOR: Torna-te para tua senhora, e humilha-te debaixo de suas mãos.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῇ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἀποστράφητι πρὸς τὴν κυρίαν σου καὶ ταπεινώθητι ὑπὸ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῆς

text_en: And again he said: I will multiply your seed exceedingly, and it shall not be numbered for multitude.
text_la: Et rursum : Multiplicans, inquit, multiplicabo semen tuum, et non numerabitur præ multitudine.
text_pt: Disse-lhe mais o anjo do Senhor: Multiplicarei sobremaneira a tua descendência, que não será contada, por numerosa que será.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου πληθύνων πληθυνῶ τὸ σπέρμα σου καὶ οὐκ ἀριθμηθήσεται ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους

text_en: And again: Behold, said he, you are with child, and you shall bring forth a son: and you shall call his name Ismael , because the Lord has heard your affliction.
text_la: Ac deinceps : Ecce, ait, concepisti, et paries filium : vocabisque nomen ejus Ismaël, eo quod audierit Dominus afflictionem tuam.
text_pt: Disse-lhe também o anjo do Senhor: Eis que concebeste, e darás à luz um filho, e chamarás o seu nome Ismael; porquanto o Senhor ouviu a tua aflição.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ὁ ἄγγελος κυρίου ἰδοὺ σὺ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχεις καὶ τέξῃ υἱὸν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ισμαηλ ὅτι ἐπήκουσεν κύριος τῇ ταπεινώσει σου

text_en: He shall be a wild man : his hand will be against all men , and all men's hands against him: and he shall pitch his tents over against all his brethren.
text_la: Hic erit ferus homo : manus ejus contra omnes, et manus omnium contra eum : et e regione universorum fratrum suorum figet tabernacula.
text_pt: E ele será homem feroz, e a sua mão será contra todos, e a mão de todos contra ele; e habitará diante da face de todos os seus irmãos.
text_el: οὗτος ἔσται ἄγροικος ἄνθρωπος αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάντας καὶ αἱ χεῖρες πάντων ἐπ' αὐτόν καὶ κατὰ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ κατοικήσει

text_en: And she called the name of the Lord that spoke unto her: You the God who has seen me. For she said: Verily, here have I seen the hinder parts of him that sees me.
text_la: Vocavit autem nomen Domini qui loquebatur ad eam : Tu Deus qui vidisti me. Dixit enim : Profecto hic vidi posteriora videntis me.
text_pt: E ela chamou o nome do Senhor, que com ela falava: Tu és Deus que me vê; porque disse: Não olhei eu também para aquele que me vê?
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Αγαρ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου τοῦ λαλοῦντος πρὸς αὐτήν σὺ ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἐπιδών με ὅτι εἶπεν καὶ γὰρ ἐνώπιον εἶδον ὀφθέντα μοι

text_en: Therefore she called that well , the well of him that lives and sees me. The same is between Cades and Barad.
text_la: Propterea appellavit puteum illum Puteum viventis et videntis me. Ipse est inter Cades et Barad.
text_pt: Por isso se chama aquele poço de Beer-Laai-Rói; eis que está entre Cades e Berede.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τούτου ἐκάλεσεν τὸ φρέαρ Φρέαρ οὗ ἐνώπιον εἶδον ἰδοὺ ἀνὰ μέσον Καδης καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Βαραδ

text_en: And Agar brought forth a son to Abram : who called his name Ismael .
text_la: Peperitque Agar Abræ filium : qui vocavit nomen ejus Ismaël.
text_pt: E Agar deu à luz um filho a Abrão; e Abrão chamou o nome do seu filho que Agar tivera, Ismael.
text_el: καὶ ἔτεκεν Αγαρ τῷ Αβραμ υἱόν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Αβραμ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ ὃν ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ Αγαρ Ισμαηλ

text_en: Abram was four score and six years old when Agar brought him forth Ismael .
text_la: Octoginta et sex annorum erat Abram quando peperit ei Agar Ismaëlem.
text_pt: E era Abrão da idade de oitenta e seis anos, quando Agar deu à luz Ismael.
text_el: Αβραμ δὲ ἦν ὀγδοήκοντα ἓξ ἐτῶν ἡνίκα ἔτεκεν Αγαρ τὸν Ισμαηλ τῷ Αβραμ

text_en: And after he began to be ninety and nine years old, the Lord appeared to him: and said unto him: I am the Almighty God : walk before me, and be perfect .
text_la: Postquam vero nonaginta et novem annorum esse cœperat, apparuit ei Dominus, dixitque ad eum : Ego Deus omnipotens : ambula coram me, et esto perfectus.
text_pt: Sendo, pois, Abrão da idade de noventa e nove anos, apareceu o SENHOR a Abrão, e disse-lhe: Eu sou o Deus Todo-Poderoso, anda em minha presença e sê perfeito.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ Αβραμ ἐτῶν ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα καὶ ὤφθη κύριος τῷ Αβραμ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεός σου εὐαρέστει ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ καὶ γίνου ἄμεμπτος

text_en: And I will make my covenant between me and you: and I will multiply you exceedingly.
text_la: Ponamque fœdus meum inter me et te, et multiplicabo te vehementer nimis.
text_pt: E porei a minha aliança entre mim e ti, e te multiplicarei grandissimamente.
text_el: καὶ θήσομαι τὴν διαθήκην μου ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον σοῦ καὶ πληθυνῶ σε σφόδρα

text_en: Abram fell flat on his face.
text_la: Cecidit Abram pronus in faciem.
text_pt: Então caiu Abrão sobre o seu rosto, e falou Deus com ele, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσεν Αβραμ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς λέγων

text_en: And God said to him: I am, and my covenant is with you, and you shall be a father of many nations.
text_la: Dixitque ei Deus : Ego sum, et pactum meum tecum, erisque pater multarum gentium.
text_pt: Quanto a mim, eis a minha aliança contigo: serás o pai de muitas nações;
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ ἰδοὺ ἡ διαθήκη μου μετὰ σοῦ καὶ ἔσῃ πατὴρ πλήθους ἐθνῶν

text_en: Neither shall your name be called any more Abram : but you shall be called Abraham : because I have made you a father of many nations.
text_la: Nec ultra vocabitur nomen tuum Abram, sed appellaberis Abraham : quia patrem multarum gentium constitui te.
text_pt: E não se chamará mais o teu nome Abrão, mas Abraão será o teu nome; porque por pai de muitas nações te tenho posto;
text_el: καὶ οὐ κληθήσεται ἔτι τὸ ὄνομά σου Αβραμ ἀλλ' ἔσται τὸ ὄνομά σου Αβρααμ ὅτι πατέρα πολλῶν ἐθνῶν τέθεικά σε

text_en: And I will make you increase exceedingly, and I will make nations of you, and kings shall come out of you.
text_la: Faciamque te crescere vehementissime, et ponam te in gentibus, regesque ex te egredientur.
text_pt: E te farei frutificar grandissimamente, e de ti farei nações, e reis sairão de ti;
text_el: καὶ αὐξανῶ σε σφόδρα σφόδρα καὶ θήσω σε εἰς ἔθνη καὶ βασιλεῖς ἐκ σοῦ ἐξελεύσονται

text_en: And I will establish my covenant between me and you, and between your seed after you in their generations , by a perpetual covenant: to be a God to you, and to your seed after you.
text_la: Et statuam pactum meum inter me et te, et inter semen tuum post te in generationibus suis, fœdere sempiterno : ut sim Deus tuus, et seminis tui post te.
text_pt: E estabelecerei a minha aliança entre mim e ti e a tua descendência depois de ti em suas gerações, por aliança perpétua, para te ser a ti por Deus, e à tua descendência depois de ti.
text_el: καὶ στήσω τὴν διαθήκην μου ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον σοῦ καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σπέρματός σου μετὰ σὲ εἰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν εἰς διαθήκην αἰώνιον εἶναί σου θεὸς καὶ τοῦ σπέρματός σου μετὰ σέ

text_en: And I will give to you, and to your seed, the land of your sojournment, all the land of Chanaan , for a perpetual possession , and I will be their God .
text_la: Daboque tibi et semini tuo terram peregrinationis tuæ, omnem terram Chanaan in possessionem æternam, eroque Deus eorum.
text_pt: E te darei a ti e à tua descendência depois de ti, a terra de tuas peregrinações, toda a terra de Canaã em perpétua possessão e ser-lhes-ei o seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ δώσω σοι καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου μετὰ σὲ τὴν γῆν ἣν παροικεῖς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν Χανααν εἰς κατάσχεσιν αἰώνιον καὶ ἔσομαι αὐτοῖς θεός

text_en: Again God said to Abraham : And you therefore shall keep my covenant, and your seed after you in their generations .
text_la: Dixit iterum Deus ad Abraham : Et tu ergo custodies pactum meum, et semen tuum post te in generationibus suis.
text_pt: Disse mais Deus a Abraão: Tu, porém, guardarás a minha aliança, tu, e a tua descendência depois de ti, nas suas gerações.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Αβρααμ σὺ δὲ τὴν διαθήκην μου διατηρήσεις σὺ καὶ τὸ σπέρμα σου μετὰ σὲ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν

text_en: This is my covenant which you shall observe between me and you, and your seed after you: All the male kind of you shall be circumcised .
text_la: Hoc est pactum meum quod observabitis inter me et vos, et semen tuum post te : circumcidetur ex vobis omne masculinum:
text_pt: Esta é a minha aliança, que guardareis entre mim e vós, e a tua descendência depois de ti: Que todo o homem entre vós será circuncidado.
text_el: καὶ αὕτη ἡ διαθήκη ἣν διατηρήσεις ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ὑμῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον τοῦ σπέρματός σου μετὰ σὲ εἰς τὰς γενεὰς αὐτῶν περιτμηθήσεται ὑμῶν πᾶν ἀρσενικόν

text_en: And you shall circumcise the flesh of your foreskin, that it may be for a sign of the covenant between me and you.
text_la: et circumcidetis carnem præputii vestri, ut sit in signum fœderis inter me et vos.
text_pt: E circuncidareis a carne do vosso prepúcio; e isto será por sinal da aliança entre mim e vós.
text_el: καὶ περιτμηθήσεσθε τὴν σάρκα τῆς ἀκροβυστίας ὑμῶν καὶ ἔσται ἐν σημείῳ διαθήκης ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ ὑμῶν

text_en: An infant of eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every manchild in your generations : he that is born in the house, as well as the bought servant, shall be circumcised , and whosoever is not of your stock:
text_la: Infans octo dierum circumcidetur in vobis, omne masculinum in generationibus vestris : tam vernaculus, quam emptitius circumcidetur, et quicumque non fuerit de stirpe vestra:
text_pt: O filho de oito dias, pois, será circuncidado, todo o homem nas vossas gerações; o nascido na casa, e o comprado por dinheiro a qualquer estrangeiro, que não for da tua descendência.
text_el: καὶ παιδίον ὀκτὼ ἡμερῶν περιτμηθήσεται ὑμῖν πᾶν ἀρσενικὸν εἰς τὰς γενεὰς ὑμῶν ὁ οἰκογενὴς τῆς οἰκίας σου καὶ ὁ ἀργυρώνητος ἀπὸ παντὸς υἱοῦ ἀλλοτρίου ὃς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκ τοῦ σπέρματός σου

text_en: And my covenant shall be in your flesh for a perpetual covenant.
text_la: eritque pactum meum in carne vestra in fœdus æternum.
text_pt: Com efeito será circuncidado o nascido em tua casa, e o comprado por teu dinheiro; e estará a minha aliança na vossa carne por aliança perpétua.
text_el: περιτομῇ περιτμηθήσεται ὁ οἰκογενὴς τῆς οἰκίας σου καὶ ὁ ἀργυρώνητος καὶ ἔσται ἡ διαθήκη μου ἐπὶ τῆς σαρκὸς ὑμῶν εἰς διαθήκην αἰώνιον

text_en: The male whose flesh of his foreskin shall not be circumcised , that soul shall be destroyed out of his people: because he has broken my covenant.
text_la: Masculus, cujus præputii caro circumcisa non fuerit, delebitur anima illa de populo suo : quia pactum meum irritum fecit.
text_pt: E o homem incircunciso, cuja carne do prepúcio não estiver circuncidada, aquela alma será extirpada do seu povo; quebrou a minha aliança.
text_el: καὶ ἀπερίτμητος ἄρσην ὃς οὐ περιτμηθήσεται τὴν σάρκα τῆς ἀκροβυστίας αὐτοῦ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἐξολεθρευθήσεται ἡ ψυχὴ ἐκείνη ἐκ τοῦ γένους αὐτῆς ὅτι τὴν διαθήκην μου διεσκέδασεν

text_en: God said also to Abraham : Sarai your wife you shall not call Sarai , but Sara .
text_la: Dixit quoque Deus ad Abraham : Sarai uxorem tuam non vocabis Sarai, sed Saram.
text_pt: Disse Deus mais a Abraão: A Sarai tua mulher não chamarás mais pelo nome de Sarai, mas Sara será o seu nome.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αβρααμ Σαρα ἡ γυνή σου οὐ κληθήσεται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Σαρα ἀλλὰ Σαρρα ἔσται τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς

text_en: And I will bless her, and of her I will give you a son, whom I will bless , and he shall become nations, and kings of people shall spring from him.
text_la: Et benedicam ei, et ex illa dabo tibi filium cui benedicturus sum : eritque in nationes, et reges populorum orientur ex eo.
text_pt: Porque eu a hei de abençoar, e te darei dela um filho; e a abençoarei, e será mãe das nações; reis de povos sairão dela.
text_el: εὐλογήσω δὲ αὐτὴν καὶ δώσω σοι ἐξ αὐτῆς τέκνον καὶ εὐλογήσω αὐτόν καὶ ἔσται εἰς ἔθνη καὶ βασιλεῖς ἐθνῶν ἐξ αὐτοῦ ἔσονται

text_en: Abraham fell upon his face, and laughed, saying in his heart: Shall a son, do you think, be born to him that is a hundred years old? And shall Sara that is ninety years old bring forth?
text_la: Cecidit Abraham in faciem suam, et risit, dicens in corde suo : Putasne centenario nascetur filius? et Sara nonagenaria pariet?
text_pt: Então caiu Abraão sobre o seu rosto, e riu-se, e disse no seu coração: A um homem de cem anos há de nascer um filho? E dará à luz Sara da idade de noventa anos?
text_el: καὶ ἔπεσεν Αβρααμ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον καὶ ἐγέλασεν καὶ εἶπεν ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ αὐτοῦ λέγων εἰ τῷ ἑκατονταετεῖ γενήσεται καὶ εἰ Σαρρα ἐνενήκοντα ἐτῶν οὖσα τέξεται

text_en: And he said to God : O that Ismael may live before you.
text_la: Dixitque ad Deum : Utinam Ismaël vivat coram te.
text_pt: E disse Abraão a Deus: Quem dera que viva Ismael diante de teu rosto!
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβρααμ πρὸς τὸν θεόν Ισμαηλ οὗτος ζήτω ἐναντίον σου

text_en: And God said to Abraham : Sara your wife shall bear you a son, and you shall call his name Isaac , and I will establish my covenant with him for a perpetual covenant, and with his seed after him.
text_la: Et ait Deus ad Abraham : Sara uxor tua pariet tibi filium, vocabisque nomen ejus Isaac, et constituam pactum meum illi in fœdus sempiternum, et semini ejus post eum.
text_pt: E disse Deus: Na verdade, Sara, tua mulher, te dará um filho, e chamarás o seu nome Isaque, e com ele estabelecerei a minha aliança, por aliança perpétua para a sua descendência depois dele.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αβρααμ ναί ἰδοὺ Σαρρα ἡ γυνή σου τέξεταί σοι υἱόν καὶ καλέσεις τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ισαακ καὶ στήσω τὴν διαθήκην μου πρὸς αὐτὸν εἰς διαθήκην αἰώνιον καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτόν

text_en: And as for Ismael I have also heard you. Behold, I will bless him, and increase, and multiply him exceedingly: he shall beget twelve chiefs, and I will make him a great nation.
text_la: Super Ismaël quoque exaudivi te : ecce, benedicam ei, et augebo, et multiplicabo eum valde : duodecim duces generabit, et faciam illum in gentem magnam.
text_pt: E quanto a Ismael, também te tenho ouvido; eis aqui o tenho abençoado, e fá-lo-ei frutificar, e fá-lo-ei multiplicar grandissimamente; doze príncipes gerará, e dele farei uma grande nação.
text_el: περὶ δὲ Ισμαηλ ἰδοὺ ἐπήκουσά σου ἰδοὺ εὐλόγησα αὐτὸν καὶ αὐξανῶ αὐτὸν καὶ πληθυνῶ αὐτὸν σφόδρα δώδεκα ἔθνη γεννήσει καὶ δώσω αὐτὸν εἰς ἔθνος μέγα

text_en: But my covenant I will establish with Isaac , whom Sara shall bring forth to you at this time in the next year.
text_la: Pactum vero meum statuam ad Isaac, quem pariet tibi Sara tempore isto in anno altero.
text_pt: A minha aliança, porém, estabelecerei com Isaque, o qual Sara dará à luz neste tempo determinado, no ano seguinte.
text_el: τὴν δὲ διαθήκην μου στήσω πρὸς Ισαακ ὃν τέξεταί σοι Σαρρα εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τοῦτον ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ τῷ ἑτέρῳ

text_en: And when he had left off speaking with him, God went up from Abraham .
text_la: Cumque finitus esset sermo loquentis cum eo, ascendit Deus ab Abraham.
text_pt: Ao acabar de falar com Abraão, subiu Deus de diante dele.
text_el: συνετέλεσεν δὲ λαλῶν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ ἀνέβη ὁ θεὸς ἀπὸ Αβρααμ

text_en: And Abraham took Ismael his son, and all that were born in his house: and all whom he had bought, every male among the men of his house: and he circumcised the flesh of their foreskin forthwith the very same day, as God had commanded him.
text_la: Tulit autem Abraham Ismaël filium suum, et omnes vernaculos domus suæ, universosque quos emerat, cunctos mares ex omnibus viris domus suæ : et circumcidit carnem præputii eorum statim in ipsa die, sicut præceperat ei Deus.
text_pt: Então tomou Abraão a seu filho Ismael, e a todos os nascidos na sua casa, e a todos os comprados por seu dinheiro, todo o homem entre os da casa de Abraão; e circuncidou a carne do seu prepúcio, naquele mesmo dia, como Deus falara com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Αβρααμ Ισμαηλ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντας τοὺς οἰκογενεῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀργυρωνήτους καὶ πᾶν ἄρσεν τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ Αβρααμ καὶ περιέτεμεν τὰς ἀκροβυστίας αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης καθὰ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός

text_en: Abraham was ninety and nine years old, when he circumcised the flesh of his foreskin.
text_la: Abraham nonaginta et novem erat annorum quando circumcidit carnem præputii sui.
text_pt: E era Abraão da idade de noventa e nove anos, quando lhe foi circuncidada a carne do seu prepúcio.
text_el: Αβρααμ δὲ ἦν ἐνενήκοντα ἐννέα ἐτῶν ἡνίκα περιέτεμεν τὴν σάρκα τῆς ἀκροβυστίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Ismael his son was full thirteen years old at the time of his circumcision .
text_la: Et Ismaël filius tredecim annos impleverat tempore circumcisionis suæ.
text_pt: E Ismael, seu filho, era da idade de treze anos, quando lhe foi circuncidada a carne do seu prepúcio.
text_el: Ισμαηλ δὲ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἐτῶν δέκα τριῶν ἦν ἡνίκα περιετμήθη τὴν σάρκα τῆς ἀκροβυστίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: The selfsame day was Abraham circumcised and Ismael his son.
text_la: Eadem die circumcisus est Abraham et Ismaël filius ejus:
text_pt: Naquele mesmo dia foram circuncidados Abraão e Ismael seu filho,
text_el: ἐν τῷ καιρῷ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης περιετμήθη Αβρααμ καὶ Ισμαηλ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And all the men of his house, as well they that were born in his house, as the bought servants and strangers, were circumcised with him.
text_la: et omnes viri domus illius, tam vernaculi, quam emptitii et alienigenæ pariter circumcisi sunt.
text_pt: E todos os homens da sua casa, os nascidos em casa, e os comprados por dinheiro ao estrangeiro, foram circuncidados com ele.
text_el: καὶ πάντες οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ οἰκογενεῖς καὶ οἱ ἀργυρώνητοι ἐξ ἀλλογενῶν ἐθνῶν περιέτεμεν αὐτούς

text_en: And the Lord appeared to him in the vale of Mambre as he was sitting at the door of his tent, in the very heat of the day.
text_la: Apparuit autem ei Dominus in convalle Mambre sedenti in ostio tabernaculi sui in ipso fervore diei.
text_pt: Depois apareceu-lhe o Senhor nos carvalhais de Manre, estando ele assentado à porta da tenda, no calor do dia
text_el: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς πρὸς τῇ δρυὶ τῇ Μαμβρη καθημένου αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ μεσημβρίας

text_en: And when he had lifted up his eyes, there appeared to him three men standing near to him: and as soon as he saw them, he ran to meet them from the door of his tent, and adored down to the ground.
text_la: Cumque elevasset oculos, apparuerunt ei tres viri stantes prope eum : quos cum vidisset, cucurrit in occursum eorum de ostio tabernaculi, et adoravit in terram.
text_pt: E levantou os seus olhos, e olhou, e eis três homens em pé junto a ele. E vendo-os, correu da porta da tenda ao seu encontro e inclinou-se à terra,
text_el: ἀναβλέψας δὲ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ εἶδεν καὶ ἰδοὺ τρεῖς ἄνδρες εἱστήκεισαν ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ καὶ ἰδὼν προσέδραμεν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῖς ἀπὸ τῆς θύρας τῆς σκηνῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκύνησεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And he said: Lord , if I have found favour in your sight, pass not away from your servant.
text_la: Et dixit : Domine, si inveni gratiam in oculis tuis, ne transeas servum tuum:
text_pt: E disse: Meu Senhor, se agora tenho achado graça aos teus olhos, rogo-te que não passes de teu servo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριε εἰ ἄρα εὗρον χάριν ἐναντίον σου μὴ παρέλθῃς τὸν παῖδά σου

text_en: But I will fetch a little water, and you wash your feet and rest under the tree.
text_la: sed afferam pauxillum aquæ, et lavate pedes vestros, et requiescite sub arbore.
text_pt: Que se traga já um pouco de água, e lavai os vossos pés, e recostai-vos debaixo desta árvore;
text_el: λημφθήτω δὴ ὕδωρ καὶ νιψάτωσαν τοὺς πόδας ὑμῶν καὶ καταψύξατε ὑπὸ τὸ δένδρον

text_en: And I will set a morsel of bread, and you strengthen your heart, afterwards you shall pass on: for therefore are you come aside to your servant. And they said: Do as you have spoken.
text_la: Ponamque buccellam panis, et confortate cor vestrum : postea transibitis : idcirco enim declinastis ad servum vestrum. Qui dixerunt : Fac ut locutus es.
text_pt: E trarei um bocado de pão, para que esforceis o vosso coração; depois passareis adiante, porquanto por isso chegastes até vosso servo. E disseram: Assim faze como disseste.
text_el: καὶ λήμψομαι ἄρτον καὶ φάγεσθε καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο παρελεύσεσθε εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν ὑμῶν οὗ εἵνεκεν ἐξεκλίνατε πρὸς τὸν παῖδα ὑμῶν καὶ εἶπαν οὕτως ποίησον καθὼς εἴρηκας

text_en: Abraham made haste into the tent to Sara , and said to her: Make haste, temper together three measures of flour, and make cakes upon the hearth.
text_la: Festinavit Abraham in tabernaculum ad Saram, dixitque ei : Accelera, tria sata similæ commisce, et fac subcinericios panes.
text_pt: E Abraão apressou-se em ir ter com Sara à tenda, e disse-lhe: Amassa depressa três medidas de flor de farinha, e faze bolos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσπευσεν Αβρααμ ἐπὶ τὴν σκηνὴν πρὸς Σαρραν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ σπεῦσον καὶ φύρασον τρία μέτρα σεμιδάλεως καὶ ποίησον ἐγκρυφίας

text_en: And he himself ran to the herd, and took from thence a calf, very tender and very good , and gave it to a young man, who made haste and boiled it.
text_la: Ipse vero ad armentum cucurrit, et tulit inde vitulum tenerrimum et optimum, deditque puero : qui festinavit et coxit illum.
text_pt: E correu Abraão às vacas, e tomou uma vitela tenra e boa, e deu-a ao moço, que se apressou em prepará-la.
text_el: καὶ εἰς τὰς βόας ἔδραμεν Αβρααμ καὶ ἔλαβεν μοσχάριον ἁπαλὸν καὶ καλὸν καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ παιδί καὶ ἐτάχυνεν τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτό

text_en: He took also butter and milk, and the calf which he had boiled, and set before them: but he stood by them under the tree.
text_la: Tulit quoque butyrum et lac, et vitulum quem coxerat, et posuit coram eis : ipse vero stabat juxta eos sub arbore.
text_pt: E tomou manteiga e leite, e a vitela que tinha preparado, e pôs tudo diante deles, e ele estava em pé junto a eles debaixo da árvore; e comeram.
text_el: ἔλαβεν δὲ βούτυρον καὶ γάλα καὶ τὸ μοσχάριον ὃ ἐποίησεν καὶ παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐφάγοσαν αὐτὸς δὲ παρειστήκει αὐτοῖς ὑπὸ τὸ δένδρον

text_en: And when they had eaten, they said to him: Where is Sara your wife? He answered: Lo she is in the tent.
text_la: Cumque comedissent, dixerunt ad eum : Ubi est Sara uxor tua? Ille respondit : Ecce in tabernaculo est.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Onde está Sara, tua mulher? E ele disse: Ei-la aí na tenda.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτόν ποῦ Σαρρα ἡ γυνή σου ὁ δὲ ἀποκριθεὶς εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἐν τῇ σκηνῇ

text_en: And he said to him: I will return and come to you at this time, life accompanying, and Sara , your wife, shall have a son. Which when Sara heard, she laughed behind the door of the tent.
text_la: Cui dixit : Revertens veniam ad te tempore isto, vita comite, et habebit filium Sara uxor tua. Quo audito, Sara risit post ostium tabernaculi.
text_pt: E disse: Certamente tornarei a ti por este tempo da vida; e eis que Sara tua mulher terá um filho. E Sara escutava à porta da tenda, que estava atrás dele.
text_el: εἶπεν δέ ἐπαναστρέφων ἥξω πρὸς σὲ κατὰ τὸν καιρὸν τοῦτον εἰς ὥρας καὶ ἕξει υἱὸν Σαρρα ἡ γυνή σου Σαρρα δὲ ἤκουσεν πρὸς τῇ θύρᾳ τῆς σκηνῆς οὖσα ὄπισθεν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now they were both old, and far advanced in years, and it had ceased to be with Sara after the manner of women .
text_la: Erant autem ambo senes, provectæque ætatis, et desierant Saræ fieri muliebria.
text_pt: E eram Abraão e Sara já velhos, e adiantados em idade; já a Sara havia cessado o costume das mulheres.
text_el: Αβρααμ δὲ καὶ Σαρρα πρεσβύτεροι προβεβηκότες ἡμερῶν ἐξέλιπεν δὲ Σαρρα γίνεσθαι τὰ γυναικεῖα

text_en: And she laughed secretly, saying: After I am grown old, and my lord is an old man , shall I give myself to pleasure?
text_la: Quæ risit occulte dicens : Postquam consenui, et dominus meus vetulus est, voluptati operam dabo?
text_pt: Assim, pois, riu-se Sara consigo, dizendo: Terei ainda deleite depois de haver envelhecido, sendo também o meu senhor já velho?
text_el: ἐγέλασεν δὲ Σαρρα ἐν ἑαυτῇ λέγουσα οὔπω μέν μοι γέγονεν ἕως τοῦ νῦν ὁ δὲ κύριός μου πρεσβύτερος

text_en: And the Lord said to Abraham : Why did Sara laugh, saying: Shall I, who am an old woman , bear a child indeed?
text_la: Dixit autem Dominus ad Abraham : Quare risit Sara, dicens : Num vere paritura sum anus?
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Abraão: Por que se riu Sara, dizendo: Na verdade darei eu à luz ainda, havendo já envelhecido?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος πρὸς Αβρααμ τί ὅτι ἐγέλασεν Σαρρα ἐν ἑαυτῇ λέγουσα ἆρά γε ἀληθῶς τέξομαι ἐγὼ δὲ γεγήρακα

text_en: Is there anything hard to God ? According to appointment I will return to you at this same time, life accompanying, and Sara shall have a son.
text_la: Numquid Deo quidquam est difficile? juxta condictum revertar ad te hoc eodem tempore, vita comite, et habebit Sara filium.
text_pt: Haveria coisa alguma difícil ao Senhor? Ao tempo determinado tornarei a ti por este tempo da vida, e Sara terá um filho.
text_el: μὴ ἀδυνατεῖ παρὰ τῷ θεῷ ῥῆμα εἰς τὸν καιρὸν τοῦτον ἀναστρέψω πρὸς σὲ εἰς ὥρας καὶ ἔσται τῇ Σαρρα υἱός

text_en: Sara denied, saying: I did not laugh: for she was afraid . But the Lord said: Nay; but you did laugh.
text_la: Negavit Sara, dicens : Non risi, timore perterrita. Dominus autem : Non est, inquit, ita : sed risisti.
text_pt: E Sara negou, dizendo: Não me ri; porquanto temeu. E ele disse: Não digas isso, porque te riste.
text_el: ἠρνήσατο δὲ Σαρρα λέγουσα οὐκ ἐγέλασα ἐφοβήθη γάρ καὶ εἶπεν οὐχί ἀλλὰ ἐγέλασας

text_en: And when the men rose up from thence, they turned their eyes towards Sodom : and Abraham walked with them, bringing them on the way.
text_la: Cum ergo surrexissent inde viri, direxerunt oculos contra Sodomam : et Abraham simul gradiebatur, deducens eos.
text_pt: E levantaram-se aqueles homens dali, e olharam para o lado de Sodoma; e Abraão ia com eles, acompanhando-os.
text_el: ἐξαναστάντες δὲ ἐκεῖθεν οἱ ἄνδρες κατέβλεψαν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον Σοδομων καὶ Γομορρας Αβρααμ δὲ συνεπορεύετο μετ' αὐτῶν συμπροπέμπων αὐτούς

text_en: And the Lord said: Can I hide from Abraham what I am about to do:
text_la: Dixitque Dominus : Num celare potero Abraham quæ gesturus sum:
text_pt: E disse o Senhor: Ocultarei eu a Abraão o que faço,
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος εἶπεν μὴ κρύψω ἐγὼ ἀπὸ Αβρααμ τοῦ παιδός μου ἃ ἐγὼ ποιῶ

text_en: Seeing he shall become a great and mighty nation, and in him all the nations of the earth shall be blessed ?
text_la: cum futurus sit in gentem magnam, ac robustissimam, et benedicendæ sint in illo omnes nationes terræ?
text_pt: Visto que Abraão certamente virá a ser uma grande e poderosa nação, e nele serão benditas todas as nações da terra?
text_el: Αβρααμ δὲ γινόμενος ἔσται εἰς ἔθνος μέγα καὶ πολύ καὶ ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν αὐτῷ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς

text_en: For I know that he will command his children, and his household after him, to keep the way of the Lord , and do judgment and justice : that for Abraham's sake, the Lord may bring to effect all the things he has spoken unto him.
text_la: Scio enim quod præcepturus sit filiis suis, et domui suæ post se ut custodiant viam Domini, et faciant judicium et justitiam : ut adducat Dominus propter Abraham omnia quæ locutus est ad eum.
text_pt: Porque eu o tenho conhecido, e sei que ele há de ordenar a seus filhos e à sua casa depois dele, para que guardem o caminho do Senhor, para agir com justiça e juízo; para que o Senhor faça vir sobre Abraão o que acerca dele tem falado.
text_el: ᾔδειν γὰρ ὅτι συντάξει τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτόν καὶ φυλάξουσιν τὰς ὁδοὺς κυρίου ποιεῖν δικαιοσύνην καὶ κρίσιν ὅπως ἂν ἐπαγάγῃ κύριος ἐπὶ Αβρααμ πάντα ὅσα ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: And the Lord said: The cry of Sodom and Gomorrha is multiplied, and their sin has become exceedingly grievous.
text_la: Dixit itaque Dominus : Clamor Sodomorum et Gomorrhæ multiplicatus est, et peccatum eorum aggravatum est nimis.
text_pt: Disse mais o Senhor: Porquanto o clamor de Sodoma e Gomorra se tem multiplicado, e porquanto o seu pecado se tem agravado muito,
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος κραυγὴ Σοδομων καὶ Γομορρας πεπλήθυνται καὶ αἱ ἁμαρτίαι αὐτῶν μεγάλαι σφόδρα

text_en: I will go down and see whether they have done according to the cry that has come to me; or whether it be not so, that I may know .
text_la: Descendam, et videbo utrum clamorem qui venit ad me, opere compleverint; an non est ita, ut sciam.
text_pt: Descerei agora, e verei se com efeito têm praticado segundo o seu clamor, que é vindo até mim; e se não, sabê-lo-ei.
text_el: καταβὰς οὖν ὄψομαι εἰ κατὰ τὴν κραυγὴν αὐτῶν τὴν ἐρχομένην πρός με συντελοῦνται εἰ δὲ μή ἵνα γνῶ

text_en: And they turned themselves from thence, and went their way to Sodom : but Abraham as yet stood before the Lord .
text_la: Converteruntque se inde, et abierunt Sodomam : Abraham vero adhuc stabat coram Domino.
text_pt: Então viraram aqueles homens os rostos dali, e foram-se para Sodoma; mas Abraão ficou ainda em pé diante da face do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψαντες ἐκεῖθεν οἱ ἄνδρες ἦλθον εἰς Σοδομα Αβρααμ δὲ ἦν ἑστηκὼς ἐναντίον κυρίου

text_en: And drawing near, he said: Will you destroy the just with the wicked?
text_la: Et appropinquans ait: Numquid perdes justum cum impio?
text_pt: E chegou-se Abraão, dizendo: Destruirás também o justo com o ímpio?
text_el: καὶ ἐγγίσας Αβρααμ εἶπεν μὴ συναπολέσῃς δίκαιον μετὰ ἀσεβοῦς καὶ ἔσται ὁ δίκαιος ὡς ὁ ἀσεβής

text_en: If there be fifty just men in the city, shall they perish withal? And will you not spare that place for the sake of the fifty just , if they be therein?
text_la: si fuerint quinquaginta justi in civitate, peribunt simul? et non parces loco illi propter quinquaginta justos, si fuerint in eo?
text_pt: Se porventura houver cinqüenta justos na cidade, destruirás também, e não pouparás o lugar por causa dos cinqüenta justos que estão dentro dela?
text_el: ἐὰν ὦσιν πεντήκοντα δίκαιοι ἐν τῇ πόλει ἀπολεῖς αὐτούς οὐκ ἀνήσεις πάντα τὸν τόπον ἕνεκεν τῶν πεντήκοντα δικαίων ἐὰν ὦσιν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: Far be it from you to do this thing, and to slay the just with the wicked, and for the just to be in like case as the wicked; this is not beseeming you: you who judge all the earth, will not make this judgment .
text_la: Absit a te ut rem hanc facias, et occidas justum cum impio, fiatque justus sicut impius, non est hoc tuum : qui judicas omnem terram, nequaquam facies judicium hoc.
text_pt: Longe de ti que faças tal coisa, que mates o justo com o ímpio; que o justo seja como o ímpio, longe de ti. Não faria justiça o Juiz de toda a terra?
text_el: μηδαμῶς σὺ ποιήσεις ὡς τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι δίκαιον μετὰ ἀσεβοῦς καὶ ἔσται ὁ δίκαιος ὡς ὁ ἀσεβής μηδαμῶς ὁ κρίνων πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν οὐ ποιήσεις κρίσιν

text_en: And the Lord said to him: If I find in Sodom fifty just within the city, I will spare the whole place for their sake.
text_la: Dixitque Dominus ad eum : Si invenero Sodomis quinquaginta justos in medio civitatis, dimittam omni loco propter eos.
text_pt: Então disse o Senhor: Se eu em Sodoma achar cinqüenta justos dentro da cidade, pouparei a todo o lugar por amor deles.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος ἐὰν εὕρω ἐν Σοδομοις πεντήκοντα δικαίους ἐν τῇ πόλει ἀφήσω πάντα τὸν τόπον δι' αὐτούς

text_en: And Abraham answered, and said: Seeing I have once begun, I will speak to my Lord , whereas I am dust and ashes.
text_la: Respondensque Abraham, ait : Quia semel cœpi, loquar ad Dominum meum, cum sim pulvis et cinis.
text_pt: E respondeu Abraão dizendo: Eis que agora me atrevi a falar ao Senhor, ainda que sou pó e cinza.
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεὶς Αβρααμ εἶπεν νῦν ἠρξάμην λαλῆσαι πρὸς τὸν κύριον ἐγὼ δέ εἰμι γῆ καὶ σποδός

text_en: What if there be five less than fifty just persons ? Will you for five and forty destroy the whole city: And he said: I will not destroy it, if I find five and forty.
text_la: Quid si minus quinquaginta justis quinque fuerint? delebis, propter quadraginta quinque, universam urbem? Et ait : Non delebo, si invenero ibi quadraginta quinque.
text_pt: Se porventura de cinqüenta justos faltarem cinco, destruirás por aqueles cinco toda a cidade? E disse: Não a destruirei, se eu achar ali quarenta e cinco.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ ἐλαττονωθῶσιν οἱ πεντήκοντα δίκαιοι πέντε ἀπολεῖς ἕνεκεν τῶν πέντε πᾶσαν τὴν πόλιν καὶ εἶπεν οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσω ἐὰν εὕρω ἐκεῖ τεσσαράκοντα πέντε

text_en: And again he said to him: But if forty be found there, what will you do? He said: I will not destroy it for the sake of forty.
text_la: Rursumque locutus est ad eum : Sin autem quadraginta ibi inventi fuerint, quid facies? Ait : Non percutiam propter quadraginta.
text_pt: E continuou ainda a falar-lhe, e disse: Se porventura se acharem ali quarenta? E disse: Não o farei por amor dos quarenta.
text_el: καὶ προσέθηκεν ἔτι λαλῆσαι πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν ἐὰν δὲ εὑρεθῶσιν ἐκεῖ τεσσαράκοντα καὶ εἶπεν οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσω ἕνεκεν τῶν τεσσαράκοντα

text_en: Lord , says he, be not angry , I beseech you, if I speak: What if thirty shall be found there? He answered: I will not do it, if I find thirty there.
text_la: Ne quæso, inquit, indigneris, Domine, si loquar : quid si ibi inventi fuerint triginta? Respondit : Non faciam, si invenero ibi triginta.
text_pt: Disse mais: Ora, não se ire o Senhor, se eu ainda falar: Se porventura se acharem ali trinta? E disse: Não o farei se achar ali trinta.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν μή τι κύριε ἐὰν λαλήσω ἐὰν δὲ εὑρεθῶσιν ἐκεῖ τριάκοντα καὶ εἶπεν οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσω ἐὰν εὕρω ἐκεῖ τριάκοντα

text_en: Seeing, says he, I have once begun, I will speak to my Lord : What if twenty be found there? He said: I will not destroy it for the sake of twenty.
text_la: Quia semel, ait, cœpi loquar ad Dominum meum : quid si ibi inventi fuerint viginti? Ait : Non interficiam propter viginti.
text_pt: E disse: Eis que agora me atrevi a falar ao Senhor: Se porventura se acharem ali vinte? E disse: Não a destruirei por amor dos vinte.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐπειδὴ ἔχω λαλῆσαι πρὸς τὸν κύριον ἐὰν δὲ εὑρεθῶσιν ἐκεῖ εἴκοσι καὶ εἶπεν οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσω ἕνεκεν τῶν εἴκοσι

text_en: I beseech you, says he, be not angry , Lord , if I speak yet once more: What if ten shall be found there? And he said: I will not destroy it for the sake of ten.
text_la: Obsecro, inquit, ne irascaris, Domine, si loquar adhuc semel : quid si inventi fuerint ibi decem? Et dixit : Non delebo propter decem.
text_pt: Disse mais: Ora, não se ire o Senhor, que ainda só mais esta vez falo: Se porventura se acharem ali dez? E disse: Não a destruirei por amor dos dez.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν μή τι κύριε ἐὰν λαλήσω ἔτι ἅπαξ ἐὰν δὲ εὑρεθῶσιν ἐκεῖ δέκα καὶ εἶπεν οὐ μὴ ἀπολέσω ἕνεκεν τῶν δέκα

text_en: And the Lord departed, after he had left speaking to Abraham : and Abraham returned to his place.
text_la: Abiitque Dominus, postquam cessavit loqui ad Abraham : et ille reversus est in locum suum.
text_pt: E retirou-se o Senhor, quando acabou de falar a Abraão; e Abraão tornou-se ao seu lugar.
text_el: ἀπῆλθεν δὲ κύριος ὡς ἐπαύσατο λαλῶν τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ Αβρααμ ἀπέστρεψεν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the two angels came to Sodom in the evening, and Lot was sitting in the gate of the city. And seeing them, he rose up and went to meet them: and worshipped prostrate to the ground.
text_la: Veneruntque duo angeli Sodomam vespere, et sedente Lot in foribus civitatis. Qui cum vidisset eos, surrexit, et ivit obviam eis : adoravitque pronus in terram,
text_pt: E vieram os dois anjos a Sodoma à tarde, e estava Ló assentado à porta de Sodoma; e vendo-os Ló, levantou-se ao seu encontro e inclinou-se com o rosto à terra;
text_el: ἦλθον δὲ οἱ δύο ἄγγελοι εἰς Σοδομα ἑσπέρας Λωτ δὲ ἐκάθητο παρὰ τὴν πύλην Σοδομων ἰδὼν δὲ Λωτ ἐξανέστη εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτοῖς καὶ προσεκύνησεν τῷ προσώπῳ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And said: I beseech you, my lords, turn in to the house of your servant, and lodge there: wash your feet , and in the morning you shall go on your way. And they said: No, but we will abide in the street.
text_la: et dixit : Obsecro, domini, declinate in domum pueri vestri, et manete ibi : lavate pedes vestros, et mane proficiscemini in viam vestram. Qui dixerunt : Minime, sed in platea manebimus.
text_pt: E disse: Eis agora, meus senhores, entrai, peço-vos, em casa de vosso servo, e passai nela a noite, e lavai os vossos pés; e de madrugada vos levantareis e ireis vosso caminho. E eles disseram: Não, antes na rua passaremos a noite.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἰδού κύριοι ἐκκλίνατε εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ παιδὸς ὑμῶν καὶ καταλύσατε καὶ νίψασθε τοὺς πόδας ὑμῶν καὶ ὀρθρίσαντες ἀπελεύσεσθε εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν ὑμῶν εἶπαν δέ οὐχί ἀλλ' ἐν τῇ πλατείᾳ καταλύσομεν

text_en: He pressed them very much to turn in unto him: and when they had come into his house, he made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread , and they ate:
text_la: Compulit illos oppido ut diverterent ad eum : ingressisque domum illius fecit convivium, et coxit azyma, et comederunt.
text_pt: E porfiou com eles muito, e vieram com ele, e entraram em sua casa; e fez-lhes banquete, e cozeu bolos sem levedura, e comeram.
text_el: καὶ κατεβιάζετο αὐτούς καὶ ἐξέκλιναν πρὸς αὐτὸν καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτοῖς πότον καὶ ἀζύμους ἔπεψεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔφαγον

text_en: But before they went to bed, the men of the city beset the house, both young and old, all the people together.
text_la: Prius autem quam irent cubitum, viri civitatis vallaverunt domum a puero usque ad senem, omnis populus simul.
text_pt: E antes que se deitassem, cercaram a casa, os homens daquela cidade, os homens de Sodoma, desde o moço até ao velho; todo o povo de todos os bairros.
text_el: πρὸ τοῦ κοιμηθῆναι καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως οἱ Σοδομῖται περιεκύκλωσαν τὴν οἰκίαν ἀπὸ νεανίσκου ἕως πρεσβυτέρου ἅπας ὁ λαὸς ἅμα

text_en: And they called Lot , and said to him: Where are the men that came in to you at night? Bring them out hither, that we may know them:
text_la: Vocaveruntque Lot, et dixerunt ei : Ubi sunt viri qui introierunt ad te nocte? educ illos huc, ut cognoscamus eos.
text_pt: E chamaram a Ló, e disseram-lhe: Onde estão os homens que a ti vieram nesta noite? Traze-os fora a nós, para que os conheçamos.
text_el: καὶ ἐξεκαλοῦντο τὸν Λωτ καὶ ἔλεγον πρὸς αὐτόν ποῦ εἰσιν οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ εἰσελθόντες πρὸς σὲ τὴν νύκτα ἐξάγαγε αὐτοὺς πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἵνα συγγενώμεθα αὐτοῖς

text_en: Lot went out to them, and shut the door after him, and said:
text_la: Egressus ad eos Lot, post tergum occludens ostium, ait:
text_pt: Então saiu Ló a eles à porta, e fechou a porta atrás de si,
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Λωτ πρὸς αὐτοὺς πρὸς τὸ πρόθυρον τὴν δὲ θύραν προσέῳξεν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ

text_en: Do not so, I beseech you, my brethren, do not commit this evil .
text_la: Nolite, quæso, fratres mei, nolite malum hoc facere.
text_pt: E disse: Meus irmãos, rogo-vos que não façais mal;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς μηδαμῶς ἀδελφοί μὴ πονηρεύσησθε

text_en: I have two daughters who, as yet, have not known man ; I will bring them out to you, and abuse you them as it shall please you, so that you do no evil to these men, because they have come in under the shadow of my roof.
text_la: Habeo duas filias, quæ necdum cognoverunt virum : educam eas ad vos, et abutimini eis sicut vobis placuerit, dummodo viris istis nihil mali faciatis, quia ingressi sunt sub umbra culminis mei.
text_pt: Eis aqui, duas filhas tenho, que ainda não conheceram homens; fora vo-las trarei, e fareis delas como bom for aos vossos olhos; somente nada façais a estes homens, porque por isso vieram à sombra do meu telhado.
text_el: εἰσὶν δέ μοι δύο θυγατέρες αἳ οὐκ ἔγνωσαν ἄνδρα ἐξάξω αὐτὰς πρὸς ὑμᾶς καὶ χρήσασθε αὐταῖς καθὰ ἂν ἀρέσκῃ ὑμῖν μόνον εἰς τοὺς ἄνδρας τούτους μὴ ποιήσητε μηδὲν ἄδικον οὗ εἵνεκεν εἰσῆλθον ὑπὸ τὴν σκέπην τῶν δοκῶν μου

text_en: But they said: Get you back thither. And again: You came in, said they, as a stranger, was it to be a judge? Therefore we will afflict you more than them. And they pressed very violently upon Lot : and they were even at the point of breaking open the doors.
text_la: At illi dixerunt : Recede illuc. Et rursus : Ingressus es, inquiunt, ut advena; numquid ut judices? te ergo ipsum magis quam hos affligemus. Vimque faciebant Lot vehementissime : jamque prope erat ut effringerent fores.
text_pt: Eles, porém, disseram: Sai daí. Disseram mais: Como estrangeiro este indivíduo veio aqui habitar, e quereria ser juiz em tudo? Agora te faremos mais mal a ti do que a eles. E arremessaram-se sobre o homem, sobre Ló, e aproximaram-se para arrombar a porta.
text_el: εἶπαν δέ ἀπόστα ἐκεῖ εἷς ἦλθες παροικεῖν μὴ καὶ κρίσιν κρίνειν νῦν οὖν σὲ κακώσομεν μᾶλλον ἢ ἐκείνους καὶ παρεβιάζοντο τὸν ἄνδρα τὸν Λωτ σφόδρα καὶ ἤγγισαν συντρῖψαι τὴν θύραν

text_en: And behold the men put out their hand, and drew in Lot unto them, and shut the door.
text_la: Et ecce miserunt manum viri, et introduxerunt ad se Lot, clauseruntque ostium:
text_pt: Aqueles homens porém estenderam as suas mãos e fizeram entrar a Ló consigo na casa, e fecharam a porta;
text_el: ἐκτείναντες δὲ οἱ ἄνδρες τὰς χεῖρας εἰσεσπάσαντο τὸν Λωτ πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς εἰς τὸν οἶκον καὶ τὴν θύραν τοῦ οἴκου ἀπέκλεισαν

text_en: And them, that were without, they struck with blindness from the least to the greatest, so that they could not find the door.
text_la: et eos, qui foris erant, percusserunt cæcitate a minimo usque ad maximum, ita ut ostium invenire non possent.
text_pt: E feriram de cegueira os homens que estavam à porta da casa, desde o menor até ao maior, de maneira que se cansaram para achar a porta.
text_el: τοὺς δὲ ἄνδρας τοὺς ὄντας ἐπὶ τῆς θύρας τοῦ οἴκου ἐπάταξαν ἀορασίᾳ ἀπὸ μικροῦ ἕως μεγάλου καὶ παρελύθησαν ζητοῦντες τὴν θύραν

text_en: And they said to Lot : Have you here any of yours? Son in law, or sons, or daughters, all that are yours bring them out of this city:
text_la: Dixerunt autem ad Lot : Habes hic quempiam tuorum? generum, aut filios, aut filias, omnes, qui tui sunt, educ de urbe hac:
text_pt: Então disseram aqueles homens a Ló: Tens alguém mais aqui? Teu genro, e teus filhos, e tuas filhas, e todos quantos tens nesta cidade, tira-os fora deste lugar;
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ οἱ ἄνδρες πρὸς Λωτ ἔστιν τίς σοι ὧδε γαμβροὶ ἢ υἱοὶ ἢ θυγατέρες ἢ εἴ τίς σοι ἄλλος ἔστιν ἐν τῇ πόλει ἐξάγαγε ἐκ τοῦ τόπου τούτου

text_en: For we will destroy this place, because their cry is grown loud before the Lord , who has sent us to destroy them.
text_la: delebimus enim locum istum, eo quod increverit clamor eorum coram Domino, qui misit nos ut perdamus illos.
text_pt: Porque nós vamos destruir este lugar, porque o seu clamor tem aumentado diante da face do Senhor, e o Senhor nos enviou a destruí-lo.
text_el: ὅτι ἀπόλλυμεν ἡμεῖς τὸν τόπον τοῦτον ὅτι ὑψώθη ἡ κραυγὴ αὐτῶν ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ἀπέστειλεν ἡμᾶς κύριος ἐκτρῖψαι αὐτήν

text_en: So Lot went out, and spoke to his sons in law that were to have his daughters, and said: Arise: get you out of this place, because the Lord will destroy this city. And he seemed to them to speak as it were in jest.
text_la: Egressus itaque Lot, locutus est ad generos suos qui accepturi erant filias ejus, et dixit : Surgite, egredimini de loco isto : quia delebit Dominus civitatem hanc. Et visus est eis quasi ludens loqui.
text_pt: Então saiu Ló, e falou a seus genros, aos que haviam de tomar as suas filhas, e disse: Levantai-vos, saí deste lugar, porque o Senhor há de destruir a cidade. Foi tido porém por zombador aos olhos de seus genros.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Λωτ καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς τοὺς γαμβροὺς αὐτοῦ τοὺς εἰληφότας τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἀνάστητε καὶ ἐξέλθατε ἐκ τοῦ τόπου τούτου ὅτι ἐκτρίβει κύριος τὴν πόλιν ἔδοξεν δὲ γελοιάζειν ἐναντίον τῶν γαμβρῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when it was morning, the angels pressed him, saying: Arise, take your wife, and the two daughters that you have: lest you also perish in the wickedness of the city.
text_la: Cumque esset mane, cogebant eum angeli, dicentes : Surge, tolle uxorem tuam, et duas filias quas habes : ne et tu pariter pereas in scelere civitatis.
text_pt: E ao amanhecer os anjos apertaram com Ló, dizendo: Levanta-te, toma tua mulher e tuas duas filhas que aqui estão, para que não pereças na injustiça desta cidade.
text_el: ἡνίκα δὲ ὄρθρος ἐγίνετο ἐπεσπούδαζον οἱ ἄγγελοι τὸν Λωτ λέγοντες ἀναστὰς λαβὲ τὴν γυναῖκά σου καὶ τὰς δύο θυγατέρας σου ἃς ἔχεις καὶ ἔξελθε ἵνα μὴ συναπόλῃ ταῖς ἀνομίαις τῆς πόλεως

text_en: And as he lingered, they took his hand, and the hand of his wife, and of his two daughters, because the Lord spared him.
text_la: Dissimulante illo, apprehenderunt manum ejus, et manum uxoris, ac duarum filiarum ejus, eo quod parceret Dominus illi.
text_pt: Ele, porém, demorava-se, e aqueles homens lhe pegaram pela mão, e pela mão de sua mulher e de suas duas filhas, sendo-lhe o Senhor misericordioso, e tiraram-no, e puseram-no fora da cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἐταράχθησαν καὶ ἐκράτησαν οἱ ἄγγελοι τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῆς χειρὸς τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τῶν χειρῶν τῶν δύο θυγατέρων αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ φείσασθαι κύριον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they brought him forth, and set him without the city: and there they spoke to him, saying: Save your life: look not back, neither stay in all the country about: but save your self in the mountain, lest you be also consumed.
text_la: Eduxeruntque eum, et posuerunt extra civitatem : ibique locuti sunt ad eum, dicentes : Salva animam tuam : noli respicere post tergum, nec stes in omni circa regione : sed in monte salvum te fac, ne et tu simul pereas.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, tirando-os fora, disse: Escapa-te por tua vida; não olhes para trás de ti, e não pares em toda esta campina; escapa lá para o monte, para que não pereças.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἐξήγαγον αὐτοὺς ἔξω καὶ εἶπαν σῴζων σῷζε τὴν σεαυτοῦ ψυχήν μὴ περιβλέψῃς εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω μηδὲ στῇς ἐν πάσῃ τῇ περιχώρῳ εἰς τὸ ὄρος σῴζου μήποτε συμπαραλημφθῇς

text_en: And Lot said to them: I beseech you, my Lord ,
text_la: Dixitque Lot ad eos : Quæso, domine mi,
text_pt: E Ló disse-lhe: Ora, não, meu Senhor!
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Λωτ πρὸς αὐτούς δέομαι κύριε

text_en: because your servant has found grace before you, and you have magnified your mercy, which you have shown to me, in saving my life, and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil seize me, and I die.
text_la: quia invenit servus tuus gratiam coram te, et magnificasti misericordiam tuam quam fecisti mecum, ut salvares animam meam, nec possum in monte salvari, ne forte apprehendat me malum, et moriar:
text_pt: Eis que agora o teu servo tem achado graça aos teus olhos, e engrandeceste a tua misericórdia que a mim me fizeste, para guardar a minha alma em vida; mas eu não posso escapar no monte, para que porventura não me apanhe este mal, e eu morra.
text_el: ἐπειδὴ εὗρεν ὁ παῖς σου ἔλεος ἐναντίον σου καὶ ἐμεγάλυνας τὴν δικαιοσύνην σου ὃ ποιεῖς ἐπ' ἐμέ τοῦ ζῆν τὴν ψυχήν μου ἐγὼ δὲ οὐ δυνήσομαι διασωθῆναι εἰς τὸ ὄρος μὴ καταλάβῃ με τὰ κακὰ καὶ ἀποθάνω

text_en: There is this city here at hand, to which I may flee, it is a little one, and I shall be saved in it: is it not a little one, and my soul shall live?
text_la: est civitas hæc juxta, ad quam possum fugere, parva, et salvabor in ea : numquid non modica est, et vivet anima mea?
text_pt: Eis que agora aquela cidade está perto, para fugir para lá, e é pequena; ora, deixe-me escapar para lá (não é pequena? ), para que minha alma viva.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡ πόλις αὕτη ἐγγὺς τοῦ καταφυγεῖν με ἐκεῖ ἥ ἐστιν μικρά ἐκεῖ σωθήσομαι οὐ μικρά ἐστιν καὶ ζήσεται ἡ ψυχή μου

text_en: And he said to him: Behold also in this, I have heard your prayers , not to destroy the city for which you have spoken.
text_la: Dixitque ad eum : Ecce etiam in hoc suscepi preces tuas, ut non subvertam urbem pro qua locutus es.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Eis aqui, tenho-te aceitado também neste negócio, para não destruir aquela cidade, de que falaste;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἰδοὺ ἐθαύμασά σου τὸ πρόσωπον καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ ῥήματι τούτῳ τοῦ μὴ καταστρέψαι τὴν πόλιν περὶ ἧς ἐλάλησας

text_en: Make haste, and be saved there: because I cannot do anything till you go in thither. Therefore the name of that city was called Segor .
text_la: Festina, et salvare ibi : quia non potero facere quidquam donec ingrediaris illuc. Idcirco vocatum est nomen urbis illius Segor.
text_pt: Apressa-te, escapa-te para ali; porque nada poderei fazer, enquanto não tiveres ali chegado. Por isso se chamou o nome da cidade Zoar.
text_el: σπεῦσον οὖν τοῦ σωθῆναι ἐκεῖ οὐ γὰρ δυνήσομαι ποιῆσαι πρᾶγμα ἕως τοῦ σε εἰσελθεῖν ἐκεῖ διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα τῆς πόλεως ἐκείνης Σηγωρ

text_en: The sun was risen upon the earth, and Lot entered into Segor .
text_la: Sol egressus est super terram, et Lot ingressus est Segor.
text_pt: Saiu o sol sobre a terra, quando Ló entrou em Zoar.
text_el: ὁ ἥλιος ἐξῆλθεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ Λωτ εἰσῆλθεν εἰς Σηγωρ

text_en: And the Lord rained upon Sodom and Gomorrha brimstone and fire from the Lord out of heaven .
text_la: Igitur Dominus pluit super Sodomam et Gomorrham sulphur et ignem a Domino de cælo:
text_pt: Então o Senhor fez chover enxofre e fogo, do Senhor desde os céus, sobre Sodoma e Gomorra;
text_el: καὶ κύριος ἔβρεξεν ἐπὶ Σοδομα καὶ Γομορρα θεῖον καὶ πῦρ παρὰ κυρίου ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: And he destroyed these cities, and all the country about, all the inhabitants of the cities, and all things that spring from the earth.
text_la: et subvertit civitates has, et omnem circa regionem, universos habitatores urbium, et cuncta terræ virentia.
text_pt: E destruiu aquelas cidades e toda aquela campina, e todos os moradores daquelas cidades, e o que nascia da terra.
text_el: καὶ κατέστρεψεν τὰς πόλεις ταύτας καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν περίοικον καὶ πάντας τοὺς κατοικοῦντας ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν καὶ πάντα τὰ ἀνατέλλοντα ἐκ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And his wife looking behind her, was turned into a statue of salt .
text_la: Respiciensque uxor ejus post se, versa est in statuam salis.
text_pt: E a mulher de Ló olhou para trás e ficou convertida numa estátua de sal.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω καὶ ἐγένετο στήλη ἁλός

text_en: And Abraham got up early in the morning, and in the place where he had stood before with the Lord :
text_la: Abraham autem consurgens mane, ubi steterat prius cum Domino,
text_pt: E Abraão levantou-se aquela mesma manhã, de madrugada, e foi para aquele lugar onde estivera diante da face do Senhor;
text_el: ὤρθρισεν δὲ Αβρααμ τὸ πρωὶ εἰς τὸν τόπον οὗ εἱστήκει ἐναντίον κυρίου

text_en: He looked towards Sodom and Gomorrha , and the whole land of that country: and he saw the ashes rise up from the earth as the smoke of a furnace.
text_la: intuitus est Sodomam et Gomorrham, et universam terram regionis illius : viditque ascendentem favillam de terra quasi fornacis fumum.
text_pt: E olhou para Sodoma e Gomorra e para toda a terra da campina; e viu, que a fumaça da terra subia, como a de uma fornalha.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέβλεψεν ἐπὶ πρόσωπον Σοδομων καὶ Γομορρας καὶ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς τῆς περιχώρου καὶ εἶδεν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἀνέβαινεν φλὸξ τῆς γῆς ὡσεὶ ἀτμὶς καμίνου

text_en: Now when God destroyed the cities of that country, remembering Abraham , he delivered Lot out of the destruction of the cities wherein he had dwelt.
text_la: Cum enim subverteret Deus civitates regionis illius, recordatus Abrahæ, liberavit Lot de subversione urbium in quibus habitaverat.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, destruindo Deus as cidades da campina, lembrou-se Deus de Abraão, e tirou a Ló do meio da destruição, derrubando aquelas cidades em que Ló habitara.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἐκτρῖψαι κύριον πάσας τὰς πόλεις τῆς περιοίκου ἐμνήσθη ὁ θεὸς τοῦ Αβρααμ καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν τὸν Λωτ ἐκ μέσου τῆς καταστροφῆς ἐν τῷ καταστρέψαι κύριον τὰς πόλεις ἐν αἷς κατῴκει ἐν αὐταῖς Λωτ

text_en: And Lot went up out of Segor , and abode in the mountain, and his two daughters with him (for he was afraid to stay in Segor ) and he dwelt in a cave, he and his two daughters with him.
text_la: Ascenditque Lot de Segor, et mansit in monte, duæ quoque filiæ ejus cum eo (timuerat enim manere in Segor) et mansit in spelunca ipse, et duæ filiæ ejus cum eo.
