text_pt: E subiu Ló de Zoar, e habitou no monte, e as suas duas filhas com ele; porque temia habitar em Zoar; e habitou numa caverna, ele e as suas duas filhas.
text_el: ἀνέβη δὲ Λωτ ἐκ Σηγωρ καὶ ἐκάθητο ἐν τῷ ὄρει καὶ αἱ δύο θυγατέρες αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐφοβήθη γὰρ κατοικῆσαι ἐν Σηγωρ καὶ ᾤκησεν ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ αὐτὸς καὶ αἱ δύο θυγατέρες αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the elder said to the younger: Our father is old, and there is no man left on the earth, to come in unto us after the manner of the whole earth.
text_la: Dixitque major ad minorem : Pater noster senex est, et nullus virorum remansit in terra, qui possit ingredi ad nos juxta morem universæ terræ.
text_pt: Então a primogênita disse à menor: Nosso pai já é velho, e não há homem na terra que entre a nós, segundo o costume de toda a terra;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ἡ πρεσβυτέρα πρὸς τὴν νεωτέραν ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν πρεσβύτερος καὶ οὐδείς ἐστιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὃς εἰσελεύσεται πρὸς ἡμᾶς ὡς καθήκει πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: Come, let us make him drunk with wine , and let us lie with him , that we may preserve seed of our father.
text_la: Veni, inebriemus eum vino, dormiamusque cum eo, ut servare possimus ex patre nostro semen.
text_pt: Vem, demos de beber vinho a nosso pai, e deitemo-nos com ele, para que em vida conservemos a descendência de nosso pai.
text_el: δεῦρο καὶ ποτίσωμεν τὸν πατέρα ἡμῶν οἶνον καὶ κοιμηθῶμεν μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξαναστήσωμεν ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν σπέρμα

text_en: And they made their father drink wine that night: and the elder went in, and lay with her father : but he perceived not, neither when his daughter lay down, nor when she rose up.
text_la: Dederunt itaque patri suo bibere vinum nocte illa. Et ingressa est major, dormivitque cum patre; at ille non sensit, nec quando accubuit filia, nec quando surrexit.
text_pt: E deram de beber vinho a seu pai naquela noite; e veio a primogênita e deitou-se com seu pai, e não sentiu ele quando ela se deitou, nem quando se levantou.
text_el: ἐπότισαν δὲ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν οἶνον ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ταύτῃ καὶ εἰσελθοῦσα ἡ πρεσβυτέρα ἐκοιμήθη μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει ἐν τῷ κοιμηθῆναι αὐτὴν καὶ ἀναστῆναι

text_en: And the next day the elder said to the younger: Behold I lay last night with my father, let us make him drink wine also to night, and you shall lie with him , that we may save seed of our father.
text_la: Altera quoque die dixit major ad minorem : Ecce dormivi heri cum patre meo, demus ei bibere vinum etiam hac nocte, et dormies cum eo, ut salvemus semen de patre nostro.
text_pt: E sucedeu, no outro dia, que a primogênita disse à menor: Vês aqui, eu já ontem à noite me deitei com meu pai; demos-lhe de beber vinho também esta noite, e então entra tu, deita-te com ele, para que em vida conservemos a descendência de nosso pai.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ τῇ ἐπαύριον καὶ εἶπεν ἡ πρεσβυτέρα πρὸς τὴν νεωτέραν ἰδοὺ ἐκοιμήθην ἐχθὲς μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ποτίσωμεν αὐτὸν οἶνον καὶ τὴν νύκτα ταύτην καὶ εἰσελθοῦσα κοιμήθητι μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξαναστήσωμεν ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν σπέρμα

text_en: They made their father drink wine that night also, and the younger daughter went in, and lay with him : and neither then did he perceive when she lay down, nor when she rose up.
text_la: Dederunt etiam et illa nocte patri suo bibere vinum, ingressaque minor filia, dormivit cum eo : et ne tunc quidem sensit quando concubuerit, vel quando illa surrexerit.
text_pt: E deram de beber vinho a seu pai também naquela noite; e levantou-se a menor, e deitou-se com ele; e não sentiu ele quando ela se deitou, nem quando se levantou.
text_el: ἐπότισαν δὲ καὶ ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν οἶνον καὶ εἰσελθοῦσα ἡ νεωτέρα ἐκοιμήθη μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει ἐν τῷ κοιμηθῆναι αὐτὴν καὶ ἀναστῆναι

text_en: So the two daughters of Lot were with child by their father.
text_la: Conceperunt ergo duæ filiæ Lot de patre suo.
text_pt: E conceberam as duas filhas de Ló de seu pai.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβον αἱ δύο θυγατέρες Λωτ ἐκ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: And the elder bore a son, and she called his name Moab: he is the father of the Moabites unto this day.
text_la: Peperitque major filium, et vocavit nomen ejus Moab : ipse est pater Moabitarum usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: E a primogênita deu à luz um filho, e chamou-lhe Moabe; este é o pai dos moabitas até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἔτεκεν ἡ πρεσβυτέρα υἱὸν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Μωαβ λέγουσα ἐκ τοῦ πατρός μου οὗτος πατὴρ Μωαβιτῶν ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: The younger also bore a son, and she called his name Ammon; that is, the son of my people: he is the father of the Ammonites unto this day.
text_la: Minor quoque peperit filium, et vocavit nomen ejus Ammon, id est, Filius populi mei : ipse est pater Ammonitarum usque hodie.
text_pt: E a menor também deu à luz um filho, e chamou-lhe Ben-Ami; este é o pai dos filhos de Amom até o dia de hoje.
text_el: ἔτεκεν δὲ καὶ ἡ νεωτέρα υἱὸν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Αμμαν υἱὸς τοῦ γένους μου οὗτος πατὴρ Αμμανιτῶν ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: Abraham removed from thence to the south country, and dwelt between Cades and Sur, and sojourned in Gerara.
text_la: Profectus inde Abraham in terram australem, habitavit inter Cades et Sur : et peregrinatus est in Geraris.
text_pt: E partiu Abraão dali para a terra do sul, e habitou entre Cades e Sur; e peregrinou em Gerar.
text_el: καὶ ἐκίνησεν ἐκεῖθεν Αβρααμ εἰς γῆν πρὸς λίβα καὶ ᾤκησεν ἀνὰ μέσον Καδης καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Σουρ καὶ παρῴκησεν ἐν Γεραροις

text_en: And he said of Sara his wife: She is my sister. So Abimelech the king of Gerara sent, and took her.
text_la: Dixitque de Sara uxore suo : Soror mea est. Misit ergo Abimelech rex Geraræ, et tulit eam.
text_pt: E havendo Abraão dito de Sara, sua mulher: É minha irmã; enviou Abimeleque, rei de Gerar, e tomou a Sara.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβρααμ περὶ Σαρρας τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἀδελφή μού ἐστιν ἐφοβήθη γὰρ εἰπεῖν ὅτι γυνή μού ἐστιν μήποτε ἀποκτείνωσιν αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς πόλεως δι' αὐτήν ἀπέστειλεν δὲ Αβιμελεχ βασιλεὺς Γεραρων καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν Σαρραν

text_en: And God came to Abimelech in a dream by night, and he said to him: Lo you shall die for the woman that you have taken: for she has a husband.
text_la: Venit autem Deus ad Abimelech per somnium nocte, et ait illi : En morieris propter mulierem quam tulisti : habet enim virum.
text_pt: Deus, porém, veio a Abimeleque em sonhos de noite, e disse-lhe: Eis que morto serás por causa da mulher que tomaste; porque ela tem marido.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Αβιμελεχ ἐν ὕπνῳ τὴν νύκτα καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ σὺ ἀποθνῄσκεις περὶ τῆς γυναικός ἧς ἔλαβες αὕτη δέ ἐστιν συνῳκηκυῖα ἀνδρί

text_en: Now Abimelech had not touched her, and he said: Lord , will you slay a nation that is ignorant and just ?
text_la: Abimelech vero non tetigerat eam, et ait : Domine, num gentem ignorantem et justam interficies?
text_pt: Mas Abimeleque ainda não se tinha chegado a ela; por isso disse: Senhor, matarás também uma nação justa?
text_el: Αβιμελεχ δὲ οὐχ ἥψατο αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν κύριε ἔθνος ἀγνοοῦν καὶ δίκαιον ἀπολεῖς

text_en: Did not he say to me: She is my sister: and she say, He is my brother? In the simplicity of my heart, and cleanness of my hands have I done this.
text_la: nonne ipse dixit mihi : Soror mea est : et ipsa ait : Frater meus est? In simplicitate cordis mei, et munditia manuum mearum feci hoc.
text_pt: Não me disse ele mesmo: É minha irmã? E ela também disse: É meu irmão. Em sinceridade do coração e em pureza das minhas mãos tenho feito isto.
text_el: οὐκ αὐτός μοι εἶπεν ἀδελφή μού ἐστιν καὶ αὐτή μοι εἶπεν ἀδελφός μού ἐστιν ἐν καθαρᾷ καρδίᾳ καὶ ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ χειρῶν ἐποίησα τοῦτο

text_en: And God said to him: And I know that you did it with a sincere heart: and therefore I withheld you from sinning against me, and I allowed you not to touch her.
text_la: Dixitque ad eum Deus : Et ego scio quod simplici corde feceris : et ideo custodivi te ne peccares in me, et non dimisi ut tangeres eam.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Deus em sonhos: Bem sei eu que na sinceridade do teu coração fizeste isto; e também eu te tenho impedido de pecar contra mim; por isso não te permiti tocá-la.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς καθ' ὕπνον κἀγὼ ἔγνων ὅτι ἐν καθαρᾷ καρδίᾳ ἐποίησας τοῦτο καὶ ἐφεισάμην ἐγώ σου τοῦ μὴ ἁμαρτεῖν σε εἰς ἐμέ ἕνεκεν τούτου οὐκ ἀφῆκά σε ἅψασθαι αὐτῆς

text_en: Now therefore restore the man his wife, for he is a prophet : and he shall pray for you, and you shall live: but if you will not restore her, know that you shall surely die, you and all that are yours.
text_la: Nunc ergo redde viro suo uxorem, quia propheta est : et orabit pro te, et vives : si autem nolueris reddere, scito quod morte morieris tu, et omnia quæ tua sunt.
text_pt: Agora, pois, restitui a mulher ao seu marido, porque profeta é, e rogará por ti, para que vivas; porém se não lha restituíres, sabe que certamente morrerás, tu e tudo o que é teu.
text_el: νῦν δὲ ἀπόδος τὴν γυναῖκα τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ὅτι προφήτης ἐστὶν καὶ προσεύξεται περὶ σοῦ καὶ ζήσῃ εἰ δὲ μὴ ἀποδίδως γνῶθι ὅτι ἀποθανῇ σὺ καὶ πάντα τὰ σά

text_en: And Abimelech forthwith rising up in the night, called all his servants: and spoke all these words in their hearing, and all the men were exceedingly afraid .
text_la: Statimque de nocte consurgens Abimelech, vocavit omnes servos suos : et locutus est universa verba hæc in auribus eorum, timueruntque omnes viri valde.
text_pt: E levantou-se Abimeleque pela manhã de madrugada, chamou a todos os seus servos, e falou todas estas palavras em seus ouvidos; e temeram muito aqueles homens.
text_el: καὶ ὤρθρισεν Αβιμελεχ τὸ πρωὶ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν πάντας τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλάλησεν πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα εἰς τὰ ὦτα αὐτῶν ἐφοβήθησαν δὲ πάντες οἱ ἄνθρωποι σφόδρα

text_en: And Abimelech called also for Abraham , and said to him: What have you done to us? What have we offended you in, that you have brought upon me and upon my kingdom a great sin ? You have done to us what you ought not to do.
text_la: Vocavit autem Abimelech etiam Abraham, et dixit ei : Quid fecisti nobis? quid peccavimus in te, quia induxisti super me et super regnum meum peccatum grande? quæ non debuisti facere, fecisti nobis.
text_pt: Então chamou Abimeleque a Abraão e disse-lhe: Que nos fizeste? E em que pequei contra ti, para trazeres sobre o meu reino tamanho pecado? Tu me fizeste aquilo que não deverias ter feito.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Αβιμελεχ τὸν Αβρααμ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τί τοῦτο ἐποίησας ἡμῖν μή τι ἡμάρτομεν εἰς σέ ὅτι ἐπήγαγες ἐπ' ἐμὲ καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν βασιλείαν μου ἁμαρτίαν μεγάλην ἔργον ὃ οὐδεὶς ποιήσει πεποίηκάς μοι

text_en: And again he expostulated with him, and said: What did you see, that you have done this?
text_la: Rursumque expostulans, ait : Quid vidisti, ut hoc faceres?
text_pt: Disse mais Abimeleque a Abraão: Que tens visto, para fazer tal coisa?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβιμελεχ τῷ Αβρααμ τί ἐνιδὼν ἐποίησας τοῦτο

text_en: Abraham answered: I thought with myself, saying: Perhaps there is not the fear of God in this place: and they will kill me for the sake of my wife:
text_la: Respondit Abraham : Cogitavi mecum, dicens : Forsitan non est timor Dei in loco isto : et interficient me propter uxorem meam:
text_pt: E disse Abraão: Porque eu dizia comigo: Certamente não há temor de Deus neste lugar, e eles me matarão por causa da minha mulher.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβρααμ εἶπα γάρ ἄρα οὐκ ἔστιν θεοσέβεια ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ ἐμέ τε ἀποκτενοῦσιν ἕνεκεν τῆς γυναικός μου

text_en: Howbeit, otherwise also she is truly my sister, the daughter of my father, and not the daughter of my mother, and I took her to wife .
text_la: alias autem et vere soror mea est, filia patris mei, et non filia matris meæ, et duxi eam in uxorem.
text_pt: E, na verdade, é ela também minha irmã, filha de meu pai, mas não filha da minha mãe; e veio a ser minha mulher;
text_el: καὶ γὰρ ἀληθῶς ἀδελφή μού ἐστιν ἐκ πατρός ἀλλ' οὐκ ἐκ μητρός ἐγενήθη δέ μοι εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: And after God brought me out of my father's house, I said to her: You shall do me this kindness: In every place, to which we shall come, you shall say that I am your brother.
text_la: Postquam autem eduxit me Deus de domo patris mei, dixi ad eam : Hanc misericordiam facies mecum : in omni loco, ad quem ingrediemur, dices quod frater tuus sim.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, fazendo-me Deus sair errante da casa de meu pai, eu lhe disse: Seja esta a graça que me farás em todo o lugar aonde chegarmos, dize de mim: É meu irmão.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἐξήγαγέν με ὁ θεὸς ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ εἶπα αὐτῇ ταύτην τὴν δικαιοσύνην ποιήσεις ἐπ' ἐμέ εἰς πάντα τόπον οὗ ἐὰν εἰσέλθωμεν ἐκεῖ εἰπὸν ἐμὲ ὅτι ἀδελφός μού ἐστιν

text_en: And Abimelech took sheep and oxen, and servants and handmaids, and gave to Abraham : and restored to him Sara his wife,
text_la: Tulit igitur Abimelech oves et boves, et servos et ancillas, et dedit Abraham : reddiditque illi Saram uxorem suam,
text_pt: Então tomou Abimeleque ovelhas e vacas, e servos e servas, e os deu a Abraão; e restituiu-lhe Sara, sua mulher.
text_el: ἔλαβεν δὲ Αβιμελεχ χίλια δίδραχμα πρόβατα καὶ μόσχους καὶ παῖδας καὶ παιδίσκας καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ Αβρααμ καὶ ἀπέδωκεν αὐτῷ Σαρραν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ

text_en: and said: The land is before you, dwell wheresoever it shall please you.
text_la: et ait : Terra coram vobis est, ubicumque tibi placuerit habita.
text_pt: E disse Abimeleque: Eis que a minha terra está diante da tua face; habita onde for bom aos teus olhos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβιμελεχ τῷ Αβρααμ ἰδοὺ ἡ γῆ μου ἐναντίον σου οὗ ἐάν σοι ἀρέσκῃ κατοίκει

text_en: And to Sara he said: Behold I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver, this shall serve you for a covering of your eyes to all that are with you, and wherever you shall go: and remember you were taken.
text_la: Saræ autem dixit : Ecce mille argenteos dedi fratri tuo, hoc erit tibi in velamen oculorum ad omnes qui tecum sunt, et quocumque perrexeris : mementoque te deprehensam.
text_pt: E a Sara disse: Vês que tenho dado ao teu irmão mil moedas de prata; eis que ele te seja por véu dos olhos para com todos os que contigo estão, e até para com todos os outros; e estás advertida.
text_el: τῇ δὲ Σαρρα εἶπεν ἰδοὺ δέδωκα χίλια δίδραχμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου ταῦτα ἔσται σοι εἰς τιμὴν τοῦ προσώπου σου καὶ πάσαις ταῖς μετὰ σοῦ καὶ πάντα ἀλήθευσον

text_en: And when Abraham prayed , God healed Abimelech and his wife, and his handmaids, and they bore children:
text_la: Orante autem Abraham, sanavit Deus Abimelech et uxorem, ancillasque ejus, et pepererunt:
text_pt: E orou Abraão a Deus, e sarou Deus a Abimeleque, e à sua mulher, e às suas servas, de maneira que tiveram filhos;
text_el: προσηύξατο δὲ Αβρααμ πρὸς τὸν θεόν καὶ ἰάσατο ὁ θεὸς τὸν Αβιμελεχ καὶ τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς παιδίσκας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔτεκον

text_en: For the Lord had closed up every womb of the house of Abimelech, on account of Sara , Abraham's wife.
text_la: concluserat enim Dominus omnem vulvam domus Abimelech propter Saram uxorem Abrahæ.
text_pt: Porque o Senhor havia fechado totalmente todas as madres da casa de Abimeleque, por causa de Sara, mulher de Abraão.
text_el: ὅτι συγκλείων συνέκλεισεν κύριος ἔξωθεν πᾶσαν μήτραν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ Αβιμελεχ ἕνεκεν Σαρρας τῆς γυναικὸς Αβρααμ

text_en: And the Lord visited Sara , as he had promised : and fulfilled what he had spoken.
text_la: Visitavit autem Dominus Saram, sicut promiserat : et implevit quæ locutus est.
text_pt: E o SENHOR visitou a Sara, como tinha dito; e fez o SENHOR a Sara como tinha prometido.
text_el: καὶ κύριος ἐπεσκέψατο τὴν Σαρραν καθὰ εἶπεν καὶ ἐποίησεν κύριος τῇ Σαρρα καθὰ ἐλάλησεν

text_en: And she conceived and bore a son in her old age, at the time that God had foretold her.
text_la: Concepitque et peperit filium in senectute sua, tempore quo prædixerat ei Deus.
text_pt: E concebeu Sara, e deu a Abraão um filho na sua velhice, ao tempo determinado, que Deus lhe tinha falado.
text_el: καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν Σαρρα τῷ Αβρααμ υἱὸν εἰς τὸ γῆρας εἰς τὸν καιρόν καθὰ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ κύριος

text_en: And Abraham called the name of his son, whom Sara bore him, Isaac .
text_la: Vocavitque Abraham nomen filii sui, quem genuit ei Sara, Isaac:
text_pt: E Abraão pôs no filho que lhe nascera, que Sara lhe dera, o nome de Isaque.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Αβρααμ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ τοῦ γενομένου αὐτῷ ὃν ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ Σαρρα Ισαακ

text_en: And he circumcised him the eighth day, as God had commanded him,
text_la: et circumcidit eum octavo die, sicut præceperat ei Deus,
text_pt: E Abraão circuncidou o seu filho Isaque, quando era da idade de oito dias, como Deus lhe tinha ordenado.
text_el: περιέτεμεν δὲ Αβρααμ τὸν Ισαακ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἡμέρᾳ καθὰ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ ὁ θεός

text_en: when he was a hundred years old: for at this age of his father, was Isaac born.
text_la: cum centum esset annorum : hac quippe ætate patris, natus est Isaac.
text_pt: E era Abraão da idade de cem anos, quando lhe nasceu Isaque seu filho.
text_el: Αβρααμ δὲ ἦν ἑκατὸν ἐτῶν ἡνίκα ἐγένετο αὐτῷ Ισαακ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Sara said: God has made a laughter for me: whosoever shall hear of it will laugh with me.
text_la: Dixitque Sara : Risum fecit mihi Deus : quicumque audierit, corridebit mihi.
text_pt: E disse Sara: Deus me tem feito riso; todo aquele que o ouvir se rirá comigo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Σαρρα γέλωτά μοι ἐποίησεν κύριος ὃς γὰρ ἂν ἀκούσῃ συγχαρεῖταί μοι

text_en: And again she said: Who would believe that Abraham should hear that Sara gave suck to a son, whom she bore to him in his old age?
text_la: Rursumque ait : Quis auditurus crederet Abraham quod Sara lactaret filium, quem peperit ei jam seni?
text_pt: Disse mais: Quem diria a Abraão que Sara daria de mamar a filhos? Pois lhe dei um filho na sua velhice.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τίς ἀναγγελεῖ τῷ Αβρααμ ὅτι θηλάζει παιδίον Σαρρα ὅτι ἔτεκον υἱὸν ἐν τῷ γήρει μου

text_en: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast on the day of his weaning.
text_la: Crevit igitur puer, et ablactatus est : fecitque Abraham grande convivium in die ablactationis ejus.
text_pt: E cresceu o menino, e foi desmamado; então Abraão fez um grande banquete no dia em que Isaque foi desmamado.
text_el: καὶ ηὐξήθη τὸ παιδίον καὶ ἀπεγαλακτίσθη καὶ ἐποίησεν Αβρααμ δοχὴν μεγάλην ᾗ ἡμέρᾳ ἀπεγαλακτίσθη Ισαακ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when Sara had seen the son of Agar, the Egyptian , playing with Isaac , her son, she said to Abraham :
text_la: Cumque vidisset Sara filium Agar Ægyptiæ ludentem cum Isaac filio suo, dixit ad Abraham:
text_pt: E viu Sara que o filho de Agar, a egípcia, o qual tinha dado a Abraão, zombava.
text_el: ἰδοῦσα δὲ Σαρρα τὸν υἱὸν Αγαρ τῆς Αἰγυπτίας ὃς ἐγένετο τῷ Αβρααμ παίζοντα μετὰ Ισαακ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς

text_en: Cast out this bondwoman and her son; for the son of the bondwoman shall not be heir with my son Isaac .
text_la: Ejice ancillam hanc, et filium ejus : non enim erit hæres filius ancillæ cum filio meo Isaac.
text_pt: E disse a Abraão: Ponha fora esta serva e o seu filho; porque o filho desta serva não herdará com Isaque, meu filho.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Αβρααμ ἔκβαλε τὴν παιδίσκην ταύτην καὶ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς οὐ γὰρ κληρονομήσει ὁ υἱὸς τῆς παιδίσκης ταύτης μετὰ τοῦ υἱοῦ μου Ισαακ

text_en: Abraham took this grievously for his son.
text_la: Dure accepit hoc Abraham pro filio suo.
text_pt: E pareceu esta palavra muito má aos olhos de Abraão, por causa de seu filho.
text_el: σκληρὸν δὲ ἐφάνη τὸ ῥῆμα σφόδρα ἐναντίον Αβρααμ περὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And God said to him: Let it not seem grievous to you for the boy, and for your bondwoman: in all that Sara has said to you, hearken to her voice: for in Isaac shall your seed be called.
text_la: Cui dixit Deus : Non tibi videatur asperum super puero, et super ancilla tua : omnia quæ dixerit tibi Sara, audi vocem ejus : quia in Isaac vocabitur tibi semen.
text_pt: Porém Deus disse a Abraão: Não te pareça mal aos teus olhos acerca do moço e acerca da tua serva; em tudo o que Sara te diz, ouve a sua voz; porque em Isaque será chamada a tua descendência.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αβρααμ μὴ σκληρὸν ἔστω τὸ ῥῆμα ἐναντίον σου περὶ τοῦ παιδίου καὶ περὶ τῆς παιδίσκης πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπῃ σοι Σαρρα ἄκουε τῆς φωνῆς αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐν Ισαακ κληθήσεταί σοι σπέρμα

text_en: But I will make the son also of the bondwoman a great nation , because he is your seed.
text_la: Sed et filium ancillæ faciam in gentem magnam, quia semen tuum est.
text_pt: Mas também do filho desta serva farei uma nação, porquanto é tua descendência.
text_el: καὶ τὸν υἱὸν δὲ τῆς παιδίσκης ταύτης εἰς ἔθνος μέγα ποιήσω αὐτόν ὅτι σπέρμα σόν ἐστιν

text_en: So Abraham rose up in the morning, and taking bread and a bottle of water, put it upon her shoulder, and delivered the boy, and sent her away. And she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Bersabee .
text_la: Surrexit itaque Abraham mane, et tollens panem et utrem aquæ, imposuit scapulæ ejus, tradiditque puerum, et dimisit eam. Quæ cum abiisset, errabat in solitudine Bersabee.
text_pt: Então se levantou Abraão pela manhã de madrugada, e tomou pão e um odre de água e os deu a Agar, pondo-os sobre o seu ombro; também lhe deu o menino e despediu-a; e ela partiu, andando errante no deserto de Berseba.
text_el: ἀνέστη δὲ Αβρααμ τὸ πρωὶ καὶ ἔλαβεν ἄρτους καὶ ἀσκὸν ὕδατος καὶ ἔδωκεν Αγαρ καὶ ἐπέθηκεν ἐπὶ τὸν ὦμον καὶ τὸ παιδίον καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτήν ἀπελθοῦσα δὲ ἐπλανᾶτο τὴν ἔρημον κατὰ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὅρκου

text_en: And when the water in the bottle was spent, she cast the boy under one of the trees that were there.
text_la: Cumque consumpta esset aqua in utre, abjecit puerum subter unam arborum, quæ ibi erant.
text_pt: E consumida a água do odre, lançou o menino debaixo de uma das árvores.
text_el: ἐξέλιπεν δὲ τὸ ὕδωρ ἐκ τοῦ ἀσκοῦ καὶ ἔρριψεν τὸ παιδίον ὑποκάτω μιᾶς ἐλάτης

text_en: And she went her way, and sat overagainst him a great way off, as far as a bow can carry, for she said: I will not see the boy die: and sitting overagainst, she lifted up her voice and wept.
text_la: Et abiit, seditque e regione procul quantum potest arcus jacere : dixit enim : Non videbo morientem puerum : et sedens contra, levavit vocem suam et flevit.
text_pt: E foi assentar-se em frente, afastando-se à distância de um tiro de arco; porque dizia: Que eu não veja morrer o menino. E assentou-se em frente, e levantou a sua voz, e chorou.
text_el: ἀπελθοῦσα δὲ ἐκάθητο ἀπέναντι αὐτοῦ μακρόθεν ὡσεὶ τόξου βολήν εἶπεν γάρ οὐ μὴ ἴδω τὸν θάνατον τοῦ παιδίου μου καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἀπέναντι αὐτοῦ ἀναβοῆσαν δὲ τὸ παιδίον ἔκλαυσεν

text_en: And God heard the voice of the boy: and an angel of God called to Agar from heaven , saying: What are you doing, Agar? fear not; for God has heard the voice of the boy, from the place wherein he is.
text_la: Exaudivit autem Deus vocem pueri : vocavitque angelus Dei Agar de cælo, dicens : Quid agis Agar? noli timere : exaudivit enim Deus vocem pueri de loco in quo est.
text_pt: E ouviu Deus a voz do menino, e bradou o anjo de Deus a Agar desde os céus, e disse-lhe: Que tens, Agar? Não temas, porque Deus ouviu a voz do menino desde o lugar onde está.
text_el: εἰσήκουσεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ παιδίου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου οὗ ἦν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν Αγαρ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ τί ἐστιν Αγαρ μὴ φοβοῦ ἐπακήκοεν γὰρ ὁ θεὸς τῆς φωνῆς τοῦ παιδίου σου ἐκ τοῦ τόπου οὗ ἐστιν

text_en: Arise, take up the boy, and hold him by the hand, for I will make him a great nation .
text_la: Surge, tolle puerum, et tene manum illius : quia in gentem magnam faciam eum.
text_pt: Ergue-te, levanta o menino e pega-lhe pela mão, porque dele farei uma grande nação.
text_el: ἀνάστηθι λαβὲ τὸ παιδίον καὶ κράτησον τῇ χειρί σου αὐτό εἰς γὰρ ἔθνος μέγα ποιήσω αὐτόν

text_en: And God opened her eyes: and she saw a well of water , and went and filled the bottle, and gave the boy to drink.
text_la: Aperuitque oculos ejus Deus : quæ videns puteum aquæ, abiit, et implevit utrem, deditque puero bibere.
text_pt: E abriu-lhe Deus os olhos, e viu um poço de água; e foi encher o odre de água, e deu de beber ao menino.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέῳξεν ὁ θεὸς τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ εἶδεν φρέαρ ὕδατος ζῶντος καὶ ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἔπλησεν τὸν ἀσκὸν ὕδατος καὶ ἐπότισεν τὸ παιδίον

text_en: And God was with him: and he grew, and dwelt in the wilderness , and became a young man, an archer.
text_la: Et fuit cum eo : qui crevit, et moratus est in solitudine, factusque est juvenis sagittarius.
text_pt: E era Deus com o menino, que cresceu; e habitou no deserto, e foi flecheiro.
text_el: καὶ ἦν ὁ θεὸς μετὰ τοῦ παιδίου καὶ ηὐξήθη καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ἐγένετο δὲ τοξότης

text_en: And he dwelt in the wilderness of Pharan, and his mother took a wife for him out of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Habitavitque in deserto Pharan, et accepit illi mater sua uxorem de terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E habitou no deserto de Parã; e sua mãe tomou-lhe mulher da terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τῇ Φαραν καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτῷ ἡ μήτηρ γυναῖκα ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: At the same time Abimelech, and Phicol the general of his army, said to Abraham : God is with you in all that you do.
text_la: Eodem tempore dixit Abimelech, et Phicol princeps exercitus ejus, ad Abraham : Deus tecum est in universis quæ agis.
text_pt: E aconteceu naquele mesmo tempo que Abimeleque, com Ficol, príncipe do seu exército, falou com Abraão, dizendo: Deus é contigo em tudo o que fazes;
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ καὶ εἶπεν Αβιμελεχ καὶ Οχοζαθ ὁ νυμφαγωγὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Φικολ ὁ ἀρχιστράτηγος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ πρὸς Αβρααμ λέγων ὁ θεὸς μετὰ σοῦ ἐν πᾶσιν οἷς ἐὰν ποιῇς

text_en: Swear therefore by God , that you will not hurt me, nor my posterity, nor my stock: but according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land wherein you have lived a stranger.
text_la: Jura ergo per Deum, ne noceas mihi, et posteris meis, stirpique meæ : sed juxta misericordiam, quam feci tibi, facies mihi, et terræ in qua versatus es advena.
text_pt: Agora, pois, jura-me aqui por Deus, que não mentirás a mim, nem a meu filho, nem a meu neto; segundo a beneficência que te fiz, me farás a mim, e à terra onde peregrinaste.
text_el: νῦν οὖν ὄμοσόν μοι τὸν θεὸν μὴ ἀδικήσειν με μηδὲ τὸ σπέρμα μου μηδὲ τὸ ὄνομά μου ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὴν δικαιοσύνην ἣν ἐποίησα μετὰ σοῦ ποιήσεις μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ τῇ γῇ ᾗ σὺ παρῴκησας ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And Abraham said: I will swear .
text_la: Dixitque Abraham : Ego jurabo.
text_pt: E disse Abraão: Eu jurarei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβρααμ ἐγὼ ὀμοῦμαι

text_en: And he reproved Abimelech for a well of water , which his servants had taken away by force.
text_la: Et increpavit Abimelech propter puteum aquæ quem vi abstulerunt servi ejus.
text_pt: Abraão, porém, repreendeu a Abimeleque por causa de um poço de água, que os servos de Abimeleque haviam tomado à força.
text_el: καὶ ἤλεγξεν Αβρααμ τὸν Αβιμελεχ περὶ τῶν φρεάτων τοῦ ὕδατος ὧν ἀφείλαντο οἱ παῖδες τοῦ Αβιμελεχ

text_en: And Abimelech answered: I knew not who did this thing: and you did not tell me, and I heard not of it till today.
text_la: Responditque Abimelech : Nescivi quis fecerit hanc rem : sed et tu non indicasti mihi, et ego non audivi præter hodie.
text_pt: Então disse Abimeleque: Eu não sei quem fez isto; e também tu não mo fizeste saber, nem eu o ouvi senão hoje.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Αβιμελεχ οὐκ ἔγνων τίς ἐποίησεν τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο οὐδὲ σύ μοι ἀπήγγειλας οὐδὲ ἐγὼ ἤκουσα ἀλλ' ἢ σήμερον

text_en: Then Abraham took sheep and oxen, and gave them to Abimelech: and both of them made a league.
text_la: Tulit itaque Abraham oves et boves, et dedit Abimelech : percusseruntque ambo fœdus.
text_pt: E tomou Abraão ovelhas e vacas, e deu-as a Abimeleque; e fizeram ambos uma aliança.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Αβρααμ πρόβατα καὶ μόσχους καὶ ἔδωκεν τῷ Αβιμελεχ καὶ διέθεντο ἀμφότεροι διαθήκην

text_en: And Abraham set apart seven ewelambs of the flock.
text_la: Et statuit Abraham septem agnas gregis seorsum.
text_pt: pôs Abraão, porém, à parte sete cordeiras do rebanho.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν Αβρααμ ἑπτὰ ἀμνάδας προβάτων μόνας

text_en: And Abimelech said to him: What mean these seven ewelambs which you have set apart?
text_la: Cui dixit Abimelech : Quid sibi volunt septem agnæ istæ, quas stare fecisti seorsum?
text_pt: E Abimeleque disse a Abraão: Para que estão aqui estas sete cordeiras, que puseste à parte?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβιμελεχ τῷ Αβρααμ τί εἰσιν αἱ ἑπτὰ ἀμνάδες τῶν προβάτων τούτων ἃς ἔστησας μόνας

text_en: But he said: You shall take seven ewelambs at my hand: that they may be a testimony for me, that I dug this well .
text_la: At ille : Septem, inquit, agnas accipies de manu mea : ut sint mihi in testimonium, quoniam ego fodi puteum istum.
text_pt: E disse: Tomarás estas sete cordeiras de minha mão, para que sejam em testemunho que eu cavei este poço.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβρααμ ὅτι τὰς ἑπτὰ ἀμνάδας ταύτας λήμψῃ παρ' ἐμοῦ ἵνα ὦσίν μοι εἰς μαρτύριον ὅτι ἐγὼ ὤρυξα τὸ φρέαρ τοῦτο

text_en: Therefore that place was called Bersabee ; because there both of them did swear .
text_la: Idcirco vocatus est locus ille Bersabee : quia ibi uterque juravit.
text_pt: Por isso se chamou aquele lugar Berseba, porquanto ambos juraram ali.
text_el: διὰ τοῦτο ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Φρέαρ ὁρκισμοῦ ὅτι ἐκεῖ ὤμοσαν ἀμφότεροι

text_en: And they made a league for the well of oath .
text_la: Et inierunt fœdus pro puteo juramenti.
text_pt: Assim fizeram aliança em Berseba. Depois se levantou Abimeleque e Ficol, príncipe do seu exército, e tornaram-se para a terra dos filisteus.
text_el: καὶ διέθεντο διαθήκην ἐν τῷ φρέατι τοῦ ὅρκου ἀνέστη δὲ Αβιμελεχ καὶ Οχοζαθ ὁ νυμφαγωγὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Φικολ ὁ ἀρχιστράτηγος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν γῆν τῶν Φυλιστιιμ

text_en: And Abimelech and Phicol, the general of his army, arose and returned to the land of the Palestines . But Abraham planted a grove in Bersabee , and there called upon the name of the Lord God eternal .
text_la: Surrexit autem Abimelech, et Phicol princeps exercitus ejus, reversique sunt in terram Palæstinorum. Abraham vero plantavit nemus in Bersabee, et invocavit ibi nomen Domini Dei æterni.
text_pt: E plantou um bosque em Berseba, e invocou lá o nome do Senhor, Deus eterno.
text_el: καὶ ἐφύτευσεν Αβρααμ ἄρουραν ἐπὶ τῷ φρέατι τοῦ ὅρκου καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο ἐκεῖ τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου θεὸς αἰώνιος

text_en: And he was a sojourner in the land of the Palestines many days.
text_la: Et fuit colonus terræ Palæstinorum diebus multis.
text_pt: E peregrinou Abraão na terra dos filisteus muitos dias.
text_el: παρῴκησεν δὲ Αβρααμ ἐν τῇ γῇ τῶν Φυλιστιιμ ἡμέρας πολλάς

text_en: After these things, God tempted Abraham , and said to him: Abraham , Abraham . And he answered: Here I am.
text_la: Quæ postquam gesta sunt, tentavit Deus Abraham, et dixit ad eum : Abraham, Abraham. At ille respondit : Adsum.
text_pt: E aconteceu depois destas coisas, que provou Deus a Abraão, e disse-lhe: Abraão! E ele disse: Eis-me aqui.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ὁ θεὸς ἐπείραζεν τὸν Αβρααμ καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτόν Αβρααμ Αβρααμ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἐγώ

text_en: He said to him: Take your only begotten son Isaac , whom you love , and go into the land of vision; and there you shall offer him for an holocaust upon one of the mountains which I will show you.
text_la: Ait illi : Tolle filium tuum unigenitum, quem diligis, Isaac, et vade in terram visionis, atque ibi offeres eum in holocaustum super unum montium quem monstravero tibi.
text_pt: E disse: Toma agora o teu filho, o teu único filho, Isaque, a quem amas, e vai-te à terra de Moriá, e oferece-o ali em holocausto sobre uma das montanhas, que eu te direi.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν λαβὲ τὸν υἱόν σου τὸν ἀγαπητόν ὃν ἠγάπησας τὸν Ισαακ καὶ πορεύθητι εἰς τὴν γῆν τὴν ὑψηλὴν καὶ ἀνένεγκον αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν ἐφ' ἓν τῶν ὀρέων ὧν ἄν σοι εἴπω

text_en: So Abraham rising up in the night, saddled his ass, and took with him two young men, and Isaac his son: and when he had cut wood for the holocaust , he went his way to the place which God had commanded him.
text_la: Igitur Abraham de nocte consurgens, stravit asinum suum, ducens secum duos juvenes, et Isaac filium suum : cumque concidisset ligna in holocaustum, abiit ad locum quem præceperat ei Deus.
text_pt: Então se levantou Abraão pela manhã de madrugada, e albardou o seu jumento, e tomou consigo dois de seus moços e Isaque seu filho; e cortou lenha para o holocausto, e levantou-se, e foi ao lugar que Deus lhe dissera.
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ Αβρααμ τὸ πρωὶ ἐπέσαξεν τὴν ὄνον αὐτοῦ παρέλαβεν δὲ μεθ' ἑαυτοῦ δύο παῖδας καὶ Ισαακ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ σχίσας ξύλα εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν ἀναστὰς ἐπορεύθη καὶ ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός

text_en: And on the third day, lifting up his eyes, he saw the place afar off.
text_la: Die autem tertio, elevatis oculis, vidit locum procul:
text_pt: Ao terceiro dia levantou Abraão os seus olhos, e viu o lugar de longe.
text_el: τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ καὶ ἀναβλέψας Αβρααμ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς εἶδεν τὸν τόπον μακρόθεν

text_en: And he said to his young men: Stay you here with the ass; I and the boy will go with speed as far as yonder, and after we have worshipped , will return to you.
text_la: dixitque ad pueros suos : Expectate hic cum asino : ego et puer illuc usque properantes, postquam adoraverimus, revertemur ad vos.
text_pt: E disse Abraão a seus moços: Ficai-vos aqui com o jumento, e eu e o moço iremos até ali; e havendo adorado, tornaremos a vós.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβρααμ τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ καθίσατε αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῆς ὄνου ἐγὼ δὲ καὶ τὸ παιδάριον διελευσόμεθα ἕως ὧδε καὶ προσκυνήσαντες ἀναστρέψωμεν πρὸς ὑμᾶς

text_en: And he took the wood for the holocaust , and laid it upon Isaac his son; and he himself carried in his hands fire and a sword. And as they two went on together,
text_la: Tulit quoque ligna holocausti, et imposuit super Isaac filium suum : ipse vero portabat in manibus ignem et gladium. Cumque duo pergerent simul,
text_pt: E tomou Abraão a lenha do holocausto, e pô-la sobre Isaque seu filho; e ele tomou o fogo e o cutelo na sua mão, e foram ambos juntos.
text_el: ἔλαβεν δὲ Αβρααμ τὰ ξύλα τῆς ὁλοκαρπώσεως καὶ ἐπέθηκεν Ισαακ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ ἔλαβεν δὲ καὶ τὸ πῦρ μετὰ χεῖρα καὶ τὴν μάχαιραν καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν οἱ δύο ἅμα

text_en: Isaac said to his father: My father. And he answered: What will you, son? Behold, says he, fire and wood: where is the victim for the holocaust ?
text_la: dixit Isaac patri suo : Pater mi. At ille respondit : Quid vis, fili? Ecce, inquit, ignis et ligna : ubi est victima holocausti?
text_pt: Então falou Isaque a Abraão seu pai, e disse: Meu pai! E ele disse: Eis-me aqui, meu filho! E ele disse: Eis aqui o fogo e a lenha, mas onde está o cordeiro para o holocausto?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ισαακ πρὸς Αβρααμ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ εἴπας πάτερ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν τί ἐστιν τέκνον λέγων ἰδοὺ τὸ πῦρ καὶ τὰ ξύλα ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ πρόβατον τὸ εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν

text_en: And Abraham said: God will provide himself a victim for an holocaust , my son. So they went on together.
text_la: Dixit autem Abraham : Deus providebit sibi victimam holocausti, fili mi. Pergebant ergo pariter.
text_pt: E disse Abraão: Deus proverá para si o cordeiro para o holocausto, meu filho. Assim caminharam ambos juntos.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβρααμ ὁ θεὸς ὄψεται ἑαυτῷ πρόβατον εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν τέκνον πορευθέντες δὲ ἀμφότεροι ἅμα

text_en: And they came to the place which God had shown him, where he built an altar , and laid the wood in order upon it; and when he had bound Isaac his son, he laid him on the altar upon the pile of wood.
text_la: Et venerunt ad locum quem ostenderat ei Deus, in quo ædificavit altare, et desuper ligna composuit; cumque alligasset Isaac filium suum, posuit eum in altare super struem lignorum.
text_pt: E chegaram ao lugar que Deus lhe dissera, e edificou Abraão ali um altar e pôs em ordem a lenha, e amarrou a Isaque seu filho, e deitou-o sobre o altar em cima da lenha.
text_el: ἦλθον ἐπὶ τὸν τόπον ὃν εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ Αβρααμ θυσιαστήριον καὶ ἐπέθηκεν τὰ ξύλα καὶ συμποδίσας Ισαακ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπέθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον ἐπάνω τῶν ξύλων

text_en: And he put forth his hand, and took the sword, to sacrifice his son.
text_la: Extenditque manum, et arripuit gladium, ut immolaret filium suum.
text_pt: E estendeu Abraão a sua mão, e tomou o cutelo para imolar o seu filho;
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτεινεν Αβρααμ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ λαβεῖν τὴν μάχαιραν σφάξαι τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And behold, an angel of the Lord from heaven called to him, saying: Abraham , Abraham . And he answered: Here I am.
text_la: Et ecce angelus Domini de cælo clamavit, dicens : Abraham, Abraham. Qui respondit : Adsum.
text_pt: Mas o anjo do Senhor lhe bradou desde os céus, e disse: Abraão, Abraão! E ele disse: Eis-me aqui.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν ἄγγελος κυρίου ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Αβρααμ Αβρααμ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἐγώ

text_en: And he said to him: Lay not your hand upon the boy, neither do anything to him: now I know that you fear God , and have not spared your only begotten son for my sake.
text_la: Dixitque ei : Non extendas manum tuam super puerum, neque facias illi quidquam : nunc cognovi quod times Deum, et non pepercisti unigenito filio tuo propter me.
text_pt: Então disse: Não estendas a tua mão sobre o moço, e não lhe faças nada; porquanto agora sei que temes a Deus, e não me negaste o teu filho, o teu único filho.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν μὴ ἐπιβάλῃς τὴν χεῖρά σου ἐπὶ τὸ παιδάριον μηδὲ ποιήσῃς αὐτῷ μηδέν νῦν γὰρ ἔγνων ὅτι φοβῇ τὸν θεὸν σὺ καὶ οὐκ ἐφείσω τοῦ υἱοῦ σου τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ δι' ἐμέ

text_en: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw behind his back a ram, amongst the briers, sticking fast by the horns, which he took and offered for a holocaust instead of his son.
text_la: Levavit Abraham oculos suos, viditque post tergum arietem inter vepres hærentem cornibus, quem assumens obtulit holocaustum pro filio.
text_pt: Então levantou Abraão os seus olhos e olhou; e eis um carneiro detrás dele, travado pelos seus chifres, num mato; e foi Abraão, e tomou o carneiro, e ofereceu-o em holocausto, em lugar de seu filho.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβλέψας Αβρααμ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτοῦ εἶδεν καὶ ἰδοὺ κριὸς εἷς κατεχόμενος ἐν φυτῷ σαβεκ τῶν κεράτων καὶ ἐπορεύθη Αβρααμ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν κριὸν καὶ ἀνήνεγκεν αὐτὸν εἰς ὁλοκάρπωσιν ἀντὶ Ισαακ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he called the name of that place, The Lord sees. Whereupon, even to this day, it is said: In the mountain the Lord will see.
text_la: Appellavitque nomen loci illius, Dominus videt. Unde usque hodie dicitur : In monte Dominus videbit.
text_pt: E chamou Abraão o nome daquele lugar: o Senhor proverá; donde se diz até ao dia de hoje: No monte do Senhor se proverá.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Αβρααμ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου κύριος εἶδεν ἵνα εἴπωσιν σήμερον ἐν τῷ ὄρει κύριος ὤφθη

text_en: And the angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time from heaven , saying:
text_la: Vocavit autem angelus Domini Abraham secundo de cælo, dicens:
text_pt: Então o anjo do Senhor bradou a Abraão pela segunda vez desde os céus,
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν ἄγγελος κυρίου τὸν Αβρααμ δεύτερον ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: By my own self have I sworn , says the Lord : because you have done this thing, and have not spared your only begotten son for my sake:
text_la: Per memetipsum juravi, dicit Dominus : quia fecisti hanc rem, et non pepercisti filio tuo unigenito propter me:
text_pt: E disse: Por mim mesmo jurei, diz o Senhor: Porquanto fizeste esta ação, e não me negaste o teu filho, o teu único filho,
text_el: λέγων κατ' ἐμαυτοῦ ὤμοσα λέγει κύριος οὗ εἵνεκεν ἐποίησας τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο καὶ οὐκ ἐφείσω τοῦ υἱοῦ σου τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ δι' ἐμέ

text_en: I will bless you, and I will multiply your seed as the stars of heaven , and as the sand that is by the sea shore; your seed shall possess the gates of their enemies.
text_la: benedicam tibi, et multiplicabo semen tuum sicut stellas cæli, et velut arenam quæ est in littore maris : possidebit semen tuum portas inimicorum suorum,
text_pt: Que deveras te abençoarei, e grandissimamente multiplicarei a tua descendência como as estrelas dos céus, e como a areia que está na praia do mar; e a tua descendência possuirá a porta dos seus inimigos;
text_el: ἦ μὴν εὐλογῶν εὐλογήσω σε καὶ πληθύνων πληθυνῶ τὸ σπέρμα σου ὡς τοὺς ἀστέρας τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὡς τὴν ἄμμον τὴν παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τῆς θαλάσσης καὶ κληρονομήσει τὸ σπέρμα σου τὰς πόλεις τῶν ὑπεναντίων

text_en: And in your seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed , because you have obeyed my voice.
text_la: et benedicentur in semine tuo omnes gentes terræ, quia obedisti voci meæ.
text_pt: E em tua descendência serão benditas todas as nações da terra; porquanto obedeceste à minha voz.
text_el: καὶ ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς ἀνθ' ὧν ὑπήκουσας τῆς ἐμῆς φωνῆς

text_en: Abraham returned to his young men, and they went to Bersabee together, and he dwelt there.
text_la: Reversus est Abraham ad pueros suos, abieruntque Bersabee simul, et habitavit ibi.
text_pt: Então Abraão tornou aos seus moços, e levantaram-se, e foram juntos para Berseba; e Abraão habitou em Berseba.
text_el: ἀπεστράφη δὲ Αβρααμ πρὸς τοὺς παῖδας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀναστάντες ἐπορεύθησαν ἅμα ἐπὶ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὅρκου καὶ κατῴκησεν Αβρααμ ἐπὶ τῷ φρέατι τοῦ ὅρκου

text_en: After these things, it was told Abraham , that Melcha also had borne children to Nachor his brother.
text_la: His ita gestis, nuntiatum est Abrahæ quod Melcha quoque genuisset filios Nachor fratri suo:
text_pt: E sucedeu depois destas coisas, que anunciaram a Abraão, dizendo: Eis que também Milca deu filhos a Naor teu irmão.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα καὶ ἀνηγγέλη τῷ Αβρααμ λέγοντες ἰδοὺ τέτοκεν Μελχα καὶ αὐτὴ υἱοὺς Ναχωρ τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου

text_en: Hus, the firstborn , and Buz, his brother, and Camuel the father of the Syrians ,
text_la: Hus primogenitum, et Buz fratrem ejus, et Camuel patrem Syrorum,
text_pt: Uz o seu primogênito, e Buz seu irmão, e Quemuel, pai de Arã,
text_el: τὸν Ωξ πρωτότοκον καὶ τὸν Βαυξ ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ τὸν Καμουηλ πατέρα Σύρων

text_en: and Cased, and Azau, and Pheldas, and Jedlaph,
text_la: et Cased, et Azau, Pheldas quoque et Jedlaph,
text_pt: E Quésede, e Hazo, e Pildas, e Jidlafe, e Betuel.
text_el: καὶ τὸν Χασαδ καὶ τὸν Αζαυ καὶ τὸν Φαλδας καὶ τὸν Ιεδλαφ καὶ τὸν Βαθουηλ

text_en: and Bathuel, of whom was born Rebecca: these eight did Melcha bear to Nachor, Abraham's brother.
text_la: ac Bathuel, de quo nata est Rebecca : octo istos genuit Melcha, Nachor fratri Abrahæ.
text_pt: E Betuel gerou Rebeca. Estes oito deu à luz Milca a Naor, irmão de Abraão.
text_el: καὶ Βαθουηλ ἐγέννησεν τὴν Ρεβεκκαν ὀκτὼ οὗτοι υἱοί οὓς ἔτεκεν Μελχα τῷ Ναχωρ τῷ ἀδελφῷ Αβρααμ

text_en: And his concubine , named Roma, bore Tabee, and Gaham, and Tahas, and Maacha.
text_la: Concubina vero illius, nomine Roma, peperit Tabee, et Gaham, et Thahas, et Maacha.
text_pt: E a sua concubina, cujo nome era Reumá, ela lhe deu também a Tebá, Gaã, Taás e Maaca.
text_el: καὶ ἡ παλλακὴ αὐτοῦ ᾗ ὄνομα Ρεημα ἔτεκεν καὶ αὐτὴ τὸν Ταβεκ καὶ τὸν Γααμ καὶ τὸν Τοχος καὶ τὸν Μωχα

text_en: And Sara lived a hundred and twenty-seven years.
text_la: Vixit autem Sara centum viginti septem annis.
text_pt: E foi a vida de Sara cento e vinte e sete anos; estes foram os anos da vida de Sara.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡ ζωὴ Σαρρας ἔτη ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ἑπτά

text_en: And she died in the city of Arbee which is Hebron , in the land of Chanaan : and Abraham came to mourn and weep for her.
text_la: Et mortua est in civitate Arbee, quæ est Hebron, in terra Chanaan : venitque Abraham ut plangeret et fleret eam.
text_pt: E morreu Sara em Quiriate-Arba, que é Hebrom, na terra de Canaã; e veio Abraão lamentar Sara e chorar por ela.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέθανεν Σαρρα ἐν πόλει Αρβοκ ἥ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ κοιλώματι αὕτη ἐστὶν Χεβρων ἐν γῇ Χανααν ἦλθεν δὲ Αβρααμ κόψασθαι Σαρραν καὶ πενθῆσαι

text_en: And after he rose up from the funeral obsequies, he spoke to the children of Heth , saying:
text_la: Cumque surrexisset ab officio funeris, locutus est ad filios Heth, dicens:
text_pt: Depois se levantou Abraão de diante de sua morta, e falou aos filhos de Hete, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Αβρααμ ἀπὸ τοῦ νεκροῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς υἱοῖς Χετ λέγων

text_en: I am a stranger and sojourner among you: give me the right of a burying place with you, that I may bury my dead.
text_la: Advena sum et peregrinus apud vos : date mihi jus sepulchri vobiscum, ut sepeliam mortuum meum.
text_pt: Estrangeiro e peregrino sou entre vós; dai-me possessão de sepultura convosco, para que eu sepulte a minha morta de diante da minha face.
text_el: πάροικος καὶ παρεπίδημος ἐγώ εἰμι μεθ' ὑμῶν δότε οὖν μοι κτῆσιν τάφου μεθ' ὑμῶν καὶ θάψω τὸν νεκρόν μου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: The children of Heth answered, saying:
text_la: Responderunt filii Heth, dicentes:
text_pt: E responderam os filhos de Hete a Abraão, dizendo-lhe:
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Χετ πρὸς Αβρααμ λέγοντες

text_en: My lord, hear us, you are a prince of God among us: bury your dead in our principal sepulchres : and no man shall have power to hinder you from burying your dead in his sepulchre .
text_la: Audi nos, domine : princeps Dei es apud nos : in electis sepulchris nostris sepeli mortuum tuum, nullusque te prohibere poterit quin in monumento ejus sepelias mortuum tuum.
text_pt: Ouve-nos, meu senhor; príncipe poderoso és no meio de nós; enterra a tua morta na mais escolhida de nossas sepulturas; nenhum de nós te vedará a sua sepultura, para enterrar a tua morta.
text_el: μή κύριε ἄκουσον δὲ ἡμῶν βασιλεὺς παρὰ θεοῦ εἶ σὺ ἐν ἡμῖν ἐν τοῖς ἐκλεκτοῖς μνημείοις ἡμῶν θάψον τὸν νεκρόν σου οὐδεὶς γὰρ ἡμῶν τὸ μνημεῖον αὐτοῦ κωλύσει ἀπὸ σοῦ τοῦ θάψαι τὸν νεκρόν σου ἐκεῖ

text_en: Abraham rose up, and bowed down to the people of the land, to wit, the children of Heth :
text_la: Surrexit Abraham, et adoravit populum terræ, filios videlicet Heth:
text_pt: Então se levantou Abraão, inclinou-se diante do povo da terra, diante dos filhos de Hete.
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ Αβρααμ προσεκύνησεν τῷ λαῷ τῆς γῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Χετ

text_en: And said to them: If it please your soul that I should bury my dead, hear me, and intercede for me to Ephron the son of Seor.
text_la: dixitque ad eos : Si placet animæ vestræ ut sepeliam mortuum meum, audite me, et intercedite pro me apud Ephron filium Seor:
text_pt: E falou com eles, dizendo: Se é de vossa vontade que eu sepulte a minha morta de diante de minha face, ouvi-me e falai por mim a Efrom, filho de Zoar,
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς Αβρααμ λέγων εἰ ἔχετε τῇ ψυχῇ ὑμῶν ὥστε θάψαι τὸν νεκρόν μου ἀπὸ προσώπου μου ἀκούσατέ μου καὶ λαλήσατε περὶ ἐμοῦ Εφρων τῷ τοῦ Σααρ

text_en: That he may give me the double cave , which he has in the end of his field: For as much money as it is worth he shall give it me before you, for a possession of a burying place.
text_la: ut det mihi speluncam duplicem, quam habet in extrema parte agri sui : pecunia digna tradat eam mihi coram vobis in possessionem sepulchri.
text_pt: Que ele me dê a cova de Macpela, que ele tem no fim do seu campo; que ma dê pelo devido preço em herança de sepulcro no meio de vós.
text_el: καὶ δότω μοι τὸ σπήλαιον τὸ διπλοῦν ὅ ἐστιν αὐτῷ τὸ ὂν ἐν μέρει τοῦ ἀγροῦ αὐτοῦ ἀργυρίου τοῦ ἀξίου δότω μοι αὐτὸ ἐν ὑμῖν εἰς κτῆσιν μνημείου

text_en: Now Ephron dwelt in the midst of the children of Heth . And Ephron made answer to Abraham in the hearing of all that went in at the gate of the city, saying:
text_la: Habitabat autem Ephron in medio filiorum Heth. Responditque Ephron ad Abraham, cunctis audientibus qui ingrediebantur portam civitatis illius, dicens:
text_pt: Ora Efrom habitava no meio dos filhos de Hete; e respondeu Efrom, heteu, a Abraão, aos ouvidos dos filhos de Hete, de todos os que entravam pela porta da sua cidade, dizendo:
text_el: Εφρων δὲ ἐκάθητο ἐν μέσῳ τῶν υἱῶν Χετ ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Εφρων ὁ Χετταῖος πρὸς Αβρααμ εἶπεν ἀκουόντων τῶν υἱῶν Χετ καὶ πάντων τῶν εἰσπορευομένων εἰς τὴν πόλιν λέγων

text_en: Let it not be so, my lord, but rather hearken to what I say: The field I deliver to you, and the cave that is therein; in the presence of the children of my people, bury your dead.
text_la: Nequaquam ita fiat, domine mi, sed tu magis ausculta quod loquor. Agrum trado tibi, et speluncam quæ in eo est, præsentibus filiis populi mei; sepeli mortuum tuum.
text_pt: Não, meu senhor, ouve-me: O campo te dou, também te dou a cova que nele está, diante dos olhos dos filhos do meu povo ta dou; sepulta a tua morta.
text_el: παρ' ἐμοὶ γενοῦ κύριε καὶ ἄκουσόν μου τὸν ἀγρὸν καὶ τὸ σπήλαιον τὸ ἐν αὐτῷ σοι δίδωμι ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν πολιτῶν μου δέδωκά σοι θάψον τὸν νεκρόν σου

text_en: Abraham bowed down before the people of the land.
text_la: Adoravit Abraham coram populo terræ.
text_pt: Então Abraão se inclinou diante da face do povo da terra,
text_el: καὶ προσεκύνησεν Αβρααμ ἐναντίον τοῦ λαοῦ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And he spoke to Ephron, in the presence of the people : I beseech you to hear me: I will give money for the field; take it, and so will I bury my dead in it.
text_la: Et locutus est ad Ephron circumstante plebe : Quæso ut audias me : dabo pecuniam pro agro : suscipe eam, et sic sepeliam mortuum meum in eo.
text_pt: E falou a Efrom, aos ouvidos do povo da terra, dizendo: Mas se tu estás por isto, ouve-me, peço-te. O preço do campo o darei; toma-o de mim e sepultarei ali a minha morta.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Εφρων εἰς τὰ ὦτα τοῦ λαοῦ τῆς γῆς ἐπειδὴ πρὸς ἐμοῦ εἶ ἄκουσόν μου τὸ ἀργύριον τοῦ ἀγροῦ λαβὲ παρ' ἐμοῦ καὶ θάψω τὸν νεκρόν μου ἐκεῖ

text_en: And Ephron answered:
text_la: Responditque Ephron:
text_pt: E respondeu Efrom a Abraão, dizendo-lhe:
text_el: ἀπεκρίθη δὲ Εφρων τῷ Αβρααμ λέγων

text_en: My lord, hear me. The ground which you desire, is worth four hundred sicles of silver: this is the price between me and you: but what is this? Bury your dead.
text_la: Domine mi, audi me : terra, quam postulas, quadringentis siclis argenti valet : istud est pretium inter me et te : sed quantum est hoc? sepeli mortuum tuum.
text_pt: Meu senhor, ouve-me, a terra é de quatrocentos siclos de prata; que é isto entre mim e ti? Sepulta a tua morta.
text_el: οὐχί κύριε ἀκήκοα γῆ τετρακοσίων διδράχμων ἀργυρίου ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ τί ἂν εἴη τοῦτο σὺ δὲ τὸν νεκρόν σου θάψον

text_en: And when Abraham had heard this, he weighed out the money that Ephron had asked, in the hearing of the children of Heth , four hundred sicles of silver, of common current money.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Abraham, appendit pecuniam, quam Ephron postulaverat, audientibus filiis Heth, quadringentos siclos argenti probatæ monetæ publicæ.
text_pt: E Abraão deu ouvidos a Efrom, e Abraão pesou a Efrom a prata de que tinha falado aos ouvidos dos filhos de Hete, quatrocentos siclos de prata, corrente entre mercadores.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Αβρααμ τοῦ Εφρων καὶ ἀπεκατέστησεν Αβρααμ τῷ Εφρων τὸ ἀργύριον ὃ ἐλάλησεν εἰς τὰ ὦτα τῶν υἱῶν Χετ τετρακόσια δίδραχμα ἀργυρίου δοκίμου ἐμπόροις

text_en: And the field that before was Ephron's, wherein was the double cave , looking towards Mambre, both it and the cave, and all the trees thereof, in all its limits round about,
text_la: Confirmatusque est ager quondam Ephronis, in quo erat spelunca duplex, respiciens Mambre, tam ipse, quam spelunca, et omnes arbores ejus in cunctis terminis ejus per circuitum,
text_pt: Assim o campo de Efrom, que estava em Macpela, em frente de Manre, o campo e a cova que nele estava, e todo o arvoredo que no campo havia, que estava em todo o seu contorno ao redor,
text_el: καὶ ἔστη ὁ ἀγρὸς Εφρων ὃς ἦν ἐν τῷ διπλῷ σπηλαίῳ ὅς ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον Μαμβρη ὁ ἀγρὸς καὶ τὸ σπήλαιον ὃ ἦν ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ πᾶν δένδρον ὃ ἦν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τοῖς ὁρίοις αὐτοῦ κύκλῳ

text_en: was made sure to Abraham for a possession , in the sight of the children of Heth , and of all that went in at the gate of his city.
text_la: Abrahæ in possessionem, videntibus filiis Heth, et cunctis qui intrabant portam civitatis illius.
text_pt: Se confirmou a Abraão em possessão diante dos olhos dos filhos de Hete, de todos os que entravam pela porta da cidade.
text_el: τῷ Αβρααμ εἰς κτῆσιν ἐναντίον τῶν υἱῶν Χετ καὶ πάντων τῶν εἰσπορευομένων εἰς τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And so Abraham buried Sara , his wife, in the double cave of the field, that looked towards Mambre, this is Hebron in the land of Chanaan .
text_la: Atque ita sepelivit Abraham Saram uxorem suam in spelunca agri duplici, quæ respiciebat Mambre. Hæc est Hebron in terra Chanaan.
text_pt: E depois sepultou Abraão a Sara sua mulher na cova do campo de Macpela, em frente de Manre, que é Hebrom, na terra de Canaã.
text_el: μετὰ ταῦτα ἔθαψεν Αβρααμ Σαρραν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ τοῦ ἀγροῦ τῷ διπλῷ ὅ ἐστιν ἀπέναντι Μαμβρη αὕτη ἐστὶν Χεβρων ἐν τῇ γῇ Χανααν

text_en: And the field was made sure to Abraham , and the cave that was in it, for a possession to bury in, by the children of Heth .
text_la: Et confirmatus est ager, et antrum quod erat in eo, Abrahæ in possessionem monumenti a filiis Heth.
text_pt: Assim o campo e a cova que nele estava foram confirmados a Abraão, pelos filhos de Hete, em possessão de sepultura.
text_el: καὶ ἐκυρώθη ὁ ἀγρὸς καὶ τὸ σπήλαιον ὃ ἦν ἐν αὐτῷ τῷ Αβρααμ εἰς κτῆσιν τάφου παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Χετ

text_en: Now Abraham was old, and advanced in age; and the Lord had blessed him in all things.
text_la: Erat autem Abraham senex, dierumque multorum : et Dominus in cunctis benedixerat ei.
text_pt: E era Abraão já velho e adiantado em idade, e o SENHOR havia abençoado a Abraão em tudo.
text_el: καὶ Αβρααμ ἦν πρεσβύτερος προβεβηκὼς ἡμερῶν καὶ κύριος εὐλόγησεν τὸν Αβρααμ κατὰ πάντα

text_en: And he said to the elder servant of his house, who was ruler over all he had: Put your hand under my thigh,
text_la: Dixitque ad servum seniorem domus suæ, qui præerat omnibus quæ habebat : Pone manum tuam subter femur meum,
text_pt: E disse Abraão ao seu servo, o mais velho da casa, que tinha o governo sobre tudo o que possuía: Põe agora a tua mão debaixo da minha coxa,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αβρααμ τῷ παιδὶ αὐτοῦ τῷ πρεσβυτέρῳ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ τῷ ἄρχοντι πάντων τῶν αὐτοῦ θὲς τὴν χεῖρά σου ὑπὸ τὸν μηρόν μου

text_en: that I may make you swear by the Lord , the God of heaven and earth, that you take not a wife for my son, of the daughters of the Chanaanites , among whom I dwell:
text_la: ut adjurem te per Dominum Deum cæli et terræ, ut non accipias uxorem filio meo de filiabus Chananæorum, inter quos habito:
text_pt: Para que eu te faça jurar pelo Senhor Deus dos céus e Deus da terra, que não tomarás para meu filho mulher das filhas dos cananeus, no meio dos quais eu habito.
text_el: καὶ ἐξορκιῶ σε κύριον τὸν θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ τὸν θεὸν τῆς γῆς ἵνα μὴ λάβῃς γυναῖκα τῷ υἱῷ μου Ισαακ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν Χαναναίων μεθ' ὧν ἐγὼ οἰκῶ ἐν αὐτοῖς

text_en: But that you go to my own country and kindred , and take a wife from thence for my son Isaac .
text_la: sed ad terram et cognationem meam proficiscaris et inde accipias uxorem filio meo Isaac.
text_pt: Mas que irás à minha terra e à minha parentela, e dali tomarás mulher para meu filho Isaque.
text_el: ἀλλὰ εἰς τὴν γῆν μου οὗ ἐγενόμην πορεύσῃ καὶ εἰς τὴν φυλήν μου καὶ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα τῷ υἱῷ μου Ισαακ ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: The servant answered: If the woman will not come with me into this land, must I bring your son back again to the place from whence you came out?
text_la: Respondit servus : Si noluerit mulier venire mecum in terram hanc, numquid reducere debeo filium tuum ad locum, de quo egressus es?
text_pt: E disse-lhe o servo: Se porventura não quiser seguir-me a mulher a esta terra, farei, pois, tornar o teu filho à terra donde saíste?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν ὁ παῖς μήποτε οὐ βούλεται ἡ γυνὴ πορευθῆναι μετ' ἐμοῦ ὀπίσω εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην ἀποστρέψω τὸν υἱόν σου εἰς τὴν γῆν ὅθεν ἐξῆλθες ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: And Abraham said: Beware you never bring my son back again thither.
text_la: Dixitque Abraham : Cave nequando reducas filium meum illuc.
text_pt: E Abraão lhe disse: Guarda-te, que não faças lá tornar o meu filho.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὸν Αβρααμ πρόσεχε σεαυτῷ μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς τὸν υἱόν μου ἐκεῖ

text_en: The Lord God of heaven , who took me out of my father's house, and out of my native country, who spoke to me, and swore to me, saying: To your seed will I give this land: he will send his angel before you, and you shall take from thence a wife for my son.
text_la: Dominus Deus cæli, qui tulit me de domo patris mei, et de terra nativitatis meæ, qui locutus est mihi, et juravit mihi, dicens : Semini tuo dabo terram hanc : ipse mittet angelum suum coram te, et accipies inde uxorem filio meo:
text_pt: O Senhor Deus dos céus, que me tomou da casa de meu pai e da terra da minha parentela, e que me falou, e que me jurou, dizendo: À tua descendência darei esta terra; ele enviará o seu anjo adiante da tua face, para que tomes mulher de lá para meu filho.
text_el: κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῆς γῆς ὃς ἔλαβέν με ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς ἧς ἐγενήθην ὃς ἐλάλησέν μοι καὶ ὤμοσέν μοι λέγων σοὶ δώσω τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου αὐτὸς ἀποστελεῖ τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ ἔμπροσθέν σου καὶ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα τῷ υἱῷ μου Ισαακ ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: But if the woman will not follow you, you shall not be bound by the oath : only bring not my son back thither again.
text_la: sin autem mulier noluerit sequi te, non teneberis juramento : filium meum tantum ne reducas illuc.
text_pt: Se a mulher, porém, não quiser seguir-te, serás livre deste meu juramento; somente não faças lá tornar a meu filho.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ θέλῃ ἡ γυνὴ πορευθῆναι μετὰ σοῦ εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην καθαρὸς ἔσῃ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὅρκου τούτου μόνον τὸν υἱόν μου μὴ ἀποστρέψῃς ἐκεῖ

text_en: The servant, therefore, put his hand under the thigh of Abraham , his lord, and swore to him upon his word.
text_la: Posuit ergo servus manum sub femore Abraham domini sui, et juravit illi super sermone hoc.
text_pt: Então pôs o servo a sua mão debaixo da coxa de Abraão seu senhor, e jurou-lhe sobre este negócio.
text_el: καὶ ἔθηκεν ὁ παῖς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ὑπὸ τὸν μηρὸν Αβρααμ τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ περὶ τοῦ ῥήματος τούτου

text_en: And he took ten camels of his master's herd, and departed, carrying something of all his goods with him, and he set forward and went on to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nachor.
text_la: Tulitque decem camelos de grege domini sui, et abiit, ex omnibus bonis ejus portans secum, profectusque perrexit in Mesopotamiam ad urbem Nachor.
text_pt: E o servo tomou dez camelos, dos camelos do seu senhor, e partiu, pois que todos os bens de seu senhor estavam em sua mão, e levantou-se e partiu para Mesopotâmia, para a cidade de Naor.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν ὁ παῖς δέκα καμήλους ἀπὸ τῶν καμήλων τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἀγαθῶν τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ μεθ' ἑαυτοῦ καὶ ἀναστὰς ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν Ναχωρ

text_en: And when he had made the camels lie down without the town, near a well of water , in the evening, at the time when women are wont to come out to draw water, he said:
text_la: Cumque camelos fecisset accumbere extra oppidum juxta puteum aquæ vespere, tempore quo solent mulieres egredi ad hauriendam aquam, dixit:
text_pt: E fez ajoelhar os camelos fora da cidade, junto a um poço de água, pela tarde, ao tempo que as moças saíam a tirar água.
text_el: καὶ ἐκοίμισεν τὰς καμήλους ἔξω τῆς πόλεως παρὰ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὕδατος τὸ πρὸς ὀψέ ἡνίκα ἐκπορεύονται αἱ ὑδρευόμεναι

text_en: O Lord , the God of my master, Abraham , meet me today, I beseech you, and show kindness to my master, Abraham .
text_la: Domine Deus domini mei Abraham, occurre, obsecro, mihi hodie, et fac misericordiam cum domino meo Abraham.
text_pt: E disse: Ó Senhor, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, dá-me hoje bom encontro, e faze beneficência ao meu senhor Abraão!
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριε ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου μου Αβρααμ εὐόδωσον ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ σήμερον καὶ ποίησον ἔλεος μετὰ τοῦ κυρίου μου Αβρααμ

text_en: Behold, I stand near the spring of water, and the daughters of the inhabitants of this city will come out to draw water:
text_la: Ecce ego sto prope fontem aquæ, et filiæ habitatorum hujus civitatis egredientur ad hauriendam aquam.
text_pt: Eis que eu estou em pé junto à fonte de água e as filhas dos homens desta cidade saem para tirar água;
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἕστηκα ἐπὶ τῆς πηγῆς τοῦ ὕδατος αἱ δὲ θυγατέρες τῶν οἰκούντων τὴν πόλιν ἐκπορεύονται ἀντλῆσαι ὕδωρ

text_en: Now, therefore, the maid to whom I shall say: Let down your pitcher that I may drink: and she shall answer, Drink, and I will give your camels drink also: let it be the same whom you have provided for your servant Isaac : and by this, I shall understand that you have shown kindness to my master.
text_la: Igitur puella, cui ego dixero : Inclina hydriam tuam ut bibam : et illa responderit : Bibe, quin et camelis tuis dabo potum : ipsa est quam præparasti servo tuo Isaac : et per hoc intelligam quod feceris misericordiam cum domino meo.
text_pt: Seja, pois, que a donzela, a quem eu disser: Abaixa agora o teu cântaro para que eu beba; e ela disser: Bebe, e também darei de beber aos teus camelos; esta seja a quem designaste ao teu servo Isaque, e que eu conheça nisso que usaste de benevolência com meu senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἡ παρθένος ᾗ ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ἐπίκλινον τὴν ὑδρίαν σου ἵνα πίω καὶ εἴπῃ μοι πίε καὶ τὰς καμήλους σου ποτιῶ ἕως ἂν παύσωνται πίνουσαι ταύτην ἡτοίμασας τῷ παιδί σου Ισαακ καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γνώσομαι ὅτι ἐποίησας ἔλεος τῷ κυρίῳ μου Αβρααμ

text_en: He had not yet ended these words within himself, and behold Rebecca came out, the daughter of Bathuel, son of Melcha, wife to Nachor the brother of Abraham , having a pitcher on her shoulder:
text_la: Necdum intra se verba compleverat, et ecce Rebecca egrediebatur, filia Bathuel, filii Melchæ uxoris Nachor fratris Abraham, habens hydriam in scapula sua:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, antes que ele acabasse de falar, eis que Rebeca, que havia nascido a Betuel, filho de Milca, mulher de Naor, irmão de Abraão, saía com o seu cântaro sobre o seu ombro.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πρὸ τοῦ συντελέσαι αὐτὸν λαλοῦντα ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ καὶ ἰδοὺ Ρεβεκκα ἐξεπορεύετο ἡ τεχθεῖσα Βαθουηλ υἱῷ Μελχας τῆς γυναικὸς Ναχωρ ἀδελφοῦ δὲ Αβρααμ ἔχουσα τὴν ὑδρίαν ἐπὶ τῶν ὤμων αὐτῆς

text_en: An exceeding comely maid, and a most beautiful virgin , and not known to man: and she went down to the spring, and filled her pitcher, and was coming back.
text_la: puella decora nimis, virgoque pulcherrima, et incognita viro : descenderat autem ad fontem, et impleverat hydriam, ac revertebatur.
text_pt: E a donzela era mui formosa à vista, virgem, a quem homem não havia conhecido; e desceu à fonte, e encheu o seu cântaro e subiu.
text_el: ἡ δὲ παρθένος ἦν καλὴ τῇ ὄψει σφόδρα παρθένος ἦν ἀνὴρ οὐκ ἔγνω αὐτήν καταβᾶσα δὲ ἐπὶ τὴν πηγὴν ἔπλησεν τὴν ὑδρίαν καὶ ἀνέβη

text_en: And the servant ran to meet her, and said: Give me a little water to drink of your pitcher.
text_la: Occurritque ei servus, et ait : Pauxillum aquæ mihi ad bibendum præbe de hydria tua.
text_pt: Então o servo correu-lhe ao encontro, e disse: Peço-te, deixa-me beber um pouco de água do teu cântaro.
text_el: ἐπέδραμεν δὲ ὁ παῖς εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν πότισόν με μικρὸν ὕδωρ ἐκ τῆς ὑδρίας σου

text_en: And she answered: Drink, my lord. And quickly she let down the pitcher upon her arm, and gave him drink.
text_la: Quæ respondit : Bibe, domine mi : celeriterque deposuit hydriam super ulnam suam, et dedit ei potum.
text_pt: E ela disse: Bebe, meu senhor. E apressou-se e abaixou o seu cântaro sobre a sua mão e deu-lhe de beber.
text_el: ἡ δὲ εἶπεν πίε κύριε καὶ ἔσπευσεν καὶ καθεῖλεν τὴν ὑδρίαν ἐπὶ τὸν βραχίονα αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπότισεν αὐτόν

text_en: And when he had drunk, she said: I will draw water for your camels also, till they all drink.
text_la: Cumque ille bibisset, adjecit : Quin et camelis tuis hauriam aquam, donec cuncti bibant.
text_pt: E, acabando ela de lhe dar de beber, disse: Tirarei também água para os teus camelos, até que acabem de beber.
text_el: ἕως ἐπαύσατο πίνων καὶ εἶπεν καὶ ταῖς καμήλοις σου ὑδρεύσομαι ἕως ἂν πᾶσαι πίωσιν

text_en: And pouring out the pitcher into the troughs, she ran back to the well to draw water; and having drawn, she gave to all the camels.
text_la: Effundensque hydriam in canalibus, recurrit ad puteum ut hauriret aquam : et haustam omnibus camelis dedit.
text_pt: E apressou-se, e despejou o seu cântaro no bebedouro, e correu outra vez ao poço para tirar água, e tirou para todos os seus camelos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσπευσεν καὶ ἐξεκένωσεν τὴν ὑδρίαν εἰς τὸ ποτιστήριον καὶ ἔδραμεν ἔτι ἐπὶ τὸ φρέαρ ἀντλῆσαι καὶ ὑδρεύσατο πάσαις ταῖς καμήλοις

text_en: But he musing, beheld her with silence, desirous to know whether the Lord had made his journey prosperous or not.
text_la: Ipse autem contemplabatur eam tacitus, scire volens utrum prosperum iter suum fecisset Dominus, an non.
text_pt: E o homem estava admirado de vê-la, calando-se, para saber se o Senhor havia prosperado a sua jornada ou não.
text_el: ὁ δὲ ἄνθρωπος κατεμάνθανεν αὐτὴν καὶ παρεσιώπα τοῦ γνῶναι εἰ εὐόδωκεν κύριος τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ ἢ οὔ

text_en: And after that the camels had drunk, the man took out golden earrings, weighing two sicles; and as many bracelets, of ten sicles weight.
text_la: Postquam autem biberunt cameli, protulit vir inaures aureas, appendentes siclos duos, et armillas totidem pondo siclorum decem.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, acabando os camelos de beber, tomou o homem um pendente de ouro de meio siclo de peso, e duas pulseiras para as suas mãos, do peso de dez siclos de ouro;
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἐπαύσαντο πᾶσαι αἱ κάμηλοι πίνουσαι ἔλαβεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐνώτια χρυσᾶ ἀνὰ δραχμὴν ὁλκῆς καὶ δύο ψέλια ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῆς δέκα χρυσῶν ὁλκὴ αὐτῶν

text_en: And he said to her: Whose daughter are you? Tell me: is there any place in your father's house to lodge?
text_la: Dixitque ad eam : Cujus es filia? indica mihi, est in domo patris tui locus ad manendum?
text_pt: E disse: De quem és filha? Faze-mo saber, peço-te. Há também em casa de teu pai lugar para nós pousarmos?
text_el: καὶ ἐπηρώτησεν αὐτὴν καὶ εἶπεν θυγάτηρ τίνος εἶ ἀνάγγειλόν μοι εἰ ἔστιν παρὰ τῷ πατρί σου τόπος ἡμῖν καταλῦσαι

text_en: And she answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Melcha, whom she bore to Nachor.
text_la: Quæ respondit : Filia sum Bathuelis, filii Melchæ, quem peperit ipsi Nachor.
text_pt: E ela lhe disse: Eu sou a filha de Betuel, filho de Milca, o qual ela deu a Naor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ θυγάτηρ Βαθουηλ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ τοῦ Μελχας ὃν ἔτεκεν τῷ Ναχωρ

text_en: And she said, moreover, to him: We have good store of both straw and hay, and a large place to lodge in.
text_la: Et addidit, dicens : Palearum quoque et fœni plurimum est apud nos, et locus spatiosus ad manendum.
text_pt: Disse-lhe mais: Também temos palha e muito pasto, e lugar para passar a noite.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἄχυρα καὶ χορτάσματα πολλὰ παρ' ἡμῖν καὶ τόπος τοῦ καταλῦσαι

text_en: The man bowed himself down, and adored the Lord ,
text_la: Inclinavit se homo, et adoravit Dominum,
text_pt: Então inclinou-se aquele homem e adorou ao Senhor,
text_el: καὶ εὐδοκήσας ὁ ἄνθρωπος προσεκύνησεν κυρίῳ

text_en: saying: Blessed be the Lord God of my master Abraham , who has not taken away his mercy and truth from my master, and has brought me the straight way into the house of my master's brother.
text_la: dicens : Benedictus Dominus Deus domini mei Abraham, qui non abstulit misericordiam et veritatem suam a domino meo, et recto itinere me perduxit in domum fratris domini mei.
text_pt: E disse: Bendito seja o SENHOR Deus de meu senhor Abraão, que não retirou a sua benevolência e a sua verdade de meu senhor; quanto a mim, o SENHOR me guiou no caminho à casa dos irmãos de meu senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν εὐλογητὸς κύριος ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου μου Αβρααμ ὃς οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπεν τὴν δικαιοσύνην αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀλήθειαν ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου μου ἐμὲ εὐόδωκεν κύριος εἰς οἶκον τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τοῦ κυρίου μου

text_en: Then the maid ran, and told in her mother's house all that she had heard.
text_la: Cucurrit itaque puella, et nuntiavit in domum matris suæ omnia quæ audierat.
text_pt: E a donzela correu, e fez saber estas coisas na casa de sua mãe.
text_el: καὶ δραμοῦσα ἡ παῖς ἀπήγγειλεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τῆς μητρὸς αὐτῆς κατὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα

text_en: And Rebecca had a brother, named Laban , who went out in haste to the man , to the well .
text_la: Habebat autem Rebecca fratrem nomine Laban, qui festinus egressus est ad hominem, ubi erat fons.
text_pt: E Rebeca tinha um irmão cujo nome era Labão, o qual correu ao encontro daquele homem até a fonte.
text_el: τῇ δὲ Ρεβεκκα ἀδελφὸς ἦν ᾧ ὄνομα Λαβαν καὶ ἔδραμεν Λαβαν πρὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἔξω ἐπὶ τὴν πηγήν

text_en: And when he had seen the earrings and bracelets in his sister's hands, and had heard all that she related, saying, Thus and thus the man spoke to me: he came to the man who stood by the camels, and near to the spring of water ,
text_la: Cumque vidisset inaures et armillas in manibus sororis suæ, et audisset cuncta verba referentis : Hæc locutus est mihi homo : venit ad virum qui stabat juxta camelos, et prope fontem aquæ:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, quando ele viu o pendente, e as pulseiras sobre as mãos de sua irmã, e quando ouviu as palavras de sua irmã Rebeca, que dizia: Assim me falou aquele homem; foi ter com o homem, que estava em pé junto aos camelos, à fonte,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα εἶδεν τὰ ἐνώτια καὶ τὰ ψέλια ἐπὶ τὰς χεῖρας τῆς ἀδελφῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ὅτε ἤκουσεν τὰ ῥήματα Ρεβεκκας τῆς ἀδελφῆς αὐτοῦ λεγούσης οὕτως λελάληκέν μοι ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον ἑστηκότος αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν καμήλων ἐπὶ τῆς πηγῆς

text_en: and said to him: Come in, you blessed of the Lord ; why are you standing outside? I have prepared the house, and a place for the camels.
text_la: dixitque ad eum : Ingredere, benedicte Domini : cur foris stas? præparavi domum, et locum camelis.
text_pt: E disse: Entra, bendito do Senhor; por que estás fora? pois eu já preparei a casa, e o lugar para os camelos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ δεῦρο εἴσελθε εὐλογητὸς κύριος ἵνα τί ἕστηκας ἔξω ἐγὼ δὲ ἡτοίμακα τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ τόπον ταῖς καμήλοις

text_en: And he brought him into his lodging; and he unharnessed the camels, and gave straw and hay, and water to wash his feet , and the feet of the men that had come with him.
text_la: Et introduxit eum in hospitium : ac destravit camelos, deditque paleas et fœnum, et aquam ad lavandos pedes ejus, et virorum qui venerant cum eo.
text_pt: Então veio aquele homem à casa, e desataram os camelos, e deram palha e pasto aos camelos, e água para lavar os pés dele, e os pés dos homens que estavam com ele.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ ὁ ἄνθρωπος εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ ἀπέσαξεν τὰς καμήλους καὶ ἔδωκεν ἄχυρα καὶ χορτάσματα ταῖς καμήλοις καὶ ὕδωρ νίψασθαι τοῖς ποσὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῖς ποσὶν τῶν ἀνδρῶν τῶν μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And bread was set before him. But he said: I will not eat, till I tell my message. He answered him: Speak.
text_la: Et appositus est in conspectu ejus panis. Qui ait : Non comedam, donec loquar sermones meos. Respondit ei : Loquere.
text_pt: Depois puseram comida diante dele. Ele, porém, disse: Não comerei, até que tenha dito as minhas palavras. E ele disse: Fala.
text_el: καὶ παρέθηκεν αὐτοῖς ἄρτους φαγεῖν καὶ εἶπεν οὐ μὴ φάγω ἕως τοῦ λαλῆσαί με τὰ ῥήματά μου καὶ εἶπαν λάλησον

text_en: And he said: I am the servant of Abraham :
text_la: At ille : Servus, inquit, Abraham sum:
text_pt: Então disse: Eu sou o servo de Abraão.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν παῖς Αβρααμ ἐγώ εἰμι

text_en: And the Lord has blessed my master wonderfully, and he has become great: and he has given him sheep and oxen, silver and gold, men servants and women servants, camels and asses.
text_la: et Dominus benedixit domino meo valde, magnificatusque est : et dedit ei oves et boves, argentum et aurum, servos et ancillas, camelos et asinos.
text_pt: E o SENHOR abençoou muito o meu senhor, de maneira que foi engrandecido, e deu-lhe ovelhas e vacas, e prata e ouro, e servos e servas, e camelos e jumentos.
text_el: κύριος δὲ εὐλόγησεν τὸν κύριόν μου σφόδρα καὶ ὑψώθη καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ πρόβατα καὶ μόσχους ἀργύριον καὶ χρυσίον παῖδας καὶ παιδίσκας καμήλους καὶ ὄνους

text_en: And Sara , my master's wife, has borne my master a son in her old age, and he has given him all that he had.
text_la: Et peperit Sara uxor domini mei filium domino meo in senectute sua, deditque illi omnia quæ habuerat.
text_pt: E Sara, a mulher do meu senhor, deu à luz um filho a meu senhor depois da sua velhice, e ele deu-lhe tudo quanto tem.
text_el: καὶ ἔτεκεν Σαρρα ἡ γυνὴ τοῦ κυρίου μου υἱὸν ἕνα τῷ κυρίῳ μου μετὰ τὸ γηρᾶσαι αὐτόν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὅσα ἦν αὐτῷ

text_en: And my master made me swear , saying: You shall not take a wife for my son of the Chanaanites , in whose land I dwell:
text_la: Et adjuravit me dominus meus, dicens : Non accipies uxorem filio meo de filiabus Chananæorum, in quorum terra habito:
text_pt: E meu senhor me fez jurar, dizendo: Não tomarás mulher para meu filho das filhas dos cananeus, em cuja terra habito;
text_el: καὶ ὥρκισέν με ὁ κύριός μου λέγων οὐ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα τῷ υἱῷ μου ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν Χαναναίων ἐν οἷς ἐγὼ παροικῶ ἐν τῇ γῇ αὐτῶν

text_en: But you shall go to my father's house, and shall take a wife of my own kindred for my son:
text_la: sed ad domum patris mei perges, et de cognatione mea accipies uxorem filio meo.
text_pt: Irás, porém, à casa de meu pai, e à minha família, e tomarás mulher para meu filho.
text_el: ἀλλ' ἢ εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου πορεύσῃ καὶ εἰς τὴν φυλήν μου καὶ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα τῷ υἱῷ μου ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: But I answered my master: What if the woman will not come with me?
text_la: Ego vero respondi domino meo : Quid si noluerit venire mecum mulier?
text_pt: Então disse eu ao meu senhor: Porventura não me seguirá a mulher.
text_el: εἶπα δὲ τῷ κυρίῳ μου μήποτε οὐ πορεύσεται ἡ γυνὴ μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: The Lord , said he, in whose sight I walk, will send his angel with you, and will direct your way: and you shall take a wife for my son of my own kindred , and of my father's house.
text_la: Dominus, ait, in cujus conspectu ambulo, mittet angelum suum tecum, et diriget viam tuam : accipiesque uxorem filio meo de cognatione mea, et de domo patris mei.
text_pt: E ele me disse: O Senhor, em cuja presença tenho andado, enviará o seu anjo contigo, e prosperará o teu caminho, para que tomes mulher para meu filho da minha família e da casa de meu pai;
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι κύριος ᾧ εὐηρέστησα ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς ἀποστελεῖ τὸν ἄγγελον αὐτοῦ μετὰ σοῦ καὶ εὐοδώσει τὴν ὁδόν σου καὶ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα τῷ υἱῷ μου ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς μου καὶ ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: But you shall be clear from my curse , when you shall come to my kindred , if they will not give you one.
text_la: Innocens eris a maledictione mea, cum veneris ad propinquos meos, et non dederint tibi.
text_pt: Então serás livre do meu juramento, quando fores à minha família; e se não te derem, livre serás do meu juramento.
text_el: τότε ἀθῷος ἔσῃ ἀπὸ τῆς ἀρᾶς μου ἡνίκα γὰρ ἐὰν ἔλθῃς εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν φυλὴν καὶ μή σοι δῶσιν καὶ ἔσῃ ἀθῷος ἀπὸ τοῦ ὁρκισμοῦ μου

text_en: And I came today to the well of water , and said: O Lord God of my master, Abraham , if you have prospered my way, wherein I now walk,
text_la: Veni ergo hodie ad fontem aquæ, et dixi : Domine Deus domini mei Abraham, si direxisti viam meam, in qua nunc ambulo,
text_pt: E hoje cheguei à fonte, e disse: Ó Senhor, Deus de meu senhor Abraão, se tu agora prosperas o meu caminho, no qual eu ando,
text_el: καὶ ἐλθὼν σήμερον ἐπὶ τὴν πηγὴν εἶπα κύριε ὁ θεὸς τοῦ κυρίου μου Αβρααμ εἰ σὺ εὐοδοῖς τὴν ὁδόν μου ἣν νῦν ἐγὼ πορεύομαι ἐπ' αὐτήν

text_en: behold, I stand by the well of water , and the virgin , that shall come out to draw water, who shall hear me say: Give me a little water to drink of your pitcher:
text_la: ecce sto juxta fontem aquæ, et virgo, quæ egredietur ad hauriendam aquam, audierit a me : Da mihi pauxillum aquæ ad bibendum ex hydria tua:
text_pt: Eis que estou junto à fonte de água; seja, pois, que a donzela que sair para tirar água e à qual eu disser: Peço-te, dá-me um pouco de água do teu cântaro;
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἐφέστηκα ἐπὶ τῆς πηγῆς τοῦ ὕδατος καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες τῶν ἀνθρώπων τῆς πόλεως ἐξελεύσονται ὑδρεύσασθαι ὕδωρ καὶ ἔσται ἡ παρθένος ᾗ ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω πότισόν με μικρὸν ὕδωρ ἐκ τῆς ὑδρίας σου

text_en: And shall say to me: Both drink thou, and I will also draw for your camels: let the same be the woman , whom the Lord has prepared for my master's son.
text_la: et dixerit mihi : Et tu bibe, et camelis tuis hauriam : ipsa est mulier, quam præparavit Dominus filio domini mei.
text_pt: E ela me disser: Bebe tu e também tirarei água para os teus camelos; esta seja a mulher que o SENHOR designou ao filho de meu senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἴπῃ μοι καὶ σὺ πίε καὶ ταῖς καμήλοις σου ὑδρεύσομαι αὕτη ἡ γυνή ἣν ἡτοίμασεν κύριος τῷ ἑαυτοῦ θεράποντι Ισαακ καὶ ἐν τούτῳ γνώσομαι ὅτι πεποίηκας ἔλεος τῷ κυρίῳ μου Αβρααμ

text_en: And whilst I pondered these things secretly with myself, Rebecca appeared, coming with a pitcher, which she carried on her shoulder: and she went down to the well and drew water. And I said to her: Give me a little to drink.
text_la: Dumque hæc tacitus mecum volverem, apparuit Rebecca veniens cum hydria, quam portabat in scapula : descenditque ad fontem, et hausit aquam. Et aio ad eam : Da mihi paululum bibere.
text_pt: E antes que eu acabasse de falar no meu coração, eis que Rebeca saía com o seu cântaro sobre o seu ombro, desceu à fonte e tirou água; e eu lhe disse: Peço-te, dá-me de beber.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πρὸ τοῦ συντελέσαι με λαλοῦντα ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ εὐθὺς Ρεβεκκα ἐξεπορεύετο ἔχουσα τὴν ὑδρίαν ἐπὶ τῶν ὤμων καὶ κατέβη ἐπὶ τὴν πηγὴν καὶ ὑδρεύσατο εἶπα δὲ αὐτῇ πότισόν με

text_en: And she speedily let down the pitcher from her shoulder, and said to me: Both drink thou, and to your camels I will give drink. I drank, and she watered the camels.
text_la: Quæ festinans deposuit hydriam de humero, et dixit mihi : Et tu bibe, et camelis tuis tribuam potum. Bibi, et adaquavit camelos.
text_pt: E ela se apressou, e abaixou o seu cântaro de sobre si, e disse: Bebe, e também darei de beber aos teus camelos; e bebi, e ela deu também de beber aos camelos.
text_el: καὶ σπεύσασα καθεῖλεν τὴν ὑδρίαν αὐτῆς ἀφ' ἑαυτῆς καὶ εἶπεν πίε σύ καὶ τὰς καμήλους σου ποτιῶ καὶ ἔπιον καὶ τὰς καμήλους μου ἐπότισεν

text_en: And I asked her, and said: Whose daughter are you? And she answered: I am the daughter of Bathuel, the son of Nachor, whom Melcha bore to him. So I put earrings on her to adorn her face, and I put bracelets on her hands.
text_la: Interrogavique eam, et dixi : Cujus es filia? Quæ respondit : Filia Bathuelis sum, filii Nachor, quem peperit ei Melcha. Suspendi itaque inaures ad ornandam faciem ejus, et armillas posui in manibus ejus.
text_pt: Então lhe perguntei, e disse: De quem és filha? E ela disse: Filha de Betuel, filho de Naor, que lhe deu Milca. Então eu pus o pendente no seu rosto, e as pulseiras sobre as suas mãos;
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτησα αὐτὴν καὶ εἶπα τίνος εἶ θυγάτηρ ἡ δὲ ἔφη θυγάτηρ Βαθουηλ εἰμὶ τοῦ υἱοῦ Ναχωρ ὃν ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ Μελχα καὶ περιέθηκα αὐτῇ τὰ ἐνώτια καὶ τὰ ψέλια περὶ τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῆς

text_en: And falling down, I adored the Lord , blessing the Lord God of my master, Abraham , who has brought me the straight way to take the daughter of my master's brother for his son.
text_la: Pronusque adoravi Dominum, benedicens Domino Deo domini mei Abraham, qui perduxit me recto itinere, ut sumerem filiam fratris domini mei filio ejus.
text_pt: E inclinando-me adorei ao SENHOR, e bendisse ao SENHOR, Deus do meu senhor Abraão, que me havia encaminhado pelo caminho da verdade, para tomar a filha do irmão de meu senhor para seu filho.
text_el: καὶ εὐδοκήσας προσεκύνησα κυρίῳ καὶ εὐλόγησα κύριον τὸν θεὸν τοῦ κυρίου μου Αβρααμ ὃς εὐόδωσέν μοι ἐν ὁδῷ ἀληθείας λαβεῖν τὴν θυγατέρα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τοῦ κυρίου μου τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Wherefore, if you do according to mercy and truth with my master, tell me: but if it please you otherwise, tell me that also, that I may go to the right hand, or to the left.
