text_la: Quam ob rem si facitis misericordiam et veritatem cum domino meo, indicate mihi : sin autem aliud placet, et hoc dicite mihi, ut vadam ad dextram, sive ad sinistram.
text_pt: Agora, pois, se vós haveis de fazer benevolência e verdade a meu senhor, fazei-mo saber; e se não, também mo fazei saber, para que eu vá à direita, ou à esquerda.
text_el: εἰ οὖν ποιεῖτε ὑμεῖς ἔλεος καὶ δικαιοσύνην πρὸς τὸν κύριόν μου ἀπαγγείλατέ μοι εἰ δὲ μή ἀπαγγείλατέ μοι ἵνα ἐπιστρέψω εἰς δεξιὰν ἢ εἰς ἀριστεράν

text_en: And Laban and Bathuel answered: The word has proceeded from the Lord : we cannot speak any other thing to you but his pleasure.
text_la: Responderuntque Laban et Bathuel : A Domino egressus est sermo : non possumus extra placitum ejus quidquam aliud loqui tecum.
text_pt: Então responderam Labão e Betuel, e disseram: Do Senhor procedeu este negócio; não podemos falar-te mal ou bem.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Λαβαν καὶ Βαθουηλ εἶπαν παρὰ κυρίου ἐξῆλθεν τὸ πρόσταγμα τοῦτο οὐ δυνησόμεθα οὖν σοι ἀντειπεῖν κακὸν καλῷ

text_en: Behold, Rebecca is before you, take her and go your way, and let her be the wife of your master's son, as the Lord has spoken.
text_la: En Rebecca coram te est, tolle eam, et proficiscere, et sit uxor filii domini tui, sicut locutus est Dominus.
text_pt: Eis que Rebeca está diante da tua face; toma-a, e vai-te; seja a mulher do filho de teu senhor, como tem dito o SENHOR.
text_el: ἰδοὺ Ρεβεκκα ἐνώπιόν σου λαβὼν ἀπότρεχε καὶ ἔστω γυνὴ τῷ υἱῷ τοῦ κυρίου σου καθὰ ἐλάλησεν κύριος

text_en: Which when Abraham's servant heard, falling down to the ground, he adored the Lord .
text_la: Quod cum audisset puer Abraham, procidens adoravit in terram Dominum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, o servo de Abraão, ouvindo as suas palavras, inclinou-se à terra diante do Senhor.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαι τὸν παῖδα τὸν Αβρααμ τῶν ῥημάτων τούτων προσεκύνησεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν κυρίῳ

text_en: And bringing forth vessels of silver and gold, and garments, he gave them to Rebecca, for a present. He offered gifts also to her brothers, and to her mother.
text_la: Prolatisque vasis argenteis, et aureis, ac vestibus, dedit ea Rebeccæ pro munere : fratribus quoque ejus et matri dona obtulit.
text_pt: E tirou o servo jóias de prata e jóias de ouro, e vestidos, e deu-os a Rebeca; também deu coisas preciosas a seu irmão e à sua mãe.
text_el: καὶ ἐξενέγκας ὁ παῖς σκεύη ἀργυρᾶ καὶ χρυσᾶ καὶ ἱματισμὸν ἔδωκεν Ρεβεκκα καὶ δῶρα ἔδωκεν τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτῆς καὶ τῇ μητρὶ αὐτῆς

text_en: And a banquet was made, and they ate and drank together, and lodged there. And in the morning, the servant arose, and said: Let me depart, that I may go to my master.
text_la: Inito convivio, vescentes pariter et bibentes manserunt ibi. Surgens autem mane, locutus est puer : Dimitte me, ut vadam ad dominum meum.
text_pt: Então comeram e beberam, ele e os homens que com ele estavam, e passaram a noite. E levantaram-se pela manhã, e disse: Deixai-me ir a meu senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἔπιον αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ μετ' αὐτοῦ ὄντες καὶ ἐκοιμήθησαν καὶ ἀναστὰς πρωὶ εἶπεν ἐκπέμψατέ με ἵνα ἀπέλθω πρὸς τὸν κύριόν μου

text_en: And her brother and mother answered: Let the maid stay, at least, ten days with us, and afterwards she shall depart.
text_la: Responderuntque fratres ejus et mater : Maneat puella saltem decem dies apud nos, et postea proficiscetur.
text_pt: Então disseram seu irmão e sua mãe: Fique a donzela conosco alguns dias, ou pelo menos dez dias, depois irá.
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῆς καὶ ἡ μήτηρ μεινάτω ἡ παρθένος μεθ' ἡμῶν ἡμέρας ὡσεὶ δέκα καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἀπελεύσεται

text_en: Stay me not, said he, because the Lord has prospered my way: send me away, that I may go to my master.
text_la: Nolite, ait, me retinere, quia Dominus direxit viam meam : dimittite me ut pergam ad dominum meum.
text_pt: Ele, porém, lhes disse: Não me detenhais, pois o SENHOR tem prosperado o meu caminho; deixai-me partir, para que eu volte a meu senhor.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς μὴ κατέχετέ με καὶ κύριος εὐόδωσεν τὴν ὁδόν μου ἐκπέμψατέ με ἵνα ἀπέλθω πρὸς τὸν κύριόν μου

text_en: And they said: Let us call the maid, and ask her will.
text_la: Et dixerunt : Vocemus puellam, et quæramus ipsius voluntatem.
text_pt: E disseram: Chamemos a donzela, e perguntemos-lho.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν καλέσωμεν τὴν παῖδα καὶ ἐρωτήσωμεν τὸ στόμα αὐτῆς

text_en: And they called her, and when she had come, they asked: Will you go with this man ? She said: I will go.
text_la: Cumque vocata venisset, sciscitati sunt : Vis ire cum homine isto? Quæ ait : Vadam.
text_pt: E chamaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: Irás tu com este homem? Ela respondeu: Irei.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσαν Ρεβεκκαν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῇ πορεύσῃ μετὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου ἡ δὲ εἶπεν πορεύσομαι

text_en: So they sent her away, and her nurse, and Abraham's servant, and his company.
text_la: Dimiserunt ergo eam, et nutricem illius, servumque Abraham, et comites ejus,
text_pt: Então despediram a Rebeca, sua irmã, e sua ama, e o servo de Abraão, e seus homens.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέπεμψαν Ρεβεκκαν τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτῆς καὶ τὸν παῖδα τὸν Αβρααμ καὶ τοὺς μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Wishing prosperity to their sister, and saying: You are our sister, may you increase to thousands of thousands; and may your seed possess the gates of their enemies.
text_la: imprecantes prospera sorori suæ, atque dicentes : Soror nostra es, crescas in mille millia, et possideat semen tuum portas inimicorum suorum.
text_pt: E abençoaram a Rebeca, e disseram-lhe: Ó nossa irmã, sê tu a mãe de milhares de milhares, e que a tua descendência possua a porta de seus aborrecedores!
text_el: καὶ εὐλόγησαν Ρεβεκκαν τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῇ ἀδελφὴ ἡμῶν εἶ γίνου εἰς χιλιάδας μυριάδων καὶ κληρονομησάτω τὸ σπέρμα σου τὰς πόλεις τῶν ὑπεναντίων

text_en: So Rebecca and her maids, being set upon camels, followed the man : who with speed returned to his master.
text_la: Igitur Rebecca et puellæ illius, ascensis camelis, secutæ sunt virum : qui festinus revertebatur ad dominum suum.
text_pt: E Rebeca se levantou com as suas moças, e subiram sobre os camelos, e seguiram o homem; e tomou aquele servo a Rebeca, e partiu.
text_el: ἀναστᾶσα δὲ Ρεβεκκα καὶ αἱ ἅβραι αὐτῆς ἐπέβησαν ἐπὶ τὰς καμήλους καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν μετὰ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἀναλαβὼν ὁ παῖς τὴν Ρεβεκκαν ἀπῆλθεν

text_en: At the same time, Isaac was walking along the way to the well which is called Of the living and the seeing : for he dwelt in the south country:
text_la: Eo autem tempore deambulabat Isaac per viam quæ ducit ad puteum, cujus nomen est Viventis et videntis : habitabat enim in terra australi:
text_pt: Ora, Isaque vinha de onde se vem do poço de Beer-Laai-Rói; porque habitava na terra do sul.
text_el: Ισαακ δὲ ἐπορεύετο διὰ τῆς ἐρήμου κατὰ τὸ φρέαρ τῆς ὁράσεως αὐτὸς δὲ κατῴκει ἐν τῇ γῇ τῇ πρὸς λίβα

text_en: And he had gone forth to meditate in the field, the day being now well spent: and when he had lifted up his eyes, he saw camels coming afar off.
text_la: et egressus fuerat ad meditandum in agro, inclinata jam die : cumque elevasset oculos, vidit camelos venientes procul.
text_pt: E Isaque saíra a orar no campo, à tarde; e levantou os seus olhos, e olhou, e eis que os camelos vinham.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ισαακ ἀδολεσχῆσαι εἰς τὸ πεδίον τὸ πρὸς δείλης καὶ ἀναβλέψας τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς εἶδεν καμήλους ἐρχομένας

text_en: Rebecca also, when she saw Isaac , lighted off the camel,
text_la: Rebecca quoque, conspecto Isaac, descendit de camelo,
text_pt: Rebeca também levantou seus olhos, e viu a Isaque, e desceu do camelo.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβλέψασα Ρεβεκκα τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς εἶδεν τὸν Ισαακ καὶ κατεπήδησεν ἀπὸ τῆς καμήλου

text_en: and said to the servant: Who is that man who comes towards us along the field? And he said to her: That man is my master. But she quickly took her cloak, and covered herself.
text_la: et ait ad puerum : Quis est ille homo qui venit per agrum in occursum nobis? Dixitque ei : Ipse est dominus meus. At illa tollens cito pallium, operuit se.
text_pt: E disse ao servo: Quem é aquele homem que vem pelo campo ao nosso encontro? E o servo disse: Este é meu senhor. Então tomou ela o véu e cobriu-se.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ παιδί τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος ὁ πορευόμενος ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ εἰς συνάντησιν ἡμῖν εἶπεν δὲ ὁ παῖς οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ κύριός μου ἡ δὲ λαβοῦσα τὸ θέριστρον περιεβάλετο

text_en: And the servant told Isaac all that he had done.
text_la: Servus autem cuncta, quæ gesserat, narravit Isaac.
text_pt: E o servo contou a Isaque todas as coisas que fizera.
text_el: καὶ διηγήσατο ὁ παῖς τῷ Ισαακ πάντα τὰ ῥήματα ἃ ἐποίησεν

text_en: Who brought her into the tent of Sara his mother, and took her to wife : and he loved her so much, that it moderated the sorrow which was occasioned by his mother's death.
text_la: Qui introduxit eam in tabernaculum Saræ matris suæ, et accepit eam uxorem : et in tantum dilexit eam, ut dolorem, qui ex morte matris ejus acciderat, temperaret.
text_pt: E Isaque trouxe-a para a tenda de sua mãe Sara, e tomou a Rebeca, e foi-lhe por mulher, e amou-a. Assim Isaque foi consolado depois da morte de sua mãe.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Ισαακ εἰς τὸν οἶκον τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν Ρεβεκκαν καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτοῦ γυνή καὶ ἠγάπησεν αὐτήν καὶ παρεκλήθη Ισαακ περὶ Σαρρας τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Abraham married another wife named Cetura:
text_la: Abraham vero aliam duxit uxorem nomine Ceturam:
text_pt: E Abraão tomou outra mulher; e o seu nome era Quetura;
text_el: προσθέμενος δὲ Αβρααμ ἔλαβεν γυναῖκα ᾗ ὄνομα Χεττουρα

text_en: Who bore him Zamram, and Jecsan, and Madan, and Madian , and Jesboc, and Sue.
text_la: quæ peperit ei Zamran et Jecsan, et Madan, et Madian, et Jesboc, et Sue.
text_pt: E deu-lhe à luz Zinrã, Jocsã, Medã, Midiã, Jisbaque e Suá.
text_el: ἔτεκεν δὲ αὐτῷ τὸν Ζεμραν καὶ τὸν Ιεξαν καὶ τὸν Μαδαν καὶ τὸν Μαδιαμ καὶ τὸν Ιεσβοκ καὶ τὸν Σωυε

text_en: Jecsan also begot Saba , and Dadan. The children of Dadan were Assurim, and Latusim, and Loomim.
text_la: Jecsan quoque genuit Saba et Dadan. Filii Dadan fuerunt Assurim, et Latusim, et Loomin.
text_pt: E Jocsã gerou Seba e Dedã; e os filhos de Dedã foram Assurim, Letusim e Leumim.
text_el: Ιεξαν δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Σαβα καὶ τὸν Θαιμαν καὶ τὸν Δαιδαν υἱοὶ δὲ Δαιδαν ἐγένοντο Ραγουηλ καὶ Ναβδεηλ καὶ Ασσουριιμ καὶ Λατουσιιμ καὶ Λοωμιμ

text_en: But of Madian was born Epha, and Opher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaa: all these were the children of Cetura.
text_la: At vero ex Madian ortus est Epha, et Opher, et Henoch, et Abida, et Eldaa : omnes hi filii Ceturæ.
text_pt: E os filhos de Midiã foram Efá, Efer, Enoque, Abida e Elda. Estes todos foram filhos de Quetura.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Μαδιαμ Γαιφα καὶ Αφερ καὶ Ενωχ καὶ Αβιρα καὶ Ελραγα πάντες οὗτοι ἦσαν υἱοὶ Χεττουρας

text_en: And Abraham gave all his possessions to Isaac :
text_la: Deditque Abraham cuncta quæ possederat, Isaac:
text_pt: Porém Abraão deu tudo o que tinha a Isaque;
text_el: ἔδωκεν δὲ Αβρααμ πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ Ισαακ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And to the children of the concubines he gave gifts, and separated them from Isaac his son, while he yet lived, to the east country.
text_la: filiis autem concubinarum largitus est munera, et separavit eos ab Isaac filio suo, dum adhuc ipse viveret, ad plagam orientalem.
text_pt: Mas aos filhos das concubinas que Abraão tinha, deu Abraão presentes e, vivendo ele ainda, despediu-os do seu filho Isaque, enviando-os ao oriente, para a terra oriental.
text_el: καὶ τοῖς υἱοῖς τῶν παλλακῶν αὐτοῦ ἔδωκεν Αβρααμ δόματα καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ Ισαακ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ ἔτι ζῶντος αὐτοῦ πρὸς ἀνατολὰς εἰς γῆν ἀνατολῶν

text_en: And the days of Abraham's life were a hundred and seventy-five years.
text_la: Fuerunt autem dies vitæ Abrahæ, centum septuaginta quinque anni.
text_pt: Estes, pois, são os dias dos anos da vida de Abraão, que viveu cento e setenta e cinco anos.
text_el: ταῦτα δὲ τὰ ἔτη ἡμερῶν ζωῆς Αβρααμ ὅσα ἔζησεν ἑκατὸν ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε ἔτη

text_en: And decaying he died in a good old age, and having lived a long time, and being full of days: and was gathered to his people .
text_la: Et deficiens mortuus est in senectute bona, provectæque ætatis et plenus dierum : congregatusque est ad populum suum.
text_pt: E Abraão expirou, morrendo em boa velhice, velho e farto de dias; e foi congregado ao seu povo;
text_el: καὶ ἐκλιπὼν ἀπέθανεν Αβρααμ ἐν γήρει καλῷ πρεσβύτης καὶ πλήρης ἡμερῶν καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Isaac and Ismael his sons buried him in the double cave , which was situated in the field of Ephron the son of Seor the Hethite , over against Mambre,
text_la: Et sepelierunt eum Isaac et Ismaël filii sui in spelunca duplici, quæ sita est in agro Ephron filii Seor Hethæi, e regione Mambre,
text_pt: E Isaque e Ismael, seus filhos, sepultaram-no na cova de Macpela, no campo de Efrom, filho de Zoar, heteu, que estava em frente de Manre,
text_el: καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν Ισαακ καὶ Ισμαηλ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον τὸ διπλοῦν εἰς τὸν ἀγρὸν Εφρων τοῦ Σααρ τοῦ Χετταίου ὅ ἐστιν ἀπέναντι Μαμβρη

text_en: which he had bought of the children of Heth : there was he buried, and Sara his wife.
text_la: quem emerat a filiis Heth : ibi sepultus est ipse, et Sara uxor ejus.
text_pt: O campo que Abraão comprara aos filhos de Hete. Ali está sepultado Abraão e Sara, sua mulher.
text_el: τὸν ἀγρὸν καὶ τὸ σπήλαιον ὃ ἐκτήσατο Αβρααμ παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Χετ ἐκεῖ ἔθαψαν Αβρααμ καὶ Σαρραν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And after his death, God blessed Isaac his son, who dwelt by the well named Of the living and seeing .
text_la: Et post obitum illius benedixit Deus Isaac filio ejus, qui habitabat juxta puteum nomine Viventis et videntis.
text_pt: E aconteceu depois da morte de Abraão, que Deus abençoou a Isaque seu filho; e habitava Isaque junto ao poço Beer-Laai-Rói.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν Αβρααμ εὐλόγησεν ὁ θεὸς Ισαακ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ κατῴκησεν Ισαακ παρὰ τὸ φρέαρ τῆς ὁράσεως

text_en: These are the generations of Ismael the son of Abraham , whom Agar the Egyptian , Sara's servant, bore unto him:
text_la: Hæ sunt generationes Ismaël filii Abrahæ, quem peperit ei Agar Ægyptia, famula Saræ : et
text_pt: Estas, porém, são as gerações de Ismael filho de Abraão, que a serva de Sara, Agar, egípcia, deu a Abraão.
text_el: αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις Ισμαηλ τοῦ υἱοῦ Αβρααμ ὃν ἔτεκεν Αγαρ ἡ παιδίσκη Σαρρας τῷ Αβρααμ

text_en: And these are the names of his children according to their calling and generations . The firstborn of Ismael was Nabajoth, then Cedar , and Adbeel, and Mabsam,
text_la: hæc nomina filiorum ejus in vocabulis et generationibus suis. Primogenitus Ismaëlis Nabaioth, deinde Cedar, et Adbeel, et Mabsam,
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Ismael, pelos seus nomes, segundo as suas gerações: O primogênito de Ismael era Nebaiote, depois Quedar, Adbeel e Mibsão,
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ισμαηλ κατ' ὄνομα τῶν γενεῶν αὐτοῦ πρωτότοκος Ισμαηλ Ναβαιωθ καὶ Κηδαρ καὶ Ναβδεηλ καὶ Μασσαμ

text_en: and Masma, and Duma, and Massa,
text_la: Masma quoque, et Duma, et Massa,
text_pt: Misma, Dumá, Massá,
text_el: καὶ Μασμα καὶ Ιδουμα καὶ Μασση

text_en: Hadar, and Thema, and Jethur, and Naphis, and Cedma.
text_la: Hadar, et Thema, et Jethur, et Naphis, et Cedma.
text_pt: Hadade, Tema, Jetur, Nafis e Quedemá.
text_el: καὶ Χοδδαδ καὶ Θαιμαν καὶ Ιετουρ καὶ Ναφες καὶ Κεδμα

text_en: These are the sons of Ismael : and these are their names by their castles and towns, twelve princes of their tribes.
text_la: Isti sunt filii Ismaëlis : et hæc nomina per castella et oppida eorum, duodecim principes tribuum suarum.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Ismael, e estes são os seus nomes pelas suas vilas e pelos seus castelos; doze príncipes segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: οὗτοί εἰσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισμαηλ καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς σκηναῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἐπαύλεσιν αὐτῶν δώδεκα ἄρχοντες κατὰ ἔθνη αὐτῶν

text_en: And the years of Ismael's life were a hundred and thirty-seven, and decaying he died, and was gathered unto his people .
text_la: Et facti sunt anni vitæ Ismaëlis centum triginta septem, deficiensque mortuus est, et appositus ad populum suum.
text_pt: E estes são os anos da vida de Ismael, cento e trinta e sete anos, e ele expirou e, morrendo, foi congregado ao seu povo.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ἔτη τῆς ζωῆς Ισμαηλ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἑπτὰ ἔτη καὶ ἐκλιπὼν ἀπέθανεν καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸ γένος αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he dwelt from Hevila as far as Sur, which looks towards Egypt , to them that go towards the Assyrians . He died in the presence of all his brethren .
text_la: Habitavit autem ab Hevila usque Sur, quæ respicit Ægyptum introëuntibus Assyrios; coram cunctis fratribus suis obiit.
text_pt: E habitaram desde Havilá até Sur, que está em frente do Egito, como quem vai para a Assíria; e fez o seu assento diante da face de todos os seus irmãos.
text_el: κατῴκησεν δὲ ἀπὸ Ευιλατ ἕως Σουρ ἥ ἐστιν κατὰ πρόσωπον Αἰγύπτου ἕως ἐλθεῖν πρὸς Ἀσσυρίους κατὰ πρόσωπον πάντων τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ κατῴκησεν

text_en: These also are the generations of Isaac the son of Abraham : Abraham begot Isaac :
text_la: Hæ quoque sunt generationes Isaac filii Abraham : Abraham genuit Isaac:
text_pt: E estas são as gerações de Isaque, filho de Abraão: Abraão gerou a Isaque;
text_el: καὶ αὗται αἱ γενέσεις Ισαακ τοῦ υἱοῦ Αβρααμ Αβρααμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ισαακ

text_en: Who when he was forty years old, took to wife Rebecca the daughter of Bathuel the Syrian of Mesopotamia, sister to Laban .
text_la: qui cum quadraginta esset annorum, duxit uxorem Rebeccam filiam Bathuelis Syri de Mesopotamia, sororem Laban.
text_pt: E era Isaque da idade de quarenta anos, quando tomou por mulher a Rebeca, filha de Betuel, arameu de Padã-Arã, irmã de Labão, arameu.
text_el: ἦν δὲ Ισαακ ἐτῶν τεσσαράκοντα ὅτε ἔλαβεν τὴν Ρεβεκκαν θυγατέρα Βαθουηλ τοῦ Σύρου ἐκ τῆς Μεσοποταμίας ἀδελφὴν Λαβαν τοῦ Σύρου ἑαυτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: And Isaac besought the Lord for his wife, because she was barren: and he heard him, and made Rebecca to conceive.
text_la: Deprecatusque est Isaac Dominum pro uxore sua, eo quod esset sterilis : qui exaudivit eum, et dedit conceptum Rebeccæ.
text_pt: E Isaque orou insistentemente ao Senhor por sua mulher, porquanto era estéril; e o Senhor ouviu as suas orações, e Rebeca sua mulher concebeu.
text_el: ἐδεῖτο δὲ Ισαακ κυρίου περὶ Ρεβεκκας τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ ὅτι στεῖρα ἦν ἐπήκουσεν δὲ αὐτοῦ ὁ θεός καὶ ἔλαβεν ἐν γαστρὶ Ρεβεκκα ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ

text_en: But the children struggled in her womb, and she said: If it were to be so with me, what need was there to conceive? And she went to consult the Lord .
text_la: Sed collidebantur in utero ejus parvuli; quæ ait : Si sic mihi futurum erat, quid necesse fuit concipere? perrexitque ut consuleret Dominum.
text_pt: E os filhos lutavam dentro dela; então disse: Se assim é, por que sou eu assim? E foi perguntar ao Senhor.
text_el: ἐσκίρτων δὲ τὰ παιδία ἐν αὐτῇ εἶπεν δέ εἰ οὕτως μοι μέλλει γίνεσθαι ἵνα τί μοι τοῦτο ἐπορεύθη δὲ πυθέσθαι παρὰ κυρίου

text_en: And he answering, said: Two nations are in your womb, and two peoples shall be divided out of your womb, and one people shall overcome the other, and the elder shall serve the younger.
text_la: Qui respondens ait : Duæ gentes sunt in utero tuo, et duo populi ex ventre tuo dividentur, populusque populum superabit, et major serviet minori.
text_pt: E o Senhor lhe disse: Duas nações há no teu ventre, e dois povos se dividirão das tuas entranhas, e um povo será mais forte do que o outro povo, e o maior servirá ao menor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν κύριος αὐτῇ δύο ἔθνη ἐν τῇ γαστρί σού εἰσιν καὶ δύο λαοὶ ἐκ τῆς κοιλίας σου διασταλήσονται καὶ λαὸς λαοῦ ὑπερέξει καὶ ὁ μείζων δουλεύσει τῷ ἐλάσσονι

text_en: And when her time had come to be delivered, behold twins were found in her womb.
text_la: Jam tempus pariendi advenerat, et ecce gemini in utero ejus reperti sunt.
text_pt: E cumprindo-se os seus dias para dar à luz, eis gêmeos no seu ventre.
text_el: καὶ ἐπληρώθησαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ τεκεῖν αὐτήν καὶ τῇδε ἦν δίδυμα ἐν τῇ κοιλίᾳ αὐτῆς

text_en: He that came forth first was red, and hairy like a skin: and his name was called Esau . Immediately the other coming forth, held his brother's foot in his hand: and therefore he was called Jacob .
text_la: Qui prior egressus est, rufus erat, et totus in morem pellis hispidus : vocatumque est nomen ejus Esau. Protinus alter egrediens, plantam fratris tenebat manu : et idcirco appellavit eum Jacob.
text_pt: E saiu o primeiro ruivo e todo como um vestido de pêlo; por isso chamaram o seu nome Esaú.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ ὁ υἱὸς ὁ πρωτότοκος πυρράκης ὅλος ὡσεὶ δορὰ δασύς ἐπωνόμασεν δὲ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ησαυ

text_en: Isaac was threescore years old when the children were born unto him.
text_la: Sexagenarius erat Isaac quando nati sunt ei parvuli.
text_pt: E depois saiu o seu irmão, agarrada sua mão ao calcanhar de Esaú; por isso se chamou o seu nome Jacó. E era Isaque da idade de sessenta anos quando os gerou.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο ἐξῆλθεν ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἡ χεὶρ αὐτοῦ ἐπειλημμένη τῆς πτέρνης Ησαυ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ιακωβ Ισαακ δὲ ἦν ἐτῶν ἑξήκοντα ὅτε ἔτεκεν αὐτοὺς Ρεβεκκα

text_en: And when they were grown up, Esau became a skilful hunter, and a husbandman: but Jacob , a plain man , dwelt in tents.
text_la: Quibus adultis, factus est Esau vir gnarus venandi, et homo agricola : Jacob autem vir simplex habitabat in tabernaculis.
text_pt: E cresceram os meninos, e Esaú foi homem perito na caça, homem do campo; mas Jacó era homem simples, habitando em tendas.
text_el: ηὐξήθησαν δὲ οἱ νεανίσκοι καὶ ἦν Ησαυ ἄνθρωπος εἰδὼς κυνηγεῖν ἄγροικος Ιακωβ δὲ ἦν ἄνθρωπος ἄπλαστος οἰκῶν οἰκίαν

text_en: Isaac loved Esau , because he ate of his hunting: and Rebecca loved Jacob .
text_la: Isaac amabat Esau, eo quod de venationibus illius vesceretur : et Rebecca diligebat Jacob.
text_pt: E amava Isaque a Esaú, porque a caça era de seu gosto, mas Rebeca amava a Jacó.
text_el: ἠγάπησεν δὲ Ισαακ τὸν Ησαυ ὅτι ἡ θήρα αὐτοῦ βρῶσις αὐτῷ Ρεβεκκα δὲ ἠγάπα τὸν Ιακωβ

text_en: And Jacob boiled pottage: to whom Esau , coming faint out of the field,
text_la: Coxit autem Jacob pulmentum: ad quem cum venisset Esau de agro lassus,
text_pt: E Jacó cozera um guisado; e veio Esaú do campo, e estava ele cansado;
text_el: ἥψησεν δὲ Ιακωβ ἕψεμα ἦλθεν δὲ Ησαυ ἐκ τοῦ πεδίου ἐκλείπων

text_en: said: Give me of this red pottage, for I am exceeding faint. For which reason his name was called Edom .
text_la: ait : Da mihi de coctione hac rufa, quia oppido lassus sum. Quam ob causam vocatum est nomen ejus Edom.
text_pt: E disse Esaú a Jacó: Deixa-me, peço-te, comer desse guisado vermelho, porque estou cansado. Por isso se chamou Edom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ησαυ τῷ Ιακωβ γεῦσόν με ἀπὸ τοῦ ἑψέματος τοῦ πυρροῦ τούτου ὅτι ἐκλείπω διὰ τοῦτο ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Εδωμ

text_en: And Jacob said to him: Sell me your first birthright.
text_la: Cui dixit Jacob : Vende mihi primogenita tua.
text_pt: Então disse Jacó: Vende-me hoje a tua primogenitura.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ τῷ Ησαυ ἀπόδου μοι σήμερον τὰ πρωτοτόκιά σου ἐμοί

text_en: He answered: Lo I die, what will the first birthright avail me?
text_la: Ille respondit : En morior, quid mihi proderunt primogenita?
text_pt: E disse Esaú: Eis que estou a ponto de morrer; para que me servirá a primogenitura?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ησαυ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ πορεύομαι τελευτᾶν καὶ ἵνα τί μοι ταῦτα τὰ πρωτοτόκια

text_en: Jacob said: Swear therefore to me. Esau swore to him, and sold his first birthright.
text_la: Ait Jacob : Jura ergo mihi. Juravit ei Esau et vendidit primogenita.
text_pt: Então disse Jacó: Jura-me hoje. E jurou-lhe e vendeu a sua primogenitura a Jacó.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ιακωβ ὄμοσόν μοι σήμερον καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ ἀπέδοτο δὲ Ησαυ τὰ πρωτοτόκια τῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: And so taking bread and the pottage of lentils, he ate, and drank, and went on his way; making little account of having sold his first birthright.
text_la: Et sic, accepto pane et lentis edulio, comedit et bibit, et abiit, parvipendens quod primogenita vendidisset.
text_pt: E Jacó deu pão a Esaú e o guisado de lentilhas; e ele comeu, e bebeu, e levantou-se, e saiu. Assim desprezou Esaú a sua primogenitura.
text_el: Ιακωβ δὲ ἔδωκεν τῷ Ησαυ ἄρτον καὶ ἕψεμα φακοῦ καὶ ἔφαγεν καὶ ἔπιεν καὶ ἀναστὰς ᾤχετο καὶ ἐφαύλισεν Ησαυ τὰ πρωτοτόκια

text_en: And when a famine came in the land, after that barrenness which had happened in the days of Abraham , Isaac went to Abimelech, king of the Palestines , to Gerara.
text_la: Orta autem fame super terram post eam sterilitatem, quæ acciderat in diebus Abraham, abiit Isaac ad Abimelech regem Palæstinorum in Gerara.
text_pt: E havia fome na terra, além da primeira fome, que foi nos dias de Abraão; por isso foi Isaque a Abimeleque, rei dos filisteus, em Gerar.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ λιμὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς χωρὶς τοῦ λιμοῦ τοῦ πρότερον ὃς ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ χρόνῳ τῷ Αβρααμ ἐπορεύθη δὲ Ισαακ πρὸς Αβιμελεχ βασιλέα Φυλιστιιμ εἰς Γεραρα

text_en: And the Lord appeared to him, and said: Go not down into Egypt , but stay in the land that I shall tell you.
text_la: Apparuitque ei Dominus, et ait : Ne descendas in Ægyptum, sed quiesce in terra quam dixero tibi,
text_pt: E apareceu-lhe o Senhor, e disse: Não desças ao Egito; habita na terra que eu te disser;
text_el: ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ κύριος καὶ εἶπεν μὴ καταβῇς εἰς Αἴγυπτον κατοίκησον δὲ ἐν τῇ γῇ ᾗ ἄν σοι εἴπω

text_en: And sojourn in it, and I will be with you, and will bless you: for to you and to your seed I will give all these countries, to fulfil the oath which I swore to Abraham your father.
text_la: et peregrinare in ea : eroque tecum, et benedicam tibi : tibi enim et semini tuo dabo universas regiones has, complens juramentum quod spopondi Abraham patri tuo.
text_pt: Peregrina nesta terra, e serei contigo, e te abençoarei; porque a ti e à tua descendência darei todas estas terras, e confirmarei o juramento que tenho jurado a Abraão teu pai;
text_el: καὶ παροίκει ἐν τῇ γῇ ταύτῃ καὶ ἔσομαι μετὰ σοῦ καὶ εὐλογήσω σε σοὶ γὰρ καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου δώσω πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ στήσω τὸν ὅρκον μου ὃν ὤμοσα Αβρααμ τῷ πατρί σου

text_en: And I will multiply your seed like the stars of heaven : and I will give to your posterity all these countries: and in your seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed .
text_la: Et multiplicabo semen tuum sicut stellas cæli : daboque posteris tuis universas regiones has : et benedicentur in semine tuo omnes gentes terræ,
text_pt: E multiplicarei a tua descendência como as estrelas dos céus, e darei à tua descendência todas estas terras; e por meio dela serão benditas todas as nações da terra;
text_el: καὶ πληθυνῶ τὸ σπέρμα σου ὡς τοὺς ἀστέρας τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ δώσω τῷ σπέρματί σου πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τῆς γῆς

text_en: Because Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my precepts and commandments , and observed my ceremonies and laws .
text_la: eo quod obedierit Abraham voci meæ, et custodierit præcepta et mandata mea, et cæremonias legesque servaverit.
text_pt: Porquanto Abraão obedeceu à minha voz, e guardou o meu mandado, os meus preceitos, os meus estatutos, e as minhas leis.
text_el: ἀνθ' ὧν ὑπήκουσεν Αβρααμ ὁ πατήρ σου τῆς ἐμῆς φωνῆς καὶ ἐφύλαξεν τὰ προστάγματά μου καὶ τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ τὰ δικαιώματά μου καὶ τὰ νόμιμά μου

text_en: So Isaac abode in Gerara.
text_la: Mansit itaque Isaac in Geraris.
text_pt: Assim habitou Isaque em Gerar.
text_el: καὶ κατῴκησεν Ισαακ ἐν Γεραροις

text_en: And when he was asked by the men of that place, concerning his wife, he answered: She is my sister: for he was afraid to confess that she was his wife, thinking lest perhaps they would kill him because of her beauty.
text_la: Qui cum interrogaretur a viris loci illius super uxore sua, respondit : Soror mea est : timuerat enim confiteri quod sibi esset sociata conjugio, reputans ne forte interficerent eum propter illius pulchritudinem.
text_pt: E perguntando-lhe os homens daquele lugar acerca de sua mulher, disse: É minha irmã; porque temia dizer: É minha mulher; para que porventura (dizia ele) não me matem os homens daquele lugar por amor de Rebeca; porque era formosa à vista.
text_el: ἐπηρώτησαν δὲ οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ τόπου περὶ Ρεβεκκας τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἀδελφή μού ἐστιν ἐφοβήθη γὰρ εἰπεῖν ὅτι γυνή μού ἐστιν μήποτε ἀποκτείνωσιν αὐτὸν οἱ ἄνδρες τοῦ τόπου περὶ Ρεβεκκας ὅτι ὡραία τῇ ὄψει ἦν

text_en: And when very many days were passed, and he abode there, Abimelech, king of the Palestines , looking out through a window, saw him playing with Rebecca, his wife.
text_la: Cumque pertransissent dies plurimi, et ibidem moraretur, prospiciens Abimelech rex Palæstinorum per fenestram, vidit eum jocantem cum Rebecca uxore sua.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, como ele esteve ali muito tempo, Abimeleque, rei dos filisteus, olhou por uma janela, e viu, e eis que Isaque estava brincando com Rebeca sua mulher.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ πολυχρόνιος ἐκεῖ παρακύψας δὲ Αβιμελεχ ὁ βασιλεὺς Γεραρων διὰ τῆς θυρίδος εἶδεν τὸν Ισαακ παίζοντα μετὰ Ρεβεκκας τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And calling for him, he said: It is evident she is your wife: why did you feign her to be your sister? He answered: I feared lest I should die for her sake.
text_la: Et accersito eo, ait : Perspicuum est quod uxor tua sit : cur mentitus es eam sororem tuam esse? Respondit : Timui ne morerer propter eam.
text_pt: Então chamou Abimeleque a Isaque, e disse: Eis que na verdade é tua mulher; como pois disseste: É minha irmã? E disse-lhe Isaque: Porque eu dizia: Para que eu porventura não morra por causa dela.
text_el: ἐκάλεσεν δὲ Αβιμελεχ τὸν Ισαακ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἄρα γε γυνή σού ἐστιν τί ὅτι εἶπας ἀδελφή μού ἐστιν εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Ισαακ εἶπα γάρ μήποτε ἀποθάνω δι' αὐτήν

text_en: And Abimelech said: Why have you deceived us? Some man of the people might have lain with your wife, and you had brought upon us a great sin . And he commanded all the people , saying:
text_la: Dixitque Abimelech : Quare imposuisti nobis? potuit coire quispiam de populo cum uxore tua, et induxeras super nos grande peccatum. Præcepitque omni populo, dicens:
text_pt: E disse Abimeleque: Que é isto que nos fizeste? Facilmente se teria deitado alguém deste povo com a tua mulher, e tu terias trazido sobre nós um delito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Αβιμελεχ τί τοῦτο ἐποίησας ἡμῖν μικροῦ ἐκοιμήθη τις τοῦ γένους μου μετὰ τῆς γυναικός σου καὶ ἐπήγαγες ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἄγνοιαν

text_en: He that shall touch this man's wife, shall surely be put to death .
text_la: Qui tetigerit hominis hujus uxorem, morte morietur.
text_pt: E mandou Abimeleque a todo o povo, dizendo: Qualquer que tocar neste homem ou em sua mulher, certamente morrerá.
text_el: συνέταξεν δὲ Αβιμελεχ παντὶ τῷ λαῷ αὐτοῦ λέγων πᾶς ὁ ἁπτόμενος τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τούτου ἢ τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ θανάτου ἔνοχος ἔσται

text_en: And Isaac sowed in that land, and he found that same year a hundredfold: and the Lord blessed him.
text_la: Sevit autem Isaac in terra illa, et invenit in ipso anno centuplum : benedixitque ei Dominus.
text_pt: E semeou Isaque naquela mesma terra, e colheu naquele mesmo ano cem medidas, porque o Senhor o abençoava.
text_el: ἔσπειρεν δὲ Ισαακ ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐκείνῃ καὶ εὗρεν ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἐκείνῳ ἑκατοστεύουσαν κριθήν εὐλόγησεν δὲ αὐτὸν κύριος

text_en: And the man was enriched , and he went on prospering and increasing, till he became exceeding great.
text_la: Et locupletatus est homo, et ibat proficiens atque succrescens, donec magnus vehementer effectus est:
text_pt: E engrandeceu-se o homem, e ia enriquecendo-se, até que se tornou mui poderoso.
text_el: καὶ ὑψώθη ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ προβαίνων μείζων ἐγίνετο ἕως οὗ μέγας ἐγένετο σφόδρα

text_en: And he had possessions of sheep and of herds, and a very great family . Wherefore the Palestines envying him,
text_la: habuit quoque possessiones ovium et armentorum, et familiæ plurimum. Ob hoc invidentes ei Palæstini,
text_pt: E tinha possessão de ovelhas, e possessão de vacas, e muita gente de serviço, de maneira que os filisteus o invejavam.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ αὐτῷ κτήνη προβάτων καὶ κτήνη βοῶν καὶ γεώργια πολλά ἐζήλωσαν δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ Φυλιστιιμ

text_en: stopped up at that time all the wells , that the servants of his father, Abraham , had digged, filling them up with earth:
text_la: omnes puteos, quos foderant servi patris illius Abraham, illo tempore obstruxerunt, implentes humo:
text_pt: E todos os poços, que os servos de seu pai tinham cavado nos dias de seu pai Abraão, os filisteus entulharam e encheram de terra.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ φρέατα ἃ ὤρυξαν οἱ παῖδες τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ χρόνῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἐνέφραξαν αὐτὰ οἱ Φυλιστιιμ καὶ ἔπλησαν αὐτὰ γῆς

text_en: Insomuch that Abimelech himself said to Isaac : Depart from us, for you have become much mightier than we.
text_la: in tantum, ut ipse Abimelech diceret ad Isaac : Recede a nobis, quoniam potentior nobis factus es valde.
text_pt: Disse também Abimeleque a Isaque: Aparta-te de nós; porque muito mais poderoso te tens feito do que nós.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Αβιμελεχ πρὸς Ισαακ ἄπελθε ἀφ' ἡμῶν ὅτι δυνατώτερος ἡμῶν ἐγένου σφόδρα

text_en: So he departed, and came to the torrent of Gerara, to dwell there:
text_la: Et ille discedens, ut veniret ad torrentem Geraræ, habitaretque ibi,
text_pt: Então Isaque partiu dali e fez o seu acampamento no vale de Gerar, e habitou lá.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν ἐκεῖθεν Ισαακ καὶ κατέλυσεν ἐν τῇ φάραγγι Γεραρων καὶ κατῴκησεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And he digged again other wells , which the servants of his father, Abraham , had digged, and which, after his death, the Philistines had of old stopped up: and he called them by the same names , by which his father before had called them.
text_la: rursum fodit alios puteos, quos foderant servi patris sui Abraham, et quos, illo mortuo, olim obstruxerant Philisthiim : appellavitque eos eisdem nominibus quibus ante pater vocaverat.
text_pt: E tornou Isaque e cavou os poços de água que cavaram nos dias de Abraão seu pai, e que os filisteus entulharam depois da morte de Abraão, e chamou-os pelos nomes que os chamara seu pai.
text_el: καὶ πάλιν Ισαακ ὤρυξεν τὰ φρέατα τοῦ ὕδατος ἃ ὤρυξαν οἱ παῖδες Αβρααμ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνέφραξαν αὐτὰ οἱ Φυλιστιιμ μετὰ τὸ ἀποθανεῖν Αβρααμ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν αὐτοῖς ὀνόματα κατὰ τὰ ὀνόματα ἃ ἐπωνόμασεν Αβρααμ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they digged in the torrent, and found living water:
text_la: Foderuntque in torrente, et repererunt aquam vivam.
text_pt: Cavaram, pois, os servos de Isaque naquele vale, e acharam ali um poço de águas vivas.
text_el: καὶ ὤρυξαν οἱ παῖδες Ισαακ ἐν τῇ φάραγγι Γεραρων καὶ εὗρον ἐκεῖ φρέαρ ὕδατος ζῶντος

text_en: But there also the herdsmen of Gerara strove against the herdsmen of Isaac , saying: It is our water. Wherefore he called the name of the well , on occasion of that which had happened, Calumny .
text_la: Sed et ibi jurgium fuit pastorum Geraræ adversus pastores Isaac, dicentium : Nostra est aqua, quam ob rem nomen putei ex eo, quod acciderat, vocavit Calumniam.
text_pt: E os pastores de Gerar porfiaram com os pastores de Isaque, dizendo: Esta água é nossa. Por isso chamou aquele poço Eseque, porque contenderam com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἐμαχέσαντο οἱ ποιμένες Γεραρων μετὰ τῶν ποιμένων Ισαακ φάσκοντες αὐτῶν εἶναι τὸ ὕδωρ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ φρέατος Ἀδικία ἠδίκησαν γὰρ αὐτόν

text_en: And they digged also another; and for that they quarrelled likewise, and he called the name of it, Enmity .
text_la: Foderunt autem et alium : et pro illo quoque rixati sunt, appellavitque eum Inimicitias.
text_pt: Então cavaram outro poço, e também porfiaram sobre ele; por isso chamou-o Sitna.
text_el: ἀπάρας δὲ Ισαακ ἐκεῖθεν ὤρυξεν φρέαρ ἕτερον ἐκρίνοντο δὲ καὶ περὶ ἐκείνου καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ἐχθρία

text_en: Going forward from thence, he digged another well , for which they contended not; therefore he called the name thereof, Latitude, saying: Now has the Lord given us room, and made us to increase upon the earth.
text_la: Profectus inde fodit alium puteum, pro quo non contenderunt : itaque vocavit nomen ejus Latitudo, dicens : Nunc dilatavit nos Dominus, et fecit crescere super terram.
text_pt: E partiu dali, e cavou outro poço, e não porfiaram sobre ele; por isso chamou-o Reobote, e disse: Porque agora nos alargou o Senhor, e crescemos nesta terra.
text_el: ἀπάρας δὲ ἐκεῖθεν ὤρυξεν φρέαρ ἕτερον καὶ οὐκ ἐμαχέσαντο περὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Εὐρυχωρία λέγων διότι νῦν ἐπλάτυνεν κύριος ἡμῖν καὶ ηὔξησεν ἡμᾶς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And he went up from that place to Bersabee ,
text_la: Ascendit autem ex illo loco in Bersabee,
text_pt: Depois subiu dali a Berseba.
text_el: ἀνέβη δὲ ἐκεῖθεν ἐπὶ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὅρκου

text_en: where the Lord appeared to him that same night, saying: I am the God of Abraham your father, do not fear , for I am with you: I will bless you, and multiply your seed for my servant Abraham's sake.
text_la: ubi apparuit ei Dominus in ipsa nocte, dicens : Ego sum Deus Abraham patris tui : noli timere, quia ego tecum sum : benedicam tibi, et multiplicabo semen tuum propter servum meum Abraham.
text_pt: E apareceu-lhe o Senhor naquela mesma noite, e disse: Eu sou o Deus de Abraão teu pai; não temas, porque eu sou contigo, e abençoar-te-ei, e multiplicarei a tua descendência por amor de Abraão meu servo.
text_el: καὶ ὤφθη αὐτῷ κύριος ἐν τῇ νυκτὶ ἐκείνῃ καὶ εἶπεν ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεὸς Αβρααμ τοῦ πατρός σου μὴ φοβοῦ μετὰ σοῦ γάρ εἰμι καὶ ηὐλόγηκά σε καὶ πληθυνῶ τὸ σπέρμα σου διὰ Αβρααμ τὸν πατέρα σου

text_en: And he built there an altar : and called upon the name of the Lord , and pitched his tent; and commanded his servants to dig a well .
text_la: Itaque ædificavit ibi altare : et invocato nomine Domini, extendit tabernaculum, præcepitque servis suis ut foderent puteum.
text_pt: Então edificou ali um altar, e invocou o nome do Senhor, e armou ali a sua tenda; e os servos de Isaque cavaram ali um poço.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο τὸ ὄνομα κυρίου καὶ ἔπηξεν ἐκεῖ τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ ὤρυξαν δὲ ἐκεῖ οἱ παῖδες Ισαακ φρέαρ

text_en: To which place when Abimelech, and Ochozath his friend, and Phicol chief captain of his soldiers, came from Gerara,
text_la: Ad quem locum cum venissent de Geraris Abimelech, et Ochozath amicus illius, et Phicol dux militum,
text_pt: E Abimeleque veio a ele de Gerar, com Auzate seu amigo, e Ficol, príncipe do seu exército.
text_el: καὶ Αβιμελεχ ἐπορεύθη πρὸς αὐτὸν ἀπὸ Γεραρων καὶ Οχοζαθ ὁ νυμφαγωγὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Φικολ ὁ ἀρχιστράτηγος τῆς δυνάμεως αὐτοῦ

text_en: Isaac said to them: Why have you come to me, a man whom you hate , and have thrust out from you?
text_la: locutus est eis Isaac : Quid venistis ad me, hominem quem odistis, et expulistis a vobis?
text_pt: E disse-lhes Isaque: Por que viestes a mim, pois que vós me odiais e me repelistes de vós?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ισαακ ἵνα τί ἤλθατε πρός με ὑμεῖς δὲ ἐμισήσατέ με καὶ ἀπεστείλατέ με ἀφ' ὑμῶν

text_en: And they answered: We saw that the Lord is with you, and therefore we said: Let there be an oath between us, and let us make a covenant,
text_la: Qui responderunt : Vidimus tecum esse Dominum, et idcirco nos diximus : Sit juramentum inter nos, et ineamus fœdus,
text_pt: E eles disseram: Havemos visto, na verdade, que o Senhor é contigo, por isso dissemos: Haja agora juramento entre nós, entre nós e ti; e façamos aliança contigo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν ἰδόντες ἑωράκαμεν ὅτι ἦν κύριος μετὰ σοῦ καὶ εἴπαμεν γενέσθω ἀρὰ ἀνὰ μέσον ἡμῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον σοῦ καὶ διαθησόμεθα μετὰ σοῦ διαθήκην

text_en: that you do us no harm, as we on our part have touched nothing of yours, nor have done anything to hurt you; but with peace have sent you away, increased with the blessing of the Lord .
text_la: ut non facias nobis quidquam mali, sicut et nos nihil tuorum attigimus, nec fecimus quod te læderet : sed cum pace dimisimus auctum benedictione Domini.
text_pt: Que não nos faças mal, como nós te não temos tocado, e como te fizemos somente bem, e te deixamos ir em paz. Agora tu és o bendito do Senhor.
text_el: μὴ ποιήσειν μεθ' ἡμῶν κακόν καθότι ἡμεῖς σε οὐκ ἐβδελυξάμεθα καὶ ὃν τρόπον ἐχρησάμεθά σοι καλῶς καὶ ἐξαπεστείλαμέν σε μετ' εἰρήνης καὶ νῦν σὺ εὐλογητὸς ὑπὸ κυρίου

text_en: And he made them a feast, and after they had eaten and drunk:
text_la: Fecit ergo eis convivium, et post cibum et potum
text_pt: Então lhes fez um banquete, e comeram e beberam;
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτοῖς δοχήν καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἔπιον

text_en: Arising in the morning, they swore one to another: and Isaac sent them away peaceably to their own home.
text_la: surgentes mane, juraverunt sibi mutuo : dimisitque eos Isaac pacifice in locum suum.
text_pt: E levantaram-se de madrugada e juraram um ao outro; depois os despediu Isaque, e despediram-se dele em paz.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστάντες τὸ πρωὶ ὤμοσαν ἄνθρωπος τῷ πλησίον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν αὐτοὺς Ισαακ καὶ ἀπῴχοντο ἀπ' αὐτοῦ μετὰ σωτηρίας

text_en: And behold, the same day the servants of Isaac came, telling him of a well which they had digged, and saying: We have found water.
text_la: Ecce autem venerunt in ipso die servi Isaac annuntiantes ei de puteo, quem foderant, atque dicentes : Invenimus aquam.
text_pt: E aconteceu, naquele mesmo dia, que vieram os servos de Isaque, e anunciaram-lhe acerca do negócio do poço, que tinham cavado; e disseram-lhe: Temos achado água.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ καὶ παραγενόμενοι οἱ παῖδες Ισαακ ἀπήγγειλαν αὐτῷ περὶ τοῦ φρέατος οὗ ὤρυξαν καὶ εἶπαν οὐχ εὕρομεν ὕδωρ

text_en: Whereupon he called it Abundance: and the name of the city was called Bersabee , even to this day.
text_la: Unde appellavit eum Abundantiam : et nomen urbi impositum est Bersabee, usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: E chamou-o Seba; por isso é o nome daquela cidade Berseba até o dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸ Ὅρκος διὰ τοῦτο ὄνομα τῇ πόλει Φρέαρ ὅρκου ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: And Esau being forty years old, married wives, Judith, the daughter of Beeri, the Hethite , and Basemath, the daughter of Elon, of the same place.
text_la: Esau vero quadragenarius duxit uxores, Judith filiam Beeri Hethæi, et Basemath filiam Elon ejusdem loci:
text_pt: Ora, sendo Esaú da idade de quarenta anos, tomou por mulher a Judite, filha de Beeri, heteu, e a Basemate, filha de Elom, heteu.
text_el: ἦν δὲ Ησαυ ἐτῶν τεσσαράκοντα καὶ ἔλαβεν γυναῖκα Ιουδιν τὴν θυγατέρα Βεηρ τοῦ Χετταίου καὶ τὴν Βασεμμαθ θυγατέρα Αιλων τοῦ Ευαίου

text_en: And they both offended the mind of Isaac and Rebecca.
text_la: quæ ambæ offenderant animum Isaac et Rebeccæ.
text_pt: E estas foram para Isaque e Rebeca uma amargura de espírito.
text_el: καὶ ἦσαν ἐρίζουσαι τῷ Ισαακ καὶ τῇ Ρεβεκκα

text_en: Now Isaac was old, and his eyes were dim, and he could not see: and he called Esau , his elder son, and said to him: My son? And he answered: Here I am.
text_la: Senuit autem Isaac, et caligaverunt oculi ejus, et videre non poterat : vocavitque Esau filium suum majorem, et dixit ei : Fili mi? Qui respondit : Adsum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, como Isaque envelheceu, e os seus olhos se escureceram, de maneira que não podia ver, chamou a Esaú, seu filho mais velho, e disse-lhe: Meu filho. E ele lhe disse: Eis-me aqui.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὸ γηρᾶσαι Ισαακ καὶ ἠμβλύνθησαν οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ τοῦ ὁρᾶν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ησαυ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν πρεσβύτερον καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ υἱέ μου καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἐγώ

text_en: And his father said to him, You see that I am old, and know not the day of my death.
text_la: Cui pater : Vides, inquit, quod senuerim, et ignorem diem mortis meæ.
text_pt: E ele disse: Eis que já agora estou velho, e não sei o dia da minha morte;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ γεγήρακα καὶ οὐ γινώσκω τὴν ἡμέραν τῆς τελευτῆς μου

text_en: Take your arms, your quiver, and bow, and go abroad; and when you have taken something by hunting,
text_la: Sume arma tua, pharetram, et arcum, et egredere foras : cumque venatu aliquid apprehenderis,
text_pt: Agora, pois, toma as tuas armas, a tua aljava e o teu arco, e sai ao campo, e apanha para mim alguma caça.
text_el: νῦν οὖν λαβὲ τὸ σκεῦός σου τήν τε φαρέτραν καὶ τὸ τόξον καὶ ἔξελθε εἰς τὸ πεδίον καὶ θήρευσόν μοι θήραν

text_en: make me a savoury meat thereof, as you know I like, and bring it that I may eat: and my soul may bless you, before I die.
text_la: fac mihi inde pulmentum sicut velle me nosti, et affer ut comedam : et benedicat tibi anima mea antequam moriar.
text_pt: E faze-me um guisado saboroso, como eu gosto, e traze-mo, para que eu coma; para que minha alma te abençoe, antes que morra.
text_el: καὶ ποίησόν μοι ἐδέσματα ὡς φιλῶ ἐγώ καὶ ἔνεγκέ μοι ἵνα φάγω ὅπως εὐλογήσῃ σε ἡ ψυχή μου πρὶν ἀποθανεῖν με

text_en: And when Rebecca had heard this, and he had gone into the field to fulfil his father's commandment,
text_la: Quod cum audisset Rebecca, et ille abiisset in agrum ut jussionem patris impleret,
text_pt: E Rebeca escutou quando Isaque falava ao seu filho Esaú. E foi Esaú ao campo para apanhar a caça que havia de trazer.
text_el: Ρεβεκκα δὲ ἤκουσεν λαλοῦντος Ισαακ πρὸς Ησαυ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἐπορεύθη δὲ Ησαυ εἰς τὸ πεδίον θηρεῦσαι θήραν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: she said to her son Jacob : I heard your father talking with Esau , your brother, and saying to him:
text_la: dixit filio suo Jacob : Audivi patrem tuum loquentem cum Esau fratre tuo, et dicentem ei:
text_pt: Então falou Rebeca a Jacó seu filho, dizendo: Eis que tenho ouvido o teu pai que falava com Esaú teu irmão, dizendo:
text_el: Ρεβεκκα δὲ εἶπεν πρὸς Ιακωβ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν ἐλάσσω ἰδὲ ἐγὼ ἤκουσα τοῦ πατρός σου λαλοῦντος πρὸς Ησαυ τὸν ἀδελφόν σου λέγοντος

text_en: Bring me of your hunting, and make me meats that I may eat, and bless you in the sight of the Lord , before I die.
text_la: Affer mihi de venatione tua, et fac cibos ut comedam, et benedicam tibi coram Domino antequam moriar.
text_pt: Traze-me caça, e faze-me um guisado saboroso, para que eu coma, e te abençoe diante da face do Senhor, antes da minha morte.
text_el: ἔνεγκόν μοι θήραν καὶ ποίησόν μοι ἐδέσματα καὶ φαγὼν εὐλογήσω σε ἐναντίον κυρίου πρὸ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν με

text_en: Now therefore, my son, follow my counsel:
text_la: Nunc ergo, fili mi, acquiesce consiliis meis:
text_pt: Agora, pois, filho meu, ouve a minha voz naquilo que eu te mando:
text_el: νῦν οὖν υἱέ ἄκουσόν μου καθὰ ἐγώ σοι ἐντέλλομαι

text_en: And go your way to the flock, bring me two kids of the best, that I may make of them meat for your father, such as he gladly eats.
text_la: et pergens ad gregem, affer mihi duos hædos optimos, ut faciam ex eis escas patri tuo, quibus libenter vescitur:
text_pt: Vai agora ao rebanho, e traze-me de lá dois bons cabritos, e eu farei deles um guisado saboroso para teu pai, como ele gosta;
text_el: καὶ πορευθεὶς εἰς τὰ πρόβατα λαβέ μοι ἐκεῖθεν δύο ἐρίφους ἁπαλοὺς καὶ καλούς καὶ ποιήσω αὐτοὺς ἐδέσματα τῷ πατρί σου ὡς φιλεῖ

text_en: Which when you have brought in, and he has eaten, he may bless you before he die.
text_la: quas cum intuleris, et comederit, benedicat tibi priusquam moriatur.
text_pt: E levá-lo-ás a teu pai, para que o coma; para que te abençoe antes da sua morte.
text_el: καὶ εἰσοίσεις τῷ πατρί σου καὶ φάγεται ὅπως εὐλογήσῃ σε ὁ πατήρ σου πρὸ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν αὐτόν

text_en: And he answered her: You know that Esau , my brother, is a hairy man , and I am smooth:
text_la: Cui ille respondit : Nosti quod Esau frater meus homo pilosus sit, et ego lenis:
text_pt: Então disse Jacó a Rebeca, sua mãe: Eis que Esaú meu irmão é homem cabeludo, e eu homem liso;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ πρὸς Ρεβεκκαν τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ ἔστιν Ησαυ ὁ ἀδελφός μου ἀνὴρ δασύς ἐγὼ δὲ ἀνὴρ λεῖος

text_en: If my father should feel me, and perceive it, I fear lest he will think I would have mocked him, and I shall bring upon me a curse instead of a blessing .
text_la: si attrectaverit me pater meus, et senserit, timeo ne putet me sibi voluisse illudere, et inducam super me maledictionem pro benedictione.
text_pt: Porventura me apalpará o meu pai, e serei aos seus olhos como enganador; assim trarei eu sobre mim maldição, e não bênção.
text_el: μήποτε ψηλαφήσῃ με ὁ πατήρ μου καὶ ἔσομαι ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ὡς καταφρονῶν καὶ ἐπάξω ἐπ' ἐμαυτὸν κατάραν καὶ οὐκ εὐλογίαν

text_en: And his mother said to him: Upon me be this curse , my son: only hear my voice, and go, fetch me the things which I have said.
text_la: Ad quem mater : In me sit, ait, ista maledictio, fili mi : tantum audi vocem meam, et pergens, affer quæ dixi.
text_pt: E disse-lhe sua mãe: Meu filho, sobre mim seja a tua maldição; somente obedece à minha voz, e vai, traze-mos.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ἡ μήτηρ ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἡ κατάρα σου τέκνον μόνον ὑπάκουσον τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ πορευθεὶς ἔνεγκέ μοι

text_en: He went, and brought, and gave them to his mother. She dressed meats, such as she knew his father liked.
text_la: Abiit, et attulit, deditque matri. Paravit illa cibos, sicut velle noverat patrem illius.
text_pt: E foi, e tomou-os, e trouxe-os a sua mãe; e sua mãe fez um guisado saboroso, como seu pai gostava.
text_el: πορευθεὶς δὲ ἔλαβεν καὶ ἤνεγκεν τῇ μητρί καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡ μήτηρ αὐτοῦ ἐδέσματα καθὰ ἐφίλει ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And she put on him very good garments of Esau , which she had at home with her:
text_la: Et vestibus Esau valde bonis, quas apud se habebat domi, induit eum:
text_pt: Depois tomou Rebeca os vestidos de gala de Esaú, seu filho mais velho, que tinha consigo em casa, e vestiu a Jacó, seu filho menor;
text_el: καὶ λαβοῦσα Ρεβεκκα τὴν στολὴν Ησαυ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς τοῦ πρεσβυτέρου τὴν καλήν ἣ ἦν παρ' αὐτῇ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ ἐνέδυσεν Ιακωβ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν νεώτερον

text_en: And the little skins of the kids she put about his hands, and covered the bare of his neck.
text_la: pelliculasque hædorum circumdedit manibus, et colli nuda protexit:
text_pt: E com as peles dos cabritos cobriu as suas mãos e a lisura do seu pescoço;
text_el: καὶ τὰ δέρματα τῶν ἐρίφων περιέθηκεν ἐπὶ τοὺς βραχίονας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ γυμνὰ τοῦ τραχήλου αὐτοῦ

text_en: And she gave him the savoury meat, and delivered him bread that she had baked.
text_la: deditque pulmentum, et panes, quos coxerat, tradidit.
text_pt: E deu o guisado saboroso e o pão que tinha preparado, na mão de Jacó seu filho.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν τὰ ἐδέσματα καὶ τοὺς ἄρτους οὓς ἐποίησεν εἰς τὰς χεῖρας Ιακωβ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς

text_en: Which when he had carried in, he said: My father? But he answered: I hear. Who are you, my son?
text_la: Quibus illatis, dixit : Pater mi? At ille respondit : Audio. Quis es tu, fili mi?
text_pt: E foi ele a seu pai, e disse: Meu pai! E ele disse: Eis-me aqui; quem és tu, meu filho?
text_el: καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν δέ πάτερ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἐγώ τίς εἶ σύ τέκνον

text_en: And Jacob said: I am Esau , your firstborn : I have done as you commanded me: arise, sit and eat of my venison, that your soul may bless me.
text_la: Dixitque Jacob : Ego sum primogenitus tuus Esau : feci sicut præcepisti mihi : surge, sede, et comede de venatione mea, ut benedicat mihi anima tua.
text_pt: E Jacó disse a seu pai: Eu sou Esaú, teu primogênito; tenho feito como me disseste; levanta-te agora, assenta-te e come da minha caça, para que a tua alma me abençoe.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιακωβ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ ἐγὼ Ησαυ ὁ πρωτότοκός σου ἐποίησα καθὰ ἐλάλησάς μοι ἀναστὰς κάθισον καὶ φάγε τῆς θήρας μου ὅπως εὐλογήσῃ με ἡ ψυχή σου

text_en: And Isaac said to his son: How could you find it so quickly, my son? He answered: It was the will of God , that what I sought came quickly in my way:
text_la: Rursumque Isaac ad filium suum : Quomodo, inquit, tam cito invenire potuisti, fili mi? Qui respondit : Voluntas Dei fuit ut cito occurreret mihi quod volebam.
text_pt: Então disse Isaque a seu filho: Como é isto, que tão cedo a achaste, filho meu? E ele disse: Porque o Senhor teu Deus a mandou ao meu encontro.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ισαακ τῷ υἱῷ αὐτοῦ τί τοῦτο ὃ ταχὺ εὗρες ὦ τέκνον ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ὃ παρέδωκεν κύριος ὁ θεός σου ἐναντίον μου

text_en: And Isaac said: Come hither, that I may feel you, my son, and may prove whether you are my son Esau , or no.
text_la: Dixitque Isaac : Accede huc, ut tangam te, fili mi, et probem utrum tu sis filius meus Esau, an non.
text_pt: E disse Isaque a Jacó: Chega-te agora, para que te apalpe, meu filho, se és meu filho Esaú mesmo, ou não.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ισαακ τῷ Ιακωβ ἔγγισόν μοι καὶ ψηλαφήσω σε τέκνον εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου Ησαυ ἢ οὔ

text_en: He came near to his father, and when he had felt him, Isaac said: The voice indeed is the voice of Jacob ; but the hands, are the hands of Esau .
text_la: Accessit ille ad patrem, et palpato eo, dixit Isaac : Vox quidem, vox Jacob est : sed manus, manus sunt Esau.
text_pt: Então se chegou Jacó a Isaque seu pai, que o apalpou, e disse: A voz é a voz de Jacó, porém as mãos são as mãos de Esaú.
text_el: ἤγγισεν δὲ Ιακωβ πρὸς Ισαακ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐψηλάφησεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν ἡ μὲν φωνὴ φωνὴ Ιακωβ αἱ δὲ χεῖρες χεῖρες Ησαυ

text_en: And he knew him not, because his hairy hands made him like to the elder. Then blessing him,
text_la: Et non cognovit eum, quia pilosæ manus similitudinem majoris expresserant. Benedicens ergo illi,
text_pt: E não o conheceu, porquanto as suas mãos estavam cabeludas, como as mãos de Esaú seu irmão; e abençoou-o.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐπέγνω αὐτόν ἦσαν γὰρ αἱ χεῖρες αὐτοῦ ὡς αἱ χεῖρες Ησαυ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ δασεῖαι καὶ ηὐλόγησεν αὐτόν

text_en: he said: Are you my son Esau ? He answered: I am.
text_la: ait : Tu es filius meus Esau? Respondit : Ego sum.
text_pt: E disse: És tu meu filho Esaú mesmo? E ele disse: Eu sou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν σὺ εἶ ὁ υἱός μου Ησαυ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἐγώ

text_en: Then he said: Bring me the meats of your hunting, my son, that my soul may bless you. And when they were brought, and he had eaten, he offered him wine also, which after he had drunk,
text_la: At ille : Affer mihi, inquit, cibos de venatione tua, fili mi, ut benedicat tibi anima mea. Quos cum oblatos comedisset, obtulit ei etiam vinum. Quo hausto,
text_pt: Então disse: Faze chegar isso perto de mim, para que coma da caça de meu filho; para que a minha alma te abençoe. E chegou-lhe, e comeu; trouxe-lhe também vinho, e bebeu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν προσάγαγέ μοι καὶ φάγομαι ἀπὸ τῆς θήρας σου τέκνον ἵνα εὐλογήσῃ σε ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ προσήγαγεν αὐτῷ καὶ ἔφαγεν καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν αὐτῷ οἶνον καὶ ἔπιεν

text_en: he said to him: Come near me, and give me a kiss , my son.
text_la: dixit ad eum : Accede ad me, et da mihi osculum, fili mi.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Isaque seu pai: Ora chega-te, e beija-me, filho meu.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ισαακ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἔγγισόν μοι καὶ φίλησόν με τέκνον

text_en: He came near, and kissed him. And immediately as he smelled the fragrant smell of his garments, blessing him, he said: Behold, the smell of my son is as the smell of a plentiful field, which the Lord has blessed .
text_la: Accessit, et osculatus est eum. Statimque ut sensit vestimentorum illius fragrantiam, benedicens illi, ait : Ecce odor filii mei sicut odor agri pleni, cui benedixit Dominus.
text_pt: E chegou-se, e beijou-o; então sentindo o cheiro das suas vestes, abençoou-o, e disse: Eis que o cheiro do meu filho é como o cheiro do campo, que o Senhor abençoou;
text_el: καὶ ἐγγίσας ἐφίλησεν αὐτόν καὶ ὠσφράνθη τὴν ὀσμὴν τῶν ἱματίων αὐτοῦ καὶ ηὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ὀσμὴ τοῦ υἱοῦ μου ὡς ὀσμὴ ἀγροῦ πλήρους ὃν ηὐλόγησεν κύριος

text_en: God give you of the dew of heaven , and of the fatness of the earth, abundance of corn and wine.
text_la: Det tibi Deus de rore cæli et de pinguedine terræ abundantiam frumenti et vini.
text_pt: Assim, pois, te dê Deus do orvalho dos céus, e das gorduras da terra, e abundância de trigo e de mosto.
text_el: καὶ δῴη σοι ὁ θεὸς ἀπὸ τῆς δρόσου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς πιότητος τῆς γῆς καὶ πλῆθος σίτου καὶ οἴνου

text_en: And let peoples serve you, and tribes worship you: be lord of your brethren, and let your mother's children bow down before you. Cursed be he that curses you: and let him that blesses you be filled with blessings .
text_la: Et serviant tibi populi, et adorent te tribus : esto dominus fratrum tuorum, et incurventur ante te filii matris tuæ : qui maledixerit tibi, sit ille maledictus, et qui benedixerit tibi, benedictionibus repleatur.
text_pt: Sirvam-te povos, e nações se encurvem a ti; sê senhor de teus irmãos, e os filhos da tua mãe se encurvem a ti; malditos sejam os que te amaldiçoarem, e benditos sejam os que te abençoarem.
text_el: καὶ δουλευσάτωσάν σοι ἔθνη καὶ προσκυνήσουσίν σοι ἄρχοντες καὶ γίνου κύριος τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου καὶ προσκυνήσουσίν σοι οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ πατρός σου ὁ καταρώμενός σε ἐπικατάρατος ὁ δὲ εὐλογῶν σε εὐλογημένος

text_en: Isaac had scarce ended his words, when, Jacob being now gone out abroad, Esau came,
text_la: Vix Isaac sermonem impleverat, et egresso Jacob foras, venit Esau,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, acabando Isaque de abençoar a Jacó, apenas Jacó acabava de sair da presença de Isaque seu pai, veio Esaú, seu irmão, da sua caça;
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὸ παύσασθαι Ισαακ εὐλογοῦντα Ιακωβ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἐξῆλθεν Ιακωβ ἀπὸ προσώπου Ισαακ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ Ησαυ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν ἀπὸ τῆς θήρας

text_en: and brought in to his father meats, made of what he had taken in hunting, saying: Arise, my father, and eat of your son's venison; that your soul may bless me.
text_la: coctosque de venatione cibos intulit patri, dicens : Surge, pater mi, et comede de venatione filii tui, ut benedicat mihi anima tua.
text_pt: E fez também ele um guisado saboroso, e trouxe-o a seu pai; e disse a seu pai: Levanta-te, meu pai, e come da caça de teu filho, para que me abençoe a tua alma.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν καὶ αὐτὸς ἐδέσματα καὶ προσήνεγκεν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν τῷ πατρί ἀναστήτω ὁ πατήρ μου καὶ φαγέτω τῆς θήρας τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ ὅπως εὐλογήσῃ με ἡ ψυχή σου

text_en: And Isaac said to him: Why! who are you? He answered: I am your firstborn son , Esau .
text_la: Dixitque illi Isaac : Quis enim es tu? Qui respondit : Ego sum filius tuus primogenitus Esau.
text_pt: E disse-lhe Isaque seu pai: Quem és tu? E ele disse: Eu sou teu filho, o teu primogênito Esaú.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ισαακ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ τίς εἶ σύ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ υἱός σου ὁ πρωτότοκος Ησαυ

text_en: Isaac was struck with fear , and astonished exceedingly; and wondering beyond what can be believed , said: Who is he then that even now brought me venison that he had taken, and I ate of all before you came? And I have blessed him, and he shall be blessed .
text_la: Expavit Isaac stupore vehementi : et ultra quam credi potest admirans, ait : Quis igitur ille est qui dudum captam venationem attulit mihi, et comedi ex omnibus priusquam tu venires; benedixique ei, et erit benedictus?
text_pt: Então estremeceu Isaque de um estremecimento muito grande, e disse: Quem, pois, é aquele que apanhou a caça, e ma trouxe? E comi de tudo, antes que tu viesses, e abençoei-o, e ele será bendito.
text_el: ἐξέστη δὲ Ισαακ ἔκστασιν μεγάλην σφόδρα καὶ εἶπεν τίς οὖν ὁ θηρεύσας μοι θήραν καὶ εἰσενέγκας μοι καὶ ἔφαγον ἀπὸ πάντων πρὸ τοῦ σε ἐλθεῖν καὶ ηὐλόγησα αὐτόν καὶ εὐλογημένος ἔστω

text_en: Esau having heard his father's words, roared out with a great cry; and, being in a consternation, said: Bless me also, my father.
text_la: Auditis Esau sermonibus patris, irrugiit clamore magno : et consternatus, ait : Benedic etiam et mihi, pater mi.
text_pt: Esaú, ouvindo as palavras de seu pai, bradou com grande e mui amargo brado, e disse a seu pai: Abençoa-me também a mim, meu pai.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἤκουσεν Ησαυ τὰ ῥήματα Ισαακ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἀνεβόησεν φωνὴν μεγάλην καὶ πικρὰν σφόδρα καὶ εἶπεν εὐλόγησον δὴ κἀμέ πάτερ

text_en: And he said: Your brother came deceitfully and got your blessing .
text_la: Qui ait : Venit germanus tuus fraudulenter, et accepit benedictionem tuam.
text_pt: E ele disse: Veio teu irmão com sutileza, e tomou a tua bênção.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ἐλθὼν ὁ ἀδελφός σου μετὰ δόλου ἔλαβεν τὴν εὐλογίαν σου

text_en: But he said again: Rightly is his name called Jacob ; for he has supplanted me lo this second time: My birthright he took away before, and now this second time he has stolen away my blessing . And again he said to his father: Have you not reserved me also a blessing ?
text_la: At ille subjunxit : Juste vocatum est nomen ejus Jacob : supplantavit enim me en altera vice : primogenita mea ante tulit, et nunc secundo surripuit benedictionem meam. Rursumque ad patrem : Numquid non reservasti, ait, et mihi benedictionem?
text_pt: Então disse ele: Não é o seu nome justamente Jacó, tanto que já duas vezes me enganou? A minha primogenitura me tomou, e eis que agora me tomou a minha bênção. E perguntou: Não reservaste, pois, para mim nenhuma bênção?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν δικαίως ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ιακωβ ἐπτέρνικεν γάρ με ἤδη δεύτερον τοῦτο τά τε πρωτοτόκιά μου εἴληφεν καὶ νῦν εἴληφεν τὴν εὐλογίαν μου καὶ εἶπεν Ησαυ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ οὐχ ὑπελίπω μοι εὐλογίαν πάτερ

text_en: Isaac answered: I have appointed him your lord, and have made all his brethren his servants: I have established him with corn and wine, and after this, what shall I do more for you, my son?
text_la: Respondit Isaac : Dominum tuum illum constitui, et omnes fratres ejus servituti illius subjugavi; frumento et vino stabilivi eum : et tibi post hæc, fili mi, ultra quid faciam?
text_pt: Então respondeu Isaque a Esaú dizendo: Eis que o tenho posto por senhor sobre ti, e todos os seus irmãos lhe tenho dado por servos; e de trigo e de mosto o tenho fortalecido; que te farei, pois, agora, meu filho?
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ισαακ εἶπεν τῷ Ησαυ εἰ κύριον αὐτὸν ἐποίησά σου καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐποίησα αὐτοῦ οἰκέτας σίτῳ καὶ οἴνῳ ἐστήρισα αὐτόν σοὶ δὲ τί ποιήσω τέκνον

text_en: And Esau said to him: Have you only one blessing , father? I beseech you bless me also. And when he wept with a loud cry,
text_la: Cui Esau : Num unam, inquit, tantum benedictionem habes, pater? mihi quoque obsecro ut benedicas. Cumque ejulatu magno fleret,
text_pt: E disse Esaú a seu pai: Tens uma só bênção, meu pai? Abençoa-me também a mim, meu pai. E levantou Esaú a sua voz, e chorou.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ησαυ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ μὴ εὐλογία μία σοί ἐστιν πάτερ εὐλόγησον δὴ κἀμέ πάτερ κατανυχθέντος δὲ Ισαακ ἀνεβόησεν φωνὴν Ησαυ καὶ ἔκλαυσεν

text_en: Isaac being moved, said to him: In the fat of the earth, and in the dew of heaven from above,
text_la: motus Isaac, dixit ad eum : In pinguedine terræ, et in rore cæli desuper,
text_pt: Então respondeu Isaque, seu pai, e disse-lhe: Eis que a tua habitação será nas gorduras da terra e no orvalho dos altos céus.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ισαακ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἰδοὺ ἀπὸ τῆς πιότητος τῆς γῆς ἔσται ἡ κατοίκησίς σου καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς δρόσου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἄνωθεν

text_en: shall your blessing be. You shall live by the sword, and shall serve your brother: and the time shall come, when you shall shake off and loose his yoke from your neck.
text_la: erit benedictio tua. Vives in gladio, et fratri tuo servies : tempusque veniet, cum excutias et solvas jugum ejus de cervicibus tuis.
text_pt: E pela tua espada viverás, e ao teu irmão servirás. Acontecerá, porém, que quando te assenhoreares, então sacudirás o seu jugo do teu pescoço.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ μαχαίρῃ σου ζήσῃ καὶ τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου δουλεύσεις ἔσται δὲ ἡνίκα ἐὰν καθέλῃς καὶ ἐκλύσεις τὸν ζυγὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ τραχήλου σου

text_en: Esau therefore always hated Jacob , for the blessing wherewith his father had blessed him; and he said in his heart: The days will come of the mourning for my father, and I will kill my brother Jacob .
text_la: Oderat ergo semper Esau Jacob pro benedictione qua benedixerat ei pater : dixitque in corde suo : Venient dies luctus patris mei, et occidam Jacob fratrem meum.
text_pt: E Esaú odiou a Jacó por causa daquela bênção, com que seu pai o tinha abençoado; e Esaú disse no seu coração: Chegar-se-ão os dias de luto de meu pai; e matarei a Jacó meu irmão.
text_el: καὶ ἐνεκότει Ησαυ τῷ Ιακωβ περὶ τῆς εὐλογίας ἧς εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ εἶπεν δὲ Ησαυ ἐν τῇ διανοίᾳ ἐγγισάτωσαν αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ πένθους τοῦ πατρός μου ἵνα ἀποκτείνω Ιακωβ τὸν ἀδελφόν μου

text_en: These things were told to Rebecca: and she sent and called Jacob , her son, and said to him: Behold Esau , your brother, threatens to kill you.
text_la: Nuntiata sunt hæc Rebeccæ : quæ mittens et vocans Jacob filium suum, dixit ad eum : Ecce Esau frater tuus minatur ut occidat te.
text_pt: E foram denunciadas a Rebeca estas palavras de Esaú, seu filho mais velho; e ela mandou chamar a Jacó, seu filho menor, e disse-lhe: Eis que Esaú teu irmão se consola a teu respeito, propondo matar-te.
text_el: ἀπηγγέλη δὲ Ρεβεκκα τὰ ῥήματα Ησαυ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτῆς τοῦ πρεσβυτέρου καὶ πέμψασα ἐκάλεσεν Ιακωβ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτῆς τὸν νεώτερον καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἰδοὺ Ησαυ ὁ ἀδελφός σου ἀπειλεῖ σοι τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναί σε

text_en: Now therefore, my son, hear my voice, arise and flee to Laban , my brother, to Haran :
text_la: Nunc ergo, fili mi, audi vocem meam, et consurgens fuge ad Laban fratrem meum in Haran:
text_pt: Agora, pois, meu filho, ouve a minha voz, e levanta-te; acolhe-te a Labão meu irmão, em Harã,
text_el: νῦν οὖν τέκνον ἄκουσόν μου τῆς φωνῆς καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀπόδραθι εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν πρὸς Λαβαν τὸν ἀδελφόν μου εἰς Χαρραν

text_en: And you shall dwell with him a few days, till the wrath of your brother be assuaged,
text_la: habitabisque cum eo dies paucos, donec requiescat furor fratris tui,
text_pt: E mora com ele alguns dias, até que passe o furor de teu irmão;
text_el: καὶ οἴκησον μετ' αὐτοῦ ἡμέρας τινὰς ἕως τοῦ ἀποστρέψαι τὸν θυμὸν

text_en: and his indignation cease, and he forget the things you have done to him: afterwards I will send, and bring you from thence hither. Why shall I be deprived of both my sons in one day?
text_la: et cesset indignatio ejus, obliviscaturque eorum quæ fecisti in eum : postea mittam, et adducam te inde huc : cur utroque orbabor filio in uno die?
text_pt: Até que se desvie de ti a ira de teu irmão, e se esqueça do que lhe fizeste; então mandarei trazer-te de lá; por que seria eu desfilhada também de vós ambos num mesmo dia?
text_el: καὶ τὴν ὀργὴν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἐπιλάθηται ἃ πεποίηκας αὐτῷ καὶ ἀποστείλασα μεταπέμψομαί σε ἐκεῖθεν μήποτε ἀτεκνωθῶ ἀπὸ τῶν δύο ὑμῶν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ

text_en: And Rebecca said to Isaac : I am weary of my life, because of the daughters of Heth : if Jacob take a wife of the stock of this land, I choose not to live.
text_la: Dixitque Rebecca ad Isaac : Tædet me vitæ meæ propter filias Heth : si acceperit Jacob uxorem de stirpe hujus terræ, nolo vivere.
text_pt: E disse Rebeca a Isaque: Enfadada estou da minha vida, por causa das filhas de Hete; se Jacó tomar mulher das filhas de Hete, como estas são, das filhas desta terra, para que me servirá a vida?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ρεβεκκα πρὸς Ισαακ προσώχθικα τῇ ζωῇ μου διὰ τὰς θυγατέρας τῶν υἱῶν Χετ εἰ λήμψεται Ιακωβ γυναῖκα ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τῆς γῆς ταύτης ἵνα τί μοι ζῆν

text_en: And Isaac called Jacob , and blessed him, and charged him, saying: Take not a wife of the stock of Chanaan :
text_la: Vocavit itaque Isaac Jacob, et benedixit eum, præcepitque ei dicens : Noli accipere conjugem de genere Chanaan:
text_pt: E Isaque chamou a Jacó, e abençoou-o, e ordenou-lhe, e disse-lhe: Não tomes mulher de entre as filhas de Canaã;
text_el: προσκαλεσάμενος δὲ Ισαακ τὸν Ιακωβ εὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ λέγων οὐ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Χανααν

text_en: But go, and take a journey to Mesopotamia of Syria , to the house of Bathuel, your mother's father, and take you a wife thence of the daughters of Laban , your uncle.
text_la: sed vade, et proficiscere in Mesopotamiam Syriæ, ad domum Bathuel patris matris tuæ, et accipe tibi inde uxorem de filiabus Laban avunculi tui.
text_pt: Levanta-te, vai a Padã-Arã, à casa de Betuel, pai de tua mãe, e toma de lá uma mulher das filhas de Labão, irmão de tua mãe;
text_el: ἀναστὰς ἀπόδραθι εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Βαθουηλ τοῦ πατρὸς τῆς μητρός σου καὶ λαβὲ σεαυτῷ ἐκεῖθεν γυναῖκα ἐκ τῶν θυγατέρων Λαβαν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τῆς μητρός σου

text_en: And God almighty bless you, and make you to increase and multiply you: that you may be a multitude of people .
text_la: Deus autem omnipotens benedicat tibi, et crescere te faciat, atque multiplicet, ut sis in turbas populorum.
text_pt: E Deus Todo-Poderoso te abençoe, e te faça frutificar, e te multiplique, para que sejas uma multidão de povos;
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεός μου εὐλογήσαι σε καὶ αὐξήσαι σε καὶ πληθύναι σε καὶ ἔσῃ εἰς συναγωγὰς ἐθνῶν

text_en: And give the blessings of Abraham to you, and to your seed after you: that you may possess the land of your sojournment, which he promised to your grandfather.
text_la: Et det tibi benedictiones Abrahæ, et semini tuo post te : ut possideas terram peregrinationis tuæ, quam pollicitus est avo tuo.
text_pt: E te dê a bênção de Abraão, a ti e à tua descendência contigo, para que em herança possuas a terra de tuas peregrinações, que Deus deu a Abraão.
text_el: καὶ δῴη σοι τὴν εὐλογίαν Αβρααμ τοῦ πατρός μου σοὶ καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου μετὰ σέ κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν τῆς παροικήσεώς σου ἣν ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τῷ Αβρααμ

text_en: And when Isaac had sent him away, he took his journey and went to Mesopotamia of Syria , to Laban , the son of Bathuel, the Syrian , brother to Rebecca, his mother.
text_la: Cumque dimisisset eum Isaac, profectus venit in Mesopotamiam Syriæ ad Laban filium Bathuel Syri, fratrem Rebeccæ matris suæ.
text_pt: Assim despediu Isaque a Jacó, o qual se foi a Padã-Arã, a Labão, filho de Betuel, arameu, irmão de Rebeca, mãe de Jacó e de Esaú.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Ισαακ τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν πρὸς Λαβαν τὸν υἱὸν Βαθουηλ τοῦ Σύρου ἀδελφὸν δὲ Ρεβεκκας τῆς μητρὸς Ιακωβ καὶ Ησαυ

text_en: And Esau seeing that his father had blessed Jacob , and had sent him into Mesopotamia of Syria , to marry a wife thence; and that after the blessing he had charged him, saying: You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Chanaan :
text_la: Videns autem Esau quod benedixisset pater suus Jacob, et misisset eum in Mesopotamiam Syriæ, ut inde uxorem duceret; et quod post benedictionem præcepisset ei, dicens : Non accipies uxorem de filiabus Chanaan:
text_pt: Vendo, pois, Esaú que Isaque abençoara a Jacó, e o enviara a Padã-Arã, para tomar mulher dali para si, e que, abençoando-o, lhe ordenara, dizendo: Não tomes mulher das filhas de Canaã;
text_el: εἶδεν δὲ Ησαυ ὅτι εὐλόγησεν Ισαακ τὸν Ιακωβ καὶ ἀπῴχετο εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Συρίας λαβεῖν ἑαυτῷ ἐκεῖθεν γυναῖκα ἐν τῷ εὐλογεῖν αὐτὸν καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτῷ λέγων οὐ λήμψῃ γυναῖκα ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων Χανααν

text_en: And that Jacob obeying his parents, had gone into Syria :
text_la: quodque obediens Jacob parentibus suis isset in Syriam:
text_pt: E que Jacó obedecera a seu pai e a sua mãe, e se fora a Padã-Arã;
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Ιακωβ τοῦ πατρὸς καὶ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς τὴν Μεσοποταμίαν Συρίας

text_en: Experiencing also, that his father was not well pleased with the daughters of Chanaan :
text_la: probans quoque quod non libenter aspiceret filias Chanaan pater suus:
text_pt: Vendo também Esaú que as filhas de Canaã eram más aos olhos de Isaque seu pai,
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ησαυ ὅτι πονηραί εἰσιν αἱ θυγατέρες Χανααν ἐναντίον Ισαακ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: He went to Ismael , and took to wife , besides them he had before, Maheleth, the daughter of Ismael , Abraham's son, the sister of Nabajoth.
text_la: ivit ad Ismaëlem, et duxit uxorem absque iis, quas prius habebat, Maheleth filiam Ismaël filii Abraham, sororem Nabaioth.
text_pt: Foi Esaú a Ismael, e tomou para si por mulher, além das suas mulheres, a Maalate filha de Ismael, filho de Abraão, irmã de Nebaiote.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ησαυ πρὸς Ισμαηλ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὴν Μαελεθ θυγατέρα Ισμαηλ τοῦ υἱοῦ Αβρααμ ἀδελφὴν Ναβαιωθ πρὸς ταῖς γυναιξὶν αὐτοῦ γυναῖκα

text_en: But Jacob being departed from Bersabee , went on to Haran .
text_la: Igitur egressus Jacob de Bersabee, pergebat Haran.
text_pt: Partiu, pois, Jacó de Berseba, e foi a Harã;
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Ιακωβ ἀπὸ τοῦ φρέατος τοῦ ὅρκου καὶ ἐπορεύθη εἰς Χαρραν

text_en: And when he had come to a certain place, and would rest in it after sunset, he took of the stones that lay there, and putting under his head, slept in the same place.
text_la: Cumque venisset ad quemdam locum, et vellet in eo requiescere post solis occubitum, tulit de lapidibus qui jacebant, et supponens capiti suo, dormivit in eodem loco.
text_pt: E chegou a um lugar onde passou a noite, porque já o sol era posto; e tomou uma das pedras daquele lugar, e a pôs por seu travesseiro, e deitou-se naquele lugar.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήντησεν τόπῳ καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐκεῖ ἔδυ γὰρ ὁ ἥλιος καὶ ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ τῶν λίθων τοῦ τόπου καὶ ἔθηκεν πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ἐκείνῳ

text_en: And he saw in his sleep a ladder standing upon the earth, and the top thereof touching heaven : the angels also of God ascending and descending by it.
text_la: Viditque in somnis scalam stantem super terram, et cacumen illius tangens cælum : angelos quoque Dei ascendentes et descendentes per eam,
text_pt: E sonhou: e eis uma escada posta na terra, cujo topo tocava nos céus; e eis que os anjos de Deus subiam e desciam por ela;
text_el: καὶ ἐνυπνιάσθη καὶ ἰδοὺ κλίμαξ ἐστηριγμένη ἐν τῇ γῇ ἧς ἡ κεφαλὴ ἀφικνεῖτο εἰς τὸν οὐρανόν καὶ οἱ ἄγγελοι τοῦ θεοῦ ἀνέβαινον καὶ κατέβαινον ἐπ' αὐτῆς

text_en: And the Lord leaning upon the ladder saying to him: I am the Lord God of Abraham your father, and the God of Isaac : The land, wherein you sleep, I will give to you and to your seed.
text_la: et Dominum innixum scalæ dicentem sibi : Ego sum Dominus Deus Abraham patris tui, et Deus Isaac : terram, in qua dormis, tibi dabo et semini tuo.
text_pt: E eis que o Senhor estava em cima dela, e disse: Eu sou o Senhor Deus de Abraão teu pai, e o Deus de Isaque; esta terra, em que estás deitado, darei a ti e à tua descendência;
text_el: ὁ δὲ κύριος ἐπεστήρικτο ἐπ' αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν ἐγὼ κύριος ὁ θεὸς Αβρααμ τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ ὁ θεὸς Ισαακ μὴ φοβοῦ ἡ γῆ ἐφ' ἧς σὺ καθεύδεις ἐπ' αὐτῆς σοὶ δώσω αὐτὴν καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου

text_en: And your seed shall be as the dust of the earth: you shall spread abroad to the west, and to the east, and to the north, and to the south: and in you and your seed, all the tribes of the earth shall be blessed.
text_la: Eritque semen tuum quasi pulvis terræ : dilataberis ad occidentem, et orientem, et septentrionem, et meridiem : et benedicentur in te et in semine tuo cunctæ tribus terræ.
text_pt: E a tua descendência será como o pó da terra, e estender-se-á ao ocidente, e ao oriente, e ao norte, e ao sul, e em ti e na tua descendência serão benditas todas as famílias da terra;
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα σου ὡς ἡ ἄμμος τῆς γῆς καὶ πλατυνθήσεται ἐπὶ θάλασσαν καὶ ἐπὶ λίβα καὶ ἐπὶ βορρᾶν καὶ ἐπ' ἀνατολάς καὶ ἐνευλογηθήσονται ἐν σοὶ πᾶσαι αἱ φυλαὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐν τῷ σπέρματί σου

text_en: And I will be your keeper wherever you go, and will bring you back into this land: neither will I leave you, till I shall have accomplished all that I have said.
text_la: Et ero custos tuus quocumque perrexeris, et reducam te in terram hanc : nec dimittam nisi complevero universa quæ dixi.
text_pt: E eis que estou contigo, e te guardarei por onde quer que fores, e te farei tornar a esta terra; porque não te deixarei, até que haja cumprido o que te tenho falado.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ μετὰ σοῦ διαφυλάσσων σε ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ πάσῃ οὗ ἐὰν πορευθῇς καὶ ἀποστρέψω σε εἰς τὴν γῆν ταύτην ὅτι οὐ μή σε ἐγκαταλίπω ἕως τοῦ ποιῆσαί με πάντα ὅσα ἐλάλησά σοι

text_en: And when Jacob awaked out of sleep, he said: Indeed the Lord is in this place, and I knew it not.
text_la: Cumque evigilasset Jacob de somno, ait : Vere Dominus est in loco isto, et ego nesciebam.
text_pt: Acordando, pois, Jacó do seu sono, disse: Na verdade o Senhor está neste lugar; e eu não o sabia.
text_el: καὶ ἐξηγέρθη Ιακωβ ἀπὸ τοῦ ὕπνου αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ὅτι ἔστιν κύριος ἐν τῷ τόπῳ τούτῳ ἐγὼ δὲ οὐκ ᾔδειν

text_en: And trembling, he said: How terrible is this place? This is no other but the house of God , and the gate of heaven .
text_la: Pavensque, Quam terribilis est, inquit, locus iste! non est hic aliud nisi domus Dei, et porta cæli.
text_pt: E temeu, e disse: Quão terrível é este lugar! Este não é outro lugar senão a casa de Deus; e esta é a porta dos céus.
text_el: καὶ ἐφοβήθη καὶ εἶπεν ὡς φοβερὸς ὁ τόπος οὗτος οὐκ ἔστιν τοῦτο ἀλλ' ἢ οἶκος θεοῦ καὶ αὕτη ἡ πύλη τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: And Jacob arising in the morning, took the stone which he had laid under his head, and set it up for a title, pouring oil upon the top of it.
text_la: Surgens ergo Jacob mane, tulit lapidem quem supposuerat capiti suo, et erexit in titulum, fundens oleum desuper.
text_pt: Então levantou-se Jacó pela manhã de madrugada, e tomou a pedra que tinha posto por seu travesseiro, e a pôs por coluna, e derramou azeite em cima dela.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Ιακωβ τὸ πρωὶ καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν λίθον ὃν ὑπέθηκεν ἐκεῖ πρὸς κεφαλῆς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν στήλην καὶ ἐπέχεεν ἔλαιον ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον αὐτῆς

text_en: And he called the name of the city Bethel , which before was called Luza.
text_la: Appellavitque nomen urbis Bethel, quæ prius Luza vocabatur.
text_pt: E chamou o nome daquele lugar Betel; o nome porém daquela cidade antes era Luz.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ιακωβ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Οἶκος θεοῦ καὶ Ουλαμλους ἦν ὄνομα τῇ πόλει τὸ πρότερον

text_en: And he made a vow , saying: If God shall be with me, and shall keep me on the way, by which I walk, and shall give me bread to eat, and raiment to put on,
text_la: Vovit etiam votum, dicens : Si fuerit Deus mecum, et custodierit me in via, per quam ego ambulo, et dederit mihi panem ad vescendum, et vestimentum ad induendum,
text_pt: E Jacó fez um voto, dizendo: Se Deus for comigo, e me guardar nesta viagem que faço, e me der pão para comer, e vestes para vestir;
text_el: καὶ ηὔξατο Ιακωβ εὐχὴν λέγων ἐὰν ᾖ κύριος ὁ θεὸς μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ διαφυλάξῃ με ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ταύτῃ ᾗ ἐγὼ πορεύομαι καὶ δῷ μοι ἄρτον φαγεῖν καὶ ἱμάτιον περιβαλέσθαι

text_en: and I shall return prosperously to my father's house: the Lord shall be my God :
text_la: reversusque fuero prospere ad domum patris mei : erit mihi Dominus in Deum,
text_pt: E eu em paz tornar à casa de meu pai, o Senhor me será por Deus;
text_el: καὶ ἀποστρέψῃ με μετὰ σωτηρίας εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός μου καὶ ἔσται μοι κύριος εἰς θεόν

text_en: And this stone, which I have set up for a title, shall be called the house of God : and of all things that you shall give to me, I will offer tithes to you.
text_la: et lapis iste, quem erexi in titulum, vocabitur Domus Dei : cunctorumque quæ dederis mihi, decimas offeram tibi.
text_pt: E esta pedra que tenho posto por coluna será casa de Deus; e de tudo quanto me deres, certamente te darei o dízimo.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λίθος οὗτος ὃν ἔστησα στήλην ἔσται μοι οἶκος θεοῦ καὶ πάντων ὧν ἐάν μοι δῷς δεκάτην ἀποδεκατώσω αὐτά σοι

text_en: Then Jacob went on in his journey, and came into the east country.
text_la: Profectus ergo Jacob venit in terram orientalem.
text_pt: Então pôs-se Jacó a caminho e foi à terra do povo do oriente;
text_el: καὶ ἐξάρας Ιακωβ τοὺς πόδας ἐπορεύθη εἰς γῆν ἀνατολῶν πρὸς Λαβαν τὸν υἱὸν Βαθουηλ τοῦ Σύρου ἀδελφὸν δὲ Ρεβεκκας μητρὸς Ιακωβ καὶ Ησαυ

text_en: And he saw a well in the field, and three flocks of sheep lying by it: for the beasts were watered out of it, and the mouth thereof was closed with a great stone.
text_la: Et vidit puteum in agro, tres quoque greges ovium accubantes juxta eum : nam ex illo adaquabantur pecora, et os ejus grandi lapide claudebatur.
text_pt: E olhou, e eis um poço no campo, e eis três rebanhos de ovelhas que estavam deitados junto a ele; porque daquele poço davam de beber aos rebanhos; e havia uma grande pedra sobre a boca do poço.
text_el: καὶ ὁρᾷ καὶ ἰδοὺ φρέαρ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ ἦσαν δὲ ἐκεῖ τρία ποίμνια προβάτων ἀναπαυόμενα ἐπ' αὐτοῦ ἐκ γὰρ τοῦ φρέατος ἐκείνου ἐπότιζον τὰ ποίμνια λίθος δὲ ἦν μέγας ἐπὶ τῷ στόματι τοῦ φρέατος
