text_en: And the custom was, when all the sheep were gathered together, to roll away the stone, and after the sheep were watered, to put it on the mouth of the well again.
text_la: Morisque erat ut cunctis ovibus congregatis devolverent lapidem, et refectis gregibus rursum super os putei ponerent.
text_pt: E ajuntavam ali todos os rebanhos, e removiam a pedra de sobre a boca do poço, e davam de beber às ovelhas; e tornavam a pôr a pedra sobre a boca do poço, no seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ συνήγοντο ἐκεῖ πάντα τὰ ποίμνια καὶ ἀπεκύλιον τὸν λίθον ἀπὸ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ φρέατος καὶ ἐπότιζον τὰ πρόβατα καὶ ἀπεκαθίστων τὸν λίθον ἐπὶ τὸ στόμα τοῦ φρέατος εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said to the shepherds: Brethren, whence are you? They answered: Of Haran .
text_la: Dixitque ad pastores : Fratres, unde estis? Qui responderunt : De Haran.
text_pt: E disse-lhes Jacó: Meus irmãos, donde sois? E disseram: Somos de Harã.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ιακωβ ἀδελφοί πόθεν ἐστὲ ὑμεῖς οἱ δὲ εἶπαν ἐκ Χαρραν ἐσμέν

text_en: And he asked them, saying: Know you Laban , the son of Nachor? They said: We know him.
text_la: Quos interrogans, Numquid, ait, nostis Laban filium Nachor? Dixerunt : Novimus.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Conheceis a Labão, filho de Naor? E disseram: Conhecemos.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς γινώσκετε Λαβαν τὸν υἱὸν Ναχωρ οἱ δὲ εἶπαν γινώσκομεν

text_en: He said: Is he in health? He is in health, say they: and behold, Rachel , his daughter, comes with his flock.
text_la: Sanusne est? inquit. Valet, inquiunt : et ecce Rachel filia ejus venit cum grege suo.
text_pt: Disse-lhes mais: Está ele bem? E disseram: Está bem, e eis aqui Raquel sua filha, que vem com as ovelhas.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς ὑγιαίνει οἱ δὲ εἶπαν ὑγιαίνει καὶ ἰδοὺ Ραχηλ ἡ θυγάτηρ αὐτοῦ ἤρχετο μετὰ τῶν προβάτων

text_en: And Jacob said: There is yet much day remaining, neither is it time to bring the flocks into the folds again: first give the sheep drink, and so lead them back to feed.
text_la: Dixitque Jacob : Adhuc multum diei superest, nec est tempus ut reducantur ad caulas greges : date ante potum ovibus, et sic eas ad pastum reducite.
text_pt: E ele disse: Eis que ainda é pleno dia, não é tempo de ajuntar o gado; dai de beber às ovelhas, e ide apascentá-las.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιακωβ ἔτι ἐστὶν ἡμέρα πολλή οὔπω ὥρα συναχθῆναι τὰ κτήνη ποτίσαντες τὰ πρόβατα ἀπελθόντες βόσκετε

text_en: They answered: We cannot, till all the cattle be gathered together, and we remove the stone from the well's mouth, that we may water the flocks.
text_la: Qui responderunt : Non possumus, donec omnia pecora congregentur, et amoveamus lapidem de ore putei, ut adaquemus greges.
text_pt: E disseram: Não podemos, até que todos os rebanhos se ajuntem, e removam a pedra de sobre a boca do poço, para que demos de beber às ovelhas.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν οὐ δυνησόμεθα ἕως τοῦ συναχθῆναι πάντας τοὺς ποιμένας καὶ ἀποκυλίσωσιν τὸν λίθον ἀπὸ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ φρέατος καὶ ποτιοῦμεν τὰ πρόβατα

text_en: They were yet speaking, and behold Rachel came with her father's sheep; for she fed the flock.
text_la: Adhuc loquebantur, et ecce Rachel veniebat cum ovibus patris sui : nam gregem ipsa pascebat.
text_pt: Estando ele ainda falando com eles, veio Raquel com as ovelhas de seu pai; porque ela era pastora.
text_el: ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος αὐτοῖς καὶ Ραχηλ ἡ θυγάτηρ Λαβαν ἤρχετο μετὰ τῶν προβάτων τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς αὐτὴ γὰρ ἔβοσκεν τὰ πρόβατα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: And when Jacob saw her, and knew her to be his cousin german, and that they were the sheep of Laban , his uncle: he removed the stone wherewith the well was closed.
text_la: Quam cum vidisset Jacob, et sciret consobrinam suam, ovesque Laban avunculi sui, amovit lapidem quo puteus claudebatur.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, vendo Jacó a Raquel, filha de Labão, irmão de sua mãe, e as ovelhas de Labão, irmão de sua mãe, chegou Jacó, e revolveu a pedra de sobre a boca do poço e deu de beber às ovelhas de Labão, irmão de sua mãe.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ὡς εἶδεν Ιακωβ τὴν Ραχηλ θυγατέρα Λαβαν ἀδελφοῦ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ πρόβατα Λαβαν ἀδελφοῦ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ προσελθὼν Ιακωβ ἀπεκύλισεν τὸν λίθον ἀπὸ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ φρέατος καὶ ἐπότισεν τὰ πρόβατα Λαβαν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τῆς μητρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And having watered the flock, he kissed her: and lifting up his voice wept.
text_la: Et adaquato grege, osculatus est eam : et elevata voce flevit,
text_pt: E Jacó beijou a Raquel, e levantou a sua voz e chorou.
text_el: καὶ ἐφίλησεν Ιακωβ τὴν Ραχηλ καὶ βοήσας τῇ φωνῇ αὐτοῦ ἔκλαυσεν

text_en: And he told her that he was her father's brother, and the son of Rebecca: but she went in haste and told her father.
text_la: et indicavit ei quod frater esset patris sui, et filius Rebeccæ : at illa festinans nuntiavit patri suo.
text_pt: E Jacó anunciou a Raquel que era irmão de seu pai, e que era filho de Rebeca; então ela correu, e o anunciou a seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλεν τῇ Ραχηλ ὅτι ἀδελφὸς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς ἐστιν καὶ ὅτι υἱὸς Ρεβεκκας ἐστίν καὶ δραμοῦσα ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτῆς κατὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα

text_en: Who, when he heard that Jacob his sister's son had come, ran forth to meet him: and embracing him, and heartily kissing him, brought him into his house. And when he had heard the causes of his journey,
text_la: Qui cum audisset venisse Jacob filium sororis suæ, cucurrit obviam ei : complexusque eum, et in oscula ruens, duxit in domum suam. Auditis autem causis itineris,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ouvindo Labão as novas de Jacó, filho de sua irmã, correu-lhe ao encontro, e abraçou-o, e beijou-o, e levou-o à sua casa; e ele contou a Labão todas estas coisas.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ὡς ἤκουσεν Λαβαν τὸ ὄνομα Ιακωβ τοῦ υἱοῦ τῆς ἀδελφῆς αὐτοῦ ἔδραμεν εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ καὶ περιλαβὼν αὐτὸν ἐφίλησεν καὶ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ καὶ διηγήσατο τῷ Λαβαν πάντας τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: he answered: You are my bone and my flesh. And after the days of one month were expired,
text_la: respondit : Os meum es, et caro mea. Et postquam impleti sunt dies mensis unius,
text_pt: Então Labão disse-lhe: Verdadeiramente és tu o meu osso e a minha carne. E ficou com ele um mês inteiro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Λαβαν ἐκ τῶν ὀστῶν μου καὶ ἐκ τῆς σαρκός μου εἶ σύ καὶ ἦν μετ' αὐτοῦ μῆνα ἡμερῶν

text_en: he said to him: Because you are my brother, shall you serve me without wages? Tell me what wages you will have.
text_la: dixit ei : Num quia frater meus es, gratis servies mihi? dic quid mercedis accipias.
text_pt: Depois disse Labão a Jacó: Porque tu és meu irmão, hás de servir-me de graça? Declara-me qual será o teu salário.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Λαβαν τῷ Ιακωβ ὅτι γὰρ ἀδελφός μου εἶ οὐ δουλεύσεις μοι δωρεάν ἀπάγγειλόν μοι τίς ὁ μισθός σού ἐστιν

text_en: Now he had two daughters, the name of the elder was Lia; and the younger was called Rachel .
text_la: Habebat vero duas filias : nomen majoris Lia, minor vero appellabatur Rachel.
text_pt: E Labão tinha duas filhas; o nome da mais velha era Lia, e o nome da menor Raquel.
text_el: τῷ δὲ Λαβαν δύο θυγατέρες ὄνομα τῇ μείζονι Λεια καὶ ὄνομα τῇ νεωτέρᾳ Ραχηλ

text_en: But Lia was blear eyed: Rachel was well favoured, and of a beautiful countenance.
text_la: Sed Lia lippis erat oculis : Rachel decora facie, et venusto aspectu.
text_pt: Lia tinha olhos tenros, mas Raquel era de formoso semblante e formosa à vista.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ Λειας ἀσθενεῖς Ραχηλ δὲ καλὴ τῷ εἴδει καὶ ὡραία τῇ ὄψει

text_en: And Jacob being in love with her, said: I will serve you seven years for Rachel , your younger daughter.
text_la: Quam diligens Jacob, ait : Serviam tibi pro Rachel filia tua minore, septem annis.
text_pt: E Jacó amava a Raquel, e disse: Sete anos te servirei por Raquel, tua filha menor.
text_el: ἠγάπησεν δὲ Ιακωβ τὴν Ραχηλ καὶ εἶπεν δουλεύσω σοι ἑπτὰ ἔτη περὶ Ραχηλ τῆς θυγατρός σου τῆς νεωτέρας

text_en: Laban answered: It is better that I give her to you than to another man ; stay with me.
text_la: Respondit Laban : Melius est ut tibi eam dem quam alteri viro : mane apud me.
text_pt: Então disse Labão: Melhor é que eu a dê a ti, do que eu a dê a outro homem; fica comigo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Λαβαν βέλτιον δοῦναί με αὐτὴν σοὶ ἢ δοῦναί με αὐτὴν ἀνδρὶ ἑτέρῳ οἴκησον μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: So Jacob served seven years for Rachel : and they seemed but a few days, because of the greatness of his love .
text_la: Servivit ergo Jacob pro Rachel septem annis: et videbantur illi pauci dies præ amoris magnitudine.
text_pt: Assim serviu Jacó sete anos por Raquel; e estes lhe pareceram como poucos dias, pelo muito que a amava.
text_el: καὶ ἐδούλευσεν Ιακωβ περὶ Ραχηλ ἔτη ἑπτά καὶ ἦσαν ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ὡς ἡμέραι ὀλίγαι παρὰ τὸ ἀγαπᾶν αὐτὸν αὐτήν

text_en: And he said to Laban : Give me my wife; for now the time is fulfilled, that I may go in unto her.
text_la: Dixitque ad Laban : Da mihi uxorem meam : quia jam tempus impletum est, ut ingrediar ad illam.
text_pt: E disse Jacó a Labão: Dá-me minha mulher, porque meus dias são cumpridos, para que eu me case com ela.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ πρὸς Λαβαν ἀπόδος τὴν γυναῖκά μου πεπλήρωνται γὰρ αἱ ἡμέραι μου ὅπως εἰσέλθω πρὸς αὐτήν

text_en: And he, having invited a great number of his friends to the feast, made the marriage .
text_la: Qui vocatis multis amicorum turbis ad convivium, fecit nuptias.
text_pt: Então reuniu Labão a todos os homens daquele lugar, e fez um banquete.
text_el: συνήγαγεν δὲ Λαβαν πάντας τοὺς ἄνδρας τοῦ τόπου καὶ ἐποίησεν γάμον

text_en: And at night he brought in Lia, his daughter, to him,
text_la: Et vespere Liam filiam suam introduxit ad eum,
text_pt: E aconteceu, à tarde, que tomou Lia, sua filha, e trouxe-a a Jacó que a possuiu.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἑσπέρα καὶ λαβὼν Λαβαν Λειαν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ εἰσήγαγεν αὐτὴν πρὸς Ιακωβ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτὴν Ιακωβ

text_en: giving his daughter a handmaid, named Zelpha. Now when Jacob had gone in to her according to custom, when morning had come he saw it was Lia.
text_la: dans ancillam filiæ, Zelpham nomine. Ad quam cum ex more Jacob fuisset ingressus, facto mane vidit Liam:
text_pt: E Labão deu sua serva Zilpa a Lia, sua filha, por serva.
text_el: ἔδωκεν δὲ Λαβαν Λεια τῇ θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ Ζελφαν τὴν παιδίσκην αὐτοῦ αὐτῇ παιδίσκην

text_en: And he said to his father in law: What is it that you meant to do? Did not I serve you for Rachel ? Why have you deceived me?
text_la: et dixit ad socerum suum : Quid est quod facere voluisti? nonne pro Rachel servivi tibi? quare imposuisti mihi?
text_pt: E aconteceu que pela manhã, viu que era Lia; pelo que disse a Labão: Por que me fizeste isso? Não te tenho servido por Raquel? Por que então me enganaste?
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ πρωί καὶ ἰδοὺ ἦν Λεια εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ τῷ Λαβαν τί τοῦτο ἐποίησάς μοι οὐ περὶ Ραχηλ ἐδούλευσα παρὰ σοί καὶ ἵνα τί παρελογίσω με

text_en: Laban answered: It is not the custom in this place, to give the younger in marriage first.
text_la: Respondit Laban : Non est in loco nostro consuetudinis, ut minores ante tradamus ad nuptias.
text_pt: E disse Labão: Não se faz assim no nosso lugar, que a menor se dê antes da primogênita.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Λαβαν οὐκ ἔστιν οὕτως ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ἡμῶν δοῦναι τὴν νεωτέραν πρὶν ἢ τὴν πρεσβυτέραν

text_en: Make up the week of days of this match: and I will give you her also, for the service that you shall render me other seven years.
text_la: Imple hebdomadam dierum hujus copulæ: et hanc quoque dabo tibi pro opere quo serviturus es mihi septem annis aliis.
text_pt: Cumpre a semana desta; então te daremos também a outra, pelo serviço que ainda outros sete anos comigo servires.
text_el: συντέλεσον οὖν τὰ ἕβδομα ταύτης καὶ δώσω σοι καὶ ταύτην ἀντὶ τῆς ἐργασίας ἧς ἐργᾷ παρ' ἐμοὶ ἔτι ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἕτερα

text_en: He yielded to his pleasure: and after the week was past, he married Rachel :
text_la: Acquievit placito : et hebdomada transacta, Rachel duxit uxorem:
text_pt: E Jacó fez assim, e cumpriu a semana de Lia; então lhe deu por mulher Raquel sua filha.
text_el: ἐποίησεν δὲ Ιακωβ οὕτως καὶ ἀνεπλήρωσεν τὰ ἕβδομα ταύτης καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ Λαβαν Ραχηλ τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ αὐτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: To whom her father gave Bala, for her servant.
text_la: cui pater servam Balam tradiderat.
text_pt: E Labão deu sua serva Bila por serva a Raquel, sua filha.
text_el: ἔδωκεν δὲ Λαβαν Ραχηλ τῇ θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ Βαλλαν τὴν παιδίσκην αὐτοῦ αὐτῇ παιδίσκην

text_en: And having at length obtained the marriage he wished for, he preferred the love of the latter before the former, and served with him other seven years.
text_la: Tandemque potitus optatis nuptiis, amorem sequentis priori prætulit, serviens apud eum septem annis aliis.
text_pt: E possuiu também a Raquel, e amou também a Raquel mais do que a Lia e serviu com ele ainda outros sete anos.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς Ραχηλ ἠγάπησεν δὲ Ραχηλ μᾶλλον ἢ Λειαν καὶ ἐδούλευσεν αὐτῷ ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἕτερα

text_en: And the Lord seeing that he despised Lia, opened her womb, but her sister remained barren.
text_la: Videns autem Dominus quod despiceret Liam, aperuit vulvam ejus, sorore sterili permanente.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, o Senhor que Lia era desprezada, abriu a sua madre; porém Raquel era estéril.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ κύριος ὅτι μισεῖται Λεια ἤνοιξεν τὴν μήτραν αὐτῆς Ραχηλ δὲ ἦν στεῖρα

text_en: And she conceived and bore a son, and called his name Ruben , saying: The Lord saw my affliction: now my husband will love me.
text_la: Quæ conceptum genuit filium, vocavitque nomen ejus Ruben, dicens : Vidit Dominus humilitatem meam : nunc amabit me vir meus.
text_pt: E concebeu Lia, e deu à luz um filho, e chamou-o Rúben; pois disse: Porque o Senhor atendeu à minha aflição, por isso agora me amará o meu marido.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβεν Λεια καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱὸν τῷ Ιακωβ ἐκάλεσεν δὲ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ρουβην λέγουσα διότι εἶδέν μου κύριος τὴν ταπείνωσιν νῦν με ἀγαπήσει ὁ ἀνήρ μου

text_en: And again she conceived and bore a son, and said: Because the Lord heard that I was despised , he has given this also to me: and she called his name Simeon .
text_la: Rursumque concepit et peperit filium, et ait : Quoniam audivit me Dominus haberi contemptui, dedit etiam istum mihi; vocavitque nomen ejus Simeon.
text_pt: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, dizendo: Porquanto o Senhor ouviu que eu era desprezada, e deu-me também este. E chamou-o Simeão.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβεν πάλιν Λεια καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱὸν δεύτερον τῷ Ιακωβ καὶ εἶπεν ὅτι ἤκουσεν κύριος ὅτι μισοῦμαι καὶ προσέδωκέν μοι καὶ τοῦτον ἐκάλεσεν δὲ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Συμεων

text_en: And she conceived the third time, and bore another son, and said: Now also my husband will be joined to me, because I have borne him three sons: and therefore she called his name Levi .
text_la: Concepitque tertio, et genuit alium filium : dixitque : Nunc quoque copulabitur mihi maritus meus : eo quod pepererim ei tres filios : et idcirco appellavit nomen ejus Levi.
text_pt: E concebeu outra vez, e deu à luz um filho, dizendo: Agora esta vez se unirá meu marido a mim, porque três filhos lhe tenho dado. Por isso chamou-o Levi.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβεν ἔτι καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱὸν καὶ εἶπεν ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ πρὸς ἐμοῦ ἔσται ὁ ἀνήρ μου ἔτεκον γὰρ αὐτῷ τρεῖς υἱούς διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Λευι

text_en: The fourth time she conceived and bore a son, and said: Now will I praise the Lord : and for this she called him Juda . And she left bearing.
text_la: Quarto concepit, et peperit filium, et ait : Modo confitebor Domino, et ob hoc vocavit eum Judam : cessavitque parere.
text_pt: E concebeu outra vez e deu à luz um filho, dizendo: Esta vez louvarei ao Senhor. Por isso chamou-o Judá; e cessou de dar à luz.
text_el: καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτι ἔτεκεν υἱὸν καὶ εἶπεν νῦν ἔτι τοῦτο ἐξομολογήσομαι κυρίῳ διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ιουδα καὶ ἔστη τοῦ τίκτειν

text_en: And Rachel seeing herself without children, envied her sister, and said to her husband: Give me children, otherwise I shall die.
text_la: Cernens autem Rachel quod infecunda esset, invidit sorori suæ, et ait marito suo : Da mihi liberos, alioquin moriar.
text_pt: Vendo Raquel que não dava filhos a Jacó, teve inveja de sua irmã, e disse a Jacó: Dá-me filhos, se não morro.
text_el: ἰδοῦσα δὲ Ραχηλ ὅτι οὐ τέτοκεν τῷ Ιακωβ καὶ ἐζήλωσεν Ραχηλ τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῆς καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ιακωβ δός μοι τέκνα εἰ δὲ μή τελευτήσω ἐγώ

text_en: And Jacob being angry with her, answered: Am I as God , who has deprived you of the fruit of your womb?
text_la: Cui iratus respondit Jacob : Num pro Deo ego sum, qui privavit te fructu ventris tui?
text_pt: Então se acendeu a ira de Jacó contra Raquel, e disse: Estou eu no lugar de Deus, que te impediu o fruto de teu ventre?
text_el: ἐθυμώθη δὲ Ιακωβ τῇ Ραχηλ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ μὴ ἀντὶ θεοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι ὃς ἐστέρησέν σε καρπὸν κοιλίας

text_en: But she said: I have here my servant Bala: go in unto her, that she may bear upon my knees, and I may have children by her.
text_la: At illa : Habeo, inquit, famulam Balam : ingredere ad illam, ut pariat super genua mea, et habeam ex illa filios.
text_pt: E ela disse: Eis aqui minha serva Bila; coabita com ela, para que dê à luz sobre meus joelhos, e eu assim receba filhos por ela.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ραχηλ τῷ Ιακωβ ἰδοὺ ἡ παιδίσκη μου Βαλλα εἴσελθε πρὸς αὐτήν καὶ τέξεται ἐπὶ τῶν γονάτων μου καὶ τεκνοποιήσομαι κἀγὼ ἐξ αὐτῆς

text_en: And she gave him Bala in marriage : who,
text_la: Deditque illi Balam in conjugium : quæ,
text_pt: Assim lhe deu a Bila, sua serva, por mulher; e Jacó a possuiu.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ Βαλλαν τὴν παιδίσκην αὐτῆς αὐτῷ γυναῖκα εἰσῆλθεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν Ιακωβ

text_en: when her husband had gone in unto her, conceived and bore a son.
text_la: ingresso ad se viro, concepit, et peperit filium.
text_pt: E concebeu Bila, e deu a Jacó um filho.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβεν Βαλλα ἡ παιδίσκη Ραχηλ καὶ ἔτεκεν τῷ Ιακωβ υἱόν

text_en: And Rachel said: The Lord has judged for me, and has heard my voice, giving me a son; and therefore she called his name Dan .
text_la: Dixitque Rachel : Judicavit mihi Dominus, et exaudivit vocem meam, dans mihi filium, et idcirco appellavit nomen ejus Dan.
text_pt: Então disse Raquel: Julgou-me Deus, e também ouviu a minha voz, e me deu um filho; por isso chamou-lhe Dã.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ραχηλ ἔκρινέν μοι ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἐπήκουσεν τῆς φωνῆς μου καὶ ἔδωκέν μοι υἱόν διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Δαν

text_en: And again Bala conceived, and bore another,
text_la: Rursumque Bala concipiens, peperit alterum,
text_pt: E Bila, serva de Raquel, concebeu outra vez, e deu a Jacó o segundo filho.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβεν ἔτι Βαλλα ἡ παιδίσκη Ραχηλ καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱὸν δεύτερον τῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: for whom Rachel said: God has compared me with my sister, and I have prevailed: and she called him Nephthali .
text_la: pro quo ait Rachel : Comparavit me Deus cum sorore mea, et invalui : vocavitque eum Nephthali.
text_pt: Então disse Raquel: Com grandes lutas tenho lutado com minha irmã; também venci; e chamou-lhe Naftali.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ραχηλ συνελάβετό μοι ὁ θεός καὶ συνανεστράφην τῇ ἀδελφῇ μου καὶ ἠδυνάσθην καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Νεφθαλι

text_en: Lia perceiving that she had left of bearing, gave Zelpha, her handmaid, to her husband.
text_la: Sentiens Lia quod parere desiisset, Zelpham ancillam suam marito tradidit.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, Lia que cessava de ter filhos, tomou também a Zilpa, sua serva, e deu-a a Jacó por mulher.
text_el: εἶδεν δὲ Λεια ὅτι ἔστη τοῦ τίκτειν καὶ ἔλαβεν Ζελφαν τὴν παιδίσκην αὐτῆς καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν τῷ Ιακωβ γυναῖκα

text_en: And when she had conceived, and brought forth a son,
text_la: Qua post conceptum edente filium,
text_pt: E deu Zilpa, serva de Lia, um filho a Jacó.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν Ιακωβ καὶ συνέλαβεν Ζελφα ἡ παιδίσκη Λειας καὶ ἔτεκεν τῷ Ιακωβ υἱόν

text_en: she said: Happily. And therefore called his name Gad .
text_la: dixit : Feliciter, et idcirco vocavit nomen ejus Gad.
text_pt: Então disse Lia: Afortunada! e chamou-lhe Gade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Λεια ἐν τύχῃ καὶ ἐπωνόμασεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Γαδ

text_en: Zelpha also bore another.
text_la: Peperit quoque Zelpha alterum.
text_pt: Depois deu Zilpa, serva de Lia, um segundo filho a Jacó.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβεν Ζελφα ἡ παιδίσκη Λειας καὶ ἔτεκεν ἔτι τῷ Ιακωβ υἱὸν δεύτερον

text_en: And Lia said: This is for my happiness : for women will call me blessed . Therefore she called him Aser .
text_la: Dixitque Lia : Hoc pro beatitudine mea : beatam quippe me dicent mulieres : propterea appellavit eum Aser.
text_pt: Então disse Lia: Para minha ventura; porque as filhas me terão por bem-aventurada; e chamou-lhe Aser.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Λεια μακαρία ἐγώ ὅτι μακαρίζουσίν με αἱ γυναῖκες καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ασηρ

text_en: And Ruben going out in the time of the wheat harvest into the field, found mandrakes: which he brought to his mother Lia. And Rachel said: Give me part of your son's mandrakes.
text_la: Egressus autem Ruben tempore messis triticeæ in agrum, reperit mandragoras, quas matri Liæ detulit. Dixitque Rachel : Da mihi partem de mandragoris filii tui.
text_pt: E foi Rúben nos dias da ceifa do trigo, e achou mandrágoras no campo. E trouxe-as a Lia sua mãe. Então disse Raquel a Lia: Ora dá-me das mandrágoras de teu filho.
text_el: ἐπορεύθη δὲ Ρουβην ἐν ἡμέραις θερισμοῦ πυρῶν καὶ εὗρεν μῆλα μανδραγόρου ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ καὶ ἤνεγκεν αὐτὰ πρὸς Λειαν τὴν μητέρα αὐτοῦ εἶπεν δὲ Ραχηλ τῇ Λεια δός μοι τῶν μανδραγορῶν τοῦ υἱοῦ σου

text_en: She answered: Do you think it a small matter, that you have taken my husband from me, unless you take also my son's mandrakes? Rachel said: He shall sleep with you this night, for your son's mandrakes.
text_la: Illa respondit : Parumne tibi videtur quod præripueris maritum mihi, nisi etiam mandragoras filii mei tuleris? Ait Rachel : Dormiat tecum hac nocte pro mandragoris filii tui.
text_pt: E ela lhe disse: É já pouco que hajas tomado o meu marido, tomarás também as mandrágoras do meu filho? Então disse Raquel: Por isso ele se deitará contigo esta noite pelas mandrágoras de teu filho.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Λεια οὐχ ἱκανόν σοι ὅτι ἔλαβες τὸν ἄνδρα μου μὴ καὶ τοὺς μανδραγόρας τοῦ υἱοῦ μου λήμψῃ εἶπεν δὲ Ραχηλ οὐχ οὕτως κοιμηθήτω μετὰ σοῦ τὴν νύκτα ταύτην ἀντὶ τῶν μανδραγορῶν τοῦ υἱοῦ σου

text_en: And when Jacob returned at even from the field, Lia went out to meet him, and said: You shall come in unto me, because I have hired you for my son's mandrakes. And he slept with her that night.
text_la: Redeuntique ad vesperam Jacob de agro, egressa est in occursum ejus Lia, et Ad me, inquit, intrabis : quia mercede conduxi te pro mandragoris filii mei. Dormivitque cum ea nocte illa.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, Jacó à tarde do campo, saiu-lhe Lia ao encontro, e disse: A mim possuirás, esta noite, porque certamente te aluguei com as mandrágoras do meu filho. E deitou-se com ela aquela noite.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Ιακωβ ἐξ ἀγροῦ ἑσπέρας καὶ ἐξῆλθεν Λεια εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ καὶ εἶπεν πρός με εἰσελεύσῃ σήμερον μεμίσθωμαι γάρ σε ἀντὶ τῶν μανδραγορῶν τοῦ υἱοῦ μου καὶ ἐκοιμήθη μετ' αὐτῆς τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην

text_en: And God heard her prayers ; and she conceived: and bore a fifth son:
text_la: Et exaudivit Deus preces ejus, concepitque et peperit filium quintum,
text_pt: E ouviu Deus a Lia, e concebeu, e deu à luz um quinto filho.
text_el: καὶ ἐπήκουσεν ὁ θεὸς Λειας καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν τῷ Ιακωβ υἱὸν πέμπτον

text_en: And said: God has given me a reward, because I gave my handmaid to my husband. And she called his name Issachar .
text_la: et ait : Dedit Deus mercedem mihi, quia dedi ancillam meam viro meo : appellavitque nomen ejus Issachar.
text_pt: Então disse Lia: Deus me tem dado o meu galardão, pois tenho dado minha serva ao meu marido. E chamou-lhe Issacar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Λεια ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν μισθόν μου ἀνθ' οὗ ἔδωκα τὴν παιδίσκην μου τῷ ἀνδρί μου καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ισσαχαρ ὅ ἐστιν Μισθός

text_en: And Lia conceived again, and bore the sixth son,
text_la: Rursum Lia concipiens, peperit sextum filium,
text_pt: E Lia concebeu outra vez, e deu a Jacó um sexto filho.
text_el: καὶ συνέλαβεν ἔτι Λεια καὶ ἔτεκεν υἱὸν ἕκτον τῷ Ιακωβ

text_en: and said: God has endowed me with a good dowry; this turn also my husband will be with me, because I have borne him six sons: and therefore she called his name Zabulon .
text_la: et ait : Dotavit me Deus dote bona : etiam hac vice mecum erit maritus meus, eo quod genuerim ei sex filios : et idcirco appellavit nomen ejus Zabulon.
text_pt: E disse Lia: Deus me deu uma boa dádiva; desta vez morará o meu marido comigo, porque lhe tenho dado seis filhos. E chamou-lhe Zebulom.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Λεια δεδώρηταί μοι ὁ θεὸς δῶρον καλόν ἐν τῷ νῦν καιρῷ αἱρετιεῖ με ὁ ἀνήρ μου ἔτεκον γὰρ αὐτῷ υἱοὺς ἕξ καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ζαβουλων

text_en: After whom she bore a daughter, named Dina.
text_la: Post quem peperit filiam, nomine Dinam.
text_pt: E depois teve uma filha, e chamou-lhe Diná.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο ἔτεκεν θυγατέρα καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Δινα

text_en: The Lord also remembering Rachel , heard her, and opened her womb.
text_la: Recordatus quoque Dominus Rachelis, exaudivit eam, et aperuit vulvam ejus.
text_pt: E lembrou-se Deus de Raquel; e Deus a ouviu, e abriu a sua madre.
text_el: ἐμνήσθη δὲ ὁ θεὸς τῆς Ραχηλ καὶ ἐπήκουσεν αὐτῆς ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἀνέῳξεν αὐτῆς τὴν μήτραν

text_en: And she conceived, and bore a son, saying: God has taken away my reproach.
text_la: Quæ concepit, et peperit filium, dicens : Abstulit Deus opprobrium meum.
text_pt: E ela concebeu, e deu à luz um filho, e disse: Tirou-me Deus a minha vergonha.
text_el: καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν τῷ Ιακωβ υἱόν εἶπεν δὲ Ραχηλ ἀφεῖλεν ὁ θεός μου τὸ ὄνειδος

text_en: And she called his name Joseph : saying: The Lord give me also another son.
text_la: Et vocavit nomen ejus Joseph, dicens : Addat mihi Dominus filium alterum.
text_pt: E chamou-lhe José, dizendo: O Senhor me acrescente outro filho.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ιωσηφ λέγουσα προσθέτω ὁ θεός μοι υἱὸν ἕτερον

text_en: And when Joseph was born, Jacob said to his father in law: Send me away, that I may return into my country, and to my land.
text_la: Nato autem Joseph, dixit Jacob socero suo : Dimitte me ut revertar in patriam, et ad terram meam.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, como Raquel deu à luz a José, disse Jacó a Labão: Deixa-me ir, que me vá ao meu lugar, e à minha terra.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ὡς ἔτεκεν Ραχηλ τὸν Ιωσηφ εἶπεν Ιακωβ τῷ Λαβαν ἀπόστειλόν με ἵνα ἀπέλθω εἰς τὸν τόπον μου καὶ εἰς τὴν γῆν μου

text_en: Give me my wives, and my children, for whom I have served you, that I may depart: you know the service that I have rendered you.
text_la: Da mihi uxores, et liberos meos, pro quibus servivi tibi, ut abeam : tu nosti servitutem qua servivi tibi.
text_pt: Dá-me as minhas mulheres, e os meus filhos, pelas quais te tenho servido, e ir-me-ei; pois tu sabes o serviço que te tenho feito.
text_el: ἀπόδος τὰς γυναῖκάς μου καὶ τὰ παιδία περὶ ὧν δεδούλευκά σοι ἵνα ἀπέλθω σὺ γὰρ γινώσκεις τὴν δουλείαν ἣν δεδούλευκά σοι

text_en: Laban said to him: Let me find favour in your sight: I have learned, by experience, that God has blessed me for your sake.
text_la: Ait illi Laban : Inveniam gratiam in conspectu tuo, experimento didici, quia benedixerit mihi Deus propter te:
text_pt: Então lhe disse Labão: Se agora tenho achado graça em teus olhos, fica comigo. Tenho experimentado que o Senhor me abençoou por amor de ti.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Λαβαν εἰ εὗρον χάριν ἐναντίον σου οἰωνισάμην ἄν εὐλόγησεν γάρ με ὁ θεὸς τῇ σῇ εἰσόδῳ

text_en: Appoint your wages which I shall give you.
text_la: constitue mercedem tuam quam dem tibi.
text_pt: E disse mais: Determina-me o teu salário, que to darei.
text_el: διάστειλον τὸν μισθόν σου πρός με καὶ δώσω

text_en: But he answered: You know how I have served you, and how great your possession has been in my hands.
text_la: At ille respondit : Tu nosti quomodo servierim tibi, et quanta in manibus meis fuerit possessio tua.
text_pt: Então lhe disse: Tu sabes como te tenho servido, e como passou o teu gado comigo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Ιακωβ σὺ γινώσκεις ἃ δεδούλευκά σοι καὶ ὅσα ἦν κτήνη σου μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: You had but little before I came to you, and now you have become rich : and the Lord has blessed you at my coming. It is reasonable, therefore, that I should now provide also for my own house.
text_la: Modicum habuisti antequam venirem ad te, et nunc dives effectus es : benedixitque tibi Dominus ad introitum meum. Justum est igitur ut aliquando provideam etiam domui meæ.
text_pt: Porque o pouco que tinhas antes de mim tem aumentado em grande número; e o SENHOR te tem abençoado por meu trabalho. Agora, pois, quando hei de trabalhar também por minha casa?
text_el: μικρὰ γὰρ ἦν ὅσα σοι ἦν ἐναντίον ἐμοῦ καὶ ηὐξήθη εἰς πλῆθος καὶ ηὐλόγησέν σε κύριος ἐπὶ τῷ ποδί μου νῦν οὖν πότε ποιήσω κἀγὼ ἐμαυτῷ οἶκον

text_en: And Laban said: What shall I give you? But he said: I require nothing; but if you will do what I demand, I will feed and keep your sheep again.
text_la: Dixitque Laban : Quid tibi dabo? At ille ait : Nihil volo : sed si feceris quod postulo, iterum pascam, et custodiam pecora tua.
text_pt: E disse ele: Que te darei? Então disse Jacó: Nada me darás. Se me fizeres isto, tornarei a apascentar e a guardar o teu rebanho;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Λαβαν τί σοι δώσω εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Ιακωβ οὐ δώσεις μοι οὐθέν ἐὰν ποιήσῃς μοι τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο πάλιν ποιμανῶ τὰ πρόβατά σου καὶ φυλάξω

text_en: Go round through all your flocks, and separate all the sheep of divers colours, and speckled; and all that is brown and spotted, and of divers colours, as well among the sheep as among the goats, shall be my wages.
text_la: Gyra omnes greges tuos, et separa cunctas oves varias, et sparso vellere; quodcumque furvum, et maculosum, variumque fuerit, tam in ovibus quam in capris, erit merces mea.
text_pt: Passarei hoje por todo o teu rebanho, separando dele todos os salpicados e malhados, e todos os morenos entre os cordeiros, e os malhados e salpicados entre as cabras; e isto será o meu salário.
text_el: παρελθάτω πάντα τὰ πρόβατά σου σήμερον καὶ διαχώρισον ἐκεῖθεν πᾶν πρόβατον φαιὸν ἐν τοῖς ἀρνάσιν καὶ πᾶν διάλευκον καὶ ῥαντὸν ἐν ταῖς αἰξίν ἔσται μοι μισθός

text_en: And my justice shall answer for me tomorrow before you, when the time of the bargain shall come; and all that is not of divers colours, and spotted, and brown, as well among the sheep as among the goats, shall accurse me of theft.
text_la: Respondebitque mihi cras justitia mea, quando placiti tempus advenerit coram te : et omnia quæ non fuerint varia, et maculosa, et furva, tam in ovibus quam in capris, furti me arguent.
text_pt: Assim testificará por mim a minha justiça no dia de amanhã, quando vieres e o meu salário estiver diante de tua face; tudo o que não for salpicado e malhado entre as cabras e moreno entre os cordeiros, ser-me-á por furto.
text_el: καὶ ἐπακούσεταί μοι ἡ δικαιοσύνη μου ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ αὔριον ὅτι ἐστὶν ὁ μισθός μου ἐνώπιόν σου πᾶν ὃ ἐὰν μὴ ᾖ ῥαντὸν καὶ διάλευκον ἐν ταῖς αἰξὶν καὶ φαιὸν ἐν τοῖς ἀρνάσιν κεκλεμμένον ἔσται παρ' ἐμοί

text_en: And Laban said: I like well what you demand.
text_la: Dixitque Laban : Gratum habeo quod petis.
text_pt: Então disse Labão: Quem dera seja conforme a tua palavra.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Λαβαν ἔστω κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου

text_en: And he separated the same day the she goats, and the sheep, and the he goats, and the rams of divers colours, and spotted; and all the flock of one colour, that is, of white and black fleece, he delivered into the hands of his sons.
text_la: Et separavit in die illa capras, et oves, et hircos, et arietes varios, atque maculosos : cunctum autem gregem unicolorem, id est albi et nigri velleris, tradidit in manu filiorum suorum.
text_pt: E separou naquele mesmo dia os bodes listrados e malhados e todas as cabras salpicadas e malhadas, todos em que havia brancura, e todos os morenos entre os cordeiros; e deu-os nas mãos dos seus filhos.
text_el: καὶ διέστειλεν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ τοὺς τράγους τοὺς ῥαντοὺς καὶ τοὺς διαλεύκους καὶ πάσας τὰς αἶγας τὰς ῥαντὰς καὶ τὰς διαλεύκους καὶ πᾶν ὃ ἦν λευκὸν ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ πᾶν ὃ ἦν φαιὸν ἐν τοῖς ἀρνάσιν καὶ ἔδωκεν διὰ χειρὸς τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he set the space of three days journey betwixt himself and his son in law, who fed the rest of his flock.
text_la: Et posuit spatium itineris trium dierum inter se et generum, qui pascebat reliquos greges ejus.
text_pt: E pôs três dias de caminho entre si e Jacó; e Jacó apascentava o restante dos rebanhos de Labão.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστησεν ὁδὸν τριῶν ἡμερῶν ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον Ιακωβ Ιακωβ δὲ ἐποίμαινεν τὰ πρόβατα Λαβαν τὰ ὑπολειφθέντα

text_en: And Jacob took green rods of poplar, and of almond, and of plane trees, and pulled them in part: so when the bark was taken off, in the parts that were pulled, there appeared whiteness: but the parts that were whole, remained green: and by this means the colour was divers.
text_la: Tollens ergo Jacob virgas populeas virides, et amygdalinas, et ex platanis, ex parte decorticavit eas : detractisque corticibus, in his, quæ spoliata fuerant, candor apparuit : illa vero quæ integra fuerant, viridia permanserunt : atque in hunc modum color effectus est varius.
text_pt: Então tomou Jacó varas verdes de álamo e de aveleira e de castanheiro, e descascou nelas riscas brancas, descobrindo a brancura que nas varas havia,
text_el: ἔλαβεν δὲ ἑαυτῷ Ιακωβ ῥάβδον στυρακίνην χλωρὰν καὶ καρυίνην καὶ πλατάνου καὶ ἐλέπισεν αὐτὰς Ιακωβ λεπίσματα λευκὰ περισύρων τὸ χλωρόν ἐφαίνετο δὲ ἐπὶ ταῖς ῥάβδοις τὸ λευκόν ὃ ἐλέπισεν ποικίλον

text_en: And he put them in the troughs, where the water was poured out; that when the flocks should come to drink, they might have the rods before their eyes, and in the sight of them might conceive.
text_la: Posuitque eas in canalibus, ubi effundebatur aqua : ut cum venissent greges ad bibendum, ante oculos haberent virgas, et in aspectu earum conciperent.
text_pt: E pôs estas varas, que tinha descascado, em frente aos rebanhos, nos canos e nos bebedouros de água, aonde os rebanhos vinham beber, para que concebessem quando vinham beber.
text_el: καὶ παρέθηκεν τὰς ῥάβδους ἃς ἐλέπισεν ἐν ταῖς ληνοῖς τῶν ποτιστηρίων τοῦ ὕδατος ἵνα ὡς ἂν ἔλθωσιν τὰ πρόβατα πιεῖν ἐνώπιον τῶν ῥάβδων ἐλθόντων αὐτῶν εἰς τὸ πιεῖν

text_en: And it came to pass, that in the very heat of coition, the sheep beheld the rods, and brought forth spotted, and of divers colours, and speckled.
text_la: Factumque est ut in ipso calore coitus, oves intuerentur virgas, et parerent maculosa, et varia, et diverso colore respersa.
text_pt: E concebiam os rebanhos diante das varas, e as ovelhas davam crias listradas, salpicadas e malhadas.
text_el: ἐγκισσήσωσιν τὰ πρόβατα εἰς τὰς ῥάβδους καὶ ἔτικτον τὰ πρόβατα διάλευκα καὶ ποικίλα καὶ σποδοειδῆ ῥαντά

text_en: And Jacob separated the flock, and put the rods in the troughs before the eyes of the rams; and all the white and the black were Laban's , and the rest were Jacob's , when the flocks were separated one from the other.
text_la: Divisitque gregem Jacob, et posuit virgas in canalibus ante oculos arietum : erant autem alba et nigra quæque, Laban; cetera vero, Jacob, separatis inter se gregibus.
text_pt: Então separou Jacó os cordeiros, e pôs as faces do rebanho para os listrados, e todo o moreno entre o rebanho de Labão; e pôs o seu rebanho à parte, e não o pôs com o rebanho de Labão.
text_el: τοὺς δὲ ἀμνοὺς διέστειλεν Ιακωβ καὶ ἔστησεν ἐναντίον τῶν προβάτων κριὸν διάλευκον καὶ πᾶν ποικίλον ἐν τοῖς ἀμνοῖς καὶ διεχώρισεν ἑαυτῷ ποίμνια καθ' ἑαυτὸν καὶ οὐκ ἔμιξεν αὐτὰ εἰς τὰ πρόβατα Λαβαν

text_en: So when the ewes went first to ram, Jacob put the rods in the troughs of water before the eyes of the rams, and of the ewes, that they might conceive while they were looking upon them.
text_la: Igitur quando primo tempore ascendebantur oves, ponebat Jacob virgas in canalibus aquarum ante oculos arietum et ovium, ut in earum contemplatione conciperent:
text_pt: E sucedia que cada vez que concebiam as ovelhas fortes, punha Jacó as varas nos canos, diante dos olhos do rebanho, para que concebessem diante das varas.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ᾧ ἐνεκίσσησεν τὰ πρόβατα ἐν γαστρὶ λαμβάνοντα ἔθηκεν Ιακωβ τὰς ῥάβδους ἐναντίον τῶν προβάτων ἐν ταῖς ληνοῖς τοῦ ἐγκισσῆσαι αὐτὰ κατὰ τὰς ῥάβδους

text_en: But when the later coming was, and the last conceiving, he did not put them. And those that were lateward, became Laban's ; and they of the first time, Jacob's .
text_la: quando vero serotina admissura erat, et conceptus extremus, non ponebat eas. Factaque sunt ea quæ erant serotina, Laban : et quæ primi temporis, Jacob.
text_pt: Mas, quando era fraco o rebanho, não as punha. Assim as fracas eram de Labão, e as fortes de Jacó.
text_el: ἡνίκα δ' ἂν ἔτεκον τὰ πρόβατα οὐκ ἐτίθει ἐγένετο δὲ τὰ ἄσημα τοῦ Λαβαν τὰ δὲ ἐπίσημα τοῦ Ιακωβ

text_en: And the man was enriched exceedingly, and he had many flocks, maidservants and menservants, camels and asses.
text_la: Ditatusque est homo ultra modum, et habuit greges multos, ancillas et servos, camelos et asinos.
text_pt: E cresceu o homem em grande maneira, e teve muitos rebanhos, e servas, e servos, e camelos e jumentos.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλούτησεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος σφόδρα σφόδρα καὶ ἐγένετο αὐτῷ κτήνη πολλὰ καὶ βόες καὶ παῖδες καὶ παιδίσκαι καὶ κάμηλοι καὶ ὄνοι

text_en: But after that he had heard the words of the sons of Laban , saying: Jacob has taken away all that was our father's, and being enriched by his substance has become great.
text_la: Postquam autem audivit verba filiorum Laban dicentium : Tulit Jacob omnia quæ fuerunt patris nostri, et de illius facultate ditatus, factus est inclytus:
text_pt: Então ouvia as palavras dos filhos de Labão, que diziam: Jacó tem tomado tudo o que era de nosso pai, e do que era de nosso pai fez ele toda esta glória.
text_el: ἤκουσεν δὲ Ιακωβ τὰ ῥήματα τῶν υἱῶν Λαβαν λεγόντων εἴληφεν Ιακωβ πάντα τὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἐκ τῶν τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν πεποίηκεν πᾶσαν τὴν δόξαν ταύτην

text_en: And perceiving also, that Laban's countenance was not towards him as yesterday and the other day.
text_la: animadvertit quoque faciem Laban, quod non esset erga se sicut heri et nudiustertius,
text_pt: Viu também Jacó o rosto de Labão, e eis que não era para com ele como anteriormente.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ιακωβ τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ Λαβαν καὶ ἰδοὺ οὐκ ἦν πρὸς αὐτὸν ὡς ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἡμέραν

text_en: Especially the Lord saying to him: Return into the land of your fathers and to your kindred , and I will be with you.
text_la: maxime dicente sibi Domino : Revertere in terram patrum tuorum, et ad generationem tuam, eroque tecum.
text_pt: E disse o Senhor a Jacó: Torna-te à terra dos teus pais, e à tua parentela, e eu serei contigo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ κύριος πρὸς Ιακωβ ἀποστρέφου εἰς τὴν γῆν τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ εἰς τὴν γενεάν σου καὶ ἔσομαι μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: He sent, and called Rachel and Lia into the field, where he fed the flocks,
text_la: Misit, et vocavit Rachel et Liam in agrum, ubi pascebat greges,
text_pt: Então mandou Jacó chamar a Raquel e a Lia ao campo, para junto do seu rebanho,
text_el: ἀποστείλας δὲ Ιακωβ ἐκάλεσεν Ραχηλ καὶ Λειαν εἰς τὸ πεδίον οὗ τὰ ποίμνια

text_en: and said to them: I see your father's countenance is not towards me as yesterday and the other day: but the God of my father has been with me.
text_la: dixitque eis : Video faciem patris vestri quod non sit erga me sicut heri et nudiustertius : Deus autem patris mei fuit mecum.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Vejo que o rosto de vosso pai não é para comigo como anteriormente; porém o Deus de meu pai tem estado comigo;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐταῖς ὁρῶ ἐγὼ τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν ὅτι οὐκ ἔστιν πρὸς ἐμοῦ ὡς ἐχθὲς καὶ τρίτην ἡμέραν ὁ δὲ θεὸς τοῦ πατρός μου ἦν μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: And you know that I have served your father to the uttermost of my power.
text_la: Et ipsæ nostis quod totis viribus meis servierim patri vestro.
text_pt: E vós mesmas sabeis que com todo o meu esforço tenho servido a vosso pai;
text_el: καὶ αὐταὶ δὲ οἴδατε ὅτι ἐν πάσῃ τῇ ἰσχύι μου δεδούλευκα τῷ πατρὶ ὑμῶν

text_en: Yea your father has also overreached me, and has changed my wages ten times: and yet God has not allowed him to hurt me.
text_la: Sed et pater vester circumvenit me et mutavit mercedem meam decem vicibus: et tamen non dimisit eum Deus ut noceret mihi.
text_pt: Mas vosso pai me enganou e mudou o salário dez vezes; porém Deus não lhe permitiu que me fizesse mal.
text_el: ὁ δὲ πατὴρ ὑμῶν παρεκρούσατό με καὶ ἤλλαξεν τὸν μισθόν μου τῶν δέκα ἀμνῶν καὶ οὐκ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς κακοποιῆσαί με

text_en: If at any time, he said: The speckled shall be your wages: all the sheep brought forth speckled: but when he said on the contrary: You shall take all the white one for your wages: all the flocks brought forth white ones.
text_la: Si quando dixit : Variæ erunt mercedes tuæ : pariebant omnes oves varios fœtus; quando vero e contrario, ait : Alba quæque accipies pro mercede : omnes greges alba pepererunt.
text_pt: Quando ele dizia assim: Os salpicados serão o teu salário; então todos os rebanhos davam salpicados. E quando ele dizia assim: Os listrados serão o teu salário, então todos os rebanhos davam listrados.
text_el: ἐὰν οὕτως εἴπῃ τὰ ποικίλα ἔσται σου μισθός καὶ τέξεται πάντα τὰ πρόβατα ποικίλα ἐὰν δὲ εἴπῃ τὰ λευκὰ ἔσται σου μισθός καὶ τέξεται πάντα τὰ πρόβατα λευκά

text_en: And God has taken your father's substance , and given it to me.
text_la: Tulitque Deus substantiam patris vestri, et dedit mihi.
text_pt: Assim Deus tirou o gado de vosso pai, e deu-o a mim.
text_el: καὶ ἀφείλατο ὁ θεὸς πάντα τὰ κτήνη τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ἔδωκέν μοι αὐτά

text_en: For after the time came of the ewes conceiving, I lifted up my eyes, and saw in my sleep , that the males which leaped upon the females were of divers colours, and spotted, and speckled.
text_la: Postquam enim conceptus ovium tempus advenerat, levavi oculos meos, et vidi in somnis ascendentes mares super feminas, varios et maculosos, et diversorum colorum.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ao tempo em que o rebanho concebia, eu levantei os meus olhos e vi em sonhos, e eis que os bodes, que cobriam as ovelhas, eram listrados, salpicados e malhados.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἐνεκίσσων τὰ πρόβατα καὶ εἶδον τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτὰ ἐν τῷ ὕπνῳ καὶ ἰδοὺ οἱ τράγοι καὶ οἱ κριοὶ ἀναβαίνοντες ἦσαν ἐπὶ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ τὰς αἶγας διάλευκοι καὶ ποικίλοι καὶ σποδοειδεῖς ῥαντοί

text_en: And the angel of God said to me in my sleep : Jacob . And I answered: Here I am.
text_la: Dixitque angelus Dei ad me in somnis : Jacob? Et ego respondi : Adsum.
text_pt: E disse-me o anjo de Deus em sonhos: Jacó! E eu disse: Eis-me aqui.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ ἄγγελος τοῦ θεοῦ καθ' ὕπνον Ιακωβ ἐγὼ δὲ εἶπα τί ἐστιν

text_en: And he said: Lift up your eyes, and see that all the males leaping upon the females, are of divers colours, spotted and speckled. For I have seen all that Laban has done to you.
text_la: Qui ait : Leva oculos tuos, et vide universos masculos ascendentes super feminas, varios, maculosos, atque respersos. Vidi enim omnia quæ fecit tibi Laban.
text_pt: E disse ele: Levanta agora os teus olhos e vê todos os bodes que cobrem o rebanho, que são listrados, salpicados e malhados; porque tenho visto tudo o que Labão te fez.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἀνάβλεψον τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς σου καὶ ἰδὲ τοὺς τράγους καὶ τοὺς κριοὺς ἀναβαίνοντας ἐπὶ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ τὰς αἶγας διαλεύκους καὶ ποικίλους καὶ σποδοειδεῖς ῥαντούς ἑώρακα γὰρ ὅσα σοι Λαβαν ποιεῖ

text_en: I am the God of Bethel , where you anointed the stone, and make a vow to me. Now therefore arise, and go out of this land, and return into your native country.
text_la: Ego sum Deus Bethel, ubi unxisti lapidem, et votum vovisti mihi. Nunc ergo surge, et egredere de terra hac, revertens in terram nativitatis tuæ.
text_pt: Eu sou o Deus de Betel, onde tens ungido uma coluna, onde me fizeste um voto; levanta-te agora, sai-te desta terra e torna-te à terra da tua parentela.
text_el: ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεὸς ὁ ὀφθείς σοι ἐν τόπῳ θεοῦ οὗ ἤλειψάς μοι ἐκεῖ στήλην καὶ ηὔξω μοι ἐκεῖ εὐχήν νῦν οὖν ἀνάστηθι καὶ ἔξελθε ἐκ τῆς γῆς ταύτης καὶ ἄπελθε εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς γενέσεώς σου καὶ ἔσομαι μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: And Rachel and Lia answered: Have we anything left among the goods and inheritance of our father's house?
text_la: Responderuntque Rachel et Lia : Numquid habemus residui quidquam in facultatibus et hæreditate domus patris nostri?
text_pt: Então responderam Raquel e Lia e disseram-lhe: Há ainda para nós parte ou herança na casa de nosso pai?
text_el: καὶ ἀποκριθεῖσα Ραχηλ καὶ Λεια εἶπαν αὐτῷ μὴ ἔστιν ἡμῖν ἔτι μερὶς ἢ κληρονομία ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν

text_en: Hath he not counted us as strangers, and sold us, and eaten up the price of us?
text_la: nonne quasi alienas reputavit nos, et vendidit, comeditque pretium nostrum?
text_pt: Não nos considera ele como estranhas? Pois vendeu-nos, e comeu de todo o nosso dinheiro.
text_el: οὐχ ὡς αἱ ἀλλότριαι λελογίσμεθα αὐτῷ πέπρακεν γὰρ ἡμᾶς καὶ κατέφαγεν καταβρώσει τὸ ἀργύριον ἡμῶν

text_en: But God has taken our father's riches, and delivered them to us, and to our children: wherefore, do all that God has commanded you.
text_la: Sed Deus tulit opes patris nostri, et eas tradidit nobis, ac filiis nostris : unde omnia quæ præcepit tibi Deus, fac.
text_pt: Porque toda a riqueza, que Deus tirou de nosso pai, é nossa e de nossos filhos; agora, pois, faze tudo o que Deus te mandou.
text_el: πάντα τὸν πλοῦτον καὶ τὴν δόξαν ἣν ἀφείλατο ὁ θεὸς τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ἡμῖν ἔσται καὶ τοῖς τέκνοις ἡμῶν νῦν οὖν ὅσα εἴρηκέν σοι ὁ θεός ποίει

text_en: Then Jacob rose up, and having set his children and wives upon camels, went his way.
text_la: Surrexit itaque Jacob, et impositis liberis ac conjugibus suis super camelos, abiit.
text_pt: Então se levantou Jacó, pondo os seus filhos e as suas mulheres sobre os camelos;
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ Ιακωβ ἔλαβεν τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰ παιδία αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὰς καμήλους

text_en: And he took all his substance , and flocks, and whatsoever he had gotten in Mesopotamia, and went forward to Isaac , his father, to the land of Chanaan .
text_la: Tulitque omnem substantiam suam, et greges, et quidquid in Mesopotamia acquisierat, pergens ad Isaac patrem suum in terram Chanaan.
text_pt: E levou todo o seu gado, e todos os seus bens, que havia adquirido, o gado que possuía, que alcançara em Padã-Arã, para ir a Isaque, seu pai, à terra de Canaã.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήγαγεν πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀποσκευὴν αὐτοῦ ἣν περιεποιήσατο ἐν τῇ Μεσοποταμίᾳ καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ ἀπελθεῖν πρὸς Ισαακ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ εἰς γῆν Χανααν

text_en: At that time Laban had gone to shear his sheep, and Rachel stole away her father's idols .
text_la: Eo tempore ierat Laban ad tondendas oves, et Rachel furata est idola patris sui.
text_pt: E havendo Labão ido a tosquiar as suas ovelhas, furtou Raquel os ídolos que seu pai tinha.
text_el: Λαβαν δὲ ᾤχετο κεῖραι τὰ πρόβατα αὐτοῦ ἔκλεψεν δὲ Ραχηλ τὰ εἴδωλα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: And Jacob would not confess to his father in law that he was flying away.
text_la: Noluitque Jacob confiteri socero suo quod fugeret.
text_pt: E Jacó logrou a Labão, o arameu, porque não lhe fez saber que fugia.
text_el: ἔκρυψεν δὲ Ιακωβ Λαβαν τὸν Σύρον τοῦ μὴ ἀναγγεῖλαι αὐτῷ ὅτι ἀποδιδράσκει

text_en: And when he had gone, together with all that belonged to him, and having passed the river, was going on towards mount Galaad,
text_la: Cumque abiisset tam ipse quam omnia quæ juris sui erant, et amne transmisso pergeret contra montem Galaad,
text_pt: E fugiu ele com tudo o que tinha, e levantou-se e passou o rio; e se dirigiu para a montanha de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέδρα αὐτὸς καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ καὶ διέβη τὸν ποταμὸν καὶ ὥρμησεν εἰς τὸ ὄρος Γαλααδ

text_en: it was told Laban on the third day, that Jacob fled.
text_la: nuntiatum est Laban die tertio quod fugeret Jacob.
text_pt: E no terceiro dia foi anunciado a Labão que Jacó tinha fugido.
text_el: ἀνηγγέλη δὲ Λαβαν τῷ Σύρῳ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρᾳ ὅτι ἀπέδρα Ιακωβ

text_en: And he took his brethren with him, and pursued after him seven days; and overtook him in the mount of Galaad.
text_la: Qui, assumptis fratribus suis, persecutus est eum diebus septem : et comprehendit eum in monte Galaad.
text_pt: Então tomou consigo os seus irmãos, e atrás dele seguiu o seu caminho por sete dias; e alcançou-o na montanha de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ παραλαβὼν πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ μεθ' ἑαυτοῦ ἐδίωξεν ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ὁδὸν ἡμερῶν ἑπτὰ καὶ κατέλαβεν αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ὄρει τῷ Γαλααδ

text_en: And he saw in a dream God , saying to him: Take heed not to speak anything harshly against Jacob .
text_la: Viditque in somnis dicentem sibi Deum: Cave ne quidquam aspere loquaris contra Jacob.
text_pt: Veio, porém, Deus a Labão, o arameu, em sonhos, de noite, e disse-lhe: Guarda-te, que não fales com Jacó nem bem nem mal.
text_el: ἦλθεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Λαβαν τὸν Σύρον καθ' ὕπνον τὴν νύκτα καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ φύλαξαι σεαυτόν μήποτε λαλήσῃς μετὰ Ιακωβ πονηρά

text_en: Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain: and when he, with his brethren, had overtaken him, he pitched his tent in the same mount of Galaad.
text_la: Jamque Jacob extenderat in monte tabernaculum : cumque ille consecutus fuisset eum cum fratribus suis, in eodem monte Galaad fixit tentorium.
text_pt: Alcançou, pois, Labão a Jacó, e armara Jacó a sua tenda naquela montanha; armou também Labão com os seus irmãos a sua, na montanha de Gileade.
text_el: καὶ κατέλαβεν Λαβαν τὸν Ιακωβ Ιακωβ δὲ ἔπηξεν τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Λαβαν δὲ ἔστησεν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Γαλααδ

text_en: And he said to Jacob : Why have you done thus, to carry away, without my knowledge , my daughters as captives taken with the sword?
text_la: Et dixit ad Jacob : Quare ita egisti, ut clam me abigeres filias meas quasi captivas gladio?
text_pt: Então disse Labão a Jacó: Que fizeste, que me lograste e levaste as minhas filhas como cativas pela espada?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Λαβαν τῷ Ιακωβ τί ἐποίησας ἵνα τί κρυφῇ ἀπέδρας καὶ ἐκλοποφόρησάς με καὶ ἀπήγαγες τὰς θυγατέρας μου ὡς αἰχμαλώτιδας μαχαίρᾳ

text_en: Why would you run away privately, and not acquaint me, that I might have brought you on the way with joy , and with songs, and with timbrels, and with harps?
text_la: cur ignorante me fugere voluisti, nec indicare mihi, ut prosequerer te cum gaudio, et canticis, et tympanis, et citharis?
text_pt: Por que fugiste ocultamente, e lograste-me, e não me fizeste saber, para que eu te enviasse com alegria, e com cânticos, e com tamboril e com harpa?
text_el: καὶ εἰ ἀνήγγειλάς μοι ἐξαπέστειλα ἄν σε μετ' εὐφροσύνης καὶ μετὰ μουσικῶν τυμπάνων καὶ κιθάρας

text_en: You have not allowed me to kiss my sons and daughters; you have done foolishly; and now indeed,
text_la: Non es passus ut oscularer filios meos et filias : stulte operatus es : et nunc quidem
text_pt: Também não me permitiste beijar os meus filhos e as minhas filhas. Loucamente agiste, agora, fazendo assim.
text_el: οὐκ ἠξιώθην καταφιλῆσαι τὰ παιδία μου καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας μου νῦν δὲ ἀφρόνως ἔπραξας

text_en: it is in my power to return you evil ; but the God of your father said to me yesterday: Take heed not to speak anything harshly against Jacob .
text_la: valet manus mea reddere tibi malum : sed Deus patris vestri heri dixit mihi : Cave ne loquaris contra Jacob quidquam durius.
text_pt: Poder havia em minha mão para vos fazer mal, mas o Deus de vosso pai me falou ontem à noite, dizendo: Guarda-te, que não fales com Jacó nem bem nem mal.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ἰσχύει ἡ χείρ μου κακοποιῆσαί σε ὁ δὲ θεὸς τοῦ πατρός σου ἐχθὲς εἶπεν πρός με λέγων φύλαξαι σεαυτόν μήποτε λαλήσῃς μετὰ Ιακωβ πονηρά

text_en: Suppose you desired to go to your friends, and had a longing after your father's house: why have you stolen away my gods ?
text_la: Esto, ad tuos ire cupiebas, et desiderio erat tibi domus patris tui : cur furatus es deos meos?
text_pt: E agora se querias ir embora, porquanto tinhas saudades de voltar à casa de teu pai, por que furtaste os meus deuses?
text_el: νῦν οὖν πεπόρευσαι ἐπιθυμίᾳ γὰρ ἐπεθύμησας ἀπελθεῖν εἰς τὸν οἶκον τοῦ πατρός σου ἵνα τί ἔκλεψας τοὺς θεούς μου

text_en: Jacob answered: That I departed unknown to you, it was for fear lest you would take away your daughters by force .
text_la: Respondit Jacob : Quod inscio te profectus sum, timui ne violenter auferres filias tuas.
text_pt: Então respondeu Jacó, e disse a Labão: Porque temia; pois que dizia comigo, se porventura não me arrebatarias as tuas filhas.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ιακωβ εἶπεν τῷ Λαβαν εἶπα γάρ μήποτε ἀφέλῃς τὰς θυγατέρας σου ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐμά

text_en: But, whereas, you charge me with theft : with whomsoever you shall find your gods , let him be slain before our brethren. Search, and if you find any of your things with me, take them away. Now when he said this, he knew not that Rachel had stolen the idols .
text_la: Quod autem furti me arguis : apud quemcumque inveneris deos tuos, necetur coram fratribus nostris : scrutare, quidquid tuorum apud me inveneris, et aufer. Hæc dicens, ignorabat quod Rachel furata esset idola.
text_pt: Com quem achares os teus deuses, esse não viva; reconhece diante de nossos irmãos o que é teu do que está comigo, e toma-o para ti. Pois Jacó não sabia que Raquel os tinha furtado.
text_el: ἐπίγνωθι τί ἐστιν τῶν σῶν παρ' ἐμοί καὶ λαβέ καὶ οὐκ ἐπέγνω παρ' αὐτῷ οὐθέν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ιακωβ παρ' ᾧ ἐὰν εὕρῃς τοὺς θεούς σου οὐ ζήσεται ἐναντίον τῶν ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν οὐκ ᾔδει δὲ Ιακωβ ὅτι Ραχηλ ἡ γυνὴ αὐτοῦ ἔκλεψεν αὐτούς

text_en: So Laban went into the tent of Jacob , and of Lia, and of both the handmaids, and found them not. And when he was entered into Rachel's tent,
text_la: Ingressus itaque Laban tabernaculum Jacob, et Liæ, et utriusque famulæ, non invenit. Cumque intrasset tentorium Rachelis,
text_pt: Então entrou Labão na tenda de Jacó, e na tenda de Lia, e na tenda de ambas as servas, e não os achou; e saindo da tenda de Lia, entrou na tenda de Raquel.
text_el: εἰσελθὼν δὲ Λαβαν ἠρεύνησεν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Λειας καὶ οὐχ εὗρεν καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου Λειας ἠρεύνησεν τὸν οἶκον Ιακωβ καὶ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τῶν δύο παιδισκῶν καὶ οὐχ εὗρεν εἰσῆλθεν δὲ καὶ εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ραχηλ

text_en: she, in haste, hid the idols under the camel's furniture, and sat upon them: and when he had searched all the tent, and found nothing,
text_la: illa festinans abscondit idola subter stramenta cameli, et sedit desuper : scrutantique omne tentorium, et nihil invenienti,
text_pt: Mas tinha tomado Raquel os ídolos e os tinha posto na albarda de um camelo, e assentara-se sobre eles; e apalpou Labão toda a tenda, e não os achou.
text_el: Ραχηλ δὲ ἔλαβεν τὰ εἴδωλα καὶ ἐνέβαλεν αὐτὰ εἰς τὰ σάγματα τῆς καμήλου καὶ ἐπεκάθισεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: she said: Let not my lord be angry that I cannot rise up before you, because it has now happened to me according to the custom of women . So his careful search was in vain.
text_la: ait : Ne irascatur dominus meus quod coram te assurgere nequeo : quia juxta consuetudinem feminarum nunc accidit mihi : sic delusa sollicitudo quærentis est.
text_pt: E ela disse a seu pai: Não se acenda a ira aos olhos de meu senhor, que não posso levantar-me diante da tua face; porquanto tenho o costume das mulheres. E ele procurou, mas não achou os ídolos.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτῆς μὴ βαρέως φέρε κύριε οὐ δύναμαι ἀναστῆναι ἐνώπιόν σου ὅτι τὸ κατ' ἐθισμὸν τῶν γυναικῶν μοί ἐστιν ἠρεύνησεν δὲ Λαβαν ἐν ὅλῳ τῷ οἴκῳ καὶ οὐχ εὗρεν τὰ εἴδωλα

text_en: And Jacob being angry , said in a chiding manner: For what fault of mine, and for what offence on my part have you so hotly pursued me,
text_la: Tumensque Jacob, cum jurgio ait : Quam ob culpam meam, et ob quod peccatum meum sic exarsisti post me,
text_pt: Então irou-se Jacó e contendeu com Labão; e respondeu Jacó, e disse a Labão: Qual é a minha transgressão? Qual é o meu pecado, que tão furiosamente me tens perseguido?
text_el: ὠργίσθη δὲ Ιακωβ καὶ ἐμαχέσατο τῷ Λαβαν ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ιακωβ εἶπεν τῷ Λαβαν τί τὸ ἀδίκημά μου καὶ τί τὸ ἁμάρτημά μου ὅτι κατεδίωξας ὀπίσω μου

text_en: and searched all my household stuff ? What have you found of all the substance of your house? Lay it here before my brethren, and your brethren, and let them judge between me and you.
text_la: et scrutatus es omnem supellectilem meam? quid invenisti de cuncta substantia domus tuæ? pone hic coram fratribus meis, et fratribus tuis, et judicent inter me et te.
text_pt: Havendo apalpado todos os meus móveis, que achaste de todos os móveis de tua casa? Põe-no aqui diante dos meus irmãos e de teus irmãos; e que julguem entre nós ambos.
text_el: καὶ ὅτι ἠρεύνησας πάντα τὰ σκεύη μου τί εὗρες ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν σκευῶν τοῦ οἴκου σου θὲς ὧδε ἐναντίον τῶν ἀδελφῶν μου καὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν σου καὶ ἐλεγξάτωσαν ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν δύο ἡμῶν

text_en: Have I, therefore, been with you twenty years? Your ewes and goats were not barren, the rams of your flocks I did not eat:
text_la: Idcirco viginti annis fui tecum? oves tuæ et capræ steriles non fuerunt, arietes gregis tui non comedi:
text_pt: Estes vinte anos eu estive contigo; as tuas ovelhas e as tuas cabras nunca abortaram, e não comi os carneiros do teu rebanho.
text_el: ταῦτά μοι εἴκοσι ἔτη ἐγώ εἰμι μετὰ σοῦ τὰ πρόβατά σου καὶ αἱ αἶγές σου οὐκ ἠτεκνώθησαν κριοὺς τῶν προβάτων σου οὐ κατέφαγον

text_en: Neither did I show you that which the beast had torn; I made good all the damage: whatsoever was lost by theft , you exacted it of me:
text_la: nec captum a bestia ostendi tibi, ego damnum omne reddebam : quidquid furto peribat, a me exigebas:
text_pt: Não te trouxe eu o despedaçado; eu o pagava; o furtado de dia e o furtado de noite da minha mão o requerias.
text_el: θηριάλωτον οὐκ ἀνενήνοχά σοι ἐγὼ ἀπετίννυον παρ' ἐμαυτοῦ κλέμματα ἡμέρας καὶ κλέμματα νυκτός

text_en: Day and night was I parched with heat, and with frost, and sleep departed from my eyes.
text_la: die noctuque æstu urebar, et gelu, fugiebatque somnus ab oculis meis.
text_pt: Estava eu assim: De dia me consumia o calor, e de noite a geada; e o meu sono fugiu dos meus olhos.
text_el: ἐγινόμην τῆς ἡμέρας συγκαιόμενος τῷ καύματι καὶ παγετῷ τῆς νυκτός καὶ ἀφίστατο ὁ ὕπνος ἀπὸ τῶν ὀφθαλμῶν μου

text_en: And in this manner have I served you in your house twenty years, fourteen for your daughters, and six for your flocks: you have changed also my wages ten times.
text_la: Sicque per viginti annos in domo tua servivi tibi, quatuordecim pro filiabus, et sex pro gregibus tuis : immutasti quoque mercedem meam decem vicibus.
text_pt: Tenho estado agora vinte anos na tua casa; catorze anos te servi por tuas duas filhas, e seis anos por teu rebanho; mas o meu salário tens mudado dez vezes.
text_el: ταῦτά μοι εἴκοσι ἔτη ἐγώ εἰμι ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ σου ἐδούλευσά σοι δέκα τέσσαρα ἔτη ἀντὶ τῶν δύο θυγατέρων σου καὶ ἓξ ἔτη ἐν τοῖς προβάτοις σου καὶ παρελογίσω τὸν μισθόν μου δέκα ἀμνάσιν

text_en: Unless the God of my father, Abraham , and the fear of Isaac , had stood by me, peradventure now you had sent me away naked: God beheld my affliction and the labour of my hands, and rebuked you yesterday.
text_la: Nisi Deus patris mei Abraham, et timor Isaac affuisset mihi, forsitan modo nudum me dimisisses : afflictionem meam et laborem manuum mearum respexit Deus, et arguit te heri.
text_pt: Se o Deus de meu pai, o Deus de Abraão e o temor de Isaque não fora comigo, por certo me despedirias agora vazio. Deus atendeu à minha aflição, e ao trabalho das minhas mãos, e repreendeu-te ontem à noite.
text_el: εἰ μὴ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ πατρός μου Αβρααμ καὶ ὁ φόβος Ισαακ ἦν μοι νῦν ἂν κενόν με ἐξαπέστειλας τὴν ταπείνωσίν μου καὶ τὸν κόπον τῶν χειρῶν μου εἶδεν ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἤλεγξέν σε ἐχθές

text_en: Laban answered him: The daughters are mine, and the children, and your flocks, and all things that you see are mine: what can I do to my children, and grandchildren?
text_la: Respondit ei Laban : Filiæ meæ et filii, et greges tui, et omnia quæ cernis, mea sunt : quid possum facere filiis et nepotibus meis?
text_pt: Então respondeu Labão, e disse a Jacó: Estas filhas são minhas filhas, e estes filhos são meus filhos, e este rebanho é o meu rebanho, e tudo o que vês, é meu; e que farei hoje a estas minhas filhas, ou a seus filhos, que deram à luz?
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Λαβαν εἶπεν τῷ Ιακωβ αἱ θυγατέρες θυγατέρες μου καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ υἱοί μου καὶ τὰ κτήνη κτήνη μου καὶ πάντα ὅσα σὺ ὁρᾷς ἐμά ἐστιν καὶ τῶν θυγατέρων μου τί ποιήσω ταύταις σήμερον ἢ τοῖς τέκνοις αὐτῶν οἷς ἔτεκον

text_en: Come, therefore, let us enter into a league; that it may be for a testimony between me and you.
text_la: Veni ergo, et ineamus fœdus, ut sit in testimonium inter me et te.
text_pt: Agora pois vem, e façamos aliança eu e tu, que seja por testemunho entre mim e ti.
text_el: νῦν οὖν δεῦρο διαθώμεθα διαθήκην ἐγὼ καὶ σύ καὶ ἔσται εἰς μαρτύριον ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ἰδοὺ οὐθεὶς μεθ' ἡμῶν ἐστιν ἰδὲ ὁ θεὸς μάρτυς ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ

text_en: And Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a title.
text_la: Tulit itaque Jacob lapidem, et erexit illum in titulum:
text_pt: Então tomou Jacó uma pedra, e erigiu-a por coluna.
text_el: λαβὼν δὲ Ιακωβ λίθον ἔστησεν αὐτὸν στήλην

text_en: And he said to his brethren: Bring hither stones. And they, gathering stones together, made a heap, and they ate upon it.
text_la: dixitque fratribus suis : Afferte lapides. Qui congregantes fecerunt tumulum, comederuntque super eum:
text_pt: E disse Jacó a seus irmãos: Ajuntai pedras. E tomaram pedras, e fizeram um montão, e comeram ali sobre aquele montão.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ συλλέγετε λίθους καὶ συνέλεξαν λίθους καὶ ἐποίησαν βουνόν καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἔπιον ἐκεῖ ἐπὶ τοῦ βουνοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Λαβαν ὁ βουνὸς οὗτος μαρτυρεῖ ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ σήμερον

text_en: And Laban called it, The witness heap ; and Jacob , The hillock of testimony : each of them according to the propriety of his language.
text_la: quem vocavit Laban Tumulum testis : et Jacob, Acervum testimonii, uterque juxta proprietatem linguæ suæ.
text_pt: E chamou-o Labão Jegar-Saaduta; porém Jacó chamou-o Galeede.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν Λαβαν Βουνὸς τῆς μαρτυρίας Ιακωβ δὲ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν Βουνὸς μάρτυς

text_en: And Laban said: This heap shall be a witness between me and you this day, and therefore the name thereof was called Galaad, that is, The witness heap .
text_la: Dixitque Laban : Tumulus iste erit testis inter me et te hodie, et idcirco appellatum est nomen ejus Galaad, id est, Tumulus testis.
text_pt: Então disse Labão: Este montão seja hoje por testemunha entre mim e ti. Por isso se lhe chamou Galeede,
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Λαβαν τῷ Ιακωβ ἰδοὺ ὁ βουνὸς οὗτος καὶ ἡ στήλη αὕτη ἣν ἔστησα ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ μαρτυρεῖ ὁ βουνὸς οὗτος καὶ μαρτυρεῖ ἡ στήλη αὕτη διὰ τοῦτο ἐκλήθη τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Βουνὸς μαρτυρεῖ

text_en: The Lord behold and judge between us, when we shall be gone one from the other.
text_la: Intueatur et judicet Dominus inter nos quando recesserimus a nobis,
text_pt: E Mispá, porquanto disse: Atente o Senhor entre mim e ti, quando nós estivermos apartados um do outro.
text_el: καὶ ἡ ὅρασις ἣν εἶπεν ἐπίδοι ὁ θεὸς ἀνὰ μέσον ἐμοῦ καὶ σοῦ ὅτι ἀποστησόμεθα ἕτερος ἀπὸ τοῦ ἑτέρου

text_en: If you afflict my daughters, and if you bring in other wives over them: none is witness of our speech but God , who is present and beholds.
text_la: si afflixeris filias meas, et si introduxeris alias uxores super eas : nullus sermonis nostri testis est absque Deo, qui præsens respicit.
text_pt: Se afligires as minhas filhas, e se tomares mulheres além das minhas filhas, ninguém está conosco; atenta que Deus é testemunha entre mim e ti.
text_el: εἰ ταπεινώσεις τὰς θυγατέρας μου εἰ λήμψῃ γυναῖκας ἐπὶ ταῖς θυγατράσιν μου ὅρα οὐθεὶς μεθ' ἡμῶν ἐστιν

text_en: And he said again to Jacob : Behold this heap, and the stone which I have set up between me and you,
text_la: Dixitque rursus ad Jacob : En tumulus hic, et lapis quem erexi inter me et te,
text_pt: Disse mais Labão a Jacó: Eis aqui este mesmo montão, e eis aqui essa coluna que levantei entre mim e ti.

text_en: shall be a witness: this heap, I say, and the stone, be they for a testimony, if either I shall pass beyond it going towards you, or you shall pass beyond it thinking harm to me.
text_la: testis erit : tumulus, inquam, iste et lapis sint in testimonium, si aut ego transiero illum pergens ad te, aut tu præterieris, malum mihi cogitans.
text_pt: Este montão seja testemunha, e esta coluna seja testemunha, que eu não passarei este montão a ti, e que tu não passarás este montão e esta coluna a mim, para mal.
text_el: ἐάν τε γὰρ ἐγὼ μὴ διαβῶ πρὸς σὲ μηδὲ σὺ διαβῇς πρός με τὸν βουνὸν τοῦτον καὶ τὴν στήλην ταύτην ἐπὶ κακίᾳ

text_en: The God of Abraham , and the God of Nachor, the God of their father, judge between us. And Jacob swore by the fear of his father Isaac :
text_la: Deus Abraham, et Deus Nachor, judicet inter nos, Deus patris eorum. Juravit ergo Jacob per timorem patris sui Isaac:
text_pt: O Deus de Abraão e o Deus de Naor, o Deus de seu pai, julgue entre nós. E jurou Jacó pelo temor de seu pai Isaque.
text_el: ὁ θεὸς Αβρααμ καὶ ὁ θεὸς Ναχωρ κρινεῖ ἀνὰ μέσον ἡμῶν καὶ ὤμοσεν Ιακωβ κατὰ τοῦ φόβου τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ισαακ

text_en: And after he had offered sacrifices in the mountain, he called his brethren to eat bread. And when they had eaten, they lodged there:
text_la: immolatisque victimis in monte, vocavit fratres suos ut ederent panem. Qui cum comedissent, manserunt ibi:
text_pt: E ofereceu Jacó um sacrifício na montanha, e convidou seus irmãos, para comer pão; e comeram pão e passaram a noite na montanha.
text_el: καὶ ἔθυσεν Ιακωβ θυσίαν ἐν τῷ ὄρει καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔφαγον καὶ ἔπιον καὶ ἐκοιμήθησαν ἐν τῷ ὄρει

text_en: But Laban arose in the night, and kissed his sons and daughters, and blessed them: and returned to his place.
text_la: Laban vero de nocte consurgens, osculatus est filios, et filias suas, et benedixit illis : reversusque est in locum suum.
text_pt: E levantou-se Labão pela manhã de madrugada, e beijou seus filhos e suas filhas e abençoou-os e partiu; e voltou Labão ao seu lugar.
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ Λαβαν τὸ πρωὶ κατεφίλησεν τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτοῦ καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς καὶ ἀποστραφεὶς Λαβαν ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὸν τόπον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Jacob also went on the journey he had begun: and the angels of God met him.
text_la: Jacob quoque abiit itinere quo cœperat : fueruntque ei obviam angeli Dei.
text_pt: Jacó também seguiu o seu caminho, e encontraram-no os anjos de Deus.
text_el: καὶ Ιακωβ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ὁδόν καὶ ἀναβλέψας εἶδεν παρεμβολὴν θεοῦ παρεμβεβληκυῖαν καὶ συνήντησαν αὐτῷ οἱ ἄγγελοι τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And when he saw them, he said: These are the camps of God , and he called the name of that place Mahanaim, that is, Camps .
text_la: Quos cum vidisset, ait : Castra Dei sunt hæc : et appellavit nomen loci illius Mahanaim, id est, Castra.
text_pt: E Jacó disse, quando os viu: Este é o exército de Deus. E chamou aquele lugar Maanaim.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ ἡνίκα εἶδεν αὐτούς Παρεμβολὴ θεοῦ αὕτη καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Παρεμβολαί

text_en: And he sent messengers before him to Esau , his brother, to the land of Seir, to the country of Edom :
text_la: Misit autem et nuntios ante se ad Esau fratrem suum in terram Seir, in regionem Edom:
text_pt: E enviou Jacó mensageiros adiante de si a Esaú, seu irmão, à terra de Seir, território de Edom.
text_el: ἀπέστειλεν δὲ Ιακωβ ἀγγέλους ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πρὸς Ησαυ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ εἰς γῆν Σηιρ εἰς χώραν Εδωμ

text_en: And he commanded them, saying: Thus shall you speak to my lord Esau : Thus says your brother Jacob : I have sojourned with Laban , and have been with him until this day:
text_la: præcepitque eis, dicens : Sic loquimini domino meo Esau : Hæc dicit frater tuus Jacob : Apud Laban peregrinatus sum, et fui usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: E ordenou-lhes, dizendo: Assim direis a meu senhor Esaú: Assim diz Jacó, teu servo: Como peregrino morei com Labão, e me detive lá até agora;
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο αὐτοῖς λέγων οὕτως ἐρεῖτε τῷ κυρίῳ μου Ησαυ οὕτως λέγει ὁ παῖς σου Ιακωβ μετὰ Λαβαν παρῴκησα καὶ ἐχρόνισα ἕως τοῦ νῦν

text_en: I have oxen, and asses, and sheep, and menservants, and womenservants: and now I send a message to my lord, that I may find favour in your sight.
text_la: Habeo boves, et asinos, et oves, et servos, et ancillas : mittoque nunc legationem ad dominum meum, ut inveniam gratiam in conspectu tuo.
text_pt: E tenho bois e jumentos, ovelhas, e servos e servas; e enviei para o anunciar a meu senhor, para que ache graça em teus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένοντό μοι βόες καὶ ὄνοι καὶ πρόβατα καὶ παῖδες καὶ παιδίσκαι καὶ ἀπέστειλα ἀναγγεῖλαι τῷ κυρίῳ μου Ησαυ ἵνα εὕρῃ ὁ παῖς σου χάριν ἐναντίον σου

text_en: And the messengers returned to Jacob , saying: We came to Esau , your brother, and behold he comes with speed to meet you with four hundred men .
text_la: Reversique sunt nuntii ad Jacob, dicentes : Venimus ad Esau fratrem tuum, et ecce properat tibi in occursum cum quadringentis viris.
text_pt: E os mensageiros voltaram a Jacó, dizendo: Fomos a teu irmão Esaú; e também ele vem para encontrar-te, e quatrocentos homens com ele.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψαν οἱ ἄγγελοι πρὸς Ιακωβ λέγοντες ἤλθομεν πρὸς τὸν ἀδελφόν σου Ησαυ καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ἔρχεται εἰς συνάντησίν σοι καὶ τετρακόσιοι ἄνδρες μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Jacob was greatly afraid; and in his fear divided the people that was with him, and the flocks, and the sheep, and the oxen, and the camels, into two companies,
text_la: Timuit Jacob valde : et perterritus divisit populum qui secum erat, greges quoque et oves, et boves, et camelos, in duas turmas,
text_pt: Então Jacó temeu muito e angustiou-se; e repartiu o povo que com ele estava, e as ovelhas, e as vacas, e os camelos, em dois bandos.
text_el: ἐφοβήθη δὲ Ιακωβ σφόδρα καὶ ἠπορεῖτο καὶ διεῖλεν τὸν λαὸν τὸν μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς βόας καὶ τὰ πρόβατα εἰς δύο παρεμβολάς

text_en: saying: If Esau come to one company, and destroy it, the other company that is left, shall escape.
text_la: dicens : Si venerit Esau ad unam turmam, et percusserit eam, alia turma, quæ relicta est, salvabitur.
text_pt: Porque dizia: Se Esaú vier a um bando e o ferir, o outro bando escapará.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιακωβ ἐὰν ἔλθῃ Ησαυ εἰς παρεμβολὴν μίαν καὶ ἐκκόψῃ αὐτήν ἔσται ἡ παρεμβολὴ ἡ δευτέρα εἰς τὸ σῴζεσθαι

text_en: And Jacob said: O God of my father Abraham , and God of my father Isaac : O Lord who said to me, Return to your land, and to the place of your birth, and I will do well for you.
text_la: Dixitque Jacob : Deus patris mei Abraham, et Deus patris mei Isaac : Domine qui dixisti mihi : Revertere in terram tuam, et in locum nativitatis tuæ, et benefaciam tibi:
text_pt: Disse mais Jacó: Deus de meu pai Abraão, e Deus de meu pai Isaque, o Senhor, que me disseste: Torna-te à tua terra, e a tua parentela, e far-te-ei bem;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ πατρός μου Αβρααμ καὶ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ πατρός μου Ισαακ κύριε ὁ εἴπας μοι ἀπότρεχε εἰς τὴν γῆν τῆς γενέσεώς σου καὶ εὖ σε ποιήσω

text_en: I am not worthy of the least of all your mercies, and of your truth which you have fulfilled to your servant. With my staff I passed over this Jordan ; and now I return with two companies.
text_la: minor sum cunctis miserationibus tuis, et veritate tua quam explevisti servo tuo. In baculo meo transivi Jordanem istum : et nunc cum duabus turmis regredior.
text_pt: Menor sou eu que todas as beneficências, e que toda a fidelidade que fizeste ao teu servo; porque com meu cajado passei este Jordão, e agora me tornei em dois bandos.
text_el: ἱκανοῦταί μοι ἀπὸ πάσης δικαιοσύνης καὶ ἀπὸ πάσης ἀληθείας ἧς ἐποίησας τῷ παιδί σου ἐν γὰρ τῇ ῥάβδῳ μου διέβην τὸν Ιορδάνην τοῦτον νῦν δὲ γέγονα εἰς δύο παρεμβολάς

text_en: Deliver me from the hand of my brother Esau , for I am greatly afraid of him; lest perhaps he come, and kill the mother with the children.
text_la: Erue me de manu fratris mei Esau, quia valde eum timeo : ne forte veniens percutiat matrem cum filiis.
text_pt: Livra-me, peço-te, da mão de meu irmão, da mão de Esaú; porque eu o temo; porventura não venha, e me fira, e a mãe com os filhos.
text_el: ἐξελοῦ με ἐκ χειρὸς τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ μου Ησαυ ὅτι φοβοῦμαι ἐγὼ αὐτόν μήποτε ἐλθὼν πατάξῃ με καὶ μητέρα ἐπὶ τέκνοις

text_en: You said that you would do well by me, and multiply my seed like the sand of the sea, which cannot be numbered for multitude.
text_la: Tu locutus es quod benefaceres mihi, et dilatares semen meum sicut arenam maris, quæ præ multitudine numerari non potest.
text_pt: E tu o disseste: Certamente te farei bem, e farei a tua descendência como a areia do mar, que pela multidão não se pode contar.
text_el: σὺ δὲ εἶπας καλῶς εὖ σε ποιήσω καὶ θήσω τὸ σπέρμα σου ὡς τὴν ἄμμον τῆς θαλάσσης ἣ οὐκ ἀριθμηθήσεται ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους

text_en: And when he had slept there that night, he set apart, of the things which he had, presents for his brother Esau ,
text_la: Cumque dormisset ibi nocte illa, separavit de his quæ habebat, munera Esau fratri suo,
text_pt: E passou ali aquela noite; e tomou do que lhe veio à sua mão, um presente para seu irmão Esaú:
text_el: καὶ ἐκοιμήθη ἐκεῖ τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην καὶ ἔλαβεν ὧν ἔφερεν δῶρα καὶ ἐξαπέστειλεν Ησαυ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: two hundred she goats, twenty he goats, two hundred ewes, and twenty rams,
text_la: capras ducentas, hircos viginti, oves ducentas, et arietes viginti,
text_pt: Duzentas cabras e vinte bodes; duzentas ovelhas e vinte carneiros;
text_el: αἶγας διακοσίας τράγους εἴκοσι πρόβατα διακόσια κριοὺς εἴκοσι

text_en: thirty milch camels with their colts, forty kine, and twenty bulls, twenty she asses, and ten of their foals.
text_la: camelos fœtas cum pullis suis triginta, vaccas quadraginta, et tauros viginti, asinas viginti et pullos earum decem.
text_pt: Trinta camelas de leite com suas crias, quarenta vacas e dez novilhos; vinte jumentas e dez jumentinhos;
text_el: καμήλους θηλαζούσας καὶ τὰ παιδία αὐτῶν τριάκοντα βόας τεσσαράκοντα ταύρους δέκα ὄνους εἴκοσι καὶ πώλους δέκα

text_en: And he sent them by the hands of his servants, every drove by itself, and he said to his servants: Go before me, and let there be a space between drove and drove.
text_la: Et misit per manus servorum suorum singulos seorsum greges, dixitque pueris suis : Antecedite me, et sit spatium inter gregem et gregem.
text_pt: E deu-os na mão dos seus servos, cada rebanho à parte, e disse a seus servos: Passai adiante de mim e ponde espaço entre rebanho e rebanho.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν διὰ χειρὸς τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ ποίμνιον κατὰ μόνας εἶπεν δὲ τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ προπορεύεσθε ἔμπροσθέν μου καὶ διάστημα ποιεῖτε ἀνὰ μέσον ποίμνης καὶ ποίμνης

text_en: And he commanded the first, saying: If you meet my brother Esau , and he asks you: Whose are you? Or where are you going? Or whose are these before you?
text_la: Et præcepit priori, dicens : Si obvium habueris fratrem meum Esau, et interrogaverit te : Cujus es? aut, Quo vadis? aut, Cujus sunt ista quæ sequeris?
text_pt: E ordenou ao primeiro, dizendo: Quando Esaú, meu irmão, te encontrar, e te perguntar, dizendo: De quem és, e para onde vais, e de quem são estes diante de ti?
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο τῷ πρώτῳ λέγων ἐάν σοι συναντήσῃ Ησαυ ὁ ἀδελφός μου καὶ ἐρωτᾷ σε λέγων τίνος εἶ καὶ ποῦ πορεύῃ καὶ τίνος ταῦτα τὰ προπορευόμενά σου

text_en: You shall answer: Your servant Jacob's : he has sent them as a present to my lord Esau ; and he comes after us.
text_la: respondebis : Servi tui Jacob, munera misit domino meo Esau, ipse quoque post nos venit.
text_pt: Então dirás: São de teu servo Jacó, presente que envia a meu senhor, a Esaú; e eis que ele mesmo vem também atrás de nós.
text_el: ἐρεῖς τοῦ παιδός σου Ιακωβ δῶρα ἀπέσταλκεν τῷ κυρίῳ μου Ησαυ καὶ ἰδοὺ αὐτὸς ὀπίσω ἡμῶν

text_en: In like manner he commanded the second, and the third, and all that followed the droves, saying: Speak the same words to Esau , when you find him.
text_la: Similiter dedit mandata secundo, et tertio, et cunctis qui sequebantur greges, dicens : Iisdem verbis loquimini ad Esau cum inveneritis eum.
text_pt: E ordenou também ao segundo, e ao terceiro, e a todos os que vinham atrás dos rebanhos, dizendo: Conforme a esta mesma palavra falareis a Esaú, quando o achardes.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο τῷ πρώτῳ καὶ τῷ δευτέρῳ καὶ τῷ τρίτῳ καὶ πᾶσι τοῖς προπορευομένοις ὀπίσω τῶν ποιμνίων τούτων λέγων κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο λαλήσατε Ησαυ ἐν τῷ εὑρεῖν ὑμᾶς αὐτὸν

text_en: And you shall add: Your servant Jacob himself also follows after us; for he said: I will appease him with the presents that go before, and afterwards I will see him, perhaps he will be gracious to me.
text_la: Et addetis : Ipse quoque servus tuus Jacob iter nostrum insequitur. Dixit enim : Placabo illum muneribus quæ præcedunt, et postea videbo illum : forsitan propitiabitur mihi.
text_pt: E direis também: Eis que o teu servo Jacó vem atrás de nós. Porque dizia: Eu o aplacarei com o presente, que vai adiante de mim, e depois verei a sua face; porventura ele me aceitará.
text_el: καὶ ἐρεῖτε ἰδοὺ ὁ παῖς σου Ιακωβ παραγίνεται ὀπίσω ἡμῶν εἶπεν γάρ ἐξιλάσομαι τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἐν τοῖς δώροις τοῖς προπορευομένοις αὐτοῦ καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο ὄψομαι τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ ἴσως γὰρ προσδέξεται τὸ πρόσωπόν μου

text_en: So the presents went before him, but himself lodged that night in the camp.
text_la: Præcesserunt itaque munera ante eum, ipse vero mansit nocte illa in castris.
text_pt: Assim, passou o presente adiante dele; ele, porém, passou aquela noite no arraial.
text_el: καὶ παρεπορεύοντο τὰ δῶρα κατὰ πρόσωπον αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς δὲ ἐκοιμήθη τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην ἐν τῇ παρεμβολῇ

text_en: And rising early, he took his two wives and his two handmaids, with his eleven sons, and passed over the ford of Jaboc.
text_la: Cumque mature surrexisset, tulit duas uxores suas, et totidem famulas cum undecim filiis, et transivit vadum Jaboc.
text_pt: E levantou-se aquela mesma noite, e tomou as suas duas mulheres, e as suas duas servas, e os seus onze filhos, e passou o vau de Jaboque.
text_el: ἀναστὰς δὲ τὴν νύκτα ἐκείνην ἔλαβεν τὰς δύο γυναῖκας καὶ τὰς δύο παιδίσκας καὶ τὰ ἕνδεκα παιδία αὐτοῦ καὶ διέβη τὴν διάβασιν τοῦ Ιαβοκ

text_en: And when all things were brought over that belonged to him,
text_la: Traductisque omnibus quæ ad se pertinebant,
text_pt: E tomou-os e fê-los passar o ribeiro; e fez passar tudo o que tinha.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτοὺς καὶ διέβη τὸν χειμάρρουν καὶ διεβίβασεν πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ

text_en: he remained alone; and behold, a man wrestled with him till morning.
text_la: mansit solus: et ecce vir luctabatur cum eo usque mane.
text_pt: Jacó, porém, ficou só; e lutou com ele um homem, até que a alva subiu.
text_el: ὑπελείφθη δὲ Ιακωβ μόνος καὶ ἐπάλαιεν ἄνθρωπος μετ' αὐτοῦ ἕως πρωί

text_en: And when he saw that he could not overcome him, he touched the sinew of his thigh, and forthwith it shrank.
text_la: Qui cum videret quod eum superare non posset, tetigit nervum femoris ejus, et statim emarcuit.
text_pt: E vendo este que não prevalecia contra ele, tocou a juntura de sua coxa, e se deslocou a juntura da coxa de Jacó, lutando com ele.
text_el: εἶδεν δὲ ὅτι οὐ δύναται πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ἥψατο τοῦ πλάτους τοῦ μηροῦ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνάρκησεν τὸ πλάτος τοῦ μηροῦ Ιακωβ ἐν τῷ παλαίειν αὐτὸν μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said to him: Let me go, for it is break of day. He answered: I will not let you go, unless you bless me.
text_la: Dixitque ad eum : Dimitte me : jam enim ascendit aurora. Respondit : Non dimittam te, nisi benedixeris mihi.
text_pt: E disse: Deixa-me ir, porque já a alva subiu. Porém ele disse: Não te deixarei ir, se não me abençoares.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ἀπόστειλόν με ἀνέβη γὰρ ὁ ὄρθρος ὁ δὲ εἶπεν οὐ μή σε ἀποστείλω ἐὰν μή με εὐλογήσῃς

text_en: And he said: What is your name ? He answered: Jacob .
text_la: Ait ergo : Quod nomen est tibi? Respondit : Jacob.
text_pt: E disse-lhe: Qual é o teu nome? E ele disse: Jacó.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ τί τὸ ὄνομά σού ἐστιν ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Ιακωβ

text_en: But he said: Your name shall not be called Jacob, but Israel; for if you have been strong against God , how much more shall you prevail against men ?
