text_la: At ille : Nequaquam, inquit, Jacob appellabitur nomen tuum, sed Israël : quoniam si contra Deum fortis fuisti, quanto magis contra homines prævalebis?
text_pt: Então disse: Não te chamarás mais Jacó, mas Israel; pois como príncipe lutaste com Deus e com os homens, e prevaleceste.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ οὐ κληθήσεται ἔτι τὸ ὄνομά σου Ιακωβ ἀλλὰ Ισραηλ ἔσται τὸ ὄνομά σου ὅτι ἐνίσχυσας μετὰ θεοῦ καὶ μετὰ ἀνθρώπων δυνατός

text_en: Jacob asked him: Tell me by what name are you called? He answered: Why do you ask my name ? And he blessed him in the same place.
text_la: Interrogavit eum Jacob : Dic mihi, quo appellaris nomine? Respondit : Cur quæris nomen meum? Et benedixit ei in eodem loco.
text_pt: E Jacó lhe perguntou, e disse: Dá-me, peço-te, a saber o teu nome. E disse: Por que perguntas pelo meu nome? E abençoou-o ali.
text_el: ἠρώτησεν δὲ Ιακωβ καὶ εἶπεν ἀνάγγειλόν μοι τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ εἶπεν ἵνα τί τοῦτο ἐρωτᾷς τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ ηὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And Jacob called the name of the place Phanuel, saying: I have seen God face to face, and my soul has been saved.
text_la: Vocavitque Jacob nomen loci illius Phanuel, dicens : Vidi Deum facie ad faciem, et salva facta est anima mea.
text_pt: E chamou Jacó o nome daquele lugar Peniel, porque dizia: Tenho visto a Deus face a face, e a minha alma foi salva.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ιακωβ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Εἶδος θεοῦ εἶδον γὰρ θεὸν πρόσωπον πρὸς πρόσωπον καὶ ἐσώθη μου ἡ ψυχή

text_en: And immediately the sun rose upon him, after he was past Phanuel; but he halted on his foot.
text_la: Ortusque est ei statim sol, postquam transgressus est Phanuel : ipse vero claudicabat pede.
text_pt: E saiu-lhe o sol, quando passou a Peniel; e manquejava da sua coxa.
text_el: ἀνέτειλεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ ἥλιος ἡνίκα παρῆλθεν τὸ Εἶδος τοῦ θεοῦ αὐτὸς δὲ ἐπέσκαζεν τῷ μηρῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Therefore the children of Israel , unto this day, eat not the sinew, that shrank in Jacob's thigh: because he touched the sinew of his thigh and it shrank.
text_la: Quam ob causam non comedunt nervum filii Israël, qui emarcuit in femore Jacob, usque in præsentem diem : eo quod tetigerit nervum femoris ejus, et obstupuerit.
text_pt: Por isso os filhos de Israel não comem o nervo encolhido, que está sobre a juntura da coxa, até o dia de hoje; porquanto tocara a juntura da coxa de Jacó no nervo encolhido.
text_el: ἕνεκεν τούτου οὐ μὴ φάγωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸ νεῦρον ὃ ἐνάρκησεν ὅ ἐστιν ἐπὶ τοῦ πλάτους τοῦ μηροῦ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ὅτι ἥψατο τοῦ πλάτους τοῦ μηροῦ Ιακωβ τοῦ νεύρου καὶ ἐνάρκησεν

text_en: And Jacob lifting up his eyes, saw Esau coming, and with him four hundred men : and he divided the children of Lia and of Rachel , and of the two handmaids.
text_la: Elevans autem Jacob oculos suos, vidit venientem Esau, et cum eo quadringentos viros : divisitque filios Liæ et Rachel, ambarumque famularum:
text_pt: E levantou Jacó os seus olhos, e olhou, e eis que vinha Esaú, e quatrocentos homens com ele. Então repartiu os filhos entre Lia, e Raquel, e as duas servas.
text_el: ἀναβλέψας δὲ Ιακωβ εἶδεν καὶ ἰδοὺ Ησαυ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἐρχόμενος καὶ τετρακόσιοι ἄνδρες μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιδιεῖλεν Ιακωβ τὰ παιδία ἐπὶ Λειαν καὶ Ραχηλ καὶ τὰς δύο παιδίσκας

text_en: And he put both the handmaids and their children foremost: and Lia and her children in the second place: and Rachel and Joseph last.
text_la: et posuit utramque ancillam, et liberos earum, in principio : Liam vero, et filios ejus, in secundo loco : Rachel autem et Joseph novissimos.
text_pt: E pôs as servas e seus filhos na frente, e a Lia e seus filhos atrás; porém a Raquel e José os derradeiros.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν τὰς δύο παιδίσκας καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν ἐν πρώτοις καὶ Λειαν καὶ τὰ παιδία αὐτῆς ὀπίσω καὶ Ραχηλ καὶ Ιωσηφ ἐσχάτους

text_en: And he went forward and bowed down with his face to the ground seven times, until his brother came near.
text_la: Et ipse progrediens adoravit pronus in terram septies, donec appropinquaret frater ejus.
text_pt: E ele mesmo passou adiante deles e inclinou-se à terra sete vezes, até que chegou a seu irmão.
text_el: αὐτὸς δὲ προῆλθεν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν ἑπτάκις ἕως τοῦ ἐγγίσαι τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: Then Esau ran to meet his brother, and embraced him: and clasping him fast about the neck, and kissing him, wept.
text_la: Currens itaque Esau obviam fratri suo, amplexatus est eum : stringensque collum ejus, et osculans flevit.
text_pt: Então Esaú correu-lhe ao encontro, e abraçou-o, e lançou-se sobre o seu pescoço, e beijou-o; e choraram.
text_el: καὶ προσέδραμεν Ησαυ εἰς συνάντησιν αὐτῷ καὶ περιλαβὼν αὐτὸν ἐφίλησεν καὶ προσέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔκλαυσαν ἀμφότεροι

text_en: And lifting up his eyes, he saw the women and their children, and said: What mean these? And do they belong to you? He answered: They are the children which God has given to me, your servant.
text_la: Levatisque oculis, vidit mulieres et parvulos earum, et ait : Quid sibi volunt isti? et si ad te pertinent? Respondit : Parvuli sunt quos donavit mihi Deus servo tuo.
text_pt: Depois levantou os seus olhos, e viu as mulheres, e os meninos, e disse: Quem são estes contigo? E ele disse: Os filhos que Deus graciosamente tem dado a teu servo.
text_el: καὶ ἀναβλέψας εἶδεν τὰς γυναῖκας καὶ τὰ παιδία καὶ εἶπεν τί ταῦτά σοί ἐστιν ὁ δὲ εἶπεν τὰ παιδία οἷς ἠλέησεν ὁ θεὸς τὸν παῖδά σου

text_en: Then the handmaids and their children came near and bowed themselves.
text_la: Et appropinquantes ancillæ et filii earum, incurvati sunt.
text_pt: Então chegaram as servas; elas e os seus filhos, e inclinaram-se.
text_el: καὶ προσήγγισαν αἱ παιδίσκαι καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν καὶ προσεκύνησαν

text_en: Lia also, with her children, came near and bowed down in like manner; and last of all, Joseph and Rachel bowed down.
text_la: Accessit quoque Lia cum pueris suis : et cum similiter adorassent, extremi Joseph et Rachel adoraverunt.
text_pt: E chegou também Lia com seus filhos, e inclinaram-se; e depois chegou José e Raquel e inclinaram-se.
text_el: καὶ προσήγγισεν Λεια καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῆς καὶ προσεκύνησαν καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα προσήγγισεν Ραχηλ καὶ Ιωσηφ καὶ προσεκύνησαν

text_en: And Esau said: What are the droves that I met? He answered: That I might find favour before my lord.
text_la: Dixitque Esau : Quænam sunt istæ turmæ quas obviam habui? Respondit : Ut invenirem gratiam coram domino meo.
text_pt: E disse Esaú: De que te serve todo este bando que tenho encontrado? E ele disse: Para achar graça aos olhos de meu senhor.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τί ταῦτά σοί ἐστιν πᾶσαι αἱ παρεμβολαὶ αὗται αἷς ἀπήντηκα ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἵνα εὕρῃ ὁ παῖς σου χάριν ἐναντίον σου κύριε

text_en: But he said: I have plenty, my brother, keep what is yours for yourself.
text_la: At ille ait : Habeo plurima, frater mi, sint tua tibi.
text_pt: Mas Esaú disse: Eu tenho bastante, meu irmão; seja para ti o que tens.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ησαυ ἔστιν μοι πολλά ἄδελφε ἔστω σοι τὰ σά

text_en: And Jacob said: Do not so I beseech you, but if I have found favour in your eyes, receive a little present at my hands: for I have seen your face, as if I should have seen the countenance of God : be gracious to me,
text_la: Dixitque Jacob : Noli ita, obsecro : sed si inveni gratiam in oculis tuis, accipe munusculum de manibus meis. Sic enim vidi faciem tuam, quasi viderim vultum Dei : esto mihi propitius,
text_pt: Então disse Jacó: Não, se agora tenho achado graça em teus olhos, peço-te que tomes o meu presente da minha mão; porquanto tenho visto o teu rosto, como se tivesse visto o rosto de Deus, e tomaste contentamento em mim.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ εἰ εὕρηκα χάριν ἐναντίον σου δέξαι τὰ δῶρα διὰ τῶν ἐμῶν χειρῶν ἕνεκεν τούτου εἶδον τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ὡς ἄν τις ἴδοι πρόσωπον θεοῦ καὶ εὐδοκήσεις με

text_en: and take the blessing which I have brought you, and which God has given me, who gives all things. He took it with much ado at his brother's earnest pressing him,
text_la: et suscipe benedictionem quam attuli tibi, et quam donavit mihi Deus tribuens omnia. Vix fratre compellente, suscipiens,
text_pt: Toma, peço-te, a minha bênção, que te foi trazida; porque Deus graciosamente ma tem dado; e porque tenho de tudo. E instou com ele, até que a tomou.
text_el: λαβὲ τὰς εὐλογίας μου ἃς ἤνεγκά σοι ὅτι ἠλέησέν με ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἔστιν μοι πάντα καὶ ἐβιάσατο αὐτόν καὶ ἔλαβεν

text_en: and said: Let us go on together, and I will accompany you in your journey.
text_la: ait : Gradiamur simul, eroque socius itineris tui.
text_pt: E disse: Caminhemos, e andemos, e eu partirei adiante de ti.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἀπάραντες πορευσόμεθα ἐπ' εὐθεῖαν

text_en: And Jacob said: My lord, you know that I have with me tender children, and sheep, and kine with young: which if I should cause to be overdriven, in one day all the flocks will die.
text_la: Dixitque Jacob : Nosti, domine mi, quod parvulos habeam teneros, et oves, et boves fœtas mecum : quas si plus in ambulando fecero laborare, morientur una die cuncti greges.
text_pt: Porém ele lhe disse: Meu senhor sabe que estes filhos são tenros, e que tenho comigo ovelhas e vacas de leite; se as afadigarem somente um dia, todo o rebanho morrerá.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ κύριός μου γινώσκει ὅτι τὰ παιδία ἁπαλώτερα καὶ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ αἱ βόες λοχεύονται ἐπ' ἐμέ ἐὰν οὖν καταδιώξω αὐτοὺς ἡμέραν μίαν ἀποθανοῦνται πάντα τὰ κτήνη

text_en: May it please my lord to go before his servant: and I will follow softly after him, as I shall see my children to be able, until I come to my lord in Seir.
text_la: Præcedat dominus meus ante servum suum : et ego sequar paulatim vestigia ejus, sicut videro parvulos meos posse, donec veniam ad dominum meum in Seir.
text_pt: Ora passe o meu senhor adiante de seu servo; e eu irei como guia pouco a pouco, conforme ao passo do gado que vai adiante de mim, e conforme ao passo dos meninos, até que chegue a meu senhor em Seir.
text_el: προελθέτω ὁ κύριός μου ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ παιδός ἐγὼ δὲ ἐνισχύσω ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ κατὰ σχολὴν τῆς πορεύσεως τῆς ἐναντίον μου καὶ κατὰ πόδα τῶν παιδαρίων ἕως τοῦ με ἐλθεῖν πρὸς τὸν κύριόν μου εἰς Σηιρ

text_en: Esau answered: I beseech you, that some of the people, at least, who are with me, may stay to accompany you on the way. And he said: There is no necessity: I want nothing else but only to find favour, my lord, in your sight.
text_la: Respondit Esau : Oro te, ut de populo qui mecum est, saltem socri remaneant viæ tuæ. Non est, inquit, necesse : hoc uno tantum indigeo, ut inveniam gratiam in conspectu tuo, domine mi.
text_pt: E Esaú disse: Permite então que eu deixe contigo alguns da minha gente. E ele disse: Para que é isso? Basta que ache graça aos olhos de meu senhor.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ησαυ καταλείψω μετὰ σοῦ ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ τοῦ μετ' ἐμοῦ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἵνα τί τοῦτο ἱκανὸν ὅτι εὗρον χάριν ἐναντίον σου κύριε

text_en: So Esau returned that day, the way that he came, to Seir.
text_la: Reversus est itaque illo die Esau itinere quo venerat in Seir.
text_pt: Assim voltou Esaú aquele dia pelo seu caminho a Seir.
text_el: ἀπέστρεψεν δὲ Ησαυ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ εἰς τὴν ὁδὸν αὐτοῦ εἰς Σηιρ

text_en: And Jacob came to Socoth: where having built a house, and pitched tents, he called the name of the place Socoth, that is, Tents .
text_la: Et Jacob venit in Socoth : ubi ædificata domo et fixis tentoriis appellavit nomen loci illius Socoth, id est, Tabernacula.
text_pt: Jacó, porém, partiu para Sucote e edificou para si uma casa; e fez cabanas para o seu gado; por isso chamou aquele lugar Sucote.
text_el: καὶ Ιακωβ ἀπαίρει εἰς Σκηνάς καὶ ἐποίησεν ἑαυτῷ ἐκεῖ οἰκίας καὶ τοῖς κτήνεσιν αὐτοῦ ἐποίησεν σκηνάς διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐκείνου Σκηναί

text_en: And he passed over to Salem , a city of the Sichemites , which is in the land of Chanaan , after he returned from Mesopotamia of Syria : and he dwelt by the town.
text_la: Transivitque in Salem urbem Sichimorum, quæ est in terra Chanaan, postquam reversus est de Mesopotamia Syriæ : et habitavit juxta oppidum.
text_pt: E chegou Jacó salvo à Salém, cidade de Siquém, que está na terra de Canaã, quando vinha de Padã-Arã; e armou a sua tenda diante da cidade.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ιακωβ εἰς Σαλημ πόλιν Σικιμων ἥ ἐστιν ἐν γῇ Χανααν ὅτε ἦλθεν ἐκ τῆς Μεσοποταμίας Συρίας καὶ παρενέβαλεν κατὰ πρόσωπον τῆς πόλεως

text_en: And he bought that part of the field, in which he pitched his tents, of the children of Hemor, the father of Sichem , for a hundred lambs.
text_la: Emitque partem agri, in qua fixerat tabernacula, a filiis Hemor patris Sichem centum agnis.
text_pt: E comprou uma parte do campo em que estendera a sua tenda, da mão dos filhos de Hamor, pai de Siquém, por cem peças de dinheiro.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτήσατο τὴν μερίδα τοῦ ἀγροῦ οὗ ἔστησεν ἐκεῖ τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ παρὰ Εμμωρ πατρὸς Συχεμ ἑκατὸν ἀμνῶν

text_en: And raising an altar there, he invoked upon it the most mighty God of Israel .
text_la: Et erecto ibi altari, invocavit super illud fortissimum Deum Israël.
text_pt: E levantou ali um altar, e chamou-lhe: Deus, o Deus de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον καὶ ἐπεκαλέσατο τὸν θεὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And Dina the daughter of Lia went out to see the women of that country.
text_la: Egressa est autem Dina filia Liæ ut videret mulieres regionis illius.
text_pt: E saiu Diná, filha de Lia, que esta dera a Jacó, para ver as filhas da terra.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Δινα ἡ θυγάτηρ Λειας ἣν ἔτεκεν τῷ Ιακωβ καταμαθεῖν τὰς θυγατέρας τῶν ἐγχωρίων

text_en: And when Sichem the son of Hemor the Hevite, the prince of that land, saw her, he was in love with her: and took her away , and lay with her, ravishing the virgin .
text_la: Quam cum vidisset Sichem filius Hemor Hevæi, princeps terræ illius, adamavit eam : et rapuit, et dormivit cum illa, vi opprimens virginem.
text_pt: E Siquém, filho de Hamor, heveu, príncipe daquela terra, viu-a, e tomou-a, e deitou-se com ela, e humilhou-a.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν αὐτὴν Συχεμ ὁ υἱὸς Εμμωρ ὁ Χορραῖος ὁ ἄρχων τῆς γῆς καὶ λαβὼν αὐτὴν ἐκοιμήθη μετ' αὐτῆς καὶ ἐταπείνωσεν αὐτήν

text_en: And his soul was fast knit unto her; and whereas she was sad, he comforted her with sweet words.
text_la: Et conglutinata est anima ejus cum ea, tristemque delinivit blanditiis.
text_pt: E apegou-se a sua alma com Diná, filha de Jacó, e amou a moça e falou afetuosamente à moça.
text_el: καὶ προσέσχεν τῇ ψυχῇ Δινας τῆς θυγατρὸς Ιακωβ καὶ ἠγάπησεν τὴν παρθένον καὶ ἐλάλησεν κατὰ τὴν διάνοιαν τῆς παρθένου αὐτῇ

text_en: And going to Hemor his father, he said: Get me this damsel to wife.
text_la: Et pergens ad Hemor patrem suum : Accipe, inquit, mihi puellam hanc conjugem.
text_pt: Falou também Siquém a Hamor, seu pai, dizendo: Toma-me esta moça por mulher.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Συχεμ πρὸς Εμμωρ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ λέγων λαβέ μοι τὴν παιδίσκην ταύτην εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: But when Jacob had heard this, his sons being absent, and employed in feeding the cattle, he held his peace till they came back.
text_la: Quod cum audisset Jacob absentibus filiis, et in pastu pecorum occupatis, siluit donec redirent.
text_pt: Quando Jacó ouviu que Diná, sua filha, fora violada, estavam os seus filhos no campo com o gado; e calou-se Jacó até que viessem.
text_el: Ιακωβ δὲ ἤκουσεν ὅτι ἐμίανεν ὁ υἱὸς Εμμωρ Διναν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ ἦσαν μετὰ τῶν κτηνῶν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ παρεσιώπησεν δὲ Ιακωβ ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν αὐτούς

text_en: And when Hemor the father of Sichem had come out to speak to Jacob ,
text_la: Egresso autem Hemor patre Sichem ut loqueretur ad Jacob,
text_pt: E saiu Hamor, pai de Siquém, a Jacó, para falar com ele.
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Εμμωρ ὁ πατὴρ Συχεμ πρὸς Ιακωβ λαλῆσαι αὐτῷ

text_en: behold his sons came from the field: and hearing what had passed, they were exceeding angry , because he had done a foul thing in Israel , and committed an unlawful act , in ravishing Jacob's daughter.
text_la: ecce filii ejus veniebant de agro : auditoque quod acciderat, irati sunt valde, eo quod fœdam rem operatus esset in Israël et, violata filia Jacob, rem illicitam perpetrasset.
text_pt: E vieram os filhos de Jacó do campo, ouvindo isso, e entristeceram-se os homens, e iraram-se muito, porquanto Siquém cometera uma insensatez em Israel, deitando-se com a filha de Jacó; o que não se devia fazer assim.
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ιακωβ ἦλθον ἐκ τοῦ πεδίου ὡς δὲ ἤκουσαν κατενύχθησαν οἱ ἄνδρες καὶ λυπηρὸν ἦν αὐτοῖς σφόδρα ὅτι ἄσχημον ἐποίησεν ἐν Ισραηλ κοιμηθεὶς μετὰ τῆς θυγατρὸς Ιακωβ καὶ οὐχ οὕτως ἔσται

text_en: And Hemor spoke to them: The soul of my son Sichem has a longing for your daughter: give her him to wife:
text_la: Locutus est itaque Hemor ad eos : Sichem filii mei adhæsit anima filiæ vestræ : date eam illi uxorem:
text_pt: Então falou Hamor com eles, dizendo: A alma de Siquém, meu filho, está enamorada da vossa filha; dai-lha, peço-vos, por mulher;
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν Εμμωρ αὐτοῖς λέγων Συχεμ ὁ υἱός μου προείλατο τῇ ψυχῇ τὴν θυγατέρα ὑμῶν δότε οὖν αὐτὴν αὐτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: And let us contract marriages one with another: give us your daughters, and take you our daughters.
text_la: et jungamus vicissim connubia : filias vestras tradite nobis, et filias nostras accipite,
text_pt: E aparentai-vos conosco, dai-nos as vossas filhas, e tomai as nossas filhas para vós;
text_el: ἐπιγαμβρεύσασθε ἡμῖν τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν δότε ἡμῖν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ἡμῶν λάβετε τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν

text_en: And dwell with us: the land is at your command, till, trade, and possess it.
text_la: et habitate nobiscum : terra in potestate vestra est : exercete, negotiamini, et possidete eam.
text_pt: E habitareis conosco; e a terra estará diante de vós; habitai e negociai nela, e tomai possessão nela.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἡμῖν κατοικεῖτε καὶ ἡ γῆ ἰδοὺ πλατεῖα ἐναντίον ὑμῶν κατοικεῖτε καὶ ἐμπορεύεσθε ἐπ' αὐτῆς καὶ ἐγκτήσασθε ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: Sichem also said to her father and to her brethren: Let me find favour in your sight, and whatsoever you shall appoint I will give:
text_la: Sed et Sichem ad patrem et ad fratres ejus ait : Inveniam gratiam coram vobis : et quæcumque statueritis, dabo:
text_pt: E disse Siquém ao pai dela, e aos irmãos dela: Ache eu graça em vossos olhos, e darei o que me disserdes;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Συχεμ πρὸς τὸν πατέρα αὐτῆς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῆς εὕροιμι χάριν ἐναντίον ὑμῶν καὶ ὃ ἐὰν εἴπητε δώσομεν

text_en: Raise the dowry, and ask gifts, and I will gladly give what you shall demand: only give me this damsel to wife.
text_la: augete dotem, et munera postulate, et libenter tribuam quod petieritis : tantum date mihi puellam hanc uxorem.
text_pt: Aumentai muito sobre mim o dote e a dádiva e darei o que me disserdes; dai-me somente a moça por mulher.
text_el: πληθύνατε τὴν φερνὴν σφόδρα καὶ δώσω καθότι ἂν εἴπητέ μοι καὶ δώσετέ μοι τὴν παῖδα ταύτην εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: The sons of Jacob answered Sichem and his father deceitfully, being enraged at the deflowering of their sister:
text_la: Responderunt filii Jacob Sichem et patri ejus in dolo, sævientes ob stuprum sororis:
text_pt: Então responderam os filhos de Jacó a Siquém e a Hamor, seu pai, enganosamente, e falaram, porquanto havia violado a Diná, sua irmã.
text_el: ἀπεκρίθησαν δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιακωβ τῷ Συχεμ καὶ Εμμωρ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ μετὰ δόλου καὶ ἐλάλησαν αὐτοῖς ὅτι ἐμίαναν Διναν τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: We cannot do what you demand, nor give our sister to one that is uncircumcised; which with us is unlawful and abominable.
text_la: Non possumus facere quod petitis, nec dare sororem nostram homini incircumciso : quod illicitum et nefarium est apud nos.
text_pt: E disseram-lhe: Não podemos fazer isso, dar a nossa irmã a um homem não circuncidado; porque isso seria uma vergonha para nós;
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτοῖς Συμεων καὶ Λευι οἱ ἀδελφοὶ Δινας υἱοὶ δὲ Λειας οὐ δυνησόμεθα ποιῆσαι τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο δοῦναι τὴν ἀδελφὴν ἡμῶν ἀνθρώπῳ ὃς ἔχει ἀκροβυστίαν ἔστιν γὰρ ὄνειδος ἡμῖν

text_en: But in this we may be allied with you, if you will be like us, and all the male sex among you be circumcised :
text_la: Sed in hoc valebimus fœderari, si volueritis esse similes nostri, et circumcidatur in vobis omne masculini sexus;
text_pt: Nisso, porém, consentiremos a vós: se fordes como nós; que se circuncide todo o homem entre vós;
text_el: ἐν τούτῳ ὁμοιωθησόμεθα ὑμῖν καὶ κατοικήσομεν ἐν ὑμῖν ἐὰν γένησθε ὡς ἡμεῖς καὶ ὑμεῖς ἐν τῷ περιτμηθῆναι ὑμῶν πᾶν ἀρσενικόν

text_en: Then will we mutually give and take your daughters, and ours; and we will dwell with you, and will be one people:
text_la: tunc dabimus et accipiemus mutuo filias vestras ac nostras : et habitabimus vobiscum, erimusque unus populus.
text_pt: Então dar-vos-emos as nossas filhas, e tomaremos nós as vossas filhas, e habitaremos convosco, e seremos um povo;
text_el: καὶ δώσομεν τὰς θυγατέρας ἡμῶν ὑμῖν καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων ὑμῶν λημψόμεθα ἡμῖν γυναῖκας καὶ οἰκήσομεν παρ' ὑμῖν καὶ ἐσόμεθα ὡς γένος ἕν

text_en: But if you will not be circumcised , we will take our daughter and depart.
text_la: Si autem circumcidi nolueritis, tollemus filiam nostram, et recedemus.
text_pt: Mas se não nos ouvirdes, e não vos circuncidardes, tomaremos a nossa filha e ir-nos-emos.
text_el: ἐὰν δὲ μὴ εἰσακούσητε ἡμῶν τοῦ περιτέμνεσθαι λαβόντες τὰς θυγατέρας ἡμῶν ἀπελευσόμεθα

text_en: Their offer pleased Hemor, and Sichem, his son:
text_la: Placuit oblatio eorum Hemor, et Sichem filio ejus,
text_pt: E suas palavras foram boas aos olhos de Hamor, e aos olhos de Siquém, filho de Hamor.
text_el: καὶ ἤρεσαν οἱ λόγοι ἐναντίον Εμμωρ καὶ ἐναντίον Συχεμ τοῦ υἱοῦ Εμμωρ

text_en: And the young man made no delay, but forthwith fulfilled what was required: for he loved the damsel exceedingly, and he was the greatest man in all his father's house.
text_la: nec distulit adolescens quin statim quod petebatur expleret : amabat enim puellam valde, et ipse erat inclytus in omni domo patris sui.
text_pt: E não tardou o jovem em fazer isto; porque a filha de Jacó lhe contentava; e ele era o mais honrado de toda a casa de seu pai.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐχρόνισεν ὁ νεανίσκος τοῦ ποιῆσαι τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ἐνέκειτο γὰρ τῇ θυγατρὶ Ιακωβ αὐτὸς δὲ ἦν ἐνδοξότατος πάντων τῶν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And going into the gate of the city, they spoke to the people:
text_la: Ingressique portam urbis, locuti sunt ad populum:
text_pt: Veio, pois, Hamor e Siquém, seu filho, à porta da sua cidade, e falaram aos homens da sua cidade, dizendo:
text_el: ἦλθεν δὲ Εμμωρ καὶ Συχεμ ὁ υἱὸς αὐτοῦ πρὸς τὴν πύλην τῆς πόλεως αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλάλησαν πρὸς τοὺς ἄνδρας τῆς πόλεως αὐτῶν λέγοντες

text_en: These men are peaceable, and are willing to dwell with us: let them trade in the land, and till it, which being large and wide wants men to till it: we shall take their daughters for wives, and we will give them ours.
text_la: Viri isti pacifici sunt, et volunt habitare nobiscum : negotientur in terra, et exerceant eam, quæ spatiosa et lata cultoribus indiget : filias eorum accipiemus uxores, et nostras illis dabimus.
text_pt: Estes homens são pacíficos conosco; portanto habitarão nesta terra, e negociarão nela; eis que a terra é larga de espaço para eles; tomaremos nós as suas filhas por mulheres, e lhes daremos as nossas filhas.
text_el: οἱ ἄνθρωποι οὗτοι εἰρηνικοί εἰσιν μεθ' ἡμῶν οἰκείτωσαν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐμπορευέσθωσαν αὐτήν ἡ δὲ γῆ ἰδοὺ πλατεῖα ἐναντίον αὐτῶν τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν λημψόμεθα ἡμῖν γυναῖκας καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ἡμῶν δώσομεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: One thing there is for which so great a good is deferred: We must circumcise every male among us, following the manner of the nation.
text_la: Unum est quo differtur tantum bonum : si circumcidamus masculos nostros, ritum gentis imitantes.
text_pt: Nisto, porém, consentirão aqueles homens, em habitar conosco, para que sejamos um povo, se todo o homem entre nós se circuncidar, como eles são circuncidados.
text_el: μόνον ἐν τούτῳ ὁμοιωθήσονται ἡμῖν οἱ ἄνθρωποι τοῦ κατοικεῖν μεθ' ἡμῶν ὥστε εἶναι λαὸν ἕνα ἐν τῷ περιτέμνεσθαι ἡμῶν πᾶν ἀρσενικόν καθὰ καὶ αὐτοὶ περιτέτμηνται

text_en: And their substance , and cattle, and all that they possess, shall be ours; only in this let us condescend, and by dwelling together, we shall make one people.
text_la: Et substantia eorum, et pecora, et cuncta quæ possident, nostra erunt : tantum in hoc acquiescamus, et habitantes simul, unum efficiemus populum.
text_pt: E seu gado, as suas possessões, e todos os seus animais não serão nossos? Consintamos somente com eles e habitarão conosco.
text_el: καὶ τὰ κτήνη αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ τετράποδα οὐχ ἡμῶν ἔσται μόνον ἐν τούτῳ ὁμοιωθῶμεν αὐτοῖς καὶ οἰκήσουσιν μεθ' ἡμῶν

text_en: And they all agreed, and circumcised all the males.
text_la: Assensique sunt omnes, circumcisis cunctis maribus.
text_pt: E deram ouvidos a Hamor e a Siquém, seu filho, todos os que saíam da porta da cidade; e foi circuncidado todo o homem, de todos os que saíam pela porta da sua cidade.
text_el: καὶ εἰσήκουσαν Εμμωρ καὶ Συχεμ τοῦ υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ πάντες οἱ ἐκπορευόμενοι τὴν πύλην τῆς πόλεως αὐτῶν καὶ περιετέμοντο τὴν σάρκα τῆς ἀκροβυστίας αὐτῶν πᾶς ἄρσην

text_en: And behold the third day, when the pain of the wound was greatest: two of the sons of Jacob , Simeon and Levi , the brothers of Dina, taking their swords, entered boldly into the city and slew all the men .
text_la: Et ecce, die tertio, quando gravissimus vulnerum dolor est : arreptis duo filii Jacob, Simeon et Levi fratres Dinæ, gladiis, ingressi sunt urbem confidenter : interfectisque omnibus masculis,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ao terceiro dia, quando estavam com a mais violenta dor, os dois filhos de Jacó, Simeão e Levi, irmãos de Diná, tomaram cada um a sua espada, e entraram afoitamente na cidade, e mataram todos os homens.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ ὅτε ἦσαν ἐν τῷ πόνῳ ἔλαβον οἱ δύο υἱοὶ Ιακωβ Συμεων καὶ Λευι οἱ ἀδελφοὶ Δινας ἕκαστος τὴν μάχαιραν αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὴν πόλιν ἀσφαλῶς καὶ ἀπέκτειναν πᾶν ἀρσενικόν

text_en: And they killed also Hemor and Sichem, and took away their sister Dina out of Sichem's house.
text_la: Hemor et Sichem pariter necaverunt, tollentes Dinam de domo Sichem sororem suam.
text_pt: Mataram também ao fio da espada a Hamor, e a seu filho Siquém; e tomaram a Diná da casa de Siquém, e saíram.
text_el: τόν τε Εμμωρ καὶ Συχεμ τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἀπέκτειναν ἐν στόματι μαχαίρας καὶ ἔλαβον τὴν Διναν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ Συχεμ καὶ ἐξῆλθον

text_en: And when they had gone out, the other sons of Jacob came upon the slain; and plundered the city in revenge of the rape.
text_la: Quibus egressis, irruerunt super occisos ceteri filii Jacob : et depopulati sunt urbem in ultionem stupri.
text_pt: Vieram os filhos de Jacó aos mortos e saquearam a cidade; porquanto violaram a sua irmã.
text_el: οἱ δὲ υἱοὶ Ιακωβ εἰσῆλθον ἐπὶ τοὺς τραυματίας καὶ διήρπασαν τὴν πόλιν ἐν ᾗ ἐμίαναν Διναν τὴν ἀδελφὴν αὐτῶν

text_en: And they took their sheep, and their herds, and their asses, wasting all they had in their houses and in their fields.
text_la: Oves eorum, et armenta, et asinos, cunctaque vastantes quæ in domibus et in agris erant,
text_pt: As suas ovelhas, e as suas vacas, e os seus jumentos, e o que havia na cidade e no campo, tomaram.
text_el: καὶ τὰ πρόβατα αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς βόας αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς ὄνους αὐτῶν ὅσα τε ἦν ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ ὅσα ἦν ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ ἔλαβον

text_en: And their children and wives they took captive .
text_la: parvulos quoque eorum et uxores duxerunt captivas.
text_pt: E todos os seus bens, e todos os seus meninos, e as suas mulheres, levaram presos, e saquearam tudo o que havia em casa.
text_el: καὶ πάντα τὰ σώματα αὐτῶν καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν ἀποσκευὴν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν ᾐχμαλώτευσαν καὶ διήρπασαν ὅσα τε ἦν ἐν τῇ πόλει καὶ ὅσα ἦν ἐν ταῖς οἰκίαις

text_en: And when they had boldly perpetrated these things, Jacob said to Simeon and Levi : You have troubled me, and made me hateful to the Chanaanites and Pherezites, the inhabitants of this land. We are few: they will gather themselves together and kill me; and both I, and my house shall be destroyed.
text_la: Quibus patratis audacter, Jacob dixit ad Simeon et Levi : Turbastis me, et odiosum fecistis me Chananæis, et Pherezæis habitatoribus terræ hujus : nos pauci sumus; illi congregati percutient me, et delebor ego, et domus mea.
text_pt: Então disse Jacó a Simeão e a Levi: Tendes-me turbado, fazendo-me cheirar mal entre os moradores desta terra, entre os cananeus e perizeus; tendo eu pouco povo em número, eles ajuntar-se-ão, e serei destruído, eu e minha casa.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ Συμεων καὶ Λευι μισητόν με πεποιήκατε ὥστε πονηρόν με εἶναι πᾶσιν τοῖς κατοικοῦσιν τὴν γῆν ἔν τε τοῖς Χαναναίοις καὶ τοῖς Φερεζαίοις ἐγὼ δὲ ὀλιγοστός εἰμι ἐν ἀριθμῷ καὶ συναχθέντες ἐπ' ἐμὲ συγκόψουσίν με καὶ ἐκτριβήσομαι ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ οἶκός μου

text_en: They answered: Should they abuse our sister as a strumpet?
text_la: Responderunt : Numquid ut scorto abuti debuere sorore nostra?
text_pt: E eles disseram: Devia ele tratar a nossa irmã como a uma prostituta?
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν ἀλλ' ὡσεὶ πόρνῃ χρήσωνται τῇ ἀδελφῇ ἡμῶν

text_en: In the mean time God said to Jacob : Arise and go up to Bethel , and dwell there, and make there an altar to God , who appeared to you when you fled from Esau , your brother.
text_la: Interea locutus est Deus ad Jacob : Surge, et ascende Bethel, et habita ibi, facque altare Deo qui apparuit tibi quando fugiebas Esau fratrem tuum.
text_pt: Depois disse Deus a Jacó: Levanta-te, sobe a Betel, e habita ali; e faze ali um altar ao Deus que te apareceu, quando fugiste da face de Esaú teu irmão.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς πρὸς Ιακωβ ἀναστὰς ἀνάβηθι εἰς τὸν τόπον Βαιθηλ καὶ οἴκει ἐκεῖ καὶ ποίησον ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον τῷ θεῷ τῷ ὀφθέντι σοι ἐν τῷ ἀποδιδράσκειν σε ἀπὸ προσώπου Ησαυ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου

text_en: And Jacob having called together all his household, said: Cast away the strange gods that are among you, and be cleansed , and change your garments.
text_la: Jacob vero convocata omni domo sua, ait : Abjicite deos alienos qui in medio vestri sunt, et mundamini, ac mutate vestimenta vestra.
text_pt: Então disse Jacó à sua família, e a todos os que com ele estavam: Tirai os deuses estranhos, que há no meio de vós, e purificai-vos, e mudai as vossas vestes.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιακωβ τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς μετ' αὐτοῦ ἄρατε τοὺς θεοὺς τοὺς ἀλλοτρίους τοὺς μεθ' ὑμῶν ἐκ μέσου ὑμῶν καὶ καθαρίσασθε καὶ ἀλλάξατε τὰς στολὰς ὑμῶν

text_en: Arise, and let us go up to Bethel , that we may make there an altar to God ; who heard me in the day of my affliction, and accompanied me in my journey.
text_la: Surgite, et ascendamus in Bethel, ut faciamus ibi altare Deo : qui exaudivit me in die tribulationis meæ, et socius fuit itineris mei.
text_pt: E levantemo-nos, e subamos a Betel; e ali farei um altar ao Deus que me respondeu no dia da minha angústia, e que foi comigo no caminho que tenho andado.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστάντες ἀναβῶμεν εἰς Βαιθηλ καὶ ποιήσωμεν ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον τῷ θεῷ τῷ ἐπακούσαντί μοι ἐν ἡμέρᾳ θλίψεως ὃς ἦν μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ διέσωσέν με ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἐπορεύθην

text_en: So they gave him all the strange gods they had, and the earrings which were in their ears: and he buried them under the turpentine tree, that is behind the city of Sichem .
text_la: Dederunt ergo ei omnes deos alienos quos habebant, et inaures quæ erant in auribus eorum : at ille infodit ea subter terebinthum, quæ est post urbem Sichem.
text_pt: Então deram a Jacó todos os deuses estranhos, que tinham em suas mãos, e as arrecadas que estavam em suas orelhas; e Jacó os escondeu debaixo do carvalho que está junto a Siquém.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν τῷ Ιακωβ τοὺς θεοὺς τοὺς ἀλλοτρίους οἳ ἦσαν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ ἐνώτια τὰ ἐν τοῖς ὠσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ κατέκρυψεν αὐτὰ Ιακωβ ὑπὸ τὴν τερέμινθον τὴν ἐν Σικιμοις καὶ ἀπώλεσεν αὐτὰ ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: And when they were departed, the terror of God fell upon all the cities round about, and they dared not pursue after them as they went away.
text_la: Cumque profecti essent, terror Dei invasit omnes per circuitum civitates, et non sunt ausi persequi recedentes.
text_pt: E partiram; e o terror de Deus foi sobre as cidades que estavam ao redor deles, e não seguiram após os filhos de Jacó.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆρεν Ισραηλ ἐκ Σικιμων καὶ ἐγένετο φόβος θεοῦ ἐπὶ τὰς πόλεις τὰς κύκλῳ αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ κατεδίωξαν ὀπίσω τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ

text_en: And Jacob came to Luza, which is in the land of Chanaan , surnamed Bethel : he and all the people that were with him.
text_la: Venit igitur Jacob Luzam, quæ est in terra Chanaan, cognomento Bethel : ipse et omnis populus cum eo.
text_pt: Assim chegou Jacó a Luz, que está na terra de Canaã (esta é Betel), ele e todo o povo que com ele havia.
text_el: ἦλθεν δὲ Ιακωβ εἰς Λουζα ἥ ἐστιν ἐν γῇ Χανααν ἥ ἐστιν Βαιθηλ αὐτὸς καὶ πᾶς ὁ λαός ὃς ἦν μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he built there an altar , and called the name of that place, The house of God : for there God appeared to him when he fled from his brother.
text_la: Ædificavitque ibi altare, et appellavit nomen loci illius, Domus Dei : ibi enim apparuit ei Deus cum fugeret fratrem suum.
text_pt: E edificou ali um altar, e chamou aquele lugar El-Betel; porquanto Deus ali se lhe tinha manifestado, quando fugia da face de seu irmão.
text_el: καὶ ᾠκοδόμησεν ἐκεῖ θυσιαστήριον καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου Βαιθηλ ἐκεῖ γὰρ ἐπεφάνη αὐτῷ ὁ θεὸς ἐν τῷ ἀποδιδράσκειν αὐτὸν ἀπὸ προσώπου Ησαυ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: At the same time Debora, the nurse of Rebecca, died, and was buried at the foot of Bethel , under an oak, and the name of that place was called, The oak of weeping .
text_la: Eodem tempore mortua est Debora nutrix Rebeccæ, et sepulta est ad radices Bethel subter quercum : vocatumque est nomen loci illius, Quercus fletus.
text_pt: E morreu Débora, a ama de Rebeca, e foi sepultada ao pé de Betel, debaixo do carvalho cujo nome chamou Alom-Bacute.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Δεββωρα ἡ τροφὸς Ρεβεκκας κατώτερον Βαιθηλ ὑπὸ τὴν βάλανον καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ιακωβ τὸ ὄνομα αὐτῆς Βάλανος πένθους

text_en: And God appeared again to Jacob , after he returned from Mesopotamia of Syria , and he blessed him,
text_la: Apparuit autem iterum Deus Jacob postquam reversus est de Mesopotamia Syriæ, benedixitque ei
text_pt: E apareceu Deus outra vez a Jacó, vindo de Padã-Arã, e abençoou-o.
text_el: ὤφθη δὲ ὁ θεὸς Ιακωβ ἔτι ἐν Λουζα ὅτε παρεγένετο ἐκ Μεσοποταμίας τῆς Συρίας καὶ ηὐλόγησεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεός

text_en: saying: You shall not be called any more Jacob, but Israel shall be your name . And he called him Israel.
text_la: dicens : Non vocaberis ultra Jacob, sed Israël erit nomen tuum. Et appellavit eum Israël,
text_pt: E disse-lhe Deus: O teu nome é Jacó; não te chamarás mais Jacó, mas Israel será o teu nome. E chamou-lhe Israel.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὁ θεός τὸ ὄνομά σου Ιακωβ οὐ κληθήσεται ἔτι Ιακωβ ἀλλ' Ισραηλ ἔσται τὸ ὄνομά σου

text_en: And said to him: I am God almighty , increase and be multiplied. Nations and peoples of nations shall be from you, and kings shall come out of your loins.
text_la: dixitque ei : Ego Deus omnipotens : cresce, et multiplicare : gentes et populi nationum ex te erunt, reges de lumbis tuis egredientur,
text_pt: Disse-lhe mais Deus: Eu sou o Deus Todo-Poderoso; frutifica e multiplica-te; uma nação, sim, uma multidão de nações sairá de ti, e reis procederão dos teus lombos;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ θεός ἐγὼ ὁ θεός σου αὐξάνου καὶ πληθύνου ἔθνη καὶ συναγωγαὶ ἐθνῶν ἔσονται ἐκ σοῦ καὶ βασιλεῖς ἐκ τῆς ὀσφύος σου ἐξελεύσονται

text_en: And the land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac , I will give to you, and to your seed after you.
text_la: terramque quam dedi Abraham et Isaac, dabo tibi et semini tuo post te.
text_pt: E te darei a ti a terra que tenho dado a Abraão e a Isaque, e à tua descendência depois de ti darei a terra.
text_el: καὶ τὴν γῆν ἣν δέδωκα Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ σοὶ δέδωκα αὐτήν σοὶ ἔσται καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου μετὰ σὲ δώσω τὴν γῆν ταύτην

text_en: And he departed from him.
text_la: Et recessit ab eo.
text_pt: E Deus subiu dele, do lugar onde falara com ele.
text_el: ἀνέβη δὲ ὁ θεὸς ἀπ' αὐτοῦ ἐκ τοῦ τόπου οὗ ἐλάλησεν μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: But he set up a monument of stone, in the place where God had spoken to him: pouring drink offerings upon it, and pouring oil thereon:
text_la: Ille vero erexit titulum lapideum in loco quo locutus fuerat ei Deus : libans super eum libamina, et effundens oleum:
text_pt: E Jacó pôs uma coluna no lugar onde falara com ele, uma coluna de pedra; e derramou sobre ela uma libação, e deitou sobre ela azeite.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν Ιακωβ στήλην ἐν τῷ τόπῳ ᾧ ἐλάλησεν μετ' αὐτοῦ στήλην λιθίνην καὶ ἔσπεισεν ἐπ' αὐτὴν σπονδὴν καὶ ἐπέχεεν ἐπ' αὐτὴν ἔλαιον

text_en: And calling the name of that place Bethel .
text_la: vocansque nomen loci illius Bethel.
text_pt: E chamou Jacó aquele lugar, onde Deus falara com ele, Betel.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Ιακωβ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ τόπου ἐν ᾧ ἐλάλησεν μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ ὁ θεός Βαιθηλ

text_en: And going forth from thence, he came in the spring time to the land which leads to Ephrata : wherein when Rachel was in travail,
text_la: Egressus autem inde, venit verno tempore ad terram quæ ducit Ephratam : in qua cum parturiret Rachel,
text_pt: E partiram de Betel; e havia ainda um pequeno espaço de terra para chegar a Efrata, e deu à luz Raquel, e ela teve trabalho em seu parto.
text_el: ἀπάρας δὲ Ιακωβ ἐκ Βαιθηλ ἔπηξεν τὴν σκηνὴν αὐτοῦ ἐπέκεινα τοῦ πύργου Γαδερ ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἤγγισεν Χαβραθα εἰς γῆν ἐλθεῖν Εφραθα ἔτεκεν Ραχηλ καὶ ἐδυστόκησεν ἐν τῷ τοκετῷ

text_en: by reason of her hard labour, she began to be in danger, and the midwife said to her: Fear not, for you shall have this son also.
text_la: ob difficultatem partus periclitari cœpit. Dixitque ei obstetrix : Noli timere, quia et hunc habebis filium.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, tendo ela trabalho em seu parto, lhe disse a parteira: Não temas, porque também este filho terás.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ σκληρῶς αὐτὴν τίκτειν εἶπεν αὐτῇ ἡ μαῖα θάρσει καὶ γὰρ οὗτός σοί ἐστιν υἱός

text_en: And when her soul was departing for pain, and death was now at hand, she called the name of her son Benoni, that is, the son of my pain: but his father called him Benjamin , that is, the son of the right hand.
text_la: Egrediente autem anima præ dolore, et imminente jam morte, vocavit nomen filii sui Benomi, id est, Filius doloris mei : pater vero appellavit eum Benjamin, id est, Filius dextræ.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, saindo-se-lhe a alma (porque morreu), chamou-lhe Benoni; mas seu pai chamou-lhe Benjamim.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ ἀφιέναι αὐτὴν τὴν ψυχήν ἀπέθνῃσκεν γάρ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Υἱὸς ὀδύνης μου ὁ δὲ πατὴρ ἐκάλεσεν αὐτὸν Βενιαμιν

text_en: So Rachel died, and was buried in the highway that leads to Ephrata , this is Bethlehem .
text_la: Mortua est ergo Rachel, et sepulta est in via quæ ducit Ephratam, hæc est Bethlehem.
text_pt: Assim morreu Raquel, e foi sepultada no caminho de Efrata; que é Belém.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Ραχηλ καὶ ἐτάφη ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ Εφραθα αὕτη ἐστὶν Βηθλεεμ

text_en: And Jacob erected a pillar over her sepulchre: this is the pillar of Rachel's monument, to this day.
text_la: Erexitque Jacob titulum super sepulchrum ejus : hic est titulus monumenti Rachel, usque in præsentem diem.
text_pt: E Jacó pôs uma coluna sobre a sua sepultura; esta é a coluna da sepultura de Raquel até o dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησεν Ιακωβ στήλην ἐπὶ τοῦ μνημείου αὐτῆς αὕτη ἐστὶν στήλη μνημείου Ραχηλ ἕως τῆς σήμερον ἡμέρας

text_en: Departing thence, he pitched his tent beyond the Flock tower.
text_la: Egressus inde, fixit tabernaculum trans Turrem gregis.
text_pt: Então partiu Israel, e estendeu a sua tenda além de Migdal Eder.

text_en: And when he dwelt in that country, Ruben went, and slept with Bala the concubine of his father: which he was not ignorant of. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.
text_la: Cumque habitaret in illa regione, abiit Ruben, et dormivit cum Bala concubina patris sui : quod illum minime latuit. Erant autem filii Jacob duodecim.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, habitando Israel naquela terra, foi Rúben e deitou-se com Bila, concubina de seu pai; e Israel o soube. E eram doze os filhos de Jacó.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα κατῴκησεν Ισραηλ ἐν τῇ γῇ ἐκείνῃ ἐπορεύθη Ρουβην καὶ ἐκοιμήθη μετὰ Βαλλας τῆς παλλακῆς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤκουσεν Ισραηλ καὶ πονηρὸν ἐφάνη ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ἦσαν δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Ιακωβ δώδεκα

text_en: The sons of Lia: Ruben the first born , and Simeon , and Levi , and Juda , and Issachar , and Zabulon .
text_la: Filii Liæ : primogenitus Ruben, et Simeon, et Levi, et Judas, et Issachar, et Zabulon.
text_pt: Os filhos de Lia: Rúben, o primogênito de Jacó, depois Simeão e Levi, e Judá, e Issacar e Zebulom;
text_el: υἱοὶ Λειας πρωτότοκος Ιακωβ Ρουβην Συμεων Λευι Ιουδας Ισσαχαρ Ζαβουλων

text_en: The sons of Rachel : Joseph and Benjamin .
text_la: Filii Rachel : Joseph et Benjamin.
text_pt: Os filhos de Raquel: José e Benjamim;
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ραχηλ Ιωσηφ καὶ Βενιαμιν

text_en: The sons of Bala, Rachel's handmaid: Dan and Nephthali .
text_la: Filii Balæ ancillæ Rachelis: Dan et Nephthali.
text_pt: E os filhos de Bila, serva de Raquel: Dã e Naftali;
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Βαλλας παιδίσκης Ραχηλ Δαν καὶ Νεφθαλι

text_en: The sons of Zelpha, Lia's handmaid: Gad and Aser : these are the sons of Jacob , that were born to him in Mesopotamia of Syria .
text_la: Filii Zelphæ ancillæ Liæ : Gad et Aser : hi sunt filii Jacob, qui nati sunt ei in Mesopotamia Syriæ.
text_pt: E os filhos de Zilpa, serva de Lia: Gade e Aser. Estes são os filhos de Jacó, que lhe nasceram em Padã-Arã.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ζελφας παιδίσκης Λειας Γαδ καὶ Ασηρ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ιακωβ οἳ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ ἐν Μεσοποταμίᾳ τῆς Συρίας

text_en: And he came to Isaac his father in Mambre, the city of Arbee, this is Hebron : wherein Abraham and Isaac sojourned.
text_la: Venit etiam ad Isaac patrem suum in Mambre, civitatem Arbee, hæc est Hebron, in qua peregrinatus est Abraham et Isaac.
text_pt: E Jacó veio a seu pai Isaque, a Manre, a Quiriate-Arba (que é Hebrom), onde peregrinaram Abraão e Isaque.
text_el: ἦλθεν δὲ Ιακωβ πρὸς Ισαακ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ εἰς Μαμβρη εἰς πόλιν τοῦ πεδίου αὕτη ἐστὶν Χεβρων ἐν γῇ Χανααν οὗ παρῴκησεν Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ

text_en: And the days of Isaac were a hundred and eighty years.
text_la: Et completi sunt dies Isaac centum octoginta annorum.
text_pt: E foram os dias de Isaque cento e oitenta anos.
text_el: ἐγένοντο δὲ αἱ ἡμέραι Ισαακ ἃς ἔζησεν ἔτη ἑκατὸν ὀγδοήκοντα

text_en: And being spent with age he died, and was gathered to his people , being old and full of days: and his sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
text_la: Consumptusque ætate mortuus est : et appositus est populo suo senex et plenus dierum : et sepelierunt eum Esau et Jacob filii sui.
text_pt: E Isaque expirou, e morreu, e foi recolhido ao seu povo, velho e farto de dias; e Esaú e Jacó, seus filhos, o sepultaram.
text_el: καὶ ἐκλιπὼν ἀπέθανεν καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸ γένος αὐτοῦ πρεσβύτερος καὶ πλήρης ἡμερῶν καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν Ησαυ καὶ Ιακωβ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And these are the generations of Esau , the same is Edom.
text_la: Hæ sunt autem generationes Esau, ipse est Edom.
text_pt: E estas são as gerações de Esaú (que é Edom).
text_el: αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις Ησαυ αὐτός ἐστιν Εδωμ

text_en: Esau took wives of the daughters of Chanaan : Ada the daughter of Elon the Hethite , and Oolibama the daughter of Ana, the daughter of Sebeon the Hevite:
text_la: Esau accepit uxores de filiabus Chanaan : Ada filiam Elon Hethæi, et Oolibama filiam Anæ filiæ Sebeon Hevæi:
text_pt: Esaú tomou suas mulheres das filhas de Canaã; a Ada, filha de Elom, heteu, e a Aolibama, filha de Aná, filho de Zibeão, heveu.
text_el: Ησαυ δὲ ἔλαβεν γυναῖκας ἑαυτῷ ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων τῶν Χαναναίων τὴν Αδα θυγατέρα Αιλων τοῦ Χετταίου καὶ τὴν Ελιβεμα θυγατέρα Ανα τοῦ υἱοῦ Σεβεγων τοῦ Ευαίου

text_en: And Basemath, the daughter of Ismael , sister of Nabajoth.
text_la: Basemath quoque filiam Ismaël sororem Nabaioth.
text_pt: E a Basemate, filha de Ismael, irmã de Nebaiote.
text_el: καὶ τὴν Βασεμμαθ θυγατέρα Ισμαηλ ἀδελφὴν Ναβαιωθ

text_en: And Ada bore Eliphaz: Basemath bore Rahuel.
text_la: Peperit autem Ada Eliphaz : Basemath genuit Rahuel:
text_pt: E Ada teve de Esaú a Elifaz; e Basemate teve a Reuel;
text_el: ἔτεκεν δὲ Αδα τῷ Ησαυ τὸν Ελιφας καὶ Βασεμμαθ ἔτεκεν τὸν Ραγουηλ

text_en: Oolibama bore Jehus, and Ihelon, and Core. These are the sons of Esau , that were born to him in the land of Chanaan .
text_la: Oolibama genuit Jehus et Ihelon et Core. Hi filii Esau qui nati sunt ei in terra Chanaan.
text_pt: E Aolibama deu à luz a Jeús, Jalão e Coré; estes são os filhos de Esaú, que lhe nasceram na terra de Canaã.
text_el: καὶ Ελιβεμα ἔτεκεν τὸν Ιεους καὶ τὸν Ιεγλομ καὶ τὸν Κορε οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ησαυ οἳ ἐγένοντο αὐτῷ ἐν γῇ Χανααν

text_en: And Esau took his wives, and his sons and daughters, and every soul of his house, and his substance , and cattle, and all that he was able to acquire in the land of Chanaan : and went into another country, and departed from his brother Jacob .
text_la: Tulit autem Esau uxores suas et filios et filias, et omnem animam domus suæ, et substantiam, et pecora, et cuncta quæ habere poterat in terra Chanaan : et abiit in alteram regionem, recessitque a fratre suo Jacob.
text_pt: E Esaú tomou suas mulheres, e seus filhos, e suas filhas, e todas as almas de sua casa, e seu gado, e todos os seus animais, e todos os seus bens, que havia adquirido na terra de Canaã; e foi para outra terra apartando-se de Jacó, seu irmão;
text_el: ἔλαβεν δὲ Ησαυ τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτοῦ καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας καὶ πάντα τὰ σώματα τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ πάντα τὰ κτήνη καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐκτήσατο καὶ ὅσα περιεποιήσατο ἐν γῇ Χανααν καὶ ἐπορεύθη ἐκ γῆς Χανααν ἀπὸ προσώπου Ιακωβ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: For they were exceeding rich , and could not dwell together: neither was the land in which they sojourned able to bear them, for the multitude of their flocks.
text_la: Divites enim erant valde, et simul habitare non poterant : nec sustinebat eos terra peregrinationis eorum præ multitudine gregum.
text_pt: Porque os bens deles eram muitos para habitarem juntos; e a terra de suas peregrinações não os podia sustentar por causa do seu gado.
text_el: ἦν γὰρ αὐτῶν τὰ ὑπάρχοντα πολλὰ τοῦ οἰκεῖν ἅμα καὶ οὐκ ἐδύνατο ἡ γῆ τῆς παροικήσεως αὐτῶν φέρειν αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτῶν

text_en: And Esau dwelt in mount Seir: he is Edom.
text_la: Habitavitque Esau in monte Seir, ipse est Edom.
text_pt: Portanto Esaú habitou na montanha de Seir; Esaú é Edom.
text_el: ᾤκησεν δὲ Ησαυ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σηιρ Ησαυ αὐτός ἐστιν Εδωμ

text_en: And these are the generations of Esau , the father of Edom , in mount Seir.
text_la: Hæ autem sunt generationes Esau patris Edom in monte Seir,
text_pt: Estas, pois, são as gerações de Esaú, pai dos edomeus, na montanha de Seir.
text_el: αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις Ησαυ πατρὸς Εδωμ ἐν τῷ ὄρει Σηιρ

text_en: And these the names of his sons: Eliphaz the son of Ada, the wife of Esau : and Rahuel, the son of Basemath, his wife.
text_la: et hæc nomina filiorum ejus : Eliphaz filius Ada uxoris Esau : Rahuel quoque filius Basemath uxoris ejus.
text_pt: Estes são os nomes dos filhos de Esaú: Elifaz, filho de Ada, mulher de Esaú; Reuel, filho de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
text_el: καὶ ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ησαυ Ελιφας υἱὸς Αδας γυναικὸς Ησαυ καὶ Ραγουηλ υἱὸς Βασεμμαθ γυναικὸς Ησαυ

text_en: And Eliphaz had sons: Theman, Omar, Sepho, and Gatham and Cenez.
text_la: Fueruntque Eliphaz filii : Theman, Omar, Sepho, et Gatham, et Cenez.
text_pt: E os filhos de Elifaz foram: Temã, Omar, Zefô, Gaetã e Quenaz.
text_el: ἐγένοντο δὲ υἱοὶ Ελιφας Θαιμαν Ωμαρ Σωφαρ Γοθομ καὶ Κενεζ

text_en: And Thamna was the concubine of Eliphaz, the son of Esau : and she bore him Amalech. These are the sons of Ada, the wife of Esau .
text_la: Erat autem Thamna concubina Eliphaz filii Esau : quæ peperit ei Amalech. Hi sunt filii Ada uxoris Esau.
text_pt: E Timna era concubina de Elifaz, filho de Esaú, e teve de Elifaz a Amaleque. Estes são os filhos de Ada, mulher de Esaú.
text_el: Θαμνα δὲ ἦν παλλακὴ Ελιφας τοῦ υἱοῦ Ησαυ καὶ ἔτεκεν τῷ Ελιφας τὸν Αμαληκ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Αδας γυναικὸς Ησαυ

text_en: And the sons of Rahuel were Nahath and Zara, Samma and Meza. These were the sons of Basemath, the wife of Esau .
text_la: Filii autem Rahuel : Nahath et Zara, Samma et Meza : hi filii Basemath uxoris Esau.
text_pt: E estes foram os filhos de Reuel: Naate, Zerá, Samá e Mizá; estes foram os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ραγουηλ Ναχοθ Ζαρε Σομε καὶ Μοζε οὗτοι ἦσαν υἱοὶ Βασεμμαθ γυναικὸς Ησαυ

text_en: And these were the sons of Oolibama, the daughter of Ana, the daughter of Sebeon, the wife of Esau , whom she bore to him, Jehus, and Ihelon, and Core.
text_la: Isti quoque erant filii Oolibama filiæ Anæ filiæ Sebeon, uxoris Esau, quos genuit ei, Jehus et Ihelon et Core.
text_pt: E estes foram os filhos de Aolibama, mulher de Esaú, filha de Aná, filho de Zibeão; ela teve de Esaú: Jeús, Jalão e Coré.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ ἦσαν υἱοὶ Ελιβεμας θυγατρὸς Ανα τοῦ υἱοῦ Σεβεγων γυναικὸς Ησαυ ἔτεκεν δὲ τῷ Ησαυ τὸν Ιεους καὶ τὸν Ιεγλομ καὶ τὸν Κορε

text_en: These were dukes of the sons of Esau : the sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau : duke Theman, duke Omar, duke Sepho, duke Cenez,
text_la: Hi duces filiorum Esau : filii Eliphaz primogeniti Esau : dux Theman, dux Omra, dux Sepho, dux Cenez,
text_pt: Estes são os príncipes dos filhos de Esaú: os filhos de Elifaz, o primogênito de Esaú, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Omar, o príncipe Zefô, o príncipe Quenaz.
text_el: οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες υἱοὶ Ησαυ υἱοὶ Ελιφας πρωτοτόκου Ησαυ ἡγεμὼν Θαιμαν ἡγεμὼν Ωμαρ ἡγεμὼν Σωφαρ ἡγεμὼν Κενεζ

text_en: duke Core, duke Gatham, duke Amalech: these are the sons of Eliphaz, in the land of Edom , and these the sons of Ada.
text_la: dux Core, dux Gathan, dux Amalech. Hi filii Eliphaz in terra Edom, et hi filii Ada.
text_pt: O príncipe Coré, o príncipe Gaetã, o príncipe Amaleque; estes são os príncipes de Elifaz na terra de Edom; estes são os filhos de Ada.
text_el: ἡγεμὼν Κορε ἡγεμὼν Γοθομ ἡγεμὼν Αμαληκ οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Ελιφας ἐν γῇ Ιδουμαίᾳ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Αδας

text_en: And these were the sons of Rahuel, the son of Esau : duke Nahath, duke Zara, duke Samma, duke Meza. And these are the dukes of Rahuel, in the land of Edom : these the sons of Basemath, the wife of Esau .
text_la: Hi quoque filii Rahuel filii Esau : dux Nahath, dux Zara, dux Samma, dux Meza : hi autem duces Rahuel in terra Edom : isti filii Basemath uxoris Esau.
text_pt: E estes são os filhos de Reuel, filhos de Esaú: o príncipe Naate, o príncipe Zerá, o príncipe Samá, o príncipe Mizá; estes são os príncipes de Reuel, na terra de Edom; estes são os filhos de Basemate, mulher de Esaú.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ραγουηλ υἱοῦ Ησαυ ἡγεμὼν Ναχοθ ἡγεμὼν Ζαρε ἡγεμὼν Σομε ἡγεμὼν Μοζε οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Ραγουηλ ἐν γῇ Εδωμ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βασεμμαθ γυναικὸς Ησαυ

text_en: And these the sons of Oolibama, the wife of Esau : duke Jehus, duke Ihelon, duke Core. These are the dukes of Oolibama, the daughter of Ana, and wife of Esau .
text_la: Hi autem filii Oolibama uxoris Esau : dux Jehus, dux Ihelon, dux Core : hi duces Oolibama filiæ Anæ uxoris Esau.
text_pt: E estes são os filhos de Aolibama, mulher de Esaú: o príncipe Jeús, o príncipe Jalão, o príncipe Coré; estes são os príncipes de Aolibama, filha de Aná, mulher de Esaú.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ελιβεμας γυναικὸς Ησαυ ἡγεμὼν Ιεους ἡγεμὼν Ιεγλομ ἡγεμὼν Κορε οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Ελιβεμας

text_en: These are the sons of Esau , and these the dukes of them: the same is Edom.
text_la: Isti sunt filii Esau, et hi duces eorum : ipse est Edom.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Esaú, e estes são seus príncipes: Ele é Edom.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ησαυ καὶ οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες αὐτῶν οὗτοί εἰσιν υἱοὶ Εδωμ

text_en: These are the sons of Seir, the Horrite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, and Sobal, and Sebeon, and Ana,
text_la: Isti sunt filii Seir Horræi, habitatores terræ : Lotan, et Sobal, et Sebeon, et Ana,
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Seir, horeu, moradores daquela terra: Lotã, Sobal, Zibeão e Aná,
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Σηιρ τοῦ Χορραίου τοῦ κατοικοῦντος τὴν γῆν Λωταν Σωβαλ Σεβεγων Ανα

text_en: and Dison, and Eser, and Disan. These are dukes of the Horrites, the sons of Seir, in the land of Edom .
text_la: et Dison, et Eser, et Disan : hi duces Horræi, filii Seir in terra Edom.
text_pt: Disom, Eser e Disã; estes são os príncipes dos horeus, filhos de Seir, na terra de Edom.
text_el: καὶ Δησων καὶ Ασαρ καὶ Ρισων οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες τοῦ Χορραίου τοῦ υἱοῦ Σηιρ ἐν τῇ γῇ Εδωμ

text_en: And Lotan had sons: Hori and Heman. And the sister of Lotan was Thamna.
text_la: Facti sunt autem filii Lotan : Hori et Heman. Erat autem soror Lotan, Thamna.
text_pt: E os filhos de Lotã foram Hori e Homã; e a irmã de Lotã era Timna.
text_el: ἐγένοντο δὲ υἱοὶ Λωταν Χορρι καὶ Αιμαν ἀδελφὴ δὲ Λωταν Θαμνα

text_en: And these the sons of Sobal: Alvan, and Manahat, and Ebal, and Sepho, and Onam.
text_la: Et isti filii Sobal : Alvan et Manahat et Ebal, et Sepho et Onam.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Sobal: Alvã, Manaate, Ebal, Sefô e Onã.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Σωβαλ Γωλων καὶ Μαναχαθ καὶ Γαιβηλ Σωφ καὶ Ωμαν

text_en: And these the sons of Sebeon: Aia and Ana. This is Ana that found the hot waters in the wilderness , when he fed the asses of Sebeon, his father:
text_la: Et hi filii Sebeon : Aja et Ana. Iste est Ana qui invenit aquas calidas in solitudine, cum pasceret asinos Sebeon patris sui:
text_pt: E estes são os filhos de Zibeão: Aiá e Aná; este é o Aná que achou as fontes termais no deserto, quando apascentava os jumentos de Zibeão, seu pai.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Σεβεγων Αιε καὶ Ωναν οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ Ωνας ὃς εὗρεν τὸν Ιαμιν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ ὅτε ἔνεμεν τὰ ὑποζύγια Σεβεγων τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he had a son Dison, and a daughter Oolibama.
text_la: habuitque filium Dison, et filiam Oolibama.
text_pt: E estes são os filhos de Aná: Disom e Aolibama, a filha de Aná.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ανα Δησων καὶ Ελιβεμα θυγάτηρ Ανα

text_en: And these were the sons of Dison: Hamdan, and Eseban, and Jethram, and Charan.
text_la: Et isti filii Dison : Hamdan, et Eseban, et Jethram, et Charan.
text_pt: E estes são os filhos de Disã: Hendã, Esbã, Itrã e Querã.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Δησων Αμαδα καὶ Ασβαν καὶ Ιεθραν καὶ Χαρραν

text_en: These also were the sons of Eser: Balaan, and Zavan, and Acan.
text_la: Hi quoque filii Eser : Balaan, et Zavan, et Acan.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Eser: Bilã, Zaavã e Acã.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ασαρ Βαλααν καὶ Ζουκαμ καὶ Ιωυκαμ καὶ Ουκαν

text_en: And Dison had sons: Hus and Aram.
text_la: Habuit autem filios Disan : Hus et Aram.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Disã: Uz e Arã.
text_el: οὗτοι δὲ υἱοὶ Ρισων Ως καὶ Αραμ

text_en: These were dukes of the Horrites: duke Lotan, duke Sobal, duke Sebeon, duke Ana,
text_la: Hi duces Horræorum : dux Lotan, dux Sobal, dux Sebeon, dux Ana,
text_pt: Estes são os príncipes dos horeus: o príncipe Lotã, o príncipe Sobal, o príncipe Zibeão, o príncipe Aná.
text_el: οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Χορρι ἡγεμὼν Λωταν ἡγεμὼν Σωβαλ ἡγεμὼν Σεβεγων ἡγεμὼν Ανα

text_en: duke Dison, duke Eser, duke Disan: these were dukes of the Horrites that ruled in the land of Seir.
text_la: dux Dison, dux Eser, dux Disan : isti duces Horræorum qui imperaverunt in terra Seir.
text_pt: O príncipe Disom, o príncipe Eser, o príncipe Disã: estes são os príncipes dos horeus segundo os seus principados na terra de Seir.
text_el: ἡγεμὼν Δησων ἡγεμὼν Ασαρ ἡγεμὼν Ρισων οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Χορρι ἐν ταῖς ἡγεμονίαις αὐτῶν ἐν γῇ Εδωμ

text_en: And the kings that ruled in the land of Edom , before the children of Israel had a king, were these:
text_la: Reges autem qui regnaverunt in terra Edom antequam haberent regem filii Israël, fuerunt hi:
text_pt: E estes são os reis que reinaram na terra de Edom, antes que reinasse rei algum sobre os filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ βασιλεῖς οἱ βασιλεύσαντες ἐν Εδωμ πρὸ τοῦ βασιλεῦσαι βασιλέα ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: Bela the son of Beor, and the name of his city Denaba.
text_la: Bela filius Beor, nomenque urbis ejus Denaba.
text_pt: Reinou, pois, em Edom Bela, filho de Beor, e o nome da sua cidade foi Dinabá.
text_el: καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἐν Εδωμ Βαλακ υἱὸς τοῦ Βεωρ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Δενναβα

text_en: And Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zara, of Bosra, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Mortuus est autem Bela, et regnavit pro eo Jobab filius Zaræ de Bosra.
text_pt: E morreu Bela; e Jobabe, filho de Zerá, de Bozra, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Βαλακ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Ιωβαβ υἱὸς Ζαρα ἐκ Βοσορρας

text_en: And when Jobab was dead, Husam, of the land of the Themanites, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Cumque mortuus esset Jobab, regnavit pro eo Husam de terra Themanorum.
text_pt: E morreu Jobabe; e Husão, da terra dos temanitas, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Ιωβαβ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Ασομ ἐκ τῆς γῆς Θαιμανων

text_en: And after his death, Adad, the son of Badad, reigned in his stead, who defeated the Madianites in the country of Boab; and the name of his city was Avith.
text_la: Hoc quoque mortuo, regnavit pro eo Adad filius Badad, qui percussit Madian in regione Moab : et nomen urbis ejus Avith.
text_pt: E morreu Husão, e em seu lugar reinou Hadade, filho de Bedade, o que feriu a Midiã, no campo de Moabe; e o nome da sua cidade foi Avite.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Ασομ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Αδαδ υἱὸς Βαραδ ὁ ἐκκόψας Μαδιαμ ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ Μωαβ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Γεθθαιμ

text_en: And when Adad was dead, there reigned in his stead, Semla, of Masreca.
text_la: Cumque mortuus esset Adad, regnavit pro eo Semla de Masreca.
text_pt: E morreu Hadade; e Samlá de Masreca reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Αδαδ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Σαμαλα ἐκ Μασεκκας

text_en: And he being dead, Saul , of the river Rohoboth, reigned in his stead.
text_la: Hoc quoque mortuo regnavit pro eo Saul de fluvio Rohoboth.
text_pt: E morreu Samlá; e Saul de Reobote, junto ao rio, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Σαμαλα καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Σαουλ ἐκ Ροωβωθ τῆς παρὰ ποταμόν

text_en: And when he also was dead, Balanan, the son of Achobor, succeeded to the kingdom.
text_la: Cumque et hic obiisset, successit in regnum Balanan filius Achobor.
text_pt: E morreu Saul; e Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor, reinou em seu lugar.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Σαουλ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Βαλαεννων υἱὸς Αχοβωρ

text_en: This man also being dead, Adar reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Phau: and his wife was called Meetabel, the daughter of Matred, daughter of Mezaab.
text_la: Isto quoque mortuo regnavit pro eo Adar, nomenque urbis ejus Phau : et appellabatur uxor ejus Meetabel, filia Matred filiæ Mezaab.
text_pt: E morreu Baal-Hanã, filho de Acbor; e Hadar reinou em seu lugar, e o nome de sua cidade foi Pau; e o nome de sua mulher foi Meetabel, filha de Matrede, filha de Me-Zaabe.
text_el: ἀπέθανεν δὲ Βαλαεννων υἱὸς Αχοβωρ καὶ ἐβασίλευσεν ἀντ' αὐτοῦ Αραδ υἱὸς Βαραδ καὶ ὄνομα τῇ πόλει αὐτοῦ Φογωρ ὄνομα δὲ τῇ γυναικὶ αὐτοῦ Μαιτεβεηλ θυγάτηρ Ματραιθ υἱοῦ Μαιζοοβ

text_en: And these are the names of the dukes of Esau in their kindreds, and places, and callings: duke Thamna, duke Alva, duke Jetheth,
text_la: Hæc ergo nomina ducum Esau in cognationibus, et locis, et vocabulis suis : dux Thamna, dux Alva, dux Jetheth,
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos príncipes de Esaú, segundo as suas gerações, segundo os seus lugares, com os seus nomes: o príncipe Timna, o príncipe Alva, o príncipe Jetete,
text_el: ταῦτα τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν ἡγεμόνων Ησαυ ἐν ταῖς φυλαῖς αὐτῶν κατὰ τόπον αὐτῶν ἐν ταῖς χώραις αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν αὐτῶν ἡγεμὼν Θαμνα ἡγεμὼν Γωλα ἡγεμὼν Ιεθερ

text_en: duke Oolibama, duke Ela, duke Phinon,
text_la: dux Oolibama, dux Ela, dux Phinon,
text_pt: O príncipe Aolibama, o príncipe Ela, o príncipe Pinom,
text_el: ἡγεμὼν Ελιβεμας ἡγεμὼν Ηλας ἡγεμὼν Φινων

text_en: duke Cenez, duke Theman, duke Mabsar,
text_la: dux Cenez, dux Theman, dux Mabsar,
text_pt: O príncipe Quenaz, o príncipe Temã, o príncipe Mibzar,
text_el: ἡγεμὼν Κενεζ ἡγεμὼν Θαιμαν ἡγεμὼν Μαζαρ

text_en: duke Magdiel, duke Hiram: these are the dukes of Edom dwelling in the land of their government; the same is Esau , the father of the Edomites .
text_la: dux Magdiel, dux Hiram : hi duces Edom habitantes in terra imperii sui, ipse est Esau pater Idumæorum.
text_pt: O príncipe Magdiel, o príncipe Irã: estes são os príncipes de Edom, segundo as suas habitações, na terra da sua possessão. Este é Esaú, pai de Edom.
text_el: ἡγεμὼν Μεγεδιηλ ἡγεμὼν Ζαφωιμ οὗτοι ἡγεμόνες Εδωμ ἐν ταῖς κατῳκοδομημέναις ἐν τῇ γῇ τῆς κτήσεως αὐτῶν οὗτος Ησαυ πατὴρ Εδωμ

text_en: And Jacob dwelt in the land of Chanaan , wherein his father sojourned.
text_la: Habitavit autem Jacob in terra Chanaan, in qua pater suus peregrinatus est.
text_pt: E Jacó habitou na terra das peregrinações de seu pai, na terra de Canaã.
text_el: κατῴκει δὲ Ιακωβ ἐν τῇ γῇ οὗ παρῴκησεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ ἐν γῇ Χανααν

text_en: And these are his generations : Joseph , when he was sixteen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren, being but a boy: and he was with the sons of Bala and of Zelpha his father's wives: and he accused his brethren to his father of a most wicked crime .
text_la: Et hæ sunt generationes ejus : Joseph cum sedecim esset annorum, pascebat gregem cum fratribus suis adhuc puer : et erat cum filiis Balæ et Zelphæ uxorum patris sui : accusavitque fratres suos apud patrem crimine pessimo.
text_pt: Estas são as gerações de Jacó. Sendo José de dezessete anos, apascentava as ovelhas com seus irmãos; sendo ainda jovem, andava com os filhos de Bila, e com os filhos de Zilpa, mulheres de seu pai; e José trazia más notícias deles a seu pai.
text_el: αὗται δὲ αἱ γενέσεις Ιακωβ Ιωσηφ δέκα ἑπτὰ ἐτῶν ἦν ποιμαίνων μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ τὰ πρόβατα ὢν νέος μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν Βαλλας καὶ μετὰ τῶν υἱῶν Ζελφας τῶν γυναικῶν τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ κατήνεγκεν δὲ Ιωσηφ ψόγον πονηρὸν πρὸς Ισραηλ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν

text_en: Now Israel loved Joseph above all his sons, because he had him in his old age: and he made him a coat of divers colours.
text_la: Israël autem diligebat Joseph super omnes filios suos, eo quod in senectute genuisset eum : fecitque ei tunicam polymitam.
text_pt: E Israel amava a José mais do que a todos os seus filhos, porque era filho da sua velhice; e fez-lhe uma túnica de várias cores.
text_el: Ιακωβ δὲ ἠγάπα τὸν Ιωσηφ παρὰ πάντας τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ ὅτι υἱὸς γήρους ἦν αὐτῷ ἐποίησεν δὲ αὐτῷ χιτῶνα ποικίλον

text_en: And his brethren seeing that he was loved by his father, more than all his sons, hated him, and could not speak peaceably to him.
text_la: Videntes autem fratres ejus quod a patre plus cunctis filiis amaretur, oderant eum, nec poterant ei quidquam pacifice loqui.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, seus irmãos que seu pai o amava mais do que a todos eles, odiaram-no, e não podiam falar com ele pacificamente.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ὅτι αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ φιλεῖ ἐκ πάντων τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ ἐμίσησαν αὐτὸν καὶ οὐκ ἐδύναντο λαλεῖν αὐτῷ οὐδὲν εἰρηνικόν

text_en: Now it fell out also that he told his brethren a dream , that he had dreamed: which occasioned them to hate him the more.
text_la: Accidit quoque ut visum somnium referret fratribus suis: quæ causa majoris odii seminarium fuit.
text_pt: Teve José um sonho, que contou a seus irmãos; por isso o odiaram ainda mais.
text_el: ἐνυπνιασθεὶς δὲ Ιωσηφ ἐνύπνιον ἀπήγγειλεν αὐτὸ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said to them: Hear my dream which I dreamed.
text_la: Dixitque ad eos : Audite somnium meum quod vidi:
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Ouvi, peço-vos, este sonho, que tenho sonhado:
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἀκούσατε τοῦ ἐνυπνίου τούτου οὗ ἐνυπνιάσθην

text_en: I thought we were binding sheaves in the field: and my sheaf arose as it were, and stood, and your sheaves standing about bowed down before my sheaf.
text_la: putabam nos ligare manipulos in agro : et quasi consurgere manipulum meum, et stare, vestrosque manipulos circumstantes adorare manipulum meum.
text_pt: Eis que estávamos atando molhos no meio do campo, e eis que o meu molho se levantava, e também ficava em pé, e eis que os vossos molhos o rodeavam, e se inclinavam ao meu molho.
text_el: ᾤμην ἡμᾶς δεσμεύειν δράγματα ἐν μέσῳ τῷ πεδίῳ καὶ ἀνέστη τὸ ἐμὸν δράγμα καὶ ὠρθώθη περιστραφέντα δὲ τὰ δράγματα ὑμῶν προσεκύνησαν τὸ ἐμὸν δράγμα

text_en: His brethren answered: Shalt you be our king? Or shall we be subject to your dominion? Therefore this matter of his dreams and words ministered nourishment to their envy and hatred .
text_la: Responderunt fratres ejus : Numquid rex noster eris? aut subjiciemur ditioni tuæ? Hæc ergo causa somniorum atque sermonum, invidiæ et odii fomitem ministravit.
text_pt: Então lhe disseram seus irmãos: Tu, pois, deveras reinarás sobre nós? Tu deveras terás domínio sobre nós? Por isso ainda mais o odiavam por seus sonhos e por suas palavras.
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ αὐτῷ οἱ ἀδελφοί μὴ βασιλεύων βασιλεύσεις ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἢ κυριεύων κυριεύσεις ἡμῶν καὶ προσέθεντο ἔτι μισεῖν αὐτὸν ἕνεκεν τῶν ἐνυπνίων αὐτοῦ καὶ ἕνεκεν τῶν ῥημάτων αὐτοῦ

text_en: He dreamed also another dream , which he told his brethren, saying: I saw in a dream , as it were the sun, and the moon, and eleven stars worshipping me.
text_la: Aliud quoque vidit somnium, quod narrans fratribus, ait : Vidi per somnium, quasi solem, et lunam, et stellas undecim adorare me.
text_pt: E teve José outro sonho, e o contou a seus irmãos, e disse: Eis que tive ainda outro sonho; e eis que o sol, e a lua, e onze estrelas se inclinavam a mim.
text_el: εἶδεν δὲ ἐνύπνιον ἕτερον καὶ διηγήσατο αὐτὸ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν ἰδοὺ ἐνυπνιασάμην ἐνύπνιον ἕτερον ὥσπερ ὁ ἥλιος καὶ ἡ σελήνη καὶ ἕνδεκα ἀστέρες προσεκύνουν με

text_en: And when he had told this to his father, and brethren, his father rebuked him and said: What means this dream that you have dreamed? Shall I and your mother, and your brethren worship you upon the earth?
text_la: Quod cum patri suo, et fratribus retulisset, increpavit eum pater suus, et dixit : Quid sibi vult hoc somnium quod vidisti? num ego et mater tua, et fratres tui adorabimus te super terram?
text_pt: E contando-o a seu pai e a seus irmãos, repreendeu-o seu pai, e disse-lhe: Que sonho é este que tiveste? Porventura viremos, eu e tua mãe, e teus irmãos, a inclinar-nos perante ti em terra?
text_el: καὶ ἐπετίμησεν αὐτῷ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ τί τὸ ἐνύπνιον τοῦτο ὃ ἐνυπνιάσθης ἆρά γε ἐλθόντες ἐλευσόμεθα ἐγώ τε καὶ ἡ μήτηρ σου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου προσκυνῆσαί σοι ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: His brethren therefore envied him: but his father considered the thing with himself.
text_la: Invidebant ei igitur fratres sui : pater vero rem tacitus considerabat.
text_pt: Seus irmãos, pois, o invejavam; seu pai porém guardava este negócio no seu coração.
text_el: ἐζήλωσαν δὲ αὐτὸν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ δὲ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ διετήρησεν τὸ ῥῆμα

text_en: And when his brethren abode in Sechem , feeding their father's flocks,
text_la: Cumque fratres illius in pascendis gregibus patris morarentur in Sichem,
text_pt: E seus irmãos foram apascentar o rebanho de seu pai, junto de Siquém.
text_el: ἐπορεύθησαν δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ βόσκειν τὰ πρόβατα τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν εἰς Συχεμ

text_en: Israel said to him: Your brethren feed the sheep in Sichem : come, I will send you to them. And when he answered:
text_la: dixit ad eum Israël : Fratres tui pascunt oves in Sichimis : veni, mittam te ad eos. Quo respondente,
text_pt: Disse, pois, Israel a José: Não apascentam os teus irmãos junto de Siquém? Vem, e enviar-te-ei a eles. E ele respondeu: Eis-me aqui.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσηφ οὐχ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου ποιμαίνουσιν ἐν Συχεμ δεῦρο ἀποστείλω σε πρὸς αὐτούς εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ἰδοὺ ἐγώ

text_en: I am ready: he said to him: Go, and see if all things be well with your brethren, and the cattle: and bring me word again what is doing. So being sent from the vale of Hebron , he came to Sichem :
text_la: Præsto sum, ait ei : Vade, et vide si cuncta prospera sint erga fratres tuos, et pecora : et renuntia mihi quid agatur. Missus de valle Hebron, venit in Sichem:
text_pt: E ele lhe disse: Ora vai, vê como estão teus irmãos, e como está o rebanho, e traze-me resposta. Assim o enviou do vale de Hebrom, e foi a Siquém.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Ισραηλ πορευθεὶς ἰδὲ εἰ ὑγιαίνουσιν οἱ ἀδελφοί σου καὶ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ ἀνάγγειλόν μοι καὶ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν ἐκ τῆς κοιλάδος τῆς Χεβρων καὶ ἦλθεν εἰς Συχεμ

text_en: And a man found him there wandering in the field, and asked what he sought.
text_la: invenitque eum vir errantem in agro, et interrogavit quid quæreret.
text_pt: E achou-o um homem, porque eis que andava errante pelo campo, e perguntou-lhe o homem, dizendo: Que procuras?
text_el: καὶ εὗρεν αὐτὸν ἄνθρωπος πλανώμενον ἐν τῷ πεδίῳ ἠρώτησεν δὲ αὐτὸν ὁ ἄνθρωπος λέγων τί ζητεῖς

text_en: But he answered: I seek my brethren, tell me where they feed the flocks.
text_la: At ille respondit : Fratres meos quæro : indica mihi ubi pascant greges.
text_pt: E ele disse: Procuro meus irmãos; dize-me, peço-te, onde eles apascentam.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν τοὺς ἀδελφούς μου ζητῶ ἀνάγγειλόν μοι ποῦ βόσκουσιν

text_en: And the man said to him: They are departed from this place: for I heard them say: Let us go to Dothain. And Joseph went forward after his brethren, and found them in Dothain.
text_la: Dixitque ei vir : Recesserunt de loco isto : audivi autem eos dicentes : Eamus in Dothain. Perrexit ergo Joseph post fratres suos, et invenit eos in Dothain.
text_pt: E disse aquele homem: Foram-se daqui; porque ouvi-os dizer: Vamos a Dotã. José, pois, seguiu atrás de seus irmãos, e achou-os em Dotã.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἀπήρκασιν ἐντεῦθεν ἤκουσα γὰρ αὐτῶν λεγόντων πορευθῶμεν εἰς Δωθαϊμ καὶ ἐπορεύθη Ιωσηφ κατόπισθεν τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ εὗρεν αὐτοὺς ἐν Δωθαϊμ

text_en: And when they saw him afar off, before he came near them, they thought to kill him:
text_la: Qui cum vidissent eum procul, antequam accederet ad eos, cogitaverunt illum occidere:
text_pt: E viram-no de longe e, antes que chegasse a eles, conspiraram contra ele para o matarem.
text_el: προεῖδον δὲ αὐτὸν μακρόθεν πρὸ τοῦ ἐγγίσαι αὐτὸν πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐπονηρεύοντο τοῦ ἀποκτεῖναι αὐτόν

text_en: And said one to another: Behold the dreamer comes.
text_la: et mutuo loquebantur : Ecce somniator venit:
text_pt: E disseram um ao outro: Eis lá vem o sonhador-mor!
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ἰδοὺ ὁ ἐνυπνιαστὴς ἐκεῖνος ἔρχεται

text_en: Come, let us kill him, and cast him into some old pit: and we will say: Some evil beast has devoured him: and then it shall appear what his dreams avail him:
text_la: venite, occidamus eum, et mittamus in cisternam veterem : dicemusque : Fera pessima devoravit eum : et tunc apparebit quid illi prosint somnia sua.
text_pt: Vinde, pois, agora, e matemo-lo, e lancemo-lo numa destas covas, e diremos: Uma fera o comeu; e veremos que será dos seus sonhos.
text_el: νῦν οὖν δεῦτε ἀποκτείνωμεν αὐτὸν καὶ ῥίψωμεν αὐτὸν εἰς ἕνα τῶν λάκκων καὶ ἐροῦμεν θηρίον πονηρὸν κατέφαγεν αὐτόν καὶ ὀψόμεθα τί ἔσται τὰ ἐνύπνια αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Ruben hearing this, endeavoured to deliver him out of their hands, and said:
text_la: Audiens autem hoc Ruben, nitebatur liberare eum de manibus eorum, et dicebat:
text_pt: E ouvindo-o Rúben, livrou-o das suas mãos, e disse: Não lhe tiremos a vida.
text_el: ἀκούσας δὲ Ρουβην ἐξείλατο αὐτὸν ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ εἶπεν οὐ πατάξομεν αὐτὸν εἰς ψυχήν

text_en: Do not take away his life , nor shed his blood: but cast him into this pit, that is in the wilderness , and keep your hands harmless: now he said this, being desirous to deliver him out of their hands and to restore him to his father.
text_la: Non interficiatis animam ejus, nec effundatis sanguinem : sed projicite eum in cisternam hanc, quæ est in solitudine, manusque vestras servate innoxias : hoc autem dicebat, volens eripere eum de manibus eorum, et reddere patri suo.
text_pt: Também lhes disse Rúben: Não derrameis sangue; lançai-o nesta cova, que está no deserto, e não lanceis mãos nele; isto disse para livrá-lo das mãos deles e para torná-lo a seu pai.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ρουβην μὴ ἐκχέητε αἷμα ἐμβάλετε αὐτὸν εἰς τὸν λάκκον τοῦτον τὸν ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ χεῖρα δὲ μὴ ἐπενέγκητε αὐτῷ ὅπως ἐξέληται αὐτὸν ἐκ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ ἀποδῷ αὐτὸν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And as soon as he came to his brethren, they forthwith stript him of his outside coat, that was of divers colours:
text_la: Confestim igitur ut pervenit ad fratres suos, nudaverunt eum tunica talari et polymita:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, chegando José a seus irmãos, tiraram de José a sua túnica, a túnica de várias cores, que trazia.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἦλθεν Ιωσηφ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐξέδυσαν τὸν Ιωσηφ τὸν χιτῶνα τὸν ποικίλον τὸν περὶ αὐτὸν

text_en: And cast him into an old pit where there was not water.
text_la: miseruntque eum in cisternam veterem, quæ non habebat aquam.
text_pt: E tomaram-no, e lançaram-no na cova; porém a cova estava vazia, não havia água nela.
text_el: καὶ λαβόντες αὐτὸν ἔρριψαν εἰς τὸν λάκκον ὁ δὲ λάκκος κενός ὕδωρ οὐκ εἶχεν

text_en: And sitting down to eat bread, they saw some Ismaelites on their way coming from Galaad, with their camels, carrying spices, and balm, and myrrh to Egypt .
text_la: Et sedentes ut comederent panem, viderunt Ismaëlitas viatores venire de Galaad, et camelos eorum portantes aromata, et resinam, et stacten in Ægyptum.
text_pt: Depois assentaram-se a comer pão; e levantaram os seus olhos, e olharam, e eis que uma companhia de ismaelitas vinha de Gileade; e seus camelos traziam especiarias e bálsamo e mirra, e iam levá-los ao Egito.
text_el: ἐκάθισαν δὲ φαγεῖν ἄρτον καὶ ἀναβλέψαντες τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς εἶδον καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁδοιπόροι Ισμαηλῖται ἤρχοντο ἐκ Γαλααδ καὶ αἱ κάμηλοι αὐτῶν ἔγεμον θυμιαμάτων καὶ ῥητίνης καὶ στακτῆς ἐπορεύοντο δὲ καταγαγεῖν εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: And Juda said to his brethren: What will it profit us to kill our brother, and conceal his blood?
text_la: Dixit ergo Judas fratribus suis : Quid nobis prodest si occiderimus fratrem nostrum, et celaverimus sanguinem ipsius?
text_pt: Então Judá disse aos seus irmãos: Que proveito haverá que matemos a nosso irmão e escondamos o seu sangue?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιουδας πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ τί χρήσιμον ἐὰν ἀποκτείνωμεν τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν καὶ κρύψωμεν τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ

text_en: It is better that he be sold to the Ismaelites , and that our hands be not defiled: for he is our brother and our flesh. His brethren agreed to his words.
text_la: melius est ut venundetur Ismaëlitis, et manus nostræ non polluantur : frater enim et caro nostra est. Acquieverunt fratres sermonibus illius.
text_pt: Vinde e vendamo-lo a estes ismaelitas, e não seja nossa mão sobre ele; porque ele é nosso irmão, nossa carne. E seus irmãos obedeceram.
text_el: δεῦτε ἀποδώμεθα αὐτὸν τοῖς Ισμαηλίταις τούτοις αἱ δὲ χεῖρες ἡμῶν μὴ ἔστωσαν ἐπ' αὐτόν ὅτι ἀδελφὸς ἡμῶν καὶ σὰρξ ἡμῶν ἐστιν ἤκουσαν δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when the Madianite merchants passed by, they drew him out of the pit, and sold him to the Ismaelites , for twenty pieces of silver: and they led him into Egypt .
text_la: Et prætereuntibus Madianitis negotiatoribus, extrahentes eum de cisterna, vendiderunt eum Ismaëlitis, viginti argenteis : qui duxerunt eum in Ægyptum.
text_pt: Passando, pois, os mercadores midianitas, tiraram e alçaram a José da cova, e venderam José por vinte moedas de prata, aos ismaelitas, os quais levaram José ao Egito.
text_el: καὶ παρεπορεύοντο οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ Μαδιηναῖοι οἱ ἔμποροι καὶ ἐξείλκυσαν καὶ ἀνεβίβασαν τὸν Ιωσηφ ἐκ τοῦ λάκκου καὶ ἀπέδοντο τὸν Ιωσηφ τοῖς Ισμαηλίταις εἴκοσι χρυσῶν καὶ κατήγαγον τὸν Ιωσηφ εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: And Ruben returning to the pit, found not the boy:
text_la: Reversusque Ruben ad cisternam, non invenit puerum:
text_pt: Voltando, pois, Rúben à cova, eis que José não estava na cova; então rasgou as suas vestes.
text_el: ἀνέστρεψεν δὲ Ρουβην ἐπὶ τὸν λάκκον καὶ οὐχ ὁρᾷ τὸν Ιωσηφ ἐν τῷ λάκκῳ καὶ διέρρηξεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ

text_en: And rending his garments he went to his brethren, and said: The boy does not appear, and whither shall I go?
text_la: et scissis vestibus pergens ad fratres suos, ait : Puer non comparet, et ego quo ibo?
text_pt: E voltou a seus irmãos e disse: O menino não está; e eu aonde irei?
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστρεψεν πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν τὸ παιδάριον οὐκ ἔστιν ἐγὼ δὲ ποῦ πορεύομαι ἔτι

text_en: And they took his coat, and dipped it in the blood of a kid, which they had killed:
text_la: Tulerunt autem tunicam ejus, et in sanguine hædi, quem occiderant, tinxerunt:
text_pt: Então tomaram a túnica de José, e mataram um cabrito, e tingiram a túnica no sangue.
text_el: λαβόντες δὲ τὸν χιτῶνα τοῦ Ιωσηφ ἔσφαξαν ἔριφον αἰγῶν καὶ ἐμόλυναν τὸν χιτῶνα τῷ αἵματι

text_en: Sending some to carry it to their father, and to say: This we have found: see whether it be your son's coat, or not.
text_la: mittentes qui ferrent ad patrem, et dicerent : Hanc invenimus : vide utrum tunica filii tui sit, an non.
text_pt: E enviaram a túnica de várias cores, mandando levá-la a seu pai, e disseram: Temos achado esta túnica; conhece agora se esta será ou não a túnica de teu filho.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλαν τὸν χιτῶνα τὸν ποικίλον καὶ εἰσήνεγκαν τῷ πατρὶ αὐτῶν καὶ εἶπαν τοῦτον εὕρομεν ἐπίγνωθι εἰ χιτὼν τοῦ υἱοῦ σού ἐστιν ἢ οὔ

text_en: And the father acknowledging it, said: It is my son's coat, an evil wild beast has eaten him, a beast has devoured Joseph .
text_la: Quam cum agnovisset pater, ait : Tunica filii mei est : fera pessima comedit eum, bestia devoravit Joseph.
text_pt: E conheceu-a, e disse: É a túnica de meu filho; uma fera o comeu; certamente José foi despedaçado.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέγνω αὐτὸν καὶ εἶπεν χιτὼν τοῦ υἱοῦ μού ἐστιν θηρίον πονηρὸν κατέφαγεν αὐτόν θηρίον ἥρπασεν τὸν Ιωσηφ

text_en: And tearing his garments, he put on sackcloth , mourning for his son a long time.
text_la: Scissisque vestibus, indutus est cilicio, lugens filium suum multo tempore.
text_pt: Então Jacó rasgou as suas vestes, pôs saco sobre os seus lombos e lamentou a seu filho muitos dias.
text_el: διέρρηξεν δὲ Ιακωβ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέθετο σάκκον ἐπὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπένθει τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ ἡμέρας πολλάς

text_en: And all his children being gathered together to comfort their father in his sorrow, he would not receive comfort, but said: I will go down to my son into hell , mourning. And whilst he continued weeping,
text_la: Congregatis autem cunctis liberis ejus ut lenirent dolorem patris, noluit consolationem accipere, sed ait : Descendam ad filium meum lugens in infernum. Et illo perseverante in fletu,
text_pt: E levantaram-se todos os seus filhos e todas as suas filhas, para o consolarem; recusou porém ser consolado, e disse: Porquanto com choro hei de descer ao meu filho até à sepultura. Assim o chorou seu pai.
text_el: συνήχθησαν δὲ πάντες οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες καὶ ἦλθον παρακαλέσαι αὐτόν καὶ οὐκ ἤθελεν παρακαλεῖσθαι λέγων ὅτι καταβήσομαι πρὸς τὸν υἱόν μου πενθῶν εἰς ᾅδου καὶ ἔκλαυσεν αὐτὸν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτοῦ

text_en: the Madianites sold Joseph in Egypt to Putiphar, an eunuch of Pharao , captain of the soldiers.
text_la: Madianitæ vendiderunt Joseph in Ægypto Putiphari eunucho Pharaonis, magistro militum.
text_pt: E os midianitas venderam-no no Egito a Potifar, oficial de Faraó, capitão da guarda.
text_el: οἱ δὲ Μαδιηναῖοι ἀπέδοντο τὸν Ιωσηφ εἰς Αἴγυπτον τῷ Πετεφρη τῷ σπάδοντι Φαραω ἀρχιμαγείρῳ

text_en: At that time Juda went down from his brethren, and turned in to a certain Odollamite , named Hiras.
text_la: Eodem tempore, descendens Judas a fratribus suis, divertit ad virum Odollamitem, nomine Hiram.
text_pt: E aconteceu no mesmo tempo que Judá desceu de entre seus irmãos e entrou na casa de um homem de Adulão, cujo nome era Hira,
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ κατέβη Ιουδας ἀπὸ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀφίκετο ἕως πρὸς ἄνθρωπόν τινα Οδολλαμίτην ᾧ ὄνομα Ιρας

text_en: And he saw there the daughter of a man of Chanaan , called Sue: and taking her to wife , he went in unto her.
