text_la: Viditque ibi filiam hominis Chananæi, vocabulo Sue : et accepta uxore, ingressus est ad eam.
text_pt: E viu Judá ali a filha de um homem cananeu, cujo nome era Sua; e tomou-a por mulher, e a possuiu.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ἐκεῖ Ιουδας θυγατέρα ἀνθρώπου Χαναναίου ᾗ ὄνομα Σαυα καὶ ἔλαβεν αὐτὴν καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτήν

text_en: And she conceived, and bore a son, and called his name Her.
text_la: Quæ concepit, et peperit filium, et vocavit nomen ejus Her.
text_pt: E ela concebeu e deu à luz um filho, e chamou-lhe Er.
text_el: καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν υἱὸν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ηρ

text_en: And conceiving again, she bore a son, and called him Onan.
text_la: Rursumque concepto fœtu, natum filium vocavit Onan.
text_pt: E tornou a conceber e deu à luz um filho, e chamou-lhe Onã.
text_el: καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτι ἔτεκεν υἱὸν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Αυναν

text_en: She bore also a third: whom she called Sela. After whose birth, she ceased to bear any more.
text_la: Tertium quoque peperit : quem appellavit Sela; quo nato, parere ultra cessavit.
text_pt: E continuou ainda e deu à luz um filho, e chamou-lhe Selá; e Judá estava em Quezibe, quando ela o deu à luz.
text_el: καὶ προσθεῖσα ἔτι ἔτεκεν υἱὸν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Σηλωμ αὐτὴ δὲ ἦν ἐν Χασβι ἡνίκα ἔτεκεν αὐτούς

text_en: And Juda took a wife for Her, his first born , whose name was Thamar.
text_la: Dedit autem Judas uxorem primogenito suo Her, nomine Thamar.
text_pt: Judá, pois, tomou uma mulher para Er, o seu primogênito, e o seu nome era Tamar.
text_el: καὶ ἔλαβεν Ιουδας γυναῖκα Ηρ τῷ πρωτοτόκῳ αὐτοῦ ᾗ ὄνομα Θαμαρ

text_en: And Her, the first born of Juda , was wicked in the sight of the Lord : and was slain by him.
text_la: Fuit quoque Her primogenitus Judæ nequam in conspectu Domini: et ab eo occisus est.
text_pt: Er, porém, o primogênito de Judá, era mau aos olhos do Senhor, por isso o Senhor o matou.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ Ηρ πρωτότοκος Ιουδα πονηρὸς ἐναντίον κυρίου καὶ ἀπέκτεινεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεός

text_en: Juda , therefore, said to Onan his son: Go in to your brother's wife and marry her, that you may raise seed to your brother.
text_la: Dixit ergo Judas ad Onan filium suum : Ingredere uxorem fratris tui, et sociare illi, ut suscites semen fratri tuo.
text_pt: Então disse Judá a Onã: Toma a mulher do teu irmão, e casa-te com ela, e suscita descendência a teu irmão.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιουδας τῷ Αυναν εἴσελθε πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ σου καὶ γάμβρευσαι αὐτὴν καὶ ἀνάστησον σπέρμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ σου

text_en: He knowing that the children should not be his, when he went in to his brother's wife, he spilled his seed upon the ground, lest children should be born in his brother's name .
text_la: Ille sciens non sibi nasci filios, introiens ad uxorem fratris sui, semen fundebat in terram, ne liberi fratris nomine nascerentur.
text_pt: Onã, porém, soube que esta descendência não havia de ser para ele; e aconteceu que, quando possuía a mulher de seu irmão, derramava o sêmen na terra, para não dar descendência a seu irmão.
text_el: γνοὺς δὲ Αυναν ὅτι οὐκ αὐτῷ ἔσται τὸ σπέρμα ἐγίνετο ὅταν εἰσήρχετο πρὸς τὴν γυναῖκα τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ ἐξέχεεν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν τοῦ μὴ δοῦναι σπέρμα τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And therefore the Lord slew him, because he did a detestable thing:
text_la: Et idcirco percussit eum Dominus, quod rem detestabilem faceret.
text_pt: E o que fazia era mau aos olhos do Senhor, pelo que também o matou.
text_el: πονηρὸν δὲ ἐφάνη ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ ὅτι ἐποίησεν τοῦτο καὶ ἐθανάτωσεν καὶ τοῦτον

text_en: Wherefore Juda said to Thamar his daughter-in-law: Remain a widow in your father's house, till Sela my son grow up: for he was afraid lest he also might die, as his brethren did. She went her way, and dwelt in her father's house.
text_la: Quam ob rem dixit Judas Thamar nurui suæ : Esto vidua in domo patris tui, donec crescat Sela filius meus : timebat enim ne et ipse moreretur, sicut fratres ejus. Quæ abiit, et habitavit in domo patris sui.
text_pt: Então disse Judá a Tamar sua nora: Fica-te viúva na casa de teu pai, até que Selá, meu filho, seja grande. Porquanto disse: Para que porventura não morra também este, como seus irmãos. Assim se foi Tamar e ficou na casa de seu pai.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιουδας Θαμαρ τῇ νύμφῃ αὐτοῦ κάθου χήρα ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρός σου ἕως μέγας γένηται Σηλωμ ὁ υἱός μου εἶπεν γάρ μήποτε ἀποθάνῃ καὶ οὗτος ὥσπερ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπελθοῦσα δὲ Θαμαρ ἐκάθητο ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς

text_en: And after many days were past: the daughter of Sue the wife of Juda died: and when he had taken comfort after his mourning, he went up to Thamnas, to the shearers of his sheep, he and Hiras the Odollamite , the shepherd of his flock.
text_la: Evolutis autem multis diebus, mortua est filia Sue uxor Judæ : qui, post luctum consolatione suscepta, ascendebat ad tonsores ovium suarum, ipse et Hiras opilio gregis Odollamites, in Thamnas.
text_pt: Passando-se pois muitos dias, morreu a filha de Sua, mulher de Judá; e depois de consolado Judá subiu aos tosquiadores das suas ovelhas em Timna, ele e Hira, seu amigo, o adulamita.
text_el: ἐπληθύνθησαν δὲ αἱ ἡμέραι καὶ ἀπέθανεν Σαυα ἡ γυνὴ Ιουδα καὶ παρακληθεὶς Ιουδας ἀνέβη ἐπὶ τοὺς κείροντας τὰ πρόβατα αὐτοῦ αὐτὸς καὶ Ιρας ὁ ποιμὴν αὐτοῦ ὁ Οδολλαμίτης εἰς Θαμνα

text_en: And it was told Thamar that her father-in-law had come up to Thamnas to shear his sheep.
text_la: Nuntiatumque est Thamar quod socer illius ascenderet in Thamnas ad tondendas oves.
text_pt: E deram aviso a Tamar, dizendo: Eis que o teu sogro sobe a Timna, a tosquiar as suas ovelhas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπηγγέλη Θαμαρ τῇ νύμφῃ αὐτοῦ λέγοντες ἰδοὺ ὁ πενθερός σου ἀναβαίνει εἰς Θαμνα κεῖραι τὰ πρόβατα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And she put off the garments of her widowhood , and took a veil: and changing her dress, sat in the cross way, that leads to Thamnas: because Sela was grown up, and she had not been married to him.
text_la: Quæ, depositis viduitatis vestibus, assumpsit theristrum : et mutato habitu, sedit in bivio itineris, quod ducit Thamnam : eo quod crevisset Sela, et non eum accepisset maritum.
text_pt: Então ela tirou de sobre si os vestidos da sua viuvez e cobriu-se com o véu, e envolveu-se, e assentou-se à entrada das duas fontes que estão no caminho de Timna, porque via que Selá já era grande, e ela não lhe fora dada por mulher.
text_el: καὶ περιελομένη τὰ ἱμάτια τῆς χηρεύσεως ἀφ' ἑαυτῆς περιεβάλετο θέριστρον καὶ ἐκαλλωπίσατο καὶ ἐκάθισεν πρὸς ταῖς πύλαις Αιναν ἥ ἐστιν ἐν παρόδῳ Θαμνα εἶδεν γὰρ ὅτι μέγας γέγονεν Σηλωμ αὐτὸς δὲ οὐκ ἔδωκεν αὐτὴν αὐτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: When Juda saw her, he thought she was a harlot: for she had covered her face, lest she should be known .
text_la: Quam cum vidisset Judas, suspicatus est esse meretricem : operuerat enim vultum suum, ne agnosceretur.
text_pt: E vendo-a Judá, teve-a por uma prostituta, porque ela tinha coberto o seu rosto.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν αὐτὴν Ιουδας ἔδοξεν αὐτὴν πόρνην εἶναι κατεκαλύψατο γὰρ τὸ πρόσωπον αὐτῆς καὶ οὐκ ἐπέγνω αὐτήν

text_en: And going to her, he said: Suffer me to lie with you: for he knew her not to be his daughter-in-law. And she answered: What will you give me to enjoy my company?
text_la: Ingrediensque ad eam, ait : Dimitte me ut coëam tecum : nesciebat enim quod nurus sua esset. Qua respondente : Quid dabis mihi ut fruaris concubitu meo?
text_pt: E dirigiu-se a ela no caminho, e disse: Vem, peço-te, deixa-me possuir-te. Porquanto não sabia que era sua nora. E ela disse: Que darás, para que possuas a mim?
text_el: ἐξέκλινεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτὴν τὴν ὁδὸν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῇ ἔασόν με εἰσελθεῖν πρὸς σέ οὐ γὰρ ἔγνω ὅτι ἡ νύμφη αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἡ δὲ εἶπεν τί μοι δώσεις ἐὰν εἰσέλθῃς πρός με

text_en: He said: I will send you a kid out of the flock. And when she said again: I will suffer what you will, if you give me a pledge, till you send what you promise.
text_la: dixit : Mittam tibi hædum de gregibus. Rursumque illa dicente : Patiar quod vis, si dederis mihi arrhabonem, donec mittas quod polliceris.
text_pt: E ele disse: Eu te enviarei um cabrito do rebanho. E ela disse: Dar-me-ás penhor até que o envies?
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἐγώ σοι ἀποστελῶ ἔριφον αἰγῶν ἐκ τῶν προβάτων ἡ δὲ εἶπεν ἐὰν δῷς ἀρραβῶνα ἕως τοῦ ἀποστεῖλαί σε

text_en: Juda said: What will you have for a pledge? She answered: Your ring and bracelet, and the staff which you hold in your hand. The woman therefore at one copulation conceived.
text_la: Ait Judas : Quid tibi vis pro arrhabone dari? Respondit : Annulum tuum, et armillam, et baculum quem manu tenes. Ad unum igitur coitum mulier concepit,
text_pt: Então ele disse: Que penhor é que te darei? E ela disse: O teu selo, e o teu cordão, e o cajado que está em tua mão. O que ele lhe deu, e possuiu-a, e ela concebeu dele.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν τίνα τὸν ἀρραβῶνά σοι δώσω ἡ δὲ εἶπεν τὸν δακτύλιόν σου καὶ τὸν ὁρμίσκον καὶ τὴν ῥάβδον τὴν ἐν τῇ χειρί σου καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῇ καὶ εἰσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτήν καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔλαβεν ἐξ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And she arose and went her way: and putting off the apparel which she had taken, put on the garments of her widowhood .
text_la: et surgens abiit : depositoque habitu quem sumpserat, induta est viduitatis vestibus.
text_pt: E ela se levantou, e se foi e tirou de sobre si o seu véu, e vestiu os vestidos da sua viuvez.
text_el: καὶ ἀναστᾶσα ἀπῆλθεν καὶ περιείλατο τὸ θέριστρον ἀφ' ἑαυτῆς καὶ ἐνεδύσατο τὰ ἱμάτια τῆς χηρεύσεως αὐτῆς

text_en: And Juda sent a kid by his shepherd, the Odollamite , that he might receive the pledge again, which he had given to the woman : but he, not finding her,
text_la: Misit autem Judas hædum per pastorem suum Odollamitem, ut reciperet pignus quod dederat mulieri : qui cum non invenisset eam,
text_pt: E Judá enviou o cabrito por mão do seu amigo, o adulamita, para tomar o penhor da mão da mulher; porém não a achou.
text_el: ἀπέστειλεν δὲ Ιουδας τὸν ἔριφον ἐξ αἰγῶν ἐν χειρὶ τοῦ ποιμένος αὐτοῦ τοῦ Οδολλαμίτου κομίσασθαι τὸν ἀρραβῶνα παρὰ τῆς γυναικός καὶ οὐχ εὗρεν αὐτήν

text_en: asked the men of that place: Where is the woman that sat in the cross way? And when they all made answer: There was no harlot in this place,
text_la: interrogavit homines loci illius : Ubi est mulier quæ sedebat in bivio? Respondentibus cunctis : Non fuit in loco ista meretrix.
text_pt: E perguntou aos homens daquele lugar dizendo: Onde está a prostituta que estava no caminho junto às duas fontes? E disseram: Aqui não esteve prostituta alguma.
text_el: ἐπηρώτησεν δὲ τοὺς ἄνδρας τοὺς ἐκ τοῦ τόπου ποῦ ἐστιν ἡ πόρνη ἡ γενομένη ἐν Αιναν ἐπὶ τῆς ὁδοῦ καὶ εἶπαν οὐκ ἦν ἐνταῦθα πόρνη

text_en: he returned to Juda , and said to him: I have not found her; moreover, the men of that place said to me, that there never sat a harlot there.
text_la: Reversus est ad Judam, et dixit ei : Non inveni eam : sed et homines loci illius dixerunt mihi, numquam sedisse ibi scortum.
text_pt: E tornou-se a Judá e disse: Não a achei; e também disseram os homens daquele lugar: Aqui não esteve prostituta.
text_el: καὶ ἀπεστράφη πρὸς Ιουδαν καὶ εἶπεν οὐχ εὗρον καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι οἱ ἐκ τοῦ τόπου λέγουσιν μὴ εἶναι ὧδε πόρνην

text_en: Juda said: Let her take it to herself, surely she cannot charge us with a lie , I sent the kid which I promised: and you did not find her.
text_la: Ait Judas : Habeat sibi, certe mendacii arguere nos non potest, ego misi hædum quem promiseram : et tu non invenisti eam.
text_pt: Então disse Judá: Deixa-a ficar com o penhor, para que porventura não caiamos em desprezo; eis que tenho enviado este cabrito; mas tu não a achaste.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιουδας ἐχέτω αὐτά ἀλλὰ μήποτε καταγελασθῶμεν ἐγὼ μὲν ἀπέσταλκα τὸν ἔριφον τοῦτον σὺ δὲ οὐχ εὕρηκας

text_en: And behold, after three months, they told Juda , saying: Thamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the harlot, and she appears to have a big belly. And Juda said: Bring her out that she may be burnt.
text_la: Ecce autem post tres menses nuntiaverunt Judæ, dicentes : Fornicata est Thamar nurus tua, et videtur uterus illius intumescere. Dixitque Judas : Producite eam ut comburatur.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, quase três meses depois, deram aviso a Judá, dizendo: Tamar, tua nora, adulterou, e eis que está grávida do adultério. Então disse Judá: Tirai-a fora para que seja queimada.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τρίμηνον ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Ιουδα λέγοντες ἐκπεπόρνευκεν Θαμαρ ἡ νύμφη σου καὶ ἰδοὺ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχει ἐκ πορνείας εἶπεν δὲ Ιουδας ἐξαγάγετε αὐτήν καὶ κατακαυθήτω

text_en: But when she was led to execution , she sent to her father in law, saying: By the man , to whom these things belong, I am with child. See whose ring, and bracelet, and staff this is.
text_la: Quæ cum duceretur ad pœnam, misit ad socerum suum, dicens : De viro, cujus hæc sunt, concepi : cognosce cujus sit annulus, et armilla, et baculus.
text_pt: E tirando-a fora, ela mandou dizer a seu sogro: Do homem de quem são estas coisas eu concebi. E ela disse mais: Conhece, peço-te, de quem é este selo, e este cordão, e este cajado.
text_el: αὐτὴ δὲ ἀγομένη ἀπέστειλεν πρὸς τὸν πενθερὸν αὐτῆς λέγουσα ἐκ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τίνος ταῦτά ἐστιν ἐγὼ ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχω καὶ εἶπεν ἐπίγνωθι τίνος ὁ δακτύλιος καὶ ὁ ὁρμίσκος καὶ ἡ ῥάβδος αὕτη

text_en: But he acknowledging the gifts, said: She is juster than I: because I did not give her to Sela, my son. However he knew her no more.
text_la: Qui, agnitis muneribus, ait : Justior me est : quia non tradidi eam Sela filio meo. Attamen ultra non cognovit eam.
text_pt: E conheceu-os Judá e disse: Mais justa é ela do que eu, porquanto não a tenho dado a Selá meu filho. E nunca mais a conheceu.
text_el: ἐπέγνω δὲ Ιουδας καὶ εἶπεν δεδικαίωται Θαμαρ ἢ ἐγώ οὗ εἵνεκεν οὐκ ἔδωκα αὐτὴν Σηλωμ τῷ υἱῷ μου καὶ οὐ προσέθετο ἔτι τοῦ γνῶναι αὐτήν

text_en: And when she was ready to be brought to bed, there appeared twins in her womb: and in the very delivery of the infants, one put forth a hand, whereon the midwife tied a scarlet thread, saying:
text_la: Instante autem partu, apparuerunt gemini in utero : atque in ipsa effusione infantium unus protulit manum, in qua obstetrix ligavit coccinum, dicens:
text_pt: E aconteceu ao tempo de dar à luz que havia gêmeos em seu ventre;
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἔτικτεν καὶ τῇδε ἦν δίδυμα ἐν τῇ γαστρὶ αὐτῆς

text_en: This shall come forth the first.
text_la: Iste egredietur prior.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, dando ela à luz, que um pôs fora a mão, e a parteira tomou-a, e atou em sua mão um fio encarnado, dizendo: Este saiu primeiro.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ τίκτειν αὐτὴν ὁ εἷς προεξήνεγκεν τὴν χεῖρα λαβοῦσα δὲ ἡ μαῖα ἔδησεν ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ κόκκινον λέγουσα οὗτος ἐξελεύσεται πρότερος

text_en: But he drawing back his hand, the other came forth: and the woman said: Why is the partition divided for you? And therefore called his name Phares.
text_la: Illo vero retrahente manum, egressus est alter : dixitque mulier : Quare divisa est propter te maceria? et ob hanc causam, vocavit nomen ejus Phares.
text_pt: Mas aconteceu que, tornando ele a recolher a sua mão, eis que saiu o seu irmão, e ela disse: Como tu tens rompido, sobre ti é a rotura. E chamaram-lhe Perez.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἐπισυνήγαγεν τὴν χεῖρα καὶ εὐθὺς ἐξῆλθεν ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἡ δὲ εἶπεν τί διεκόπη διὰ σὲ φραγμός καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Φαρες

text_en: Afterwards his brother came out, on whose hand was the scarlet thread: and she called his name Zara.
text_la: Postea egressus est frater ejus, in cujus manu erat coccinum : quem appellavit Zara.
text_pt: E depois saiu o seu irmão, em cuja mão estava o fio encarnado; e chamaram-lhe Zerá.
text_el: καὶ μετὰ τοῦτο ἐξῆλθεν ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἐφ' ᾧ ἦν ἐπὶ τῇ χειρὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ κόκκινον καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Ζαρα

text_en: And Joseph was brought into Egypt , and Putiphar, an eunuch of Pharao , chief captain of the army, an Egyptian , bought him of the Ismaelites , by whom he was brought.
text_la: Igitur Joseph ductus est in Ægyptum, emitque eum Putiphar eunuchus Pharaonis, princeps exercitus, vir ægyptius, de manu Ismaëlitarum, a quibus perductus erat.
text_pt: E José foi levado ao Egito, e Potifar, oficial de Faraó, capitão da guarda, homem egípcio, comprou-o da mão dos ismaelitas que o tinham levado lá.
text_el: Ιωσηφ δὲ κατήχθη εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐκτήσατο αὐτὸν Πετεφρης ὁ εὐνοῦχος Φαραω ἀρχιμάγειρος ἀνὴρ Αἰγύπτιος ἐκ χειρὸς Ισμαηλιτῶν οἳ κατήγαγον αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And the Lord was with him, and he was a prosperous man in all things: and he dwelt in his master's house:
text_la: Fuitque Dominus cum eo, et erat vir in cunctis prospere agens : habitavitque in domo domini sui,
text_pt: E o SENHOR estava com José, e foi homem próspero; e estava na casa de seu senhor egípcio.
text_el: καὶ ἦν κύριος μετὰ Ιωσηφ καὶ ἦν ἀνὴρ ἐπιτυγχάνων καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ παρὰ τῷ κυρίῳ τῷ Αἰγυπτίῳ

text_en: Who knew very well that the Lord was with him, and made all that he did to prosper in his hand.
text_la: qui optime noverat Dominum esse cum eo, et omnia, quæ gerebat, ab eo dirigi in manu illius.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, o seu senhor que o SENHOR estava com ele, e tudo o que fazia o SENHOR prosperava em sua mão,
text_el: ᾔδει δὲ ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ ὅτι κύριος μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ὅσα ἂν ποιῇ κύριος εὐοδοῖ ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Joseph found favour in the sight of his master, and ministered to him: and being set over all by him, he governed the house committed to him, and all things that were delivered to him:
text_la: Invenitque Joseph gratiam coram domino suo, et ministrabat ei : a quo præpositus omnibus gubernabat creditam sibi domum, et universa quæ ei tradita fuerant:
text_pt: José achou graça em seus olhos, e servia-o; e ele o pôs sobre a sua casa, e entregou na sua mão tudo o que tinha.
text_el: καὶ εὗρεν Ιωσηφ χάριν ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ εὐηρέστει δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἦν αὐτῷ ἔδωκεν διὰ χειρὸς Ιωσηφ

text_en: And the Lord blessed the house of the Egyptian for Joseph's sake, and multiplied all his substance , both at home and in the fields.
text_la: benedixitque Dominus domui Ægyptii propter Joseph, et multiplicavit tam in ædibus quam in agris cunctam ejus substantiam:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, desde que o pusera sobre a sua casa e sobre tudo o que tinha, o Senhor abençoou a casa do egípcio por amor de José; e a bênção do Senhor foi sobre tudo o que tinha, na casa e no campo.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὸ κατασταθῆναι αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ πάντα ὅσα ἦν αὐτῷ καὶ ηὐλόγησεν κύριος τὸν οἶκον τοῦ Αἰγυπτίου διὰ Ιωσηφ καὶ ἐγενήθη εὐλογία κυρίου ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπάρχουσιν αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ καὶ ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ

text_en: Neither knew he any other thing, but the bread which he ate. And Joseph was of a beautiful countenance, and comely to behold.
text_la: nec quidquam aliud noverat, nisi panem quo vescebatur. Erat autem Joseph pulchra facie, et decorus aspectu.
text_pt: E deixou tudo o que tinha na mão de José, de maneira que nada sabia do que estava com ele, a não ser do pão que comia. E José era formoso de porte, e de semblante.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέτρεψεν πάντα ὅσα ἦν αὐτῷ εἰς χεῖρας Ιωσηφ καὶ οὐκ ᾔδει τῶν καθ' ἑαυτὸν οὐδὲν πλὴν τοῦ ἄρτου οὗ ἤσθιεν αὐτός καὶ ἦν Ιωσηφ καλὸς τῷ εἴδει καὶ ὡραῖος τῇ ὄψει σφόδρα

text_en: And after many days, his mistress cast her eyes on Joseph , and said: Lie with me.
text_la: Post multos itaque dies injecit domina sua oculos suos in Joseph, et ait : Dormi mecum.
text_pt: E aconteceu depois destas coisas que a mulher do seu senhor pôs os seus olhos em José, e disse: Deita-te comigo.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα καὶ ἐπέβαλεν ἡ γυνὴ τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς αὐτῆς ἐπὶ Ιωσηφ καὶ εἶπεν κοιμήθητι μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: But he in no wise consenting to that wicked act said to her: Behold, my master has delivered all things to me, and knows not what he has in his own house:
text_la: Qui nequaquam acquiescens operi nefario, dixit ad eam : Ecce dominus meus, omnibus mihi traditis, ignorat quid habeat in domo sua:
text_pt: Porém ele recusou, e disse à mulher do seu senhor: Eis que o meu senhor não sabe do que há em casa comigo, e entregou em minha mão tudo o que tem;
text_el: ὁ δὲ οὐκ ἤθελεν εἶπεν δὲ τῇ γυναικὶ τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ εἰ ὁ κύριός μου οὐ γινώσκει δι' ἐμὲ οὐδὲν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν αὐτῷ ἔδωκεν εἰς τὰς χεῖράς μου

text_en: Neither is there anything which is not in my power, or that he has not delivered to me, but you, who are his wife; how then can I do this wicked thing , and sin against my God ?
text_la: nec quidquam est quod non in mea sit potestate, vel non tradiderit mihi, præter te, quæ uxor ejus es : quomodo ergo possum hoc malum facere, et peccare in Deum meum?
text_pt: Ninguém há maior do que eu nesta casa, e nenhuma coisa me vedou, senão a ti, porquanto tu és sua mulher; como pois faria eu tamanha maldade, e pecaria contra Deus?
text_el: καὶ οὐχ ὑπερέχει ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ταύτῃ οὐθὲν ἐμοῦ οὐδὲ ὑπεξῄρηται ἀπ' ἐμοῦ οὐδὲν πλὴν σοῦ διὰ τὸ σὲ γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ εἶναι καὶ πῶς ποιήσω τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ πονηρὸν τοῦτο καὶ ἁμαρτήσομαι ἐναντίον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: With such words as these day by day, both the woman was importunate with the young man, and he refused the adultery .
text_la: Hujuscemodi verbis per singulos dies, et mulier molesta erat adolescenti : et ille recusabat stuprum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que falando ela cada dia a José, e não lhe dando ele ouvidos, para deitar-se com ela, e estar com ela,
text_el: ἡνίκα δὲ ἐλάλει τῷ Ιωσηφ ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας καὶ οὐχ ὑπήκουσεν αὐτῇ καθεύδειν μετ' αὐτῆς τοῦ συγγενέσθαι αὐτῇ

text_en: Now it happened on a certain day, that Joseph went into the house, and was doing some business, without any man with him:
text_la: Accidit autem quadam die ut intraret Joseph domum, et operis quippiam absque arbitris faceret:
text_pt: Sucedeu num certo dia que ele veio à casa para fazer seu serviço; e nenhum dos da casa estava ali;
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ τοιαύτη τις ἡμέρα εἰσῆλθεν Ιωσηφ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν ποιεῖν τὰ ἔργα αὐτοῦ καὶ οὐθεὶς ἦν τῶν ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ ἔσω

text_en: And she catching the skirt of his garment, said: Lie with me. But he leaving the garment in her hand, fled, and went out.
text_la: et illa, apprehensa lacinia vestimenti ejus, diceret : Dormi mecum. Qui relicto in manu ejus pallio fugit, et egressus est foras.
text_pt: E ela lhe pegou pela sua roupa, dizendo: Deita-te comigo. E ele deixou a sua roupa na mão dela, e fugiu, e saiu para fora.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεσπάσατο αὐτὸν τῶν ἱματίων λέγουσα κοιμήθητι μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ καταλιπὼν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῆς ἔφυγεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω

text_en: And when the woman saw the garment in her hands, and herself disregarded,
text_la: Cumque vidisset mulier vestem in manibus suis, et se esse contemptam,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, vendo ela que deixara a sua roupa em sua mão, e fugira para fora,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς εἶδεν ὅτι κατέλιπεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῆς καὶ ἔφυγεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω

text_en: she called to her the men of her house, and said to them: See, he has brought in a Hebrew, to abuse us: he came in to me, to lie with me; and when I cried out,
text_la: vocavit ad se homines domus suæ, et ait ad eos : En introduxit virum hebræum, ut illuderet nobis : ingressus est ad me, ut coiret mecum : cumque ego succlamassem,
text_pt: Chamou aos homens de sua casa, e falou-lhes, dizendo: Vede, meu marido trouxe-nos um homem hebreu para escarnecer de nós; veio a mim para deitar-se comigo, e eu gritei com grande voz;
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τοὺς ὄντας ἐν τῇ οἰκίᾳ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς λέγουσα ἴδετε εἰσήγαγεν ἡμῖν παῖδα Εβραῖον ἐμπαίζειν ἡμῖν εἰσῆλθεν πρός με λέγων κοιμήθητι μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἐβόησα φωνῇ μεγάλῃ

text_en: and he heard my voice, he left the garment that I held, and got him out.
text_la: et audisset vocem meam, reliquit pallium quod tenebam, et fugit foras.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ouvindo ele que eu levantava a minha voz e gritava, deixou a sua roupa comigo, e fugiu, e saiu para fora.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ ἀκοῦσαι αὐτὸν ὅτι ὕψωσα τὴν φωνήν μου καὶ ἐβόησα καταλιπὼν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ παρ' ἐμοὶ ἔφυγεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω

text_en: For a proof therefore of her fidelity , she kept the garment, and showed it to her husband when he returned home:
text_la: In argumentum ergo fidei retentum pallium ostendit marito revertenti domum,
text_pt: E ela pôs a sua roupa perto de si, até que o seu senhor voltou à sua casa.
text_el: καὶ καταλιμπάνει τὰ ἱμάτια παρ' ἑαυτῇ ἕως ἦλθεν ὁ κύριος εἰς τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And said: The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought, came to me to abuse me.
text_la: et ait : Ingressus est ad me servus hebræus quem adduxisti, ut illuderet mihi:
text_pt: Então falou-lhe conforme as mesmas palavras, dizendo: Veio a mim o servo hebreu, que nos trouxeste, para escarnecer de mim;
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῷ κατὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα λέγουσα εἰσῆλθεν πρός με ὁ παῖς ὁ Εβραῖος ὃν εἰσήγαγες πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἐμπαῖξαί μοι καὶ εἶπέν μοι κοιμηθήσομαι μετὰ σοῦ

text_en: And when he heard me cry, he left the garment which I held, and fled out.
text_la: cumque audisset me clamare, reliquit pallium quod tenebam, et fugit foras.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, levantando eu a minha voz e gritando, ele deixou a sua roupa comigo, e fugiu para fora.
text_el: ὡς δὲ ἤκουσεν ὅτι ὕψωσα τὴν φωνήν μου καὶ ἐβόησα κατέλιπεν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ παρ' ἐμοὶ καὶ ἔφυγεν καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ἔξω

text_en: His master hearing these things, and giving too much credit to his wife's words, was very angry ,
text_la: His auditis dominus, et nimium credulus verbis conjugis, iratus est valde:
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ouvindo o seu senhor as palavras de sua mulher, que lhe falava, dizendo: Conforme a estas mesmas palavras me fez teu servo, a sua ira se acendeu.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ὡς ἤκουσεν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ τὰ ῥήματα τῆς γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ ὅσα ἐλάλησεν πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγουσα οὕτως ἐποίησέν μοι ὁ παῖς σου καὶ ἐθυμώθη ὀργῇ

text_en: and cast Joseph into the prison , where the king's prisoners were kept, and he was there shut up.
text_la: tradiditque Joseph in carcerem, ubi vincti regis custodiebantur, et erat ibi clausus.
text_pt: E o senhor de José o tomou, e o entregou na casa do cárcere, no lugar onde os presos do rei estavam encarcerados; assim esteve ali na casa do cárcere.
text_el: καὶ λαβὼν ὁ κύριος Ιωσηφ ἐνέβαλεν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ ὀχύρωμα εἰς τὸν τόπον ἐν ᾧ οἱ δεσμῶται τοῦ βασιλέως κατέχονται ἐκεῖ ἐν τῷ ὀχυρώματι

text_en: But the Lord was with Joseph , and having mercy upon him gave him favour in the sight of the chief keeper of the prison :
text_la: Fuit autem Dominus cum Joseph, et misertus illius dedit ei gratiam in conspectu principis carceris.
text_pt: O Senhor, porém, estava com José, e estendeu sobre ele a sua benignidade, e deu-lhe graça aos olhos do carcereiro-mor.
text_el: καὶ ἦν κύριος μετὰ Ιωσηφ καὶ κατέχεεν αὐτοῦ ἔλεος καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ χάριν ἐναντίον τοῦ ἀρχιδεσμοφύλακος

text_en: Who delivered into his hand all the prisoners that were kept in custody: and whatsoever was done, was under him.
text_la: Qui tradidit in manu illius universos vinctos qui in custodia tenebantur : et quidquid fiebat, sub ipso erat.
text_pt: E o carcereiro-mor entregou na mão de José todos os presos que estavam na casa do cárcere, e ele ordenava tudo o que se fazia ali.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ ἀρχιδεσμοφύλαξ τὸ δεσμωτήριον διὰ χειρὸς Ιωσηφ καὶ πάντας τοὺς ἀπηγμένους ὅσοι ἐν τῷ δεσμωτηρίῳ καὶ πάντα ὅσα ποιοῦσιν ἐκεῖ

text_en: Neither did he himself know anything, having committed all things to him: for the Lord was with him, and made all that he did to prosper.
text_la: Nec noverat aliquid, cunctis ei creditis : Dominus enim erat cum illo, et omnia opera ejus dirigebat.
text_pt: E o carcereiro-mor não teve cuidado de nenhuma coisa que estava na mão dele, porquanto o Senhor estava com ele, e tudo o que fazia o Senhor prosperava.
text_el: οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἀρχιδεσμοφύλαξ τοῦ δεσμωτηρίου γινώσκων δι' αὐτὸν οὐθέν πάντα γὰρ ἦν διὰ χειρὸς Ιωσηφ διὰ τὸ τὸν κύριον μετ' αὐτοῦ εἶναι καὶ ὅσα αὐτὸς ἐποίει κύριος εὐώδου ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτοῦ

text_en: After this, it came to pass, that two eunuchs, the butler and the baker of the king of Egypt , offended their lord.
text_la: His ita gestis, accidit ut peccarent duo eunuchi, pincerna regis Ægypti, et pistor, domino suo.
text_pt: E aconteceu, depois destas coisas, que o copeiro do rei do Egito, e o seu padeiro, ofenderam o seu senhor, o rei do Egito.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα ἥμαρτεν ὁ ἀρχιοινοχόος τοῦ βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου καὶ ὁ ἀρχισιτοποιὸς τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτῶν βασιλεῖ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And Pharao being angry with them, (now the one was chief butler, the other chief baker),
text_la: Iratusque contra eos Pharao (nam alter pincernis præerat, alter pistoribus),
text_pt: E indignou-se Faraó muito contra os seus dois oficiais, contra o copeiro-mor e contra o padeiro-mor.
text_el: καὶ ὠργίσθη Φαραω ἐπὶ τοῖς δυσὶν εὐνούχοις αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῷ ἀρχιοινοχόῳ καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ ἀρχισιτοποιῷ

text_en: he sent them to the prison of the commander of the soldiers, in which Joseph also was prisoner.
text_la: misit eos in carcerem principis militum, in quo erat vinctus et Joseph.
text_pt: E entregou-os à prisão, na casa do capitão da guarda, na casa do cárcere, no lugar onde José estava preso.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο αὐτοὺς ἐν φυλακῇ παρὰ τῷ δεσμοφύλακι εἰς τὸ δεσμωτήριον εἰς τὸν τόπον οὗ Ιωσηφ ἀπῆκτο ἐκεῖ

text_en: But the keeper of the prison delivered them to Joseph , and he served them. Some little time passed, and they were kept in custody.
text_la: At custos carceris tradidit eos Joseph, qui et ministrabat eis : aliquantulum temporis fluxerat, et illi in custodia tenebantur.
text_pt: E o capitão da guarda pô-los a cargo de José, para que os servisse; e estiveram muitos dias na prisão.
text_el: καὶ συνέστησεν ὁ ἀρχιδεσμώτης τῷ Ιωσηφ αὐτούς καὶ παρέστη αὐτοῖς ἦσαν δὲ ἡμέρας ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ

text_en: And they both dreamed a dream the same night, according to the interpretation agreeing to themselves:
text_la: Videruntque ambo somnium nocte una, juxta interpretationem congruam sibi:
text_pt: E ambos tiveram um sonho, cada um seu sonho, na mesma noite, cada um conforme a interpretação do seu sonho, o copeiro e o padeiro do rei do Egito, que estavam presos na casa do cárcere.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον ἀμφότεροι ἐνύπνιον ἑκάτερος ἐνύπνιον ἐν μιᾷ νυκτὶ ὅρασις τοῦ ἐνυπνίου αὐτοῦ ὁ ἀρχιοινοχόος καὶ ὁ ἀρχισιτοποιός οἳ ἦσαν τῷ βασιλεῖ Αἰγύπτου οἱ ὄντες ἐν τῷ δεσμωτηρίῳ

text_en: And when Joseph had come into them in the morning, and saw them sad,
text_la: ad quos cum introisset Joseph mane, et vidisset eos tristes,
text_pt: E veio José a eles pela manhã, e olhou para eles, e viu que estavam perturbados.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτοὺς Ιωσηφ τὸ πρωὶ καὶ εἶδεν αὐτούς καὶ ἦσαν τεταραγμένοι

text_en: he asked them, saying: Why is your countenance sadder today than usual?
text_la: sciscitatus est eos, dicens : Cur tristior est hodie solito facies vestra?
text_pt: Então perguntou aos oficiais de Faraó, que com ele estavam no cárcere da casa de seu senhor, dizendo: Por que estão hoje tristes os vossos semblantes?
text_el: καὶ ἠρώτα τοὺς εὐνούχους Φαραω οἳ ἦσαν μετ' αὐτοῦ ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ παρὰ τῷ κυρίῳ αὐτοῦ λέγων τί ὅτι τὰ πρόσωπα ὑμῶν σκυθρωπὰ σήμερον

text_en: They answered: We have dreamed a dream, and there is nobody to interpret it to us. And Joseph said to them: Does not interpretation belong to God ? Tell me what you have dreamed:
text_la: Qui responderunt : Somnium vidimus, et non est qui interpretetur nobis. Dixitque ad eos Joseph : Numquid non Dei est interpretatio? referte mihi quid videritis.
text_pt: E eles lhe disseram: Tivemos um sonho, e ninguém há que o interprete. E José disse-lhes: Não são de Deus as interpretações? Contai-mo, peço-vos.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ ἐνύπνιον εἴδομεν καὶ ὁ συγκρίνων οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτό εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ιωσηφ οὐχὶ διὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡ διασάφησις αὐτῶν ἐστιν διηγήσασθε οὖν μοι

text_en: The chief butler first told his dream: I saw before me a vine,
text_la: Narravit prior, præpositus pincernarum, somnium suum : Videbam coram me vitem,
text_pt: Então contou o copeiro-mor o seu sonho a José, e disse-lhe: Eis que em meu sonho havia uma vide diante da minha face.
text_el: καὶ διηγήσατο ὁ ἀρχιοινοχόος τὸ ἐνύπνιον αὐτοῦ τῷ Ιωσηφ καὶ εἶπεν ἐν τῷ ὕπνῳ μου ἦν ἄμπελος ἐναντίον μου

text_en: on which were three branches, which by little and little sent out buds, and after the blossoms brought forth ripe grapes:
text_la: in qua erant tres propagines, crescere paulatim in gemmas, et post flores uvas maturescere:
text_pt: E na vide três sarmentos, e brotando ela, a sua flor saía, e os seus cachos amadureciam em uvas;
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῇ ἀμπέλῳ τρεῖς πυθμένες καὶ αὐτὴ θάλλουσα ἀνενηνοχυῖα βλαστούς πέπειροι οἱ βότρυες σταφυλῆς

text_en: And the cup of Pharao was in my hand: and I took the grapes, and pressed them into the cup which I held, and I gave the cup to Pharao .
text_la: calicemque Pharaonis in manu mea : tuli ergo uvas, et expressi in calicem quem tenebam, et tradidi poculum Pharaoni.
text_pt: E o copo de Faraó estava na minha mão, e eu tomava as uvas, e as espremia no copo de Faraó, e dava o copo na mão de Faraó.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ποτήριον Φαραω ἐν τῇ χειρί μου καὶ ἔλαβον τὴν σταφυλὴν καὶ ἐξέθλιψα αὐτὴν εἰς τὸ ποτήριον καὶ ἔδωκα τὸ ποτήριον εἰς τὰς χεῖρας Φαραω

text_en: Joseph answered: This is the interpretation of the dream : The three branches, are yet three days:
text_la: Respondit Joseph : Hæc est interpretatio somnii : tres propagines, tres adhuc dies sunt:
text_pt: Então disse-lhe José: Esta é a sua interpretação: Os três sarmentos são três dias;
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ιωσηφ τοῦτο ἡ σύγκρισις αὐτοῦ οἱ τρεῖς πυθμένες τρεῖς ἡμέραι εἰσίν

text_en: After which Pharao will remember your service, and will restore you to your former place: and you shall present him the cup according to your office, as before you were wont to do.
text_la: post quos recordabitur Pharao ministerii tui, et restituet te in gradum pristinum : dabisque ei calicem juxta officium tuum, sicut ante facere consueveras.
text_pt: Dentro ainda de três dias Faraó levantará a tua cabeça, e te restaurará ao teu estado, e darás o copo de Faraó na sua mão, conforme o costume antigo, quando eras seu copeiro.
text_el: ἔτι τρεῖς ἡμέραι καὶ μνησθήσεται Φαραω τῆς ἀρχῆς σου καὶ ἀποκαταστήσει σε ἐπὶ τὴν ἀρχιοινοχοΐαν σου καὶ δώσεις τὸ ποτήριον Φαραω εἰς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ κατὰ τὴν ἀρχήν σου τὴν προτέραν ὡς ἦσθα οἰνοχοῶν

text_en: Only remember me when it shall be well with you, and do me this kindness: to put Pharao in mind to take me out of this prison :
text_la: Tantum memento mei, cum bene tibi fuerit, et facias mecum misericordiam : ut suggeras Pharaoni ut educat me de isto carcere:
text_pt: Porém lembra-te de mim, quando te for bem; e rogo-te que uses comigo de compaixão, e que faças menção de mim a Faraó, e faze-me sair desta casa;
text_el: ἀλλὰ μνήσθητί μου διὰ σεαυτοῦ ὅταν εὖ σοι γένηται καὶ ποιήσεις ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔλεος καὶ μνησθήσῃ περὶ ἐμοῦ Φαραω καὶ ἐξάξεις με ἐκ τοῦ ὀχυρώματος τούτου

text_en: For I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here without any fault was cast into the dungeon .
text_la: quia furto sublatus sum de terra Hebræorum, et hic innocens in lacum missus sum.
text_pt: Porque, de fato, fui roubado da terra dos hebreus; e tampouco aqui nada tenho feito para que me pusessem nesta cova.
text_el: ὅτι κλοπῇ ἐκλάπην ἐκ γῆς Εβραίων καὶ ὧδε οὐκ ἐποίησα οὐδέν ἀλλ' ἐνέβαλόν με εἰς τὸν λάκκον τοῦτον

text_en: The chief baker seeing that he had wisely interpreted the dream , said: I also dreamed a dream, That I had three baskets of meal upon my head:
text_la: Videns pistorum magister quod prudenter somnium dissolvisset, ait : Et ego vidi somnium : quod tria canistra farinæ haberem super caput meum:
text_pt: Vendo então o padeiro-mor que tinha interpretado bem, disse a José: Eu também sonhei, e eis que três cestos brancos estavam sobre a minha cabeça;
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν ὁ ἀρχισιτοποιὸς ὅτι ὀρθῶς συνέκρινεν καὶ εἶπεν τῷ Ιωσηφ κἀγὼ εἶδον ἐνύπνιον καὶ ᾤμην τρία κανᾶ χονδριτῶν αἴρειν ἐπὶ τῆς κεφαλῆς μου

text_en: And that in one basket which was uppermost, I carried all meats that are made by the art of baking, and that the birds ate out of it.
text_la: et in uno canistro quod erat excelsius, portare me omnes cibos qui fiunt arte pistoria, avesque comedere ex eo.
text_pt: E no cesto mais alto havia de todos os manjares de Faraó, obra de padeiro; e as aves o comiam do cesto, de sobre a minha cabeça.
text_el: ἐν δὲ τῷ κανῷ τῷ ἐπάνω ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν γενῶν ὧν ὁ βασιλεὺς Φαραω ἐσθίει ἔργον σιτοποιοῦ καὶ τὰ πετεινὰ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ κατήσθιεν αὐτὰ ἀπὸ τοῦ κανοῦ τοῦ ἐπάνω τῆς κεφαλῆς μου

text_en: Joseph answered: This is the interpretation of the dream : The three baskets, are yet three days:
text_la: Respondit Joseph : Hæc est interpretatio somnii : tria canistra, tres adhuc dies sunt:
text_pt: Então respondeu José, e disse: Esta é a sua interpretação: Os três cestos são três dias;
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ιωσηφ εἶπεν αὐτῷ αὕτη ἡ σύγκρισις αὐτοῦ τὰ τρία κανᾶ τρεῖς ἡμέραι εἰσίν

text_en: After which Pharao will take your head from you, and hang you on a cross , and the birds shall tear your flesh.
text_la: post quos auferet Pharao caput tuum, ac suspendet te in cruce, et lacerabunt volucres carnes tuas.
text_pt: Dentro ainda de três dias Faraó tirará a tua cabeça e te pendurará num pau, e as aves comerão a tua carne de sobre ti.
text_el: ἔτι τριῶν ἡμερῶν ἀφελεῖ Φαραω τὴν κεφαλήν σου ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ κρεμάσει σε ἐπὶ ξύλου καὶ φάγεται τὰ ὄρνεα τοῦ οὐρανοῦ τὰς σάρκας σου ἀπὸ σοῦ

text_en: The third day after this was the birthday of Pharao : and he made a great feast for his servants, and at the banquet remembered the chief butler, and the chief baker.
text_la: Exinde dies tertius natalitius Pharaonis erat : qui faciens grande convivium pueris suis, recordatus est inter epulas magistri pincernarum, et pistorum principis.
text_pt: E aconteceu ao terceiro dia, o dia do nascimento de Faraó, que fez um banquete a todos os seus servos; e levantou a cabeça do copeiro-mor, e a cabeça do padeiro-mor, no meio dos seus servos.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ ἡμέρα γενέσεως ἦν Φαραω καὶ ἐποίει πότον πᾶσι τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐμνήσθη τῆς ἀρχῆς τοῦ ἀρχιοινοχόου καὶ τῆς ἀρχῆς τοῦ ἀρχισιτοποιοῦ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν παίδων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he restored the one to his place, to present him the cup:
text_la: Restituitque alterum in locum suum, ut porrigeret ei poculum:
text_pt: E fez tornar o copeiro-mor ao seu ofício de copeiro, e este deu o copo na mão de Faraó,
text_el: καὶ ἀπεκατέστησεν τὸν ἀρχιοινοχόον ἐπὶ τὴν ἀρχὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν τὸ ποτήριον εἰς τὴν χεῖρα Φαραω

text_en: The other he hanged on a gibbet, that the truth of the interpreter might be shown.
text_la: alterum suspendit in patibulo, ut conjectoris veritas probaretur.
text_pt: Mas ao padeiro-mor enforcou, como José havia interpretado.
text_el: τὸν δὲ ἀρχισιτοποιὸν ἐκρέμασεν καθὰ συνέκρινεν αὐτοῖς Ιωσηφ

text_en: But the chief butler, when things prospered with him, forgot his interpreter.
text_la: Et tamen succedentibus prosperis, præpositus pincernarum oblitus est interpretis sui.
text_pt: O copeiro-mor, porém, não se lembrou de José, antes se esqueceu dele.
text_el: οὐκ ἐμνήσθη δὲ ὁ ἀρχιοινοχόος τοῦ Ιωσηφ ἀλλὰ ἐπελάθετο αὐτοῦ

text_en: After two years Pharao had a dream. He thought he stood by the river,
text_la: Post duos annos vidit Pharao somnium. Putabat se stare super fluvium,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, ao fim de dois anos inteiros, Faraó sonhou, e eis que estava em pé junto ao rio.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ δύο ἔτη ἡμερῶν Φαραω εἶδεν ἐνύπνιον ᾤετο ἑστάναι ἐπὶ τοῦ ποταμοῦ

text_en: out of which came up seven kine, very beautiful and fat: and they fed in marshy places.
text_la: de quo ascendebant septem boves, pulchræ et crassæ nimis : et pascebantur in locis palustribus.
text_pt: E eis que subiam do rio sete vacas, formosas à vista e gordas de carne, e pastavam no prado.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ὥσπερ ἐκ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἀνέβαινον ἑπτὰ βόες καλαὶ τῷ εἴδει καὶ ἐκλεκταὶ ταῖς σαρξὶν καὶ ἐβόσκοντο ἐν τῷ ἄχει

text_en: Other seven also came up out of the river, ill favoured, and lean fleshed: and they fed on the very bank of the river, in green places:
text_la: Aliæ quoque septem emergebant de flumine, fœdæ confectæque macie : et pascebantur in ipsa amnis ripa in locis virentibus:
text_pt: E eis que subiam do rio após elas outras sete vacas, feias à vista e magras de carne; e paravam junto às outras vacas na praia do rio.
text_el: ἄλλαι δὲ ἑπτὰ βόες ἀνέβαινον μετὰ ταύτας ἐκ τοῦ ποταμοῦ αἰσχραὶ τῷ εἴδει καὶ λεπταὶ ταῖς σαρξὶν καὶ ἐνέμοντο παρὰ τὰς βόας παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τοῦ ποταμοῦ

text_en: And they devoured them, whose bodies were very beautiful and well conditioned. So Pharao awoke.
text_la: devoraveruntque eas, quarum mira species et habitudo corporum erat. Expergefactus Pharao,
text_pt: E as vacas feias à vista e magras de carne, comiam as sete vacas formosas à vista e gordas. Então acordou Faraó.
text_el: καὶ κατέφαγον αἱ ἑπτὰ βόες αἱ αἰσχραὶ καὶ λεπταὶ ταῖς σαρξὶν τὰς ἑπτὰ βόας τὰς καλὰς τῷ εἴδει καὶ τὰς ἐκλεκτάς ἠγέρθη δὲ Φαραω

text_en: He slept again, and dreamed another dream: Seven ears of corn came up upon one stalk full and fair:
text_la: rursum dormivit, et vidit alterum somnium : septem spicæ pullulabant in culmo uno plenæ atque formosæ:
text_pt: Depois dormiu e sonhou outra vez, e eis que brotavam de um mesmo pé sete espigas cheias e boas.
text_el: καὶ ἐνυπνιάσθη τὸ δεύτερον καὶ ἰδοὺ ἑπτὰ στάχυες ἀνέβαινον ἐν πυθμένι ἑνὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ καὶ καλοί

text_en: Then seven other ears sprung up thin and blasted,
text_la: aliæ quoque totidem spicæ tenues, et percussæ uredine oriebantur,
text_pt: E eis que sete espigas miúdas, e queimadas do vento oriental, brotavam após elas.
text_el: ἄλλοι δὲ ἑπτὰ στάχυες λεπτοὶ καὶ ἀνεμόφθοροι ἀνεφύοντο μετ' αὐτούς

text_en: and devoured all the beauty of the former. Pharao awaked after his rest:
text_la: devorantes omnium priorum pulchritudinem. Evigilans Pharao post quietem,
text_pt: E as espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas grandes e cheias. Então acordou Faraó, e eis que era um sonho.
text_el: καὶ κατέπιον οἱ ἑπτὰ στάχυες οἱ λεπτοὶ καὶ ἀνεμόφθοροι τοὺς ἑπτὰ στάχυας τοὺς ἐκλεκτοὺς καὶ τοὺς πλήρεις ἠγέρθη δὲ Φαραω καὶ ἦν ἐνύπνιον

text_en: And when morning had come, being struck with fear, he sent to all the interpreters of Egypt , and to all the wise men : and they being called for, he told them his dream, and there was not any one that could interpret it.
text_la: et facto mane, pavore perterritus, misit ad omnes conjectores Ægypti, cunctosque sapientes, et accersitis narravit somnium, nec erat qui interpretaretur.
text_pt: E aconteceu que pela manhã o seu espírito perturbou-se, e enviou e chamou todos os adivinhadores do Egito, e todos os seus sábios; e Faraó contou-lhes os seus sonhos, mas ninguém havia que lhos interpretasse.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ πρωὶ καὶ ἐταράχθη ἡ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀποστείλας ἐκάλεσεν πάντας τοὺς ἐξηγητὰς Αἰγύπτου καὶ πάντας τοὺς σοφοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ διηγήσατο αὐτοῖς Φαραω τὸ ἐνύπνιον καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἀπαγγέλλων αὐτὸ τῷ Φαραω

text_en: Then at length the chief butler remembering, said: I confess my sin :
text_la: Tunc demum reminiscens pincernarum magister, ait : Confiteor peccatum meum:
text_pt: Então falou o copeiro-mor a Faraó, dizendo: Das minhas ofensas me lembro hoje:
text_el: καὶ ἐλάλησεν ὁ ἀρχιοινοχόος πρὸς Φαραω λέγων τὴν ἁμαρτίαν μου ἀναμιμνῄσκω σήμερον

text_en: The king being angry with his servants, commanded me and the chief baker to be cast into the prison of the captain of the soldiers.
text_la: iratus rex servis suis, me et magistrum pistorum retrudi jussit in carcerem principis militum:
text_pt: Estando Faraó muito indignado contra os seus servos, e pondo-me sob prisão na casa do capitão da guarda, a mim e ao padeiro-mor,
text_el: Φαραω ὠργίσθη τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔθετο ἡμᾶς ἐν φυλακῇ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ ἀρχιμαγείρου ἐμέ τε καὶ τὸν ἀρχισιτοποιόν

text_en: Where in one night both of us dreamed a dream foreboding things to come.
text_la: ubi una nocte uterque vidimus somnium præsagum futurorum.
text_pt: Então tivemos um sonho na mesma noite, eu e ele; sonhamos, cada um conforme a interpretação do seu sonho.
text_el: καὶ εἴδομεν ἐνύπνιον ἐν νυκτὶ μιᾷ ἐγώ τε καὶ αὐτός ἕκαστος κατὰ τὸ αὑτοῦ ἐνύπνιον εἴδομεν

text_en: There was there a young man a Hebrew, servant to the same captain of the soldiers: to whom we told our dreams,
text_la: Erat ibi puer hebræus, ejusdem ducis militum famulus : cui narrantes somnia,
text_pt: E estava ali conosco um jovem hebreu, servo do capitão da guarda, e contamos-lhe os nossos sonhos e ele no-los interpretou, a cada um conforme o seu sonho.
text_el: ἦν δὲ ἐκεῖ μεθ' ἡμῶν νεανίσκος παῖς Εβραῖος τοῦ ἀρχιμαγείρου καὶ διηγησάμεθα αὐτῷ καὶ συνέκρινεν ἡμῖν

text_en: and we heard what afterwards the event of the thing proved to be so. For I was restored to my office: and he was hanged upon a gibbet.
text_la: audivimus quidquid postea rei probavit eventus; ego enim redditus sum officio meo, et ille suspensus est in cruce.
text_pt: E como ele nos interpretou, assim aconteceu; a mim me foi restituído o meu cargo, e ele foi enforcado.
text_el: ἐγενήθη δὲ καθὼς συνέκρινεν ἡμῖν οὕτως καὶ συνέβη ἐμέ τε ἀποκατασταθῆναι ἐπὶ τὴν ἀρχήν μου ἐκεῖνον δὲ κρεμασθῆναι

text_en: Forthwith at the king's command Joseph was brought out of the prison , and they shaved him: and changing his apparel brought him in to him.
text_la: Protinus ad regis imperium eductum de carcere Joseph totonderunt: ac veste mutata obtulerunt ei.
text_pt: Então mandou Faraó chamar a José, e o fizeram sair logo do cárcere; e barbeou-se e mudou as suas roupas e apresentou-se a Faraó.
text_el: ἀποστείλας δὲ Φαραω ἐκάλεσεν τὸν Ιωσηφ καὶ ἐξήγαγον αὐτὸν ἐκ τοῦ ὀχυρώματος καὶ ἐξύρησαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἤλλαξαν τὴν στολὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦλθεν πρὸς Φαραω

text_en: And he said to him: I have dreamed dreams, and there is no one that can expound them: Now I have heard that you are very wise at interpreting them:
text_la: Cui ille ait : Vidi somnia, nec est qui edisserat : quæ audivi te sapientissime conjicere.
text_pt: E Faraó disse a José: Eu tive um sonho, e ninguém há que o interprete; mas de ti ouvi dizer que quando ouves um sonho o interpretas.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Φαραω τῷ Ιωσηφ ἐνύπνιον ἑώρακα καὶ ὁ συγκρίνων οὐκ ἔστιν αὐτό ἐγὼ δὲ ἀκήκοα περὶ σοῦ λεγόντων ἀκούσαντά σε ἐνύπνια συγκρῖναι αὐτά

text_en: Joseph answered: Without me, God shall give Pharao a prosperous answer.
text_la: Respondit Joseph: Absque me Deus respondebit prospera Pharaoni.
text_pt: E respondeu José a Faraó, dizendo: Isso não está em mim; Deus dará resposta de paz a Faraó.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ιωσηφ τῷ Φαραω εἶπεν ἄνευ τοῦ θεοῦ οὐκ ἀποκριθήσεται τὸ σωτήριον Φαραω

text_en: So Pharao told what he had dreamed: Methought I stood upon the bank of the river,
text_la: Narravit ergo Pharao quod viderat : Putabam me stare super ripam fluminis,
text_pt: Então disse Faraó a José: Eis que em meu sonho estava eu em pé na margem do rio,
text_el: ἐλάλησεν δὲ Φαραω τῷ Ιωσηφ λέγων ἐν τῷ ὕπνῳ μου ᾤμην ἑστάναι παρὰ τὸ χεῖλος τοῦ ποταμοῦ

text_en: and seven kine came up out of the river, exceeding beautiful and full of flesh: and they grazed on green places in a marshy pasture.
text_la: et septem boves de amne conscendere, pulchras nimis, et obesis carnibus : quæ in pastu paludis virecta carpebant.
text_pt: E eis que subiam do rio sete vacas gordas de carne e formosas à vista, e pastavam no prado.
text_el: καὶ ὥσπερ ἐκ τοῦ ποταμοῦ ἀνέβαινον ἑπτὰ βόες καλαὶ τῷ εἴδει καὶ ἐκλεκταὶ ταῖς σαρξὶν καὶ ἐνέμοντο ἐν τῷ ἄχει

text_en: And behold, there followed these, other seven kine, so very ill favoured and lean, that I never saw the like in the land of Egypt :
text_la: Et ecce, has sequebantur aliæ septem boves, in tantum deformes et macilentæ, ut numquam tales in terra Ægypti viderim:
text_pt: E eis que outras sete vacas subiam após estas, muito feias à vista e magras de carne; não tenho visto outras tais, quanto à fealdade, em toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἰδοὺ ἑπτὰ βόες ἕτεραι ἀνέβαινον ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ἐκ τοῦ ποταμοῦ πονηραὶ καὶ αἰσχραὶ τῷ εἴδει καὶ λεπταὶ ταῖς σαρξίν οἵας οὐκ εἶδον τοιαύτας ἐν ὅλῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ αἰσχροτέρας

text_en: And they devoured and consumed the former,
text_la: quæ, devoratis et consumptis prioribus,
text_pt: E as vacas magras e feias comiam as primeiras sete vacas gordas;
text_el: καὶ κατέφαγον αἱ ἑπτὰ βόες αἱ αἰσχραὶ καὶ λεπταὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ βόας τὰς πρώτας τὰς καλὰς καὶ ἐκλεκτάς

text_en: and yet gave no mark of their being full: but were as lean and ill favoured as before. I awoke, and then fell asleep again,
text_la: nullum saturitatis dedere vestigium : sed simili macie et squalore torpebant. Evigilans, rursus sopore depressus,
text_pt: E entravam em suas entranhas, mas não se conhecia que houvessem entrado; porque o seu parecer era feio como no princípio. Então acordei.
text_el: καὶ εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὰς κοιλίας αὐτῶν καὶ οὐ διάδηλοι ἐγένοντο ὅτι εἰσῆλθον εἰς τὰς κοιλίας αὐτῶν καὶ αἱ ὄψεις αὐτῶν αἰσχραὶ καθὰ καὶ τὴν ἀρχήν ἐξεγερθεὶς δὲ ἐκοιμήθην

text_en: and dreamed a dream: Seven ears of corn grew up upon one stalk, full and very fair.
text_la: vidi somnium. Septem spicæ pullulabant in culmo uno plenæ atque pulcherrimæ.
text_pt: Depois vi em meu sonho, e eis que de um mesmo pé subiam sete espigas cheias e boas;
text_el: καὶ εἶδον πάλιν ἐν τῷ ὕπνῳ μου καὶ ὥσπερ ἑπτὰ στάχυες ἀνέβαινον ἐν πυθμένι ἑνὶ πλήρεις καὶ καλοί

text_en: Other seven also thin and blasted, sprung of the stalk:
text_la: Aliæ quoque septem tenues et percussæ uredine, oriebantur e stipula:
text_pt: E eis que sete espigas secas, miúdas e queimadas do vento oriental, brotavam após elas.
text_el: ἄλλοι δὲ ἑπτὰ στάχυες λεπτοὶ καὶ ἀνεμόφθοροι ἀνεφύοντο ἐχόμενοι αὐτῶν

text_en: And they devoured the beauty of the former: I told this dream to the conjecturers, and there is no man that can expound it.
text_la: quæ priorum pulchritudinem devoraverunt. Narravi conjectoribus somnium, et nemo est qui edisserat.
text_pt: E as sete espigas miúdas devoravam as sete espigas boas. E eu contei isso aos magos, mas ninguém houve que mo interpretasse.
text_el: καὶ κατέπιον οἱ ἑπτὰ στάχυες οἱ λεπτοὶ καὶ ἀνεμόφθοροι τοὺς ἑπτὰ στάχυας τοὺς καλοὺς καὶ τοὺς πλήρεις εἶπα οὖν τοῖς ἐξηγηταῖς καὶ οὐκ ἦν ὁ ἀπαγγέλλων μοι

text_en: Joseph answered: The king's dream is one: God has shown to Pharao what he is about to do.
text_la: Respondit Joseph : Somnium regis unum est : quæ facturus est Deus, ostendit Pharaoni.
text_pt: Então disse José a Faraó: O sonho de Faraó é um só; o que Deus há de fazer, mostrou-o a Faraó.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσηφ τῷ Φαραω τὸ ἐνύπνιον Φαραω ἕν ἐστιν ὅσα ὁ θεὸς ποιεῖ ἔδειξεν τῷ Φαραω

text_en: The seven beautiful kine, and the seven full ears, are seven years of plenty: and both contain the same meaning of the dream.
text_la: Septem boves pulchræ, et septem spicæ plenæ, septem ubertatis anni sunt : eamdemque vim somnii comprehendunt.
text_pt: As sete vacas formosas são sete anos, as sete espigas formosas também são sete anos, o sonho é um só.
text_el: αἱ ἑπτὰ βόες αἱ καλαὶ ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἐστίν καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ στάχυες οἱ καλοὶ ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἐστίν τὸ ἐνύπνιον Φαραω ἕν ἐστιν

text_en: And the seven lean and thin kine that came up after them, and the seven thin ears that were blasted with the burning wind, are seven years of famine to come:
text_la: Septem quoque boves tenues atque macilentæ, quæ ascenderunt post eas, et septem spicæ tenues, et vento urente percussæ, septem anni venturæ sunt famis.
text_pt: E as sete vacas feias à vista e magras, que subiam depois delas, são sete anos, e as sete espigas miúdas e queimadas do vento oriental, serão sete anos de fome.
text_el: καὶ αἱ ἑπτὰ βόες αἱ λεπταὶ αἱ ἀναβαίνουσαι ὀπίσω αὐτῶν ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἐστίν καὶ οἱ ἑπτὰ στάχυες οἱ λεπτοὶ καὶ ἀνεμόφθοροι ἔσονται ἑπτὰ ἔτη λιμοῦ

text_en: Which shall be fulfilled in this order.
text_la: Qui hoc ordine complebuntur:
text_pt: Esta é a palavra que tenho dito a Faraó; o que Deus há de fazer, mostrou-o a Faraó.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ῥῆμα ὃ εἴρηκα Φαραω ὅσα ὁ θεὸς ποιεῖ ἔδειξεν τῷ Φαραω

text_en: Behold, there shall come seven years of great plenty in the whole land of Egypt :
text_la: ecce septem anni venient fertilitatis magnæ in universa terra Ægypti,
text_pt: E eis que vêm sete anos, e haverá grande fartura em toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἔρχεται εὐθηνία πολλὴ ἐν πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: After which shall follow other seven years of so great scarcity, that all the abundance before shall be forgotten: for the famine shall consume all the land,
text_la: quos sequentur septem anni alii tantæ sterilitatis, ut oblivioni tradatur cuncta retro abundantia : consumptura est enim fames omnem terram,
text_pt: E depois deles levantar-se-ão sete anos de fome, e toda aquela fartura será esquecida na terra do Egito, e a fome consumirá a terra;
text_el: ἥξει δὲ ἑπτὰ ἔτη λιμοῦ μετὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐπιλήσονται τῆς πλησμονῆς ἐν ὅλῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ἀναλώσει ὁ λιμὸς τὴν γῆν

text_en: and the greatness of the scarcity shall destroy the greatness of the plenty.
text_la: et ubertatis magnitudinem perditura est inopiæ magnitudo.
text_pt: E não será conhecida a abundância na terra, por causa daquela fome que haverá depois; porquanto será gravíssima.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἐπιγνωσθήσεται ἡ εὐθηνία ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ λιμοῦ τοῦ ἐσομένου μετὰ ταῦτα ἰσχυρὸς γὰρ ἔσται σφόδρα

text_en: And for that you saw the second time a dream pertaining to the same thing: it is a token of the certainty, and that the word of God comes to pass, and is fulfilled speedily.
text_la: Quod autem vidisti secundo ad eamdem rem pertinens somnium : firmitatis indicium est, eo quod fiat sermo Dei, et velocius impleatur.
text_pt: E que o sonho foi repetido duas vezes a Faraó, é porque esta coisa é determinada por Deus, e Deus se apressa em fazê-la.
text_el: περὶ δὲ τοῦ δευτερῶσαι τὸ ἐνύπνιον Φαραω δίς ὅτι ἀληθὲς ἔσται τὸ ῥῆμα τὸ παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ταχυνεῖ ὁ θεὸς τοῦ ποιῆσαι αὐτό

text_en: Now therefore let the king provide a wise and industrious man , and make him ruler over the land of Egypt :
text_la: Nunc ergo provideat rex virum sapientem et industrium, et præficiat eum terræ Ægypti:
text_pt: Portanto, Faraó previna-se agora de um homem entendido e sábio, e o ponha sobre a terra do Egito.
text_el: νῦν οὖν σκέψαι ἄνθρωπον φρόνιμον καὶ συνετὸν καὶ κατάστησον αὐτὸν ἐπὶ γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: That he may appoint overseers over all the countries: and gather into barns the fifth part of the fruits, during the seven fruitful years,
text_la: qui constituat præpositos per cunctas regiones: et quintam partem fructuum per septem annos fertilitatis,
text_pt: Faça isso Faraó e ponha governadores sobre a terra, e tome a quinta parte da terra do Egito nos sete anos de fartura,
text_el: καὶ ποιησάτω Φαραω καὶ καταστησάτω τοπάρχας ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἀποπεμπτωσάτωσαν πάντα τὰ γενήματα τῆς γῆς Αἰγύπτου τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐτῶν τῆς εὐθηνίας

text_en: that shall now presently ensue: and let all the corn be laid up, under Pharao's hands, and be reserved in the cities.
text_la: qui jam nunc futuri sunt, congreget in horrea : et omne frumentum sub Pharaonis potestate condatur, serveturque in urbibus.
text_pt: E ajuntem toda a comida destes bons anos, que vêm, e amontoem o trigo debaixo da mão de Faraó, para mantimento nas cidades, e o guardem.
text_el: καὶ συναγαγέτωσαν πάντα τὰ βρώματα τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐτῶν τῶν ἐρχομένων τῶν καλῶν τούτων καὶ συναχθήτω ὁ σῖτος ὑπὸ χεῖρα Φαραω βρώματα ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν φυλαχθήτω

text_en: And let it be in readiness, against the famine of seven years to come, which shall oppress Egypt , and the land shall not be consumed with scarcity.
text_la: Et præparetur futuræ septem annorum fami, quæ oppressura est Ægyptum, et non consumetur terra inopia.
text_pt: Assim será o mantimento para provimento da terra, para os sete anos de fome, que haverá na terra do Egito; para que a terra não pereça de fome.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὰ βρώματα πεφυλαγμένα τῇ γῇ εἰς τὰ ἑπτὰ ἔτη τοῦ λιμοῦ ἃ ἔσονται ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ οὐκ ἐκτριβήσεται ἡ γῆ ἐν τῷ λιμῷ

text_en: The counsel pleased Pharao , and all his servants.
text_la: Placuit Pharaoni consilium et cunctis ministris ejus:
text_pt: E esta palavra foi boa aos olhos de Faraó, e aos olhos de todos os seus servos.
text_el: ἤρεσεν δὲ τὰ ῥήματα ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ ἐναντίον πάντων τῶν παίδων αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he said to them: Can we find such another man , that is full of the spirit of God ?
text_la: locutusque est ad eos : Num invenire poterimus talem virum, qui spiritu Dei plenus sit?
text_pt: E disse Faraó a seus servos: Acharíamos um homem como este em quem haja o espírito de Deus?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Φαραω πᾶσιν τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ μὴ εὑρήσομεν ἄνθρωπον τοιοῦτον ὃς ἔχει πνεῦμα θεοῦ ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: He said therefore to Joseph : Seeing God has shown you all that you have said, can I find one wiser and one like unto you?
text_la: Dixit ergo ad Joseph : Quia ostendit tibi Deus omnia quæ locutus es, numquid sapientiorem et consimilem tui invenire potero?
text_pt: Depois disse Faraó a José: Pois que Deus te fez saber tudo isto, ninguém há tão entendido e sábio como tu.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Φαραω τῷ Ιωσηφ ἐπειδὴ ἔδειξεν ὁ θεός σοι πάντα ταῦτα οὐκ ἔστιν ἄνθρωπος φρονιμώτερος καὶ συνετώτερός σου

text_en: You shall be over my house, and at the commandment of your mouth all the people shall obey : only in the kingly throne will I be above you.
text_la: Tu eris super domum meam, et ad tui oris imperium cunctus populus obediet : uno tantum regni solio te præcedam.
text_pt: Tu estarás sobre a minha casa, e por tua boca se governará todo o meu povo, somente no trono eu serei maior que tu.
text_el: σὺ ἔσῃ ἐπὶ τῷ οἴκῳ μου καὶ ἐπὶ τῷ στόματί σου ὑπακούσεται πᾶς ὁ λαός μου πλὴν τὸν θρόνον ὑπερέξω σου ἐγώ

text_en: And again Pharao said to Joseph : Behold, I have appointed you over the whole land of Egypt .
text_la: Dixitque rursus Pharao ad Joseph : Ecce, constitui te super universam terram Ægypti.
text_pt: Disse mais Faraó a José: Vês aqui te tenho posto sobre toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Φαραω τῷ Ιωσηφ ἰδοὺ καθίστημί σε σήμερον ἐπὶ πάσης γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And he took his ring from his own hand, and gave it into his hand: and he put upon him a robe of silk, and put a chain of gold about his neck.
text_la: Tulitque annulum de manu sua, et dedit eum in manu ejus : vestivitque eum stola byssina, et collo torquem auream circumposuit.
text_pt: E tirou Faraó o anel da sua mão, e o pôs na mão de José, e o fez vestir de roupas de linho fino, e pôs um colar de ouro no seu pescoço.
text_el: καὶ περιελόμενος Φαραω τὸν δακτύλιον ἀπὸ τῆς χειρὸς αὐτοῦ περιέθηκεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὴν χεῖρα Ιωσηφ καὶ ἐνέδυσεν αὐτὸν στολὴν βυσσίνην καὶ περιέθηκεν κλοιὸν χρυσοῦν περὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he made him go up into his second chariot, the crier proclaiming that all should bow their knee before him, and that they should know he was made governor over the whole land of Egypt .
text_la: Fecitque eum ascendere super currum suum secundum, clamante præcone, ut omnes coram eo genu flecterent, et præpositum esse scirent universæ terræ Ægypti.
text_pt: E o fez subir no segundo carro que tinha, e clamavam diante dele: Ajoelhai. Assim o pôs sobre toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἀνεβίβασεν αὐτὸν ἐπὶ τὸ ἅρμα τὸ δεύτερον τῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκήρυξεν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ κῆρυξ καὶ κατέστησεν αὐτὸν ἐφ' ὅλης γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the king said to Joseph : I am Pharao : without your commandment no man shall move hand or foot in all the land of Egypt .
text_la: Dixit quoque rex ad Joseph : Ego sum Pharao : absque tuo imperio non movebit quisquam manum aut pedem in omni terra Ægypti.
text_pt: E disse Faraó a José: Eu sou Faraó; porém sem ti ninguém levantará a sua mão ou o seu pé em toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Φαραω τῷ Ιωσηφ ἐγὼ Φαραω ἄνευ σοῦ οὐκ ἐξαρεῖ οὐθεὶς τὴν χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And he turned his name , and called him in the Egyptian tongue the saviour of the world. And he gave him to wife Aseneth , the daughter of Putiphare, priest of Heliopolis. Then Joseph went out to the land of Egypt .
text_la: Vertitque nomen ejus, et vocavit eum, lingua ægyptiaca, Salvatorem mundi. Deditque illi uxorem Aseneth filiam Putiphare sacerdotis Heliopoleos. Egressus est itaque Joseph ad terram Ægypti
text_pt: E Faraó chamou a José de Zafenate-Panéia, e deu-lhe por mulher a Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om; e saiu José por toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάλεσεν Φαραω τὸ ὄνομα Ιωσηφ Ψονθομφανηχ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτῷ τὴν Ασεννεθ θυγατέρα Πετεφρη ἱερέως Ἡλίου πόλεως αὐτῷ γυναῖκα

text_en: (Now he was thirty years old when he stood before King Pharao ), and he went round all the countries of Egypt .
text_la: (triginta autem annorum erat quando stetit in conspectu regis Pharaonis), et circuivit omnes regiones Ægypti.
text_pt: E José era da idade de trinta anos quando se apresentou a Faraó, rei do Egito. E saiu José da presença de Faraó e passou por toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: Ιωσηφ δὲ ἦν ἐτῶν τριάκοντα ὅτε ἔστη ἐναντίον Φαραω βασιλέως Αἰγύπτου ἐξῆλθεν δὲ Ιωσηφ ἐκ προσώπου Φαραω καὶ διῆλθεν πᾶσαν γῆν Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the fruitfulness of the seven years came: and the corn being bound up into sheaves, was gathered together into the barns of Egypt .
text_la: Venitque fertilitas septem annorum: et in manipulos redactæ segetes congregatæ sunt in horrea Ægypti.
text_pt: E nos sete anos de fartura a terra produziu abundantemente.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν ἡ γῆ ἐν τοῖς ἑπτὰ ἔτεσιν τῆς εὐθηνίας δράγματα

text_en: And all the abundance of grain was laid up in every city.
text_la: Omnis etiam frugum abundantia in singulis urbibus condita est.
text_pt: E ele ajuntou todo o mantimento dos sete anos, que houve na terra do Egito; e guardou o mantimento nas cidades, pondo nas mesmas o mantimento do campo que estava ao redor de cada cidade.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν πάντα τὰ βρώματα τῶν ἑπτὰ ἐτῶν ἐν οἷς ἦν ἡ εὐθηνία ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἔθηκεν τὰ βρώματα ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν βρώματα τῶν πεδίων τῆς πόλεως τῶν κύκλῳ αὐτῆς ἔθηκεν ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And there was so great abundance of wheat, that it was equal to the sand of the sea, and the plenty exceeded measure.
text_la: Tantaque fuit abundantia tritici, ut arenæ maris coæquaretur, et copia mensuram excederet.
text_pt: Assim ajuntou José muitíssimo trigo, como a areia do mar, até que cessou de contar; porquanto não havia numeração.
text_el: καὶ συνήγαγεν Ιωσηφ σῖτον ὡσεὶ τὴν ἄμμον τῆς θαλάσσης πολὺν σφόδρα ἕως οὐκ ἠδύναντο ἀριθμῆσαι οὐ γὰρ ἦν ἀριθμός

text_en: And before the famine came, Joseph had two sons born: whom Aseneth , the daughter of Putiphare, priest of Heliopolis, bore unto him.
text_la: Nati sunt autem Joseph filii duo antequam veniret fames: quos peperit ei Aseneth filia Putiphare sacerdotis Heliopoleos.
text_pt: E nasceram a José dois filhos (antes que viesse um ano de fome), que lhe deu Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om.
text_el: τῷ δὲ Ιωσηφ ἐγένοντο υἱοὶ δύο πρὸ τοῦ ἐλθεῖν τὰ ἑπτὰ ἔτη τοῦ λιμοῦ οὓς ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ Ασεννεθ θυγάτηρ Πετεφρη ἱερέως Ἡλίου πόλεως

text_en: And he called the name of the firstborn Manasses , saying: God has made me to forget all my labours, and my father's house.
text_la: Vocavitque nomen primogeniti Manasses, dicens : Oblivisci me fecit Deus omnium laborum meorum, et domus patris mei.
text_pt: E chamou José ao primogênito Manassés, porque disse: Deus me fez esquecer de todo o meu trabalho, e de toda a casa de meu pai.
text_el: ἐκάλεσεν δὲ Ιωσηφ τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ πρωτοτόκου Μανασση ὅτι ἐπιλαθέσθαι με ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς πάντων τῶν πόνων μου καὶ πάντων τῶν τοῦ πατρός μου

text_en: And he named the second Ephraim, saying: God has made me to grow in the land of my poverty .
text_la: Nomen quoque secundi appellavit Ephraim, dicens : Crescere me fecit Deus in terra paupertatis meæ.
text_pt: E ao segundo chamou Efraim; porque disse: Deus me fez crescer na terra da minha aflição.
text_el: τὸ δὲ ὄνομα τοῦ δευτέρου ἐκάλεσεν Εφραιμ ὅτι ηὔξησέν με ὁ θεὸς ἐν γῇ ταπεινώσεώς μου

text_en: Now when the seven years of plenty that had been in Egypt were passed:
text_la: Igitur transactis septem ubertatis annis, qui fuerant in Ægypto,
text_pt: Então acabaram-se os sete anos de fartura que havia na terra do Egito.
text_el: παρῆλθον δὲ τὰ ἑπτὰ ἔτη τῆς εὐθηνίας ἃ ἐγένοντο ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: The seven years of scarcity, which Joseph had foretold, began to come: and the famine prevailed in the whole world, but there was bread in all the land of Egypt .
text_la: cœperunt venire septem anni inopiæ, quos prædixerat Joseph : et in universo orbe fames prævaluit, in cuncta autem terra Ægypti panis erat.
text_pt: E começaram a vir os sete anos de fome, como José tinha dito; e havia fome em todas as terras, mas em toda a terra do Egito havia pão.
text_el: καὶ ἤρξαντο τὰ ἑπτὰ ἔτη τοῦ λιμοῦ ἔρχεσθαι καθὰ εἶπεν Ιωσηφ καὶ ἐγένετο λιμὸς ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ἐν δὲ πάσῃ γῇ Αἰγύπτου ἦσαν ἄρτοι

text_en: And when there also they began to be famished, the people cried to Pharao , for food. And he said to them: Go to Joseph : and do all that he shall say to you.
text_la: Qua esuriente, clamavit populus ad Pharaonem, alimenta petens. Quibus ille respondit : Ite ad Joseph : et quidquid ipse vobis dixerit, facite.
text_pt: E tendo toda a terra do Egito fome, clamou o povo a Faraó por pão; e Faraó disse a todos os egípcios: Ide a José; o que ele vos disser, fazei.
text_el: καὶ ἐπείνασεν πᾶσα ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου ἐκέκραξεν δὲ ὁ λαὸς πρὸς Φαραω περὶ ἄρτων εἶπεν δὲ Φαραω πᾶσι τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις πορεύεσθε πρὸς Ιωσηφ καὶ ὃ ἐὰν εἴπῃ ὑμῖν ποιήσατε

text_en: And the famine increased daily in all the land: and Joseph opened all the barns, and sold to the Egyptians : for the famine had oppressed them also.
text_la: Crescebat autem quotidie fames in omni terra : aperuitque Joseph universa horrea, et vendebat Ægyptiis : nam et illos oppresserat fames.
text_pt: Havendo, pois, fome sobre toda a terra, abriu José tudo em que havia mantimento, e vendeu aos egípcios; porque a fome prevaleceu na terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ὁ λιμὸς ἦν ἐπὶ προσώπου πάσης τῆς γῆς ἀνέῳξεν δὲ Ιωσηφ πάντας τοὺς σιτοβολῶνας καὶ ἐπώλει πᾶσι τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις

text_en: And all provinces came into Egypt , to buy food, and to seek some relief of their want.
text_la: Omnesque provinciæ veniebant in Ægyptum, ut emerent escas, et malum inopiæ temperarent.
text_pt: E de todas as terras vinham ao Egito, para comprar de José; porquanto a fome prevaleceu em todas as terras.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσαι αἱ χῶραι ἦλθον εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἀγοράζειν πρὸς Ιωσηφ ἐπεκράτησεν γὰρ ὁ λιμὸς ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ

text_en: And Jacob hearing that food was sold in Egypt , said to his sons: Why are you careless?
text_la: Audiens autem Jacob quod alimenta venderentur in Ægypto, dixit filiis suis : Quare negligitis?
text_pt: Vendo então Jacó que havia mantimento no Egito, disse a seus filhos: Por que estais olhando uns para os outros?
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ Ιακωβ ὅτι ἔστιν πρᾶσις ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ εἶπεν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ ἵνα τί ῥᾳθυμεῖτε

text_en: I have heard that wheat is sold in Egypt : Go down, and buy us necessaries, that we may live, and not be consumed with want .
text_la: audivi quod triticum venundetur in Ægypto : descendite, et emite nobis necessaria, ut possimus vivere, et non consumamur inopia.
text_pt: Disse mais: Eis que tenho ouvido que há mantimentos no Egito; descei para lá, e comprai-nos dali, para que vivamos e não morramos.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἀκήκοα ὅτι ἔστιν σῖτος ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ κατάβητε ἐκεῖ καὶ πρίασθε ἡμῖν μικρὰ βρώματα ἵνα ζῶμεν καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν

text_en: So the ten brethren of Joseph went down, to buy corn in Egypt :
text_la: Descendentes igitur fratres Joseph decem, ut emerent frumenta in Ægypto,
text_pt: Então desceram os dez irmãos de José, para comprarem trigo no Egito.
text_el: κατέβησαν δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ Ιωσηφ οἱ δέκα πρίασθαι σῖτον ἐξ Αἰγύπτου

text_en: Whilst Benjamin was kept at home by Jacob , who said to his brethren: Lest perhaps he take any harm in the journey.
text_la: Benjamin domi retento a Jacob, qui dixerat fratribus ejus : Ne forte in itinere quidquam patiatur mali:
text_pt: A Benjamim, porém, irmão de José, não enviou Jacó com os seus irmãos, porque dizia: Para que lhe não suceda, porventura, algum desastre.
text_el: τὸν δὲ Βενιαμιν τὸν ἀδελφὸν Ιωσηφ οὐκ ἀπέστειλεν μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ εἶπεν γάρ μήποτε συμβῇ αὐτῷ μαλακία

text_en: And they entered into the land of Egypt with others that went to buy. For the famine was in the land of Chanaan .
text_la: ingressi sunt terram Ægypti cum aliis qui pergebant ad emendum. Erat autem fames in terra Chanaan.
text_pt: Assim, entre os que iam lá foram os filhos de Israel para comprar, porque havia fome na terra de Canaã.
text_el: ἦλθον δὲ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀγοράζειν μετὰ τῶν ἐρχομένων ἦν γὰρ ὁ λιμὸς ἐν γῇ Χανααν

text_en: And Joseph was governor in the land of Egypt , and corn was sold by his direction to the people. And when his brethren had bowed down to him,
text_la: Et Joseph erat princeps in terra Ægypti, atque ad ejus nutum frumenta populis vendebantur. Cumque adorassent eum fratres sui,
text_pt: José, pois, era o governador daquela terra; ele vendia a todo o povo da terra; e os irmãos de José chegaram e inclinaram-se a ele, com o rosto em terra.
text_el: Ιωσηφ δὲ ἦν ἄρχων τῆς γῆς οὗτος ἐπώλει παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τῆς γῆς ἐλθόντες δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ Ιωσηφ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: and he knew them, he spoke as it were to strangers, somewhat roughly, asking them: Whence came you? They answered: From the land of Chanaan , to buy necessaries of life.
text_la: et agnovisset eos, quasi ad alienos durius loquebatur, interrogans eos : Unde venistis? Qui responderunt : De terra Chanaan, ut emamus victui necessaria.
text_pt: E José, vendo os seus irmãos, conheceu-os; porém mostrou-se estranho para com eles, e falou-lhes asperamente, e disse-lhes: De onde vindes? E eles disseram: Da terra de Canaã, para comprarmos mantimento.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ Ιωσηφ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐπέγνω καὶ ἠλλοτριοῦτο ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς σκληρὰ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς πόθεν ἥκατε οἱ δὲ εἶπαν ἐκ γῆς Χανααν ἀγοράσαι βρώματα

text_en: And though he knew his brethren, he was not known by them.
text_la: Et tamen fratres ipse cognoscens, non est cognitus ab eis.
text_pt: José, pois, conheceu os seus irmãos; mas eles não o conheceram.
text_el: ἐπέγνω δὲ Ιωσηφ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ἐπέγνωσαν αὐτόν

text_en: And remembering the dreams , which formerly he had dreamed, he said to them: You are spies. You have come to view the weaker parts of the land.
text_la: Recordatusque somniorum, quæ aliquando viderat, ait ad eos : Exploratores estis : ut videatis infirmiora terræ venistis.
text_pt: Então José lembrou-se dos sonhos que havia tido deles e disse-lhes: Vós sois espias, e viestes para ver a nudez da terra.
text_el: καὶ ἐμνήσθη Ιωσηφ τῶν ἐνυπνίων ὧν εἶδεν αὐτός καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς κατάσκοποί ἐστε κατανοῆσαι τὰ ἴχνη τῆς χώρας ἥκατε

text_en: But they said: It is not so, my lord; but your servants have come to buy food.
text_la: Qui dixerunt : Non est ita, domine, sed servi tui venerunt ut emerent cibos.
text_pt: E eles lhe disseram: Não, senhor meu; mas teus servos vieram comprar mantimento.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν οὐχί κύριε οἱ παῖδές σου ἤλθομεν πρίασθαι βρώματα

text_en: We are all the sons of one man : we have come as peaceable men , neither do your servants go about any evil .
text_la: Omnes filii unius viri sumus : pacifici venimus, nec quidquam famuli tui machinantur mali.
text_pt: Todos nós somos filhos de um mesmo homem; somos homens de retidão; os teus servos não são espias.
text_el: πάντες ἐσμὲν υἱοὶ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου εἰρηνικοί ἐσμεν οὐκ εἰσὶν οἱ παῖδές σου κατάσκοποι

text_en: And he answered them: It is otherwise: you have come to consider the unfenced parts of this land.
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Aliter est : immunita terræ hujus considerare venistis.
text_pt: E ele lhes disse: Não; antes viestes para ver a nudez da terra.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς οὐχί ἀλλὰ τὰ ἴχνη τῆς γῆς ἤλθατε ἰδεῖν

text_en: But they said: We your servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Chanaan : the youngest is with our father, the other is not living.
text_la: At illi : Duodecim, inquiunt, servi tui, fratres sumus, filii viri unius in terra Chanaan : minimus cum patre nostro est, alius non est super.
text_pt: E eles disseram: Nós, teus servos, somos doze irmãos, filhos de um homem na terra de Canaã; e eis que o mais novo está com nosso pai hoje; mas um já não existe.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν δώδεκά ἐσμεν οἱ παῖδές σου ἀδελφοὶ ἐν γῇ Χανααν καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ νεώτερος μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν σήμερον ὁ δὲ ἕτερος οὐχ ὑπάρχει

text_en: He says, This is it that I said: You are spies.
text_la: Hoc est, ait, quod locutus sum : exploratores estis.
text_pt: Então lhes disse José: Isso é o que vos tenho dito, sois espias;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ιωσηφ τοῦτό ἐστιν ὃ εἴρηκα ὑμῖν λέγων ὅτι κατάσκοποί ἐστε

text_en: I shall now presently try what you are: by the health of Pharao , you shall not depart hence, until your youngest brother come.
text_la: Jam nunc experimentum vestri capiam : per salutem Pharaonis non egrediemini hinc, donec veniat frater vester minimus.
text_pt: Nisto sereis provados; pela vida de Faraó, não saireis daqui senão quando vosso irmão mais novo vier aqui.
text_el: ἐν τούτῳ φανεῖσθε νὴ τὴν ὑγίειαν Φαραω οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθητε ἐντεῦθεν ἐὰν μὴ ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν ὁ νεώτερος ἔλθῃ ὧδε

text_en: Send one of you to fetch him: and you shall be in prison , till what you have said be proved, whether it be true or false : or else by the health of Pharao you are spies.
text_la: Mittite ex vobis unum, et adducat eum : vos autem eritis in vinculis, donec probentur quæ dixistis utrum vera an falsa sint : alioquin per salutem Pharaonis exploratores estis.
text_pt: Enviai um dentre vós, que traga vosso irmão, mas vós ficareis presos, e vossas palavras sejam provadas, se há verdade convosco; e se não, pela vida de Faraó, vós sois espias.
text_el: ἀποστείλατε ἐξ ὑμῶν ἕνα καὶ λάβετε τὸν ἀδελφὸν ὑμῶν ὑμεῖς δὲ ἀπάχθητε ἕως τοῦ φανερὰ γενέσθαι τὰ ῥήματα ὑμῶν εἰ ἀληθεύετε ἢ οὔ εἰ δὲ μή νὴ τὴν ὑγίειαν Φαραω ἦ μὴν κατάσκοποί ἐστε

text_en: So he put them in prison three days.
text_la: Tradidit ergo illos custodiæ tribus diebus.
text_pt: E pô-los juntos, em prisão, três dias.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο αὐτοὺς ἐν φυλακῇ ἡμέρας τρεῖς

text_en: And the third day he brought them out of prison , and said: Do as I have said, and you shall live: for I fear God .
text_la: Die autem tertio eductis de carcere, ait : Facite quæ dixi, et vivetis : Deum enim timeo.
text_pt: E ao terceiro dia disse-lhes José: Fazei isso, e vivereis; porque eu temo a Deus.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ τρίτῃ τοῦτο ποιήσατε καὶ ζήσεσθε τὸν θεὸν γὰρ ἐγὼ φοβοῦμαι

text_en: If you be peaceable men , let one of your brethren be bound in prison : and go your ways, and carry the corn that you have bought, unto your houses.
text_la: Si pacifici estis, frater vester unus ligetur in carcere : vos autem abite, et ferte frumenta quæ emistis, in domos vestras,
text_pt: Se sois homens de retidão, que fique um de vossos irmãos preso na casa de vossa prisão; e vós ide, levai mantimento para a fome de vossa casa,
text_el: εἰ εἰρηνικοί ἐστε ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν εἷς κατασχεθήτω ἐν τῇ φυλακῇ αὐτοὶ δὲ βαδίσατε καὶ ἀπαγάγετε τὸν ἀγορασμὸν τῆς σιτοδοσίας ὑμῶν

text_en: And bring your youngest brother to me, that I may find your words to be true , and you may not die. They did as he had said.
text_la: et fratrem vestrum minimum ad me adducite, ut possim vestros probare sermones, et non moriamini. Fecerunt ut dixerat,
text_pt: E trazei-me o vosso irmão mais novo, e serão verificadas vossas palavras, e não morrereis. E eles assim fizeram.
text_el: καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ὑμῶν τὸν νεώτερον ἀγάγετε πρός με καὶ πιστευθήσονται τὰ ῥήματα ὑμῶν εἰ δὲ μή ἀποθανεῖσθε ἐποίησαν δὲ οὕτως

text_en: And they talked one to another: We deserve to suffer these things, because we have sinned against our brother, seeing the anguish of his soul , when he besought us, and we would not hear: therefore is this affliction come upon us.
text_la: et locuti sunt ad invicem : Merito hæc patimur, quia peccavimus in fratrem nostrum, videntes angustiam animæ illius, dum deprecaretur nos, et non audivimus : idcirco venit super nos ista tribulatio.
text_pt: Então disseram uns aos outros: Na verdade, somos culpados acerca de nosso irmão, pois vimos a angústia da sua alma, quando nos rogava; nós porém não ouvimos, por isso vem sobre nós esta angústia.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ναί ἐν ἁμαρτίᾳ γάρ ἐσμεν περὶ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ ἡμῶν ὅτι ὑπερείδομεν τὴν θλῖψιν τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ ὅτε κατεδέετο ἡμῶν καὶ οὐκ εἰσηκούσαμεν αὐτοῦ ἕνεκεν τούτου ἐπῆλθεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἡ θλῖψις αὕτη

text_en: And Ruben , one of them, said: Did not I say to you: Do not sin against the boy; and you would not hear me? Behold his blood is required.
text_la: E quibus unus Ruben, ait : Numquid non dixi vobis : Nolite peccare in puerum : et non audistis me? en sanguis ejus exquiritur.
text_pt: E Rúben respondeu-lhes, dizendo: Não vo-lo dizia eu: Não pequeis contra o menino; mas não ouvistes; e vedes aqui, o seu sangue também é requerido.
text_el: ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ Ρουβην εἶπεν αὐτοῖς οὐκ ἐλάλησα ὑμῖν λέγων μὴ ἀδικήσητε τὸ παιδάριον καὶ οὐκ εἰσηκούσατέ μου καὶ ἰδοὺ τὸ αἷμα αὐτοῦ ἐκζητεῖται

text_en: And they knew not that Joseph understood, because he spoke to them by an interpreter.
text_la: Nesciebant autem quod intelligeret Joseph, eo quod per interpretem loqueretur ad eos.
text_pt: E eles não sabiam que José os entendia, porque havia intérprete entre eles.
text_el: αὐτοὶ δὲ οὐκ ᾔδεισαν ὅτι ἀκούει Ιωσηφ ὁ γὰρ ἑρμηνευτὴς ἀνὰ μέσον αὐτῶν ἦν

text_en: And he turned himself away a little while, and wept: and returning, he spoke to them.
text_la: Avertitque se parumper, et flevit : et reversus locutus est ad eos.
text_pt: E retirou-se deles e chorou. Depois tornou a eles, e falou-lhes, e tomou a Simeão dentre eles, e amarrou-o perante os seus olhos.
text_el: ἀποστραφεὶς δὲ ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἔκλαυσεν Ιωσηφ καὶ πάλιν προσῆλθεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔλαβεν τὸν Συμεων ἀπ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἔδησεν αὐτὸν ἐναντίον αὐτῶν

text_en: And taking Simeon , and binding him in their presence, he commanded his servants to fill their sacks with wheat, and to put every man's money again in their sacks, and to give them besides provisions for the way: and they did so.
text_la: Tollensque Simeon, et ligans illis præsentibus, jussit ministris ut implerent eorum saccos tritico, et reponerent pecunias singulorum in sacculis suis, datis supra cibariis in viam : qui fecerunt ita.
text_pt: E ordenou José, que enchessem os seus sacos de trigo, e que lhes restituíssem o seu dinheiro a cada um no seu saco, e lhes dessem comida para o caminho; e fizeram-lhes assim.
text_el: ἐνετείλατο δὲ Ιωσηφ ἐμπλῆσαι τὰ ἀγγεῖα αὐτῶν σίτου καὶ ἀποδοῦναι τὸ ἀργύριον ἑκάστου εἰς τὸν σάκκον αὐτοῦ καὶ δοῦναι αὐτοῖς ἐπισιτισμὸν εἰς τὴν ὁδόν καὶ ἐγενήθη αὐτοῖς οὕτως

text_en: But they having loaded their asses with the corn went their way.
text_la: At illi portantes frumenta in asinis suis, profecti sunt.
text_pt: E carregaram o seu trigo sobre os seus jumentos e partiram dali.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιθέντες τὸν σῖτον ἐπὶ τοὺς ὄνους αὐτῶν ἀπῆλθον ἐκεῖθεν

text_en: And one of them opening his sack, to give his beast provender in the inn, saw the money in the sack's mouth,
text_la: Apertoque unus sacco, ut daret jumento pabulum in diversorio, contemplatus pecuniam in ore sacculi,
text_pt: E, abrindo um deles o seu saco, para dar pasto ao seu jumento na estalagem, viu o seu dinheiro; porque eis que estava na boca do seu saco.
text_el: λύσας δὲ εἷς τὸν μάρσιππον αὐτοῦ δοῦναι χορτάσματα τοῖς ὄνοις αὐτοῦ οὗ κατέλυσαν εἶδεν τὸν δεσμὸν τοῦ ἀργυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἦν ἐπάνω τοῦ στόματος τοῦ μαρσίππου

text_en: and said to his brethren: My money is given me again; behold it is in the sack. And they were astonished, and troubled, and said to one another: What is this that God has done unto us?
text_la: dixit fratribus suis : Reddita est mihi pecunia, en habetur in sacco. Et obstupefacti, turbatique, mutuo dixerunt : Quidnam est hoc quod fecit nobis Deus?
