text_pt: E disse a seus irmãos: Devolveram o meu dinheiro, e ei-lo também aqui no saco. Então lhes desfaleceu o coração, e pasmavam, dizendo um ao outro: Que é isto que Deus nos tem feito?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ ἀπεδόθη μοι τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ ἰδοὺ τοῦτο ἐν τῷ μαρσίππῳ μου καὶ ἐξέστη ἡ καρδία αὐτῶν καὶ ἐταράχθησαν πρὸς ἀλλήλους λέγοντες τί τοῦτο ἐποίησεν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῖν

text_en: And they came to Jacob their father in the land of Chanaan , and they told him all things that had befallen them, saying:
text_la: Veneruntque ad Jacob patrem suum in terram Chanaan, et narraverunt ei omnia quæ accidissent sibi, dicentes:
text_pt: E vieram para Jacó, seu pai, na terra de Canaã; e contaram-lhe tudo o que lhes aconteceu, dizendo:
text_el: ἦλθον δὲ πρὸς Ιακωβ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν εἰς γῆν Χανααν καὶ ἀπήγγειλαν αὐτῷ πάντα τὰ συμβάντα αὐτοῖς λέγοντες

text_en: The lord of the land spoke roughly to us, and took us to be spies of the country.
text_la: Locutus est nobis dominus terræ dure, et putavit nos exploratores esse provinciæ.
text_pt: O homem, o senhor da terra, falou conosco asperamente, e tratou-nos como espias da terra;
text_el: λελάληκεν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ κύριος τῆς γῆς πρὸς ἡμᾶς σκληρὰ καὶ ἔθετο ἡμᾶς ἐν φυλακῇ ὡς κατασκοπεύοντας τὴν γῆν

text_en: And we answered him: We are peaceable men , and we mean no plot.
text_la: Cui respondimus : Pacifici sumus, nec ullas molimur insidias.
text_pt: Mas dissemos-lhe: Somos homens de retidão; não somos espias;
text_el: εἴπαμεν δὲ αὐτῷ εἰρηνικοί ἐσμεν οὔκ ἐσμεν κατάσκοποι

text_en: We are twelve brethren born of one father: one is not living, the youngest is with our father in the land of Chanaan .
text_la: Duodecim fratres uno patre geniti sumus : unus non est super, minimus cum patre nostro est in terra Chanaan.
text_pt: Somos doze irmãos, filhos de nosso pai; um não mais existe, e o mais novo está hoje com nosso pai na terra de Canaã.
text_el: δώδεκα ἀδελφοί ἐσμεν υἱοὶ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν ὁ εἷς οὐχ ὑπάρχει ὁ δὲ μικρότερος μετὰ τοῦ πατρὸς ἡμῶν σήμερον ἐν γῇ Χανααν

text_en: And he said to us: Hereby shall I know that you are peaceable men : Leave one of your brethren with me, and take necessary provision for your houses, and go your ways,
text_la: Qui ait nobis : Sic probabo quod pacifici sitis : fratrem vestrum unum dimittite apud me, et cibaria domibus vestris necessaria sumite, et abite,
text_pt: E aquele homem, o senhor da terra, nos disse: Nisto conhecerei que vós sois homens de retidão; deixai comigo um de vossos irmãos, e tomai para a fome de vossas casas, e parti,
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ἡμῖν ὁ ἄνθρωπος ὁ κύριος τῆς γῆς ἐν τούτῳ γνώσομαι ὅτι εἰρηνικοί ἐστε ἀδελφὸν ἕνα ἄφετε ὧδε μετ' ἐμοῦ τὸν δὲ ἀγορασμὸν τῆς σιτοδοσίας τοῦ οἴκου ὑμῶν λαβόντες ἀπέλθατε

text_en: and bring your youngest brother to me, that I may know you are not spies: and you may receive this man again, that is kept in prison : and afterwards may have leave to buy what you will.
text_la: fratremque vestrum minimum adducite ad me, ut sciam quod non sitis exploratores : et istum, qui tenetur in vinculis, recipere possitis : ac deinceps quæ vultis, emendi habeatis licentiam.
text_pt: E trazei-me vosso irmão mais novo; assim saberei que não sois espias, mas homens de retidão; então vos darei o vosso irmão e negociareis na terra.
text_el: καὶ ἀγάγετε πρός με τὸν ἀδελφὸν ὑμῶν τὸν νεώτερον καὶ γνώσομαι ὅτι οὐ κατάσκοποί ἐστε ἀλλ' ὅτι εἰρηνικοί ἐστε καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ὑμῶν ἀποδώσω ὑμῖν καὶ τῇ γῇ ἐμπορεύεσθε

text_en: When they had told this, they poured out their corn, and every man found his money tied in the mouth of his sack: and all being astonished together,
text_la: His dictis, cum frumenta effunderent, singuli repererunt in ore saccorum ligatas pecunias, exterritisque simul omnibus,
text_pt: E aconteceu que, despejando eles os seus sacos, eis que cada um tinha o pacote com seu dinheiro no seu saco; e viram os pacotes com seu dinheiro, eles e seu pai, e temeram.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἐν τῷ κατακενοῦν αὐτοὺς τοὺς σάκκους αὐτῶν καὶ ἦν ἑκάστου ὁ δεσμὸς τοῦ ἀργυρίου ἐν τῷ σάκκῳ αὐτῶν καὶ εἶδον τοὺς δεσμοὺς τοῦ ἀργυρίου αὐτῶν αὐτοὶ καὶ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν

text_en: their father Jacob said: You have made me to be without children: Joseph is not living, Simeon is kept in bonds, and Benjamin you will take away: all these evils are fallen upon me.
text_la: dixit pater Jacob : Absque liberis me esse fecistis : Joseph non est super, Simeon tenetur in vinculis, et Benjamin auferetis : in me hæc omnia mala reciderunt.
text_pt: Então Jacó, seu pai, disse-lhes: Tendes-me desfilhado; José já não existe e Simeão não está aqui; agora levareis a Benjamim. Todas estas coisas vieram sobre mim.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ιακωβ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν ἐμὲ ἠτεκνώσατε Ιωσηφ οὐκ ἔστιν Συμεων οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ τὸν Βενιαμιν λήμψεσθε ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐγένετο πάντα ταῦτα

text_en: And Ruben answered him: Kill my two sons, if I bring him not again to you: deliver him into my hand, and I will restore him to you.
text_la: Cui respondit Ruben : Duos filios meos interfice, si non reduxero illum tibi : trade illum in manu mea, et ego eum tibi restituam.
text_pt: Mas Rúben falou a seu pai, dizendo: Mata os meus dois filhos, se eu não tornar a trazê-lo para ti; entrega-o em minha mão, e tornarei a trazê-lo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ρουβην τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ λέγων τοὺς δύο υἱούς μου ἀπόκτεινον ἐὰν μὴ ἀγάγω αὐτὸν πρὸς σέ δὸς αὐτὸν εἰς τὴν χεῖρά μου κἀγὼ ἀνάξω αὐτὸν πρὸς σέ

text_en: But he said: My son shall not go down with you: his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if any mischief befall him in the land to which you go, you will bring down my grey hairs with sorrow to hell .
text_la: At ille : Non descendet, inquit, filius meus vobiscum : frater ejus mortuus est, et ipse solus remansit : si quid ei adversi acciderit in terra ad quam pergitis, deducetis canos meos cum dolore ad inferos.
text_pt: Ele porém disse: Não descerá meu filho convosco; porquanto o seu irmão é morto, e só ele ficou. Se lhe suceder algum desastre no caminho por onde fordes, fareis descer minhas cãs com tristeza à sepultura.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν οὐ καταβήσεται ὁ υἱός μου μεθ' ὑμῶν ὅτι ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπέθανεν καὶ αὐτὸς μόνος καταλέλειπται καὶ συμβήσεται αὐτὸν μαλακισθῆναι ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ ᾗ ἂν πορεύησθε καὶ κατάξετέ μου τὸ γῆρας μετὰ λύπης εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: In the mean time the famine was heavy upon all the land.
text_la: Interim fames omnem terram vehementer premebat.
text_pt: E a fome era gravíssima na terra.
text_el: ὁ δὲ λιμὸς ἐνίσχυσεν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And when they had eaten up all the corn, which they had brought out of Egypt , Jacob said to his sons: Go again, and buy us a little food.
text_la: Consumptisque cibis quos ex Ægypto detulerant, dixit Jacob ad filios suos : Revertimini, et emite nobis pauxillum escarum.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, como acabaram de comer o mantimento que trouxeram do Egito, disse-lhes seu pai: Voltai, comprai-nos um pouco de alimento.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα συνετέλεσαν καταφαγεῖν τὸν σῖτον ὃν ἤνεγκαν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν πάλιν πορευθέντες πρίασθε ἡμῖν μικρὰ βρώματα

text_en: Juda answered: The man declared unto us with the attestation of an oath , saying: You shall not see my face, unless you bring your youngest brother with you.
text_la: Respondit Judas : Denuntiavit nobis vir ille sub attestatione jurisjurandi, dicens : Non videbitis faciem meam, nisi fratrem vestrum minimum adduxeritis vobiscum.
text_pt: Mas Judá respondeu-lhe, dizendo: Fortemente nos protestou aquele homem, dizendo: Não vereis a minha face, se o vosso irmão não vier convosco.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ Ιουδας λέγων διαμαρτυρίᾳ διαμεμαρτύρηται ἡμῖν ὁ ἄνθρωπος λέγων οὐκ ὄψεσθε τὸ πρόσωπόν μου ἐὰν μὴ ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν ὁ νεώτερος μεθ' ὑμῶν ᾖ

text_en: If therefore you will send him with us, we will set out together, and will buy necessaries for you.
text_la: Si ergo vis eum mittere nobiscum, pergemus pariter, et ememus tibi necessaria:
text_pt: Se enviares conosco o nosso irmão, desceremos e te compraremos alimento;
text_el: εἰ μὲν οὖν ἀποστέλλεις τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν μεθ' ἡμῶν καταβησόμεθα καὶ ἀγοράσωμέν σοι βρώματα

text_en: But if you will not, we will not go: for the man , as we have often said, declared unto us, saying: You shall not see my face without your youngest brother.
text_la: sin autem non vis, non ibimus : vir enim, ut sæpe diximus, denuntiavit nobis, dicens : Non videbitis faciem meam absque fratre vestro minimo.
text_pt: Mas se não o enviares, não desceremos; porquanto aquele homem nos disse: Não vereis a minha face, se o vosso irmão não vier convosco.
text_el: εἰ δὲ μὴ ἀποστέλλεις τὸν ἀδελφὸν ἡμῶν μεθ' ἡμῶν οὐ πορευσόμεθα ὁ γὰρ ἄνθρωπος εἶπεν ἡμῖν λέγων οὐκ ὄψεσθέ μου τὸ πρόσωπον ἐὰν μὴ ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν ὁ νεώτερος μεθ' ὑμῶν ᾖ

text_en: Israel said to them: You have done this for my misery, in that you told him you had also another brother.
text_la: Dixit eis Israël : In meam hoc fecistis miseriam, ut indicaretis ei et alium habere vos fratrem.
text_pt: E disse Israel: Por que me fizeste tal mal, fazendo saber àquele homem que tínheis ainda outro irmão?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ισραηλ τί ἐκακοποιήσατέ με ἀναγγείλαντες τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ εἰ ἔστιν ὑμῖν ἀδελφός

text_en: But they answered: The man asked us in order concerning our kindred: if our father lived: if we had a brother: and we answered him regularly, according to what he demanded: could we know that he would say: Bring hither your brother with you?
text_la: At illi responderunt : Interrogavit nos homo per ordinem nostram progeniem : si pater viveret : si haberemus fratrem : et nos respondimus ei consequenter juxta id quod fuerat sciscitatus : numquid scire poteramus quod dicturus esset : Adducite fratrem vestrum vobiscum?
text_pt: E eles disseram: Aquele homem particularmente nos perguntou por nós, e pela nossa parentela, dizendo: Vive ainda vosso pai? Tendes mais um irmão? E respondemos-lhe conforme as mesmas palavras. Podíamos nós saber que diria: Trazei vosso irmão?
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν ἐρωτῶν ἐπηρώτησεν ἡμᾶς ὁ ἄνθρωπος καὶ τὴν γενεὰν ἡμῶν λέγων εἰ ἔτι ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ζῇ εἰ ἔστιν ὑμῖν ἀδελφός καὶ ἀπηγγείλαμεν αὐτῷ κατὰ τὴν ἐπερώτησιν ταύτην μὴ ᾔδειμεν εἰ ἐρεῖ ἡμῖν ἀγάγετε τὸν ἀδελφὸν ὑμῶν

text_en: And Juda said to his father: Send the boy with me, that we may set forward, and may live: lest both we and our children perish.
text_la: Judas quoque dixit patri suo : Mitte puerum mecum, ut proficiscamur, et possimus vivere : ne moriamur nos et parvuli nostri.
text_pt: Então disse Judá a Israel, seu pai: Envia o jovem comigo, e levantar-nos-emos, e iremos, para que vivamos e não morramos, nem nós, nem tu, nem os nossos filhos.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιουδας πρὸς Ισραηλ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ ἀπόστειλον τὸ παιδάριον μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ ἀναστάντες πορευσόμεθα ἵνα ζῶμεν καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν καὶ ἡμεῖς καὶ σὺ καὶ ἡ ἀποσκευὴ ἡμῶν

text_en: I take the boy upon me, require him at my hand: unless I bring him again, and restore him to you, I will be guilty of sin against you for ever .
text_la: Ego suscipio puerum : de manu mea require illum : nisi reduxero, et reddidero eum tibi, ero peccati reus in te omni tempore.
text_pt: Eu serei fiador por ele, da minha mão o requererás; se eu não o trouxer, e não o puser perante a tua face, serei réu de crime para contigo para sempre.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐκδέχομαι αὐτόν ἐκ χειρός μου ζήτησον αὐτόν ἐὰν μὴ ἀγάγω αὐτὸν πρὸς σὲ καὶ στήσω αὐτὸν ἐναντίον σου ἡμαρτηκὼς ἔσομαι πρὸς σὲ πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: If delay had not been made, we had been here again the second time.
text_la: Si non intercessisset dilatio, jam vice alter venissemus.
text_pt: E se não nos tivéssemos detido, certamente já estaríamos segunda vez de volta.
text_el: εἰ μὴ γὰρ ἐβραδύναμεν ἤδη ἂν ὑπεστρέψαμεν δίς

text_en: Then Israel said to them: If it must needs be so, do what you will: take of the best fruits of the land in your vessels, and carry down presents to the man , a little balm, and honey, and storax, myrrh, turpentine, and almonds.
text_la: Igitur Israël pater eorum dixit ad eos : Si sic necesse est, facite quod vultis : sumite de optimis terræ fructibus in vasis vestris, et deferte viro munera, modicum resinæ, et mellis, et storacis, stactes, et terebinthi, et amygdalarum.
text_pt: Então disse-lhes Israel, seu pai: Pois que assim é, fazei isso; tomai do mais precioso desta terra em vossos vasos, e levai ao homem um presente: um pouco do bálsamo e um pouco de mel, especiarias e mirra, terebinto e amêndoas;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ισραηλ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν εἰ οὕτως ἐστίν τοῦτο ποιήσατε λάβετε ἀπὸ τῶν καρπῶν τῆς γῆς ἐν τοῖς ἀγγείοις ὑμῶν καὶ καταγάγετε τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ δῶρα τῆς ῥητίνης καὶ τοῦ μέλιτος θυμίαμα καὶ στακτὴν καὶ τερέμινθον καὶ κάρυα

text_en: And take with you double money, and carry back what you found in your sacks, lest perhaps it was done by mistake.
text_la: Pecuniam quoque duplicem ferte vobiscum : et illam, quam invenistis in sacculis, reportate, ne forte errore factum sit:
text_pt: E tomai em vossas mãos dinheiro em dobro, e o dinheiro que voltou na boca dos vossos sacos tornai a levar em vossas mãos; bem pode ser que fosse erro.
text_el: καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον δισσὸν λάβετε ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν ὑμῶν τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ ἀποστραφὲν ἐν τοῖς μαρσίπποις ὑμῶν ἀποστρέψατε μεθ' ὑμῶν μήποτε ἀγνόημά ἐστιν

text_en: And take also your brother, and go to the man .
text_la: sed et fratrem vestrum tollite, et ite ad virum.
text_pt: Tomai também a vosso irmão, e levantai-vos e voltai àquele homem;
text_el: καὶ τὸν ἀδελφὸν ὑμῶν λάβετε καὶ ἀναστάντες κατάβητε πρὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον

text_en: And may my almighty God make him favourable to you: and send back with you your brother, whom he keeps, and this Benjamin : and as for me I shall be desolate without children.
text_la: Deus autem meus omnipotens faciat vobis eum placabilem : et remittat vobiscum fratrem vestrum quem tenet, et hunc Benjamin : ego autem quasi orbatus absque liberis ero.
text_pt: E Deus Todo-Poderoso vos dê misericórdia diante do homem, para que deixe vir convosco vosso outro irmão, e Benjamim; e eu, se for desfilhado, desfilhado ficarei.
text_el: ὁ δὲ θεός μου δῴη ὑμῖν χάριν ἐναντίον τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καὶ ἀποστείλαι τὸν ἀδελφὸν ὑμῶν τὸν ἕνα καὶ τὸν Βενιαμιν ἐγὼ μὲν γάρ καθὰ ἠτέκνωμαι ἠτέκνωμαι

text_en: So the men took the presents, and double money, and Benjamin : and went down into Egypt , and stood before Joseph .
text_la: Tulerunt ergo viri munera, et pecuniam duplicem, et Benjamin : descenderuntque in Ægyptum, et steterunt coram Joseph.
text_pt: E os homens tomaram aquele presente, e dinheiro em dobro em suas mãos, e a Benjamim; e levantaram-se, e desceram ao Egito, e apresentaram-se diante de José.
text_el: λαβόντες δὲ οἱ ἄνδρες τὰ δῶρα ταῦτα καὶ τὸ ἀργύριον διπλοῦν ἔλαβον ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν καὶ τὸν Βενιαμιν καὶ ἀναστάντες κατέβησαν εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἔστησαν ἐναντίον Ιωσηφ

text_en: And when he had seen them, and Benjamin with them, he commanded the steward of his house, saying: Bring in the men into the house, and kill victims, and prepare a feast: because they shall eat with me at noon .
text_la: Quos cum ille vidisset et Benjamin simul, præcepit dispensatori domus suæ, dicens : Introduc viros domum, et occide victimas, et instrue convivium : quoniam mecum sunt comesturi meridie.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, José a Benjamim com eles, disse ao que estava sobre a sua casa: Leva estes homens à casa, e mata reses, e prepara tudo; porque estes homens comerão comigo ao meio-dia.
text_el: εἶδεν δὲ Ιωσηφ αὐτοὺς καὶ τὸν Βενιαμιν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν ὁμομήτριον καὶ εἶπεν τῷ ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ εἰσάγαγε τοὺς ἀνθρώπους εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ σφάξον θύματα καὶ ἑτοίμασον μετ' ἐμοῦ γὰρ φάγονται οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἄρτους τὴν μεσημβρίαν

text_en: He did as he was commanded, and brought the men into the house.
text_la: Fecit ille quod sibi fuerat imperatum, et introduxit viros domum.
text_pt: E o homem fez como José dissera, e levou-os à casa de José.
text_el: ἐποίησεν δὲ ὁ ἄνθρωπος καθὰ εἶπεν Ιωσηφ καὶ εἰσήγαγεν τοὺς ἀνθρώπους εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ιωσηφ

text_en: And they being much afraid , said there one to another: Because of the money, which we carried back the first time in our sacks, we are brought in: that he may bring upon us a false accusation, and by violence make slaves of us and our asses.
text_la: Ibique exterriti, dixerunt mutuo : Propter pecuniam, quam retulimus prius in saccis nostris, introducti sumus : ut devolvat in nos calumniam, et violenter subjiciat servituti et nos, et asinos nostros.
text_pt: Então temeram aqueles homens, porquanto foram levados à casa de José, e diziam: Por causa do dinheiro que dantes voltou nos nossos sacos, fomos trazidos aqui, para nos incriminar e cair sobre nós, para que nos tome por servos, e a nossos jumentos.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ἄνθρωποι ὅτι εἰσήχθησαν εἰς τὸν οἶκον Ιωσηφ εἶπαν διὰ τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ ἀποστραφὲν ἐν τοῖς μαρσίπποις ἡμῶν τὴν ἀρχὴν ἡμεῖς εἰσαγόμεθα τοῦ συκοφαντῆσαι ἡμᾶς καὶ ἐπιθέσθαι ἡμῖν τοῦ λαβεῖν ἡμᾶς εἰς παῖδας καὶ τοὺς ὄνους ἡμῶν

text_en: Wherefore, going up to the steward of the house, at the door,
text_la: Quam ob rem in ipsis foribus accedentes ad dispensatorem domus,
text_pt: Por isso chegaram-se ao homem que estava sobre a casa de José, e falaram com ele à porta da casa,
text_el: προσελθόντες δὲ πρὸς τὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν ἐπὶ τοῦ οἴκου Ιωσηφ ἐλάλησαν αὐτῷ ἐν τῷ πυλῶνι τοῦ οἴκου

text_en: they said: Sir, we desire you to hear us. We came down once before to buy food:
text_la: locuti sunt : Oramus, domine, ut audias nos. Jam ante descendimus ut emeremus escas:
text_pt: E disseram: Ai! senhor meu, certamente descemos dantes a comprar mantimento;
text_el: λέγοντες δεόμεθα κύριε κατέβημεν τὴν ἀρχὴν πρίασθαι βρώματα

text_en: And when we had bought, and had come to the inn, we opened our sacks, and found our money in the mouths of the sacks: which we have now brought again in the same weight.
text_la: quibus emptis, cum venissemus ad diversorium, aperuimus saccos nostros, et invenimus pecuniam in ore saccorum : quam nunc eodem pondere reportavimus.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, chegando à estalagem, e abrindo os nossos sacos, eis que o dinheiro de cada um estava na boca do seu saco, nosso dinheiro por seu peso; e tornamos a trazê-lo em nossas mãos;
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἤλθομεν εἰς τὸ καταλῦσαι καὶ ἠνοίξαμεν τοὺς μαρσίππους ἡμῶν καὶ τόδε τὸ ἀργύριον ἑκάστου ἐν τῷ μαρσίππῳ αὐτοῦ τὸ ἀργύριον ἡμῶν ἐν σταθμῷ ἀπεστρέψαμεν νῦν ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν ἡμῶν

text_en: And we have brought other money besides, to buy what we want: we cannot tell who put it in our bags.
text_la: Sed et aliud attulimus argentum, ut emamus quæ nobis necessaria sunt : non est in nostra conscientia quis posuerit eam in marsupiis nostris.
text_pt: Também trouxemos outro dinheiro em nossas mãos, para comprar mantimento; não sabemos quem tenha posto o nosso dinheiro nos nossos sacos.
text_el: καὶ ἀργύριον ἕτερον ἠνέγκαμεν μεθ' ἑαυτῶν ἀγοράσαι βρώματα οὐκ οἴδαμεν τίς ἐνέβαλεν τὸ ἀργύριον εἰς τοὺς μαρσίππους ἡμῶν

text_en: But he answered: Peace be with you, fear not: your God , and the God of your father, has given you treasure in your sacks. For the money, which you gave me, I have for good. And he brought Simeon out to them.
text_la: At ille respondit : Pax vobiscum, nolite timere : Deus vester, et Deus patris vestri, dedit vobis thesauros in saccis vestris : nam pecuniam, quam dedistis mihi, probatam ego habeo. Eduxitque ad eos Simeon.
text_pt: E ele disse: Paz seja convosco, não temais; o vosso Deus, e o Deus de vosso pai, vos tem dado um tesouro nos vossos sacos; o vosso dinheiro me chegou a mim. E trouxe-lhes fora a Simeão.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς ἵλεως ὑμῖν μὴ φοβεῖσθε ὁ θεὸς ὑμῶν καὶ ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν ἔδωκεν ὑμῖν θησαυροὺς ἐν τοῖς μαρσίπποις ὑμῶν τὸ δὲ ἀργύριον ὑμῶν εὐδοκιμοῦν ἀπέχω καὶ ἐξήγαγεν πρὸς αὐτοὺς τὸν Συμεων

text_en: And having brought them into the house, he fetched water, and they washed their feet , and he gave provender to their asses.
text_la: Et introductis domum, attulit aquam, et laverunt pedes suos, deditque pabulum asinis eorum.
text_pt: Depois levou os homens à casa de José, e deu-lhes água, e lavaram os seus pés; também deu pasto aos seus jumentos.
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκεν ὕδωρ νίψαι τοὺς πόδας αὐτῶν καὶ ἔδωκεν χορτάσματα τοῖς ὄνοις αὐτῶν

text_en: But they made ready the presents, against Joseph came at noon : for they had heard that they should eat bread there.
text_la: Illi vero parabant munera, donec ingrederetur Joseph meridie : audierant enim quod ibi comesturi essent panem.
text_pt: E prepararam o presente, para quando José viesse ao meio-dia; porque tinham ouvido que ali haviam de comer pão.
text_el: ἡτοίμασαν δὲ τὰ δῶρα ἕως τοῦ ἐλθεῖν Ιωσηφ μεσημβρίας ἤκουσαν γὰρ ὅτι ἐκεῖ μέλλει ἀριστᾶν

text_en: Then Joseph came in to his house, and they offered him the presents, holding them in their hands; and they bowed down with their face to the ground.
text_la: Igitur ingressus est Joseph domum suam, obtuleruntque ei munera, tenentes in manibus suis : et adoraverunt proni in terram.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, José à casa, trouxeram-lhe ali o presente que tinham em suas mãos; e inclinaram-se a ele até à terra.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Ιωσηφ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν καὶ προσήνεγκαν αὐτῷ τὰ δῶρα ἃ εἶχον ἐν ταῖς χερσὶν αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν οἶκον καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: But he courteously saluting them again, asked them, saying: Is the old man your father in health, of whom you told me? Is he yet living?
text_la: At ille, clementer resalutatis eis, interrogavit eos, dicens : Salvusne est pater vester senex, de quo dixeratis mihi? adhuc vivit?
text_pt: E ele lhes perguntou como estavam, e disse: Vosso pai, o ancião de quem falastes, está bem? Ainda vive?
text_el: ἠρώτησεν δὲ αὐτούς πῶς ἔχετε καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς εἰ ὑγιαίνει ὁ πατὴρ ὑμῶν ὁ πρεσβύτερος ὃν εἴπατε ἔτι ζῇ

text_en: And they answered: Your servant our father, is in health; he is yet living. And bowing themselves, they made obeisance to him.
text_la: Qui responderunt : Sospes est servus tuus pater noster, adhuc vivit. Et incurvati, adoraverunt eum.
text_pt: E eles disseram: Bem está o teu servo, nosso pai vive ainda. E abaixaram a cabeça, e inclinaram-se.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπαν ὑγιαίνει ὁ παῖς σου ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν ἔτι ζῇ καὶ εἶπεν εὐλογητὸς ὁ ἄνθρωπος ἐκεῖνος τῷ θεῷ καὶ κύψαντες προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ

text_en: And Joseph lifting up his eyes, saw Benjamin , his brother by the same mother, and said: Is this your young brother, of whom you told me? And he said: God be gracious to you, my son.
text_la: Attollens autem Joseph oculos, vidit Benjamin fratrem suum uterinum, et ait : Iste est frater vester parvulus, de quo dixeratis mihi? Et rursum : Deus, inquit, misereatur tui, fili mi.
text_pt: E ele levantou os seus olhos, e viu a Benjamim, seu irmão, filho de sua mãe, e disse: Este é vosso irmão mais novo de quem falastes? Depois ele disse: Deus te dê a sua graça, meu filho.
text_el: ἀναβλέψας δὲ τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς Ιωσηφ εἶδεν Βενιαμιν τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ τὸν ὁμομήτριον καὶ εἶπεν οὗτος ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν ὁ νεώτερος ὃν εἴπατε πρός με ἀγαγεῖν καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεὸς ἐλεήσαι σε τέκνον

text_en: And he made haste, because his heart was moved upon his brother, and tears gushed out: and going into his chamber, he wept.
text_la: Festinavitque, quia commota fuerant viscera ejus super fratre suo, et erumpebant lacrimæ : et introiens cubiculum flevit.
text_pt: E José apressou-se, porque as suas entranhas comoveram-se por causa do seu irmão, e procurou onde chorar; e entrou na câmara, e chorou ali.
text_el: ἐταράχθη δὲ Ιωσηφ συνεστρέφετο γὰρ τὰ ἔντερα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῷ ἀδελφῷ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐζήτει κλαῦσαι εἰσελθὼν δὲ εἰς τὸ ταμιεῖον ἔκλαυσεν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And when he had washed his face, coming out again, he refrained himself, and said: Set bread on the table.
text_la: Rursumque lota facie egressus, continuit se, et ait : Ponite panes.
text_pt: Depois lavou o seu rosto, e saiu; e conteve-se, e disse: Ponde pão.
text_el: καὶ νιψάμενος τὸ πρόσωπον ἐξελθὼν ἐνεκρατεύσατο καὶ εἶπεν παράθετε ἄρτους

text_en: And when it was set on, for Joseph apart, and for his brethren apart, for the Egyptians also that ate with him apart, (for it is unlawful for the Egyptians to eat with the Hebrews, and they think such a feast profane):
text_la: Quibus appositis, seorsum Joseph, et seorsum fratribus, Ægyptiis quoque qui vescebantur simul, seorsum (illicitum est enim Ægyptiis comedere cum Hebræis, et profanum putant hujuscemodi convivium)
text_pt: E serviram-lhe à parte, e a eles também à parte, e aos egípcios, que comiam com ele, à parte; porque os egípcios não podem comer pão com os hebreus, porquanto é abominação para os egípcios.
text_el: καὶ παρέθηκαν αὐτῷ μόνῳ καὶ αὐτοῖς καθ' ἑαυτοὺς καὶ τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις τοῖς συνδειπνοῦσιν μετ' αὐτοῦ καθ' ἑαυτούς οὐ γὰρ ἐδύναντο οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι συνεσθίειν μετὰ τῶν Εβραίων ἄρτους βδέλυγμα γάρ ἐστιν τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις

text_en: They sat before him, the firstborn according to his birthright, and the youngest according to his age. And they wondered very much;
text_la: sederunt coram eo, primogenitus juxta primogenita sua, et minimus juxta ætatem suam. Et mirabantur nimis,
text_pt: E assentaram-se diante dele, o primogênito segundo a sua primogenitura, e o menor segundo a sua menoridade; do que os homens se maravilhavam entre si.
text_el: ἐκάθισαν δὲ ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ὁ πρωτότοκος κατὰ τὰ πρεσβεῖα αὐτοῦ καὶ ὁ νεώτερος κατὰ τὴν νεότητα αὐτοῦ ἐξίσταντο δὲ οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἕκαστος πρὸς τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: taking the messes which they received of him: and the greater mess came to Benjamin , so that it exceeded by five parts. And they drank, and were merry with him.
text_la: sumptis partibus quas ab eo acceperant : majorque pars venit Benjamin, ita ut quinque partibus excederet. Biberuntque et inebriati sunt cum eo.
text_pt: E apresentou-lhes as porções que estavam diante dele; porém a porção de Benjamim era cinco vezes maior do que as porções deles todos. E eles beberam, e se regalaram com ele.
text_el: ἦραν δὲ μερίδας παρ' αὐτοῦ πρὸς αὐτούς ἐμεγαλύνθη δὲ ἡ μερὶς Βενιαμιν παρὰ τὰς μερίδας πάντων πενταπλασίως πρὸς τὰς ἐκείνων ἔπιον δὲ καὶ ἐμεθύσθησαν μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Joseph commanded the steward of his house, saying: Fill their sacks with corn, as much as they can hold: and put the money of every one in the top of his sack.
text_la: Præcepit autem Joseph dispensatori domus suæ, dicens : Imple saccos eorum frumento, quantum possunt capere : et pone pecuniam singulorum in summitate sacci.
text_pt: E deu ordem ao que estava sobre a sua casa, dizendo: Enche de mantimento os sacos destes homens, quanto puderem levar, e põe o dinheiro de cada um na boca do seu saco.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετείλατο Ιωσηφ τῷ ὄντι ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ λέγων πλήσατε τοὺς μαρσίππους τῶν ἀνθρώπων βρωμάτων ὅσα ἐὰν δύνωνται ἆραι καὶ ἐμβάλατε ἑκάστου τὸ ἀργύριον ἐπὶ τοῦ στόματος τοῦ μαρσίππου

text_en: And in the mouth of the younger's sack put my silver cup, and the price which he gave for the wheat. And it was so done.
text_la: Scyphum autem meum argenteum, et pretium quod dedit tritici, pone in ore sacci junioris. Factumque est ita.
text_pt: E o meu copo, o copo de prata, porás na boca do saco do mais novo, com o dinheiro do seu trigo. E fez conforme a palavra que José tinha dito.
text_el: καὶ τὸ κόνδυ μου τὸ ἀργυροῦν ἐμβάλατε εἰς τὸν μάρσιππον τοῦ νεωτέρου καὶ τὴν τιμὴν τοῦ σίτου αὐτοῦ ἐγενήθη δὲ κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα Ιωσηφ καθὼς εἶπεν

text_en: And when the morning arose, they were sent away with their asses.
text_la: Et orto mane, dimissi sunt cum asinis suis.
text_pt: Vinda a luz da manhã, despediram-se estes homens, eles com os seus jumentos.
text_el: τὸ πρωὶ διέφαυσεν καὶ οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἀπεστάλησαν αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ ὄνοι αὐτῶν

text_en: And when they were now departed out of the city, and had gone forward a little way: Joseph sending for the steward of his house, said: Arise, and pursue after the men : and when you have overtaken them, say to them: Why have you returned evil for good ?
text_la: Jamque urbem exierant, et processerant paululum : tunc Joseph accersito dispensatore domus, Surge, inquit, et persequere viros : et apprehensis dicito : Quare reddidistis malum pro bono?
text_pt: Saindo eles da cidade, e não se havendo ainda distanciado, disse José ao que estava sobre a sua casa: Levanta-te, e persegue aqueles homens; e, alcançando-os, lhes dirás: Por que pagastes mal por bem?
text_el: ἐξελθόντων δὲ αὐτῶν τὴν πόλιν οὐκ ἀπέσχον μακράν καὶ Ιωσηφ εἶπεν τῷ ἐπὶ τῆς οἰκίας αὐτοῦ ἀναστὰς ἐπιδίωξον ὀπίσω τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ καταλήμψῃ αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐρεῖς αὐτοῖς τί ὅτι ἀνταπεδώκατε πονηρὰ ἀντὶ καλῶν

text_en: The cup which you have stolen , is that in which my lord drinks, and in which he is wont to divine : you have done a very evil thing.
text_la: scyphus, quem furati estis, ipse est in quo bibit dominus meus, et in quo augurari solet : pessimam rem fecistis.
text_pt: Não é este o copo em que bebe meu senhor e pelo qual bem adivinha? Procedestes mal no que fizestes.
text_el: ἵνα τί ἐκλέψατέ μου τὸ κόνδυ τὸ ἀργυροῦν οὐ τοῦτό ἐστιν ἐν ᾧ πίνει ὁ κύριός μου αὐτὸς δὲ οἰωνισμῷ οἰωνίζεται ἐν αὐτῷ πονηρὰ συντετέλεσθε ἃ πεποιήκατε

text_en: He did as he had commanded him. And having overtaken them, he spoke to them the same words.
text_la: Fecit ille ut jusserat: et apprehensis per ordinem locutus est.
text_pt: E alcançou-os, e falou-lhes as mesmas palavras.
text_el: εὑρὼν δὲ αὐτοὺς εἶπεν αὐτοῖς κατὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα

text_en: And they answered: Why does our lord speak so, as though your servants had committed so heinous a fact?
text_la: Qui responderunt : Quare sic loquitur dominus noster, ut servi tui tantum flagitii commiserint?
text_pt: E eles disseram-lhe: Por que diz meu senhor tais palavras? Longe estejam teus servos de fazerem semelhante coisa.
text_el: οἱ δὲ εἶπον αὐτῷ ἵνα τί λαλεῖ ὁ κύριος κατὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα μὴ γένοιτο τοῖς παισίν σου ποιῆσαι κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: The money, that we found in the top of our sacks, we brought back to you from the land of Chanaan : how then should it be that we should steal out of your lord's house, gold or silver?
text_la: pecuniam, quam invenimus in summitate saccorum, reportavimus ad te de terra Chanaan : et quomodo consequens est ut furati simus de domo domini tui aurum vel argentum?
text_pt: Eis que o dinheiro, que temos achado nas bocas dos nossos sacos, te tornamos a trazer desde a terra de Canaã; como, pois, furtaríamos da casa do teu senhor prata ou ouro?
text_el: εἰ τὸ μὲν ἀργύριον ὃ εὕρομεν ἐν τοῖς μαρσίπποις ἡμῶν ἀπεστρέψαμεν πρὸς σὲ ἐκ γῆς Χανααν πῶς ἂν κλέψαιμεν ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ κυρίου σου ἀργύριον ἢ χρυσίον

text_en: With whomsoever of your servants shall be found that which you seek, let him die , and we will be the bondmen of my lord.
text_la: apud quemcumque fuerit inventum servorum tuorum quod quæris, moriatur, et nos erimus servi domini nostri.
text_pt: Aquele, com quem de teus servos for achado, morra; e ainda nós seremos escravos do meu senhor.
text_el: παρ' ᾧ ἂν εὑρεθῇ τὸ κόνδυ τῶν παίδων σου ἀποθνῃσκέτω καὶ ἡμεῖς δὲ ἐσόμεθα παῖδες τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν

text_en: And he said to them: Let it be according to your sentence: with whomsoever it shall be found, let him be my servant , and you shall be blameless.
text_la: Qui dixit eis : Fiat juxta vestram sententiam : apud quemcumque fuerit inventus, ipse sit servus meus, vos autem eritis innoxii.
text_pt: E ele disse: Ora seja também assim conforme as vossas palavras; aquele com quem se achar será meu escravo, porém vós sereis desculpados.
text_el: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν καὶ νῦν ὡς λέγετε οὕτως ἔσται ὁ ἄνθρωπος παρ' ᾧ ἂν εὑρεθῇ τὸ κόνδυ αὐτὸς ἔσται μου παῖς ὑμεῖς δὲ ἔσεσθε καθαροί

text_en: Then they speedily took down their sacks to the ground, and every man opened his sack.
text_la: Itaque festinato deponentes in terram saccos, aperuerunt singuli.
text_pt: E eles apressaram-se e cada um pôs em terra o seu saco, e cada um abriu o seu saco.
text_el: καὶ ἔσπευσαν καὶ καθεῖλαν ἕκαστος τὸν μάρσιππον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ ἤνοιξαν ἕκαστος τὸν μάρσιππον αὐτοῦ

text_en: Which when he had searched, beginning at the eldest, and ending at the youngest, he found the cup in Benjamin's sack.
text_la: Quos scrutatus, incipiens a majore usque ad minimum, invenit scyphum in sacco Benjamin.
text_pt: E buscou, começando do maior, e acabando no mais novo; e achou-se o copo no saco de Benjamim.
text_el: ἠρεύνα δὲ ἀπὸ τοῦ πρεσβυτέρου ἀρξάμενος ἕως ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὸν νεώτερον καὶ εὗρεν τὸ κόνδυ ἐν τῷ μαρσίππῳ τῷ Βενιαμιν

text_en: Then they rent their garments, and loading their asses again, returned into the town.
text_la: At illi, scissis vestibus, oneratisque rursum asinis, reversi sunt in oppidum.
text_pt: Então rasgaram as suas vestes, e carregou cada um o seu jumento, e tornaram à cidade.
text_el: καὶ διέρρηξαν τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπέθηκαν ἕκαστος τὸν μάρσιππον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὸν ὄνον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς τὴν πόλιν

text_en: And Juda at the head of his brethren went in to Joseph (for he was not yet gone out of the place) and they all together fell down before him on the ground.
text_la: Primusque Judas cum fratribus ingressus est ad Joseph (necdum enim de loco abierat) omnesque ante eum pariter in terram corruerunt.
text_pt: E veio Judá com os seus irmãos à casa de José, porque ele ainda estava ali; e prostraram-se diante dele em terra.
text_el: εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Ιουδας καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ πρὸς Ιωσηφ ἔτι αὐτοῦ ὄντος ἐκεῖ καὶ ἔπεσον ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: And he said to them: Why would you do so? know you not that there is no one like me in the science of divining .
text_la: Quibus ille ait : Cur sic agere voluistis? an ignoratis quod non sit similis mei in augurandi scientia?
text_pt: E disse-lhes José: Que é isto que fizestes? Não sabeis vós que um homem como eu pode, muito bem, adivinhar?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ιωσηφ τί τὸ πρᾶγμα τοῦτο ὃ ἐποιήσατε οὐκ οἴδατε ὅτι οἰωνισμῷ οἰωνιεῖται ἄνθρωπος οἷος ἐγώ

text_en: And Juda said to him: What shall we answer my lord? Or what shall we say, or be able justly to allege? God has found out the iniquity of your servants: behold, we are all bondmen to my lord, both we, and he with whom the cup was found.
text_la: Cui Judas : Quid respondebimus, inquit, domino meo? vel quid loquemur, aut juste poterimus obtendere? Deus invenit iniquitatem servorum tuorum : en omnes servi sumus domini mei, et nos, et apud quem inventus est scyphus.
text_pt: Então disse Judá: Que diremos a meu senhor? Que falaremos? E como nos justificaremos? Achou Deus a iniqüidade de teus servos; eis que somos escravos de meu senhor, tanto nós como aquele em cuja mão foi achado o copo.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιουδας τί ἀντεροῦμεν τῷ κυρίῳ ἢ τί λαλήσωμεν ἢ τί δικαιωθῶμεν ὁ δὲ θεὸς εὗρεν τὴν ἀδικίαν τῶν παίδων σου ἰδού ἐσμεν οἰκέται τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν καὶ ἡμεῖς καὶ παρ' ᾧ εὑρέθη τὸ κόνδυ

text_en: Joseph answered: God forbid that I should do so: he that stole the cup, he shall be my bondman : and go you away free to your father.
text_la: Respondit Joseph : Absit a me ut sic agam : qui furatus est scyphum, ipse sit servus meus : vos autem abite liberi ad patrem vestrum.
text_pt: Mas ele disse: Longe de mim que eu tal faça; o homem em cuja mão o copo foi achado, esse será meu servo; porém vós, subi em paz para vosso pai.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιωσηφ μή μοι γένοιτο ποιῆσαι τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ὁ ἄνθρωπος παρ' ᾧ εὑρέθη τὸ κόνδυ αὐτὸς ἔσται μου παῖς ὑμεῖς δὲ ἀνάβητε μετὰ σωτηρίας πρὸς τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν

text_en: Then Juda coming nearer, said boldly: I beseech you, my lord, let your servant speak a word in your ears, and be not angry with your servant: for after Pharao you are.
text_la: Accedens autem propius Judas, confidenter ait : Oro, domini mi, loquatur servus tuus verbum in auribus tuis, et ne irascaris famulo tuo : tu es enim post Pharaonem
text_pt: Então Judá se chegou a ele, e disse: Ai! senhor meu, deixa, peço-te, o teu servo dizer uma palavra aos ouvidos de meu senhor, e não se acenda a tua ira contra o teu servo; porque tu és como Faraó.
text_el: ἐγγίσας δὲ αὐτῷ Ιουδας εἶπεν δέομαι κύριε λαλησάτω ὁ παῖς σου ῥῆμα ἐναντίον σου καὶ μὴ θυμωθῇς τῷ παιδί σου ὅτι σὺ εἶ μετὰ Φαραω

text_en: My lord. You asked your servants the first time: Have you a father or a brother.
text_la: dominus meus. Interrogasti prius servos tuos : Habetis patrem aut fratrem?
text_pt: Meu senhor perguntou a seus servos, dizendo: Tendes vós pai, ou irmão?
text_el: κύριε σὺ ἠρώτησας τοὺς παῖδάς σου λέγων εἰ ἔχετε πατέρα ἢ ἀδελφόν

text_en: And we answered you, my lord: We have a father an old man , and a young boy, that was born in his old age; whose brother by the mother is dead; and he alone is left of his mother, and his father loves him tenderly.
text_la: et nos respondimus tibi domino meo : Est nobis pater senex, et puer parvulus, qui in senectute illius natus est : cujus uterinus frater mortuus est : et ipsum solum habet mater sua, pater vero tenere diliget eum.
text_pt: E dissemos a meu senhor: Temos um velho pai, e um filho da sua velhice, o mais novo, cujo irmão é morto; e só ele ficou de sua mãe, e seu pai o ama.
text_el: καὶ εἴπαμεν τῷ κυρίῳ ἔστιν ἡμῖν πατὴρ πρεσβύτερος καὶ παιδίον γήρως νεώτερον αὐτῷ καὶ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ἀπέθανεν αὐτὸς δὲ μόνος ὑπελείφθη τῇ μητρὶ αὐτοῦ ὁ δὲ πατὴρ αὐτὸν ἠγάπησεν

text_en: And you said to your servants: Bring him hither to me, and I will set my eyes on him.
text_la: Dixistique servis tuis : Adducite eum ad me, et ponam oculos meos super illum.
text_pt: Então tu disseste a teus servos: Trazei-mo a mim, e porei os meus olhos sobre ele.
text_el: εἶπας δὲ τοῖς παισίν σου καταγάγετε αὐτὸν πρός με καὶ ἐπιμελοῦμαι αὐτοῦ

text_en: We suggested to my lord: The boy cannot leave his father: for if he leave him, he will die.
text_la: Suggessimus domino meo : Non potest puer relinquere patrem suum : si enim illum dimiserit, morietur.
text_pt: E nós dissemos a meu senhor: Aquele moço não poderá deixar a seu pai; se deixar a seu pai, este morrerá.
text_el: καὶ εἴπαμεν τῷ κυρίῳ οὐ δυνήσεται τὸ παιδίον καταλιπεῖν τὸν πατέρα ἐὰν δὲ καταλίπῃ τὸν πατέρα ἀποθανεῖται

text_en: And you said to your servants: Unless your youngest brother comes with you, you shall see my face no more.
text_la: Et dixisti servis tuis : Nisi venerit frater vester minimus vobiscum, non videbitis amplius faciem meam.
text_pt: Então tu disseste a teus servos: Se vosso irmão mais novo não descer convosco, nunca mais vereis a minha face.
text_el: σὺ δὲ εἶπας τοῖς παισίν σου ἐὰν μὴ καταβῇ ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν ὁ νεώτερος μεθ' ὑμῶν οὐ προσθήσεσθε ἔτι ἰδεῖν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου

text_en: Therefore when we had gone up to your servant our father, we told him all that my lord had said.
text_la: Cum ergo ascendissemus ad famulum tuum patrem nostrum, narravimus ei omnia quæ locutus est dominus meus.
text_pt: E aconteceu que, subindo nós a teu servo meu pai, e contando-lhe as palavras de meu senhor,
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ ἡνίκα ἀνέβημεν πρὸς τὸν παῖδά σου πατέρα δὲ ἡμῶν ἀπηγγείλαμεν αὐτῷ τὰ ῥήματα τοῦ κυρίου

text_en: And our father said: Go again, and buy us a little wheat.
text_la: Et dixit pater noster : Revertimini, et emite nobis parum tritici.
text_pt: Disse nosso pai: Voltai, comprai-nos um pouco de mantimento.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ἡμῖν ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν βαδίσατε πάλιν ἀγοράσατε ἡμῖν μικρὰ βρώματα

text_en: And we said to him: We cannot go: if our youngest brother go down with us, we will set out together: otherwise, without him we dare not see the man's face.
text_la: Cui diximus : Ire non possumus : si frater noster minimus descenderit nobiscum, proficiscemur simul : alioquin illo absente, non audemus videre faciem viri.
text_pt: E nós dissemos: Não poderemos descer; mas, se nosso irmão menor for conosco, desceremos; pois não poderemos ver a face do homem se este nosso irmão menor não estiver conosco.
text_el: ἡμεῖς δὲ εἴπαμεν οὐ δυνησόμεθα καταβῆναι ἀλλ' εἰ μὲν ὁ ἀδελφὸς ἡμῶν ὁ νεώτερος καταβαίνει μεθ' ἡμῶν καταβησόμεθα οὐ γὰρ δυνησόμεθα ἰδεῖν τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ τοῦ νεωτέρου μὴ ὄντος μεθ' ἡμῶν

text_en: Whereunto he answered: You know that my wife bore me two.
text_la: Ad quæ ille respondit : Vos scitis quod duos genuerit mihi uxor mea.
text_pt: Então disse-nos teu servo, meu pai: Vós sabeis que minha mulher me deu dois filhos;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ παῖς σου ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν πρὸς ἡμᾶς ὑμεῖς γινώσκετε ὅτι δύο ἔτεκέν μοι ἡ γυνή

text_en: One went out, and you said: A beast devoured him; and hitherto he appears not.
text_la: Egressus est unus, et dixistis : Bestia devoravit eum : et hucusque non comparet.
text_pt: E um ausentou-se de mim, e eu disse: Certamente foi despedaçado, e não o tenho visto até agora;
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ εἷς ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ εἴπατε ὅτι θηριόβρωτος γέγονεν καὶ οὐκ εἶδον αὐτὸν ἔτι καὶ νῦν

text_en: If you take this also, and anything befall him on the way, you will bring down my grey hairs with sorrow unto hell .
text_la: Si tuleritis et istum, et aliquid ei in via contigerit, deducetis canos meos cum mœrore ad inferos.
text_pt: Se agora também tirardes a este da minha face, e lhe acontecer algum desastre, fareis descer as minhas cãs com aflição à sepultura.
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν λάβητε καὶ τοῦτον ἐκ προσώπου μου καὶ συμβῇ αὐτῷ μαλακία ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ κατάξετέ μου τὸ γῆρας μετὰ λύπης εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: Therefore, if I shall go to your servant, our father, and the boy be wanting, (whereas his life depends upon the life of him),
text_la: Igitur si intravero ad servum tuum patrem nostrum, et puer defuerit (cum anima illius ex hujus anima pendeat),
text_pt: Agora, pois, indo eu a teu servo, meu pai, e o moço não indo conosco, como a sua alma está ligada com a alma dele,
text_el: νῦν οὖν ἐὰν εἰσπορεύωμαι πρὸς τὸν παῖδά σου πατέρα δὲ ἡμῶν καὶ τὸ παιδάριον μὴ ᾖ μεθ' ἡμῶν ἡ δὲ ψυχὴ αὐτοῦ ἐκκρέμαται ἐκ τῆς τούτου ψυχῆς

text_en: and he shall see that he is not with us, he will die, and your servants shall bring down his grey hairs with sorrow unto hell .
text_la: videritque eum non esse nobiscum, morietur, et deducent famuli tui canos ejus cum dolore ad inferos.
text_pt: Acontecerá que, vendo ele que o moço ali não está, morrerá; e teus servos farão descer as cãs de teu servo, nosso pai, com tristeza à sepultura.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ἐν τῷ ἰδεῖν αὐτὸν μὴ ὂν τὸ παιδάριον μεθ' ἡμῶν τελευτήσει καὶ κατάξουσιν οἱ παῖδές σου τὸ γῆρας τοῦ παιδός σου πατρὸς δὲ ἡμῶν μετ' ὀδύνης εἰς ᾅδου

text_en: Let me be your proper servant, who took him into my trust, and promised, saying: If I bring him not again, I will be guilty of sin against my father for ever .
text_la: Ego proprie servus tuus sim qui in meam hunc recepi fidem, et spopondi dicens : Nisi reduxero eum, peccati reus ero in patrem meum omni tempore.
text_pt: Porque teu servo se deu por fiador por este moço para com meu pai, dizendo: Se eu o não tornar para ti, serei culpado para com meu pai por todos os dias.
text_el: ὁ γὰρ παῖς σου ἐκδέδεκται τὸ παιδίον παρὰ τοῦ πατρὸς λέγων ἐὰν μὴ ἀγάγω αὐτὸν πρὸς σὲ καὶ στήσω αὐτὸν ἐναντίον σου ἡμαρτηκὼς ἔσομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα πάσας τὰς ἡμέρας

text_en: Therefore I, your servant, will stay instead of the boy in the service of my lord, and let the boy go up with his brethren.
text_la: Manebo itaque servus tuus pro puero in ministerio domini mei, et puer ascendat cum fratribus suis.
text_pt: Agora, pois, fique teu servo em lugar deste moço por escravo de meu senhor, e que suba o moço com os seus irmãos.
text_el: νῦν οὖν παραμενῶ σοι παῖς ἀντὶ τοῦ παιδίου οἰκέτης τοῦ κυρίου τὸ δὲ παιδίον ἀναβήτω μετὰ τῶν ἀδελφῶν

text_en: For I cannot return to my father without the boy, lest I be a witness of the calamity that will oppress my father.
text_la: Non enim possum redire ad patrem meum, absente puero : ne calamitatis, quæ oppressura est patrem meum, testis assistam.
text_pt: Porque, como subirei eu a meu pai, se o moço não for comigo? para que não veja eu o mal que sobrevirá a meu pai.
text_el: πῶς γὰρ ἀναβήσομαι πρὸς τὸν πατέρα τοῦ παιδίου μὴ ὄντος μεθ' ἡμῶν ἵνα μὴ ἴδω τὰ κακά ἃ εὑρήσει τὸν πατέρα μου

text_en: Joseph could no longer refrain himself before many that stood by: whereupon he commanded that all should go out, and no stranger be present at their knowing one another.
text_la: Non se poterat ultra cohibere Joseph multis coram astantibus : unde præcepit ut egrederentur cuncti foras, et nullus interesset alienus agnitioni mutuæ.
text_pt: Então José não se podia conter diante de todos os que estavam com ele; e clamou: Fazei sair daqui a todo o homem; e ninguém ficou com ele, quando José se deu a conhecer a seus irmãos.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο Ιωσηφ ἀνέχεσθαι πάντων τῶν παρεστηκότων αὐτῷ ἀλλ' εἶπεν ἐξαποστείλατε πάντας ἀπ' ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐ παρειστήκει οὐδεὶς ἔτι τῷ Ιωσηφ ἡνίκα ἀνεγνωρίζετο τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he lifted up his voice with weeping, which the Egyptians , and all the house of Pharao heard.
text_la: Elevavitque vocem cum fletu, quam audierunt Ægyptii, omnisque domus Pharaonis.
text_pt: E levantou a sua voz com choro, de maneira que os egípcios o ouviam, e a casa de Faraó o ouviu.
text_el: καὶ ἀφῆκεν φωνὴν μετὰ κλαυθμοῦ ἤκουσαν δὲ πάντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι καὶ ἀκουστὸν ἐγένετο εἰς τὸν οἶκον Φαραω

text_en: And he said to his brethren: I am Joseph : Is my father yet living? His brethren could not answer him, being struck with exceeding great fear .
text_la: Et dixit fratribus suis : Ego sum Joseph : adhuc pater meus vivit? Non poterant respondere fratres nimio terrore perterriti.
text_pt: E disse José a seus irmãos: Eu sou José; vive ainda meu pai? E seus irmãos não lhe puderam responder, porque estavam pasmados diante da sua face.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιωσηφ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐγώ εἰμι Ιωσηφ ἔτι ὁ πατήρ μου ζῇ καὶ οὐκ ἐδύναντο οἱ ἀδελφοὶ ἀποκριθῆναι αὐτῷ ἐταράχθησαν γάρ

text_en: And he said mildly to them: Come nearer to me. And when they had come near him, he said: I am Joseph , your brother, whom you sold into Egypt .
text_la: Ad quos ille clementer : Accedite, inquit, ad me. Et cum accessissent prope : Ego sum, ait, Joseph, frater vester, quem vendidistis in Ægyptum.
text_pt: E disse José a seus irmãos: Peço-vos, chegai-vos a mim. E chegaram-se; então disse ele: Eu sou José vosso irmão, a quem vendestes para o Egito.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιωσηφ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἐγγίσατε πρός με καὶ ἤγγισαν καὶ εἶπεν ἐγώ εἰμι Ιωσηφ ὁ ἀδελφὸς ὑμῶν ὃν ἀπέδοσθε εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: Be not afraid , and let it not seem to you a hard case that you sold me into these countries: for God sent me before you into Egypt for your preservation.
text_la: Nolite pavere, neque vobis durum esse videatur quod vendidistis me in his regionibus : pro salute enim vestra misit me Deus ante vos in Ægyptum.
text_pt: Agora, pois, não vos entristeçais, nem vos pese aos vossos olhos por me haverdes vendido para cá; porque para conservação da vida, Deus me enviou adiante de vós.
text_el: νῦν οὖν μὴ λυπεῖσθε μηδὲ σκληρὸν ὑμῖν φανήτω ὅτι ἀπέδοσθέ με ὧδε εἰς γὰρ ζωὴν ἀπέστειλέν με ὁ θεὸς ἔμπροσθεν ὑμῶν

text_en: For it is two years since the famine began to be upon the land, and five years more remain, wherein there can be neither ploughing nor reaping.
text_la: Biennium est enim quod cœpit fames esse in terra : et adhuc quinque anni restant, quibus nec arari poterit, nec meti.
text_pt: Porque já houve dois anos de fome no meio da terra, e ainda restam cinco anos em que não haverá lavoura nem sega.
text_el: τοῦτο γὰρ δεύτερον ἔτος λιμὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἔτι λοιπὰ πέντε ἔτη ἐν οἷς οὐκ ἔσται ἀροτρίασις οὐδὲ ἄμητος

text_en: And God sent me before, that you may be preserved upon the earth, and may have food to live.
text_la: Præmisitque me Deus ut reservemini super terram, et escas ad vivendum habere possitis.
text_pt: Pelo que Deus me enviou adiante de vós, para conservar vossa sucessão na terra, e para guardar-vos em vida por um grande livramento.
text_el: ἀπέστειλεν γάρ με ὁ θεὸς ἔμπροσθεν ὑμῶν ὑπολείπεσθαι ὑμῶν κατάλειμμα ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐκθρέψαι ὑμῶν κατάλειψιν μεγάλην

text_en: Not by your counsel was I sent hither, but by the will of God : who has made me as it were a father to Pharao , and lord of his whole house, and governor in all the land of Egypt .
text_la: Non vestro consilio, sed Dei voluntate huc missum sum : qui fecit me quasi patrem Pharaonis, et dominum universæ domus ejus, ac principem in omni terra Ægypti.
text_pt: Assim não fostes vós que me enviastes para cá, senão Deus, que me tem posto por pai de Faraó, e por senhor de toda a sua casa, e como regente em toda a terra do Egito.
text_el: νῦν οὖν οὐχ ὑμεῖς με ἀπεστάλκατε ὧδε ἀλλ' ἢ ὁ θεός καὶ ἐποίησέν με ὡς πατέρα Φαραω καὶ κύριον παντὸς τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἄρχοντα πάσης γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: Make haste, and go up to my father, and say to him: Thus says your son Joseph : God has made me lord of the whole land of Egypt ; come down to me, linger not.
text_la: Festinate, et ascendite ad patrem meum, et dicetis ei : Hæc mandat filius tuus Joseph : Deus fecit me dominum universæ terræ Ægypti : descende ad me, ne moreris,
text_pt: Apressai-vos, e subi a meu pai, e dizei-lhe: Assim tem dito o teu filho José: Deus me tem posto por senhor em toda a terra do Egito; desce a mim, e não te demores;
text_el: σπεύσαντες οὖν ἀνάβητε πρὸς τὸν πατέρα μου καὶ εἴπατε αὐτῷ τάδε λέγει ὁ υἱός σου Ιωσηφ ἐποίησέν με ὁ θεὸς κύριον πάσης γῆς Αἰγύπτου κατάβηθι οὖν πρός με καὶ μὴ μείνῃς

text_en: And you shall dwell in the land of Gessen: and you shall be near me, you and your sons, and your sons' sons, your sheep, and your herds, and all things that you have.
text_la: et habitabis in terra Gessen : erisque juxta me tu, et filii tui, et filii filiorum tuorum, oves tuæ, et armenta tua, et universa quæ possides:
text_pt: E habitarás na terra de Gósen, e estarás perto de mim, tu e os teus filhos, e os filhos dos teus filhos, e as tuas ovelhas, e as tuas vacas, e tudo o que tens.
text_el: καὶ κατοικήσεις ἐν γῇ Γεσεμ Ἀραβίας καὶ ἔσῃ ἐγγύς μου σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν υἱῶν σου τὰ πρόβατά σου καὶ αἱ βόες σου καὶ ὅσα σοί ἐστιν

text_en: And there I will feed you, (for there are yet five years of famine remaining) lest both you perish, and your house , and all things that you have.
text_la: ibique te pascam (adhuc enim quinque anni residui sunt famis) ne et tu pereas, et domus tua, et omnia quæ possides.
text_pt: E ali te sustentarei, porque ainda haverá cinco anos de fome, para que não pereças de pobreza, tu e tua casa, e tudo o que tens.
text_el: καὶ ἐκθρέψω σε ἐκεῖ ἔτι γὰρ πέντε ἔτη λιμός ἵνα μὴ ἐκτριβῇς σὺ καὶ οἱ υἱοί σου καὶ πάντα τὰ ὑπάρχοντά σου

text_en: Behold, your eyes, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin , see that it is my mouth that speaks to you.
text_la: En oculi vestri, et oculi fratris mei Benjamin, vident quod os meum loquatur ad vos.
text_pt: E eis que vossos olhos, e os olhos de meu irmão Benjamim, vêem que é minha boca que vos fala.
text_el: ἰδοὺ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ ὑμῶν βλέπουσιν καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ Βενιαμιν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ μου ὅτι τὸ στόμα μου τὸ λαλοῦν πρὸς ὑμᾶς

text_en: You shall tell my father of all my glory , and all things that you have seen in Egypt : make haste and bring him to me.
text_la: Nuntiate patri meo universam gloriam meam, et cuncta quæ vidistis in Ægypto : festinate, et adducite eum ad me.
text_pt: E fazei saber a meu pai toda a minha glória no Egito, e tudo o que tendes visto, e apressai-vos a fazer descer meu pai para cá.
text_el: ἀπαγγείλατε οὖν τῷ πατρί μου πᾶσαν τὴν δόξαν μου τὴν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ ὅσα εἴδετε καὶ ταχύναντες καταγάγετε τὸν πατέρα μου ὧδε

text_en: And falling upon the neck of his brother Benjamin , he embraced him and wept: and Benjamin in like manner wept also on his neck.
text_la: Cumque amplexatus recidisset in collum Benjamin fratris sui, flevit : illo quoque similiter flente super collum ejus.
text_pt: E lançou-se ao pescoço de Benjamim seu irmão, e chorou; e Benjamim chorou também ao seu pescoço.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιπεσὼν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον Βενιαμιν τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ ἔκλαυσεν ἐπ' αὐτῷ καὶ Βενιαμιν ἔκλαυσεν ἐπὶ τῷ τραχήλῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Joseph kissed all his brethren, and wept upon every one of them: after which they were emboldened to speak to him.
text_la: Osculatusque est Joseph omnes fratres suos, et ploravit super singulos : post quæ ausi sunt loqui ad eum.
text_pt: E beijou a todos os seus irmãos, e chorou sobre eles; e depois seus irmãos falaram com ele.
text_el: καὶ καταφιλήσας πάντας τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἔκλαυσεν ἐπ' αὐτοῖς καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα ἐλάλησαν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: And it was heard, and the fame was spread abroad in the king's court : The brethren of Joseph have come; and Pharao with all his family was glad .
text_la: Auditumque est, et celebri sermone vulgatum in aula regis : Venerunt fratres Joseph : et gavisus est Pharao, atque omnis familia ejus.
text_pt: E esta notícia ouviu-se na casa de Faraó: Os irmãos de José são vindos; e pareceu bem aos olhos de Faraó, e aos olhos de seus servos.
text_el: καὶ διεβοήθη ἡ φωνὴ εἰς τὸν οἶκον Φαραω λέγοντες ἥκασιν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ Ιωσηφ ἐχάρη δὲ Φαραω καὶ ἡ θεραπεία αὐτοῦ

text_en: And he spoke to Joseph that he should give orders to his brethren, saying: Load your beasts, and go into the land of Chanaan ,
text_la: Dixitque ad Joseph ut imperaret fratribus suis, dicens : Onerantes jumenta, ite in terram Chanaan,
text_pt: E disse Faraó a José: Dize a teus irmãos: Fazei isto: carregai os vossos animais e parti, tornai à terra de Canaã.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Φαραω πρὸς Ιωσηφ εἰπὸν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς σου τοῦτο ποιήσατε γεμίσατε τὰ πορεῖα ὑμῶν καὶ ἀπέλθατε εἰς γῆν Χανααν

text_en: and bring away from thence your father and kindred , and come to me; and I will give you all the good things of Egypt , that you may eat the marrow of the land.
text_la: et tollite inde patrem vestrum et cognationem, et venite ad me : et ego dabo vobis omnia bona Ægypti, ut comedatis medullam terræ.
text_pt: E tornai a vosso pai, e às vossas famílias, e vinde a mim; e eu vos darei o melhor da terra do Egito, e comereis da fartura da terra.
text_el: καὶ παραλαβόντες τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν καὶ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα ὑμῶν ἥκετε πρός με καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν πάντων τῶν ἀγαθῶν Αἰγύπτου καὶ φάγεσθε τὸν μυελὸν τῆς γῆς

text_en: Give orders also that they take wagons out of the land of Egypt , for the carriage of their children and their wives; and say: Take up your father, and make haste to come with all speed:
text_la: Præcipe etiam ut tollant plaustra de terra Ægypti, ad subvectionem parvulorum suorum ac conjugum : et dicito : Tollite patrem vestrum, et properate quantocius venientes.
text_pt: A ti, pois, é ordenado: Fazei isto: tomai vós da terra do Egito carros para vossos meninos, para vossas mulheres, e para vosso pai, e vinde.
text_el: σὺ δὲ ἔντειλαι ταῦτα λαβεῖν αὐτοῖς ἁμάξας ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου τοῖς παιδίοις ὑμῶν καὶ ταῖς γυναιξίν καὶ ἀναλαβόντες τὸν πατέρα ὑμῶν παραγίνεσθε

text_en: And leave nothing of your household stuff ; for all the riches of Egypt shall be yours.
text_la: Nec dimittatis quidquam de supellectili vestra : quia omnes opes Ægypti vestræ erunt.
text_pt: E não vos pese coisa alguma dos vossos utensílios; porque o melhor de toda a terra do Egito será vosso.
text_el: καὶ μὴ φείσησθε τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς τῶν σκευῶν ὑμῶν τὰ γὰρ πάντα ἀγαθὰ Αἰγύπτου ὑμῖν ἔσται

text_en: And the sons of Israel did as they were bid. And Joseph gave them wagons according to Pharao's commandment: and provisions for the way.
text_la: Feceruntque filii Israël ut eis mandatum fuerat. Quibus dedit Joseph plaustra, secundum Pharaonis imperium, et cibaria in itinere.
text_pt: E os filhos de Israel fizeram assim. E José deu-lhes carros, conforme o mandado de Faraó; também lhes deu comida para o caminho.
text_el: ἐποίησαν δὲ οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἔδωκεν δὲ Ιωσηφ αὐτοῖς ἁμάξας κατὰ τὰ εἰρημένα ὑπὸ Φαραω τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς ἐπισιτισμὸν εἰς τὴν ὁδόν

text_en: He ordered also to be brought out for every one of them two robes: but to Benjamin he gave three hundred pieces of silver, with five robes of the best:
text_la: Singulis quoque proferri jussit binas stolas: Benjamin vero dedit trecentos argenteos cum quinque stolis optimis:
text_pt: A todos lhes deu, a cada um, mudas de roupas; mas a Benjamim deu trezentas peças de prata, e cinco mudas de roupas.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσιν ἔδωκεν δισσὰς στολάς τῷ δὲ Βενιαμιν ἔδωκεν τριακοσίους χρυσοῦς καὶ πέντε ἐξαλλασσούσας στολάς

text_en: Sending to his father as much money and raiment; adding besides, ten he asses, to carry off all the riches of Egypt , and as many she asses, carrying wheat and bread for the journey.
text_la: tantumdem pecuniæ et vestium mittens patri suo, addens et asinos decem, qui subveherent ex omnibus divitiis Ægypti, et totidem asinas, triticum in itinere, panesque portantes.
text_pt: E a seu pai enviou semelhantemente dez jumentos carregados do melhor do Egito, e dez jumentos carregados de trigo e pão, e comida para seu pai, para o caminho.
text_el: καὶ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπέστειλεν κατὰ τὰ αὐτὰ καὶ δέκα ὄνους αἴροντας ἀπὸ πάντων τῶν ἀγαθῶν Αἰγύπτου καὶ δέκα ἡμιόνους αἰρούσας ἄρτους τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς ὁδόν

text_en: So he sent away his brethren, and at their departing said to them: Be not angry in the way.
text_la: Dimisit ergo fratres suos, et proficiscentibus ait : Ne irascamini in via.
text_pt: E despediu os seus irmãos, e partiram; e disse-lhes: Não contendais pelo caminho.
text_el: ἐξαπέστειλεν δὲ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπορεύθησαν καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς μὴ ὀργίζεσθε ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ

text_en: And they went up out of Egypt , and came into the land of Chanaan , to their father Jacob .
text_la: Qui ascendentes ex Ægypto, venerunt in terram Chanaan ad patrem suum Jacob.
text_pt: E subiram do Egito, e vieram à terra de Canaã, a Jacó seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβησαν ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἦλθον εἰς γῆν Χανααν πρὸς Ιακωβ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν

text_en: And they told him, saying: Joseph , your son, is living; and he is ruler in all the land of Egypt . Which when Jacob heard, he awaked as it were out of a deep sleep, yet did not believe them.
text_la: Et nuntiaverunt ei, dicentes : Joseph filius tuus vivit : et ipse dominatur in omni terra Ægypti. Quo audito Jacob, quasi de gravi somno evigilans, tamen non credebat eis.
text_pt: Então lhe anunciaram, dizendo: José ainda vive, e ele também é regente em toda a terra do Egito. E o seu coração desmaiou, porque não os acreditava.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήγγειλαν αὐτῷ λέγοντες ὅτι ὁ υἱός σου Ιωσηφ ζῇ καὶ αὐτὸς ἄρχει πάσης γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐξέστη ἡ διάνοια Ιακωβ οὐ γὰρ ἐπίστευσεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: They, on the other side, told the whole order of the thing. And when he saw the wagons, and all that he had sent, his spirit revived,
text_la: Illi e contra referebant omnem ordinem rei. Cumque vidisset plaustra et universa quæ miserat, revixit spiritus ejus,
text_pt: Porém, havendo-lhe eles contado todas as palavras de José, que ele lhes falara, e vendo ele os carros que José enviara para levá-lo, reviveu o espírito de Jacó seu pai.
text_el: ἐλάλησαν δὲ αὐτῷ πάντα τὰ ῥηθέντα ὑπὸ Ιωσηφ ὅσα εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἰδὼν δὲ τὰς ἁμάξας ἃς ἀπέστειλεν Ιωσηφ ὥστε ἀναλαβεῖν αὐτόν ἀνεζωπύρησεν τὸ πνεῦμα Ιακωβ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῶν

text_en: and he said: It is enough for me if Joseph , my son, be yet living: I will go and see him before I die.
text_la: et ait : Sufficit mihi si adhuc Joseph filius meus vivit : vadam, et videbo illum antequam moriar.
text_pt: E disse Israel: Basta; ainda vive meu filho José; eu irei e o verei antes que morra.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ισραηλ μέγα μοί ἐστιν εἰ ἔτι Ιωσηφ ὁ υἱός μου ζῇ πορευθεὶς ὄψομαι αὐτὸν πρὸ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν με

text_en: And Israel taking his journey, with all that he had, came to the well of the oath , and killing victims there to the God of his father Isaac ,
text_la: Profectusque Israël cum omnibus quæ habebat, venit ad Puteum juramenti : et mactatis ibi victimis Deo patris sui Isaac,
text_pt: E partiu Israel com tudo quanto tinha, e veio a Berseba, e ofereceu sacrifícios ao Deus de seu pai Isaque.
text_el: ἀπάρας δὲ Ισραηλ αὐτὸς καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν ἐπὶ τὸ φρέαρ τοῦ ὅρκου καὶ ἔθυσεν θυσίαν τῷ θεῷ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ Ισαακ

text_en: he heard him, by a vision in the night, calling him, and saying to him: Jacob , Jacob . And he answered him: Lo, here I am.
text_la: audivit eum per visionem noctis vocantem se, et dicentem sibi : Jacob, Jacob. Cui respondit : Ecce adsum.
text_pt: E falou Deus a Israel em visões de noite, e disse: Jacó, Jacó! E ele disse: Eis-me aqui.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ ὁ θεὸς Ισραηλ ἐν ὁράματι τῆς νυκτὸς εἴπας Ιακωβ Ιακωβ ὁ δὲ εἶπεν τί ἐστιν

text_en: God said to him: I am the most mighty God of your father ; fear not, go down into Egypt , for I will make a great nation of you there.
text_la: Ait illi Deus : Ego sum fortissimus Deus patris tui : noli timere, descende in Ægyptum, quia in gentem magnam faciam te ibi.
text_pt: E disse: Eu sou Deus, o Deus de teu pai; não temas descer ao Egito, porque eu te farei ali uma grande nação.
text_el: λέγων ἐγώ εἰμι ὁ θεὸς τῶν πατέρων σου μὴ φοβοῦ καταβῆναι εἰς Αἴγυπτον εἰς γὰρ ἔθνος μέγα ποιήσω σε ἐκεῖ

text_en: I will go down with you thither, and will bring you back again from thence: Joseph also shall put his hands upon your eyes.
text_la: Ego descendam tecum illuc, et ego inde adducam te revertentem : Joseph quoque ponet manus suas super oculos tuos.
text_pt: E descerei contigo ao Egito, e certamente te farei tornar a subir, e José porá a sua mão sobre os teus olhos.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ καταβήσομαι μετὰ σοῦ εἰς Αἴγυπτον καὶ ἐγὼ ἀναβιβάσω σε εἰς τέλος καὶ Ιωσηφ ἐπιβαλεῖ τὰς χεῖρας ἐπὶ τοὺς ὀφθαλμούς σου

text_en: And Jacob rose up from the well of the oath : and his sons took him up, with their children and wives in the wagons, which Pharao had sent to carry the old man ,
text_la: Surrexit autem Jacob a Puteo juramenti: tuleruntque eum filii cum parvulis et uxoribus suis in plaustris quæ miserat Pharao ad portandum senem,
text_pt: Então levantou-se Jacó de Berseba; e os filhos de Israel levaram a seu pai Jacó, e seus meninos, e as suas mulheres, nos carros que Faraó enviara para o levar.
text_el: ἀνέστη δὲ Ιακωβ ἀπὸ τοῦ φρέατος τοῦ ὅρκου καὶ ἀνέλαβον οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ τὸν πατέρα αὐτῶν καὶ τὴν ἀποσκευὴν καὶ τὰς γυναῖκας αὐτῶν ἐπὶ τὰς ἁμάξας ἃς ἀπέστειλεν Ιωσηφ ἆραι αὐτόν

text_en: and all that he had in the land of Chanaan : and he came into Egypt with all his seed;
text_la: et omnia quæ possederat in terra Chanaan : venitque in Ægyptum cum omni semine suo,
text_pt: E tomaram o seu gado e os seus bens que tinham adquirido na terra de Canaã, e vieram ao Egito, Jacó e toda a sua descendência com ele;
text_el: καὶ ἀναλαβόντες τὰ ὑπάρχοντα αὐτῶν καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν κτῆσιν ἣν ἐκτήσαντο ἐν γῇ Χανααν εἰσῆλθον εἰς Αἴγυπτον Ιακωβ καὶ πᾶν τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: his sons, and grandsons, daughters, and all his offspring together.
text_la: filii ejus, et nepotes, filiæ, et cuncta simul progenies.
text_pt: Os seus filhos e os filhos de seus filhos com ele, as filhas, e as filhas de seus filhos, e toda a sua descendência levou consigo ao Egito.
text_el: υἱοὶ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ μετ' αὐτοῦ θυγατέρες καὶ θυγατέρες τῶν υἱῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶν τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἤγαγεν εἰς Αἴγυπτον

text_en: And these are the names of the children of Israel , that entered into Egypt , he and his children. His firstborn Ruben ,
text_la: Hæc sunt autem nomina filiorum Israël, qui ingressi sunt in Ægyptum, ipse cum liberis suis. Primogenitus Ruben.
text_pt: E estes são os nomes dos filhos de Israel, que vieram ao Egito, Jacó e seus filhos: Rúben, o primogênito de Jacó.
text_el: ταῦτα δὲ τὰ ὀνόματα τῶν υἱῶν Ισραηλ τῶν εἰσελθόντων εἰς Αἴγυπτον Ιακωβ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ πρωτότοκος Ιακωβ Ρουβην

text_en: the sons of Ruben : Henoch and Phallu, and Hesron and Charmi.
text_la: Filii Ruben: Henoch et Phallu et Hesron et Charmi.
text_pt: E os filhos de Rúben: Enoque, Palu, Hezrom e Carmi.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ρουβην Ενωχ καὶ Φαλλους Ασρων καὶ Χαρμι

text_en: The sons of Simeon : Jamuel and Jamin and Ahod, and Jachin and Sohar, and Saul, the son of a woman of Chanaan .
text_la: Filii Simeon : Jamuel et Jamin et Ahod, et Jachin et Sohar, et Saul filius Chanaanitidis.
text_pt: E os filhos de Simeão: Jemuel, Jamim, Oade, Jaquim, Zoar e Saul, filho de uma mulher cananéia.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Συμεων Ιεμουηλ καὶ Ιαμιν καὶ Αωδ καὶ Ιαχιν καὶ Σααρ καὶ Σαουλ υἱὸς τῆς Χανανίτιδος

text_en: The sons of Levi : Gerson and Caath, and Merari.
text_la: Filii Levi: Gerson et Caath et Merari.
text_pt: E os filhos de Levi: Gérson, Coate e Merari.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Λευι Γηρσων Κααθ καὶ Μεραρι

text_en: The sons of Juda : Her and Onan, and Sela, and Phares and Zara. And Her and Onan died in the land of Chanaan . And sons were born to Phares: Hesron and Hamul.
text_la: Filii Juda : Her et Onan et Sela et Phares et Zara; mortui sunt autem Her et Onan in terra Chanaan. Natique sunt filii Phares : Hesron et Hamul.
text_pt: E os filhos de Judá: Er, Onã, Selá, Perez e Zerá; Er e Onã, porém, morreram na terra de Canaã; e os filhos de Perez foram Hezrom e Hamul.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ιουδα Ηρ καὶ Αυναν καὶ Σηλωμ καὶ Φαρες καὶ Ζαρα ἀπέθανεν δὲ Ηρ καὶ Αυναν ἐν γῇ Χανααν ἐγένοντο δὲ υἱοὶ Φαρες Ασρων καὶ Ιεμουηλ

text_en: The sons of Issachar : Thola and Phua, and Job and Semron.
text_la: Filii Issachar: Thola et Phua et Job et Semron.
text_pt: E os filhos de Issacar: Tola, Puva, Jó e Sinrom.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ισσαχαρ Θωλα καὶ Φουα καὶ Ιασουβ καὶ Ζαμβραμ

text_en: The sons of Zabulon : Sared, and Elon, and Jahelel.
text_la: Filii Zabulon: Sared et Elon et Jahelel.
text_pt: E os filhos de Zebulom: Serede, Elom e Jaleel.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ζαβουλων Σερεδ καὶ Αλλων καὶ Αλοηλ

text_en: These are the sons of Lia, whom she bore in Mesopotamia of Syria , with Dina, his daughter. All the souls of her sons and daughters, thirty-three.
text_la: Hi filii Liæ quos genuit in Mesopotamia Syriæ cum Dina filia sua : omnes animæ filiorum ejus et filiarum, triginta tres.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Lia, que ela deu a Jacó em Padã-Arã, além de Diná, sua filha; todas as almas de seus filhos e de suas filhas foram trinta e três.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Λειας οὓς ἔτεκεν τῷ Ιακωβ ἐν Μεσοποταμίᾳ τῆς Συρίας καὶ Διναν τὴν θυγατέρα αὐτοῦ πᾶσαι αἱ ψυχαί υἱοὶ καὶ θυγατέρες τριάκοντα τρεῖς

text_en: The sons of Gad : Sephion and Haggi, and Suni and Esebon, and Heri and Arodi, and Areli.
text_la: Filii Gad: Sephion et Haggi et Suni et Esebon et Heri et Arodi et Areli.
text_pt: E os filhos de Gade: Zifiom, Hagi, Suni, Esbom, Eri, Arodi e Areli.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Γαδ Σαφων καὶ Αγγις καὶ Σαυνις καὶ Θασοβαν καὶ Αηδις καὶ Αροηδις καὶ Αροηλις

text_en: The sons of Aser : Jamne and Jesua, and Jessuri and Beria, and Sara their sister. The sons of Beria: Heber and Melchiel.
text_la: Filii Aser : Jamne et Jesua et Jessui et Beria, Sara quoque soror eorum. Filii Beria : Heber et Melchiel.
text_pt: E os filhos de Aser: Imna, Isvá, Isvi, Berias e Sera, a irmã deles; e os filhos de Berias: Héber e Malquiel.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ασηρ Ιεμνα καὶ Ιεσουα καὶ Ιεουλ καὶ Βαρια καὶ Σαρα ἀδελφὴ αὐτῶν υἱοὶ δὲ Βαρια Χοβορ καὶ Μελχιηλ

text_en: These are the sons of Zelpha, whom Laban gave to Lia, his daughter. And these she bore to Jacob , sixteen souls .
text_la: Hi filii Zelphæ, quam dedit Laban Liæ filiæ suæ : et hos genuit Jacob sedecim animas.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Zilpa, a qual Labão deu à sua filha Lia; e deu a Jacó estas dezesseis almas.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ζελφας ἣν ἔδωκεν Λαβαν Λεια τῇ θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ ἣ ἔτεκεν τούτους τῷ Ιακωβ δέκα ἓξ ψυχάς

text_en: The sons of Rachel , Jacob's wife: Joseph and Benjamin .
text_la: Filii Rachel uxoris Jacob: Joseph et Benjamin.
text_pt: Os filhos de Raquel, mulher de Jacó: José e Benjamim.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ραχηλ γυναικὸς Ιακωβ Ιωσηφ καὶ Βενιαμιν

text_en: And sons were born to Joseph , in the land of Egypt , whom Aseneth , the daughter of Putiphare, priest of Heliopolis, bore him: Manasses and Ephraim.
text_la: Natique sunt Joseph filii in terra Ægypti, quos genuit ei Aseneth filia Putiphare sacerdotis Heliopoleos : Manasses et Ephraim.
text_pt: E nasceram a José na terra do Egito, Manassés e Efraim, que lhe deu Azenate, filha de Potífera, sacerdote de Om.
text_el: ἐγένοντο δὲ υἱοὶ Ιωσηφ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ οὓς ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ Ασεννεθ θυγάτηρ Πετεφρη ἱερέως Ἡλίου πόλεως τὸν Μανασση καὶ τὸν Εφραιμ ἐγένοντο δὲ υἱοὶ Μανασση οὓς ἔτεκεν αὐτῷ ἡ παλλακὴ ἡ Σύρα τὸν Μαχιρ Μαχιρ δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Γαλααδ υἱοὶ δὲ Εφραιμ ἀδελφοῦ Μανασση Σουταλααμ καὶ Τααμ υἱοὶ δὲ Σουταλααμ Εδεμ

text_en: The sons of Benjamin : Bela and Bechor, and Asbel and Gera, and Naaman and Echi, and Ross and Mophim, and Ophim and Ared.
text_la: Filii Benjamin: Bela et Bechor et Asbel et Gera et Naaman et Echi et Ros et Mophim et Ophim et Ared.
text_pt: E os filhos de Benjamim: Belá, Bequer, Asbel, Gera, Naamã, Eí, Rôs, Mupim, Hupim e Arde.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Βενιαμιν Βαλα καὶ Χοβωρ καὶ Ασβηλ ἐγένοντο δὲ υἱοὶ Βαλα Γηρα καὶ Νοεμαν καὶ Αγχις καὶ Ρως καὶ Μαμφιν καὶ Οφιμιν Γηρα δὲ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Αραδ

text_en: These are the sons of Rachel , whom she bore to Jacob : all the souls , fourteen.
text_la: Hi filii Rachel quos genuit Jacob : omnes animæ, quatuordecim.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Raquel, que nasceram a Jacó, ao todo catorze almas.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ραχηλ οὓς ἔτεκεν τῷ Ιακωβ πᾶσαι ψυχαὶ δέκα ὀκτώ

text_en: The sons of Dan : Husim.
text_la: Filii Dan : Husim.
text_pt: E o filho de Dã: Husim.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Δαν Ασομ

text_en: The sons of Nephthali : Jaziel and Guni, and Jeser and Sallem.
text_la: Filii Nephthali: Jasiel et Guni et Jeser et Sallem.
text_pt: E os filhos de Naftali: Jazeel, Guni, Jezer e Silém.
text_el: καὶ υἱοὶ Νεφθαλι Ασιηλ καὶ Γωυνι καὶ Ισσααρ καὶ Συλλημ

text_en: These are the sons of Bala, whom Laban gave to Rachel , his daughter: and these she bore to Jacob : all the souls , seven.
text_la: Hi filii Balæ, quam dedit Laban Racheli filiæ suæ : et hos genuit Jacob : omnes animæ, septem.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos de Bila, a qual Labão deu à sua filha Raquel; e deu estes a Jacó; todas as almas foram sete.
text_el: οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βαλλας ἣν ἔδωκεν Λαβαν Ραχηλ τῇ θυγατρὶ αὐτοῦ ἣ ἔτεκεν τούτους τῷ Ιακωβ πᾶσαι ψυχαὶ ἑπτά

text_en: All the souls that went with Jacob into Egypt , and that came out of his thigh, besides his sons' wives, sixty-six.
text_la: Cunctæ animæ, quæ ingressæ sunt cum Jacob in Ægyptum, et egressæ sunt de femore illius, absque uxoribus filiorum ejus, sexaginta sex.
text_pt: Todas as almas que vieram com Jacó ao Egito, que saíram dos seus lombos, fora as mulheres dos filhos de Jacó, todas foram sessenta e seis almas.
text_el: πᾶσαι δὲ ψυχαὶ αἱ εἰσελθοῦσαι μετὰ Ιακωβ εἰς Αἴγυπτον οἱ ἐξελθόντες ἐκ τῶν μηρῶν αὐτοῦ χωρὶς τῶν γυναικῶν υἱῶν Ιακωβ πᾶσαι ψυχαὶ ἑξήκοντα ἕξ

text_en: And the sons of Joseph , that were born to him in the land of Egypt , two souls . All the souls of the house of Jacob , that entered into Egypt , were seventy.
text_la: Filii autem Joseph, qui nati sunt ei in terra Ægypti, animæ duæ. Omnes animæ domus Jacob, quæ ingressæ sunt in Ægyptum, fuere septuaginta.
text_pt: E os filhos de José, que lhe nasceram no Egito, eram duas almas. Todas as almas da casa de Jacó, que vieram ao Egito, eram setenta.
text_el: υἱοὶ δὲ Ιωσηφ οἱ γενόμενοι αὐτῷ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ψυχαὶ ἐννέα πᾶσαι ψυχαὶ οἴκου Ιακωβ αἱ εἰσελθοῦσαι εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἑβδομήκοντα πέντε

text_en: And he sent Juda before him to Joseph , to tell him; and that he should meet him in Gessen.
text_la: Misit autem Judam ante se ad Joseph, ut nuntiaret ei, et occurreret in Gessen.
text_pt: E Jacó enviou Judá adiante de si a José, para o encaminhar a Gósen; e chegaram à terra de Gósen.
text_el: τὸν δὲ Ιουδαν ἀπέστειλεν ἔμπροσθεν αὐτοῦ πρὸς Ιωσηφ συναντῆσαι αὐτῷ καθ' Ἡρώων πόλιν εἰς γῆν Ραμεσση

text_en: And when he had come thither, Joseph made ready his chariot, and went up to meet his father in the same place: and seeing him, he fell upon his neck, and embracing him, wept.
text_la: Quo cum pervenisset, juncto Joseph curro suo, ascendit obviam patri suo ad eumdem locum : vidensque eum, irruit super collum ejus, et inter amplexus flevit.
text_pt: Então José aprontou o seu carro, e subiu ao encontro de Israel, seu pai, a Gósen. E, apresentando-se-lhe, lançou-se ao seu pescoço, e chorou sobre o seu pescoço longo tempo.
text_el: ζεύξας δὲ Ιωσηφ τὰ ἅρματα αὐτοῦ ἀνέβη εἰς συνάντησιν Ισραηλ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ καθ' Ἡρώων πόλιν καὶ ὀφθεὶς αὐτῷ ἐπέπεσεν ἐπὶ τὸν τράχηλον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔκλαυσεν κλαυθμῷ πλείονι

text_en: And the father said to Joseph : Now shall I die with joy , because I have seen your face, and leave you alive.
text_la: Dixitque pater ad Joseph : Jam lætus moriar, quia vidi faciem tuam, et superstitem te relinquo.
text_pt: E Israel disse a José: Morra eu agora, pois já tenho visto o teu rosto, que ainda vives.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσηφ ἀποθανοῦμαι ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἐπεὶ ἑώρακα τὸ πρόσωπόν σου ἔτι γὰρ σὺ ζῇς

text_en: And Joseph said to his brethren, and to all his father's house: I will go up, and will tell Pharao , and will say to him: My brethren, and my father's house, that were in the land of Chanaan , have come to me:
text_la: At ille locutus est ad fratres suos, et ad omnem domum patris sui : Ascendam, et nuntiabo Pharaoni, dicamque ei : Fratres mei, et domus patris mei, qui erant in terra Chanaan, venerunt ad me:
text_pt: Depois disse José a seus irmãos, e à casa de seu pai: Eu subirei e anunciarei a Faraó, e lhe direi: Meus irmãos e a casa de meu pai, que estavam na terra de Canaã, vieram a mim!
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιωσηφ πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ ἀναβὰς ἀπαγγελῶ τῷ Φαραω καὶ ἐρῶ αὐτῷ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου καὶ ὁ οἶκος τοῦ πατρός μου οἳ ἦσαν ἐν γῇ Χανααν ἥκασιν πρός με

text_en: And the men are shepherds, and their occupation is to feed cattle; their flocks, and herds, and all they have, they have brought with them.
text_la: et sunt viri pastores ovium, curamque habent alendorum gregum : pecora sua, et armenta, et omnia quæ habere potuerunt, adduxerunt secum.
text_pt: E os homens são pastores de ovelhas, porque são homens de gado, e trouxeram consigo as suas ovelhas, e as suas vacas, e tudo o que têm.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ἄνδρες εἰσὶν ποιμένες ἄνδρες γὰρ κτηνοτρόφοι ἦσαν καὶ τὰ κτήνη καὶ τοὺς βόας καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτῶν ἀγειόχασιν

text_en: And when he shall call you, and shall say: What is your occupation?
text_la: Cumque vocaverit vos, et dixerit : Quod est opus vestrum?
text_pt: Quando, pois, acontecer que Faraó vos chamar, e disser: Qual é o vosso negócio?
text_el: ἐὰν οὖν καλέσῃ ὑμᾶς Φαραω καὶ εἴπῃ ὑμῖν τί τὸ ἔργον ὑμῶν ἐστιν

text_en: You shall answer: We, your servants, are shepherds, from our infancy until now, both we and our fathers. And this you shall say, that you may dwell in the land of Gessen, because the Egyptians have all shepherds in abomination.
text_la: respondebitis : Viri pastores sumus servi tui, ab infantia nostra usque in præsens, et nos et patres nostri. Hæc autem dicetis, ut habitare possitis in terra Gessen : quia detestantur Ægyptii omnes pastores ovium.
text_pt: Então direis: Teus servos foram homens de gado desde a nossa mocidade até agora, tanto nós como os nossos pais; para que habiteis na terra de Gósen, porque todo o pastor de ovelhas é abominação aos egípcios.
text_el: ἐρεῖτε ἄνδρες κτηνοτρόφοι ἐσμὲν οἱ παῖδές σου ἐκ παιδὸς ἕως τοῦ νῦν καὶ ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ἵνα κατοικήσητε ἐν γῇ Γεσεμ Ἀραβίᾳ βδέλυγμα γάρ ἐστιν Αἰγυπτίοις πᾶς ποιμὴν προβάτων

text_en: Then Joseph went in and told Pharao , saying: My father and brethren, their sheep and their herds, and all that they possess, have come out of the land of Chanaan : and behold they stay in the land of Gessen.
text_la: Ingressus ergo Joseph nuntiavit Pharaoni, dicens : Pater meus et fratres, oves eorum et armenta, et cuncta quæ possident, venerunt de terra Chanaan : et ecce consistunt in terra Gessen.
text_pt: Então veio José e anunciou a Faraó, e disse: Meu pai e os meus irmãos e as suas ovelhas, e as suas vacas, com tudo o que têm, são vindos da terra de Canaã, e eis que estão na terra de Gósen.
text_el: ἐλθὼν δὲ Ιωσηφ ἀπήγγειλεν τῷ Φαραω λέγων ὁ πατήρ μου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου καὶ τὰ κτήνη καὶ οἱ βόες αὐτῶν καὶ πάντα τὰ αὐτῶν ἦλθον ἐκ γῆς Χανααν καὶ ἰδού εἰσιν ἐν γῇ Γεσεμ

text_en: Five men also, the last of his brethren, he presented before the king :
text_la: Extremos quoque fratrum suorum quinque viros constituit coram rege:
text_pt: E tomou uma parte de seus irmãos, a saber, cinco homens, e os pôs diante de Faraó.
text_el: ἀπὸ δὲ τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ παρέλαβεν πέντε ἄνδρας καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτοὺς ἐναντίον Φαραω

text_en: And he asked them: What is your occupation? They answered: We, your servants, are shepherds, both we and our fathers.
text_la: quos ille interrogavit : Quid habetis operis? Responderunt : Pastores ovium sumus servi tui, et nos et patres nostri.
text_pt: Então disse Faraó a seus irmãos: Qual é o vosso negócio? E eles disseram a Faraó: Teus servos são pastores de ovelhas, tanto nós como nossos pais.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Φαραω τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς Ιωσηφ τί τὸ ἔργον ὑμῶν οἱ δὲ εἶπαν τῷ Φαραω ποιμένες προβάτων οἱ παῖδές σου καὶ ἡμεῖς καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν

text_en: We have come to sojourn in your land, because there is no grass for the flocks of your servants, the famine being very grievous in the land of Chanaan : and we pray you to give orders that we your servants may be in the land of Gessen.
text_la: Ad peregrinandum in terra tua venimus : quoniam non est herba gregibus servorum tuorum, ingravescente fame in terra Chanaan : petimusque ut esse nos jubeas servos tuos in terra Gessen.
text_pt: Disseram mais a Faraó: Viemos para peregrinar nesta terra; porque não há pasto para as ovelhas de teus servos, porquanto a fome é grave na terra de Canaã; agora, pois, rogamos-te que teus servos habitem na terra de Gósen.
text_el: εἶπαν δὲ τῷ Φαραω παροικεῖν ἐν τῇ γῇ ἥκαμεν οὐ γάρ ἐστιν νομὴ τοῖς κτήνεσιν τῶν παίδων σου ἐνίσχυσεν γὰρ ὁ λιμὸς ἐν γῇ Χανααν νῦν οὖν κατοικήσομεν οἱ παῖδές σου ἐν γῇ Γεσεμ

text_en: The king therefore said to Joseph : Your father and your brethren have come to you.
text_la: Dixit itaque rex ad Joseph : Pater tuus et fratres tui venerunt ad te.
text_pt: Então falou Faraó a José, dizendo: Teu pai e teus irmãos vieram a ti;
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Φαραω τῷ Ιωσφη κατοικείτωσαν ἐν γῇ Γεσεμ εἰ δὲ ἐπίστῃ ὅτι εἰσὶν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἄνδρες δυνατοί κατάστησον αὐτοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν ἐμῶν κτηνῶν ἦλθον δὲ εἰς Αἴγυπτον πρὸς Ιωσηφ Ιακωβ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἤκουσεν Φαραω βασιλεὺς Αἰγύπτου καὶ εἶπεν Φαραω πρὸς Ιωσηφ λέγων ὁ πατήρ σου καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί σου ἥκασι πρὸς σέ

text_en: The land of Egypt is before you: and make them dwell in the best place, and give them the land of Gessen. And if you know that there are industrious men among them, make them rulers over my cattle.
text_la: Terra Ægypti in conspectu tuo est : in optimo loco fac eos habitare, et trade eis terram Gessen. Quod si nosti in eis esse viros industrios, constitue illos magistros pecorum meorum.
text_pt: A terra do Egito está diante de ti; no melhor da terra faze habitar teu pai e teus irmãos; habitem na terra de Gósen, e se sabes que entre eles há homens valentes, os porás por maiorais do gado, sobre o que eu tenho.
text_el: ἰδοὺ ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου ἐναντίον σού ἐστιν ἐν τῇ βελτίστῃ γῇ κατοίκισον τὸν πατέρα σου καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου

text_en: After this Joseph brought in his father to the king , and presented him before him: and he blessed him.
text_la: Post hæc introduxit Joseph patrem suum ad regem, et statuit eum coram eo : qui benedicens illi,
text_pt: E trouxe José a Jacó, seu pai, e o apresentou a Faraó; e Jacó abençoou a Faraó.
text_el: εἰσήγαγεν δὲ Ιωσηφ Ιακωβ τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔστησεν αὐτὸν ἐναντίον Φαραω καὶ εὐλόγησεν Ιακωβ τὸν Φαραω

text_en: And being asked by him: How many are the days of the years of your life?
text_la: et interrogatus ab eo : Quot sunt dies annorum vitæ tuæ?
text_pt: E Faraó disse a Jacó: Quantos são os dias dos anos da tua vida?
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Φαραω τῷ Ιακωβ πόσα ἔτη ἡμερῶν τῆς ζωῆς σου

text_en: He answered: The days of my pilgrimage are a hundred and thirty years, few, and evil , and they are not come up to the days of the pilgrimage of my fathers .
text_la: respondit : Dies peregrinationis meæ centum triginta annorum sunt, parvi et mali, et non pervenerunt usque ad dies patrum meorum quibus peregrinati sunt.
