text_pt: E Jacó disse a Faraó: Os dias dos anos das minhas peregrinações são cento e trinta anos, poucos e maus foram os dias dos anos da minha vida, e não chegaram aos dias dos anos da vida de meus pais nos dias das suas peregrinações.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιακωβ τῷ Φαραω αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν ἐτῶν τῆς ζωῆς μου ἃς παροικῶ ἑκατὸν τριάκοντα ἔτη μικραὶ καὶ πονηραὶ γεγόνασιν αἱ ἡμέραι τῶν ἐτῶν τῆς ζωῆς μου οὐκ ἀφίκοντο εἰς τὰς ἡμέρας τῶν ἐτῶν τῆς ζωῆς τῶν πατέρων μου ἃς ἡμέρας παρῴκησαν

text_en: And blessing the king , he went out.
text_la: Et benedicto rege, egressus est foras.
text_pt: E Jacó abençoou a Faraó, e saiu da sua presença.
text_el: καὶ εὐλογήσας Ιακωβ τὸν Φαραω ἐξῆλθεν ἀπ' αὐτοῦ

text_en: But Joseph gave a possession to his father and his brethren in Egypt , in the best place of the land, in Ramesses, as Pharao had commanded.
text_la: Joseph vero patri et fratribus suis dedit possessionem in Ægypto in optimo terræ loco, Ramesses, ut præceperat Pharao.
text_pt: E José fez habitar a seu pai e seus irmãos e deu-lhes possessão na terra do Egito, no melhor da terra, na terra de Ramessés, como Faraó ordenara.
text_el: καὶ κατῴκισεν Ιωσηφ τὸν πατέρα καὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς κατάσχεσιν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου ἐν τῇ βελτίστῃ γῇ ἐν γῇ Ραμεσση καθὰ προσέταξεν Φαραω

text_en: And he nourished them, and all his father's house, allowing food to every one.
text_la: Et alebat eos, omnemque domum patris sui, præbens cibaria singulis.
text_pt: E José sustentou de pão a seu pai, seus irmãos e toda a casa de seu pai, segundo as suas famílias.
text_el: καὶ ἐσιτομέτρει Ιωσηφ τῷ πατρὶ καὶ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ παντὶ τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ σῖτον κατὰ σῶμα

text_en: For in the whole world there was want of bread, and a famine had oppressed the land, more especially of Egypt and Chanaan ;
text_la: In toto enim orbe panis deerat, et oppresserat fames terram, maxime Ægypti et Chanaan.
text_pt: E não havia pão em toda a terra, porque a fome era muito grave; de modo que a terra do Egito e a terra de Canaã desfaleciam por causa da fome.
text_el: σῖτος δὲ οὐκ ἦν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ γῇ ἐνίσχυσεν γὰρ ὁ λιμὸς σφόδρα ἐξέλιπεν δὲ ἡ γῆ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἡ γῆ Χανααν ἀπὸ τοῦ λιμοῦ

text_en: out of which he gathered up all the money for the corn which they bought, and brought it in to the king's treasure.
text_la: E quibus omnem pecuniam congregavit pro venditione frumenti, et intulit eam in ærarium regis.
text_pt: Então José recolheu todo o dinheiro que se achou na terra do Egito, e na terra de Canaã, pelo trigo que compravam; e José trouxe o dinheiro à casa de Faraó.
text_el: συνήγαγεν δὲ Ιωσηφ πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον τὸ εὑρεθὲν ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐν γῇ Χανααν τοῦ σίτου οὗ ἠγόραζον καὶ ἐσιτομέτρει αὐτοῖς καὶ εἰσήνεγκεν Ιωσηφ πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον εἰς τὸν οἶκον Φαραω

text_en: And when the buyers wanted money, all Egypt came to Joseph , saying: Give us bread: why should we die in your presence, having now no money?
text_la: Cumque defecisset emptoribus pretium, venit cuncta Ægyptus ad Joseph, dicens : Da nobis panes : quare morimur coram te, deficiente pecunia?
text_pt: Acabando-se, pois, o dinheiro da terra do Egito, e da terra de Canaã, vieram todos os egípcios a José, dizendo: Dá-nos pão; por que morreremos em tua presença? porquanto o dinheiro nos falta.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέλιπεν πᾶν τὸ ἀργύριον ἐκ γῆς Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐκ γῆς Χανααν ἦλθον δὲ πάντες οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι πρὸς Ιωσηφ λέγοντες δὸς ἡμῖν ἄρτους καὶ ἵνα τί ἀποθνῄσκομεν ἐναντίον σου ἐκλέλοιπεν γὰρ τὸ ἀργύριον ἡμῶν

text_en: And he answered them: Bring me your cattle, and for them I will give you food, if you have no money.
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Adducite pecora vestra, et dabo vobis pro eis cibos, si pretium non habetis.
text_pt: E José disse: Dai o vosso gado, e eu vo-lo darei por vosso gado, se falta o dinheiro.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ιωσηφ φέρετε τὰ κτήνη ὑμῶν καὶ δώσω ὑμῖν ἄρτους ἀντὶ τῶν κτηνῶν ὑμῶν εἰ ἐκλέλοιπεν τὸ ἀργύριον

text_en: And when they had brought them, he gave them food in exchange for their horses, and sheep, and oxen, and asses: and he maintained them that year for the exchange of their cattle.
text_la: Quæ cum adduxissent, dedit eis alimenta pro equis, et ovibus, et bobus, et asinis : sustentavitque eos illo anno pro commutatione pecorum.
text_pt: Então trouxeram o seu gado a José; e José deu-lhes pão em troca de cavalos, e das ovelhas, e das vacas e dos jumentos; e os sustentou de pão aquele ano por todo o seu gado.
text_el: ἤγαγον δὲ τὰ κτήνη πρὸς Ιωσηφ καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς Ιωσηφ ἄρτους ἀντὶ τῶν ἵππων καὶ ἀντὶ τῶν προβάτων καὶ ἀντὶ τῶν βοῶν καὶ ἀντὶ τῶν ὄνων καὶ ἐξέθρεψεν αὐτοὺς ἐν ἄρτοις ἀντὶ πάντων τῶν κτηνῶν αὐτῶν ἐν τῷ ἐνιαυτῷ ἐκείνῳ

text_en: And they came the second year, and said to him: We will not hide from our lord, how that our money is spent, and our cattle also have gone: neither are you ignorant that we have nothing now left but our bodies and our lands.
text_la: Venerunt quoque anno secundo, et dixerunt ei : Non celabimus dominum nostrum quod deficiente pecunia, pecora simul defecerunt : nec clam te est, quod absque corporibus et terra nihil habeamus.
text_pt: E acabado aquele ano, vieram a ele no segundo ano e disseram-lhe: Não ocultaremos ao meu senhor que o dinheiro acabou; e meu senhor possui os animais, e nenhuma outra coisa nos ficou diante de meu senhor, senão o nosso corpo e a nossa terra;
text_el: ἐξῆλθεν δὲ τὸ ἔτος ἐκεῖνο καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς αὐτὸν ἐν τῷ ἔτει τῷ δευτέρῳ καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ μήποτε ἐκτριβῶμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν εἰ γὰρ ἐκλέλοιπεν τὸ ἀργύριον καὶ τὰ ὑπάρχοντα καὶ τὰ κτήνη πρὸς σὲ τὸν κύριον καὶ οὐχ ὑπολείπεται ἡμῖν ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν ἀλλ' ἢ τὸ ἴδιον σῶμα καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡμῶν

text_en: Why therefore shall we die before your eyes? We will be yours, both we and our lands: buy us to be the king's servants, and give us seed, lest for want of tillers the land be turned into a wilderness .
text_la: Cur ergo moriemur te vidente? et nos et terra nostra tui erimus : eme nos in servitutem regiam, et præbe semina, ne pereunte cultore redigatur terra in solitudinem.
text_pt: Por que morreremos diante dos teus olhos, tanto nós como a nossa terra? Compra-nos a nós e a nossa terra por pão, e nós e a nossa terra seremos servos de Faraó; e dá-nos semente, para que vivamos, e não morramos, e a terra não se desole.
text_el: ἵνα οὖν μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν ἐναντίον σου καὶ ἡ γῆ ἐρημωθῇ κτῆσαι ἡμᾶς καὶ τὴν γῆν ἡμῶν ἀντὶ ἄρτων καὶ ἐσόμεθα ἡμεῖς καὶ ἡ γῆ ἡμῶν παῖδες Φαραω δὸς σπέρμα ἵνα σπείρωμεν καὶ ζῶμεν καὶ μὴ ἀποθάνωμεν καὶ ἡ γῆ οὐκ ἐρημωθήσεται

text_en: So Joseph bought all the land of Egypt , every man selling his possessions , because of the greatness of the famine. And he brought it into Pharao's hands:
text_la: Emit igitur Joseph omnem terram Ægypti, vendentibus singulis possessiones suas præ magnitudine famis. Subjecitque eam Pharaoni,
text_pt: Assim José comprou toda a terra do Egito para Faraó, porque os egípcios venderam cada um o seu campo, porquanto a fome prevaleceu sobre eles; e a terra ficou sendo de Faraó.
text_el: καὶ ἐκτήσατο Ιωσηφ πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν τῶν Αἰγυπτίων τῷ Φαραω ἀπέδοντο γὰρ οἱ Αἰγύπτιοι τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν τῷ Φαραω ἐπεκράτησεν γὰρ αὐτῶν ὁ λιμός καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ γῆ Φαραω

text_en: And all its people from one end of the borders of Egypt , even to the other end thereof,
text_la: et cunctos populos ejus a novissimis terminis Ægypti usque ad extremos fines ejus,
text_pt: E, quanto ao povo, fê-lo passar às cidades, desde uma extremidade da terra do Egito até a outra extremidade.
text_el: καὶ τὸν λαὸν κατεδουλώσατο αὐτῷ εἰς παῖδας ἀπ' ἄκρων ὁρίων Αἰγύπτου ἕως τῶν ἄκρων

text_en: except the land of the priests , which had been given them by the king : to whom also a certain allowance of food was given out of the public stores, and therefore they were not forced to sell their possessions .
text_la: præter terram sacerdotum, quæ a rege tradita fuerat eis : quibus et statuta cibaria ex horreis publicis præbebantur, et idcirco non sunt compulsi vendere possessiones suas.
text_pt: Somente a terra dos sacerdotes não a comprou, porquanto os sacerdotes tinham porção de Faraó, e eles comiam a sua porção que Faraó lhes tinha dado; por isso não venderam a sua terra.
text_el: χωρὶς τῆς γῆς τῶν ἱερέων μόνον οὐκ ἐκτήσατο ταύτην Ιωσηφ ἐν δόσει γὰρ ἔδωκεν δόμα τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν Φαραω καὶ ἤσθιον τὴν δόσιν ἣν ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς Φαραω διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἀπέδοντο τὴν γῆν αὐτῶν

text_en: Then Joseph said to the people: Behold, as you see, both you and your lands belong to Pharao ; take seed and sow the fields,
text_la: Dixit ergo Joseph ad populos : En ut cernitis, et vos et terram vestram Pharao possidet : accipite semina, et serite agros,
text_pt: Então disse José ao povo: Eis que hoje tenho comprado a vós e a vossa terra para Faraó; eis aí tendes semente para vós, para que semeeis a terra.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιωσηφ πᾶσι τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις ἰδοὺ κέκτημαι ὑμᾶς καὶ τὴν γῆν ὑμῶν σήμερον τῷ Φαραω λάβετε ἑαυτοῖς σπέρμα καὶ σπείρατε τὴν γῆν

text_en: that you may have corn. The fifth part you shall give to the king ; the other four you shall have for seed, and for food for your families and children.
text_la: ut fruges habere possitis. Quintam partem regi dabitis : quatuor reliquas permitto vobis in sementem, et in cibum familiis et liberis vestris.
text_pt: Há de ser, porém, que das colheitas dareis o quinto a Faraó, e as quatro partes serão vossas, para semente do campo, e para o vosso mantimento, e dos que estão nas vossas casas, e para que comam vossos filhos.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται τὰ γενήματα αὐτῆς δώσετε τὸ πέμπτον μέρος τῷ Φαραω τὰ δὲ τέσσαρα μέρη ἔσται ὑμῖν αὐτοῖς εἰς σπέρμα τῇ γῇ καὶ εἰς βρῶσιν ὑμῖν καὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν τοῖς οἴκοις ὑμῶν

text_en: And they answered: our life is in your hand; only let my lord look favourably upon us, and we will gladly serve the king .
text_la: Qui responderunt : Salus nostra in manu tua est : respiciat nos tantum dominus noster, et læti serviemus regi.
text_pt: E disseram: A vida nos tens dado; achemos graça aos olhos de meu senhor, e seremos servos de Faraó.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν σέσωκας ἡμᾶς εὕρομεν χάριν ἐναντίον τοῦ κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ ἐσόμεθα παῖδες Φαραω

text_en: From that time unto this day, in the whole land of Egypt , the fifth part is paid to the kings , and it has become as a law , except the land of the priests , which was free from this covenant.
text_la: Ex eo tempore usque in præsentem diem, in universa terra Ægypti regibus quinta pars solvitur, et factum est quasi in legem, absque terra sacerdotali, quæ libera ab hac conditione fuit.
text_pt: José, pois, estabeleceu isto por estatuto, até ao dia de hoje, sobre a terra do Egito, que Faraó tirasse o quinto; só a terra dos sacerdotes não ficou sendo de Faraó.
text_el: καὶ ἔθετο αὐτοῖς Ιωσηφ εἰς πρόσταγμα ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης ἐπὶ γῆν Αἰγύπτου τῷ Φαραω ἀποπεμπτοῦν χωρὶς τῆς γῆς τῶν ἱερέων μόνον οὐκ ἦν τῷ Φαραω

text_en: So Israel dwelt in Egypt , that is, in the land of Gessen, and possessed it; and grew, and was multiplied exceedingly.
text_la: Habitavit ergo Israël in Ægypto, id est, in terra Gessen, et possedit eam : auctusque est, et multiplicatus nimis.
text_pt: Assim habitou Israel na terra do Egito, na terra de Gósen, e nela tomaram possessão, e frutificaram, e multiplicaram-se muito.
text_el: κατῴκησεν δὲ Ισραηλ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς Γεσεμ καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν ἐπ' αὐτῆς καὶ ηὐξήθησαν καὶ ἐπληθύνθησαν σφόδρα

text_en: And he lived in it seventeen years: and all the days of his life came to a hundred and forty-seven years.
text_la: Et vixit in ea decem et septem annis : factique sunt omnes dies vitæ illius, centum quadraginta septem annorum.
text_pt: E Jacó viveu na terra do Egito dezessete anos, de sorte que os dias de Jacó, os anos da sua vida, foram cento e quarenta e sete anos.
text_el: ἐπέζησεν δὲ Ιακωβ ἐν γῇ Αἰγύπτῳ δέκα ἑπτὰ ἔτη ἐγένοντο δὲ αἱ ἡμέραι Ιακωβ ἐνιαυτῶν τῆς ζωῆς αὐτοῦ ἑκατὸν τεσσαράκοντα ἑπτὰ ἔτη

text_en: And when he saw that the day of his death drew near, he called his son Joseph , and said to him: If I have found favour in your sight, put your hand under my thigh; and you shall show me this kindness and truth , not to bury me in Egypt .
text_la: Cumque appropinquare cerneret diem mortis suæ, vocavit filium suum Joseph, et dixit ad eum : Si inveni gratiam in conspectu tuo, pone manum tuam sub femore meo : et facies mihi misericordiam et veritatem, ut non sepelias me in Ægypto:
text_pt: Chegando-se, pois, o tempo da morte de Israel, chamou a José, seu filho, e disse-lhe: Se agora tenho achado graça em teus olhos, rogo-te que ponhas a tua mão debaixo da minha coxa, e usa comigo de beneficência e verdade; rogo-te que não me enterres no Egito,
text_el: ἤγγισαν δὲ αἱ ἡμέραι Ισραηλ τοῦ ἀποθανεῖν καὶ ἐκάλεσεν τὸν υἱὸν αὐτοῦ Ιωσηφ καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ εἰ εὕρηκα χάριν ἐναντίον σου ὑπόθες τὴν χεῖρά σου ὑπὸ τὸν μηρόν μου καὶ ποιήσεις ἐπ' ἐμὲ ἐλεημοσύνην καὶ ἀλήθειαν τοῦ μή με θάψαι ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ

text_en: But I will sleep with my fathers , and you shall take me away out of this land, and bury me in the burying place of my ancestors. And Joseph answered him: I will do what you have commanded.
text_la: sed dormiam cum patribus meis, et auferas me de terra hac, condasque in sepulchro majorum meorum. Cui respondit Joseph : Ego faciam quod jussisti.
text_pt: Mas que eu jaza com os meus pais; por isso me levarás do Egito e me enterrarás na sepultura deles. E ele disse: Farei conforme a tua palavra.
text_el: ἀλλὰ κοιμηθήσομαι μετὰ τῶν πατέρων μου καὶ ἀρεῖς με ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ θάψεις με ἐν τῷ τάφῳ αὐτῶν ὁ δὲ εἶπεν ἐγὼ ποιήσω κατὰ τὸ ῥῆμά σου

text_en: And he said: Swear then to me. And as he was swearing , Israel adored God , turning to the bed's head.
text_la: Et ille : Jura ergo, inquit, mihi. Quo jurante, adoravit Israël Deum, conversus ad lectuli caput.
text_pt: E disse ele: Jura-me. E ele jurou-lhe; e Israel inclinou-se sobre a cabeceira da cama.
text_el: εἶπεν δέ ὄμοσόν μοι καὶ ὤμοσεν αὐτῷ καὶ προσεκύνησεν Ισραηλ ἐπὶ τὸ ἄκρον τῆς ῥάβδου αὐτοῦ

text_en: After these things, it was told Joseph that his father was sick; and he set out to go to him, taking his two sons Manasses and Ephraim.
text_la: His ita transactis, nuntiatum est Joseph quod ægrotaret pater suus : qui, assumptis duobus filiis Manasse et Ephraim, ire perrexit.
text_pt: E aconteceu, depois destas coisas, que alguém disse a José: Eis que teu pai está enfermo. Então tomou consigo os seus dois filhos, Manassés e Efraim.
text_el: ἐγένετο δὲ μετὰ τὰ ῥήματα ταῦτα καὶ ἀπηγγέλη τῷ Ιωσηφ ὅτι ὁ πατήρ σου ἐνοχλεῖται καὶ ἀναλαβὼν τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ τὸν Μανασση καὶ τὸν Εφραιμ ἦλθεν πρὸς Ιακωβ

text_en: And it was told the old man : Behold your son Joseph comes to you. And being strengthened, he sat on his bed.
text_la: Dictumque est seni : Ecce filius tuus Joseph venit ad te. Qui confortatus sedit in lectulo.
text_pt: E alguém participou a Jacó, e disse: Eis que José teu filho vem a ti. E esforçou-se Israel, e assentou-se sobre a cama.
text_el: ἀπηγγέλη δὲ τῷ Ιακωβ λέγοντες ἰδοὺ ὁ υἱός σου Ιωσηφ ἔρχεται πρὸς σέ καὶ ἐνισχύσας Ισραηλ ἐκάθισεν ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην

text_en: And when Joseph had come in to him, he said: God almighty appeared to me at Luza , which is in the land of Chanaan , and he blessed me,
text_la: Et ingresso ad se ait : Deus omnipotens apparuit mihi in Luza, quæ est in terra Chanaan : benedixitque mihi,
text_pt: E Jacó disse a José: O Deus Todo-Poderoso me apareceu em Luz, na terra de Canaã, e me abençoou.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιακωβ τῷ Ιωσηφ ὁ θεός μου ὤφθη μοι ἐν Λουζα ἐν γῇ Χανααν καὶ εὐλόγησέν με

text_en: and said: I will cause you to increase and multiply, and I will make of you a multitude of people: and I will give this land to you, and to your seed after you for an everlasting possession .
text_la: et ait : Ego te augebo et multiplicabo, et faciam te in turbas populorum : daboque tibi terram hanc, et semini tuo post te in possessionem sempiternam.
text_pt: E me disse: Eis que te farei frutificar e multiplicar, e tornar-te-ei uma multidão de povos e darei esta terra à tua descendência depois de ti, em possessão perpétua.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ αὐξανῶ σε καὶ πληθυνῶ σε καὶ ποιήσω σε εἰς συναγωγὰς ἐθνῶν καὶ δώσω σοι τὴν γῆν ταύτην καὶ τῷ σπέρματί σου μετὰ σὲ εἰς κατάσχεσιν αἰώνιον

text_en: So your two sons, who were born to you in the land of Egypt before I came hither to you, shall be mine: Ephraim and Manasses shall be reputed to me as Ruben and Simeon .
text_la: Duo ergo filii tui, qui nati sunt tibi in terra Ægypti antequam huc venirem ad te, mei erunt : Ephraim et Manasses, sicut Ruben et Simeon reputabuntur mihi.
text_pt: Agora, pois, os teus dois filhos, que te nasceram na terra do Egito, antes que eu viesse a ti no Egito, são meus: Efraim e Manassés serão meus, como Rúben e Simeão;
text_el: νῦν οὖν οἱ δύο υἱοί σου οἱ γενόμενοί σοι ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ πρὸ τοῦ με ἐλθεῖν πρὸς σὲ εἰς Αἴγυπτον ἐμοί εἰσιν Εφραιμ καὶ Μανασση ὡς Ρουβην καὶ Συμεων ἔσονταί μοι

text_en: But the rest whom you shall have after them, shall be yours, and shall be called by the name of their brethren in their possessions.
text_la: Reliquos autem quos genueris post eos, tui erunt, et nomine fratrum suorum vocabuntur in possessionibus suis.
text_pt: Mas a tua geração, que gerarás depois deles, será tua; segundo o nome de seus irmãos serão chamados na sua herança.
text_el: τὰ δὲ ἔκγονα ἃ ἐὰν γεννήσῃς μετὰ ταῦτα σοὶ ἔσονται ἐπὶ τῷ ὀνόματι τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτῶν κληθήσονται ἐν τοῖς ἐκείνων κλήροις

text_en: For, when I came out of Mesopotamia, Rachel died from me in the land of Chanaan in the very journey, and it was spring time: and I was going to Ephrata , and I buried her near the way of Ephrata , which by another name is called Bethlehem .
text_la: Mihi enim, quando veniebam de Mesopotamia, mortua est Rachel in terra Chanaan in ipso itinere, eratque vernum tempus : et ingrediebar Ephratam, et sepelivi eam juxta viam Ephratæ, quæ alio nomine appellatur Bethlehem.
text_pt: Vindo, pois, eu de Padã, morreu-me Raquel no caminho, na terra de Canaã, havendo ainda pequena distância para chegar a Efrata; e eu a sepultei ali, no caminho de Efrata, que é Belém.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ ἡνίκα ἠρχόμην ἐκ Μεσοποταμίας τῆς Συρίας ἀπέθανεν Ραχηλ ἡ μήτηρ σου ἐν γῇ Χανααν ἐγγίζοντός μου κατὰ τὸν ἱππόδρομον χαβραθα τῆς γῆς τοῦ ἐλθεῖν Εφραθα καὶ κατώρυξα αὐτὴν ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ τοῦ ἱπποδρόμου αὕτη ἐστὶν Βαιθλεεμ

text_en: Then seeing his sons, he said to him: Who are these?
text_la: Videns autem filios ejus dixit ad eum: Qui sunt isti?
text_pt: E Israel viu os filhos de José, e disse: Quem são estes?
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ Ισραηλ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ιωσηφ εἶπεν τίνες σοι οὗτοι

text_en: He answered: They are my sons, whom God has given me in this place. And he said: Bring them to me, that I may bless them.
text_la: Respondit : Filii mei sunt, quos donavit mihi Deus in hoc loco. Adduc, inquit, eos ad me, ut benedicam illis.
text_pt: E José disse a seu pai: Eles são meus filhos, que Deus me tem dado aqui. E ele disse: Peço-te, traze-mos aqui, para que os abençoe.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιωσηφ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ υἱοί μού εἰσιν οὓς ἔδωκέν μοι ὁ θεὸς ἐνταῦθα καὶ εἶπεν Ιακωβ προσάγαγέ μοι αὐτούς ἵνα εὐλογήσω αὐτούς

text_en: For Israel's eyes were dim by reason of his great age, and he could not see clearly. And when they were brought to him, he kissed and embraced them,
text_la: Oculi enim Israël caligabant præ nimia senectute, et clare videre non poterat. Applicitosque ad se, deosculatus et circumplexus eos,
text_pt: Os olhos de Israel, porém, estavam carregados de velhice, já não podia ver; e fê-los chegar a ele, e beijou-os, e abraçou-os.
text_el: οἱ δὲ ὀφθαλμοὶ Ισραηλ ἐβαρυώπησαν ἀπὸ τοῦ γήρους καὶ οὐκ ἠδύνατο βλέπειν καὶ ἤγγισεν αὐτοὺς πρὸς αὐτόν καὶ ἐφίλησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ περιέλαβεν αὐτούς

text_en: and said to his son: I am not deprived of seeing you; moreover God has shown me your seed.
text_la: dixit ad filium suum : Non sum fraudatus aspectu tuo : insuper ostendit mihi Deus semen tuum.
text_pt: E Israel disse a José: Eu não cuidara ver o teu rosto; e eis que Deus me fez ver também a tua descendência.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ισραηλ πρὸς Ιωσηφ ἰδοὺ τοῦ προσώπου σου οὐκ ἐστερήθην καὶ ἰδοὺ ἔδειξέν μοι ὁ θεὸς καὶ τὸ σπέρμα σου

text_en: And when Joseph had taken them from his father's lap, he bowed down with his face to the ground.
text_la: Cumque tulisset eos Joseph de gremio patris, adoravit pronus in terram.
text_pt: Então José os tirou dos joelhos de seu pai, e inclinou-se à terra diante da sua face.
text_el: καὶ ἐξήγαγεν Ιωσηφ αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῶν γονάτων αὐτοῦ καὶ προσεκύνησαν αὐτῷ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And he set Ephraim on his right hand, that is, towards the left hand of Israel ; but Manasses on his left hand, to wit, towards his father's right hand, and brought them near to him.
text_la: Et posuit Ephraim ad dexteram suam, id est, ad sinistram Israël : Manassen vero in sinistra sua, ad dexteram scilicet patris, applicuitque ambos ad eum.
text_pt: E tomou José a ambos, a Efraim na sua mão direita, à esquerda de Israel, e Manassés na sua mão esquerda, à direita de Israel, e fê-los chegar a ele.
text_el: λαβὼν δὲ Ιωσηφ τοὺς δύο υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ τόν τε Εφραιμ ἐν τῇ δεξιᾷ ἐξ ἀριστερῶν δὲ Ισραηλ τὸν δὲ Μανασση ἐν τῇ ἀριστερᾷ ἐκ δεξιῶν δὲ Ισραηλ ἤγγισεν αὐτοὺς αὐτῷ

text_en: But he, stretching forth his right hand, put it upon the head of Ephraim, the younger brother; and the left upon the head of Manasses , who was the elder, changing his hands.
text_la: Qui extendens manum dexteram, posuit super caput Ephraim minoris fratris : sinistram autem super caput Manasse qui major natu erat, commutans manus.
text_pt: Mas Israel estendeu a sua mão direita e a pôs sobre a cabeça de Efraim, que era o menor, e a sua esquerda sobre a cabeça de Manassés, dirigindo as suas mãos propositadamente, não obstante Manassés ser o primogênito.
text_el: ἐκτείνας δὲ Ισραηλ τὴν χεῖρα τὴν δεξιὰν ἐπέβαλεν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Εφραιμ οὗτος δὲ ἦν ὁ νεώτερος καὶ τὴν ἀριστερὰν ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Μανασση ἐναλλὰξ τὰς χεῖρας

text_en: And Jacob blessed the sons of Joseph , and said: God , in whose sight my fathers Abraham and Isaac walked, God that feeds me from my youth until this day:
text_la: Benedixitque Jacob filiis Joseph, et ait : Deus, in cujus conspectu ambulaverunt patres mei Abraham, et Isaac; Deus qui pascit me ab adolescentia mea usque in præsentem diem:
text_pt: E abençoou a José, e disse: O Deus, em cuja presença andaram os meus pais Abraão e Isaque, o Deus que me sustentou, desde que eu nasci até este dia;
text_el: καὶ ηὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς καὶ εἶπεν ὁ θεός ᾧ εὐηρέστησαν οἱ πατέρες μου ἐναντίον αὐτοῦ Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ ὁ θεὸς ὁ τρέφων με ἐκ νεότητος ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: The angel that delivers me from all evils , bless these boys: and let my name be called upon them, and the names of my fathers Abraham and Isaac ; and may they grow into a multitude upon the earth.
text_la: angelus, qui eruit me de cunctis malis, benedicat pueris istis : et invocetur super eos nomen meum, nomina quoque patrum meorum Abraham et Isaac, et crescant in multitudinem super terram.
text_pt: O anjo que me livrou de todo o mal, abençoe estes rapazes, e seja chamado neles o meu nome, e o nome de meus pais Abraão e Isaque, e multipliquem-se como peixes, em multidão, no meio da terra.
text_el: ὁ ἄγγελος ὁ ῥυόμενός με ἐκ πάντων τῶν κακῶν εὐλογήσαι τὰ παιδία ταῦτα καὶ ἐπικληθήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸ ὄνομά μου καὶ τὸ ὄνομα τῶν πατέρων μου Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ πληθυνθείησαν εἰς πλῆθος πολὺ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς

text_en: And Joseph seeing that his father had put his right hand upon the head of Ephraim, was much displeased: and taking his father's hand, he tried to lift it from Ephraim's head, and to remove it to the head of Manasses .
text_la: Videns autem Joseph quod posuisset pater suus dexteram manum super caput Ephraim, graviter accepit : et apprehensam manum patris levare conatus est de capite Ephraim, et transferre super caput Manasse.
text_pt: Vendo, pois, José que seu pai punha a sua mão direita sobre a cabeça de Efraim, foi mau aos seus olhos; e tomou a mão de seu pai, para a transpor de sobre a cabeça de Efraim à cabeça de Manassés.
text_el: ἰδὼν δὲ Ιωσηφ ὅτι ἐπέβαλεν ὁ πατὴρ τὴν δεξιὰν αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Εφραιμ βαρὺ αὐτῷ κατεφάνη καὶ ἀντελάβετο Ιωσηφ τῆς χειρὸς τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἀφελεῖν αὐτὴν ἀπὸ τῆς κεφαλῆς Εφραιμ ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν Μανασση

text_en: And he said to his father: It should not be so, my father; for this is the firstborn , put your right hand upon his head.
text_la: Dixitque ad patrem : Non ita convenit, pater : quia hic est primogenitus, pone dexteram tuam super caput ejus.
text_pt: E José disse a seu pai: Não assim, meu pai, porque este é o primogênito; põe a tua mão direita sobre a sua cabeça.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ιωσηφ τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ οὐχ οὕτως πάτερ οὗτος γὰρ ὁ πρωτότοκος ἐπίθες τὴν δεξιάν σου ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: But he refusing, said: I know , my son, I know : and this also shall become a people, and shall be multiplied; but his younger brother shall be greater than he; and his seed shall grow into nations.
text_la: Qui renuens, ait : Scio, fili mi, scio : et iste quidem erit in populos, et multiplicabitur : sed frater ejus minor, major erit illo : et semen illius crescet in gentes.
text_pt: Mas seu pai recusou, e disse: Eu o sei, meu filho, eu o sei; também ele será um povo, e também ele será grande; contudo o seu irmão menor será maior que ele, e a sua descendência será uma multidão de nações.
text_el: καὶ οὐκ ἠθέλησεν ἀλλὰ εἶπεν οἶδα τέκνον οἶδα καὶ οὗτος ἔσται εἰς λαόν καὶ οὗτος ὑψωθήσεται ἀλλὰ ὁ ἀδελφὸς αὐτοῦ ὁ νεώτερος μείζων αὐτοῦ ἔσται καὶ τὸ σπέρμα αὐτοῦ ἔσται εἰς πλῆθος ἐθνῶν

text_en: And he blessed them at that time, saying: In you shall Israel be blessed , and it shall be said: God do to you as to Ephraim, and as to Manasses . And he set Ephraim before Manasses .
text_la: Benedixitque eis in tempore illo, dicens : In te benedicetur Israël, atque dicetur : Faciat tibi Deus sicut Ephraim, et sicut Manasse. Constituitque Ephraim ante Manassen.
text_pt: Assim os abençoou naquele dia, dizendo: Em ti abençoará Israel, dizendo: Deus te faça como a Efraim e como a Manassés. E pôs a Efraim diante de Manassés.
text_el: καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ λέγων ἐν ὑμῖν εὐλογηθήσεται Ισραηλ λέγοντες ποιήσαι σε ὁ θεὸς ὡς Εφραιμ καὶ ὡς Μανασση καὶ ἔθηκεν τὸν Εφραιμ ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ Μανασση

text_en: And he said to Joseph , his son: Behold I die, and God will be with you, and will bring you back into the land of your fathers.
text_la: Et ait ad Joseph filium suum : En ego morior, et erit Deus vobiscum, reducetque vos ad terram patrum vestrorum.
text_pt: Depois disse Israel a José: Eis que eu morro, mas Deus será convosco, e vos fará tornar à terra de vossos pais.
text_el: εἶπεν δὲ Ισραηλ τῷ Ιωσηφ ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποθνῄσκω καὶ ἔσται ὁ θεὸς μεθ' ὑμῶν καὶ ἀποστρέψει ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν γῆν τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν

text_en: I give you a portion above your brethren, which I took out of the hand of the Amorrhite with my sword and bow.
text_la: Do tibi partem unam extra fratres tuos, quam tuli de manu Amorrhæi in gladio et arcu meo.
text_pt: E eu tenho dado a ti um pedaço da terra a mais do que a teus irmãos, que tomei com a minha espada e com o meu arco, da mão dos amorreus.
text_el: ἐγὼ δὲ δίδωμί σοι Σικιμα ἐξαίρετον ὑπὲρ τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου ἣν ἔλαβον ἐκ χειρὸς Αμορραίων ἐν μαχαίρᾳ μου καὶ τόξῳ

text_en: And Jacob called his sons, and said to them: Gather yourselves together, that I may tell you the things that shall befall you in the last days.
text_la: Vocavit autem Jacob filios suos, et ait eis : Congregamini, ut annuntiem quæ ventura sunt vobis in diebus novissimis.
text_pt: Depois chamou Jacó a seus filhos, e disse: Ajuntai-vos, e anunciar-vos-ei o que vos há de acontecer nos dias vindouros;
text_el: ἐκάλεσεν δὲ Ιακωβ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτοῦ καὶ εἶπεν συνάχθητε ἵνα ἀναγγείλω ὑμῖν τί ἀπαντήσει ὑμῖν ἐπ' ἐσχάτων τῶν ἡμερῶν

text_en: Gather yourselves together, and hear, O you sons of Jacob , hearken to Israel , your father:
text_la: Congregamini, et audite, filii Jacob, audite Israël patrem vestrum :
text_pt: Ajuntai-vos, e ouvi, filhos de Jacó; e ouvi a Israel vosso pai.
text_el: ἀθροίσθητε καὶ ἀκούσατε υἱοὶ Ιακωβ ἀκούσατε Ισραηλ τοῦ πατρὸς ὑμῶν

text_en: Ruben , my firstborn , you are my strength, and the beginning of my sorrow; excelling in gifts, greater in command.
text_la: Ruben, primogenitus meus, tu fortitudo mea, et principium doloris mei; prior in donis, major in imperio.
text_pt: Rúben, tu és meu primogênito, minha força e o princípio de meu vigor, o mais excelente em alteza e o mais excelente em poder.
text_el: Ρουβην πρωτότοκός μου σύ ἰσχύς μου καὶ ἀρχὴ τέκνων μου σκληρὸς φέρεσθαι καὶ σκληρὸς αὐθάδης

text_en: You are poured out as water; grow not; because you went up to your father's bed, and defiled his couch.
text_la: Effusus es sicut aqua, non crescas : quia ascendisti cubile patris tui, et maculasti stratum ejus.
text_pt: Impetuoso como a água, não serás o mais excelente, porquanto subiste ao leito de teu pai. Então o contaminaste; subiu à minha cama.
text_el: ἐξύβρισας ὡς ὕδωρ μὴ ἐκζέσῃς ἀνέβης γὰρ ἐπὶ τὴν κοίτην τοῦ πατρός σου τότε ἐμίανας τὴν στρωμνήν οὗ ἀνέβης

text_en: Simeon and Levi brethren: vessels of iniquity waging war .
text_la: Simeon et Levi fratres vasa iniquitatis bellantia.
text_pt: Simeão e Levi são irmãos; as suas espadas são instrumentos de violência.
text_el: Συμεων καὶ Λευι ἀδελφοί συνετέλεσαν ἀδικίαν ἐξ αἱρέσεως αὐτῶν

text_en: Let not my soul go into their counsel, nor my glory be in their assembly: because in their fury they slew a man , and in their selfwill they undermined a wall.
text_la: In consilium eorum non veniat anima mea, et in cœtu illorum non sit gloria mea : quia in furore suo occiderunt virum, et in voluntate sua suffoderunt murum.
text_pt: No seu secreto conselho não entre minha alma, com a sua congregação minha glória não se ajunte; porque no seu furor mataram homens, e na sua teima arrebataram bois.
text_el: εἰς βουλὴν αὐτῶν μὴ ἔλθοι ἡ ψυχή μου καὶ ἐπὶ τῇ συστάσει αὐτῶν μὴ ἐρείσαι τὰ ἥπατά μου ὅτι ἐν τῷ θυμῷ αὐτῶν ἀπέκτειναν ἀνθρώπους καὶ ἐν τῇ ἐπιθυμίᾳ αὐτῶν ἐνευροκόπησαν ταῦρον

text_en: Cursed be their fury , because it was stubborn: and their wrath , because it was cruel: I will divide them in Jacob , and will scatter them in Israel .
text_la: Maledictus furor eorum, quia pertinax : et indignatio eorum, quia dura : dividam eos in Jacob, et dispergam eos in Israël.
text_pt: Maldito seja o seu furor, pois era forte, e a sua ira, pois era dura; eu os dividirei em Jacó, e os espalharei em Israel.
text_el: ἐπικατάρατος ὁ θυμὸς αὐτῶν ὅτι αὐθάδης καὶ ἡ μῆνις αὐτῶν ὅτι ἐσκληρύνθη διαμεριῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν Ιακωβ καὶ διασπερῶ αὐτοὺς ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: Juda , you shall your brethren praise: your hand shall be on the necks of your enemies; the sons of your father shall bow down to you.
text_la: Juda, te laudabunt fratres tui : manus tua in cervicibus inimicorum tuorum, adorabunt te filii patris tui.
text_pt: Judá, a ti te louvarão os teus irmãos; a tua mão será sobre o pescoço de teus inimigos; os filhos de teu pai a ti se inclinarão.
text_el: Ιουδα σὲ αἰνέσαισαν οἱ ἀδελφοί σου αἱ χεῖρές σου ἐπὶ νώτου τῶν ἐχθρῶν σου προσκυνήσουσίν σοι οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ πατρός σου

text_en: Juda is a lion's whelp: to the prey, my son, you have gone up: resting you have couched as a lion, and as a lioness, who shall rouse him?
text_la: Catulus leonis Juda : ad prædam, fili mi, ascendisti : requiescens accubuisti ut leo, et quasi leæna : quis suscitabit eum?
text_pt: Judá é um leãozinho, da presa subiste, filho meu; encurva-se, e deita-se como um leão, e como um leão velho; quem o despertará?
text_el: σκύμνος λέοντος Ιουδα ἐκ βλαστοῦ υἱέ μου ἀνέβης ἀναπεσὼν ἐκοιμήθης ὡς λέων καὶ ὡς σκύμνος τίς ἐγερεῖ αὐτόν

text_en: The sceptre shall not be taken away from Juda , nor a ruler from his thigh, till he come that is to be sent , and he shall be the expectation of nations.
text_la: Non auferetur sceptrum de Juda, et dux de femore ejus, donec veniat qui mittendus est, et ipse erit expectatio gentium.
text_pt: O cetro não se arredará de Judá, nem o legislador dentre seus pés, até que venha Siló; e a ele se congregarão os povos.
text_el: οὐκ ἐκλείψει ἄρχων ἐξ Ιουδα καὶ ἡγούμενος ἐκ τῶν μηρῶν αὐτοῦ ἕως ἂν ἔλθῃ τὰ ἀποκείμενα αὐτῷ καὶ αὐτὸς προσδοκία ἐθνῶν

text_en: Tying his foal to the vineyard, and his ass, O my son, to the vine. He shall wash his robe in wine, and his garment in the blood of the grape.
text_la: Ligans ad vineam pullum suum, et ad vitem, o fili mi, asinam suam, lavabit in vino stolam suam et in sanguine uvæ pallium suum.
text_pt: Ele amarrará o seu jumentinho à vide, e o filho da sua jumenta à cepa mais excelente; ele lavará a sua roupa no vinho, e a sua capa em sangue de uvas.
text_el: δεσμεύων πρὸς ἄμπελον τὸν πῶλον αὐτοῦ καὶ τῇ ἕλικι τὸν πῶλον τῆς ὄνου αὐτοῦ πλυνεῖ ἐν οἴνῳ τὴν στολὴν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν αἵματι σταφυλῆς τὴν περιβολὴν αὐτοῦ

text_en: His eyes are more beautiful than wine, and his teeth whiter than milk.
text_la: Pulchriores sunt oculi ejus vino, et dentes ejus lacte candidiores.
text_pt: Os olhos serão vermelhos de vinho, e os dentes brancos de leite.
text_el: χαροποὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοὶ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ οἴνου καὶ λευκοὶ οἱ ὀδόντες αὐτοῦ ἢ γάλα

text_en: Zabulon shall dwell on the seashore, and in the road of ships, reaching as far as Sidon .
text_la: Zabulon in littore maris habitabit, et in statione navium pertingens usque ad Sidonem.
text_pt: Zebulom habitará no porto dos mares, e será como porto dos navios, e o seu termo será para Sidom.
text_el: Ζαβουλων παράλιος κατοικήσει καὶ αὐτὸς παρ' ὅρμον πλοίων καὶ παρατενεῖ ἕως Σιδῶνος

text_en: Issachar shall be a strong ass, lying down between the borders.
text_la: Issachar asinus fortis accubans inter terminos.
text_pt: Issacar é jumento de fortes ossos, deitado entre dois fardos.
text_el: Ισσαχαρ τὸ καλὸν ἐπεθύμησεν ἀναπαυόμενος ἀνὰ μέσον τῶν κλήρων

text_en: He saw rest that it was good : and the land that it was excellent: and he bowed his shoulder to carry, and became a servant under tribute.
text_la: Vidit requiem, quod esset bona et terram, quod optima : et supposuit humerum suum ad portandum, factusque est tributis serviens.
text_pt: E viu ele que o descanso era bom, e que a terra era deliciosa e abaixou seu ombro para acarretar, e serviu debaixo de tributo.
text_el: καὶ ἰδὼν τὴν ἀνάπαυσιν ὅτι καλή καὶ τὴν γῆν ὅτι πίων ὑπέθηκεν τὸν ὦμον αὐτοῦ εἰς τὸ πονεῖν καὶ ἐγενήθη ἀνὴρ γεωργός

text_en: Dan shall judge his people like another tribe in Israel .
text_la: Dan judicabit populum suum sicut et alia tribus in Israël.
text_pt: Dã julgará o seu povo, como uma das tribos de Israel.
text_el: Δαν κρινεῖ τὸν ἑαυτοῦ λαὸν ὡσεὶ καὶ μία φυλὴ ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: Let Dan be a snake in the way, a serpent in the path, that bites the horse's heels, that his rider may fall backward.
text_la: Fiat Dan coluber in via, cerastes in semita, mordens ungulas equi, ut cadat ascensor ejus retro.
text_pt: Dã será serpente junto ao caminho, uma víbora junto à vereda, que morde os calcanhares do cavalo, e faz cair o seu cavaleiro por detrás.
text_el: καὶ γενηθήτω Δαν ὄφις ἐφ' ὁδοῦ ἐγκαθήμενος ἐπὶ τρίβου δάκνων πτέρναν ἵππου καὶ πεσεῖται ὁ ἱππεὺς εἰς τὰ ὀπίσω

text_en: I will look for your salvation , O Lord .
text_la: Salutare tuum expectabo, Domine.
text_pt: A tua salvação espero, ó Senhor!
text_el: τὴν σωτηρίαν περιμένω κυρίου

text_en: Gad , being girded, shall fight before him: and he himself shall be girded backward.
text_la: Gad, accinctus præliabatur ante eum : et ipse accingetur retrorsum.
text_pt: Quanto a Gade, uma tropa o acometerá; mas ele a acometerá por fim.
text_el: Γαδ πειρατήριον πειρατεύσει αὐτόν αὐτὸς δὲ πειρατεύσει αὐτῶν κατὰ πόδας

text_en: Aser , his bread shall be fat, and he shall yield dainties to kings.
text_la: Aser, pinguis panis ejus, et præbebit delicias regibus.
text_pt: De Aser, o seu pão será gordo, e ele dará delícias reais.
text_el: Ασηρ πίων αὐτοῦ ὁ ἄρτος καὶ αὐτὸς δώσει τρυφὴν ἄρχουσιν

text_en: Nephthali , a hart let loose, and giving words of beauty.
text_la: Nephthali, cervus emissus, et dans eloquia pulchritudinis.
text_pt: Naftali é uma gazela solta; ele dá palavras formosas.
text_el: Νεφθαλι στέλεχος ἀνειμένον ἐπιδιδοὺς ἐν τῷ γενήματι κάλλος

text_en: Joseph is a growing son, a growing son and comely to behold: the daughters run to and fro upon the wall;
text_la: Filius accrescens Joseph, filius accrescens et decorus aspectu : filiæ discurrerunt super murum.
text_pt: José é um ramo frutífero, ramo frutífero junto à fonte; seus ramos correm sobre o muro.
text_el: υἱὸς ηὐξημένος Ιωσηφ υἱὸς ηὐξημένος ζηλωτός υἱός μου νεώτατος πρός με ἀνάστρεψον

text_en: but they that held darts, provoked him, and quarrelled with him, and envied him.
text_la: Sed exasperaverunt eum et jurgati sunt, invideruntque illi habentes jacula.
text_pt: Os flecheiros lhe deram amargura, e o flecharam e odiaram.
text_el: εἰς ὃν διαβουλευόμενοι ἐλοιδόρουν καὶ ἐνεῖχον αὐτῷ κύριοι τοξευμάτων

text_en: His bow rested upon the strong, and the bands of his arms and his hands were loosed, by the hands of the mighty one of Jacob : thence he came forth a pastor, the stone of Israel .
text_la: Sedit in forti arcus ejus, et dissoluta sunt vincula brachiorum et manuum illius per manus potentis Jacob : inde pastor egressus est, lapis Israël.
text_pt: O seu arco, porém, susteve-se no forte, e os braços de suas mãos foram fortalecidos pelas mãos do Valente de Jacó (de onde é o pastor e a pedra de Israel).
text_el: καὶ συνετρίβη μετὰ κράτους τὰ τόξα αὐτῶν καὶ ἐξελύθη τὰ νεῦρα βραχιόνων χειρῶν αὐτῶν διὰ χεῖρα δυνάστου Ιακωβ ἐκεῖθεν ὁ κατισχύσας Ισραηλ

text_en: The God of your father shall be your helper, and the Almighty shall bless you with the blessings of heaven above, with the blessings of the deep that lies beneath, with the blessings of the breasts and of the womb.
text_la: Deus patris tui erit adjutor tuus, et omnipotens benedicet tibi benedictionibus cæli desuper, benedictionibus abyssi jacentis deorsum, benedictionibus uberum et vulvæ.
text_pt: Pelo Deus de teu pai, o qual te ajudará, e pelo Todo-Poderoso, o qual te abençoará com bênçãos dos altos céus, com bênçãos do abismo que está embaixo, com bênçãos dos seios e da madre.
text_el: παρὰ θεοῦ τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ ἐβοήθησέν σοι ὁ θεὸς ὁ ἐμὸς καὶ εὐλόγησέν σε εὐλογίαν οὐρανοῦ ἄνωθεν καὶ εὐλογίαν γῆς ἐχούσης πάντα ἕνεκεν εὐλογίας μαστῶν καὶ μήτρας

text_en: The blessings of your father are strengthened with the blessings of his fathers: until the desire of the everlasting hills should come: may they be upon the head of Joseph , and upon the crown of the Nazarite among his brethren.
text_la: Benedictiones patris tui confortatæ sunt benedictionibus patrum ejus, donec veniret desiderium collium æternorum : fiant in capite Joseph, et in vertice Nazaræi inter fratres suos.
text_pt: As bênçãos de teu pai excederão as bênçãos de meus pais, até à extremidade dos outeiros eternos; elas estarão sobre a cabeça de José, e sobre o alto da cabeça do que foi separado de seus irmãos.
text_el: εὐλογίας πατρός σου καὶ μητρός σου ὑπερίσχυσεν ἐπ' εὐλογίαις ὀρέων μονίμων καὶ ἐπ' εὐλογίαις θινῶν ἀενάων ἔσονται ἐπὶ κεφαλὴν Ιωσηφ καὶ ἐπὶ κορυφῆς ὧν ἡγήσατο ἀδελφῶν

text_en: Benjamin a ravenous wolf, in the morning shall eat the prey, and in the evening shall divide the spoil.
text_la: Benjamin lupus rapax, mane comedat prædam, et vespere dividet spolia.
text_pt: Benjamim é lobo que despedaça; pela manhã comerá a presa, e à tarde repartirá o despojo.
text_el: Βενιαμιν λύκος ἅρπαξ τὸ πρωινὸν ἔδεται ἔτι καὶ εἰς τὸ ἑσπέρας διαδώσει τροφήν

text_en: All these are the twelve tribes of Israel : these things their father spoke to them, and he blessed every one with their proper blessings .
text_la: Omnes hi in tribubus Israël duodecim : hæc locutus est eis pater suus, benedixitque singulis benedictionibus propriis.
text_pt: Todas estas são as doze tribos de Israel; e isto é o que lhes falou seu pai quando os abençoou; a cada um deles abençoou segundo a sua bênção.
text_el: πάντες οὗτοι υἱοὶ Ιακωβ δώδεκα καὶ ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν αὐτοῖς ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν καὶ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς ἕκαστον κατὰ τὴν εὐλογίαν αὐτοῦ εὐλόγησεν αὐτούς

text_en: And he charged them, saying: I am now going to be gathered to my people : bury me with my fathers in the double cave , which is in the field of Ephron the Hethite ,
text_la: Et præcepit eis, dicens : Ego congregor ad populum meum : sepelite me cum patribus meis in spelunca duplici quæ est in agro Ephron Hethæi,
text_pt: Depois ordenou-lhes, e disse-lhes: Eu me congrego ao meu povo; sepultai-me com meus pais, na cova que está no campo de Efrom, o heteu,
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς ἐγὼ προστίθεμαι πρὸς τὸν ἐμὸν λαόν θάψατέ με μετὰ τῶν πατέρων μου ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ ὅ ἐστιν ἐν τῷ ἀγρῷ Εφρων τοῦ Χετταίου

text_en: over against Mambre, in the land of Chanaan , which Abraham bought together with the field, of Ephron the Hethite , for a possession to bury in.
text_la: contra Mambre in terra Chanaan, quam emit Abraham cum agro ab Ephron Hethæo in possessionem sepulchri.
text_pt: Na cova que está no campo de Macpela, que está em frente de Manre, na terra de Canaã, a qual Abraão comprou com aquele campo de Efrom, o heteu, por herança de sepultura.
text_el: ἐν τῷ σπηλαίῳ τῷ διπλῷ τῷ ἀπέναντι Μαμβρη ἐν τῇ γῇ Χανααν ὃ ἐκτήσατο Αβρααμ τὸ σπήλαιον παρὰ Εφρων τοῦ Χετταίου ἐν κτήσει μνημείου

text_en: There they buried him, and Sara his wife: there was Isaac buried with Rebecca, his wife: there also Lia does lie buried.
text_la: Ibi sepelierunt eum, et Saram uxorem ejus : ibi sepultus est Isaac cum Rebecca conjuge sua : ibi et Lia condita jacet.
text_pt: Ali sepultaram a Abraão e a Sara sua mulher; ali sepultaram a Isaque e a Rebeca sua mulher; e ali eu sepultei a Lia.
text_el: ἐκεῖ ἔθαψαν Αβρααμ καὶ Σαρραν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ ἐκεῖ ἔθαψαν Ισαακ καὶ Ρεβεκκαν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκεῖ ἔθαψα Λειαν

text_en: The purchase of the field and of the cave that {is} therein {was} from the children of Heth.
text_pt: O campo e a cova que está nele, foram comprados aos filhos de Hete.
text_el: ἐν κτήσει τοῦ ἀγροῦ καὶ τοῦ σπηλαίου τοῦ ὄντος ἐν αὐτῷ παρὰ τῶν υἱῶν Χετ

text_en: And when he had ended the commandments, wherewith he instructed his sons, he drew up his feet upon the bed, and died: and he was gathered to his people .
text_la: Finitisque mandatis quibus filios instruebat, collegit pedes suos super lectulum, et obiit : appositusque est ad populum suum.
text_pt: Acabando, pois, Jacó de dar instruções a seus filhos, encolheu os pés na cama, e expirou, e foi congregado ao seu povo.
text_el: καὶ κατέπαυσεν Ιακωβ ἐπιτάσσων τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξάρας τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τὴν κλίνην ἐξέλιπεν καὶ προσετέθη πρὸς τὸν λαὸν αὐτοῦ

text_en: And when Joseph saw this, he fell upon his father's face, weeping and kissing him.
text_la: Quod cernens Joseph, ruit super faciem patris, flens et deosculans eum.
text_pt: Então José se lançou sobre o rosto de seu pai e chorou sobre ele, e o beijou.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιπεσὼν Ιωσηφ ἐπὶ τὸ πρόσωπον τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ ἔκλαυσεν ἐπ' αὐτὸν καὶ ἐφίλησεν αὐτόν

text_en: And he commanded his servants, the physicians, to embalm his father.
text_la: Præcepitque servis suis medicis ut aromatibus condirent patrem.
text_pt: E José ordenou aos seus servos, os médicos, que embalsamassem a seu pai; e os médicos embalsamaram a Israel.
text_el: καὶ προσέταξεν Ιωσηφ τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ τοῖς ἐνταφιασταῖς ἐνταφιάσαι τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐνεταφίασαν οἱ ἐνταφιασταὶ τὸν Ισραηλ

text_en: And while they were fulfilling his commands, there passed forty days: for this was the manner with bodies that were embalmed, and Egypt mourned for him seventy days.
text_la: Quibus jussa explentibus, transierunt quadraginta dies : iste quippe mos erat cadaverum conditorum : flevitque eum Ægyptus septuaginta diebus.
text_pt: E cumpriram-se-lhe quarenta dias; porque assim se cumprem os dias daqueles que se embalsamam; e os egípcios o choraram setenta dias.
text_el: καὶ ἐπλήρωσαν αὐτοῦ τεσσαράκοντα ἡμέρας οὕτως γὰρ καταριθμοῦνται αἱ ἡμέραι τῆς ταφῆς καὶ ἐπένθησεν αὐτὸν Αἴγυπτος ἑβδομήκοντα ἡμέρας

text_en: And the time of the mourning being expired, Joseph spoke to the family of Pharao : If I have found favour in your sight, speak in the ears of Pharao :
text_la: Et expleto planctus tempore, locutus est Joseph ad familiam Pharaonis : Si inveni gratiam in conspectu vestro, loquimini in auribus Pharaonis:
text_pt: Passados, pois, os dias de seu choro, falou José à casa de Faraó, dizendo: Se agora tenho achado graça aos vossos olhos, rogo-vos que faleis aos ouvidos de Faraó, dizendo:
text_el: ἐπειδὴ δὲ παρῆλθον αἱ ἡμέραι τοῦ πένθους ἐλάλησεν Ιωσηφ πρὸς τοὺς δυνάστας Φαραω λέγων εἰ εὗρον χάριν ἐναντίον ὑμῶν λαλήσατε περὶ ἐμοῦ εἰς τὰ ὦτα Φαραω λέγοντες

text_en: For my father made me swear to him, saying: Behold I die; you shall bury me in my sepulchre which I have digged for myself in the land of Chanaan . So I will go up and bury my father, and return.
text_la: eo quod pater meus adjuraverit me dicens : En morior : in sepulchro meo, quod fodi mihi in terra Chanaan, sepelies me. Ascendam igitur, et sepeliam patrem meum, ac revertar.
text_pt: Meu pai me fez jurar, dizendo: Eis que eu morro; em meu sepulcro, que cavei para mim na terra de Canaã, ali me sepultarás. Agora, pois, te peço, que eu suba, para que sepulte a meu pai; então voltarei.
text_el: ὁ πατήρ μου ὥρκισέν με λέγων ἐν τῷ μνημείῳ ᾧ ὤρυξα ἐμαυτῷ ἐν γῇ Χανααν ἐκεῖ με θάψεις νῦν οὖν ἀναβὰς θάψω τὸν πατέρα μου καὶ ἐπανελεύσομαι

text_en: And Pharao said to him: Go up and bury your father according as he made you swear .
text_la: Dixitque ei Pharao : Ascende, et sepeli patrem tuum sicut adjuratus es.
text_pt: E Faraó disse: Sobe, e sepulta a teu pai como ele te fez jurar.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Φαραω ἀνάβηθι θάψον τὸν πατέρα σου καθάπερ ὥρκισέν σε

text_en: So he went up, and there went with him all the ancients of Pharao's house, and all the elders of the land of Egypt .
text_la: Quo ascendente, ierunt cum eo omnes senes domus Pharaonis, cunctique majores natu terræ Ægypti:
text_pt: E José subiu para sepultar a seu pai; e subiram com ele todos os servos de Faraó, os anciãos da sua casa, e todos os anciãos da terra do Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέβη Ιωσηφ θάψαι τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ καὶ συνανέβησαν μετ' αὐτοῦ πάντες οἱ παῖδες Φαραω καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ πάντες οἱ πρεσβύτεροι τῆς γῆς Αἰγύπτου

text_en: And the house of Joseph with his brethren, except their children, and their flocks and herds, which they left in the land of Gessen.
text_la: domus Joseph cum fratribus suis, absque parvulis, et gregibus atque armentis, quæ dereliquerant in terra Gessen.
text_pt: Como também toda a casa de José, e seus irmãos, e a casa de seu pai; somente deixaram na terra de Gósen os seus meninos, e as suas ovelhas e as suas vacas.
text_el: καὶ πᾶσα ἡ πανοικία Ιωσηφ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσα ἡ οἰκία ἡ πατρικὴ αὐτοῦ καὶ τὴν συγγένειαν καὶ τὰ πρόβατα καὶ τοὺς βόας ὑπελίποντο ἐν γῇ Γεσεμ

text_en: He had also in his train chariots and horsemen: and it was a great company.
text_la: Habuit quoque in comitatu currus et equites : et facta est turba non modica.
text_pt: E subiram também com ele, tanto carros como gente a cavalo; e o cortejo foi grandíssimo.
text_el: καὶ συνανέβησαν μετ' αὐτοῦ καὶ ἅρματα καὶ ἱππεῖς καὶ ἐγένετο ἡ παρεμβολὴ μεγάλη σφόδρα

text_en: And they came to the threshing floor of Atad , which is situated beyond the Jordan : where celebrating the exequies with a great and vehement lamentation, they spent full seven days.
text_la: Veneruntque ad Aream Atad, quæ sita est trans Jordanem : ubi celebrantes exequias planctu magno atque vehementi impleverunt septem dies.
text_pt: Chegando eles, pois, à eira de Atade, que está além do Jordão, fizeram um grande e dolorido pranto; e fez a seu pai uma grande lamentação por sete dias.
text_el: καὶ παρεγένοντο ἐφ' ἅλωνα Αταδ ὅ ἐστιν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου καὶ ἐκόψαντο αὐτὸν κοπετὸν μέγαν καὶ ἰσχυρὸν σφόδρα καὶ ἐποίησεν τὸ πένθος τῷ πατρὶ αὐτοῦ ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας

text_en: And when the inhabitants of Chanaan saw this, they said: This is a great mourning to the Egyptians . And therefore the name of that place was called, The mourning of Egypt .
text_la: Quod cum vidissent habitatores terræ Chanaan, dixerunt : Planctus magnus est iste Ægyptiis. Et idcirco vocatum est nomen loci illius, Planctus Ægypti.
text_pt: E vendo os moradores da terra, os cananeus, o luto na eira de Atade, disseram: É este o pranto grande dos egípcios. Por isso chamou-se-lhe Abel-Mizraim, que está além do Jordão.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον οἱ κάτοικοι τῆς γῆς Χανααν τὸ πένθος ἐν ἅλωνι Αταδ καὶ εἶπαν πένθος μέγα τοῦτό ἐστιν τοῖς Αἰγυπτίοις διὰ τοῦτο ἐκάλεσεν τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ Πένθος Αἰγύπτου ὅ ἐστιν πέραν τοῦ Ιορδάνου

text_en: So the sons of Jacob did as he had commanded them.
text_la: Fecerunt ergo filii Jacob sicut præceperat eis:
text_pt: E fizeram-lhe os seus filhos assim como ele lhes ordenara.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν ἐκεῖ

text_en: And carrying him into the land of Chanaan , they buried him in the double cave , which Abraham had bought together with the field for a possession of a burying place, of Ephron, the Hethite , over against Mambre.
text_la: et portantes eum in terram Chanaan, sepelierunt eum in spelunca duplici, quam emerat Abraham cum agro in possessionem sepulchri ab Ephron Hethæo, contra faciem Mambre.
text_pt: Pois os seus filhos o levaram à terra de Canaã, e o sepultaram na cova do campo de Macpela, que Abraão tinha comprado com o campo, por herança de sepultura de Efrom, o heteu, em frente de Manre.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέλαβον αὐτὸν οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ εἰς γῆν Χανααν καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ σπήλαιον τὸ διπλοῦν ὃ ἐκτήσατο Αβρααμ τὸ σπήλαιον ἐν κτήσει μνημείου παρὰ Εφρων τοῦ Χετταίου κατέναντι Μαμβρη

text_en: And Joseph returned into Egypt with his brethren, and all that were in his company, after he had buried his father.
text_la: Reversusque est Joseph in Ægyptum cum fratribus suis, et omni comitatu, sepulto patre.
text_pt: Depois de haver sepultado seu pai, voltou José para o Egito, ele e seus irmãos, e todos os que com ele subiram a sepultar seu pai.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστρεψεν Ιωσηφ εἰς Αἴγυπτον αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ οἱ συναναβάντες θάψαι τὸν πατέρα αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now he being dead, his brethren were afraid, and talked one with another: Lest perhaps he should remember the wrong he suffered, and requite us all the evil that we did to him.
text_la: Quo mortuo, timentes fratres ejus, et mutuo colloquentes : Ne forte memor sit injuriæ quam passus est, et reddat nobis omne malum quod fecimus,
text_pt: Vendo então os irmãos de José que seu pai já estava morto, disseram: Porventura nos odiará José e certamente nos retribuirá todo o mal que lhe fizemos.
text_el: ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ Ιωσηφ ὅτι τέθνηκεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῶν εἶπαν μήποτε μνησικακήσῃ ἡμῖν Ιωσηφ καὶ ἀνταπόδομα ἀνταποδῷ ἡμῖν πάντα τὰ κακά ἃ ἐνεδειξάμεθα αὐτῷ

text_en: And they sent a message to him, saying: Your father commanded us before he died,
text_la: mandaverunt ei dicentes: Pater tuus præcepit nobis antequam moreretur,
text_pt: Portanto mandaram dizer a José: Teu pai ordenou, antes da sua morte, dizendo:
text_el: καὶ παρεγένοντο πρὸς Ιωσηφ λέγοντες ὁ πατήρ σου ὥρκισεν πρὸ τοῦ τελευτῆσαι αὐτὸν λέγων

text_en: that we should say thus much to you from him: I beseech you to forget the wickedness of your brethren, and the sin and malice they practised against you: we also pray you, to forgive the servants of the God of your father this wickedness . And when Joseph heard this, he wept.
text_la: ut hæc tibi verbis illius diceremus : Obsecro ut obliviscaris sceleris fratrum tuorum, et peccati atque malitiæ quam exercuerunt in te : nos quoque oramus ut servis Dei patris tui dimittas iniquitatem hanc. Quibus auditis flevit Joseph.
text_pt: Assim direis a José: Perdoa, rogo-te, a transgressão de teus irmãos, e o seu pecado, porque te fizeram mal; agora, pois, rogamos-te que perdoes a transgressão dos servos do Deus de teu pai. E José chorou quando eles lhe falavam.
text_el: οὕτως εἴπατε Ιωσηφ ἄφες αὐτοῖς τὴν ἀδικίαν καὶ τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτῶν ὅτι πονηρά σοι ἐνεδείξαντο καὶ νῦν δέξαι τὴν ἀδικίαν τῶν θεραπόντων τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ πατρός σου καὶ ἔκλαυσεν Ιωσηφ λαλούντων αὐτῶν πρὸς αὐτόν

text_en: And his brethren came to him; and worshipping prostrate on the ground, they said: We are your servants.
text_la: Veneruntque ad eum fratres sui : et proni adorantes in terram, dixerunt : Servi tui sumus.
text_pt: Depois vieram também seus irmãos, e prostraram-se diante dele, e disseram: Eis-nos aqui por teus servos.
text_el: καὶ ἐλθόντες πρὸς αὐτὸν εἶπαν οἵδε ἡμεῖς σοι οἰκέται

text_en: And he answered them: Fear not: can we resist the will of God ?
text_la: Quibus ille respondit : Nolite timere : num Dei possumus resistere voluntati?
text_pt: E José lhes disse: Não temais; porventura estou eu em lugar de Deus?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ιωσηφ μὴ φοβεῖσθε τοῦ γὰρ θεοῦ εἰμι ἐγώ

text_en: You thought evil against me: but God turned it into good , that he might exalt me, as at present you see, and might save many people .
text_la: Vos cogitastis de me malum : sed Deus vertit illud in bonum, ut exaltaret me, sicut in præsentiarum cernitis, et salvos faceret multos populos.
text_pt: Vós bem intentastes mal contra mim; porém Deus o intentou para bem, para fazer como se vê neste dia, para conservar muita gente com vida.
text_el: ὑμεῖς ἐβουλεύσασθε κατ' ἐμοῦ εἰς πονηρά ὁ δὲ θεὸς ἐβουλεύσατο περὶ ἐμοῦ εἰς ἀγαθά ὅπως ἂν γενηθῇ ὡς σήμερον ἵνα διατραφῇ λαὸς πολύς

text_en: Fear not: I will feed you and your children. And he comforted them, and spoke gently and mildly.
text_la: Nolite timere : ego pascam vos et parvulos vestros : consolatusque est eos, et blande ac leniter est locutus.
text_pt: Agora, pois, não temais; eu vos sustentarei a vós e a vossos filhos. Assim os consolou, e falou segundo o coração deles.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς μὴ φοβεῖσθε ἐγὼ διαθρέψω ὑμᾶς καὶ τὰς οἰκίας ὑμῶν καὶ παρεκάλεσεν αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐλάλησεν αὐτῶν εἰς τὴν καρδίαν

text_en: And he dwelt in Egypt with all his father's house; and lived a hundred and ten years.
text_la: Et habitavit in Ægypto cum omni domo patris sui : vixitque centum decem annis.
text_pt: José, pois, habitou no Egito, ele e a casa de seu pai; e viveu José cento e dez anos.
text_el: καὶ κατῴκησεν Ιωσηφ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ πᾶσα ἡ πανοικία τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔζησεν Ιωσηφ ἔτη ἑκατὸν δέκα

text_en: And he saw the children of Ephraim to the third generation . The children also of Machir, the sons of Manasses , were born on Joseph's knees.
text_la: Et vidit Ephraim filios usque ad tertiam generationem. Filii quoque Machir filii Manasse nati sunt in genibus Joseph.
text_pt: E viu José os filhos de Efraim, da terceira geração; também os filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, nasceram sobre os joelhos de José.
text_el: καὶ εἶδεν Ιωσηφ Εφραιμ παιδία ἕως τρίτης γενεᾶς καὶ υἱοὶ Μαχιρ τοῦ υἱοῦ Μανασση ἐτέχθησαν ἐπὶ μηρῶν Ιωσηφ

text_en: After which he told his brethren: God will visit you after my death, and will make you go up out of this land, to the land which he swore to Abraham , Isaac , and Jacob .
text_la: Quibus transactis, locutus est fratribus suis : Post mortem meam Deus visitabit vos, et ascendere vos faciet de terra ista ad terram quam juravit Abraham, Isaac et Jacob.
text_pt: E disse José a seus irmãos: Eu morro; mas Deus certamente vos visitará, e vos fará subir desta terra à terra que jurou a Abraão, a Isaque e a Jacó.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιωσηφ τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτοῦ λέγων ἐγὼ ἀποθνῄσκω ἐπισκοπῇ δὲ ἐπισκέψεται ὑμᾶς ὁ θεὸς καὶ ἀνάξει ὑμᾶς ἐκ τῆς γῆς ταύτης εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν ὤμοσεν ὁ θεὸς τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν Αβρααμ καὶ Ισαακ καὶ Ιακωβ

text_en: And he made them swear to him, saying: God will visit you, carry my bones with you out of this place:
text_la: Cumque adjurasset eos atque dixisset : Deus visitabit vos, asportate ossa mea vobiscum de loco isto:
text_pt: E José fez jurar os filhos de Israel, dizendo: Certamente vos visitará Deus, e fareis transportar os meus ossos daqui.
text_el: καὶ ὥρκισεν Ιωσηφ τοὺς υἱοὺς Ισραηλ λέγων ἐν τῇ ἐπισκοπῇ ᾗ ἐπισκέψεται ὑμᾶς ὁ θεός καὶ συνανοίσετε τὰ ὀστᾶ μου ἐντεῦθεν μεθ' ὑμῶν

text_en: And he died, being a hundred and ten years old. And being embalmed, he was laid in a coffin in Egypt .
text_la: mortuus est, expletis centum decem vitæ suæ annis. Et conditus aromatibus, repositus est in loculo in Ægypto.
text_pt: E morreu José da idade de cento e dez anos, e o embalsamaram e o puseram num caixão no Egito.
text_el: καὶ ἐτελεύτησεν Ιωσηφ ἐτῶν ἑκατὸν δέκα καὶ ἔθαψαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἔθηκαν ἐν τῇ σορῷ ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ
